    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u.u_vp, false, vp);
    const planes = frustumPlanes(vp),
      R2 = (D * 1.42 + 24) * (D * 1.42 + 24);
    const list = this.casList || (this.casList = []);
    list.length = 0;
    for (const s of r.sections.values()) {
      if (!s.o) continue;
      const dx = s.x + 8 - at[0],
        dz = s.z + 8 - at[2];
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz > R2) continue;
      if (!aabbInFrustum(planes, s.x, s.y, s.z, s.x + 16, s.y + 16, s.z + 16)) continue;
      list.push(s);
    }
    // by mesh page: depth only, the order changes nothing drawn, and each page's VAO binds once (render.js secDraw;
    // in the sections' order it was a bind per section, ~1 000 for the far cascade)
    list.sort((a, b) => a.o.a.pg.id - b.o.a.pg.id);
    r.secDraw(P, list, true, false);
  }
  // before the translucent pass: snapshot colour + depth for reflections / the water's depth
  copyScene() {
    const gl = this.r.gl,
      [W, H] = this.size;
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.READ_FRAMEBUFFER, this.sceneFB);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, this.copyFB);
    gl.blitFramebuffer(0, 0, W, H, 0, 0, W, H, gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, this.sceneFB);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE6);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.copyColor);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE7);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.copyDepth);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    this.copied = true;
  }
  pass(P, tgt, setup) {
    const gl = this.r.gl;
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, tgt ? tgt.fb : null);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, tgt ? tgt.w : this.size[0], tgt ? tgt.h : this.size[1]);
    gl.useProgram(P.p);
    let unit = 0;
    const bind = (name, tex) => {
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + unit);
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
      gl.bindSampler(unit, null);
      if (P.u[name]) gl.uniform1i(P.u[name], unit);
      unit++;
    };
    if (P.u.u_texel) gl.uniform2f(P.u.u_texel, 1 / (tgt ? tgt.w : this.size[0]), 1 / (tgt ? tgt.h : this.size[1]));
    if (P.u.u_nf) gl.uniform2f(P.u.u_nf, this.r.near, this.r.far);
    if (P.u.u_invVP) gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u.u_invVP, false, this.invVP);
    if (P.u.u_cam) gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_cam, this.r.camPos);
    if (P.u.u_frame) gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_frame, this.taa ? this.frameN % 64 : 0);
    setup(bind, P);
    gl.bindVertexArray(this.r.emptyVao);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
  }
  // after the world (and hand) is drawn: post chain to the screen
  end() {
    const r = this.r,
      gl = r.gl,
      cfg = this.cfg,
      [W, H] = this.size,
      A = this.A,
      env = this.env,
      game = this.game;
    r.fxOn = false;
    // the passes below bind their own textures on units 0 - 5: whatever draws after them (previews, icons) binds the
    // terrain / entity programs' textures again (render.js ufState / bindFrameTex: once an epoch)
    r.ufEpoch = (r.ufEpoch || 0) + 1;
    if (!this.copied) this.copyScene();
    this.copied = false;
    gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.depthMask(false);
    const color = this.sceneColor,
      depth = this.sceneDepth;
    const hw = Math.max(1, W >> 1),
      hh = Math.max(1, H >> 1);
    let vol = null,
      clouds = null;
    if (cfg.vl && this.shadowOn && A.vl[0] + A.vl[1] + A.vl[2] > 0.002) {
      const a = this.target('vol', hw, hh, 'hdr');
      this.pass(this.pVol, a, (bind, P) => {
        bind('u_depth', depth);
        gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE5);
        gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, this.shadowTex);
        gl.bindSampler(5, this.cmpSampler);
        gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_shadow, 5);
        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u['u_shadowVP[0]'], false, this.shadowVP.subarray(0, 48));
        gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_sunDir, this.sunDir);
        gl.uniform1fv(P.u['u_shadowRange[0]'], this.shadowRange.subarray(0, 3));
        gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_vlCol, A.vl);
        gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_samples, cfg.vl);
        gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_maxD, Math.max(128, this.renderD * 0.98));
        gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_shadowD, cfg.casc[2]);
        gl.uniform4f(P.u.u_vlK, A.rainyNight, this.eyeSky, A.sunVis > 0.5 ? 1 : 0, A.rain * A.rain);
      });
      gl.bindSampler(5, null);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE5);
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, null);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
      vol = a.tex;
    }
    if (this.cloudsOn) {
      const t = this.target('clouds', hw, hh, 'hdr');
      this.pass(this.pCloud, t, (bind, P) => {
        bind('u_depth', depth);
        bind('u_cloudNoise', this.cloudNoiseTex());
        this.setSky(P);
        gl.uniform4fv(P.u.u_cloud, this.cloud);
        gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_cAmb, A.cAmb);
        gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_cLight, A.cLight);
      });
      clouds = t.tex;
    }
    // A: sky, fog, clouds, light shafts -> linear HDR
    const lin = this.target('lin', W, H, 'hdr'),
      black = this.blackTex();
    const skyOn = env.sky === 'overworld' && !game.headInWater && !game.headInLava ? 1 : 0;
    this.pass(this.pCompose, lin, (bind, P) => {
      var _r$frameTime3;
      bind('u_color', color);
      bind('u_depth', depth);
      bind('u_depthO', this.copyDepth);
      bind('u_clouds', clouds || black);
      bind('u_vol', vol || black);
      bind('u_noise', this.noiseTex());
      this.setSky(P);
      gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_useClouds, clouds ? 1 : 0);
      gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_useVol, vol ? 1 : 0);
      gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_skyOn, skyOn);
      gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_fogOn, !this.special && env.sky === 'overworld' ? 1 : 0);
      gl.uniform2f(P.u.u_cloudSlab, this.cloud[1] - 16, this.cloud[1] + 16);
      gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_sunDisc, A.sunDisc);
      gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_renderD, Math.max(32, this.renderD - 12));
      gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_yOff, r.yOff || 0);
      gl.uniform4f(P.u.u_fogK, A.rain, this.eyeSky, A.cave, A.vsB);
      gl.uniform4f(P.u.u_atmK, 1 - A.night, A.sunVis2, A.noon, A.sunFactor);
      gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_nightUp, A.nightUp);
      gl.uniform3fv(P.u.u_dayDownFog, A.dayDownFog);
      gl.uniform4f(P.u.u_misc, A.rainbow, game.headInWater ? 1 : 0, A.aurora, this.special ? 0 : A.bloomFog);
      gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_time, (_r$frameTime3 = r.frameTime) !== null && _r$frameTime3 !== void 0 ? _r$frameTime3 : performance.now() % 10000000);
    });
    // bloom: 1/2 (weighted by the bloom haze), then 1/4 .. 1/64 summed back up
    const b0 = this.target('b0', hw, hh, 'hdr');
    this.pass(this.pDown0, b0, bind => bind('u_src', lin.tex));
    const chain = [b0];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const prev = chain[i - 1],
        t = this.target('b' + i, Math.max(1, prev.w >> 1), Math.max(1, prev.h >> 1), 'hdr');
      this.pass(this.pDown, t, bind => bind('u_src', prev.tex));
      chain.push(t);
    }
    for (let i = 5; i >= 2; i--) {
      const src = chain[i],
        dst = this.target('u' + (i - 1), chain[i - 1].w, chain[i - 1].h, 'hdr');
      this.pass(this.pUp, dst, bind => {
        bind('u_src', src.tex);
        bind('u_add', chain[i - 1].tex);
      });
      chain[i - 1] = dst;
    }
    const bloom = chain[1].tex;
    // B: grade into LDR
    const ldr = this.target('ldr', W, H, 'ldr');
    this.pass(this.pGrade, ldr, (bind, P) => {
      bind('u_src', lin.tex);
      bind('u_bloom', bloom);
      gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_bloomK, 0.12);
    });
    let out = ldr;
    if (this.taa) {
      const cur = this.target('hist' + this.histI, W, H, 'ldr'),
        prev = this.target('hist' + (1 - this.histI), W, H, 'ldr');
      this.pass(this.pTAA, cur, (bind, P) => {
        bind('u_cur', ldr.tex);
        bind('u_hist', prev.tex);
        bind('u_depth', depth);
        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u.u_invVPU, false, this.invVPU);
        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u.u_prevVP, false, this.prevVP);
        gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_reset, this.histOK ? 0 : 1);
      });
      this.histOK = true;
      this.histI = 1 - this.histI;
      out = cur;
    } else this.histOK = false;
    this.prevVP.set(this.vpU);
    this.pass(this.pFinal, null, (bind, P) => {
      bind('u_src', out.tex);
      gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_fxaa, this.taa ? 0 : 1);
      gl.uniform1f(P.u.u_sharp, this.taa ? 0.25 : 0.125);
    });
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, W, H);
    gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.depthMask(true);
    gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) gl.bindSampler(i, null);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
  }
  blackTex() {
    if (!this._black) {
      const gl = this.r.gl;
      this._black = gl.createTexture();
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this._black);
      gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA8, 1, 1, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, new Uint8Array([0, 0, 0, 0]));
    }
    return this._black;
  }
}
function smoothstep01(a, b, x) {
  const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}
function normalize3(v) {
  const l = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1;
  return [v[0] / l, v[1] / l, v[2] / l];
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/audio.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Procedural sound effects (WebAudio, no sound files). There is no music: the background music and the music
// discs were taken out (user, 2026-10-29) - jukeboxes take discs but play nothing.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Sound = {
  ctx: null,
  master: null,
  sfx: null,
  noiseBuf: null,
  volume: 0.8,
  listener: {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    z: 0,
    yaw: 0
  },
  init() {
    if (this.ctx) {
      if (this.idle) this.wake();else if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
      return;
    }
    // iPhones: web audio follows the ring / silent switch unless the page says it plays media (iOS 16.4+), or plays
    // through an <audio> element once (older) - with the switch on silent the game had no sound while videos did
    try {
      if (navigator.audioSession) navigator.audioSession.type = 'playback';else if (/iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) || /Macintosh/.test(navigator.userAgent) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1) {
        const a = this.unmute = document.createElement('audio');
        a.setAttribute('x-webkit-airplay', 'deny');
        a.preload = 'auto';
        a.loop = true;
        a.src = 'data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRigAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAAIhYAQACABAAZGF0YQQAAAAAAAAA';
        const pr = a.play();
        if (pr && pr.catch) pr.catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      this.ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    } catch (e) {
      return;
    }
    const c = this.ctx;
    this.master = c.createGain();
    this.master.gain.value = 1;
    this.master.connect(c.destination);
    this.sfx = c.createGain();
    this.sfx.gain.value = this.volume;
    this.sfx.connect(this.master);
    const len = c.sampleRate * 2;
    this.noiseBuf = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate);
    const d = this.noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    if (this.packReady && this.predecode) this.predecode();
    this.watch();
  },
  setVolume(v) {
    this.volume = v;
    if (this.sfx) this.sfx.gain.value = v;
  },
  // spatial output node
  out(pos, vol = 1) {
    const c = this.ctx;
    const g = c.createGain();
    let v = vol;
    if (pos) {
      const L = this.listener,
        dx = pos[0] - L.x,
        dy = pos[1] - L.y,
        dz = pos[2] - L.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
      v *= Math.max(0, 1 - d / 20);
      if (v <= 0.001) return null;
      if (c.createStereoPanner) {
        const p = c.createStereoPanner();
        const right = dx * Math.cos(L.yaw) - dz * Math.sin(L.yaw);
        p.pan.value = clamp(right / (d + 0.5), -1, 1) * 0.7;
        g.connect(p);
        p.connect(this.sfx);
      } else g.connect(this.sfx);
    } else g.connect(this.sfx);
    g.gain.value = v;
    return g;
  },
  noise(pos, {
    dur = 0.15,
    vol = 0.5,
    type = 'bandpass',
    freq = 1000,
    q = 1,
    freqEnd,
    attack = 0.005,
    delay = 0
  }) {
    if (!this.ctx || this.idle) return;
    const c = this.ctx,
      o = this.out(pos, vol);
    if (!o) return;
    const t = c.currentTime + delay;
    const src = c.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = this.noiseBuf;
    src.playbackRate.value = 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
    f.type = type;
    f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    f.Q.value = q;
    if (freqEnd) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freqEnd, t + dur);
    const g = c.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1, t + attack);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
    src.connect(f);
    f.connect(g);
    g.connect(o);
    src.start(t, Math.random() * 1.5);
    src.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
  },
  tone(pos, {
    freq = 440,
    freqEnd,
    dur = 0.2,
    vol = 0.3,
    type = 'sine',
    attack = 0.01,
    delay = 0,
    dest
  }) {
    if (!this.ctx || this.idle) return;
    const c = this.ctx,
      o = dest || this.out(pos, vol);
    if (!o) return;
    const t = c.currentTime + delay;
    const osc = c.createOscillator();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    if (freqEnd) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freqEnd, t + dur);
    const g = c.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(dest ? vol : 1, t + attack);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + dur);
    osc.connect(g);
    g.connect(o);
    osc.start(t);
    osc.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
  },
  MAT: {
    stone: {
      freq: 900,
      q: 0.8,
      dur: 0.12,
      type: 'bandpass'
    },
    wood: {
      freq: 450,
      q: 2.5,
      dur: 0.13,
      type: 'bandpass'
    },
    grass: {
      freq: 2400,
      q: 0.5,
      dur: 0.14,
      type: 'highpass'
    },
    gravel: {
      freq: 1300,
      q: 0.6,
      dur: 0.16,
      type: 'bandpass'
    },
    sand: {
      freq: 3000,
      q: 0.4,
      dur: 0.16,
      type: 'highpass'
    },
    snow: {
      freq: 3500,
      q: 0.4,
      dur: 0.18,
      type: 'highpass'
    },
    glass: {
      freq: 3500,
      q: 3,
      dur: 0.1,
      type: 'bandpass'
    },
    wool: {
      freq: 600,
      q: 0.4,
      dur: 0.15,
      type: 'lowpass'
    },
    metal: {
      freq: 2000,
      q: 6,
      dur: 0.15,
      type: 'bandpass'
    }
  },
  block(kind, mat, pos) {
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const m = this.MAT[mat] || this.MAT.stone;
    if (kind === 'step') this.noise(pos, {
      ...m,
      vol: 0.18,
      dur: m.dur * 0.8
    });else if (kind === 'hit') this.noise(pos, {
      ...m,
      vol: 0.22,
      dur: m.dur * 0.6
    });else if (kind === 'place') {
      this.noise(pos, {
        ...m,
        vol: 0.55,
        freq: m.freq * 0.8
      });
      if (mat === 'wood') this.tone(pos, {
        freq: 180,
        freqEnd: 120,
        dur: 0.08,
        vol: 0.25,
        type: 'triangle'
      });
    } else if (kind === 'break') {
      this.noise(pos, {
        ...m,
        vol: 0.7,
        dur: m.dur * 1.6
      });
      this.noise(pos, {
        ...m,
        vol: 0.4,
        dur: m.dur * 1.2,
        delay: 0.04,
        freq: m.freq * 0.7
      });
      if (mat === 'glass') for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.tone(pos, {
        freq: 2000 + Math.random() * 3000,
        dur: 0.15,
        vol: 0.12,
        delay: i * 0.03,
        type: 'sine'
      });
    }
  },
  pop(pos) {
    this.tone(pos, {
      freq: 600 + Math.random() * 300,
      freqEnd: 1400 + Math.random() * 300,
      dur: 0.08,
      vol: 0.25,
      type: 'sine'
    });
  },
  click() {
    this.tone(null, {
      freq: 800,
      freqEnd: 500,
      dur: 0.05,
      vol: 0.25,
      type: 'square'
    });
  },
  hurt(pos) {
    this.tone(pos, {
      freq: 330,
      freqEnd: 180,
      dur: 0.18,
      vol: 0.4,
      type: 'sawtooth'
    });
    this.noise(pos, {
      freq: 600,
      dur: 0.12,
      vol: 0.3,
      type: 'lowpass'
    });
  },
  explode(pos) {
    this.noise(pos, {
      type: 'lowpass',
      freq: 1500,
      freqEnd: 60,
      dur: 1.8,
      vol: 1.2,
      q: 0.5
    });
    this.noise(pos, {
      type: 'lowpass',
      freq: 300,
      freqEnd: 40,
      dur: 2.5,
      vol: 1.0,
      q: 0.3
    });
  },
  fuse(pos) {
    this.noise(pos, {
      type: 'highpass',
      freq: 4000,
      dur: 1.2,
      vol: 0.4,
      attack: 0.05
    });
  },
  fizz(pos) {
    this.noise(pos, {
      type: 'highpass',
      freq: 3000,
      dur: 0.5,
      vol: 0.4
    });
  },
  splash(pos) {
    this.noise(pos, {
      type: 'lowpass',
      freq: 2000,
      freqEnd: 300,
      dur: 0.5,
      vol: 0.5
    });
  },
  eat(pos) {
    this.noise(pos, {
      type: 'bandpass',
      freq: 900 + Math.random() * 400,
      q: 1.5,
      dur: 0.1,
      vol: 0.45
    });
  },
  burp(pos) {
    this.tone(pos, {
      freq: 120,
      freqEnd: 80,
      dur: 0.3,
      vol: 0.4,
      type: 'sawtooth'
    });
  },
  bow(pos) {
    this.tone(pos, {
      freq: 300,
      freqEnd: 900,
      dur: 0.15,
      vol: 0.3,
      type: 'triangle'
    });
    this.noise(pos, {
      freq: 2000,
      dur: 0.15,
      vol: 0.2
    });
  },
  arrowHit(pos) {
    this.noise(pos, {
      freq: 800,
      dur: 0.08,
      vol: 0.4,
      q: 2
    });
  },
  door(pos, open) {
    this.tone(pos, {
      freq: open ? 200 : 160,
      freqEnd: open ? 140 : 100,
      dur: 0.18,
      vol: 0.4,
      type: 'triangle'
    });
    this.noise(pos, {
      freq: 500,
      q: 3,
      dur: 0.15,
      vol: 0.3
    });
  },
  levelup() {
    [0, 4, 7, 12].forEach((n, i) => this.tone(null, {
      freq: 523 * Math.pow(2, n / 12),
      dur: 0.35,
      vol: 0.18,
      type: 'triangle',
      delay: i * 0.09
    }));
  },
  toast() {
    [0, 7].forEach((n, i) => this.tone(null, {
      freq: 880 * Math.pow(2, n / 12),
      dur: 0.3,
      vol: 0.15,
      type: 'sine',
      delay: i * 0.12
    }));
  },
  note(pos, pitch) {
    this.tone(pos, {
      freq: 185 * Math.pow(2, pitch / 12),
      dur: 0.8,
      vol: 0.4,
      type: 'triangle'
    });
  },
  mob(type, kind, pos) {
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const r = Math.random();
    switch (type) {
      case 'pig':
        this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 260 + r * 60,
          freqEnd: 180,
          dur: 0.25,
          vol: 0.35,
          type: 'sawtooth'
        });
        this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 240,
          freqEnd: 160,
          dur: 0.2,
          vol: 0.25,
          type: 'square',
          delay: 0.15
        });
        break;
      case 'cow':
        this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 140 + r * 20,
          freqEnd: 110,
          dur: 0.9,
          vol: 0.4,
          type: 'sawtooth',
          attack: 0.1
        });
        break;
      case 'sheep':
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 420 + r * 50,
          freqEnd: 400,
          dur: 0.12,
          vol: 0.25,
          type: 'sawtooth',
          delay: i * 0.1
        });
        break;
      case 'chicken':
        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 1100 + r * 300,
          freqEnd: 700,
          dur: 0.08,
          vol: 0.2,
          type: 'square',
          delay: i * 0.12
        });
        break;
      case 'zombie':
        this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 110 + r * 30,
          freqEnd: 80,
          dur: 0.9,
          vol: 0.45,
          type: 'sawtooth',
          attack: 0.15
        });
        this.noise(pos, {
          freq: 300,
          dur: 0.8,
          vol: 0.2,
          type: 'lowpass',
          attack: 0.1
        });
        break;
      case 'skeleton':
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.noise(pos, {
          freq: 2500,
          q: 5,
          dur: 0.05,
          vol: 0.35,
          delay: i * 0.07
        });
        break;
      case 'creeper':
        this.fuse(pos);
        break;
      case 'spider':
        this.noise(pos, {
          freq: 1200,
          q: 4,
          dur: 0.3,
          vol: 0.3
        });
        this.tone(pos, {
          freq: 90,
          dur: 0.3,
          vol: 0.2,
          type: 'sawtooth'
        });
        break;
    }
    if (kind === 'hurt') this.tone(pos, {
      freq: 500,
      freqEnd: 250,
      dur: 0.12,
      vol: 0.2,
      type: 'square'
    });
  }
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vanilla sound events (built from the local game assets by tools/build_sounds.py).
// Served over http the page only loads the event list (js/sound_events.js) and fetches each file
// (sounds/sfx/<name>.ogg) the first time it plays; opened from file://, where fetch is not allowed, it loads
// js/sounds.js with every file embedded (20 MB of text that stayed in memory).
// Falls back to the synthesized sounds above when the pack is missing.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sounds decode on first use into a size-capped cache (least recently used goes first): decoding all 1316
// files up front held ~230 MB of PCM.
const SOUND_CACHE_BYTES = 32 << 20;
Object.assign(Sound, {
  buffers: new Map(),
  pending: new Map(),
  packReady: false,
  cacheBytes: 0,
  // WebKit (every browser on an iPhone, the Bilibili app there, Safari on a Mac) did not decode Ogg until lately -
  // iPhones had no sound at all (players' feedback 2026-10-31): the effects are AAC (sounds/sfx/<name>.m4a), which
  // every browser decodes; the Toy package carries only those (both doubled its files and Bilibili's upload timed
  // out). A browser that can't decode AAC switches to the Ogg files where they are (decode)
  ext: '.m4a',
  loadPack() {
    if (window.SOUNDS) {
      this.packReady = true;
      this.predecode();
      return;
    }
    const embedded = location.protocol === 'file:';
    const s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([(window.__SOUND_EVENTS_RAW||'')],{type:'text/javascript'}));
    s.onload = () => {
      if (!embedded && window.SOUND_EVENTS) window.SOUNDS = {
        events: SOUND_EVENTS,
        files: null
      };
      this.packReady = !!window.SOUNDS;
      this.predecode();
    };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  },
  cached(name) {
    const b = this.buffers.get(name);
    if (b) {
      this.buffers.delete(name);
      this.buffers.set(name, b);
    } // most recently used last
    return b;
  },
  remember(name, buf) {
    this.buffers.set(name, buf);
    this.cacheBytes += buf.length * buf.numberOfChannels * 4;
    for (const [k, b] of this.buffers) {
      if (this.cacheBytes <= SOUND_CACHE_BYTES) break;
      this.buffers.delete(k);
      this.cacheBytes -= b.length * b.numberOfChannels * 4;
    }
  },
  decode(name) {
    const have = this.cached(name);
    if (have) return Promise.resolve(have);
    if (this.pending.has(name)) return this.pending.get(name);
    if (!window.SOUNDS || !this.ctx) return Promise.resolve(null);
    let data;
    if (SOUNDS.files) {
      const b64 = SOUNDS.files[name];
      if (!b64) return Promise.resolve(null);
      const bin = atob(b64),
        arr = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) arr[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      data = Promise.resolve(arr.buffer);
    } else data = fetch('sounds/sfx/' + name + this.ext).then(r => r.ok ? r.arrayBuffer() : null);
    const dec = ab => ab && new Promise(res => this.ctx.decodeAudioData(ab, res, () => res(null)));
    let came = false;
    const p = data.then(ab => {
      came = !!ab;
      return dec(ab);
    }).catch(() => null)
    // a file that came but would not decode: this browser can't read that kind, the other kind from now on
    .then(buf => {
      if (buf || !came || SOUNDS.files || this.switched) return buf;
      this.switched = true;
      this.ext = this.ext === '.m4a' ? '.ogg' : '.m4a';
      return fetch('sounds/sfx/' + name + this.ext).then(r => r.ok ? r.arrayBuffer() : null).then(dec).catch(() => null);
    }).then(buf => {
      this.pending.delete(name);
      if (buf) this.remember(name, buf);
      return buf;
    });
    this.pending.set(name, p);
    return p;
  },
  // warm the cache with the sounds heard all the time (footsteps, digging, hits, clicks), so they aren't late
  async predecode() {
    if (!this.ctx || !this.packReady || this._predecoding) return;
    this._predecoding = true;
    const names = new Set();
    for (const ev in SOUNDS.events) {
      if (!/^(block\.(stone|grass|wood|gravel|sand|dirt|deepslate)\.(step|break|place|hit)|entity\.player\.(hurt|attack\.\w+)|entity\.generic\.eat|ui\.button\.click|entity\.item\.pickup)$/.test(ev)) continue;
      for (const s of SOUNDS.events[ev]) names.add(s.name);
    }
    const list = [...names];
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i += 8) await Promise.all(list.slice(i, i + 8).map(n => this.decode(n)));
  },
  // play a vanilla sound event; returns false when unavailable so callers can fall back
  ev(event, pos, vol = 1, pitch = 1) {
    if (!this.ctx || !this.packReady) return false;
    const list = SOUNDS.events[event];
    if (!list || !list.length) return false;
    if (this.idle) return true; // (asleep: dropped, not queued - Sound.sleep)
    if (this.onPlay) this.onPlay(event, pos, vol); // (subtitles)
    let total = 0;
    for (const s of list) total += s.weight || 1;
    let r = Math.random() * total,
      pick = list[0];
    for (const s of list) {
      r -= s.weight || 1;
      if (r <= 0) {
        pick = s;
        break;
      }
    }
    const play = buf => {
      var _pick$volume, _pick$pitch;
      if (!buf) return;
      const o = this.out(pos, Math.min(1, vol * ((_pick$volume = pick.volume) !== null && _pick$volume !== void 0 ? _pick$volume : 1)), Math.max(16, 16 * vol));
      if (!o) return;
      const src = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
      src.buffer = buf;
      src.playbackRate.value = clamp(pitch * ((_pick$pitch = pick.pitch) !== null && _pick$pitch !== void 0 ? _pick$pitch : 1), 0.5, 2);
      src.connect(o);
      src.start();
    };
    const buf = this.cached(pick.name);
    if (buf) play(buf);else {
      const t = performance.now();
      this.decode(pick.name).then(b => {
        if (performance.now() - t < 250) play(b);
      });
    }
    return true;
  },
  rr() {
    return Math.random() - Math.random();
  }
});

// spatial output with configurable range (replaces the original 20-block falloff)
Sound.out = function (pos, vol = 1, range = 20) {
  const c = this.ctx;
  const g = c.createGain();
  let v = vol;
  if (pos) {
    const L = this.listener,
      dx = pos[0] - L.x,
      dy = pos[1] - L.y,
      dz = pos[2] - L.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
    v *= Math.max(0, 1 - d / range);
    if (v <= 0.001) return null;
    if (c.createStereoPanner) {
      const p = c.createStereoPanner();
      const right = dx * Math.cos(L.yaw) - dz * Math.sin(L.yaw);
      p.pan.value = clamp(right / (d + 0.5), -1, 1) * 0.7;
      g.connect(p);
      p.connect(this.sfx);
    } else g.connect(this.sfx);
  } else g.connect(this.sfx);
  g.gain.value = v;
  return g;
};

// the sound of putting on a piece of armor (its equippable component's equip_sound)
const ARMOR_EQUIP = {
  leather: 'leather',
  chainmail: 'chain',
  iron: 'iron',
  golden: 'gold',
  diamond: 'diamond',
  netherite: 'netherite',
  copper: 'copper'
};
function armorEquipSound(k) {
  if (k === 'elytra') return 'item.armor.equip_elytra';
  if (k === 'turtle_helmet') return 'item.armor.equip_turtle';
  const m = /^([a-z]+)_(helmet|chestplate|leggings|boots)$/.exec(k);
  return 'item.armor.equip_' + (m && ARMOR_EQUIP[m[1]] || 'generic');
}
// a looping sound whose place, volume and pitch the caller sets every tick (vanilla's tickable sound instances: a
// minecart rolling). pos null: not placed (heard as is). One left without updates for half a second stops itself
Sound.loops = new Set();
Sound.loop = function (event) {
  const S = this,
    h = {
      update() {},
      stop() {}
    };
  const list = window.SOUNDS && SOUNDS.events[event];
  if (!S.ctx || !S.packReady || !list || !list.length || S.idle) return h;
  const pick = list[0],
    c = S.ctx,
    g = c.createGain(),
    pan = c.createStereoPanner ? c.createStereoPanner() : null;
  g.gain.value = 0;
  if (pan) {
    g.connect(pan);
    pan.connect(S.sfx);
  } else g.connect(S.sfx);
  let src = null,
    dead = false,
    last = performance.now(),
    rate = 1;
  S.decode(pick.name).then(buf => {
    if (!buf || dead) return;
    src = c.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = buf;
    src.loop = true;
    src.playbackRate.value = rate;
    src.connect(g);
    src.start();
  });
  h.update = (pos, vol, pitch) => {
    var _pick$volume2, _pick$pitch2;
    last = performance.now();
    let v = vol * ((_pick$volume2 = pick.volume) !== null && _pick$volume2 !== void 0 ? _pick$volume2 : 1),
      p = 0;
    if (pos) {
      const L = S.listener,
        dx = pos[0] - L.x,
        dy = pos[1] - L.y,
        dz = pos[2] - L.z,
        d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
      v *= Math.max(0, 1 - d / 16);
      p = clamp((dx * Math.cos(L.yaw) - dz * Math.sin(L.yaw)) / (d + 0.5), -1, 1) * 0.7;
    }
    g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v, c.currentTime, 0.05);
    if (pan) pan.pan.value = p;
    rate = clamp(pitch * ((_pick$pitch2 = pick.pitch) !== null && _pick$pitch2 !== void 0 ? _pick$pitch2 : 1), 0.5, 2);
    if (src) src.playbackRate.value = rate;
  };
  h.live = true;
  h.stop = () => {
    if (dead) return;
    dead = true;
    h.live = false;
    S.loops.delete(h);
    if (src) try {
      src.stop();
    } catch (e) {}
    g.disconnect();
  };
  h.stale = () => performance.now() - last > 500;
  S.loops.add(h);
  // (the sweep runs only while there are loops: it went on 4 times a second for good after the first minecart ride)
  if (!S.loopSweep) S.loopSweep = setInterval(() => {
    for (const l of S.loops) if (l.stale()) l.stop();
    if (!S.loops.size) {
      clearInterval(S.loopSweep);
      S.loopSweep = 0;
    }
  }, 250);
  return h;
};

// ---- the audio device asleep while nothing can be heard: the page hidden, or a pausing screen over a frozen world
// (single player) for 5 s with no loop playing. A running AudioContext keeps the audio output and its thread going,
// silent or not - battery on a phone. One-shot sounds meanwhile are dropped (they would all come at once on waking);
// a tap or key (Sound.init: a menu button's click plays), the world going on or the page shown again wake it ----
Object.assign(Sound, {
  idle: null,
  pauseT: 0,
  sleep(why) {
    if (this.idle || !this.ctx) return;
    this.idle = why;
    try {
      this.ctx.suspend().catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  wake() {
    if (!this.idle) return;
    this.idle = null;
    this.pauseT = performance.now();
    try {
      this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  watch() {
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) this.sleep('hidden');else if (this.idle === 'hidden') this.wake();
    });
    setInterval(() => {
      const g = typeof game !== 'undefined' && game,
        sc = g && g.ui && g.ui.screen,
        now = performance.now();
      if (!(g && g.state === 'play' && sc && sc.pauses && !g.net && !g.p2pHost && !g.p2pGuest)) {
        this.pauseT = now;
        if (this.idle === 'pause') this.wake();
        return;
      }
      if (!this.idle && !this.loops.size && now - this.pauseT > 5000) this.sleep('pause');
    }, 1000);
  }
});
(() => {
  const S = Sound,
    wrap = (name, fn) => {
      const orig = S[name];
      S[name] = function (...a) {
        if (fn.apply(this, a) !== false) return;
        return orig.apply(this, a);
      };
    };
  // (the sound types without events of their own name use others': vanilla SoundType HARD_CROP, GLOW_LICHEN, LILY_PAD,
  // fire as wool, bee nests as wood)
  const MAT_MAP = {
    stone: 'stone',
    wood: 'wood',
    grass: 'grass',
    gravel: 'gravel',
    sand: 'sand',
    snow: 'snow',
    glass: 'glass',
    wool: 'wool',
    metal: 'metal',
    netherrack: 'netherrack',
    nether_bricks: 'nether_bricks',
    soul_sand: 'soul_sand',
    hard_crop: 'wood',
    glow_lichen: 'vine',
    lily_pad: 'big_dripleaf',
    fire: 'wool',
    beehive: 'wood'
  };
  wrap('block', function (kind, mat, pos) {
    if (mat === 'lily_pad' && kind === 'place') return this.ev('block.lily_pad.place', pos, 1, 0.8);
    // vanilla sound groups (data-driven blocks) play their own events when the pack has them
    const m = MAT_MAP[mat] || (window.SOUNDS && SOUNDS.events['block.' + mat + '.' + kind] ? mat : /grass|moss|leaves|sapling|vine|lichen|berry|dripleaf|roots|azalea|blossom|petals|litter|flower|lily|crop|fungus|sprouts/.test(mat) ? 'grass' : /wood|stem|bamboo|beehive/.test(mat) ? 'wood' : 'stone');
    const P = {
      break: [1, 0.8],
      step: [0.15, 1],
      place: [1, 0.8],
      hit: [0.25, 0.5],
      fall: [0.5, 0.75]
    }[kind] || [1, 1];
    return this.ev('block.' + m + '.' + kind, pos, P[0], P[1]);
  });
  wrap('pop', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.item.pickup', pos, 0.2, (this.rr() * 0.7 + 1) * 2);
  });
  wrap('click', function () {
    return this.ev('ui.button.click', null, 0.25, 1);
  });
  wrap('hurt', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.player.hurt', pos, 1, 1 + this.rr() * 0.2);
  });
  wrap('explode', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.generic.explode', pos, 4, (1 + this.rr() * 0.2) * 0.7);
  });
  wrap('fuse', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.tnt.primed', pos, 1, 1);
  });
  wrap('fizz', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('block.lava.extinguish', pos, 0.5, 2.6 + this.rr() * 0.8);
  });
  wrap('splash', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.player.splash', pos, 0.6, 1 + this.rr() * 0.4);
  });
  wrap('eat', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.generic.eat', pos, 0.5, 1 + this.rr() * 0.4);
  });
  wrap('burp', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.player.burp', pos, 0.5, Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9);
  });
  wrap('bow', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.arrow.shoot', pos, 1, 1 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 1.2) + 0.5);
  });
  wrap('arrowHit', function (pos) {
    return this.ev('entity.arrow.hit', pos, 1, 1.2 / (Math.random() * 0.2 + 0.9));
  });
  // doors, trapdoors and fence gates by their block's set (vanilla BlockSetType / WoodType sounds): iron, copper, cherry,
  // bamboo, nether wood; all played the wooden door's before
  wrap('door', function (pos, open, key) {
    const k = key || '',
      kind = /trapdoor$/.test(k) ? 'trapdoor' : /fence_gate$/.test(k) ? 'fence_gate' : 'door';
    const set = /^iron_/.test(k) ? 'iron' : /copper/.test(k) ? 'copper' : /^cherry_/.test(k) ? 'cherry_wood' : /^bamboo_/.test(k) ? 'bamboo_wood' : /^(crimson|warped)_/.test(k) ? 'nether_wood' : '';
    const name = set ? set + '_' + kind : kind === 'fence_gate' ? 'fence_gate' : 'wooden_' + kind;
    return this.ev('block.' + name + (open ? '.open' : '.close'), pos, 1, Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9);
  });
  wrap('levelup', function () {
    return this.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.75, 1);
  });
  // a toast sliding in (and ui.toast.out when it leaves: ui.js); vanilla's challenge advancements add challenge_complete
  wrap('toast', function () {
    return this.ev('ui.toast.in', null, 1, 1);
  });
  wrap('note', function (pos, n) {
    return this.ev('block.note_block.harp', pos, 3, Math.pow(2, (n - 12) / 12));
  });
  // mobs that use another one's sounds, and ambient sounds under another name (vanilla getAmbientSound / getHurtSound)
  const MOB_SOUND_AS = {
    trader_llama: 'llama',
    mooshroom: 'cow',
    cave_spider: 'spider',
    giant: 'zombie',
    pufferfish: 'puffer_fish'
  };
  const MOB_IDLE = {
    sniffer: 'idle',
    turtle: 'ambient_land',
    axolotl: 'idle_air',
    allay: 'ambient_without_item',
    breeze: 'idle_ground'
  };
  wrap('mob', function (type, kind, pos) {
    if (type === 'creeper' && kind === 'idle') return true;
    const k = kind === 'idle' ? MOB_IDLE[type] || 'ambient' : kind;
    type = MOB_SOUND_AS[type] || type;
    const vol = type === 'ghast' || type === 'ender_dragon' ? 5 : 1;
    return this.ev('entity.' + type + '.' + k, pos, vol, 1 + this.rr() * 0.2);
  });
  // a mob's calls, hurt and death sounds decoded as soon as one comes near: a sound not ready within 250 ms is
  // dropped, and a mob's few, rare calls each came out silent the first time - "生物不会发出声音" (feedback 10-31)
  S.warmMob = function (type) {
    if (!this.ctx || !this.packReady || (this._warmed || (this._warmed = new Set())).has(type)) return;
    this._warmed.add(type);
    const t = MOB_SOUND_AS[type] || type,
      re = new RegExp('^entity\\.' + t + '\\.(ambient\\w*|idle\\w*|hurt|death)$'),
      names = [];
    for (const ev in SOUNDS.events) if (re.test(ev)) for (const s of SOUNDS.events[ev]) names.push(s.name);
    (async () => {
      for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i += 4) await Promise.all(names.slice(i, i + 4).map(n => this.decode(n)));
    })();
  };
  S.xp = function () {
    if (!this.ev('entity.experience_orb.pickup', null, 0.1, 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.9)) this.tone(null, {
      freq: 1200 + Math.random() * 400,
      dur: 0.12,
      vol: 0.12,
      type: 'sine'
    });
  };
  S.chest = function (pos, open) {
    if (!this.ev(open ? 'block.chest.open' : 'block.chest.close', pos, 0.5, Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9)) this.door(pos, open);
  };
})();
</script>
