      this.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
      this.bodyYaw = this.yaw;
      this.charge++;
      if (this.charge === 10) Sound.ev('entity.ghast.warn', this.pos, 5, 1);
      if (this.charge >= 20) {
        const fx = -Math.sin(this.yaw),
          fz = -Math.cos(this.yaw);
        const sx = this.pos[0] + fx * 2.2,
          sy = this.pos[1] + 2,
          sz = this.pos[2] + fz * 2.2;
        const ex = p.pos[0] - sx,
          ey = p.pos[1] + 1 - sy,
          ez = p.pos[2] - sz,
          l = Math.hypot(ex, ey, ez);
        g.addEntity(new Fireball(g, sx, sy, sz, [ex / l * 0.7, ey / l * 0.7, ez / l * 0.7], this, false));
        Sound.ev('entity.ghast.shoot', this.pos, 5, 1);
        this.charge = -40;
      }
    } else if (this.charge > 0) this.charge--;else if (this.charge < 0) this.charge++;
    this.fly(this.goal[0], this.goal[1], this.goal[2], 0.006, 0.92);
    if (this.collidedH) this.goal = null;
    // without a target it faces where it flies (vanilla Ghast.faceMovementDirection); it kept its last yaw and often
    // drifted backwards
    if (!sees && Math.hypot(this.vel[0], this.vel[2]) > 1e-3) {
      this.yaw = Math.atan2(-this.vel[0], -this.vel[2]);
      this.bodyYaw = this.yaw;
    }
    this.animate();
  }
  pose(a) {
    // vanilla GhastModel.animateTentacles: xRot 0.4 +- 0.2, the tips trailing backwards (negated in this model's space -
    // positive swung them forward)
    const P = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) P['t' + i] = {
      rx: -(0.2 * Math.sin((this.age + a) * 0.3 + i) + 0.4)
    };
    return P;
  }
}
class MagmaCube extends Mob {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, size = 4) {
    super(g, 'magma_cube', x, y, z);
    this.setSize(size);
    this.jumpDelay = 20;
    this.squish = 0;
    this.prevSquish = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  setSize(s) {
    this.size = s;
    this.w = this.h = 0.52 * s;
    this.health = this.maxHealth = s * s;
  }
  die(src) {
    super.die(src);
    if (this.size > 1) {
      for (let i = 0, n = 2 + (Math.random() * 3 | 0); i < n; i++) {
        const c = new MagmaCube(this.game, this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, this.size / 2);
        this.game.addEntity(c);
      }
      if (Math.random() < 0.25) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], makeStack('magma_cream', 1));
    }
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.baseTick();
    if (this.deathTick()) return;
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      dP = this.distTo(p);
    if (!this.persistent && dP > 100 || randomDespawn(this)) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    this.prevSquish = this.squish;
    this.squish *= 0.6;
    const playerOk = p.deathTime === 0 && !p.creative;
    this.target = playerOk && dP < seenWithin(p, 16) ? p : null;
    if (this.target) {
      const dx = p.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
        dz = p.pos[2] - this.pos[2];
      this.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
    } else if (Math.random() < 0.02) this.yaw += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
    if (this.onGround) {
      this.vel[0] *= 0.5;
      this.vel[2] *= 0.5;
      if (this.wasAir) {
        this.squish = -0.5;
        Sound.ev('entity.magma_cube.squish', this.pos, 1, 1);
        this.wasAir = false;
      }
      if (--this.jumpDelay <= 0) {
        this.jumpDelay = this.target ? 10 + (Math.random() * 10 | 0) : 20 + (Math.random() * 40 | 0);
        const sp = 0.1 + this.size * 0.04;
        this.vel[1] = 0.42 + this.size * 0.1;
        this.vel[0] = -Math.sin(this.yaw) * sp;
        this.vel[2] = -Math.cos(this.yaw) * sp;
        this.squish = 1;
        Sound.ev('entity.magma_cube.jump', this.pos, 1, 1);
      }
    } else this.wasAir = true;
    this.move(this.vel[0], this.vel[1], this.vel[2]);
    this.vel[1] = (this.vel[1] - 0.08) * 0.98;
    if (this.attackCd > 0) this.attackCd--;
    if (this.target && this.attackCd <= 0) {
      const a = this.box(),
        b = p.box();
      if (a[0] < b[3] && a[3] > b[0] && a[1] < b[4] && a[4] > b[1] && a[2] < b[5] && a[5] > b[2]) {
        this.attackCd = 20;
        p.hurt([3, 3, 4, 4, 6][this.size] || 3, {
          type: 'mob',
          attacker: this,
          knockFrom: this.pos
        });
      }
    }
    this.bodyYaw = this.yaw;
  }
}

// ---- Projectiles ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Fireball extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, vel, owner, small) {
    super(g, x, y, z, small ? 0.3125 : 1, small ? 0.3125 : 1);
    this.vel = vel;
    this.owner = owner;
    this.small = small;
    this.hittable = !small;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.small || !src || !src.attacker) return false;
    const att = src.attacker;
    const d = att === this.game.player ? this.game.lookDir() : [this.pos[0] - att.pos[0], 0, this.pos[2] - att.pos[2]];
    const l = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]) || 1;
    this.vel = [d[0] / l * 0.9, d[1] / l * 0.9, d[2] / l * 0.9];
    this.owner = att;
    this.deflected = true;
    return true;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.age > 300) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel,
      steps = 4;
    const ents = g.entities.concat([g.player]); // (once a tick: it copied the whole list at each of its 4 steps)
    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
      const nx = this.pos[0] + v[0] / steps,
        ny = this.pos[1] + v[1] / steps,
        nz = this.pos[2] + v[2] / steps;
      for (const e of ents) {
        if (e === this || e === this.owner || e.dead || !(e instanceof Living) || e.deathTime > 0) continue;
        if (this.owner instanceof Ghast && e instanceof Ghast) continue;
        const b = e.box(),
          r = this.w / 2;
        if (nx > b[0] - r && nx < b[3] + r && ny > b[1] - r && ny < b[4] + r && nz > b[2] - r && nz < b[5] + r) {
          this.impact(e);
          return;
        }
      }
      const id = this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz));
      if (id && BLOCKS[id].solid) {
        this.impact(null, [Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz)]);
        return;
      }
      this.pos[0] = nx;
      this.pos[1] = ny;
      this.pos[2] = nz;
    }
    if (this.age % 2 === 0) g.particles.spawn('smoke', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h / 2, this.pos[2], 0, 0.01, 0);
  }
  impact(e, block) {
    const g = this.game;
    this.dead = true;
    if (this.small) {
      if (e) {
        if (!e.fireproof) {
          e.hurt(5, {
            type: 'fireball',
            attacker: this.owner,
            knockFrom: this.pos
          });
          e.fire = Math.max(e.fire || 0, 100);
        }
      } else if (block) {
        const px = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
          py = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
          pz = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
        if ((!(this.owner instanceof Mob) || g.rule('mob_griefing') !== false) && this.world.getBlock(px, py, pz) === 0 && SOLIDCUBE[this.world.getBlock(px, py - 1, pz)]) this.world.setBlock(px, py, pz, g.fireIdAt(px, py, pz), 0);
      }
      Sound.ev('block.fire.extinguish', this.pos, 0.3, 1.5);
      return;
    }
    if (e && this.owner && e !== this.owner) e.hurt(6, {
      type: 'fireball',
      attacker: this.owner,
      knockFrom: this.pos
    });
    if (e instanceof Ghast && this.deflected && this.owner === g.player) {
      e.hurt(1000, {
        type: 'fireball',
        attacker: g.player,
        player: true
      });
      g.grant('return_sender');
    }
    g.explode(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], 1, this.owner && this.owner.T ? this.owner : null, false, true, true);
  }
}
class DragonFireball extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, vel, owner) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 1, 1);
    this.vel = vel;
    this.owner = owner;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.age > 300) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel;
    for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
      const nx = this.pos[0] + v[0] / 4,
        ny = this.pos[1] + v[1] / 4,
        nz = this.pos[2] + v[2] / 4;
      const p = g.player,
        b = p.box();
      const hitP = nx > b[0] - 0.5 && nx < b[3] + 0.5 && ny > b[1] - 0.5 && ny < b[4] + 0.5 && nz > b[2] - 0.5 && nz < b[5] + 0.5;
      const id = this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz));
      if (hitP || id && BLOCKS[id].solid || ny < 0) {
        this.burst();
        return;
      }
      this.pos[0] = nx;
      this.pos[1] = ny;
      this.pos[2] = nz;
    }
    const pp = g.particles.spawn('breath', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05);
  }
  burst() {
    this.dead = true;
    const g = this.game;
    let y = this.pos[1];
    const fx = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      fz = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    for (let k = 0; k < 8 && y > 1 && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(fx, Math.floor(y - 0.5), fz)].solid; k++) y -= 1;
    g.addEntity(new AreaCloud(g, this.pos[0], Math.floor(y), this.pos[2], 3, 200, this.owner));
    Sound.ev('entity.dragon_fireball.explode', this.pos, 1, 1);
  }
}
class AreaCloud extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, r, life, owner) {
    super(g, x, y, z, r * 2, 0.5);
    this.radius = r;
    this.life = life;
    this.owner = owner;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const g = this.game,
      k = 1 - this.age / this.life,
      r = this.radius * (0.5 + 0.5 * k);
    if (this.age >= this.life) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        d = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * r;
      g.particles.spawn('breath', this.pos[0] + Math.cos(a) * d, this.pos[1] + 0.1, this.pos[2] + Math.sin(a) * d, 0, 0.02, 0);
    }
    if (this.age % 20 === 0) {
      const p = g.player;
      if (Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - this.pos[0], p.pos[2] - this.pos[2]) < r && Math.abs(p.pos[1] - this.pos[1]) < 2) p.hurt(4, {
        type: 'magic',
        attacker: this.owner
      });
    }
  }
}
class ThrownPearl extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, vel, owner) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.25, 0.25);
    this.vel = vel;
    this.owner = owner;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel,
      steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) / 0.3));
    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
      const nx = this.pos[0] + v[0] / steps,
        ny = this.pos[1] + v[1] / steps,
        nz = this.pos[2] + v[2] / steps;
      let hit = null;
      for (const e of g.entities) {
        if (e === this || !(e instanceof Living) || e.deathTime > 0) continue;
        const b = e.box();
        if (nx > b[0] && nx < b[3] && ny > b[1] && ny < b[4] && nz > b[2] && nz < b[5]) {
          hit = e;
          break;
        }
      }
      const id = this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz));
      if (hit || id && BLOCKS[id].solid || ny < -60) {
        if (hit) hit.hurt(0.01, {
          type: 'pearl',
          attacker: this.owner
        });
        this.land();
        return;
      }
      this.pos[0] = nx;
      this.pos[1] = ny;
      this.pos[2] = nz;
    }
    v[0] *= 0.99;
    v[1] = v[1] * 0.99 - 0.03;
    v[2] *= 0.99;
    if (this.age % 2 === 0) g.particles.spawn('portal', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], 0, 0, 0);
  }
  land() {
    this.dead = true;
    const g = this.game,
      p = this.owner;
    particleBurst(g, 'portal', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], 32, 1);
    if (p !== g.player || p.deathTime > 0 || this.pos[1] < -60) return;
    // back off from the surface a little so the player doesn't end up inside a block
    p.pos = [this.pos[0] - this.vel[0] * 0.3, this.pos[1] - Math.max(0, this.vel[1]) * 0.3, this.pos[2] - this.vel[2] * 0.3];
    let guard = 0;
    while (p.collides(p.box()) && guard++ < 4) p.pos[1] += 0.5;
    p.prev = [...p.pos];
    p.vel = [0, 0, 0];
    p.fallDist = 0;
    if (!p.creative) p.hurt(5, {
      type: 'fall'
    });
    Sound.ev('entity.enderman.teleport', p.pos, 1, 1);
  }
}
class EyeOfEnder extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, tx, tz) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.25, 0.25);
    const dx = tx - x,
      dz = tz - z,
      d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d > 12) {
      this.tx = x + dx / d * 12;
      this.tz = z + dz / d * 12;
      this.ty = y + 8;
    } else {
      this.tx = tx;
      this.tz = tz;
      this.ty = y;
    }
    this.survive = Math.random() > 0.2;
    Sound.ev('entity.ender_eye.launch', this.pos, 1, 1);
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel;
    const dx = this.tx - this.pos[0],
      dz = this.tz - this.pos[2],
      hd = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    let sp = Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]);
    const tsp = lerp(sp, hd, 0.0025);
    let vy = v[1];
    if (hd < 1) {
      sp *= 0.8;
      vy *= 0.8;
    }
    const a = Math.atan2(dz, dx);
    v[0] = Math.cos(a) * Math.max(tsp, 0.05);
    v[2] = Math.sin(a) * Math.max(tsp, 0.05);
    v[1] = vy + ((this.pos[1] < this.ty ? 1 : -1) - vy) * 0.015;
    this.pos[0] += v[0];
    this.pos[1] += v[1];
    this.pos[2] += v[2];
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) g.particles.spawn('portal', this.pos[0] - v[0] * 0.25 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, this.pos[1] - v[1] * 0.25 - 0.2, this.pos[2] - v[2] * 0.25 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1);
    if (this.age > 80) {
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.ender_eye.death', this.pos, 1, 1);
      if (this.survive) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], makeStack('ender_eye', 1), [0, 0.1, 0]);else {
        particleBurst(g, 'portal', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], 20, 0.5);
        Sound.block('break', 'glass', this.pos);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ---- End crystal ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class EndCrystal extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 2, 2);
    this.hittable = true;
    this.spin = Math.random() * 100;
    this.showBase = true;
    this.type = 'end_crystal';
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.dead) return false;
    this.dead = true;
    const g = this.game;
    const dragon = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof EnderDragon && e.healer === this);
    g.explode(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], 6, this, false, false);
    if (dragon) {
      dragon.healer = null;
      dragon.hurtRaw(10, {
        type: 'explosion',
        attacker: src && src.attacker
      });
    }
    return true;
  }
}

// ---- Ender Dragon --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class EnderDragon extends Living {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 8, 4, 200);
    this.type = 'ender_dragon';
    this.T = {
      cn: '末影龙',
      hostile: true,
      drops: [],
      model: 'dragon'
    };
    this.noClip = true;
    this.persistent = true;
    this.fireproof = true;
    this.alwaysTick = true;
    this.phase = 'circle';
    this.phaseT = 0;
    this.circleA = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    this.circleDir = 1;
    this.hist = [];
    this.flap = 0;
    this.prevFlap = 0;
    this.healer = null;
    this.perchDamage = 0;
    this.yaw = 0;
    this.pitchD = 0;
    this.speed = 0.6;
    this.stepHeight = 0;
  }
  box() {
    return [this.pos[0] - 4, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] - 4, this.pos[0] + 4, this.pos[1] + 4, this.pos[2] + 4];
  }
  // hit boxes: head (full damage), body, wings, tail (quarter damage)
  parts() {
    const s = Math.sin(this.yaw),
      c = Math.cos(this.yaw),
      x = this.pos[0],
      y = this.pos[1],
      z = this.pos[2];
    const at = (fwd, side, up, hw, hh) => [x - s * fwd + c * side - hw, y + up, z - c * fwd - s * side - hw, x - s * fwd + c * side + hw, y + up + hh, z - c * fwd - s * side + hw];
    const hp = this.headPos || [x - s * 6.5, y + 2, z - c * 6.5];
    return [{
      box: [hp[0] - 1, hp[1] - 0.5, hp[2] - 1, hp[0] + 1, hp[1] + 1.5, hp[2] + 1],
      mult: 1,
      head: true
    }, {
      box: at(0, 0, 0.5, 2.5, 3),
      mult: 0.25
    }, {
      box: at(0, 4.5, 2, 2, 2),
      mult: 0.25
    }, {
      box: at(0, -4.5, 2, 2, 2),
      mult: 0.25
    }, {
      box: at(-7, 0, 1.5, 1.5, 2),
      mult: 0.25
    }, {
      box: at(-11, 0, 1.5, 1.2, 2),
      mult: 0.25
    }];
  }
  hurtPart(part, amount, src) {
    if (this.deathTime > 0) return false;
    let a = part.head ? amount : amount * 0.25 + 1;
    if (src && src.type !== 'explosion' && !(src.attacker === this.game.player || src.player)) return false;
    // (vanilla AbstractDragonSittingPhase.onHurt: perched, it takes nothing from arrows and tridents - they bounce off)
    if (this.phase === 'perch' && src && (src.type === 'arrow' || src.type === 'trident')) {
      src.deflected = true;
      return false;
    }
    if (this.phase === 'perch') this.perchDamage += a;
    return this.hurtRaw(a, src);
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    return this.hurtPart({
      mult: 0.25
    }, a, src);
  }
  hurtRaw(a, src) {
    if (this.deathTime > 0) return false;
    if (this.invuln > 10) return false;
    this.invuln = 20;
    this.hurtTime = 10;
    this.health -= a;
    Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.hurt', this.pos, 5, 1);
    if (this.phase === 'perch' && this.perchDamage > 50) this.setPhase('takeoff');
    if (this.health <= 0) {
      this.health = 0;
      this.deathTime = 1;
      Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.death', this.pos, 10, 1);
    }
    return true;
  }
  setPhase(ph) {
    this.phase = ph;
    this.phaseT = 0;
    if (ph === 'perch') this.perchDamage = 0;
  }
  perchPoint() {
    const w = this.world;
    return [0.5, (w.podiumY && w.endTop0 !== undefined ? w.podiumY() : (w.endTop0 || 60) + 2) + 3.5, 0.5];
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.invuln > 0) this.invuln--;
    if (this.hurtTime > 0) this.hurtTime--;
    this.prevFlap = this.flap;
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player;
    this.hist.unshift([this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], this.yaw]);
    if (this.hist.length > 64) this.hist.length = 64;
    if (this.deathTime > 0) {
      this.deathTime++;
      this.pos[1] += 0.1;
      this.flap += 0.02;
      if (this.deathTime > 150 && this.deathTime % 5 === 0) particleBurst(g, 'explosion', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], 2, 8);
      if (this.deathTime >= 200) {
        this.dead = true;
        g.onDragonKilled(this);
      }
      return;
    }
    // crystal healing
    if (this.age % 10 === 0) {
      if (!this.healer || this.healer.dead) {
        this.healer = null;
        let bd = 32;
        for (const e of g.entities) if (e instanceof EndCrystal && !e.dead) {
          const d = e.distTo(this);
          if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            this.healer = e;
          }
        }
      }
      if (this.healer && this.healer.distTo(this) > 40) this.healer = null;
      if (this.healer && this.health < this.maxHealth) this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 1);
    }
    const sp = this.flapSpeed();
    this.flap += sp;
    if (Math.floor(this.flap) !== Math.floor(this.prevFlap)) Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.flap', this.pos, 5, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.3);
    if (this.age % 200 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.growl', this.pos, 5, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.3);
    const playerOk = p.deathTime === 0 && !p.creative && g.dim === 'end';
    this.phaseT++;
    let target,
      speed = 0.6;
    let crystals = 0;
    for (const e of g.entities) if (e instanceof EndCrystal && !e.dead) crystals++; // (counted, not a new list each tick)
    switch (this.phase) {
      case 'circle':
        {
          this.circleA += 0.008 * this.circleDir;
          const R = 70;
          target = [Math.cos(this.circleA) * R, 95 + Math.sin(this.circleA * 3) * 10, Math.sin(this.circleA) * R];
          // (landing does not wait for a player to attack - vanilla's holding pattern lands for anyone, creative
          // too; here it never came down for a creative player, "末影龙一直在天上飞都不下来", feedback 2026-11-01/02)
          if (this.phaseT > 60 && this.age % 20 === 0) {
            const r = Math.random();
            if (r < 1 / (crystals + 3)) this.setPhase('land');else if (!playerOk) {} else if (r < 0.25) this.setPhase('strafe');else if (r < 0.32) this.setPhase('charge');else if (r < 0.34) this.circleDir *= -1;
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'strafe':
        {
          if (!playerOk) {
            this.setPhase('circle');
            break;
          }
          target = [p.pos[0], Math.max(p.pos[1] + 18, 75), p.pos[2]];
          const d = Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - this.pos[0], p.pos[2] - this.pos[2]);
          const look = [-Math.sin(this.yaw), -Math.cos(this.yaw)],
            to = [(p.pos[0] - this.pos[0]) / d, (p.pos[2] - this.pos[2]) / d];
          if (d < 64 && look[0] * to[0] + look[1] * to[1] > 0.85 && this.phaseT > 20) {
            const hp = this.headPos || this.pos;
            const ex = p.pos[0] - hp[0],
              ey = p.pos[1] + 1 - hp[1],
              ez = p.pos[2] - hp[2],
              l = Math.hypot(ex, ey, ez);
            g.addEntity(new DragonFireball(g, hp[0], hp[1], hp[2], [ex / l * 1.2, ey / l * 1.2, ez / l * 1.2], this));
            Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.shoot', this.pos, 5, 1);
            this.setPhase('circle');
          }
          if (this.phaseT > 300) this.setPhase('circle');
          break;
        }
      case 'charge':
        if (!playerOk) {
          this.setPhase('circle');
          break;
        }
        target = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + 1, p.pos[2]];
        speed = 1.0;
        if (this.distTo(p) < 6 || this.phaseT > 120) this.setPhase('circle');
        break;
      case 'land':
        {
          target = this.perchPoint();
          speed = 0.5;
          const d = Math.hypot(target[0] - this.pos[0], target[1] - this.pos[1], target[2] - this.pos[2]);
          if (d < 3) this.setPhase('perch');
          if (this.phaseT > 500) this.setPhase('circle');
          break;
        }
      case 'perch':
        {
          target = this.perchPoint();
          speed = 0.1;
          if (playerOk) {
            const dx = p.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
              dz = p.pos[2] - this.pos[2];
            this.wantYaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
          }
          if (this.phaseT % 50 === 25 && playerOk && this.distTo(p) < 24) {
            const hp = this.headPos || this.pos,
              fx = -Math.sin(this.yaw),
              fz = -Math.cos(this.yaw);
            let gy = Math.floor(hp[1]);
            while (gy > 1 && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(hp[0] + fx * 2), gy - 1, Math.floor(hp[2] + fz * 2))].solid) gy--;
            g.addEntity(new AreaCloud(g, hp[0] + fx * 3, gy, hp[2] + fz * 3, 3.5, 60, this));
            Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.growl', this.pos, 5, 1);
          }
          if (this.phaseT > 320) this.setPhase('takeoff');
          break;
        }
      case 'takeoff':
        target = [this.pos[0] - Math.sin(this.yaw) * 20, 105, this.pos[2] - Math.cos(this.yaw) * 20];
        if (this.pos[1] > 95 || this.phaseT > 100) this.setPhase('circle');
        break;
    }
    // (strafe and charge give up on a player who died, went creative or left: back to circling - with no target for
    // that tick, the steering below threw 'reading 0', telemetry 11-02/03: ~58 devices. The circle's point instead)
    if (!target) target = [Math.cos(this.circleA) * 70, 95 + Math.sin(this.circleA * 3) * 10, Math.sin(this.circleA) * 70];
    // steering
    const dx = target[0] - this.pos[0],
      dy = target[1] - this.pos[1],
      dz = target[2] - this.pos[2],
      d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1;
    if (this.phase === 'perch') {
      this.vel = [dx * 0.1, dy * 0.1, dz * 0.1];
      if (this.wantYaw !== undefined) {
        let dyaw = this.wantYaw - this.yaw;
        while (dyaw > Math.PI) dyaw -= Math.PI * 2;
        while (dyaw < -Math.PI) dyaw += Math.PI * 2;
        this.yaw += clamp(dyaw, -0.05, 0.05);
      }
    } else {
      const want = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
      let dyaw = want - this.yaw;
      while (dyaw > Math.PI) dyaw -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (dyaw < -Math.PI) dyaw += Math.PI * 2;
      // damped turning: angular velocity eases in and out, so turns become smooth arcs
      const hs = Math.hypot(this.vel[0], this.vel[2]) + 1,
        turnSpeed = 0.7 / Math.min(hs, 40) / hs;
      this.yawVel = (this.yawVel || 0) * 0.8 + clamp(dyaw * 180 / Math.PI, -50, 50) * turnSpeed;
      this.yaw += this.yawVel * 0.1 * Math.PI / 180;
      const fwd = [-Math.sin(this.yaw), -Math.cos(this.yaw)];
      const turn = Math.abs(dyaw) > 1 ? 0.5 : 1;
      this.vel[0] += (fwd[0] * speed * turn - this.vel[0]) * 0.08;
      this.vel[2] += (fwd[1] * speed * turn - this.vel[2]) * 0.08;
      this.vel[1] += (clamp(dy / d, -0.6, 0.6) * speed - this.vel[1]) * 0.08;
    }
    this.pos[0] += this.vel[0];
    this.pos[1] += this.vel[1];
    this.pos[2] += this.vel[2];
    this.pitchD = lerp(this.pitchD, clamp(this.vel[1] * 0.8, -0.6, 0.6), 0.1);
    // head position (used for hit boxes and breath)
    const s = Math.sin(this.yaw),
      c = Math.cos(this.yaw);
    const headDrop = this.phase === 'perch' ? -2.5 : 0;
    this.headPos = [this.pos[0] - s * 7, this.pos[1] + 2 + headDrop + this.pitchD * 3, this.pos[2] - c * 7];
    // contact damage & knockback
    if (playerOk && p.invuln <= 0) {
      for (const part of this.parts()) {
        const b = part.box,
          pb = p.box();
        if (pb[0] < b[3] && pb[3] > b[0] && pb[1] < b[4] && pb[4] > b[1] && pb[2] < b[5] && pb[5] > b[2]) {
          if (part.head) p.hurt(10, {
            type: 'mob',
            attacker: this,
            knockFrom: this.pos,
            knock: 1
          });else if (this.phase !== 'perch') {
            const kx = p.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
              kz = p.pos[2] - this.pos[2],
              kl = Math.hypot(kx, kz) || 1;
            p.vel[0] += kx / kl * 2;
            p.vel[2] += kz / kl * 2;
            p.vel[1] = 0.6;
            p.hurt(5, {
              type: 'mob',
              attacker: this
            });
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    // destroy soft blocks the body flies through (vanilla checkWalls: only with mob_griefing)
    if (this.phase !== 'perch' && this.age % 2 === 0 && g.rule('mob_griefing') !== false) {
      let n = 0;
      const b = this.parts()[1].box;
      for (let x = Math.floor(b[0]); x <= Math.floor(b[3]) && n < 12; x++) for (let y = Math.floor(b[1]); y <= Math.floor(b[4]) && n < 12; y++) for (let z = Math.floor(b[2]); z <= Math.floor(b[5]) && n < 12; z++) {
        const id = this.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
        if (id && ![172, 28, 6, 174, 175, 176, 180, 21].includes(id) && !IS_FLUID[id]) {
          this.world.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
          n++;
          g.particles.blockBreak(x, y, z, id, 0);
        }
      }
      if (n) Sound.explode(this.pos);
    }
  }
  // slow, heavy wingbeats when flying fast; quicker while hovering or perched; faster when climbing
  flapSpeed() {
    if (this.phase === 'perch') return 0.1;
    return 0.2 / (Math.hypot(this.vel[0], this.vel[2]) * 10 + 1) * Math.pow(2, this.vel[1]);
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/ui.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2D UI (HUD, inventories, menus) drawn on an overlay canvas in GUI pixels
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Text uses the vanilla font (ascii.png + Unifont, tools/build_font.py -> font.js): a 16 px glyph atlas drawn
// at half size, so Latin letters land on whole GUI pixels and CJK on half pixels, like vanilla's
// Unifont. Each (string, colour) pair is rendered once into a small cached canvas.
const Font = {
  img: null,
  atlas: null,
  index: new Map(),
  adv: null,
  cache: new Map(),
  // colour emoji (emoji.js: the AI companion's set, 2026-11-01): drawn as pictures over the tinted text; ZWJ and
  // variation selectors take no room
  emo: null,
  emoImg: null,
  noEmo: false,
  init(img) {
    this.img = img;
    const F = window.FONT_MC;
    if (!F) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < F.chars.length;) {
      const cp = F.chars.codePointAt(i),
        ch = String.fromCodePoint(cp);
      this.index.set(ch, this.index.size);
      i += ch.length;
    }
    this.adv = F.adv.slice();
    if (this.index.has(' ')) this.adv[this.index.get(' ')] = 8; // vanilla space is 4 GUI px
    const im = new Image();
    im.onload = () => {
      this.atlas = im;
      this.cache.clear();
    };
    im.src = F.img;
    const E = window.EMOJI;
    if (E) {
      this.emo = new Map([...E.chars].map((c, i) => [c, i]));
      const ei = new Image();
      ei.onload = () => {
        this.emoImg = ei;
        this.cache.clear();
      };
      ei.src = E.src;
    }
  },
  charW(c) {
    if (c === '\uFE0F' || c === '\u200D' || c === '\uFE0E') return 0;
    if (this.emo && this.emo.has(c)) return 9;
    const i = this.index.get(c);
    return i !== undefined ? this.adv[i] / 2 : c.charCodeAt(0) < 128 ? 6 : 9;
  },
  width(str) {
    let w = 0;
    for (const c of String(str)) w += this.charW(c);
    return w;
  },
  // the string rendered at atlas scale (16 px tall), tinted
  render(str, color) {
    const key = color + (this.noEmo ? '\u0001' : '\u0000') + str;
    let cv = this.cache.get(key);
    if (cv) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      this.cache.set(key, cv);
      return cv;
    }
    const F = window.FONT_MC,
      cell = F.cell,
      cols = F.cols;
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.width(str) * 2) + 2);
    cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = w;
    cv.height = cell;
    const x = cv.getContext('2d');
    x.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    let px = 0;
    const emo = [];
    for (const c of String(str)) {
      if (this.charW(c) === 0) continue;
      if (this.emo && this.emo.has(c)) {
        emo.push([this.emo.get(c), px]);
        px += this.charW(c) * 2;
        continue;
      }
      const i = this.index.get(c);
      if (i !== undefined) x.drawImage(this.atlas, i % cols * cell, Math.floor(i / cols) * cell, cell, cell, px, 0, cell, cell);else {
        x.fillStyle = '#fff';
        x.font = '16px sans-serif';
        x.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
        x.fillText(c, px, F.ascent);
      }
      px += this.charW(c) * 2;
    }
    x.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
    x.fillStyle = color;
    x.fillRect(0, 0, w, cell);
    // (the emoji in colour, over the tint; not in the shadow)
    if (emo.length && !this.noEmo && this.emoImg) {
      const E = window.EMOJI,
        es = E.size;
      x.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      x.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      for (const [k, ex] of emo) x.drawImage(this.emoImg, k % E.cols * es, Math.floor(k / E.cols) * es, es, es, ex + 1, 0, cell - 1, cell - 1);
    }
    this.cache.set(key, cv);
    if (this.cache.size > 800) this.cache.delete(this.cache.keys().next().value);
    return cv;
  },
  drawRaw(ctx, str, x, y, color) {
    str = String(str);
    if (!str) return x;
    if (!this.atlas) return x + this.width(str);
    const cv = this.render(str, color);
    ctx.drawImage(cv, 0, 0, cv.width, cv.height, x, y, cv.width / 2, cv.height / 2);
    return x + this.width(str);
  },
  draw(ctx, str, x, y, color = '#FFFFFF', shadow = true) {
    if (shadow) {
      this.noEmo = true;
      this.drawRaw(ctx, str, x + 1, y + 1, shade(color));
      this.noEmo = false;
    }
    return this.drawRaw(ctx, str, x, y, color);
  },
  center(ctx, str, cx, y, color, shadow = true) {
    this.draw(ctx, str, Math.round(cx - this.width(str) / 2), y, color, shadow);
  }
};
function shade(c) {
  const n = parseInt(c.slice(1), 16);
  const r = n >> 16 & 255,
    g = n >> 8 & 255,
    b = n & 255;
  return '#' + [r >> 2, g >> 2, b >> 2].map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}
// an item icon scaled smoothly (a block drawn in 3D) or in whole pixels (flat items, crosses)
const iconSmooth = id => {
  const def = ITEMS[id];
  return !!(def && def.block && !def.flat && BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].shape !== SH_CROSS);
};
// the shining buttons' colours (UI.goldShine): [normal, hover] pairs; glint is an rgba() prefix
const SHINE_GOLD = {
  top: ['rgba(246,205,80,0.9)', 'rgba(255,226,120,0.92)'],
  bottom: ['rgba(190,132,24,0.9)', 'rgba(214,160,40,0.92)'],
  light: 'rgba(255,248,210,0.55)',
  dark: 'rgba(110,70,0,0.55)',
  glint: 'rgba(255,255,220,',
  edge: ['#E8B830', '#FFF2B0']
};
const SHINE_BLUE = {
  top: ['rgba(96,176,255,0.92)', 'rgba(130,200,255,0.94)'],
  bottom: ['rgba(30,96,226,0.92)', 'rgba(50,120,240,0.94)'],
  light: 'rgba(214,236,255,0.6)',
  dark: 'rgba(0,36,110,0.55)',
  glint: 'rgba(230,246,255,',
  edge: ['#4AA8FF', '#D2EAFF']
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class UI {
  constructor(game, canvas) {
    this.game = game;
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    this.scale = 2;
    this.w = 320;
    this.h = 240;
    this.mouse = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      down: false,
      button: -1
    };
    this.screen = null;
    this.cursor = null;
    this.chat = [];
    this.toasts = [];
    this.subs = [];
    Sound.onPlay = (ev, pos, vol) => this.hearSound(ev, pos, vol);
    this.itemNameT = 0;
    this.lastSel = -1;
    this.debug = false;
    this.hideHud = false;
    this.input = document.getElementById('textinput');
    this.drag = null;
  }
  get img() {
    return this.game.renderer.images;
  }
  resize() {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    this.canvas.width = Math.floor(window.innerWidth * dpr);
    this.canvas.height = Math.floor(window.innerHeight * dpr);
    const auto = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.floor(this.canvas.width / 320), Math.floor(this.canvas.height / 240)));
    const pref = this.game.settings.guiScale;
    this.scale = pref ? Math.min(pref * dpr, auto) : Math.min(auto, Math.round(3 * dpr));
    this.scale = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.scale));
    this.w = Math.ceil(this.canvas.width / this.scale);
    this.h = Math.ceil(this.canvas.height / this.scale);
    this.dpr = dpr;
    if (this.screen && this.screen.layout) this.screen.layout();
  }
  toGui(ev) {
    const r = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return [(ev.clientX - r.left) * this.dpr / this.scale, (ev.clientY - r.top) * this.dpr / this.scale];
  }
  open(screen) {
    if (this.screen && this.screen.close) this.screen.close();
    const wide = this.screen && this.screen.needW || screen && screen.needW;
    this.screen = screen;
    this.hideInput();
    if (wide) this.resize();
    if (screen) {
      if (screen.layout && !wide) screen.layout();
      // (opened by a mouse button still down - right click on a chest: the lock goes when it is let go, main.js -
      // the pointer jumping back with the right button down is a mouse gesture to Edge, which closed the page)
      const g = this.game,
        held = g.rawMouse && (g.rawMouse[0] || g.rawMouse[1] || g.rawMouse[2]) && document.pointerLockElement === g.canvas;
      if (!screen.keepPointer) {
        if (held) g.unlockOnUp = true;else g.releasePointer();
      }
    }
  }
  close() {
    this.game.unlockOnUp = false;
    if (this.screen && this.screen.close) this.screen.close();
    const wide = this.screen && this.screen.needW;
    this.screen = null;
    if (wide) this.resize();
    if (this.cursor) {
      this.returnStack(this.cursor);
      this.cursor = null;
    }
    this.hideInput();
    this.game.capturePointer();
  }
  returnStack(s) {
    const left = this.game.player.inv.add(s);
    if (left) this.game.dropFromPlayer({
      ...s,
      count: left
    });
  }
  // the items an open screen holds for now (the stack on the pointer, a crafting grid, a station's own slots): they
  // go back to the inventory when it closes - a save meanwhile counts them in, so leaving the game with items in the
  // crafting table no longer loses them (feedback 2026-11-02 「往工作台里放东西后退出重进，物品会消失」)
  pendingStacks() {
    const s = this.screen,
      out = [];
    if (this.cursor) out.push(this.cursor);
    if (s && Array.isArray(s.grid)) for (const x of s.grid) if (x) out.push(x);
    if (s && Array.isArray(s.held)) for (const x of s.held) if (x) out.push(x);
    return out;
  }
  message(text, color = '#FFFFFF') {
    this.chat.push({
      text,
      color,
      t: performance.now()
    });
    if (this.chat.length > 100) this.chat.shift();
  }
  // a line held on the chat's bottom row for ms (shown even with the chat closed; what comes meanwhile goes above
  // it), then an ordinary message that scrolls up and fades like the rest (the room service's sponsor line)
  pinMessage(text, ms, color = '#FFAA00') {
    this.pinned = {
      text,
      color,
      until: performance.now() + ms
    };
  }
  toast(title, sub, iconId) {
    this.toasts.push({
      title,
      sub,
      icon: iconId,
      t: performance.now()
    });
    Sound.toast();
  }

  // ---- primitives ---------------------------------------------------------------
  sprite(name, x, y, w, h, sx = 0, sy = 0, sw, sh) {
    const im = this.img[name];
    this.ctx.drawImage(im, sx, sy, sw !== null && sw !== void 0 ? sw : w !== null && w !== void 0 ? w : im.width, sh !== null && sh !== void 0 ? sh : h !== null && h !== void 0 ? h : im.height, x, y, w !== null && w !== void 0 ? w : im.width, h !== null && h !== void 0 ? h : im.height);
  }
  // vanilla's purple boss bar (the wither's), made once from the pink one: its pixels are the pink's with red moved to
  // blue and red at 0.52 of it (within 1 of the jar's purple_background / purple_progress); false until it can be made
  bossPurple() {
    if (this.img.boss_purple_bg) return true;
    const src = [this.img.boss_bg, this.img.boss_fg];
    if (src.some(im => !im || !im.width || im.complete === false)) return false;
    const out = src.map(im => {
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = im.width;
      cv.height = im.height;
      const x = cv.getContext('2d');
      x.drawImage(im, 0, 0);
      const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height),
        q = d.data;
      for (let i = 0; i < q.length; i += 4) {
        const r = q[i];
        q[i] = Math.round(r * 0.52);
        q[i + 1] = 0;
        q[i + 2] = r;
      }
      x.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
      return cv;
    });
    this.img.boss_purple_bg = out[0];
    this.img.boss_purple_fg = out[1];
    return true;
  }
  nine(name, x, y, w, h, border) {
    const im = this.img[name],
      c = this.ctx,
      iw = im.width,
      ih = im.height,
      b = border;
    c.drawImage(im, 0, 0, b, b, x, y, b, b);
    c.drawImage(im, iw - b, 0, b, b, x + w - b, y, b, b);
    c.drawImage(im, 0, ih - b, b, b, x, y + h - b, b, b);
    c.drawImage(im, iw - b, ih - b, b, b, x + w - b, y + h - b, b, b);
    c.drawImage(im, b, 0, iw - 2 * b, b, x + b, y, w - 2 * b, b);
    c.drawImage(im, b, ih - b, iw - 2 * b, b, x + b, y + h - b, w - 2 * b, b);
    c.drawImage(im, 0, b, b, ih - 2 * b, x, y + b, b, h - 2 * b);
    c.drawImage(im, iw - b, b, b, ih - 2 * b, x + w - b, y + b, b, h - 2 * b);
    c.drawImage(im, b, b, iw - 2 * b, ih - 2 * b, x + b, y + b, w - 2 * b, h - 2 * b);
  }
  drawItem(stack, x, y, opts = {}) {
    if (!stack) return;
    const r = this.game.renderer,
      c = this.ctx;
    const id = stack.id,
      def = ITEMS[id];
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = iconSmooth(id);
    c.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    // an item this game doesn't have (on a server; or an id not in ITEMS at all - telemetry 11-02/03, tooltips and the
    // held item's name threw on one, every frame): the missing texture
    if (stack.unk || !def) {
      c.fillStyle = '#000';
      c.fillRect(x, y, 16, 16);
      c.fillStyle = '#F800F8';
      c.fillRect(x, y, 8, 8);
      c.fillRect(x + 8, y + 8, 8, 8);
    } else if (def.key === 'shield' && r.shieldStackIcon && r.shieldStackIcon(stack)) c.drawImage(r.shieldStackIcon(stack), x, y, 16, 16); // (with its banner: equip.js)
    else if (stackTinted(stack) && r.stackIcon(id, stack)) c.drawImage(r.stackIcon(id, stack), x, y, 16, 16);else if (typeof itemStateTex === 'function' && itemStateTex(stack, this.game.player)) c.drawImage(r.tileIcon(itemStateTex(stack, this.game.player)), x, y, 16, 16);else c.drawImage(this.itemIcon(id), x, y, 16, 16);
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    c.imageSmoothingQuality = 'low';
    if (def && (stack.g || stack.g !== false && (stack.e && stack.e.length || def.glint))) this.drawGlint(stack, x, y);
    if (def && def.durability && stack.dmg > 0) {
      const f = 1 - stack.dmg / def.durability;
      c.fillStyle = '#000';
      c.fillRect(x + 2, y + 13, 13, 2);
      c.fillStyle = `hsl(${Math.round(f * 120)},100%,50%)`;
      c.fillRect(x + 2, y + 13, Math.round(13 * f), 1);
    }
    if (stack.count > 1 || opts.showCount) {
      const t = String(stack.count);
      Font.draw(c, t, x + 17 - Font.width(t), y + 9, '#FFFFFF');
    }
  }
  // an item's icon as a small canvas of its own (copied once from the icon atlas, most recently used kept).
  // Drawn straight from the atlas (2048x3200, filled with putImageData) every slot of every frame, the browser
  // had to upload the whole atlas to the GPU again each time its GPU copy was dropped from the canvas cache -
  // which, once it happened (after a while, often on opening a menu), held the game at 7-8 fps until a reload.
  // Made at the size it is shown (16 GUI px: 48 device px on most phones, never over the atlas's 64), scaled once the
  // way drawItem scaled it each frame, and enough of them kept for every item: 600 of 64x64 churned through the
  // creative tabs - going through them all a second time still made 2838 canvases (4.1 ms a frame), now none
  // (0.20 ms a frame); all 1578 kept at 48 px are 13.9 MB, the 600 at 64 px were 9.4 (11-03)
  itemIcon(id) {
    const r = this.game.renderer,
      S = r.iconSize,
      D = Math.min(S, 16 * this.scale);
    if (this.iconsOf !== r.iconAtlas || this.iconD !== D) {
      this.iconsOf = r.iconAtlas;
      this.iconD = D;
      this.icons = new Map();
    }
    const cache = this.icons;
    let cv = cache.get(id);
    if (cv) {
      cache.delete(id);
      cache.set(id, cv);
      return cv;
    }
    cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = cv.height = D;
    const k = cv.getContext('2d');
    if (D === S) k.drawImage(r.iconAtlas, ...r.iconXY(id), S, S, 0, 0, S, S);else {
      k.imageSmoothingEnabled = iconSmooth(id);
      k.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
      k.drawImage(this.iconCopy(id), 0, 0, S, S, 0, 0, D, D);
    }
    cache.set(id, cv);
    if (cache.size > 2048) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
    return cv;
  }
  // the item's 64 px picture copied out of the atlas into one canvas kept for it, to be scaled from there: the same
  // picture to the bit as before (scaled straight out of the 2048x3200 atlas, 75 flat icons came out a pixel off at
  // their edges and 1032 block icons up to 29/255 apart - the texel picked on the half-pixel steps of 64 -> 48 px, 11-04)
  // (a canvas of its own each time - only when the icon isn't kept yet: one canvas used again for every icon, WebKit can
  // draw it later than asked with the next icon's picture in it - iPhones / iPads, 11-13, see render.js flatInto)
  iconCopy(id) {
    const r = this.game.renderer,
      S = r.iconSize,
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = cv.height = S;
    cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(r.iconAtlas, ...r.iconXY(id), S, S, 0, 0, S, S);
    return cv;
  }
  // the enchantment glint: the icon's shape tinted purple, pulsing (its shape from the 64 px picture, once per item)
  drawGlint(stack, x, y) {
    const r = this.game.renderer,
      S = r.iconSize,
      id = stack.id,
      cache = this.glints || (this.glints = new Map());
    let cv = cache.get(id);
    if (!cv) {
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = cv.height = 16;
      const k = cv.getContext('2d');
      k.drawImage(this.iconCopy(id), 0, 0, S, S, 0, 0, 16, 16);
      k.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
      k.fillStyle = '#A050FF';
      k.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 16);
      cache.set(id, cv);
    }
    const c = this.ctx;
    c.globalAlpha = 0.25 + 0.2 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 400 + x * 0.05);
    c.drawImage(cv, x, y);
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  tooltip(lines, x, y) {
    const c = this.ctx;
    let w = 0;
    for (const l of lines) w = Math.max(w, Font.width(l.text));
    const h = lines.length * 10 + (lines.length > 1 ? 2 : 0) - 2;
    let tx = x + 12,
      ty = y - 12;
    if (tx + w + 4 > this.w) tx = x - w - 16;
    if (ty + h + 6 > this.h) ty = this.h - h - 6;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(16,0,16,0.94)';
    c.fillRect(tx - 3, ty - 4, w + 6, h + 8);
    c.fillRect(tx - 4, ty - 3, w + 8, h + 6);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,0,255,0.32)';
    c.fillRect(tx - 3, ty - 3, w + 6, 1);
    c.fillRect(tx - 3, ty + h + 2, w + 6, 1);
    c.fillRect(tx - 3, ty - 3, 1, h + 6);
    c.fillRect(tx + w + 2, ty - 3, 1, h + 6);
    let yy = ty;
    lines.forEach((l, i) => {
      Font.draw(c, l.text, tx, yy, l.color || '#FFFFFF');
      yy += i === 0 ? 12 : 10;
    });
  }
  // a slot's tooltip: an id not in ITEMS (telemetry 11-02/03: 'rarity' of undefined) only gets these - the itemLines
  // wrappers of other files read ITEMS[id] too
  tipLines(stack) {
    return ITEMS[stack.id] || stack.unk ? this.itemLines(stack) : this.unknownLines(stack);
  }
  unknownLines(stack) {
    return [{
      text: '未知物品',
      color: '#FFFFFF'
    }, {
      text: '#' + stack.id,
      color: '#555555'
    }];
  }
  itemLines(stack) {
    if (stack.unk) return netItemLines(stack, [{
      text: '未知物品',
      color: '#FFFFFF'
    }, {
      text: 'minecraft:' + stack.unk,
      color: '#555555'
    }]);
    const d = ITEMS[stack.id];
    if (!d) return this.unknownLines(stack);
    const R = ['common', 'uncommon', 'rare', 'epic'],
      ri = Math.max(0, R.indexOf(d.rarity || 'common')),
      rr = stack.e && stack.e.length ? ri < 2 ? 2 : 3 : ri;
    const lines = [{
      text: d.cn,
      color: ['#FFFFFF', '#FFFF55', '#55FFFF', '#FF55FF'][rr]
    }];
    if (stack.trim && typeof TRIM_CN !== 'undefined') {
      // vanilla: the armour trim under the name, in the material's colour
      const col = TRIM_COLOR[stack.trim.material] || '#AAAAAA';
      lines.push({
        text: '已有升级：',
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      }, {
        text: ' ' + (TRIM_PATTERN_CN[stack.trim.pattern] || stack.trim.pattern) + '盔甲纹饰',
        color: col
      }, {
        text: ' ' + (TRIM_CN[stack.trim.material] || stack.trim.material),
        color: col
      });
    }
    if (d.food) lines.push({
      text: `食物: +${d.food[0]} 饥饿值`,
      color: '#AAAAAA'
    });
    if (d.tool) lines.push({
      text: `攻击伤害: ${d.attack}`,
      color: '#00AA00'
    });else if (d.attack) lines.push({
      text: `攻击伤害: ${d.attack}`,
      color: '#00AA00'
    });
    if (d.armor && d.armor.points) lines.push({
      text: `护甲值: +${d.armor.points}`,
      color: '#5555FF'
    });
    if (d.armor && d.armor.tough) lines.push({
      text: `盔甲韧性: +${d.armor.tough}`,
      color: '#5555FF'
    });
    if (d.durability) lines.push({
      text: `耐久度: ${d.durability - (stack.dmg || 0)} / ${d.durability}`,
      color: '#AAAAAA'
    });
    if (fuelValue(stack.id)) lines.push({
      text: `燃料: ${(fuelValue(stack.id) / 200).toFixed(1)} 个物品`,
      color: '#777777'
    });
    if (this.game.settings.advTooltips) lines.push({
      text: 'minecraft:' + d.key,
      color: '#555555'
    });
    if (stack.name || stack.e || stack.pot || stack.lore) netItemLines(stack, lines); // a server's stack (net.js)
    if (stack.pot && !this.game.net) {
      const i = lines.findIndex((l, k) => k > 0 && (l.color === '#5555FF' || l.color === '#AAAAAA'));
      if (i > 0) lines.splice(i, 1);
      potionLines(stack, lines);
    }
    return lines;
  }
  button(b) {
    const hover = this.hit(b) && b.enabled !== false;
    this.nine(b.enabled === false ? 'button_dis' : hover ? 'button_hl' : 'button', b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 3);
    // (goldFrom: a button turning gold - fades in over 0.7 s, the old label fading out before the new one comes)
    const c = this.ctx,
      k = b.goldFrom ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - b.goldFrom) / 700) : 1;
    if ((b.gold || b.glowBlue) && b.enabled !== false) {
      c.save();
      c.globalAlpha = k;
      this.goldShine(b, hover);
      c.restore();
    }
    // (blue: the way into your own room)
    // (tint: a colour of its own over the button - the light blue of the mods)
    if (b.tint && b.enabled !== false) {
      c.fillStyle = b.tint;
      c.fillRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2);
      if (hover) {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
        c.fillRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2);
      }
    }
    if (b.blue && b.enabled !== false) {
      c.fillStyle = hover ? 'rgba(80,140,255,0.6)' : 'rgba(40,90,220,0.55)';
      c.fillRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2);
    }
    if (b.icon) {
      const im = this.img[b.icon];
      if (im) c.drawImage(im, Math.floor(b.x + (b.w - im.width) / 2), Math.floor(b.y + (b.h - im.height) / 2));
      return;
    }
    const col = b.enabled === false ? '#A0A0A0' : b.color || '#FFFFFF',
      ty = b.y + (b.h - 8) / 2;
    if (k < 1 && b.fromLabel) {
      c.save();
      c.globalAlpha = k < 0.5 ? 1 - 2 * k : 2 * k - 1;
      Font.center(c, k < 0.5 ? b.fromLabel : typeof b.label === 'function' ? b.label() : b.label, b.x + b.w / 2, ty, col);
      c.restore();
      return;
    }
    Font.center(c, typeof b.label === 'function' ? b.label() : b.label, b.x + b.w / 2, ty, col);
  }
  // the few buttons that matter most (log in, unlock, skins, invite): gold, with a glint sweeping across every few
  // seconds like an enchantment's (UX_IDEAS.md 界面风格). glowBlue: the same in bright blue (触控设置, the user 2026-11-03)
  goldShine(b, hover) {
    const c = this.ctx,
      t = performance.now() / 1000,
      P = b.glowBlue ? SHINE_BLUE : SHINE_GOLD,
      h = hover ? 1 : 0;
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2);
    c.clip();
    const gr = c.createLinearGradient(0, b.y, 0, b.y + b.h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, P.top[h]);
    gr.addColorStop(1, P.bottom[h]);
    c.fillStyle = gr;
    c.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    c.fillStyle = P.light;
    c.fillRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, 1);
    c.fillStyle = P.dark;
    c.fillRect(b.x + 1, b.y + b.h - 2, b.w - 2, 1);
    // the glint: a slanted band crossing in 0.7 s, every 3 s (buttons a little apart in time)
    const ph = (t + (b.x + b.y) * 0.003) % 3 / 0.7;
    if (ph < 1) {
      const x = b.x - 20 + (b.w + 40) * ph,
        g = c.createLinearGradient(x - 14, 0, x + 14, 0);
      g.addColorStop(0, P.glint + '0)');
      g.addColorStop(0.5, P.glint + '0.55)');
      g.addColorStop(1, P.glint + '0)');
      c.fillStyle = g;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x - 10, b.y + b.h);
      c.lineTo(x + 2, b.y);
      c.lineTo(x + 18, b.y);
      c.lineTo(x + 6, b.y + b.h);
      c.fill();
    }
    c.restore();
    c.strokeStyle = P.edge[h];
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    c.strokeRect(b.x + 0.5, b.y + 0.5, b.w - 1, b.h - 1);
  }
  slider(s) {
    this.nine('slider', s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h, 2);
    const hx = s.x + Math.round(s.value * (s.w - 8));
    this.nine(this.hit(s) ? 'slider_handle_hl' : 'slider_handle', hx, s.y, 8, s.h, 2);
    Font.center(this.ctx, s.label(), s.x + s.w / 2, s.y + (s.h - 8) / 2, '#FFFFFF');
  }
  // vanilla 1.20.5+ menu backgrounds: the world blurred behind a translucent tile; inworld_* variants while playing
  tile(name, x, y, w, h) {
    this.tiled(this.img[name], name, x, y, w, h);
  }
  // a texture repeated over a rectangle (from its top left), filled with a pattern once into a canvas of that size
  // and copied from then on. Pattern fills straight on the screen, frame after frame each time a menu opened, left
  // the browser's GPU side slower for good after some 40 openings (the whole game at 70 fps instead of 180 until
  // a reload, measured 2026-10-29); copying a finished canvas does not
  tiled(img, key, x, y, w, h) {
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || !img) return;
    const s = this.scale,
      W = Math.ceil(w * s),
      H = Math.ceil(h * s),
      k = key + '|' + W + 'x' + H + '|' + s;
    const cache = this.tileCache || (this.tileCache = new Map());
    let cv = cache.get(k);
    if (!cv) {
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = W;
      cv.height = H;
      const x2 = cv.getContext('2d');
      x2.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      x2.scale(s, s);
      x2.fillStyle = x2.createPattern(img, 'repeat');
      x2.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      cache.set(k, cv);
      if (cache.size > 32) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
    }
    const c = this.ctx,
      sm = c.imageSmoothingEnabled;
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    c.drawImage(cv, 0, 0, W, H, x, y, W / s, H / s);
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = sm;
  }
  sepName(kind) {
    return (this.game.state === 'play' ? 'inworld_' : '') + kind + '_sep';
  }
  menuBackground() {
    this.wantBlur = true;
    this.tile(this.game.state === 'play' ? 'options_bg' : 'menu_bg', 0, 0, this.w, this.h);
  }
  listBackground(top, bottom) {
    this.tile(this.game.state === 'play' ? 'inworld_list_bg' : 'menu_list_bg', 0, top, this.w, bottom - top);
    this.tile(this.sepName('header'), 0, top - 2, this.w, 2);
    this.tile(this.sepName('footer'), 0, bottom, this.w, 2);
  }
  hit(r, mx = this.mouse.x, my = this.mouse.y) {
    return mx >= r.x && my >= r.y && mx < r.x + r.w && my < r.y + r.h;
  }
  dim(a = 0.55) {
    this.ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(16,16,16,${a})`;
    this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.w, this.h);
  }
  showInput(x, y, w, h, value, onEnter, opts = {}) {
    const el = this.input,
      s = this.scale / this.dpr;
    this.inputBox = {
      x,
      y,
      w,
      h,
      t0: performance.now()
    };
    el.style.display = 'block';
    el.style.left = x * s + 'px';
    el.style.top = y * s + 'px';
    el.style.width = w * s + 'px';
    el.style.height = h * s + 'px';
    // (the field's own text is invisible - drawInputText draws it. On a touch screen at least 16px: iPhones zoom the
    // whole page in on a field with smaller text when it is focused)
    el.style.fontSize = Math.max(navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0 ? 16 : 12, (h - 6) * s) + 'px';
    el.value = value || '';
    el.maxLength = opts.max || 100;
    el.enterKeyHint = opts.enter || 'done';
    // (Esc in a field: marked as held, as main.js does for the window's keys - the field keeps its keys to itself - so a
    // screen it closes takes the mouse lock back only when the key comes up. Taken while it was down, the browser read
    // the same Esc as leaving the lock and opened the pause menu: chat open + Esc did that, feedback 2026-11-01 14:13)
    el.onkeydown = e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.key === 'Enter') onEnter(el.value);
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (!e.repeat) this.game.escHeld = performance.now();
        if (opts.onEsc) opts.onEsc();
      }
    };
    el.oninput = () => {
      if (opts.onInput) opts.onInput(el.value);
    };
    // after a touch the field waits for its own tap, so the on-screen keyboard doesn't pop up uninvited
    // (not again when it already has the focus: a layout on every resize - the keyboard's own - focused it once more)
    if (!(this.lastTouch && performance.now() - this.lastTouch < 2000) && document.activeElement !== el) setTimeout(() => el.focus(), 0);
  }
  hideInput() {
    this.input.style.display = 'none';
    this.input.onkeydown = null;
    this.input.blur();
    this.inputBox = null;
  }
  // vanilla-style text field contents: pixel font, scrolled to keep the caret visible, blinking caret
  drawInputText() {
    var _el$selectionStart;
    const b = this.inputBox,
      el = this.input;
    if (!b || el.style.display === 'none') return;
    const c = this.ctx,
      v = el.value,
      caret = (_el$selectionStart = el.selectionStart) !== null && _el$selectionStart !== void 0 ? _el$selectionStart : v.length;
    const ty = b.y + Math.floor((b.h - 8) / 2),
      maxW = b.w - 6;
    let start = 0;
    while (start < caret && Font.width(v.slice(start, caret)) > maxW) start++;
    let end = start;
    while (end < v.length && Font.width(v.slice(start, end + 1)) <= maxW) end++;
    Font.draw(c, v.slice(start, end), b.x + 2, ty, '#E0E0E0');
    if (Math.floor((performance.now() - b.t0) / 300) % 2 === 0) {
      const cx = b.x + 2 + Font.width(v.slice(start, caret));
      if (caret >= v.length) Font.draw(c, '_', cx, ty, '#E0E0E0');else {
        c.fillStyle = '#D0D0D0';
        c.fillRect(cx, ty - 1, 1, 10);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- HUD ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  drawHUD() {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      c = this.ctx,
      W = this.w,
      H = this.h;
    if (this.hideHud) return;
    drawEffectIcons(this, p);
    // crosshair (inverted)
    if (!this.screen && g.perspective === 0 && !g.hideCrosshair) {
      // (hideCrosshair: a caller hiding it for a frame)
      c.globalCompositeOperation = 'difference';
      this.sprite('crosshair', Math.floor(W / 2 - 7.5), Math.floor(H / 2 - 7.5));
      // vanilla attack indicator: cool-down bar, or the full icon when aiming at a mob with a slow weapon
      const str = g.attackStrength(0),
        x = Math.floor(W / 2 - 8),
        y = Math.floor(H / 2 - 7 + 16);
      if (str < 1 && this.img.attack_bg) {
        this.sprite('attack_bg', x, y);
        const w = Math.floor(str * 17);
        if (w > 0) c.drawImage(this.img.attack_progress, 0, 0, w, 4, x, y, w, 4);
      } else if (g.targetEntity && 20 / g.attackSpeed() > 5 && this.img.attack_full) this.sprite('attack_full', x, y);
      c.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    }
    const hx = Math.floor(W / 2 - 91),
      hy = H - 22;
    if (g.mode === 'spectator') return;
    this.sprite('hotbar', hx, hy);
    this.sprite('hotbar_sel', hx - 1 + p.inv.sel * 20, hy - 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) this.drawItem(p.inv.slots[i], hx + 3 + i * 20, hy + 3);
    if (p.inv.slots[40]) {
      this.sprite('hotbar_offhand_left', hx - 29, hy - 1);
      this.drawItem(p.inv.slots[40], hx - 26, hy + 3);
    }
    if (!p.creative) {
      // xp bar
      const xb = H - 29,
        jm = p.vehicle && (p.vehicle.jumpStr || p.vehicle.dashCd !== undefined) ? p.vehicle : null;
      const lvl = g.xpLevel(),
        need = g.xpNeeded(lvl),
        prog = (p.xp - g.xpTotalFor(lvl)) / need;
      if (jm && this.img.jump_bar_bg) {
        // riding a horse: the jump bar (a camel's dash cooldown greys it out)
        this.sprite('jump_bar_bg', hx, xb);
        if (jm.dashCd > 0) this.sprite('jump_bar_cooldown', hx, xb);else {
          const jw = Math.floor(182 * clamp(jm.jumpCharge || 0, 0, 1));
          if (jw > 0) c.drawImage(this.img.jump_bar_progress, 0, 0, jw, 5, hx, xb, jw, 5);
        }
      } else {
        this.sprite('xp_bg', hx, xb);
        const pw = Math.floor(182 * clamp(prog, 0, 1));
        if (pw > 0) c.drawImage(this.img.xp_fg, 0, 0, pw, 5, hx, xb, pw, 5);
      }
      if (lvl > 0) {
        const t = String(lvl),
          tx = Math.floor(W / 2 - Font.width(t) / 2);
        for (const [ox, oy] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) Font.drawRaw(c, t, tx + ox, xb - 6 + oy, '#000000');
        Font.drawRaw(c, t, tx, xb - 6, '#80FF20');
      }
      // hearts
      const hy2 = H - 39;
      // vanilla: on damage the containers blink for 20 ticks and the lost health shows as white hearts
      const hp = Math.ceil(p.health),
        now = performance.now();
      if (this.lastHealth === undefined) {
        this.lastHealth = hp;
        this.displayHealth = hp;
      }
      if (hp < this.lastHealth && p.invuln > 0) {
        this.lastHealthT = now;
        this.blinkUntil = g.tickCount + 20;
      } else if (hp > this.lastHealth && p.invuln > 0) {
        this.lastHealthT = now;
        this.blinkUntil = g.tickCount + 10;
      }
      if (now - (this.lastHealthT || 0) > 1000) this.displayHealth = hp;
      this.lastHealth = hp;
      const blink = this.blinkUntil > g.tickCount && ((this.blinkUntil - g.tickCount) / 3 | 0) % 2 === 1;
      // vanilla: health boost and absorption add hearts in rows of 10 (rows squeeze together when there are many),
      // poison / wither / freezing change the hearts, absorption ones are golden, regeneration ripples along them
      const maxHp = Math.max(p.maxHealth || 20, hp),
        abs = Math.ceil(p.absorption || 0);
      const nMax = Math.ceil(maxHp / 2),
        nAbs = Math.ceil(abs / 2),
        rows = Math.ceil((maxHp + abs) / 20),
        rowH = Math.max(10 - (rows - 2), 3);
      const hc = g.hardcore,
        H_ = hc ? 'hardcore_' : '';
      const kind = p.hasEffect && p.hasEffect('poison') ? 'poisoned_' : p.hasEffect && p.hasEffect('wither') ? 'withered_' : (p.frozenT || 0) >= 140 ? 'frozen_' : '';
      const low = p.health + abs <= 4;
      const regen = p.hasEffect && p.hasEffect('regeneration') ? g.tickCount % Math.ceil(maxHp + 5) : -1;
      let absLeft = abs;
      for (let i = nMax + nAbs - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const x = hx + i % 10 * 8;
        let y = hy2 - Math.floor(i / 10) * rowH;
        if (low) y += Math.round(Math.sin(g.tickCount * 1.7 + i * 3.1) * 1);
        if (i === regen) y -= 2;
        this.sprite(hc ? blink ? 'heart_container_hc_blink' : 'heart_container_hc' : blink ? 'heart_container_blink' : 'heart_container', x, y);
        if (i >= nMax) {
          // absorption hearts (withered when withering), filled from the last one down
          const half = absLeft === abs && abs % 2 === 1;
          absLeft -= half ? 1 : 2;
          this.sprite('heart_' + (kind === 'withered_' ? 'withered_' : 'absorbing_') + H_ + (half ? 'half' : 'full'), x, y);
          continue;
        }
        if (blink && i * 2 < this.displayHealth) {
          const f = this.displayHealth - i * 2 >= 2 ? 'full' : 'half';
          this.sprite(kind ? 'heart_' + kind + H_ + f + '_blinking' : (hc ? 'heart_hc_' : 'heart_') + f + '_blink', x, y);
        }
        const hpv = hp - i * 2;
        if (hpv >= 1) {
          const f = hpv >= 2 ? 'full' : 'half';
          this.sprite(kind ? 'heart_' + kind + H_ + f : (hc ? 'heart_hc_' : 'heart_') + f, x, y);
        }
      }
      // armor (above all the heart rows)
      const ap = p.inv.armorPoints(),
        ay = hy2 - (rows - 1) * rowH - 10;
      if (ap > 0) for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const v = ap - i * 2;
        this.sprite(v >= 2 ? 'armor_full' : v >= 1 ? 'armor_half' : 'armor_empty', hx + i * 8, ay);
      }
      // food (riding a living mount: its hearts instead, in rows of 10, and the jump bar over the experience bar)
      const mount = p.vehicle && p.vehicle.maxHealth ? p.vehicle : null;
      if (mount) {
        const mh = Math.ceil(mount.maxHealth / 2);
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(mh, 30); i++) {
          const x = hx + 182 - 9 - i % 10 * 8,
            y = hy2 - Math.floor(i / 10) * 10,
            v = Math.ceil(mount.health) - i * 2;
          this.sprite('heart_vehicle_container', x, y);
          if (v >= 2) this.sprite('heart_vehicle_full', x, y);else if (v >= 1) this.sprite('heart_vehicle_half', x, y);
        }
      }
      if (!mount) for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const x = hx + 182 - 9 - i * 8;
        let y = hy2;
        if (p.saturation <= 0 && g.tickCount % (p.food * 3 + 1) === 0) y += Math.round(Math.random() * 2 - 1);
        const hu = p.hasEffect && p.hasEffect('hunger') ? '_hunger' : '';
        this.sprite('food_empty' + hu, x, y);
        const fv = p.food - i * 2;
        if (fv >= 2) this.sprite('food_full' + hu, x, y);else if (fv >= 1) this.sprite('food_half' + hu, x, y);
      }
      // air
      if (p.eyeInWater || p.air < 300) {
        const bubbles = Math.ceil((p.air - 2) * 10 / 300),
          full = Math.ceil(p.air * 10 / 300) - bubbles;
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
          const x = hx + 182 - 9 - i * 8;
          if (i < bubbles) this.sprite('air', x, hy2 - 10);else if (i < bubbles + full && p.air > 0) this.sprite('air_bursting', x, hy2 - 10);
        }
      }
    }
    // held item name
    if (p.inv.sel !== this.lastSel) {
      this.lastSel = p.inv.sel;
      this.itemNameT = performance.now();
    }
    const held = p.inv.held,
      hd = held && ITEMS[held.id];
    const dt = performance.now() - this.itemNameT;
    if (hd && dt < 2500) {
      const a = dt > 2000 ? 1 - (dt - 2000) / 500 : 1;
      c.globalAlpha = a;
      // (stackName: an item named per stack by a mod - Tinkers' tools by what they are made of, 钴镐)
      Font.center(c, hd.stackName ? hd.stackName(held) : hd.cn || hd.key, W / 2, H - (p.creative ? 38 : 58), '#FFFFFF');
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    // action bar message
    if (this.actionBar && performance.now() - this.actionBar.t < 2500) Font.center(c, this.actionBar.text, W / 2, H - (p.creative ? 50 : 70), this.actionBar.color || '#FFFFFF');
    // boss bars (vanilla BossHealthOverlay): the dragon's (pink), the withers' (purple), the raids' (red, in tenths), one
    // under another
    const bars = [];
    const dr = g.dragon && g.dragon();
    if (dr) bars.push({
      name: '末影龙',
      progress: dr.health / dr.maxHealth,
      color: 'pink'
    });
    // (vanilla WitherBoss's boss event: filling up while it charges, then its health; shown while it is tracked - 10
    // chunks. Online the server's boss events aren't read and a server's mob has no health here: not there. A local
    // room's guest has the host's value from the snapshot, bossProg - none from a host without it)
    if (!g.net && typeof Wither !== 'undefined') for (const e of g.entities) {
      if (!(e instanceof Wither) || e.dead || e.distTo(p) >= 160 || g.p2pGuest && typeof e.bossProg !== 'number') continue;
      bars.push({
        name: e.customName || '凋灵',
        progress: g.p2pGuest ? e.bossProg : e.invulT > 0 ? 1 - e.invulT / 220 : e.health / e.maxHealth,
        color: 'purple'
      });
    }
    if (g.raidBars) bars.push(...g.raidBars());
    bars.forEach((b, i) => {
      const bx = Math.floor(W / 2 - 91),
        by = 12 + i * 19;
      let bg = b.color === 'red' ? 'boss_red_bg' : 'boss_bg',
        fg = b.color === 'red' ? 'boss_red_fg' : 'boss_fg';
      if (b.color === 'purple' && this.bossPurple()) {
        bg = 'boss_purple_bg';
        fg = 'boss_purple_fg';
      }
      Font.center(c, b.name, W / 2, by - 9, '#FFFFFF');
      this.sprite(bg, bx, by);
      if (b.notch === 10 && this.img.boss_n10_bg) this.sprite('boss_n10_bg', bx, by);
      const pw = Math.ceil(182 * clamp(b.progress, 0, 1));
      if (pw > 0) {
        c.drawImage(this.img[fg], 0, 0, pw, 5, bx, by, pw, 5);
        if (b.notch === 10 && this.img.boss_n10_fg) c.drawImage(this.img.boss_n10_fg, 0, 0, pw, 5, bx, by, pw, 5);
      }
    });
    this.drawChat();
    this.drawSubtitles();
    this.drawToasts();
    if (this.debug) this.drawDebug();
    if (g.sleepFade > 0) {
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(10,10,20,${g.sleepFade})`;
      c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    // the mouse isn't captured (just joined a world, or capturing again after a screen closed failed): the pause
    // menu, like vanilla when the window loses focus - its "back to game" click captures the mouse. A short grace
    // for a capture still in flight; g.noLockPause (scripted tests, which never get the lock) keeps playing instead
    // closed with Esc, though, the browser refuses the lock (a key press is no "user gesture" for it): a line asking
    // for a click instead of the same menu coming straight back (Mac, players' feedback 2026-10-31). Nor while the Esc
    // that closed a screen is still down (escCapture: the lock is asked for when it comes up, main.js) - held past the
    // grace, the pause menu opened anyway: chat + Esc did that, feedback 2026-11-01 14:13
    const unlocked = document.pointerLockElement !== g.canvas,
      escWait = g.escCapture && g.escHeld && performance.now() - g.escHeld < 1500;
    if (g.clickToResume && (!unlocked || this.screen || g.state !== 'play')) g.clickToResume = 0;
    if (g.clickToResume && !touchOn(g) && !g.lockFails) {
      const t = '点击画面继续游戏',
        tw = Font.width(t);
      c.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      c.fillStyle = '#000';
      c.fillRect(Math.floor(W / 2 - tw / 2 - 6), Math.floor(H / 2) + 14, tw + 12, 14);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
      Font.center(c, t, W / 2, Math.floor(H / 2) + 17, '#FFFFFF');
    } else if (!this.screen && g.state === 'play' && unlocked && !g.debugPause && !touchOn(g) && !g.noLockPause && !g.lockFails && !escWait) {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (!this.unlockedAt) this.unlockedAt = now;else if (now - this.unlockedAt > 250) {
        this.unlockedAt = 0;
        this.open(new PauseScreen(g));
      }
    } else this.unlockedAt = 0;
  }
  drawChat() {
    const c = this.ctx,
      now = performance.now(),
      open = this.screen && this.screen.isChat;
    let y = this.h - 48 - (this.touch ? this.touch.chatLift() : 0);
    const pin = this.pinned;
    // (a row: [text, colour] runs - an administrator's coloured name; null is the message's own colour)
    const row = (m, r) => {
      let x = 4;
      for (const [t, col] of r) x = Font.draw(c, t, x, y, col || m.color);
    };
    let pinRows = 0;
    if (pin && now >= pin.until) {
      this.pinned = null;
      this.message(pin.text, pin.color);
    } else if (pin) {
      const rows = this.chatWrap(pin);
      for (let i = rows.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        c.globalAlpha = 0.5;
        c.fillStyle = '#000';
        c.fillRect(2, y - 1, 320, 10);
        c.globalAlpha = 1;
        row(pin, rows[i]);
        y -= 10;
      }
      pinRows = rows.length;
    }
    // counted in rows, as vanilla's ChatComponent (20 open, 10 closed; scrolled by rows)
    const n = Math.max(1, (open ? 20 : 10) - pinRows),
      off = open ? Math.min(this.chatOff || 0, Math.max(0, this.chatRowCount() - 20)) : 0;
    for (const [m, r] of this.chatRowsBack(off + n).slice(off)) {
      const age = now - m.t;
      if (!open && age > 10000) continue;
      const a = open ? 1 : clamp((10000 - age) / 1000, 0, 1);
      c.globalAlpha = a * 0.5;
      c.fillStyle = '#000';
      c.fillRect(2, y - 1, 320, 10);
      c.globalAlpha = a;
      row(m, r);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
      y -= 10;
    }
  }
  // a chat message in rows that fit the box, as vanilla's ComponentRenderUtils.wrapComponents: broken at the last space
  // that fits (anywhere in Chinese), at a line break, a row carried over indented by a space. A long message went on
  // past the box and off the screen. Kept on the message (m.parts may come after it was added: net.js)
  chatWrap(m) {
    const src = m.parts || m.text;
    if (m.wrap && m.wrapOf === src && m.wrapFont === Font.adv) return m.wrap;
    const ch = [],
      rows = [],
      MAX = 316,
      SP = Font.charW(' ');
    for (const [t, col] of m.parts || [[m.text, null]]) for (const s of String(t !== null && t !== void 0 ? t : '')) ch.push([s, col]);
    let st = 0,
      w = 0,
      sp = -1,
      ind = false;
    const emit = (a, b) => {
      const r = ind ? [[' ', null]] : [];
      for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
        const last = r[r.length - 1];
        if (last && last[1] === ch[i][1] && (r.length > 1 || !ind)) last[0] += ch[i][0];else r.push([ch[i][0], ch[i][1]]);
      }
      rows.push(r);
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < ch.length; i++) {
      const s = ch[i][0],
        cw = Font.charW(s);
      if (s === '\n') {
        emit(st, i);
        st = i + 1;
        w = 0;
        sp = -1;
        ind = false;
        continue;
      }
      if (w + cw > MAX - (ind ? SP : 0) && i > st) {
        if (s === ' ') {
          emit(st, i);
          st = i + 1;
          ind = true;
          w = 0;
          sp = -1;
          continue;
        }
        if (sp > st) {
          emit(st, sp);
          st = sp + 1;
        } else {
          emit(st, i);
          st = i;
        }
        ind = true;
        sp = -1;
        w = 0;
        for (let k = st; k < i; k++) w += Font.charW(ch[k][0]);
        i--;
        continue; // (this character again, on the new row)
      }
      if (s === ' ') sp = i;
      w += cw;
    }
    emit(st, ch.length);
    m.wrapOf = src;
    m.wrapFont = Font.adv; // (the font's widths: a message wrapped before they loaded is wrapped again)
    return m.wrap = rows;
  }
  // the newest max rows, newest first: [message, row]
  chatRowsBack(max) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = this.chat.length - 1; i >= 0 && out.length < max; i--) {
      const m = this.chat[i],
        rs = this.chatWrap(m);
      for (let j = rs.length - 1; j >= 0 && out.length < max; j--) out.push([m, rs[j]]);
    }
    return out;
  }
  chatRowCount() {
    let n = 0;
    for (const m of this.chat) n += this.chatWrap(m).length;
    return n;
  }
  // subtitles (vanilla SubtitleOverlay): the sounds heard in the last 3 seconds, each where it was last heard - an
  // arrow on the side it comes from when it's off to a side, the text greying as it gets older
  hearSound(ev, pos, vol) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!g.settings.subtitles || !self.SUBTITLES || !SUBTITLES[ev]) return;
    const L = Sound.listener;
    if (pos && Math.hypot(pos[0] - L.x, pos[1] - L.y, pos[2] - L.z) > Math.max(16, 16 * vol)) return;
    const text = SUBTITLES[ev],
      s = this.subs.find(e => e.text === text);
    if (s) {
      s.pos = pos;
      s.t = performance.now();
    } else this.subs.push({
      text,
      pos,
      t: performance.now()
    });
  }
  drawSubtitles() {
    const g = this.game,
      now = performance.now();
    if (!g.settings.subtitles || g.state !== 'play') {
      this.subs.length = 0;
      return;
    }
    this.subs = this.subs.filter(s => now - s.t < 3000);
    if (!this.subs.length) return;
    const c = this.ctx,
      L = Sound.listener,
      lw = Font.width('<'),
      sw = Font.width(' ');
    const k = Math.max(...this.subs.map(s => Font.width(s.text))) + lw * 2 + sw * 2;
    this.subs.forEach((s, i) => {
      const cx = this.w - k / 2 - 2,
        cy = this.h - 35 - i * 10,
        f = Math.round(255 - (now - s.t) / 3000 * 180);
      const col = `rgb(${f},${f},${f})`;
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
      c.fillRect(Math.round(cx - k / 2 - 1), cy - 5, k + 2, 10);
      Font.draw(c, s.text, Math.round(cx - Font.width(s.text) / 2), cy - 4, col, false);
      if (!s.pos) return;
      const dx = s.pos[0] - L.x,
        dz = s.pos[2] - L.z,
        d = Math.hypot(dx, s.pos[1] - L.y, dz);
      const right = d > 0.5 ? (dx * Math.cos(L.yaw) - dz * Math.sin(L.yaw)) / d : 0;
      if (right > 0.5) Font.draw(c, '>', Math.round(cx + k / 2 - lw), cy - 4, col, false);else if (right < -0.5) Font.draw(c, '<', Math.round(cx - k / 2), cy - 4, col, false);
    });
  }
  drawToasts() {
    const c = this.ctx,
      now = performance.now();
    const g = this.game;
    if (g.state === 'play' && g.tutorial >= 0 && g.mode === 'survival' && !this.toasts.length && !this.debug) {
      // with touch controls the toast sits below the pause / chat buttons
      const st = TUTORIAL[g.tutorial],
        x = this.w - 160,
        ty = this.touch ? this.touch.topInset() : 0,
        touch = touchOn(g);
      this.sprite('toast', x, ty);
      this.drawItem({
        id: item(st.icon),
        count: 1
      }, x + 8, ty + 8);
      Font.draw(c, st.title, x + 30, ty + 7, '#55FFFF', false);
      Font.draw(c, touch && st.touch || st.text, x + 30, ty + 18, '#FFFFFF', false);
    }
    this.toasts = this.toasts.filter(t => now - t.t < 5500);
    let y = this.touch ? this.touch.topInset() : 0;
    for (const t of this.toasts) {
      const age = now - t.t;
      if (age > 5000 && !t.out) {
        t.out = true;
        Sound.ev('ui.toast.out', null, 1, 1);
      }
      const slide = age < 400 ? 1 - age / 400 : age > 5000 ? (age - 5000) / 500 : 0;
      const x = this.w - 160 + Math.round(slide * 160);
      this.sprite('toast', x, y);
      if (t.icon) this.drawItem({
        id: t.icon,
        count: 1
      }, x + 8, y + 8);
      Font.draw(c, t.title, x + 30, y + 7, '#FFFF00', false);
      Font.draw(c, t.sub, x + 30, y + 18, '#FFFFFF', false);
      y += 32;
    }
  }
  drawDebug() {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      c = this.ctx;
    const x = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(p.pos[1]),
      z = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
    const dirs = ['南 (+Z)', '西 (-X)', '北 (-Z)', '东 (+X)'];
    let yaw = (-p.yaw * 180 / Math.PI % 360 + 540) % 360 - 180;
    const facing = dirs[Math.round((yaw + 180) % 360 / 90) % 4];
    const ch = g.world.getChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4);
    const bi = ch ? BIOMES[ch.biome[(z & 15) << 4 | x & 15]] : '?';
    const l = g.world.getLight(x, y, z);
    const t = g.dayTime();
    const L = [`OpusMC (26.2 官方材质)`, `${g.fps} fps  区段: ${g.renderer.stats ? g.renderer.stats.sections : 0}  三角形: ${g.renderer.stats ? g.renderer.stats.tris : 0}` + (typeof DynRes !== 'undefined' && g.settings.dynRes ? `  渲染比例: ${Math.round(DynRes.scale * 100)}%` : ''), `区块: 已加载 ${g.world.chunks.size}  待生成 ${g.genQueueLen || 0}  实体: ${g.entities.length}  粒子: ${g.particles.list.length}`, ``, `XYZ: ${p.pos[0].toFixed(3)} / ${(p.pos[1] + (g.world.minY || 0)).toFixed(3)} / ${p.pos[2].toFixed(3)}`, `方块: ${x} ${y + (g.world.minY || 0)} ${z}   区块: ${x >> 4} ${z >> 4}`, `朝向: ${facing} (${yaw.toFixed(1)} / ${(p.pitch * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1)})`, `生物群系: ${bi}`, `光照: 天空 ${l >> 4}  方块 ${l & 15}`, `时间: 第 ${Math.floor(g.worldTime / 24000) + 1} 天  ${String(Math.floor((t / 1000 + 6) % 24)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor(t % 1000 * 0.06)).padStart(2, '0')}`, `种子: ${g.world.seed}   维度: ${DIM_CN[g.dim] || g.dim}`];
    if (g.target) {
      const b = BLOCKS[g.world.getBlock(...g.target.pos)];
      L.push(`目标方块: minecraft:${b ? b.key : '?'} (${g.target.pos[0]}, ${g.target.pos[1] + (g.world.minY || 0)}, ${g.target.pos[2]})`);
    }
    let yy = 2;
    for (const s of L) {
      if (s) {
        const w = Font.width(s);
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,80,80,0.55)';
        c.fillRect(1, yy - 1, w + 2, 10);
        Font.draw(c, s, 2, yy, '#E0E0E0', false);
      }
      yy += 10;
    }
    // right column (like vanilla's): performance and memory; frame-time graph at the bottom
    PerfMon.gpuOn = true;
    // a narrow screen has no room for two columns side by side: the second goes below the first
    yy = this.w < 560 ? yy + 6 : 2;
    for (const l of PerfMon.lines(g)) {
      const s = typeof l === 'string' ? l : l.text,
        col = typeof l === 'string' ? '#E0E0E0' : l.color;
      if (s) {
        const w = Font.width(s),
          x0 = this.w - w - 2;
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,80,80,0.55)';
        c.fillRect(x0 - 1, yy - 1, w + 2, 10);
        Font.draw(c, s, x0, yy, col, false);
      }
      yy += 10;
    }
    PerfMon.drawGraph(c, 2, this.h - 2, Math.min(240, Math.floor(this.w / 2) - 4), 60, g);
  }

  // ---- frame ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  draw() {
    const c = this.ctx;
    // (a page with no size - an app web view in the background or a frame folded away: the vignette copy, made the
    // canvas's size, could not be drawn - telemetry 11-02/03 'canvas element with a width or height of 0' - and there is
    // nothing to see anyway: nothing drawn until it has a size again, which resize() gives it)
    if (!this.canvas.width || !this.canvas.height) return;
