    c.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    c.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
    c.setTransform(this.scale, 0, 0, this.scale, 0, 0);
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    const g = this.game;
    // played with the mouse free (the browser refuses the lock, main.js freeMouse): no pointer over the world, as when
    // locked - it stayed in sight the whole game (phones / tablets with a mouse, QQ / WeChat / learning-machine browsers)
    const hide = g.state === 'play' && !this.screen && g.lockFails > 0 && document.pointerLockElement !== g.canvas && !touchOn(g);
    if (hide !== !!this.ptrHidden && document.body) {
      this.ptrHidden = hide;
      document.body.style.cursor = hide ? 'none' : '';
    }
    if (g.state === 'play') {
      this.drawOverlays();
      this.drawHUD();
    }
    this.wantBlur = false;
    if (this.screen) this.screen.draw(this);
    if (typeof UnlockSparks !== 'undefined') UnlockSparks.draw(this); // (account.js: something just unlocked)
    if (this.wantBlur !== !!this.blurOn) {
      this.blurOn = this.wantBlur;
      const st = g.canvas.style;
      st.filter = this.blurOn ? 'blur(5px)' : '';
      st.transform = this.blurOn ? 'scale(1.03)' : '';
    }
    this.drawInputText();
    if (this.touch) this.touch.draw(this);
    if (this.cursor) this.drawItem(this.cursor, this.mouse.x - 8, this.mouse.y - 8);
  }
  // the underwater tile at brightness q (0-1): black at 1 - q laid over it inside its own alpha, which is what the
  // brightness(q) filter did to it (at most 33 of 16x16 kept)
  waterTile(q) {
    const src = this.img.underwater;
    if (this.waterOf !== src) {
      this.waterOf = src;
      this.waterTiles = new Map();
    }
    let cv = this.waterTiles.get(q);
    if (!cv) {
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = src.width;
      cv.height = src.height;
      const k = cv.getContext('2d');
      k.drawImage(src, 0, 0);
      if (q < 1) {
        k.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop';
        k.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${1 - q})`;
        k.fillRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      }
      this.waterTiles.set(q, cv);
    }
    return cv;
  }
  drawOverlays() {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      c = this.ctx,
      W = this.w,
      H = this.h;
    // vignette
    // vanilla darkens the screen by the texture's brightness (blend ZERO, ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR);
    // the UI canvas is transparent, so turn it into a black overlay with that brightness as alpha
    if (!this.vigCanvas && this.img.vignette && this.img.vignette.width) {
      const src = this.img.vignette,
        vc = document.createElement('canvas');
      vc.width = src.width;
      vc.height = src.height;
      const vx = vc.getContext('2d');
      vx.drawImage(src, 0, 0);
      const id = vx.getImageData(0, 0, vc.width, vc.height),
        d = id.data;
      for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
        d[i + 3] = d[i];
        d[i] = d[i + 1] = d[i + 2] = 0;
      }
      vx.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
      this.vigCanvas = vc;
    }
    // scaled to the canvas once (at half strength) and then copied 1:1 each frame: stretching the 256 px texture
    // over the whole screen every frame is cheap only while the browser draws canvases on the GPU - when it falls
    // back to drawing them in software (it can, after a while, until the page reloads) it cost most of a frame
    const cw = this.canvas.width,
      chh = this.canvas.height;
    if (this.vigCanvas && (!this.vigFull || this.vigFull.width !== cw || this.vigFull.height !== chh)) {
      const vf = this.vigFull = document.createElement('canvas');
      vf.width = cw;
      vf.height = chh;
      const fx = vf.getContext('2d');
      fx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      fx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      fx.drawImage(this.vigCanvas, 0, 0, cw, chh);
    }
    if (this.vigFull) {
      c.save();
      c.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      c.drawImage(this.vigFull, 0, 0);
      c.restore();
    }
    // under water: vanilla ScreenEffectRenderer.renderWater - underwater.png stretched four times across the
    // screen each way, at 10% and darkened by the light at the eyes, sliding 1/64 tile per degree of turning.
    // Darkened beforehand: the 16 px tile kept per brightness step (1/32: under 1/2 a level of the 10% overlay) - a
    // canvas filter made the browser draw each of the 25 tiles through an offscreen layer of its own
    if (g.headInWater && this.img.underwater) {
      const [sky, blk] = p.lightAt(),
        lv = Math.max(sky * g.daylight(), blk),
        br = lv / (4 - 3 * lv);
      const tw = W / 4,
        th = H / 4,
        D = 180 / Math.PI,
        im = this.waterTile(Math.round(br * 32) / 32);
      const ox = (p.yaw * D / 64 % 1 + 1) % 1 * tw,
        oy = (p.pitch * D / 64 % 1 + 1) % 1 * th;
      c.globalAlpha = 0.1;
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      for (let x = ox - tw; x < W; x += tw) for (let y = oy - th; y < H; y += th) c.drawImage(im, x, y, tw, th);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    }
    if (g.headInLava) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,60,0,0.75)';
      c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    // freezing in powder snow: vanilla's frost round the edges of the view, as strong as how frozen (140 ticks = full)
    if ((p.frozenT || 0) > 0 && this.img.powder_snow_outline) {
      c.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.frozenT / 140);
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      c.drawImage(this.img.powder_snow_outline, 0, 0, W, H);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    }
    // burning: two animated flames at the bottom corners of the view (vanilla screen fire)
    if (p.fire > 0 && !p.creative && !p.fireproof && g.perspective === 0 && !g.headInLava) {
      const r = g.renderer,
        base = T('fire_1'),
        frames = ANIM_FRAMES[base] || 1,
        layer = base + Math.floor(g.worldTime / 2) % frames;
      const sz = Math.round(H * 0.62);
      c.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        c.save();
        c.translate(W / 2 + side * W * 0.27, H - sz * 0.32);
        c.transform(1, side * 0.08, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        if (side < 0) c.scale(-1, 1);
        c.drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(layer), 16, 16, -sz / 2, -sz / 2, sz, sz);
        c.restore();
      }
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    // the eyes in a block: its texture, dark (vanilla ScreenEffectRenderer) - not the caves and ores beyond it
    const wallId = g.perspective === 0 && !p.noClip && g.inWallBlock ? g.inWallBlock() : 0;
    if (wallId) {
      var _b$particle;
      const r = g.renderer,
        b = BLOCKS[wallId],
        layer = (_b$particle = b.particle) !== null && _b$particle !== void 0 ? _b$particle : Array.isArray(b.tex) ? b.tex[0] : b.tex;
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      if (layer != null) c.drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(layer), 16, 16, 0, 0, W, H);
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)';
      c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    if (g.portalOverlay > 0) {
      const r = g.renderer,
        layer = T('nether_portal') + Math.floor(performance.now() / 100) % 32;
      c.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.85, g.portalOverlay * 0.9);
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      c.drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(layer), 16, 16, 0, 0, W, H);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    if (p.fire > 0 && !p.creative && g.perspective === 0) {
      const r = g.renderer,
        layer = T('fire_0') + g.tickCount % 32;
      c.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      const s = Math.min(W, H) * 0.45;
      c.drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(layer), 16, 16, W / 2 - s * 1.1, H - s * 0.75, s, s);
      c.drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(layer), 16, 16, W / 2 + s * 0.1, H - s * 0.75, s, s);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    if (p.hurtTime > 0) {
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(160,0,0,${p.hurtTime / 10 * 0.25})`;
      c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    if (p.deathTime > 0) {
      const a = Math.min(0.6, p.deathTime / 40);
      const gr = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      gr.addColorStop(0, `rgba(80,0,0,${a})`);
      gr.addColorStop(1, `rgba(160,20,20,${a})`);
      c.fillStyle = gr;
      c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
  }

  // ---- input routing -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  mouseMove(ev) {
    [this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y] = this.toGui(ev);
    if (this.screen && this.screen.mouseMove) this.screen.mouseMove(this, this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y);
  }
  mouseDown(ev) {
    [this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y] = this.toGui(ev);
    this.mouse.down = true;
    this.mouse.button = ev.button;
    if (this.screen && this.screen.mouseDown) this.screen.mouseDown(this, this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y, ev.button, ev.shiftKey);
  }
  mouseUp(ev) {
    [this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y] = this.toGui(ev);
    this.mouse.down = false;
    if (this.screen && this.screen.mouseUp) this.screen.mouseUp(this, this.mouse.x, this.mouse.y, ev.button);
  }
  wheel(dy) {
    if (this.screen && this.screen.wheel) this.screen.wheel(this, dy);
  }
  key(ev) {
    if (this.screen && this.screen.key) return this.screen.key(this, ev);
    return false;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Container screen base (slot handling, MC click semantics)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, bg, w, h, title) {
    this.game = game;
    this.bg = bg;
    this.gw = w;
    this.gh = h;
    this.title = title;
    this.slots = [];
    this.dragSlots = null;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.x = Math.floor((u.w - this.gw) / 2);
    this.y = Math.floor((u.h - this.gh) / 2);
  }
  addPlayerSlots(y0, hotY) {
    const inv = this.game.player.inv;
    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
      const i = 9 + r * 9 + c;
      this.slots.push({
        x: 8 + c * 18,
        y: y0 + r * 18,
        get: () => inv.slots[i],
        set: s => {
          inv.slots[i] = s;
        },
        group: 'main',
        idx: i
      });
    }
    for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) this.slots.push({
      x: 8 + c * 18,
      y: hotY,
      get: () => inv.slots[c],
      set: s => {
        inv.slots[c] = s;
      },
      group: 'hotbar',
      idx: c
    });
  }
  slotAt(mx, my) {
    for (const s of this.slots) if (mx >= this.x + s.x - 1 && mx < this.x + s.x + 17 && my >= this.y + s.y - 1 && my < this.y + s.y + 17) return s;
    return null;
  }
  drawBase(ui) {
    var _this$titleX;
    ui.dim(0.6);
    ui.ctx.drawImage(ui.img[this.bg], 0, 0, this.gw, this.gh, this.x, this.y, this.gw, this.gh);
    if (this.title) Font.draw(ui.ctx, this.title, this.x + ((_this$titleX = this.titleX) !== null && _this$titleX !== void 0 ? _this$titleX : 8), this.y + 6, '#404040', false);
  }
  drawSlots(ui) {
    const hov = this.slotAt(ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    for (const s of this.slots) {
      const st = s.get();
      if (!st && s.emptyIcon) {
        ui.ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
        ui.sprite(s.emptyIcon, this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y);
        ui.ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      ui.drawItem(st, this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y);
      if (s === hov || this.dragSlots && this.dragSlots.has(s)) {
        ui.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
        ui.ctx.fillRect(this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y, 16, 16);
      }
    }
    if (hov && hov.get() && !ui.cursor) ui.tooltip(ui.tipLines(hov.get()), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  draw(ui) {
    this.drawBase(ui);
    this.drawExtra && this.drawExtra(ui);
    this.drawSlots(ui);
  }
  canPlace(s, st) {
    return !s.output && (!s.accept || s.accept(st));
  }
  maxIn(s, st) {
    return Math.min(maxStack(st.id), s.max || 64);
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const s = this.slotAt(mx, my);
    if (!s) {
      if (this.outside && this.outside(mx, my) && ui.cursor) {
        if (button === 0) {
          this.game.dropFromPlayer(ui.cursor);
          ui.cursor = null;
        } else if (button === 2) {
          this.game.dropFromPlayer({
            ...ui.cursor,
            count: 1
          });
          ui.cursor.count--;
          if (!ui.cursor.count) ui.cursor = null;
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    Sound.init();
    // (a long press - the touch layer's right click - on a result takes all it can make: there is no shift on a phone)
    if (s.output) {
      this.takeOutput(ui, s, shift || button === 2 && typeof touchOn === 'function' && touchOn(this.game));
      return;
    }
    if (shift && button === 0) {
      this.quickMove(s);
      this.changed();
      return;
    }
    const st = s.get(),
      now = performance.now();
    // double click (vanilla PICKUP_ALL): the stack just picked up from this slot, clicked again - the same items from
    // every other slot gathered onto it. (It used to take the remembered stack back as the cursor, which a quick
    // tap sequence could leave lying in a slot too: the same tool in two places - 「背包随便划拉一下就能复制物品」,
    // and a real double click never got there - 「电脑双击不能收集一组」, feedback 2026-11-02)
    if (button === 0 && ui.cursor && !st && this.lastClick && now - this.lastClick.t < 300 && this.lastClick.slot === s && this.lastClick.stack === ui.cursor) {
      const c = ui.cursor,
        ms = maxStack(c.id);
      if (!(ITEMS[c.id] && ITEMS[c.id].durability)) for (const o of this.slots) {
        if (o.output || c.count >= ms) continue;
        const os = o.get();
        if (os && os !== c && sameKind(os, c)) {
          const k = Math.min(os.count, ms - c.count);
          c.count += k;
          os.count -= k;
          if (!os.count) o.set(null);
        }
      }
      this.lastClick = null;
      this.changed();
      return;
    }
    // start drag distribution
    if (ui.cursor && (button === 0 || button === 2) && (!st || sameKind(st, ui.cursor))) {
      this.dragSlots = new Set([s]);
      this.dragButton = button;
      this.dragStart = s;
    }
    if (this.dragSlots) return; // resolved on mouseUp
    this.clickSlot(ui, s, button);
    this.lastClick = {
      t: now,
      slot: s,
      stack: ui.cursor
    };
  }
  clickSlot(ui, s, button) {
    const st = s.get();
    if (s.armorSlot !== undefined && st && enchLevel(st, 'binding_curse') && !this.game.player.creative) return;
    if (button === 0) {
      if (!ui.cursor) {
        if (st) {
          ui.cursor = st;
          s.set(null);
        }
      } else if (!st) {
        if (this.canPlace(s, ui.cursor)) {
          const k = Math.min(ui.cursor.count, this.maxIn(s, ui.cursor));
          s.set({
            ...ui.cursor,
            count: k
          });
          ui.cursor.count -= k;
          if (!ui.cursor.count) ui.cursor = null;
        }
      } else if (sameKind(st, ui.cursor) && !(ITEMS[st.id] && ITEMS[st.id].durability)) {
        const k = Math.min(ui.cursor.count, this.maxIn(s, st) - st.count);
        st.count += k;
        ui.cursor.count -= k;
        if (!ui.cursor.count) ui.cursor = null;
      } else if (this.canPlace(s, ui.cursor)) {
        s.set(ui.cursor);
        ui.cursor = st;
      }
    } else if (button === 2) {
      if (!ui.cursor) {
        if (st) {
          const k = Math.ceil(st.count / 2);
          ui.cursor = {
            ...st,
            count: k
          };
          st.count -= k;
          if (!st.count) s.set(null);
        }
      } else if (!st) {
        if (this.canPlace(s, ui.cursor)) {
          s.set({
            ...ui.cursor,
            count: 1
          });
          ui.cursor.count--;
          if (!ui.cursor.count) ui.cursor = null;
        }
      } else if (sameKind(st, ui.cursor) && st.count < this.maxIn(s, st)) {
        st.count++;
        ui.cursor.count--;
        if (!ui.cursor.count) ui.cursor = null;
      } else if (this.canPlace(s, ui.cursor)) {
        s.set(ui.cursor);
        ui.cursor = st;
      }
    }
    this.changed();
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    if (this.dragSlots && ui.mouse.down && ui.cursor) {
      const s = this.slotAt(mx, my);
      if (s && !s.output && (!s.get() || sameKind(s.get(), ui.cursor)) && this.canPlace(s, ui.cursor) && this.dragSlots.size < ui.cursor.count + (this.dragButton === 2 ? 0 : 0)) this.dragSlots.add(s);
    }
  }
  mouseUp(ui, mx, my, button) {
    if (!this.dragSlots) return;
    const set = [...this.dragSlots];
    this.dragSlots = null;
    if (set.length === 1) {
      this.clickSlot(ui, set[0], this.dragButton);
      return;
    }
    if (!ui.cursor) return;
    const per = this.dragButton === 2 ? 1 : Math.floor(ui.cursor.count / set.length);
    if (per < 1) return;
    for (const s of set) {
      if (!ui.cursor) break;
      const st = s.get();
      const room = this.maxIn(s, ui.cursor) - (st ? st.count : 0);
      const k = Math.min(per, room, ui.cursor.count);
      if (k <= 0) continue;
      if (st) st.count += k;else s.set({
        ...ui.cursor,
        count: k
      });
      ui.cursor.count -= k;
      if (!ui.cursor.count) ui.cursor = null;
    }
    this.changed();
  }
  quickMove(s) {
    const st = s.get();
    if (!st) return;
    let targets;
    if (s.group === 'hotbar') targets = this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'container').length ? this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'container') : this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'main');else if (s.group === 'main') targets = this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'container').length ? this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'container') : this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'hotbar');else targets = this.slots.filter(o => o.group === 'hotbar' || o.group === 'main').sort((a, b) => (a.group === 'hotbar' ? 1 : 0) - (b.group === 'hotbar' ? 1 : 0)).reverse();
    if (ITEMS[st.id] && ITEMS[st.id].armor && (s.group === 'main' || s.group === 'hotbar')) {
      const a = this.slots.find(o => o.armorSlot === ITEMS[st.id].armor.slot && !o.get());
      if (a) {
        a.set(st);
        s.set(null);
        return;
      }
    }
    targets = targets.filter(t => this.canPlace(t, st));
    for (const t of targets) {
      const ts = t.get();
      if (ts && sameKind(ts, st) && !(ITEMS[st.id] && ITEMS[st.id].durability)) {
        const k = Math.min(st.count, this.maxIn(t, st) - ts.count);
        ts.count += k;
        st.count -= k;
        if (!st.count) {
          s.set(null);
          return;
        }
      }
    }
    for (const t of targets) {
      if (!t.get()) {
        const k = Math.min(st.count, this.maxIn(t, st));
        t.set({
          ...st,
          count: k
        });
        st.count -= k;
        if (!st.count) {
          s.set(null);
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  takeOutput(ui, s, shift) {
    const st = s.get();
    if (!st) return;
    if (shift) {
      let guard = 0;
      while (s.get() && guard++ < 64) {
        const out = s.get(),
          inv = this.game.player.inv;
        // only a result that fits whole: part of it put in, the rest refused, was a part had without paying
        let room = 0;
        const ms = maxStack(out.id);
        for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
          const t = inv.slots[i];
          room += !t ? ms : sameKind(t, out) && !ITEMS[t.id].durability ? Math.max(0, ms - t.count) : 0;
        }
        if (room < out.count) break;
        // (vanilla quickMoveStack of a result: the hotbar from its right end, then the inventory from its last slot -
        // not the selected slot or the offhand first, as a pickup)
        inv.add({
          ...out
        }, [8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, ...Array.from({
          length: 27
        }, (_, i) => 35 - i)]);
        s.onTake(out);
        this.changed();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!ui.cursor) {
      ui.cursor = {
        ...st
      };
      s.onTake(st);
    } else if (sameKind(ui.cursor, st) && ui.cursor.count + st.count <= maxStack(st.id)) {
      ui.cursor.count += st.count;
      s.onTake(st);
    }
    this.changed();
  }
  // the hotbar keys, swap-with-offhand and drop as bound (按键绑定), like vanilla's AbstractContainerScreen
  // (checkHotbarKeyPressed, keyDrop) - they were 1-9 and Q whatever the bindings said, and no offhand key
  key(ui, ev) {
    const acts = bindingsFor(this.game, ev.code);
    if (acts.includes('inventory')) return false; // (closes the screen first, as vanilla: main.js)
    const hb = acts.find(a => a.startsWith('hotbar.'));
    if (hb || acts.includes('swapOffhand')) {
      const s = this.slotAt(ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
      if (s && !s.output && !ui.cursor) {
        // (not while an item is carried, as vanilla)
        const inv = this.game.player.inv,
          i = hb ? +hb.slice(7) - 1 : 40;
        const a = s.get(),
          b = inv.slots[i];
        // creative palette / trash: a full stack into the slot, nothing back; empty cell does nothing (vanilla SWAP)
        if (s.creative || s.trash) {
          if (a) {
            inv.slots[i] = {
              ...a,
              count: maxStack(a.id),
              dmg: 0
            };
            this.changed();
          }
        } else if (!b || this.canPlace(s, b)) {
          s.set(b);
          inv.slots[i] = a;
          this.changed();
        }
      }
      return true;
    }
    if (acts.includes('drop')) {
      const s = this.slotAt(ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
      if (s && s.get() && !s.output && !ui.cursor) {
        const st = s.get();
        const n = ev.ctrlKey ? s.creative ? maxStack(st.id) : st.count : 1;
        this.game.dropFromPlayer({
          ...st,
          count: n
        });
        st.count -= n;
        if (!st.count) s.set(null);
        this.changed();
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  outside(mx, my) {
    return mx < this.x || my < this.y || mx > this.x + this.gw || my > this.y + this.gh;
  }
  changed() {}
}
class CraftingScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, size) {
    const big = size === 3;
    super(game, big ? 'crafting_table' : 'inventory', 176, 166, big ? '合成' : null);
    this.size = size;
    this.grid = new Array(size * size).fill(null);
    if (big) this.titleX = 29; // vanilla CraftingScreen title position
    const ox = big ? 30 : 98,
      oy = big ? 17 : 18;
    for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
      const i = r * size + c;
      this.slots.push({
        x: ox + c * 18,
        y: oy + r * 18,
        get: () => this.grid[i],
        set: s => {
          this.grid[i] = s;
        },
        group: 'craft'
      });
    }
    this.result = null;
    this.slots.push({
      x: big ? 124 : 154,
      y: big ? 35 : 28,
      output: true,
      get: () => this.result,
      set: () => {},
      onTake: () => this.consume()
    });
    if (!big) {
      const inv = game.player.inv;
      const icons = ['slot_helmet', 'slot_chestplate', 'slot_leggings', 'slot_boots'];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.slots.push({
        x: 8,
        y: 8 + i * 18,
        armorSlot: i,
        emptyIcon: icons[i],
        get: () => inv.slots[36 + i],
        set: s => {
          inv.slots[36 + i] = s;
        },
        accept: st => !!ITEMS[st.id] && ITEMS[st.id].armor && ITEMS[st.id].armor.slot === i,
        max: 1,
        group: 'armor'
      });
    }
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
    if (!big && !game.net) {
      const inv = game.player.inv;
      this.slots.push({
        x: 77,
        y: 62,
        emptyIcon: 'slot_shield',
        get: () => inv.slots[40],
        set: s => {
          inv.slots[40] = s;
        },
        group: 'offhand'
      });
    }
  }
  changed() {
    const r = matchRecipe(this.grid, this.size);
    const src = r && r.keep !== undefined ? this.grid.find(s => s && r.ing[r.keep].includes(s.id)) : null;
    this.result = r ? {
      ...(src || {}),
      id: r.result,
      count: r.count,
      dmg: src ? src.dmg || 0 : 0
    } : null;
  }
  // vanilla recipe book: closed by default; when open the GUI moves right (RecipeBookComponent)
  layout() {
    super.layout();
    const u = this.game.ui;
    // vanilla widthTooNarrow (< 379): the open book is drawn centred in place of the container
    this.narrow = u.w < 379;
    this.bookOpen = this.game.settings.recipeBook === true;
    if (this.bookOpen && !this.narrow) this.x = 177 + Math.floor((u.w - this.gw - 200) / 2);
    if (!this.bookOpen || !this.narrow) this.peek = false;
    this.bookBtn = this.size === 3 ? {
      x: 5,
      y: 34,
      w: 20,
      h: 18
    } : {
      x: 104,
      y: 61,
      w: 20,
      h: 18
    };
    this.page = this.page || 0;
    this.tab = this.tab || 0;
    this.search = this.search || '';
    if (!this.bookOpen && this.searching) {
      u.hideInput();
      this.searching = false;
    }
  }
  // vanilla crafting book categories: 1 equipment, 2 building blocks, 3 misc, 4 redstone
  static category(id) {
    const it = ITEMS[id],
      k = it.key;
    if (it.tool || it.armor || ['bow', 'arrow', 'shears', 'flint_and_steel', 'fishing_rod'].includes(k)) return 1;
    if (['tnt', 'note_block', 'oak_door', 'oak_trapdoor', 'redstone_block'].includes(k)) return 4;
    if (it.block !== undefined && !['crafting_table', 'furnace', 'chest', 'torch', 'ladder', 'jack_o_lantern', 'bookshelf', 'end_crystal'].includes(k) && !BLOCKS[it.block].bed) return 2;
    return 3;
  }
  bookRecipes() {
    const n = this.size * this.size;
    // a recipe that takes another of the same kind of thing and only changes its colour (a dye and a bed of another
    // colour): its ingredient lists hold items whose names end the same way as the result's
    const tail = id => String(ITEMS[id] && ITEMS[id].key || '').replace(/^.*?_/, '');
    const recolours = x => {
      const t = tail(x.result);
      return (x.ing || Object.values(x.keys || {})).some(alts => [].concat(alts).some(id => id !== x.result && tail(id) === t && ITEMS[id].key !== ITEMS[x.result].key));
    };
    const inv = this.game.player.inv;
    const avail = new Map();
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
      const s = inv.slots[i];
      if (s) avail.set(s.id, (avail.get(s.id) || 0) + s.count);
    }
    for (const s of this.grid) if (s) avail.set(s.id, (avail.get(s.id) || 0) + s.count);
    const q = this.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    // one entry per result item (vanilla groups alternative recipes into one "many" button)
    const byResult = new Map();
    for (const r of RECIPES) {
      if (r.type === 'shaped' ? r.w > this.size || r.h > this.size : r.ing.length > n) continue;
      if (this.tab > 0 && CraftingScreen.category(r.result) !== this.tab) continue;
      if (q && !ITEMS[r.result].cn.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !ITEMS[r.result].key.includes(q)) continue;
      const plan = planRecipe(r, avail, this.size);
      let e = byResult.get(r.result);
      // (the one shown: one that can be made now, else the item's own recipe before a re-colouring one - a white
      // bed showed "dye + any bed" when the wool and planks weren't there yet, and players took it for the only way)
      const rank = (x, p) => (p ? 4 : 0) + (x.type === 'shaped' ? 2 : 0) + (recolours(x) ? 0 : 1);
      if (!e) byResult.set(r.result, e = {
        r,
        plan,
        many: false
      });else {
        e.many = true;
        if (rank(r, plan) > rank(e.r, e.plan)) {
          e.r = r;
          e.plan = plan;
        }
      }
    }
    let list = [...byResult.values()];
    if (this.onlyCraftable) list = list.filter(e => e.plan);
    list.sort((a, b) => (b.plan ? 1 : 0) - (a.plan ? 1 : 0));
    return list;
  }
  // bookRecipes, again only when what it depends on changed: the inventory, the grid, the tab, the search, the filter
  // (it ran every frame - about 950 recipes planned against the inventory: 「图鉴太卡点不动」「翻页卡顿」, worse in rooms)
  bookList() {
    const inv = this.game.player.inv,
      sig = st => st ? st.id + ':' + st.count : '-';
    let key = this.size + '|' + this.tab + '|' + this.search + '|' + !!this.onlyCraftable + '|' + !!this.net + '|';
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) key += sig(inv.slots[i]) + ',';
    for (const st of this.grid) key += sig(st) + ',';
    // (in a room the grid is the server's window, not this.grid: there, also at most every half second)
    const now = performance.now();
    if (key !== this.bookKey || this.net && now - this.bookAt > 500) {
      this.bookKey = key;
      this.bookAt = now;
      this.bookCache = this.bookRecipes();
    }
    return this.bookCache;
  }
  fillRecipe(entry, max) {
    const inv = this.game.player.inv,
      ui = this.game.ui;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.grid.length; i++) if (this.grid[i]) {
      ui.returnStack(this.grid[i]);
      this.grid[i] = null;
    }
    const avail = new Map();
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
      const s = inv.slots[i];
      if (s) avail.set(s.id, (avail.get(s.id) || 0) + s.count);
    }
    const plan = planRecipe(entry.r, avail, this.size);
    this.ghost = null;
    if (!plan) {
      // not enough materials: show the recipe as a red "ghost" in the grid, like vanilla
      const g = new Array(this.size * this.size).fill(null),
        r = entry.r;
      if (r.type === 'shaped') {
        for (let y = 0; y < r.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < r.w; x++) {
          const ch = r.pattern[y][x];
          if (ch && ch !== ' ') g[y * this.size + x] = r.keys[ch];
        }
      } else r.ing.forEach((opts, i) => {
        g[i] = opts;
      });
      this.ghost = {
        slots: g,
        result: r.result,
        t: performance.now()
      };
      this.changed();
      return;
    }
    let times = 1;
    if (max) {
      const need = new Map();
      for (const c of plan) if (c) need.set(c.id, (need.get(c.id) || 0) + 1);
      times = 64;
      for (const [id, k] of need) times = Math.min(times, Math.floor(avail.get(id) / k), maxStack(id));
      times = Math.max(1, times);
    }
    plan.forEach((c, i) => {
      if (c) {
        inv.remove(c.id, times);
        this.grid[i] = {
          id: c.id,
          count: times,
          dmg: 0
        };
      }
    });
    this.changed();
    Sound.click();
  }
  bookLayout() {
    return {
      x: Math.floor((this.game.ui.w - 147) / 2) - (this.narrow ? 0 : 86),
      y: Math.floor((this.game.ui.h - 166) / 2),
      w: 147,
      h: 166
    };
  }
  drawBook(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      P = this.bookLayout();
    // category tabs on the left edge (the selected one sticks out 2 px further)
    this.tabRects = [];
    const icons = [['compass'], ['iron_axe', 'golden_sword'], ['bricks'], ['lava_bucket', 'apple'], ['redstone']];
    icons.forEach((ic, i) => {
      const sel = i === this.tab,
        x = P.x - 30 - (sel ? 2 : 0),
        y = P.y + 3 + i * 27;
      ui.sprite(sel ? 'rb_tab_selected' : 'rb_tab', x, y);
      this.tabRects.push({
        x,
        y,
        w: 35,
        h: 27
      });
      let ids = ic.map(k => ITEM_KEY[k]).filter(v => v !== undefined);
      if (!ids.length) ids = [ITEM_KEY.iron_pickaxe];
      ids.forEach((id, k) => ui.drawItem({
        id,
        count: 1
      }, x + 9 + (ids.length > 1 ? 3 * k - 2 : 0), y + 5 + (ids.length > 1 ? 3 * k - 1 : 0)));
    });
    c.drawImage(ui.img.recipe_book, 1, 1, 147, 166, P.x, P.y, 147, 166);
    // search box (its frame is part of the panel texture)
    this.searchRect = {
      x: P.x + 25,
      y: P.y + 13,
      w: 81,
      h: 14
    };
    if (!this.searching && !this.search) Font.draw(c, '搜索…', P.x + 27, P.y + 15, '#808080', false);else if (!this.searching) Font.draw(c, this.search, P.x + 27, P.y + 15, '#E0E0E0', false);
    // craftable-only toggle
    this.filterBtn = {
      x: P.x + 110,
      y: P.y + 12,
      w: 26,
      h: 16
    };
    ui.sprite((this.onlyCraftable ? 'rb_filter_enabled' : 'rb_filter_disabled') + (ui.hit(this.filterBtn) ? '_hl' : ''), this.filterBtn.x, this.filterBtn.y);
    const list = this.bookList();
    const per = 20,
      pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(list.length / per));
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    this.bookCells = [];
    let hover = null;
    list.slice(this.page * per, this.page * per + per).forEach((e, i) => {
      const x = P.x + 11 + i % 5 * 25,
        y = P.y + 31 + Math.floor(i / 5) * 25;
      const cell = {
        x,
        y,
        w: 25,
        h: 25,
        e
      };
      this.bookCells.push(cell);
      ui.sprite('rb_slot_' + (e.many ? 'many_' : '') + (e.plan ? 'craftable' : 'uncraftable'), x, y);
      ui.drawItem({
        id: e.r.result,
        count: e.r.count
      }, x + 4, y + 4);
      if (ui.hit(cell)) hover = e;
    });
    this.prevBtn = {
      x: P.x + 38,
      y: P.y + 137,
      w: 12,
      h: 17
    };
    this.nextBtn = {
      x: P.x + 93,
      y: P.y + 137,
      w: 12,
      h: 17
    };
    if (pages > 1) {
      const t = this.page + 1 + '/' + pages;
      Font.draw(c, t, P.x + 73 - Math.floor(Font.width(t) / 2), P.y + 141, '#FFFFFF', false);
      if (this.page > 0) ui.sprite('rb_page_backward' + (ui.hit(this.prevBtn) ? '_hl' : ''), this.prevBtn.x, this.prevBtn.y);
      if (this.page < pages - 1) ui.sprite('rb_page_forward' + (ui.hit(this.nextBtn) ? '_hl' : ''), this.nextBtn.x, this.nextBtn.y);
    }
    if (ui.hit(this.filterBtn) && !ui.cursor) ui.tooltip([{
      text: this.onlyCraftable ? '显示全部' : '显示可合成的配方'
    }], ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);else if (hover && !ui.cursor) ui.tooltip(ui.itemLines({
      id: hover.r.result,
      count: hover.r.count
    }), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  // red ghost of an uncraftable recipe (vanilla ghost slots); gone once something is placed
  drawGhost(ui) {
    const g = this.ghost;
    if (!g) return;
    if (this.grid.some(s => s)) {
      this.ghost = null;
      return;
    }
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cyc = Math.floor((performance.now() - g.t) / 1000);
    let k = 0;
    for (const s of this.slots) {
      if (s.group !== 'craft' && !s.output) continue;
      const opts = s.output ? [g.result] : g.slots[k++];
      if (!opts) continue;
      const id = opts[cyc % opts.length];
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.19)';
      c.fillRect(this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y, 16, 16);
      c.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      ui.drawItem({
        id,
        count: 1
      }, this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y);
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }
  consume() {
    const r = this.result;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.grid.length; i++) {
      const s = this.grid[i];
      if (s) {
        if (s.id === item('water_bucket') || s.id === item('lava_bucket')) {
          this.grid[i] = makeStack('bucket');
          continue;
        }
        s.count--;
        if (!s.count) this.grid[i] = null;
      }
    }
    if (r) this.game.onCraft(r.id, r.count);
    this.changed();
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const b = this.bookBtn,
      btn = () => ui.sprite(ui.hit({
        x: this.x + b.x,
        y: this.y + b.y,
        w: b.w,
        h: b.h
      }) ? 'rb_button_hl' : 'rb_button', this.x + b.x, this.y + b.y);
    // (narrow: the book covers the grid - once a recipe is chosen it steps aside (peek) so the grid and the result show;
    // its button brings it back. Phone players chose a recipe and saw nothing happen: 「配方表点不进去」)
    if (this.bookOpen && this.narrow && !this.peek) {
      ui.dim(0.6);
      this.drawBook(ui);
      btn();
      return;
    }
    this.drawBase(ui);
    if (this.bookOpen && !this.peek) this.drawBook(ui);
    this.drawExtra(ui);
    btn();
    this.drawGhost(ui);
    this.drawSlots(ui);
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const b = this.bookBtn;
    if (ui.hit({
      x: this.x + b.x,
      y: this.y + b.y,
      w: b.w,
      h: b.h
    }, mx, my)) {
      if (this.peek) {
        this.peek = false;
        Sound.click();
        return;
      }
      this.game.settings.recipeBook = !this.bookOpen;
      this.game.saveSettings();
      this.layout();
      Sound.click();
      return;
    }
    if (this.bookOpen && !this.peek) {
      const none = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        w: 0,
        h: 0
      };
      if (ui.hit(this.filterBtn || none, mx, my)) {
        this.onlyCraftable = !this.onlyCraftable;
        this.page = 0;
        Sound.click();
        return;
      }
      if (ui.hit(this.prevBtn || none, mx, my)) {
        this.page--;
        Sound.click();
        return;
      }
      if (ui.hit(this.nextBtn || none, mx, my)) {
        this.page++;
        Sound.click();
        return;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < (this.tabRects || []).length; i++) if (ui.hit(this.tabRects[i], mx, my)) {
        this.tab = i;
        this.page = 0;
        Sound.click();
        return;
      }
      if (ui.hit(this.searchRect || none, mx, my)) {
        const r = this.searchRect;
        this.searching = true;
        ui.showInput(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, this.search, () => {}, {
          onInput: v => {
            this.search = v;
            this.page = 0;
            this.tab = 0;
          },
          onEsc: () => {
            ui.hideInput();
            this.searching = false;
          },
          max: 30
        });
        return;
      }
      if (this.searching) {
        ui.hideInput();
        this.searching = false;
      }
      // (a long press - right click - fills as many as the materials make, as shift does)
      for (const c of this.bookCells || []) if (ui.hit(c, mx, my)) {
        if (!ui.cursor) {
          this.fillRecipe(c.e, shift || button === 2);
          if (this.narrow) this.peek = true;
        }
        return;
      }
      if (ui.hit(this.bookLayout(), mx, my) || this.narrow) return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    if (this.bookOpen && !this.peek && ui.hit(this.bookLayout())) this.page += Math.sign(dy);
  }
  // (touch: a finger dragged from the open book scrolls it, even from over the slots under it on a narrow screen - #B1)
  scrollsAt(x, y) {
    return !!this.bookOpen && !this.peek && this.game.ui.hit(this.bookLayout(), x, y);
  }
  outside(mx, my) {
    return super.outside(mx, my) && !(this.bookOpen && !this.peek && this.game.ui.hit(this.bookLayout(), mx, my));
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    if (this.size === 2) {
      Font.draw(ui.ctx, '合成', this.x + 97, this.y + 6, '#404040', false);
      // player preview
      const pv = this.game.renderer.playerPreview(this.game, ui, this.x + 26, this.y + 8, 49, 70);
      if (pv) {
        ui.ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        ui.ctx.drawImage(pv, this.x + 26, this.y + 8, 49, 70);
        ui.ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      }
    } else Font.draw(ui.ctx, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 72, '#404040', false);
  }
  close() {
    for (const s of this.grid) if (s) this.game.ui.returnStack(s);
    this.grid.fill(null);
    // (the result too: the 图鉴 button opens over this window and closes it - back from it, the old result was still
    // there to take from an empty grid, free planks; feedback 2026-11-01/02)
    this.result = null;
    this.ghost = null;
    if (this.searching) {
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      this.searching = false;
    }
  }
}

// one block entity = small chest (3 rows), two = large chest (6 rows)
class ChestScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, bes, title = '箱子') {
    if (!Array.isArray(bes)) bes = [bes];
    const rows = bes.length * 3;
    super(game, 'generic_54', 176, 114 + rows * 18, title);
    this.bes = bes;
    this.be = bes[0];
    this.rows = rows;
    bes.forEach((be, h) => {
      for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
        const i = r * 9 + c;
        this.slots.push({
          x: 8 + c * 18,
          y: 18 + (h * 3 + r) * 18,
          get: () => be.slots[i],
          set: s => {
            be.slots[i] = s;
          },
          group: 'container'
        });
      }
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(31 + rows * 18, 89 + rows * 18);
    for (const be of bes) game.openChests.add(be.pos.join(','));
    const p = this.be.pos,
      ob = game.world && BLOCKS[game.world.getBlock(p[0], p[1], p[2])];
    this.blockKey = ob ? ob.key : ''; // (what it is a screen of: barrels, shulker boxes and the ender chest close with their own sound)
  }
  // closing the screen when a half is broken
  owns(be) {
    return this.bes.includes(be);
  }
  drawBase(ui) {
    ui.dim(0.6);
    const c = ui.ctx,
      im = ui.img.generic_54,
      top = 17 + this.rows * 18;
    c.drawImage(im, 0, 0, 176, top, this.x, this.y, 176, top);
    c.drawImage(im, 0, 126, 176, 96, this.x, this.y + top, 176, 96);
    Font.draw(c, this.title, this.x + 8, this.y + 6, '#404040', false);
    Font.draw(c, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + top + 3, '#404040', false);
  }
  close() {
    for (const be of this.bes) {
      this.game.markBlockEntity(be);
      this.game.openChests.delete(be.pos.join(','));
    }
    const p = this.be.pos,
      c = [p[0] + 0.5, p[1] + 0.5, p[2] + 0.5],
      k = this.blockKey,
      w = this.game.world,
      pitch = Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9;
    if (k === 'barrel') {
      // the barrel shuts again (game.js opened it)
      const id = w.getBlock(p[0], p[1], p[2]),
        m = w.getMeta(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
      if (BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].key === 'barrel' && Features.propOf(id, m, 'open') === 'true') {
        w.setMeta(p[0], p[1], p[2], Features.withProp(id, m, 'open', false));
        if (this.game.flushMesh) this.game.flushMesh();
      }
      Sound.ev('block.barrel.close', c, 0.5, pitch);
    } else if (/(^|_)shulker_box$/.test(k)) Sound.ev('block.shulker_box.close', c, 0.5, pitch);else if (k === 'ender_chest') Sound.ev('block.ender_chest.close', c, 0.5, pitch);else Sound.chest(c, false);
  }
}
class FurnaceScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, be) {
    super(game, 'furnace', 176, 166, '熔炉');
    this.be = be;
    this.slots.push({
      x: 56,
      y: 17,
      get: () => be.input,
      set: s => {
        be.input = s;
      },
      group: 'container',
      accept: st => !!COOKING[be.kind || 'smelting'][st.id]
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 56,
      y: 53,
      get: () => be.fuel,
      set: s => {
        be.fuel = s;
      },
      group: 'container',
      accept: st => fuelValue(st.id) > 0
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 116,
      y: 35,
      output: true,
      get: () => be.output,
      set: s => {
        be.output = s;
      },
      onTake: st => {
        this.game.onSmeltTake(st, be);
        be.output = null;
      }
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
  }
  canPlace(s, st) {
    if (s.output) return false;
    return !s.accept || s.accept(st);
  }
  quickMove(s) {
    const st = s.get();
    if (!st) return;
    if (s.group === 'main' || s.group === 'hotbar') {
      const tgt = COOKING[this.be.kind || 'smelting'][st.id] ? this.slots[0] : fuelValue(st.id) ? this.slots[1] : null;
      if (tgt) {
        const ts = tgt.get();
        if (!ts) {
          tgt.set(st);
          s.set(null);
          return;
        }
        if (sameKind(ts, st)) {
          const k = Math.min(st.count, maxStack(st.id) - ts.count);
          ts.count += k;
          st.count -= k;
          if (!st.count) s.set(null);
          return;
        }
      }
    }
    super.quickMove(s);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const be = this.be,
      c = ui.ctx;
    if (be.burn > 0) {
      const f = Math.ceil(be.burn / be.burnMax * 13) + 1;
      c.drawImage(ui.img.lit_progress, 0, 14 - f, 14, f, this.x + 56, this.y + 36 + 14 - f, 14, f);
    }
    if (be.cook > 0) {
      const w = Math.ceil(be.cook / (be.cookMax || 200) * 24);
      c.drawImage(ui.img.burn_progress, 0, 0, w, 16, this.x + 79, this.y + 34, w, 16);
    }
    Font.draw(c, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 73, '#404040', false);
  }
  close() {
    this.game.markBlockEntity(this.be);
  }
}
class CreativeScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, 'tab_items', 195, 136, null);
    this.tab = 0;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.search = '';
    this.items = [];
    this.trash = null;
    const inv = game.player.inv;
    for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) this.slots.push({
      x: 9 + c * 18,
      y: 112,
      get: () => inv.slots[c],
      set: s => {
        inv.slots[c] = s;
      },
      group: 'hotbar'
    });
    for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
      const k = r * 9 + c;
      this.slots.push({
        x: 9 + c * 18,
        y: 18 + r * 18,
        creative: true,
        get: () => {
          const e = this.items[this.scroll * 9 + k];
          return e == null ? null : typeof e === 'object' ? {
            ...e,
            count: 1
          } : {
            id: e,
            count: 1
          };
        },
        set: () => {}
      });
    }
    this.trashSlot = {
      x: 173,
      y: 112,
      trash: true,
      get: () => null,
      set: () => {}
    };
    this.slots.push(this.trashSlot);
    this.itemSlots = this.slots;
    // vanilla's survival inventory tab: armour, offhand, the whole inventory, the player
    const A = ['slot_helmet', 'slot_chestplate', 'slot_leggings', 'slot_boots'];
    this.invSlots = [...[0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => ({
      x: 54 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 54,
      y: 6 + i % 2 * 27,
      armorSlot: i,
      emptyIcon: A[i],
      max: 1,
      group: 'armor',
      get: () => inv.slots[36 + i],
      set: s => {
        inv.slots[36 + i] = s;
      },
      accept: st => !!ITEMS[st.id] && ITEMS[st.id].armor && ITEMS[st.id].armor.slot === i
    })), {
      x: 35,
      y: 20,
      emptyIcon: 'slot_shield',
      group: 'offhand',
      get: () => inv.slots[40],
      set: s => {
        inv.slots[40] = s;
      }
    }, ...Array.from({
      length: 27
    }, (_, k) => ({
      x: 9 + k % 9 * 18,
      y: 54 + Math.floor(k / 9) * 18,
      group: 'main',
      get: () => inv.slots[9 + k],
      set: s => {
        inv.slots[9 + k] = s;
      }
    })), ...this.itemSlots.filter(s => s.group === 'hotbar'), this.trashSlot];
    this.setTab(0);
  }
  // vanilla's ten, search, the survival inventory; then any more (a mod's - 匠魂's seven) on pages of their own, ten
  // to a page in the same places as vanilla's, search and the inventory on every page (as Forge pages them; they took
  // the search tab's place before, and search and the inventory both sat at the bottom right)
  tabs() {
    return [...CREATIVE_TABS.slice(0, 10), {
      name: '搜索物品',
      icon: 'compass_search',
      search: true
    }, {
      name: '生存模式物品栏',
      inv: true
    }, ...CREATIVE_TABS.slice(10)];
  }
  setTab(t) {
    this.tab = t;
    this.scroll = 0;
    const tabs = this.tabs();
    this.slots = tabs[t].inv ? this.invSlots : this.itemSlots;
    if (tabs[t].inv) {
      this.bg = 'tab_inventory';
      this.items = [];
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      return;
    }
    if (tabs[t].search) {
      this.bg = 'tab_item_search';
      const q = this.search.trim().toLowerCase();
      // (vanilla searches the tooltip: an enchanted book is found by its enchantment's name, a potion by its effect -
      // so the tabs' books and potions are searched too, by what their tooltip says)
      const plain = ITEMS.filter(it => it && !(BLOCKS[it.id] && BLOCKS[it.id].noItem)).map(it => it.id);
      const extra = q ? CREATIVE_TABS.flatMap(t => t.items.filter(k => typeof k === 'object').map(k => {
        const {
          key,
          ...data
        } = k;
        return {
          id: item(key),
          count: 1,
          dmg: 0,
          ...data
        };
      })) : [];
      const text = st => {
        const it = ITEMS[st.id] || ITEMS[st];
        const lines = typeof netItemLines === 'function' && typeof st === 'object' ? netItemLines(st, [{
          text: it.cn,
          color: '#FFFFFF'
        }]) : [{
          text: it.cn
        }];
        return (lines.map(l => l.text).join(' ') + ' ' + it.key + ' ' + (st.e ? st.e.map(e => e[0]).join(' ') : '') + ' ' + (st.pot || '')).toLowerCase();
      };
      this.items = [...plain, ...extra].filter(st => !q || text(st).includes(q));
      const u = this.game.ui;
      if (this.x !== undefined) u.showInput(this.x + 82, this.y + 6, 89, 10, this.search, () => {}, {
        onInput: v => {
          this.search = v;
          this.setTab(this.tab);
        },
        onEsc: () => u.close(),
        max: 30
      });
    } else {
      this.bg = 'tab_items';
      this.items = tabs[t].items.map(k => {
        if (typeof k !== 'object') return item(k);
        const {
          key,
          ...data
        } = k;
        return {
          id: item(key),
          ...data
        };
      });
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
    }
  }
  layout() {
    super.layout();
    if (this.tabs()[this.tab].search) this.setTab(this.tab);
  }
  maxScroll() {
    return Math.max(0, Math.ceil(this.items.length / 9) - 5);
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll + Math.sign(dy), 0, this.maxScroll());
  }
  // ---- pages: 0 vanilla's ten, then ten more each; search (10) and the inventory (11) on all of them ----
  // (the tabs after them ten to a page; a tab with newPage starts a page of its own - 农夫乐事's kinds after 匠魂's
  // seven, the user 11-13)
  tabLayout() {
    const tabs = this.tabs();
    if (this._tl && this._tl.n === tabs.length) return this._tl;
    const page = [],
      slot = [];
    let p = 1,
      s = 0;
    for (let i = 12; i < tabs.length; i++) {
      if (tabs[i].newPage && s > 0 || s === 10) {
        p++;
        s = 0;
      }
      page[i] = p;
      slot[i] = s++;
    }
    return this._tl = {
      n: tabs.length,
      page,
      slot,
      pages: tabs.length > 12 ? p + 1 : 1
    };
  }
  pages() {
    return this.tabLayout().pages;
  }
  tabPage(i) {
    return i === 10 || i === 11 ? -1 : i < 10 ? 0 : this.tabLayout().page[i];
  }
  tabShown(i) {
    const p = this.tabPage(i);
    return p < 0 || p === (this.page || 0);
  }
  // (its place on its page: 0-4 on top, 5-9 below)
  tabSlot(i) {
    return i < 10 ? i : this.tabLayout().slot[i];
  }
  // vanilla's tab places: five on top, five below, the search tab at the top right, the inventory at the bottom right
  tabCol(i) {
    return i === 10 || i === 11 ? 6 : this.tabSlot(i) % 5;
  }
  tabTop(i) {
    return i === 10 || i !== 11 && this.tabSlot(i) < 5;
  }
  tabRect(i) {
    const c = this.tabCol(i);
    return {
      x: this.x + (c === 6 ? 167 : c * 27),
      y: this.tabTop(i) ? this.y - 28 : this.y + 132,
      w: 26,
      h: 30
    };
  }
  tabSprite(i, sel) {
    return 'tab_' + (this.tabTop(i) ? 'top' : 'bottom') + (sel ? '_selected_' : '_unselected_') + (this.tabCol(i) + 1);
  }
  // the page buttons: ◀ ▶ in the top corner, between the fifth tab and search (Forge's page buttons; the user 11-07)
  pageBtn(d) {
    return {
      x: this.x + (d < 0 ? 136 : 152),
      y: this.y - 24,
      w: 15,
      h: 18
    };
  }
  setPage(p) {
    const n = this.pages();
    p = clamp(p, 0, n - 1);
    if (p === (this.page || 0)) return;
    this.page = p;
    // (the page's first tab, unless search or the inventory is open - those stay)
    const tabs = this.tabs();
    if (!tabs[this.tab].search && !tabs[this.tab].inv) {
      const i = tabs.findIndex((_, k) => this.tabPage(k) === p);
      if (i >= 0) this.setTab(i);
    }
  }
  draw(ui) {
    ui.dim(0.6);
    const c = ui.ctx,
      tabs = this.tabs(),
      sel = this.tabShown(this.tab);
    for (let i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) if (i !== this.tab && this.tabShown(i)) {
      const r = this.tabRect(i);
      ui.sprite(this.tabSprite(i, false), r.x, r.y);
    }
    c.drawImage(ui.img[this.bg], 0, 0, 195, 136, this.x, this.y, 195, 136);
    if (sel) {
      const r = this.tabRect(this.tab);
      ui.sprite(this.tabSprite(this.tab, true), r.x, r.y);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
      if (!this.tabShown(i)) continue;
      const r = this.tabRect(i),
        t = tabs[i];
      // (iconStack: a tab's icon that needs its data - a tool in a material, a filled gauge)
      const st = !t.search && !t.inv && t.iconStack || {
        id: t.search ? item('book') : t.inv ? item('chest') : item(t.icon),
        count: 1
      };
      ui.drawItem(st, r.x + 5, r.y + (this.tabTop(i) ? 9 : 7));
    }
    if (this.pages() > 1) {
      const p = this.page || 0;
      for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
        const b = this.pageBtn(d),
          on = d < 0 ? p > 0 : p < this.pages() - 1,
          hov = on && ui.hit(b);
        ui.nine(on ? hov ? 'button_hl' : 'button' : 'button_dis', b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 3);
        Font.center(c, d < 0 ? '<' : '>', b.x + b.w / 2 + 1, b.y + 5, on ? '#FFFFFF' : '#A0A0A0');
      }
      // (which page: 1 / 2, above the buttons)
      Font.center(c, p + 1 + ' / ' + this.pages(), this.x + 151, this.y - 37, '#FFFFFF');
    }
    if (!tabs[this.tab].inv) Font.draw(c, tabs[this.tab].name, this.x + 8, this.y + 6, '#404040', false);
    // scroller
    const ms = this.maxScroll();
    const sy = this.y + 18 + (ms ? Math.round(this.scroll / ms * (112 - 15 - 18)) : 0);
    if (!tabs[this.tab].inv) ui.sprite(ms ? 'scroller' : 'scroller_disabled', this.x + 175, sy);else {
      // the player, as in the survival inventory
      const pv = this.game.renderer.playerPreview(this.game, ui, this.x + 73, this.y + 6, 32, 43);
      if (pv) {
        c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        c.drawImage(pv, this.x + 73, this.y + 6, 32, 43);
        c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      }
    }
    // trash slot
    ui.ctx.fillStyle = '#8b8b8b';
    ui.ctx.fillRect(this.x + 173, this.y + 112, 16, 16);
    Font.center(c, 'X', this.x + 181, this.y + 116, '#FF5555');
    this.drawSlots(ui);
    for (let i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) if (this.tabShown(i) && ui.hit(this.tabRect(i))) ui.tooltip([{
      text: tabs[i].name
    }], ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    if (this.pages() > 1) for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      const tp = (this.page || 0) + d;
      if (tp >= 0 && tp < this.pages() && ui.hit(this.pageBtn(d))) ui.tooltip([{
        text: d < 0 ? '上一页' : '下一页'
      }, {
        text: tp === 0 ? '原版物品' : '模组物品',
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      }], ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    }
  }
  drawSlots(ui) {
    const hov = this.slotAt(ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    for (const s of this.slots) {
      if (s.trash) continue;
      if (!s.get() && s.emptyIcon) {
        ui.ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
        ui.sprite(s.emptyIcon, this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y);
        ui.ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      ui.drawItem(s.get(), this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y);
      if (s === hov) {
        ui.ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
        ui.ctx.fillRect(this.x + s.x, this.y + s.y, 16, 16);
      }
    }
    if (hov && hov.get() && !ui.cursor) ui.tooltip(ui.tipLines(hov.get()), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const tabs = this.tabs();
    if (this.pages() > 1) for (const d of [-1, 1]) if (ui.hit(this.pageBtn(d), mx, my)) {
      const p = this.page || 0;
      this.setPage(p + d);
      if ((this.page || 0) !== p) Sound.click();
      return;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) if (this.tabShown(i) && ui.hit(this.tabRect(i), mx, my)) {
      this.setTab(i);
      Sound.click();
      return;
    }
    if (!tabs[this.tab].inv && mx >= this.x + 175 && mx < this.x + 187 && my >= this.y + 18 && my < this.y + 130) {
      this.scrolling = true;
      this.mouseMove(ui, mx, my);
      return;
    }
    const s = this.slotAt(mx, my);
    if (s && s.trash) {
      if (ui.cursor) ui.cursor = null;else if (shift) this.game.player.inv.slots.fill(null, 0, 36);
      return;
    }
    if (s && s.creative) {
      const st = s.get();
      if (ui.cursor) {
        ui.cursor = null;
        return;
      }
      if (!st) return;
      if (shift) {
        const inv = this.game.player.inv;
        const i = inv.slots.findIndex((x, j) => j < 9 && !x);
        inv.slots[i >= 0 ? i : inv.sel] = {
          ...st,
          count: maxStack(st.id),
          dmg: 0
        };
        return;
      }
      ui.cursor = {
        ...st,
        count: button === 2 ? 1 : maxStack(st.id),
        dmg: 0
      };
      return;
    }
    if (s && button === 1 && s.get()) {
      ui.cursor = {
        ...s.get(),
        count: maxStack(s.get().id)
      };
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    if (this.scrolling && ui.mouse.down) {
      const ms = this.maxScroll();
      this.scroll = clamp(Math.round((my - this.y - 25) / (112 - 15 - 18) * ms), 0, ms);
      return;
    }
    super.mouseMove(ui, mx, my);
  }
  mouseUp(ui, mx, my, b) {
    this.scrolling = false;
    super.mouseUp(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  quickMove(s) {
    if (this.tabs()[this.tab].inv) return super.quickMove(s);
    if (s.group === 'hotbar') s.set(null);
  }
  outside(mx, my) {
    return super.outside(mx, my) && my > this.y - 28 && my < this.y + 164;
  }
  key(ui, ev) {
    if (this.tabs()[this.tab].search && document.activeElement === ui.input) return true;
    return super.key(ui, ev);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Menu screens (buttons & sliders)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, title) {
    this.game = game;
    this.title = title;
    this.widgets = [];
    this.bgDim = 0.5;
    this.blurBg = true;
  }
  layout() {}
  draw(ui) {
    var _this$titleY;
    if (this.blurBg) ui.menuBackground();else if (this.bgDirt) this.drawDirt(ui);else if (this.bgDim) ui.dim(this.bgDim);
    if (this.title) Font.center(ui.ctx, this.title, ui.w / 2, (_this$titleY = this.titleY) !== null && _this$titleY !== void 0 ? _this$titleY : 30, '#FFFFFF');
    if (this.drawExtra) this.drawExtra(ui);
    for (const w of this.widgets) {
      if (w.slider) ui.slider(w);else if (w.text) Font.center(ui.ctx, typeof w.text === 'function' ? w.text() : w.text, w.x, w.y, w.color || '#FFFFFF');else ui.button(w);
    }
    for (const w of this.widgets) if (w.tip && ui.hit(w)) ui.tooltip(w.tip.map(t => ({
      text: t
    })), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  drawDirt(ui) {
    const r = this.game.renderer;
    if (!ui.dirtTile) {
      const t = ui.dirtTile = document.createElement('canvas');
      t.width = 32;
      t.height = 32;
      const x = t.getContext('2d');
      x.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      x.drawImage(r.stripCanvas, ...r.tileXY(T('dirt')), 16, 16, 0, 0, 32, 32);
      x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
      x.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32);
    }
    ui.tiled(ui.dirtTile, 'dirt', 0, 0, ui.w, ui.h); // (no pattern fill on the screen: UI.tiled)
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button) {
    if (button !== 0) return;
    for (const w of this.widgets) {
      if (w.slider && ui.hit(w, mx, my)) {
        this.dragging = w;
        this.mouseMove(ui, mx, my);
        Sound.click();
        return;
      }
      if (!w.slider && !w.text && w.enabled !== false && ui.hit(w, mx, my)) {
        Sound.init();
        Sound.click();
        w.onClick();
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx) {
    if (this.dragging && ui.mouse.down) {
      const w = this.dragging;
      w.value = clamp((mx - w.x - 4) / (w.w - 8), 0, 1);
      w.onChange(w.value);
    }
  }
  mouseUp() {
    this.dragging = null;
  }
  key(ui, ev) {
    if (ev.key === 'Escape' && this.onEsc) {
      this.onEsc();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
}

// Choose concrete ingredient ids for a recipe given available counts; returns per-grid-slot list or null
function planRecipe(r, avail, size) {
  const left = new Map(avail);
  const take = opts => {
    let best = -1,
      bestN = 0;
    for (const id of opts) {
      const n = left.get(id) || 0;
      if (n > bestN) {
        best = id;
        bestN = n;
      }
    }
    if (best < 0) return null;
    left.set(best, bestN - 1);
    return {
      id: best
    };
  };
  const out = new Array(size * size).fill(null);
  if (r.type === 'shaped') {
    for (let y = 0; y < r.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < r.w; x++) {
      const ch = r.pattern[y][x];
      if (ch === ' ' || ch === undefined) continue;
      const t = take(r.keys[ch]);
      if (!t) return null;
      out[y * size + x] = t;
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < r.ing.length; i++) {
      const t = take(r.ing[i]);
      if (!t) return null;
      out[i] = t;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

<script>
/* ==== js/save.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Persistence: IndexedDB, falling back to localStorage, then to memory
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const LS = {
  ok: (() => {
    try {
      const k = '__mcjs_test';
      localStorage.setItem(k, '1');
      localStorage.removeItem(k);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  })(),
  get(k) {
    try {
      const v = localStorage.getItem(k);
      return v ? JSON.parse(v) : null;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  },
  set(k, v) {
    localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v));
  },
  keys(prefix) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
      const k = localStorage.key(i);
      if (k.startsWith(prefix)) out.push(k);
    }
    return out;
  }
};
const DB = {
  NAME: 'mc-js-clone',
  // the stores and how each is made (a new one only needs adding here: the database is bumped by itself - see connect)
  STORES: {
    worlds: {
      keyPath: 'id'
    },
    chunks: undefined
  },
  db: null,
  mem: {
    worlds: new Map(),
    chunks: new Map()
  },
  ok: false,
  backend: 'memory',
  opens: 0,
  blocked: false,
  // the first open: IndexedDB missing or failing -> localStorage, else memory. A database that is slow to answer
  // (another page holding it while it has to be repaired) doesn't keep the game from starting: after 8 s the title
  // comes up and what reads or saves waits for the connection (wait)
  open() {
    return new Promise(res => {
      let done = false,
        t = 0;
      const fin = ok => {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        clearTimeout(t);
        if (ok) {
          this.ok = true;
          this.backend = 'idb';
        } else this.backend = LS.ok ? 'local' : 'memory';
        res(ok);
      };
      t = setTimeout(() => fin(true), 8000);
      // (a late failure: nothing was written to it meanwhile - every read and save was waiting for it)
      this.conn().then(() => fin(true), () => {
        if (!done) fin(false);else if (!this.db && !this.opens) this.backend = LS.ok ? 'local' : 'memory';
      });
    });
  },
  // the browser closes the connection by itself (a phone app sent to the background, storage cleaned up, another
  // tab upgrading): every save after that failed with "The database connection is closing" - 1739 devices on
  // 2026-11-01/02, "保存失败", worlds rolled back. The handle is dropped when that happens and opened again
  took(db) {
    this.db = db;
    db.onclose = () => {
      db.gone = true;
      if (this.db === db) this.db = null;
    };
    db.onversionchange = () => this.drop(db);
  },
  drop(db) {
    db.gone = true;
    try {
      db.close();
    } catch (e) {}
    if (this.db === db) this.db = null;
  },
  conn() {
    if (this.db) return Promise.resolve(this.db);
    if (!this.reopening) {
      const p = this.reopening = this.connect().then(db => {
        if (this.reopening === p) this.reopening = null;
        this.took(db);
        this.opens++;
        return db;
      }, e => {
        if (this.reopening === p) this.reopening = null;
        throw e;
      });
      p.catch(() => {});
    }
    return this.reopening;
  },
  // ...and that reopen came back with a database without its stores: "One of the specified object stores was not
  // found" on every save and on creating a world (386 devices from 2026-11-02 23:00, iOS Bilibili app / Safari,
  // 101 an hour by 11-03 18:00). The storage had been cleared while the connection was closed, and the reopen (no
  // upgrade handler) made a new, empty database; a reload didn't help either, the empty one was there to stay.
  // Now every open goes through here: the database as it is (whatever its version; a new one gets its stores in its
  // upgrade), and one missing a store is opened again one version up, whose upgrade adds only what is missing.
  // (A healthy database is left at its version: no versionchange for other pages - an older build still open in
  // another tab opens version 1 by number and would fail with a VersionError after a bump)
  async connect() {
    let ver;
    for (let n = 0;; n++) {
      let db,
        made = false;
      try {
        db = await this.req(ver, () => {
          made = true;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (e && e.name === 'VersionError' && n < 4) {
          ver = undefined;
          continue;
        }
        throw e;
      } // (another page bumped it first)
      if (made) this.note(ver ? 'save_db_repaired' : this.opens ? 'save_db_recreated' : 'save_db_new');
      const miss = Object.keys(this.STORES).filter(s => !db.objectStoreNames.contains(s));
      if (!miss.length) {
        if (!this.opens) try {
          localStorage.setItem('mcjs-db', '1');
        } catch (e) {}
        return db;
      }
      ver = db.version + 1;
      try {
        db.close();
      } catch (e) {}
      if (n >= 4) throw new Error('存档数据库缺少 ' + miss.join('、') + '，修复失败');
    }
  },
  // one open request (ver: that version; none: the version it has, or 1 for a new database). blocked: another
  // page's connection is in the way of the upgrade; the request goes on by itself once that page lets go
  req(ver, upgraded) {
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      let r;
      try {
        r = ver ? indexedDB.open(this.NAME, ver) : indexedDB.open(this.NAME);
      } catch (e) {
        rej(e);
        return;
      }
      r.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        const db = r.result;
        for (const [s, o] of Object.entries(this.STORES)) if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(s)) db.createObjectStore(s, o);
        upgraded();
      };
      // (closed at once when another page needs to upgrade: this one's own repair open must not be held up either)
      r.onsuccess = () => {
        this.blocked = false;
        const db = r.result;
        db.onversionchange = () => {
          db.gone = true;
          db.close();
        };
        res(db);
      };
      r.onerror = () => {
        this.blocked = false;
        rej(r.error || new Error('打不开存档数据库'));
      };
      r.onblocked = () => {
        this.blocked = true;
      };
    });
  },
  // what happened to the database (telemetry: how often it is new / gone mid-game / repaired; a device that had one
  // and starts with a new one lost its worlds between two visits)
  note(k) {
    if (k === 'save_db_new') {
      let had = null;
      try {
        had = localStorage.getItem('mcjs-db');
      } catch (e) {}
      if (had) k = 'save_db_gone';
    }
    if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count(k);
  },
  // the connection, or an error instead of waiting for ever (saving and quitting waits on it)
  wait() {
    if (this.db) return Promise.resolve(this.db);
    const p = this.conn();
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(this.blocked ? '存档数据库被另一个打开着的游戏页面占用：关掉其他游戏页面再试' : '存档数据库没有响应，稍后再试')), 15000);
      p.then(db => {
        clearTimeout(t);
        res(db);
      }, e => {
        clearTimeout(t);
        rej(e);
      });
    });
  },
  // errors a fresh connection gets past: closed or closing (InvalidStateError; WebKit "Connection to Indexed
  // Database server lost" and "Database deleted by request of the user" are UnknownErrors), a store missing
  // (NotFoundError - the reopen repairs it), a transaction aborted under it
  stale(e) {
    return !!e && (/^(InvalidStateError|NotFoundError|UnknownError|AbortError)$/.test(e.name) || /clos(ing|ed)|lost|deleted/i.test(e.message || ''));
  },
  // what the player reads after "保存失败: " (the browser's words are English; telemetry: QuotaExceededError on 6 devices)
  nice(e) {
    if (e && (e.name === 'QuotaExceededError' || e.code === 22 || /quota/i.test(e.message || ''))) {
      const q = new Error('存储空间不够了：删掉不玩的世界，或清理设备的存储空间 (QuotaExceededError)');
      q.name = 'QuotaExceededError';
      return q;
    }
    return e;
  },
  // (again on a fresh connection when this one turned out closed or broken; puts are the same the second time and a
  // failed transaction wrote nothing)
  async tx(store, mode, fn) {
    for (let i = 0;; i++) {
      let db = null;
      // (a failed open is not tried again here - connect already did - but its error reads like the others)
      try {
        db = await this.wait();
        return await this.tx1(db, store, mode, fn);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!db || i >= 2 || !(db.gone || this.stale(e))) throw this.nice(e || new Error('存档数据库出错'));
        this.drop(db);
      }
    }
  },
  tx1(db, store, mode, fn) {
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      // (writes: relaxed durability - done once the data is with the system, not after forcing it to disk: a save
      // costs phones less I/O and power; only a power cut right after it could lose that one save)
      const t = mode === 'readwrite' ? db.transaction(store, mode, {
          durability: 'relaxed'
        }) : db.transaction(store, mode),
        s = t.objectStore(store);
      let out, r;
      // (a throw half way - a record that can't be stored - must not leave the puts before it to commit)
      try {
        r = fn(s);
      } catch (e) {
        try {
          t.abort();
        } catch (e2) {}
        throw e;
      }
      if (r && 'onsuccess' in r) r.onsuccess = () => {
        out = r.result;
      };
      t.oncomplete = () => res(out);
      // (a failed request's error reaches the transaction before the transaction has an error of its own:
      // t.error is still null here, the save was rejected with null - no retry on a lost connection, and
      // saveWorld's "保存失败: " + e.message threw instead of showing anything)
      t.onerror = ev => rej(ev && ev.target && ev.target.error || t.error || new Error('存档数据库出错'));
      // an aborted transaction (the browser closed the database, out of space ...) fires neither of the two
      // above: without this its promise never settled and whatever waited on it (a chunk's saved data, the
      // save on leaving the world) waited for ever
      t.onabort = () => rej(t.error || new Error('数据库事务被中止'));
    });
  },
  async listWorlds() {
    let all;
    if (this.backend === 'idb') all = await this.tx('worlds', 'readonly', s => s.getAll());else if (this.backend === 'local') all = LS.keys('mcjs:w:').map(k => LS.get(k)).filter(Boolean);else all = [...this.mem.worlds.values()];
    return (all || []).sort((a, b) => b.lastPlayed - a.lastPlayed);
  },
  async getWorld(id) {
    if (this.backend === 'idb') return this.tx('worlds', 'readonly', s => s.get(id));
    if (this.backend === 'local') return LS.get('mcjs:w:' + id);
    return this.mem.worlds.get(id);
  },
  async putWorld(w) {
    // (a live object that got into the world's record - a mob, a canvas - made every save fail with a DataCloneError
    // after its chunks were written: blocks saved, the player's items and position not. It is written without them)
    if (this.backend === 'idb') {
      try {
        return await this.tx('worlds', 'readwrite', s => s.put(w));
      } catch (e) {
        if (!e || e.name !== 'DataCloneError') throw e;
        if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('save_clone_fixed');
        return this.tx('worlds', 'readwrite', s => s.put(this.plain(w)));
      }
    }
    if (this.backend === 'local') {
      try {
        LS.set('mcjs:w:' + w.id, w);
      } catch (e) {
        throw this.nice(e);
      }
      return;
    }
    this.mem.worlds.set(w.id, w);
  },
  // a copy of a record with only what can be stored: plain objects, arrays, maps, sets, typed arrays and plain values
  // (class instances, functions, DOM objects and loops are left out)
  plain(v, path = new Set()) {
    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return typeof v === 'function' || typeof v === 'symbol' ? undefined : v;
    if (ArrayBuffer.isView(v) || v instanceof ArrayBuffer || v instanceof Date || typeof Blob !== 'undefined' && v instanceof Blob) return v;
    if (path.has(v)) return undefined;
    path.add(v);
    let out;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) out = v.map(x => this.plain(x, path));else if (v instanceof Map) {
      out = new Map();
      for (const [k, x] of v) {
        const c = this.plain(x, path);
        if (c !== undefined) out.set(k, c);
      }
    } else if (v instanceof Set) {
      out = new Set();
      for (const x of v) {
        const c = this.plain(x, path);
        if (c !== undefined) out.add(c);
      }
    } else {
      const pr = Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
      if (pr === null || Object.getPrototypeOf(pr) === null) {
        out = {};
        for (const k of Object.keys(v)) {
          const c = this.plain(v[k], path);
          if (c !== undefined) out[k] = c;
        }
      }
    }
    path.delete(v);
    return out;
  },
  async deleteWorld(id) {
    if (this.backend === 'idb') {
      await this.tx('worlds', 'readwrite', s => s.delete(id));
      for (const sid of [id, id + '~nether', id + '~end']) await this.tx('chunks', 'readwrite', s => s.delete(IDBKeyRange.bound(sid + ':', sid + ':￿')));
    } else if (this.backend === 'local') {
      localStorage.removeItem('mcjs:w:' + id);
      for (const sid of [id, id + '~nether', id + '~end']) for (const k of LS.keys('mcjs:c:' + sid + ':')) localStorage.removeItem(k);
    } else {
      this.mem.worlds.delete(id);
      for (const k of [...this.mem.chunks.keys()]) if (k.startsWith(id + ':') || k.startsWith(id + '~')) this.mem.chunks.delete(k);
    }
  },
  async loadChunks(id) {
    const out = new Map();
    if (this.backend === 'idb') {
      // (through tx like every other read: a closed or broken database is opened again / repaired first. A failed
      // read is an error, not "no saved chunks": that made the world come back as fresh terrain, saved over the edits)
      await this.tx('chunks', 'readonly', s => {
        out.clear();
        const req = s.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.bound(id + ':', id + ':￿'));
        req.onsuccess = () => {
          const c = req.result;
          if (c) {
            const [, cx, cz] = c.key.split(':');
            out.set(ckey(+cx, +cz), c.value);
            c.continue();
          }
        };
      });
    } else if (this.backend === 'local') {
      for (const k of LS.keys('mcjs:c:' + id + ':')) {
        const [,,, cx, cz] = k.split(':');
        const v = LS.get(k);
        if (v) out.set(ckey(+cx, +cz), this.lsChunk(v));
      }
    } else {
      for (const [k, v] of this.mem.chunks) if (k.startsWith(id + ':')) {
        const [, cx, cz] = k.split(':');
        out.set(ckey(+cx, +cz), v);
      }
    }
    return out;
  },
  // the keys of a world's saved chunks; the records themselves are read one at a time when their chunk loads
  // (Game.savedReady): an imported world can hold tens of thousands of them
  async chunkKeys(id) {
    const out = new Set(),
      add = k => {
        const [, cx, cz] = k.split(':');
        out.add(ckey(+cx, +cz));
      };
    if (this.backend === 'idb') {
      for (const k of (await this.tx('chunks', 'readonly', s => s.getAllKeys(IDBKeyRange.bound(id + ':', id + ':\uffff')))) || []) add(k);
    } else if (this.backend === 'local') {
      for (const k of LS.keys('mcjs:c:' + id + ':')) add(k.slice(7));
    } else for (const k of this.mem.chunks.keys()) if (k.startsWith(id + ':')) add(k);
    return out;
  },
  async getChunk(id, cx, cz) {
    const k = id + ':' + cx + ':' + cz;
    if (this.backend === 'idb') return this.tx('chunks', 'readonly', s => s.get(k));
    if (this.backend === 'local') {
      const v = LS.get('mcjs:c:' + k);
      return v ? this.lsChunk(v) : undefined;
    }
    return this.mem.chunks.get(k);
  },
  // a chunk record in localStorage is JSON: its waterlogged cells (w) went missing there, so a world saved without
  // IndexedDB lost the water in its stairs, slabs, fences ... on every reload
  lsChunk(v) {
    const r = {
      b: new Uint16Array(v.b),
      m: new Uint16Array(v.m)
    };
    if (v.w && v.w.length) r.w = new Uint32Array(v.w);
    return r;
  },
  async putChunks(id, list) {
    if (!list.length) return;
    if (this.backend === 'idb') return this.tx('chunks', 'readwrite', s => {
      for (const [cx, cz, v] of list) s.put(v, id + ':' + cx + ':' + cz);
    });
    if (this.backend === 'local') {
      try {
        for (const [cx, cz, v] of list) LS.set('mcjs:c:' + id + ':' + cx + ':' + cz, v.w && v.w.length ? {
          b: Array.from(v.b),
          m: Array.from(v.m),
          w: Array.from(v.w)
        } : {
          b: Array.from(v.b),
          m: Array.from(v.m)
        });
      } catch (e) {
        throw this.nice(e);
      }
      return;
    }
    for (const [cx, cz, v] of list) this.mem.chunks.set(id + ':' + cx + ':' + cz, v);
  }
};
function encodeChunk(ch) {
  const r = {
    b: new Uint16Array(rleEncode(ch.flatBlocks())),
    m: new Uint16Array(rleEncode(ch.flatMeta()))
  };
  if (ch.wl && ch.wl.size) r.w = Uint32Array.from(ch.wl); // the waterlogged cells (block indices)
  return r;
}
// replaces the chunk's blocks and meta (its light is worked out again)
function decodeChunk(rec, ch) {
  const n = 256 * HEIGHT;
  ch.packFrom(rleDecode(rec.b, n), rleDecode(rec.m, n));
  ch.wl = rec.w && rec.w.length ? new Set(rec.w) : null;
  ch.lit = false;
}
</script>

class Game {
  constructor() {
