      });
      gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
    }
    // worn armour (vanilla humanoid armour layers; leather is dyed #A06540 with an undyed overlay)
    const armour = isPlayer ? e.inv.slots.slice(36, 40) : e.armorItems || [];
    // (other players too: a server's player, a guest in a room on this browser - armorItems [head, chest, legs, feet])
    if (pl0 || e.T.model === 'zombie' || e.T.model === 'skeleton' || e.T.model === 'zombified_piglin') this.drawArmor(armour, m, poses, lt, env, {
      overlay,
      baby: !!e.baby
    });
    if (pl0 && this.drawWings) this.drawWings(e, m, lt, env, overlay);
    if (e.type === 'sheep' && !e.sheared) {
      const col = WOOL_RGB[e.woolColor] || [1, 1, 1];
      r.drawModel('sheep_wool', 'sheep_wool', m, poses, lt, env, {
        overlay,
        tint: col
      });
    }
    if (e.type === 'spider') {
      gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE);
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
      r.drawModel('spider', 'spider_eyes', m, poses, [1, 1], env, {});
      gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
    }
    // shadow on the ground below
    if (e.deathTime === 0 && !e.displayMatrix) {
      const fx = Math.floor(ip[0]),
        fz = Math.floor(ip[2]);
      let gy = Math.floor(ip[1] + 0.01);
      for (let k = 0; k < 4 && gy > 0 && !SOLIDCUBE[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)] && !((_BLOCKS$this$world$ge = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)]) !== null && _BLOCKS$this$world$ge !== void 0 && _BLOCKS$this$world$ge.solid); k++) {
        var _BLOCKS$this$world$ge;
        gy--;
      }
      const h = ip[1] - gy;
      if (h < 3) r.drawShadow(ip[0], gy, ip[2], e.w * 0.75 * (1 - h / 6), 0.55 * (1 - h / 3));
    }
  }
  // worn armour (vanilla humanoid armour layers; leather is dyed #A06540 with an undyed overlay): [helmet, chestplate,
  // leggings, boots] on a humanoid model posed by poses (opts: overlay, vp)
  drawArmor(armour, m, poses, lt, env, opts = {}) {
    const r = this.renderer;
    if (!armour.some(s => s)) return;
    const parts = [['head'], ['body', 'rarm', 'larm'], ['body', 'rleg', 'lleg'], ['rleg', 'lleg']];
    armour.forEach((st, slot) => {
      if (!st) return;
      const a = ITEMS[st.id].armor,
        mat = a && a.mat;
      if (!mat || mat === 'elytra') return;
      const legs = slot === 2,
        model = legs ? 'armor_inner' : 'armor_outer',
        tex = r.beTex('armor_' + mat + (legs ? '_legs' : ''));
      if (!tex) return;
      const ap = {};
      for (const k of ['head', 'body', 'rarm', 'larm', 'rleg', 'lleg']) ap[k] = parts[slot].includes(k) ? poses && poses[k] || {} : {
        hidden: true
      };
      r.drawModel(model, tex, m, ap, lt, env, {
        ...opts,
        tint: mat === 'leather' ? typeof dyeTintOf === 'function' ? dyeTintOf(st, [160 / 255, 101 / 255, 64 / 255]) : [160 / 255, 101 / 255, 64 / 255] : null
      });
      // enchanted: the armour glint over that first layer only (render.js drawGlint; vanilla EquipmentLayerRenderer:
      // the leather overlay and the trim come after it and cover it)
      if (typeof stackGlint === 'function' && stackGlint(st)) r.drawModel(model, tex, m, ap, lt, env, {
        ...opts,
        glint: 'armor',
        glintOnly: true
      });
      if (mat === 'leather') r.drawModel(model, tex + '_overlay', m, ap, lt, env, opts);
      // its trim (from the smithing table) over it, on the same faces: equip.js trimTex
      const tt = st.trim && r.trimTex && !opts.baby ? r.trimTex(st.trim, mat, legs) : null; // (none on babies, like vanilla)
      if (tt) {
        const gl = r.gl;
        gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
        r.drawModel(model, tt, m, ap, lt, env, opts);
        gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
      }
    });
  }
  // the body's facing, like vanilla LivingEntity.tickHeadTurn: it turns towards where the player walks (walking
  // backwards: away from it), to the view while swinging, and otherwise stays put until the head is turned more
  // than 50 degrees from it; the head always follows the view
  tickPlayerBody(p) {
    const wrap = d => {
      while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
      return d;
    };
    if (p.bodyYaw === undefined || p.prevBodyYaw === undefined) p.bodyYaw = p.prevBodyYaw = p.yaw;
    if (p.pose === 'swim' || p.gliding || p.sleeping || this.sleeping) {
      p.bodyYaw = p.yaw;
      return;
    }
    const dx = p.pos[0] - p.prev[0],
      dz = p.pos[2] - p.prev[2];
    let target = p.bodyYaw;
    if (dx * dx + dz * dz > 0.0025) {
      target = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
      if (Math.abs(wrap(p.yaw - target)) > 95 * Math.PI / 180) target += Math.PI;
    }
    if (p.swingT > 0) target = p.yaw;
    p.bodyYaw += wrap(target - p.bodyYaw) * 0.3;
    const d = wrap(p.yaw - p.bodyYaw),
      max = 50 * Math.PI / 180;
    if (Math.abs(d) > max) p.bodyYaw += d - Math.sign(d) * max;
    p.bodyYaw = p.yaw + wrap(p.bodyYaw - p.yaw);
  }
  playerBodyYaw(a) {
    var _p$prevBodyYaw, _p$prevBodyYaw2;
    const p = this.player;
    if (p.bodyYaw === undefined) return p.yaw;
    let d = p.bodyYaw - ((_p$prevBodyYaw = p.prevBodyYaw) !== null && _p$prevBodyYaw !== void 0 ? _p$prevBodyYaw : p.bodyYaw);
    while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
    return ((_p$prevBodyYaw2 = p.prevBodyYaw) !== null && _p$prevBodyYaw2 !== void 0 ? _p$prevBodyYaw2 : p.bodyYaw) + d * a;
  }
  // vanilla HumanoidModel.setupAnim for the player, in this model's axes (y up, x mirrored): rx = -xRot, ry = -yRot
  playerPose(a) {
    const p = this.player;
    const swing = lerp(p.limbSwing - p.limbAmt, p.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
      amt = p.limbAmt;
    const l = Math.cos(swing) * 1.4 * amt,
      r = -l;
    let headY = p.yaw - this.playerBodyYaw(a);
    while (headY > Math.PI) headY -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (headY < -Math.PI) headY += Math.PI * 2;
    const P = {
      head: {
        rx: p.pitch,
        ry: headY
      },
      body: {},
      rarm: {
        rx: -Math.cos(swing) * amt
      },
      larm: {
        rx: Math.cos(swing) * amt
      },
      rleg: {
        rx: l
      },
      lleg: {
        rx: r
      }
    };
    // holding something: the arm half swings and stays a little raised
    if (p.inv.held) P.rarm.rx = P.rarm.rx * 0.5 + Math.PI / 10;
    // the attack swing (setupAttackAnimation): the body twists and carries the shoulders round, the arm rises fast,
    // sweeps in across the body and comes down slowly, higher when looking up
    // (a spear's stab: the twist and shoulders only, its arm is equip.js's)
    const dur = p.swingDur || 6,
      t = p.swingT > 0 ? clamp((dur - p.swingT + a) / dur, 0, 1) : 0;
    // (vanilla getAttackArm: the other hand's swing - placing from it - turns the body the other way and lifts that arm)
    const offSw = p.swingHand === 'off',
      A = offSw ? P.larm : P.rarm;
    if (t > 0) {
      const by = -Math.sin(Math.sqrt(t) * Math.PI * 2) * 0.2 * (offSw ? -1 : 1),
        c = Math.cos(by),
        s = Math.sin(by);
      P.body.ry = by;
      P.rarm.t = [6 * c - 6, 0, -6 * s];
      P.larm.t = [-6 * c + 6, 0, 6 * s];
    }
    if (t > 0 && !p.swingStab) {
      const by = P.body.ry;
      P.rarm.ry = by;
      P.larm.ry = by;
      P.larm.rx += by;
      let f = 1 - t;
      f *= f;
      f *= f;
      f = 1 - f;
      const f1 = Math.sin(f * Math.PI),
        f2 = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * (p.pitch + 0.7) * 0.75;
      A.rx += f1 * 1.2 + f2;
      A.ry += by * 2;
      A.rz = -0.4 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI);
    }
    // swimming / crawling
    if (p.pose === 'swim') return swimLimbs(P, lerp(p.limbSwing - p.limbAmt, p.limbSwing, a), p.swimming);
    // crouching (vanilla HumanoidModel offsets, converted to this model's y-up pixels; switched at once like vanilla)
    if (p.sneaking && !p.flying) {
      P.head.t = [0, -4.2 / 16, 0];
      P.body.t = [0, -1.73 / 16, 5.75 / 16];
      P.body.rx = -0.5;
      for (const k of ['rarm', 'larm']) {
        const o = P[k].t || [0, 0, 0];
        P[k].t = [o[0] / 16, o[1] / 16 - 3.2 / 16, o[2] / 16];
        P[k].rx -= 0.4;
      }
      for (const k of ['rleg', 'lleg']) P[k].t = [0, -0.2 / 16, 4 / 16];
    } else for (const k of ['rarm', 'larm']) if (P[k].t) P[k].t = P[k].t.map(v => v / 16);
    // the arms' idle sway (AnimationUtils.bobArms)
    const age = (p.age || this.tickCount || 0) + a;
    P.rarm.rz = (P.rarm.rz || 0) + Math.cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05;
    P.larm.rz = (P.larm.rz || 0) - (Math.cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05);
    P.rarm.rx -= Math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05;
    P.larm.rx += Math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05;
    return P;
  }
  blockMesh(id, meta) {
    if (!this._bm) this._bm = new Map();
    const k = id * 256 + meta;
    let m = this._bm.get(k);
    if (!m) {
      m = Mesher.single(id, meta);
      this._bm.set(k, m);
    }
    return m;
  }
  spriteMesh(layer) {
    return itemSpriteMesh(layer);
  }
  // the layers of a flat item model, each with its colour: potions by their effects, dyed leather by its dye, the rest
  // by the model's tint sources. Only the first layer used to be drawn, untinted (a potion was a grey blob of liquid
  // without its bottle)
  itemLayers(st, def, vim, b) {
    if (!(vim && vim.gen && vim.model.layers && vim.model.layers.length)) return [[b ? def.flat ? T(def.flat) : b.tex[0] : def.tex, null]];
    const info = VM.data.items[def.key];
    return vim.model.layers.map((l, k) => [T(l), stackTint(this.renderer, info, k, st)]);
  }
  // draws them over each other: each later layer a little thicker, so it covers the one before instead of flickering
  // (glint: the enchantment glint over them, render.js drawGlint)
  drawLayers(layers, m, env, light, glint) {
    layers.forEach(([layer, c], k) => {
      let mm = m;
      if (k) {
        mm = new Float32Array(m);
        M4.scale(mm, 1, 1, 1 + 0.08 * k);
      }
      const o = c ? {
        color: [c[0] / 255, c[1] / 255, c[2] / 255, 1]
      } : {};
      if (glint) o.glint = 'item';
      this.renderer.drawMesh(this.spriteMesh(layer), mm, env, light, o);
    });
  }
  drawItemModel(id, m, l, env, ctx, st) {
    const def = ITEMS[id],
      r = this.renderer;
    if (!def) return; // (an item this game doesn't have - a room's, another version's: nothing to draw instead of an error a frame)
    if (def.key === 'shield' && this.drawShieldItem && (ctx === 'ground' || ctx === 'fixed')) {
      this.drawShieldItem(st || {
        id,
        count: 1
      }, m, l, env, ctx);
      return;
    }
    const b = def.block !== undefined ? BLOCKS[def.block] : null;
    const vim = r.itemModel(id);
    const flat = vim ? vim.gen || !b && !vim.mesh : !b || def.flat || b.shape === SH_CROSS || b.shape === SH_TORCH || b.ladder || b.door;
    const glint = typeof stackGlint === 'function' && stackGlint(st || {
      id
    }); // (enchanted: the glint, like vanilla's dropped items)
    if (flat) {
      const mm = new Float32Array(m);
      if (ctx === 'ground') {
        M4.scale(mm, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
        M4.translate(mm, -0.5, 0, 0);
      }
      this.drawLayers(this.itemLayers(st, def, vim, b), mm, env, l, glint);
    } else {
      const mm = new Float32Array(m);
      // (a bed: its own two halves, renderer.itemModel, centred at z 1 - one mesh cached for every bed made all the
      // beds on the ground the colour of the first one drawn)
      if (ctx === 'ground') {
        M4.scale(mm, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25);
        M4.translate(mm, -0.5, 0, b && b.bed ? -1 : -0.5);
      }
      if (vim && vim.mesh) {
        r.drawMesh(vim.mesh, mm, env, l, {
          glint: glint && 'item'
        });
        return;
      }
      if (this.isBEItem({
        id
      })) {
        this.drawBEItem(b, mm, l, env);
        return;
      } // (banners, chests, heads ...)
      let meta = b.facing ? 4 : 0;
      if (b.stairs) meta = 0;
      r.drawMesh(this.blockMesh(def.block, meta), mm, env, l, {
        glint: glint && 'item'
      });
    }
  }
  drawHand(a, env) {
    var _p$oHandH, _p$handH;
    const r = this.renderer,
      gl = r.gl,
      p = this.player;
    if (!r.fxOn) gl.clear(gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
    const proj = M4.create();
    M4.perspective(proj, 70 * Math.PI / 180, r.canvas.width / r.canvas.height, 0.05, 10);
    const savedVP = r.vp,
      savedCam = r.camPos;
    r.vp = proj;
    r.camPos = [0, 0, 0];
    // the item in hand (the previous one until the hand has lowered) and how far it is lowered
    const cur = p.inv.held,
      curId = cur ? cur.id : -1;
    const hid = p.handItem === undefined ? curId : p.handItem;
    const held = hid === curId ? cur : hid >= 0 ? {
      id: hid,
      count: 1,
      dmg: 0
    } : null;
    const eq = 1 - lerp((_p$oHandH = p.oHandH) !== null && _p$oHandH !== void 0 ? _p$oHandH : 1, (_p$handH = p.handH) !== null && _p$handH !== void 0 ? _p$handH : 1, a);
    const sw = p.swingT > 0 && p.swingHand !== 'off' ? clamp((6 - p.swingT + a) / 6, 0, 1) : 0; // (the other hand's swing: equip.js)
    const D = Math.PI / 180,
      PI = Math.PI;
    const m = M4.create();
    // view bobbing applied to hand as in vanilla (slight)
    if (this.settings.bobbing) {
      const bob = lerp(p.prevBob, p.bob, a) * PI * 0.6,
        amt = lerp(p.prevBobAmt || 0, p.bobAmt, a);
      M4.translate(m, Math.sin(bob) * amt * 0.5, -Math.abs(Math.cos(bob) * amt), 0);
    }
    const lt = p.lightAt();
    const env2 = {
      ...env,
      fogNear: 1e8,
      fogFar: 2e8
    };
    if (!held) {
      const f1 = Math.sqrt(sw);
      M4.translate(m, -0.3 * Math.sin(f1 * PI) + 0.64, 0.4 * Math.sin(f1 * PI * 2) - 0.6 - eq * 0.6, -0.4 * Math.sin(sw * PI) - 0.72);
      M4.rotY(m, 45 * D);
      M4.rotY(m, Math.sin(f1 * PI) * 70 * D);
      M4.rotZ(m, Math.sin(sw * sw * PI) * -20 * D);
      M4.translate(m, -1, 3.6, 3.5);
      M4.rotZ(m, 120 * D);
      M4.rotX(m, 200 * D);
      M4.rotY(m, -135 * D);
      M4.translate(m, 5.6, 0, 0);
      M4.translate(m, -6 / 16, 2 / 16, 0);
      M4.rotZ(m, PI);
      r.drawModel(typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.armOf(this, false) : 'arm', typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.texOf(this, p) : 'steve', m, null, lt, env2, {
        vp: proj
      });
    } else {
      const def = ITEMS[held.id];
      const b = def.block !== undefined ? BLOCKS[def.block] : null;
      const vim = r.itemModel(held.id);
      const flat = vim ? vim.gen || !b && !vim.mesh : !b || def.flat || b.shape === SH_CROSS || b.shape === SH_TORCH || b.ladder || b.door;
      // eating and drinking (potions, milk, honey, ominous bottles) share vanilla's applyEatTransform; the honey
      // bottle takes 40 ticks, the rest 32
      const mine = p.usingItem === held.id && p.useHand !== 'off'; // (not while the other hand is the one in use)
      const eating = mine && (def.food || /^(potion|milk_bucket|honey_bottle|ominous_bottle)$/.test(def.key));
      const bowing = mine && def.key === 'bow';
      if (eating) {
        const dur = def.key === 'honey_bottle' ? 40 : 32,
          left = dur - p.useT - a + 1,
          f1 = left / dur;
        if (f1 < 0.8) M4.translate(m, 0, Math.abs(Math.cos(left / 4 * PI) * 0.1), 0);
        const f3 = 1 - Math.pow(Math.max(0, f1), 27);
        M4.translate(m, f3 * 0.6, f3 * -0.5, 0);
        M4.rotY(m, f3 * 90 * D);
        M4.rotX(m, f3 * 10 * D);
        M4.rotZ(m, f3 * 30 * D);
        M4.translate(m, 0.56, -0.52 - eq * 0.6, -0.72);
      } else if (bowing) {
        M4.translate(m, 0.56, -0.52 - eq * 0.6, -0.72);
        M4.translate(m, -0.2785682, 0.18344387, 0.15731531);
        M4.rotX(m, -13.935 * D);
        M4.rotY(m, 35.3 * D);
        M4.rotZ(m, -9.785 * D);
        let f = (p.useT + a) / 20;
        f = (f * f + f * 2) / 3;
        if (f > 1) f = 1;
        if (f > 0.1) M4.translate(m, 0, Math.sin((p.useT - 0.1) * 1.3) * (f - 0.1) * 0.004, 0);
        M4.translate(m, 0, 0, f * 0.04);
        M4.scale(m, 1, 1, 1 + f * 0.2);
        M4.rotY(m, -45 * D);
      } else {
        const f1 = Math.sqrt(sw);
        M4.translate(m, -0.4 * Math.sin(f1 * PI), 0.2 * Math.sin(f1 * PI * 2), -0.2 * Math.sin(sw * PI));
        M4.translate(m, 0.56, -0.52 - eq * 0.6, -0.72);
        const f = Math.sin(sw * sw * PI);
        M4.rotY(m, (45 + f * -20) * D);
        M4.rotZ(m, f * -20 * D * Math.sin(f1 * PI));
        M4.rotX(m, Math.sin(f1 * PI) * -80 * D);
        M4.rotY(m, -45 * D);
      }
      // the item model's own first-person transform (vanilla ItemTransform.apply), like the other hand's (equip.js): one
      // transform for every flat item held the fishing rod backwards, and the beds were one cached mesh - the first bed
      // held, whatever colour the next one was - drawn small and turned by hand-made offsets
      const disp = vim && vim.model && vim.model.display;
      const d = disp && disp.firstperson_righthand || (flat ? {
        r: [0, -90, 25],
        t: [1.13, 3.2, 1.13],
        s: [0.68, 0.68, 0.68]
      } : disp ? {
        r: [0, 0, 0],
        t: [0, 0, 0],
        s: [1, 1, 1]
      } : {
        r: [0, 45, 0],
        t: [0, 0, 0],
        s: [0.4, 0.4, 0.4]
      });
      M4.translate(m, d.t[0] / 16, d.t[1] / 16, d.t[2] / 16);
      M4.rotX(m, d.r[0] * D);
      M4.rotY(m, d.r[1] * D);
      M4.rotZ(m, d.r[2] * D);
      M4.scale(m, d.s[0], d.s[1], d.s[2]);
      if (flat) {
        M4.translate(m, -0.5, -0.5, 0);
        let layers = this.itemLayers(held, def, vim, b);
        // (a mod's bow - 匠魂's longbow, borrowing the bow's key while drawn - keeps its own pulled frames: itemLayers)
        if (bowing && !def.tcTool) {
          const f = p.useT;
          layers = [[T(f >= 18 ? 'i_bow_pulling_2' : f >= 13 ? 'i_bow_pulling_1' : 'i_bow_pulling_0'), null]];
        }
        this.drawLayers(layers, m, env2, lt, typeof stackGlint === 'function' && stackGlint(held));
      } else {
        // (a bed: renderer.itemModel's head and foot, like vanilla's composite bed item)
        M4.translate(m, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5);
        const go = {
          glint: typeof stackGlint === 'function' && stackGlint(held) && 'item'
        };
        if (vim && vim.mesh) {
          r.drawMesh(vim.mesh, m, env2, lt, go);
          r.vp = savedVP;
          r.camPos = savedCam;
          return;
        }
        let meta = b.facing ? 4 : 0;
        if (b.stairs) meta = 0;
        r.drawMesh(this.blockMesh(def.block, meta), m, env2, lt, go);
      }
    }
    r.vp = savedVP;
    r.camPos = savedCam;
  }
  // vanilla weather: within 10 blocks, one camera-facing quad per column from the ground (or 10
  // below the eye) to 10 above it; rain.png spans the quad's width and repeats every 4 blocks,
  // each column scrolls at its own random speed; snow falls slowly and drifts sideways.
  // Columns fade with distance and take the lightmap colour of where they are.
  // What a column is - where it starts and ends, rain or snow, its light, its random speed - is worked out once a tick (or
  // when the eye moves into another block: weatherCols); each frame only writes the vertices, into one array kept for
  // it, sent with bufferSubData. All of it every frame cost 0.66 ms and 236 KB of garbage a frame on a desktop (437
  // columns while raining; a phone takes several times that, and a collection every few seconds); now 0.03 ms and ~40
  // bytes on a frame between ticks, 0.47 ms and ~10 KB on one that works the columns out - 0.16 ms a frame at 60 Hz.
  // The same vertices as before, to the bit
  weatherCols(px, pz, cy, ticks, R) {
    const w = this.world,
      N = (2 * R + 1) * (2 * R + 1);
    let C = this.wxCols;
    if (!C || C.N !== N) C = this.wxCols = {
      N,
      n: 0,
      tick: -1,
      px: 0,
      pz: 0,
      cy: 0,
      w: null,
      cx: new Float64Array(N),
      cz: new Float64Array(N),
      y0: new Int32Array(N),
      y1: new Int32Array(N),
      sx: new Float64Array(N),
      sz: new Float64Array(N),
      cold: new Uint8Array(N),
      li: new Uint16Array(N),
      k: new Float64Array(N),
      i3: new Uint8Array(N),
      u0: new Float64Array(N),
      // rain or snow, or neither, by column for as long as its surface stays (the biome's temperature at that height:
      // the noise behind it was most of a rebuild's time and garbage), 64 x 64 columns by world position
      gx: new Int32Array(4096),
      gz: new Int32Array(4096),
      gy: new Int32Array(4096).fill(-1e9),
      gf: new Uint8Array(4096)
    };
    if (C.tick === ticks && C.px === px && C.pz === pz && C.cy === cy && C.w === w) return C;
    if (C.w !== w) C.gy.fill(-1e9);
    C.tick = ticks;
    C.px = px;
    C.pz = pz;
    C.cy = cy;
    C.w = w;
    let n = 0;
    for (let dz = -R; dz <= R; dz++) for (let dx = -R; dx <= R; dx++) {
      const x = px + dx,
        z = pz + dz;
      if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) continue;
      // a column roofed higher than the scan below starts (a cave, a deep mine) gets no rain: the scan alone missed
      // the roof and it rained in deep caves (players' feedback 2026-10-31); vanilla goes by the heightmap
      const sy = w.surfaceY(x, z);
      if (sy + 1 > cy + R) continue;
      // height of the first motion-blocking block in this column
      let ground = cy + R;
      while (ground > cy - R - 1 && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, ground - 1, z)].solid && !IS_FLUID[w.getBlock(x, ground - 1, z)]) ground--;
      const y0 = Math.max(cy - R, ground),
        y1 = Math.max(cy + R, ground);
      if (y0 === y1) continue;
      const gi = (z & 63) << 6 | x & 63;
      if (C.gx[gi] !== x || C.gz[gi] !== z || C.gy[gi] !== sy) {
        C.gx[gi] = x;
        C.gz[gi] = z;
        C.gy[gi] = sy;
        C.gf[gi] = this.dryAt(x, z) ? 2 : this.isCold(x, z) ? 1 : 0;
      }
      if (C.gf[gi] === 2) continue;
      // column direction: the quad faces the player
      const f2 = Math.hypot(dz, dx) || 1;
      const ly = Math.max(cy, ground),
        L = w.getLight(x, ly, z),
        cold = C.gf[gi] === 1;
      // the column's own random numbers: the first two of RNG(seed) (util.js mulberry32), without making one each time
      const a1 = ((x * x * 3121 + x * 45238971 ^ z * z * 418711 + z * 13761) >>> 0 | 0) + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      let sl = L >> 4,
        bl = L & 15;
      if (cold) {
        sl = Math.min(15, Math.round(((L >> 4) * 3 + 15) / 4));
        bl = Math.min(15, Math.round(((L & 15) * 3 + 15) / 4));
        C.k[n] = mulberryAt(a1);
        C.u0[n] = mulberryAt(a1 + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0) + 0.01 * Math.sin(ticks * 0.05 + x);
      } else {
        C.k[n] = 3 + mulberryAt(a1);
        C.i3[n] = ticks + x * x * 3121 + x * 45238971 + z * z * 418711 + z * 13761 & 31;
      }
      C.cx[n] = x + 0.5;
      C.cz[n] = z + 0.5;
      C.y0[n] = y0;
      C.y1[n] = y1;
      C.sx[n] = -dx / f2 * 0.5;
      C.sz[n] = dz / f2 * 0.5;
      C.cold[n] = cold ? 1 : 0;
      C.li[n] = (sl * 16 + bl) * 4;
      n++;
    }
    C.n = n;
    return C;
  }
  drawWeather(env, a) {
    if (this.weather < 0.02) return;
    const r = this.renderer,
      gl = r.gl,
      p = this.player,
      w = this.world;
    // (the eye between ticks, as p.ipos(a) - without its new array)
    const ix = lerp(p.prev[0], p.pos[0], a),
      iz = lerp(p.prev[2], p.pos[2], a),
      camY = lerp(p.prev[1], p.pos[1], a) + p.eye();
    const px = Math.floor(ix),
      pz = Math.floor(iz),
      cy = Math.floor(camY);
    const R = 10,
      ticks = this.tickCount,
      C = this.weatherCols(px, pz, cy, ticks, R);
    const lm = r._lmData,
      wt = this.weather,
      fxOn = r.fxOn;
    if (!r.weatherData || r.weatherData.length < C.N * 36) r.weatherData = new Float32Array(C.N * 36);
    const V = r.weatherData;
    // rain first, then snow, each in the columns' order (the quads blend over each other)
    let o = 0,
      nRain = 0;
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) for (let i = 0; i < C.n; i++) {
      const cold = C.cold[i];
      if (cold !== pass) continue;
      const cx = C.cx[i],
        cz = C.cz[i],
        ex = cx - ix,
        ez = cz - iz;
      const alpha = ((1 - (ex * ex + ez * ez) / (R * R)) * 0.5 + 0.5) * wt;
      if (alpha <= 0) continue;
      let u0 = 0,
        vOff;
      if (!cold) vOff = -((C.i3[i] + a) / 32) * C.k[i];else {
        vOff = -(((ticks & 511) + a) / 512) + C.k[i];
        u0 = C.u0[i];
      }
      const li = C.li[i],
        lr = lm ? lm[li] / 255 : 1,
        lg = lm ? lm[li + 1] / 255 : 1,
        lb = lm ? lm[li + 2] / 255 : 1;
      // (with the shader pack rain and snow are fainter, the haze carries the weather)
      const al = alpha * (fxOn ? cold ? 0.6 : 0.4 : 1);
      const y0 = C.y0[i],
        y1 = C.y1[i],
        sx = C.sx[i],
        sz = C.sz[i],
        v0 = y0 * 0.25 + vOff,
        v1 = y1 * 0.25 + vOff;
      o = weatherVert(V, o, cx - sx, y1, cz - sz, u0, v0, lr, lg, lb, al);
      o = weatherVert(V, o, cx + sx, y1, cz + sz, u0 + 1, v0, lr, lg, lb, al);
      o = weatherVert(V, o, cx + sx, y0, cz + sz, u0 + 1, v1, lr, lg, lb, al);
      o = weatherVert(V, o, cx - sx, y0, cz - sz, u0, v1, lr, lg, lb, al);
      if (!cold) nRain++;
    }
    const nSnow = o / 36 - nRain;
    if (!r.weatherProg) {
      r.weatherProg = compile(gl, `#version 300 es
layout(location=0) in vec3 a_pos; layout(location=1) in vec2 a_uv; layout(location=2) in vec4 a_col;
uniform mat4 u_vp; out vec2 v_uv; out vec4 v_col;
void main(){ v_uv = a_uv; v_col = a_col; gl_Position = u_vp * vec4(a_pos, 1.0); }`, `#version 300 es
precision highp float; uniform sampler2D u_tex; in vec2 v_uv; in vec4 v_col; out vec4 o;
void main(){ vec4 t = texture(u_tex, v_uv); if (t.a * v_col.a < 0.01) discard; o = t * v_col; }`);
      r.weatherVao = gl.createVertexArray();
      gl.bindVertexArray(r.weatherVao);
      r.weatherBuf = gl.createBuffer();
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, r.weatherBuf);
      gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, V.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
      r.weatherCap = V.length; // (its size once: then only written into)
      gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
      gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 36, 0);
      gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
      gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 36, 12);
      gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);
      gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 36, 20);
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, r.quadIdx);
    }
    const P = r.weatherProg;
    gl.useProgram(P.p);
    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(P.u.u_vp, false, r.vp);
    gl.uniform1i(P.u.u_tex, 0);
    gl.bindVertexArray(r.weatherVao);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    gl.depthMask(false);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    if (o) {
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, r.weatherBuf);
      if (r.weatherCap < V.length) {
        gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, V.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
        r.weatherCap = V.length;
      }
      gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, V, 0, o);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
      if (nRain) {
        gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, r.entityTex.rain);
        gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, nRain * 6, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
      }
      if (nSnow) {
        gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, r.entityTex.snowfall);
        gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, nSnow * 6, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, nRain * 24);
      }
    }
    gl.depthMask(true);
    gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    // vanilla rain sounds: from a random spot where rain lands nearby (quieter when it's above you)
    if (this.weather > 0.2 && this.tickCount !== this._rainSoundT && Math.random() < 0.33 * this.weather) {
      this._rainSoundT = this.tickCount;
      const x = px + (Math.random() * 21 | 0) - 10,
        z = pz + (Math.random() * 21 | 0) - 10;
      if (!this.isCold(x, z) && !this.dryAt(x, z)) {
        const gy = w.surfaceY(x, z) + 1;
        if (gy > camY + 1 && w.surfaceY(px, pz) + 1 > camY) Sound.ev('weather.rain.above', [x, gy, z], 0.1, 0.5);else Sound.ev('weather.rain', [x, gy, z], 0.2, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- pointer -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  capturePointer() {
    if (this.state !== 'play') return;
    // a screen closed with Esc: the lock is taken when the key comes up - taken while it was down, the browser read
    // that same Esc as leaving the lock and the pause screen opened again (Mac, players' feedback 2026-10-31)
    if (this.escHeld && performance.now() - this.escHeld < 1500) {
      this.escCapture = true;
      return;
    }
    const c = this.canvas,
      ua = navigator.userActivation;
    // (already locked, or a request still on its way: asking again sent a change event without the lock - main.js then
    // opened the pause menu under a mouse that got locked a moment later - or, Chrome's first raw-input request still
    // pending, "Pointer lock pending": a refusal, and the game went on with the mouse free)
    if (document.pointerLockElement === c || performance.now() - (this.lockAsked || 0) < 1000) return;
    if (!this.lockHooked) {
      this.lockHooked = true;
      document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
        this.lockAsked = 0;
        this.lockSoftAt = 0;
        if (document.pointerLockElement !== c) this.lockLostAt = performance.now();
      });
      // A refusal that says nothing about the browser - asked with no click or key behind it (a screen closed with Esc,
      // a world that took over ~5 s to load), or again within the moment the browser holds off after the player left
      // the lock with Esc - doesn't count toward playing with the mouse free (main.js counts every pointerlockerror,
      // this listener comes after its own): the pause menu or "click to continue" asks for a click instead. Counted, it
      // left PC players with the cursor out and leaving the window, onto a second screen ("鼠标锁不住、指针露出来",
      // feedback 10-30 to 11-03, ~45). A browser that refuses a click still gets the free mouse.
      document.addEventListener('pointerlockerror', () => {
        // (Firefox, Safari: no promise to settle, the request is over with this event - the next click asks again)
        if (this.lockNoPromise) this.lockAsked = 0;
        if (this.lockSoftAt && performance.now() - this.lockSoftAt < 1500) {
          this.lockSoftAt = 0;
          this.lockFails = Math.max(0, (this.lockFails || 0) - 1);
        }
      });
    }
    const ask = raw => {
      const now = performance.now(),
        soft = ua && !ua.isActive || now - (this.lockLostAt || -1e9) < 2000;
      this.lockAsked = now;
      this.lockSoftAt = soft ? now : 0;
      this.lockRaw = false;
      let r;
      try {
        r = raw ? c.requestPointerLock({
          unadjustedMovement: true
        }) : c.requestPointerLock();
      } catch (e) {
        this.lockAsked = 0;
        if (raw) {
          this.rawLockOff = true;
          ask(false);
        }
        // (no pointer lock here at all - iOS web views, TV browsers: the call is missing or throws, and no pointerlockerror
        // comes): a refusal all the same. Not counted, the pause menu came back every 250 ms for good (ui.js)
        else if (!soft || typeof c.requestPointerLock !== 'function') this.lockFails = (this.lockFails || 0) + 1;
        return;
      }
      // (no answer at all - neither the lock nor a refusal - within 1.5 s: a refusal too)
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.lockAsked === now && document.pointerLockElement !== c) {
          this.lockAsked = 0;
          if (!soft) this.lockFails = (this.lockFails || 0) + 1;
        }
      }, 1500);
      this.lockNoPromise = !(r && r.then);
      if (r && r.then) r.then(() => {
        this.lockAsked = 0;
        this.lockRaw = raw;
      }, e => {
        this.lockAsked = 0;
        // raw input (unadjustedMovement) isn't on every system: asked again without it at once, still inside the click,
        // and not asked for again this session (each refusal was a pointerlockerror too)
        if (raw && e && e.name === 'NotSupportedError') {
          this.rawLockOff = true;
          ask(false);
          this.lockSoftAt = performance.now();
        }
      });
    };
    ask(this.settings.rawInput !== false && !this.rawLockOff);
  }
  releasePointer() {
    if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock();
  }
}

Player.prototype.loadedHere = function () {
  const w = this.world,
    x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
    z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
  return w.isLoaded(x, z) && w.getChunk(x >> 4, z >> 4).lit;
};

// one output of util.js RNG (mulberry32) for a state already stepped: RNG(seed)()'s first is mulberryAt((seed | 0) +
// 0x6D2B79F5 | 0), the next one 0x6D2B79F5 further (the weather's per-column numbers, with no generator made for them)
function mulberryAt(a) {
  let t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
  t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
  return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}
// one weather vertex (position, uv, colour) into V at o; the next offset
function weatherVert(V, o, x, y, z, u, v, cr, cg, cb, ca) {
  V[o] = x;
  V[o + 1] = y;
  V[o + 2] = z;
  V[o + 3] = u;
  V[o + 4] = v;
  V[o + 5] = cr;
  V[o + 6] = cg;
  V[o + 7] = cb;
  V[o + 8] = ca;
  return o + 9;
}
function rayBox(o, d, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) {
  let tmin = -Infinity,
    tmax = Infinity,
    face = -1;
  const mins = [x0, y0, z0],
    maxs = [x1, y1, z1];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (Math.abs(d[i]) < 1e-9) {
      if (o[i] < mins[i] || o[i] > maxs[i]) return null;
      continue;
    }
    let t1 = (mins[i] - o[i]) / d[i],
      t2 = (maxs[i] - o[i]) / d[i];
    let f1 = i * 2,
      f2 = i * 2 + 1; // face indices: 0 -x,1 +x,2 -y,3 +y,4 -z,5 +z
    if (t1 > t2) {
      const t = t1;
      t1 = t2;
      t2 = t;
      const f = f1;
      f1 = f2;
      f2 = f;
    }
    if (t1 > tmin) {
      tmin = t1;
      face = f1;
    }
    if (t2 < tmax) tmax = t2;
    if (tmin > tmax) return null;
  }
  if (tmax < 0) return null;
  return {
    t: Math.max(0, tmin),
    face
  };
}
// swimming / crawling limbs (the player, other players): breaststroke arms and fluttering legs, at vanilla's pace:
// one stroke every 26 units of limb swing (about 1.3 s at full speed), the legs kick with cos(limbSwing / 3)
function swimLimbs(P, t, swimming) {
  const ph = (t % 26 + 26) % 26 / 26 * Math.PI * 2;
  const reach = Math.PI * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.cos(ph)),
    spread = Math.max(0, Math.sin(ph)) * 1.1;
  P.rarm = {
    rx: reach,
    rz: spread
  };
  P.larm = {
    rx: reach,
    rz: -spread
  };
  P.rleg = {
    rx: Math.cos(t / 3) * 0.3
  };
  P.lleg = {
    rx: -Math.cos(t / 3) * 0.3
  };
  P.head.rx = swimming ? Math.PI / 4 : 1.2; // vanilla: the head tilts 45 degrees up while swimming
  return P;
}

function initVanillaBiomes(grassMap, foliageMap) {
  if (VBIOME.length) return;
  const D = self.WG_DATA;
  D.biome_order.forEach((name, i) => {
    const id = VB_BASE + i,
      b = D.biome[name],
      e = b.effects || {},
      at = b.attributes || {};
    // GrassColor / FoliageColor: colormap at (1 - temperature, 1 - downfall * temperature)
    const col = (map, override) => {
      if (override) return hexRGB(override);
      const t = clamp(b.temperature, 0, 1),
        d = clamp(b.downfall, 0, 1) * t;
      const k = (((1 - d) * 255 | 0) * 256 + ((1 - t) * 255 | 0)) * 4;
      return [map[k], map[k + 1], map[k + 2]];
    };
    let grass = col(grassMap, e.grass_color);
    if (e.grass_color_modifier === 'dark_forest') {
      const v = ((grass[0] << 16 | grass[1] << 8 | grass[2]) & 0xFEFEFE) + 0x28340A >> 1;
      grass = [v >> 16 & 255, v >> 8 & 255, v & 255];
    }
    const sky = at['minecraft:visual/sky_color'],
      fog = at['minecraft:visual/fog_color'];
    const music = at['minecraft:audio/background_music'];
    VBIOME[id] = {
      name,
      def: b,
      cn: D.biome_cn[name] || name,
      precip: !!b.has_precipitation,
      sky: sky ? hexRGB(sky) : null,
      fog: fog ? hexRGB(fog) : null,
      grass,
      foliage: col(foliageMap, e.foliage_color),
      swamp: e.grass_color_modifier === 'swamp',
      dry: hexRGB(e.dry_foliage_color || DRY_FOLIAGE[name] || '#5c3c32'),
      water: hexRGB(e.water_color || '#3f76e4'),
      music: music && music.default ? music.default.sound.replace('minecraft:', '') : null,
      amb: at['minecraft:audio/ambient_sounds'] || null // (loop / mood / additions: audio.js ambientSounds)
    };
    BIOMES[id] = VBIOME[id].cn;
    BIOME_TEMP[id] = b.temperature;
    BIOME_WATER[id] = VBIOME[id].water;
  });
}

// vanilla parses numeric seeds as longs and hashes anything else with String.hashCode
function parseSeed(str) {
  str = (str || '').trim();
  if (!str) {
    const r = () => BigInt(Math.floor(Math.random() * 4294967296));
    return BigInt.asIntN(64, r() << 32n | r()).toString();
  }
  if (/^[-+]?\d+$/.test(str)) {
    const v = BigInt(str);
    if (v >= -(2n ** 63n) && v < 2n ** 63n) return v.toString();
  }
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h, 31) + str.charCodeAt(i) | 0;
  return String(h);
}
const seed32 = s => typeof s === 'number' ? s | 0 : Number(BigInt.asIntN(32, BigInt(s)));

// vanilla block-state strings of the structure templates -> [id, meta] in this game (id -1: not placed)
const STATE_ALIAS = {
  cave_air: 'air',
  void_air: 'air',
  wall_torch: 'torch',
  suspicious_gravel: 'gravel',
  suspicious_sand: 'sand',
  lit_furnace: 'furnace',

  end_gateway: 'end_portal'

const FACE_META = {
  west: 0,
  east: 1,
  north: 4,
  south: 5
};
function mapVanillaState(str) {
  const k = str.indexOf('['),
    name = k < 0 ? str : str.slice(0, k),
    props = {};
  if (k >= 0) for (const kv of str.slice(k + 1, -1).split(',')) {
    const [a, v] = kv.split('=');
    props[a] = v;
  }
  let key = BID[name] !== undefined ? name : STATE_ALIAS[name];
  // a burning furnace is a block of its own here (vanilla: furnace[lit=true]); a server's lit furnace stayed unlit
  if (key === 'furnace' && props.lit === 'true' && BID.lit_furnace !== undefined) key = 'lit_furnace';
  if (key === 'air' || name === 'air') return [0, 0];
  const id = BID[key];
  if (id === undefined) return null;
  // water and lava: level 0 a source, 1-7 flowing, 8-15 falling (this game's metas 0, 1-7, 8); every flowing
  // fluid came in as a source before - imported worlds flooded, and a server's streams were drawn full
  if ((id === WATER || id === LAVA) && props.level !== undefined) {
    const l = +props.level || 0;
    return [id, l >= 8 ? 8 : l];
  }
  const b = BLOCKS[id];
  if (key === 'redstone_wire' && +props.power > 0 && typeof WIRE_ID !== 'undefined') {
    const r = Features.stateOf({
      Name: key,
      Properties: props
    }) || [id, 0];
    return [WIRE_ID[+props.power], r[1]];
  }
  if (b.states) return Features.stateOf({
    Name: key,
    Properties: props
  }) || [id, 0];
  if (b.facing && props.facing) {
    var _FACE_META$props$faci;
    let m = (_FACE_META$props$faci = FACE_META[props.facing]) !== null && _FACE_META$props$faci !== void 0 ? _FACE_META$props$faci : 0;
    if (b.chestLike) {
      if (props.type === 'left') m |= 16;else if (props.type === 'right') m |= 32;
    }
    return [id, m];
  }
  if (b.axis && props.axis) return [id, {
    y: 0,
    x: 1,
    z: 2
  }[props.axis]];
  if (k < 0) return [id, 0];
  // compact-meta blocks: the meta whose vanilla state matches best
  let best = 0,
    bestScore = -1e9;
  for (let m = 0; m < 64; m++) {
    const vs = vanillaState(b, m, null);
    if (vs.key !== name && !(name === 'wall_torch' && vs.key === 'wall_torch')) continue;
    let sc = 0;
    for (const a in props) if (vs.p[a] !== undefined) sc += String(vs.p[a]) === props[a] ? 1 : -10;
    if (sc > bestScore) {
      bestScore = sc;
      best = m;
    }
  }
  return [id, best];
}

// such stay air. Returns [id, meta, true] for a substitute; null when nothing fits.
const NEAR_WOODS = ['spruce', 'birch', 'jungle', 'acacia', 'cherry', 'dark_oak', 'pale_oak', 'mangrove', 'bamboo', 'crimson', 'warped'];
const NEAR_COLORS = ['white', 'orange', 'magenta', 'light_blue', 'yellow', 'lime', 'pink', 'gray', 'light_gray', 'cyan', 'purple', 'blue', 'brown', 'green', 'red', 'black'];
const NEAR_SHAPES = [['_wall_hanging_sign', 'oak_wall_sign'], ['_hanging_sign', 'oak_sign'], ['_wall_sign', 'oak_wall_sign'], ['_sign', 'oak_sign'], ['_fence_gate', 'oak_fence_gate'], ['_pressure_plate', 'stone_pressure_plate', 'oak_pressure_plate'], ['_trapdoor', 'oak_trapdoor'], ['_door', 'oak_door'], ['_stairs', 'stone_stairs', 'cobblestone_stairs', 'oak_stairs'], ['_slab', 'stone_slab', 'smooth_stone_slab', 'cobblestone_slab', 'oak_slab'], ['_wall', 'cobblestone_wall'], ['_fence', 'oak_fence'], ['_button', 'stone_button', 'oak_button'], ['_planks', 'oak_planks'], ['_log', 'oak_log'], ['_wood', 'oak_log'], ['_hyphae', 'oak_log'], ['_stem', 'oak_log'], ['_leaves', 'oak_leaves'], ['_sapling', 'oak_sapling'], ['_bricks', 'stone_bricks', 'bricks'], ['_tiles', 'stone_bricks'], ['_pillar', 'quartz_block', 'stone'], ['_ore', 'stone'], ['_rail', 'rail'], ['shulker_box', 'chest'], ['_carpet', 'white_carpet'], ['_candle', 'candle'], ['_wall_torch', 'wall_torch'], ['_torch', 'torch'], ['_lantern', 'lantern'], ['_bars', 'iron_bars'], ['_chain', 'chain', 'iron_chain'], ['_grate', 'glass'], ['_bulb', 'redstone_lamp'], ['_froglight', 'glowstone'], ['_coral_block', 'stone'], ['_concrete_powder', 'sand'], ['_block', 'stone']];
function nearNames(n) {
  const out = [],
    add = x => {
      if (x && x !== n && !out.includes(x)) out.push(x);
    };
  const b = n.replace(/^(waxed_|stripped_|infested_|potted_|dead_)+/, '').replace(/^(exposed_|weathered_|oxidized_)/, '');
  add(b);
  for (const wd of NEAR_WOODS) if (b.startsWith(wd + '_')) add('oak_' + b.slice(wd.length + 1));
  for (const c of NEAR_COLORS) if (b.startsWith(c + '_')) {
    const rest = b.slice(c.length + 1);
    for (const c2 of NEAR_COLORS) add(c2 + '_' + rest);
    add(rest);
  }
  add(b.replace(/_concrete_powder$/, '_concrete'));
  add(b.replace(/_glazed_terracotta$/, '_terracotta'));
  if (/glass_pane$/.test(b)) add('glass_pane');else if (/glass$/.test(b)) add('glass');
  if (b.includes('copper_')) {
    add(b.replace('copper_', 'iron_'));
    add(b.replace('copper_', ''));
  }
  if (b.startsWith('soul_')) add(b.slice(5));
  if (b.endsWith('candle_cake')) add('cake');
  for (const [suf, ...to] of NEAR_SHAPES) if (b.endsWith(suf)) {
    for (const t of to) add(t);
    break;
  }
  return out;
}
const nearCache = new Map();
function mapVanillaStateNear(str) {
  const exact = mapVanillaState(str);
  if (exact) return exact;
  let r = nearCache.get(str);
  if (r !== undefined) return r;
  r = null;
  const k = str.indexOf('['),
    name = k < 0 ? str : str.slice(0, k),
    props = k < 0 ? '' : str.slice(k);
  for (const cand of nearNames(name)) {
    let m = null;
    try {
      m = mapVanillaState(cand + props);
    } catch (e) {}
    if (m && m[0]) {
      r = [m[0], m[1], true];
      break;
    }
  }
  nearCache.set(str, r);
  return r;
}
function structStateMap() {
  if (structStateMap.cache) return structStateMap.cache;
  const S = self.STRUCT_DATA;
  if (!S || typeof Features === 'undefined') return null;
  const out = new Int32Array(S.states.length * 2),
    missing = new Set();
  // per state: 2 = the block can hold water, 1 = the template has it waterlogged (structStateMap.wl)
  const wl = structStateMap.wl = new Uint8Array(S.states.length);
  S.states.forEach((str, i) => {
    // the template's own markers are not placed
    let r = null;
    const name = str.split('[')[0];
    if (!['structure_void', 'structure_block', 'jigsaw'].includes(name)) try {
      r = mapVanillaState(str);
    } catch (e) {
      r = null;
    }
    if (!r) {
      out[i * 2] = -1;
      const n = str.split('[')[0];
      if (!['structure_void', 'structure_block', 'jigsaw'].includes(n)) missing.add(n);
    } else {
      out[i * 2] = r[0];
      out[i * 2 + 1] = r[1];
      if (r[0] > 0 && canWaterlog(r[0], r[1])) wl[i] = 2 | (str.includes('waterlogged=true') ? 1 : 0);
    }
  });
  if (missing.size) console.info('structure blocks the game does not have:', [...missing].join(' '));
  return structStateMap.cache = out;
}

// the generator inside the page, for when workers cannot be started (pages opened from file://):
// one message at a time between frames, and at most one chunk a frame (InlineGenWorker.frame is counted up
// by the game's frame loop) - a chunk takes 30 ms or more, and generating them back to back left 4 frames a
// second. While playing, a chunk is also followed by twice its time without one: on a phone a chunk takes 300 ms
// and more, and one every frame left the game at 2 - 3 frames a second for as long as chunks were missing
class InlineGenWorker {
  constructor() {
    this.core = self.makeGenCore();
    this.q = [];
    this.running = false;
    this.onmessage = null;
    this.inline = true;
    this.genFrame = -1;
    this.nextT = 0;
  }
  postMessage(m) {
    this.q.push(m);
    this.kick();
  }
  kick() {
    if (!this.running && !this.dead) {
      this.running = true;
      setTimeout(() => this.step(), 0);
    }
  }
  async step() {
    const gen = this.q.length && this.q[0].type === 'gen';
    if (gen) {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (this.genFrame === InlineGenWorker.frame || now < this.nextT) {
        this.running = false;
        setTimeout(() => this.kick(), Math.max(4, Math.min(50, this.nextT - now)));
        return;
      }
      this.genFrame = InlineGenWorker.frame;
    }
    const m = this.q.shift(),
      t0 = performance.now();
    if (m && !this.dead) await this.core(m, msg => {
      if (!this.dead && this.onmessage) this.onmessage({
        data: msg
      });
    });
    if (gen) {
      const t = performance.now(),
        loading = window.game && game.state === 'loading';
      this.nextT = loading ? 0 : t + Math.min(1000, 2 * (t - t0));
    }
    this.running = false;
    if (this.q.length) this.kick();
  }
  terminate() {
    this.dead = true;
    this.q = [];
  }
}
InlineGenWorker.frame = 0;
const newGenWorker = () => {
  if (!GenPool.inline) {
    try {
      return new Worker(window.__makeGenWorker());
    } catch (e) {
      GenPool.inline = true;
      console.info('worldgen: workers unavailable (' + e.name + '), generating in the page');
    }
  }
  return new InlineGenWorker();
};
class GenPool {
  constructor(seed) {
    this.seed = String(seed);
    if (location.protocol === 'file:') GenPool.inline = true;
    const n = GenPool.inline ? 1 : genWorkerCount();
    const palette = {
      air: 0
    };
    for (const k in BID) palette[k] = BID[k];
    this.workers = [];
    this.queue = [];
    this.wait = new Map();
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.dead = false;
    // gen jobs asked for and not yet answered, by dimension and chunk (asked): game.js chunkWatchdog forgets
    // game.genPending, and the same chunks were asked for again while the first jobs still waited - on a slow phone the
    // generator then spent its time on duplicates (a world at 350 ms a chunk never finished loading)
    this.keys = new Map();
    this.okN = 0;
    this.errRun = 0;
    this.errSeen = new Set(); // chunks made, errors in a row, error kinds reported
    this.init = {
      type: 'init',
      seed: this.seed,
      palette,
      smap: structStateMap(),
      swl: structStateMap.wl
    };
    // ready once a worker has built its generator (jobs sent before that wait in it)
    this.ready = new Promise(res => {
      this.readyRes = res;
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.spawn(0);
  }
  // a worker that fails (its scripts didn't load, it crashed) is replaced and its jobs go back in the queue;
  // before, its jobs never answered and chunk generation stalled
  spawn(tries) {
    const w = newGenWorker();
    w.busy = 0;
    w.jobs = new Map();
    // (any answer: it is alive; a job done: it works, and its restarts count from 0 again - they used to add up over a
    // session, and the 5th moved generation into the page for good, one chunk a frame on the main thread)
    w.onmessage = e => {
      const m = e.data;
      w.jobT = performance.now();
      w.heard = true;
      if (m && m.type !== 'error' && m.type !== 'ready') tries = 0;
      this.onMessage(w, m);
    };
    w.onerror = e => {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      if (!this.workers.includes(w)) return;
      console.warn('worldgen: worker failed (' + (e && e.message || 'error') + '), restarting');
      this.workers = this.workers.filter(x => x !== w);
      try {
        w.terminate();
      } catch (err) {}
      this.queue.unshift(...w.jobs.values());
      w.jobs.clear();
      if (this.dead) return;
      if (tries < 5) setTimeout(() => {
        if (!this.dead) this.spawn(tries + 1);
      }, 250 * (tries + 1));else if (!this.workers.length) {
        GenPool.inline = true;
        this.spawn(0);
      }
      this.pump();
    };
    w.postMessage(this.init);
    this.workers.push(w);
    this.pump();
  }
  onMessage(w, m) {
    if (!m || !this.workers.includes(w)) return; // (a replaced worker's late answer: its jobs went back in the queue)
    if (m.type === 'ready') {
      this.readyRes();
      return;
    }
    if (m.type === 'error') this.workerError(m);else if (m.type === 'chunk') {
      this.okN++;
      this.errRun = 0;
      if (m.warn) this.workerError({
        message: m.warn
      }, true);
    }
    if (m.id === undefined) {
      // (no job: building its generator failed - when every worker's did, the page tries)
      w.broken = true;
      if (!this.okN && !GenPool.inline && !this.dead && this.workers.every(x => x.broken)) this.goInline(String(m.message || '').split('\n')[0]);
      return;
    }
    if (!w.jobs.has(m.id)) return;
    w.jobs.delete(m.id);
    w.busy = Math.max(0, w.busy - 1);
    this.answer(m.id, m);
    this.pump();
  }
  // (a callback that throws is reported, and the queue still moves on)
  answer(id, m) {
    const j = this.wait.get(id);
    if (!j) return;
    this.wait.delete(id);
    if (j.key) {
      const n = this.keys.get(j.key) - 1;
      if (n > 0) this.keys.set(j.key, n);else this.keys.delete(j.key);
    }
    if (this.dead) return;
    try {
      j.cb(m);
    } catch (e) {
      if (window.game && game.reportError) game.reportError('worldgen ' + (m && m.type), e, true);
    }
  }
  // a worker's error: in the error log once per kind with the worker's own message and place (it was only in the
  // console - telemetry showed what it broke on the page, never why)
  workerError(m, warnOnly) {
    const text = String(m.message || 'error'),
      line = text.split('\n')[0].slice(0, 200);
    if (!this.errSeen.has(line) && this.errSeen.size < 8) {
      this.errSeen.add(line);
      console.error('worldgen:', text);
      const e = new Error(line);
      e.stack = text;
      if (window.game && game.reportError) game.reportError(warnOnly ? '地形生成线程（结构）' : '地形生成线程出错', e, true);
    }
    if (warnOnly) return;
    this.errRun++;
    // workers that answer every job with an error and never with a chunk (telemetry 11-02/03: all 28 Firefox devices,
    // every frame) are replaced by the same generator in the page
    if (!this.okN && this.errRun >= 6 && !GenPool.inline && !this.dead) this.goInline(line);
  }
  goInline(why) {
    console.warn('worldgen: the workers only fail (' + why + '), generating in the page');
    if (window.game && game.reportError) game.reportError('地形生成线程不能用，改在页面里生成', new Error(why), true);
    GenPool.inline = true;
    for (const w of this.workers) {
      try {
        w.terminate();
      } catch (e) {}
      this.queue.unshift(...w.jobs.values());
      w.jobs.clear();
    }
    this.workers = [];
    this.spawn(0);
  }
  request(msg, cb) {
    msg.id = this.nextId++;
    const key = msg.type === 'gen' ? (msg.dim || 'overworld') + ':' + ckey(msg.cx, msg.cz) : null;
    if (key) this.keys.set(key, (this.keys.get(key) || 0) + 1);
    this.wait.set(msg.id, {
      cb,
      key
    });
    this.queue.push(msg);
    this.pump();
  }
  asked(dim, k) {
    return this.keys.has((dim || 'overworld') + ':' + k);
  }
  pump() {
    for (const w of this.workers) {
      while (w.busy < 2 && this.queue.length) {
        const m = this.queue.shift();
        if (!w.busy) w.jobT = performance.now();
        w.busy++;
        w.jobs.set(m.id, m);
        w.postMessage(m);
      }
    }
  }
  // a worker that hasn't answered any job for 30 s (a chunk takes milliseconds) is stuck: it is replaced and
  // its jobs go back in the queue, like a crashed one. (One that has said nothing yet is still loading its scripts and
  // building the generator, which on a slow phone is a good part of that: it gets a minute. A /locate search or an
  // export's biomes can take longer than a chunk by far: 90 s - restarted at 30 s, the same search started over.)
  check() {
    if (GenPool.inline || this.dead) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - (this.checkT || 0) < 2000) return;
    this.checkT = now;
    for (const w of [...this.workers]) {
      if (!w.busy) {
        w.jobT = 0;
        w.suspect = 0;
        continue;
      }
      const j0 = w.jobs.values().next().value,
        lim = !w.heard ? 60000 : j0 && j0.type !== 'gen' ? 90000 : 30000;
      if (now - w.jobT < lim) {
        w.suspect = 0;
        continue;
      }
      // (still silent at the next check, 2 s on: not an answer held up by a long pause of this page)
      if (!w.suspect) {
        w.suspect = now;
        continue;
      }
      console.warn('worldgen: a worker stopped answering, restarting it');
      if (window.game && game.reportError) game.reportError('地形生成线程无响应（已重启）', new Error('worker timeout'), true);
      // the job it was on (its oldest) gets a strike, and one that has stopped two workers is answered as failed
      // instead of going to the next one: a job that never ends restarted the workers forever, and after the 5th
      // restart it ran in the page and froze the game
      const j = w.jobs.values().next().value;
      if (j && (j.strikes = (j.strikes || 0) + 1) >= 2) {
        w.jobs.delete(j.id);
        w.busy--;
        this.answer(j.id, {
          type: 'error',
          id: j.id,
          message: 'timeout: the job stopped two workers',
          timeout: true
        });
      }
      w.onerror({
        message: 'timeout'
      });
    }
  }
  inflight() {
    return this.wait.size;
  }
  terminate() {
    this.dead = true;
    for (const w of this.workers) w.terminate();
    this.workers = [];
  }
  // the same workers for another world's seed: a new init after the jobs they are on, whose answers are dropped (11-10:
  // a new pool each time - every worker loading its scripts again, 4 MB and with Tinkers' 8, and unpacking the
  // structures - was a good part of opening a world on a phone)
  reseed(seed) {
    this.seed = String(seed);
    this.init = Object.assign({}, this.init, {
      seed: this.seed
    });
    this.ready = new Promise(res => {
      this.readyRes = res;
    });
    this.queue = [];
    this.wait.clear();
    this.keys.clear();
    this.errRun = 0;
    for (const w of this.workers) {
      w.jobs.clear();
      w.busy = 0;
      w.jobT = 0;
      w.suspect = 0;
      w.broken = false;
      w.postMessage(this.init);
    }
    this.pump();
  }
}
Game.prototype.genSetup = function (seed) {
  if (this.genPool && this.genPool.seed === String(seed)) return this.genPool.ready;
  // (the workers there are, seeded again: GenPool.reseed - a new pool only when there are none that work)
  if (this.genPool && !this.genPool.dead && this.genPool.workers.length && !this.genPool.workers.every(x => x.broken)) {
    this.genPool.reseed(seed);
    initVanillaBiomes(this.renderer.grassMap, this.renderer.foliageMap);
    this.genPending = new Set();
    return this.genPool.ready;
  }
  if (this.genPool) this.genPool.terminate();
  if (!this.chunkWorker) this.chunkWorker = new ChunkWorker(this);
  initVanillaBiomes(this.renderer.grassMap, this.renderer.foliageMap);
  this.genPool = new GenPool(seed);
  this.genPending = new Set();
  return this.genPool.ready;
};
// ---- chunk worker (chunk_worker.js): decoration, finishing and meshing off the main thread -------------
// The world it works on is the one last reset into it; its protos are counted in w.protoKeys.
class ChunkWorker {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.ready = false;
    this.failed = false;
    this.epoch = 0;
    this.world = null;
    this.meshCb = new Map();
    this.nextId = 1;
    // keys the page told it to forget ('unloaded') and not answered yet: not asked for again meanwhile (see 'held');
    // keys of finished chunks waiting in game.finalQ: not asked for again either (they were, while the queue waited
    // for saved data or the frame budget)
    this.asking = new Map();
    this.askN = 0;
    this.inQ = new Set();
    // chunks a stuck worker hung on (key -> stage) in the generated world poisonId names (seed, dimension, structures:
    // the same chunk hangs again there, and only there - another world's chunk at that place is fine), restarts so far
    this.poison = new Map();
    this.poisonId = '';
    this.restarts = 0;
    if (location.protocol === 'file:' || typeof Worker === 'undefined') {
      this.failed = true;
      return;
    }
    if (!this.start()) this.failed = true;
  }
  start() {
    let w;
    try {
      w = this.w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([(window.__CHUNK_COMBINED||'')],{type:'text/javascript'})));
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
    this.startT = performance.now();
    this.ready = false;
    this.pingT = 0;
    this.suspect = 0;
    this.last = null;
    // (last: its last message when that said which chunk it started on - see stuck())
    w.onmessage = e => {
      if (w !== this.w) return;
      const m = e.data;
      this.lastMsg = performance.now();
      this.last = m && m.type === 'work' ? m : null;
      this.onMessage(m);
    };
    w.onerror = e => {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      if (w !== this.w || this.failed) return;
      const err = new Error(e && e.message || 'error');
      err.stack = e && e.filename ? e.filename + ':' + e.lineno : '';
      this.game.reportError('区块线程出错', err, true);
      this.restart(e && e.message);
    };
    return true;
  }
  fail(why) {
    if (this.failed) return;
    console.warn('chunk worker unavailable (' + why + '), staying on the main thread');
    this.failed = true;
    this.ready = false;
    try {
      this.w.terminate();
    } catch (e) {}
    // whatever it held is lost: its world regenerates on the main thread
    if (this.world) {
      this.world.protoKeys = null;
      this.world.useCW = false;
    }
    this.asking.clear();
    this.inQ.clear();
    for (const cb of this.meshCb.values()) cb(null);
    this.meshCb.clear();
  }
  // a worker that stopped answering or crashed is replaced (3 times, then the page goes on without one): the new one is
  // told what the page has, and the chunks the old one was building are asked for again. Before, the first 20 s of
  // silence moved decoration, lighting and meshing to the main thread for good - on a phone the game then crawled - and
  // the chunk it had hung on was then built on the main thread, which froze the page
  restart(why) {
    if (this.failed) return;
    if (this.restarts >= 3) {
      this.fail(why);
      return;
    }
    this.restarts++;
    console.warn('chunk worker: ' + why + ', starting a new one');
    try {
      this.w.terminate();
    } catch (e) {}
    for (const cb of this.meshCb.values()) cb(null);
    this.meshCb.clear();
    this.asking.clear();
    if (!this.start()) {
      this.fail(why + '; no new worker');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.world) return;
    // (messages sent before its scripts have loaded wait in its queue)
    if (this.world === this.game.world) this.reset(this.world, true);else this.world = null;
  }
  // every 5 s: a ping it must answer. One that answers nothing for 20 s is stuck (a loop in a chunk's generation), and
  // one that hasn't started after a minute (its 10 MB of scripts didn't load) won't: either is replaced
  check() {
    if (this.failed) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (!this.ready) {
      if (now - this.startT > 60000) {
        this.game.reportError('区块线程启动不了', new Error('chunk worker not ready after 60 s'), true);
        this.restart('not ready after 60 s');
      }
      return;
    }
    const waiting = this.pingT && !(this.lastMsg >= this.pingT);
    if (waiting) {
      // (still silent 3 s after it was first noticed: an answer held up by a long pause of this page is
      // handled in between)
      if (now - this.pingT > 20000) {
        if (!this.suspect) this.suspect = now;else if (now - this.suspect > 3000) this.stuck();
      }
      return;
    }
    this.suspect = 0;
    if (now - (this.pingT || 0) > 5000) {
      this.pingT = now;
      this.post({
        type: 'ping'
      });
    }
  }
  // the chunk it went quiet on (its last message said it started on it) is skipped from then on, in the new worker and
  // on the main thread alike
  stuck() {
    const last = this.last,
      k = last && last.type === 'work' && this.world ? last.k : undefined;
    if (k !== undefined) {
      const id = ChunkWorker.genId(this.world);
      if (id !== this.poisonId) {
        this.poison.clear();
        this.poisonId = id;
      }
      this.poison.set(k, last.s);
    }
    const at = k !== undefined ? ' at chunk ' + (Math.floor(k / 65536) - 32768) + ',' + (k % 65536 - 32768) + ' stage ' + last.s : '';
    this.game.reportError(this.restarts < 3 ? '区块线程无响应（已重启）' : '区块线程无响应（改在主线程生成）', new Error('chunk worker timeout' + at), true);
    this.restart('no answer for 20 s' + at);
  }
  post(m, tr) {
    // (the worker answers which of these it still holds: 'held')
    if (m.type === 'unloaded' && m.keys.length) {
      m.ask = ++this.askN;
      for (const k of m.keys) this.asking.set(k, m.ask);
    }
    this.w.postMessage(m, tr || []);
  }
  // a world (re)starts in the worker. keepQ (a replaced worker): finished chunks waiting in finalQ stay, and the
  // worker is told about them and every chunk the page has - it builds their neighbours against them
  reset(w, keepQ) {
    const g = this.game,
      q = keepQ && this.world === w ? (g.finalQ || []).filter(m => m.epoch === this.epoch) : [];
    this.epoch++;
    this.world = w;
    w.protoKeys = new Set();
    this.sent = null;
    this.asking.clear();
    this.inQ.clear();
    g.finalQ = q;
    this.post({
      type: 'reset',
      epoch: this.epoch,
      seed: w.seedStr,
      dim: w.dim,
      minY: w.minY || 0,
      structures: w.structures !== false
    });
    this.opts();
    const keys = [],
      bio = [];
    for (const ch of w.chunks.values()) {
      keys.push(ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz));
      bio.push(ch.biome);
    }
    for (const m of q) {
      m.epoch = this.epoch;
      const k = ckey(m.cx, m.cz);
      this.inQ.add(k);
      keys.push(k);
      bio.push(m.biome);
    }
    if (keys.length) {
      const b = new Uint8Array(keys.length * 256);
      bio.forEach((x, i) => {
        if (x) b.set(x, i * 256);
      });
      this.post({
        type: 'have',
        epoch: this.epoch,
        keys,
        biomes: b
      }, [b.buffer]);
    }
    const p = this.poisonFor(w);
    if (p) this.post({
      type: 'skip',
      keys: [...p.keys()],
      stages: [...p.values()]
    });
  }
  poisonFor(w) {
    return this.poison.size && w && this.poisonId === ChunkWorker.genId(w) ? this.poison : null;
  }
  static genId(w) {
    return w.seedStr + ':' + (w.dim || 'overworld') + ':' + (w.structures !== false);
  }
  // meshing options (图形品质)
  opts() {
    if (!this.failed) this.post({
      type: 'opts',
      fastLeaves: FAST_LEAVES
    });
  }
  center(cx, cz, R) {
    const s = cx + ',' + cz + ',' + R;
    if (s === this.sent) return;
    this.sent = s;
    this.post({
      type: 'center',
      epoch: this.epoch,
      cx,
      cz,
      R
    });
  }
  mesh(snap, cb) {
    const id = this.nextId++;
    this.meshCb.set(id, cb);
    snap.type = 'mesh';
    snap.id = id;
    this.post(snap, [snap.ids.buffer, snap.metas.buffer, snap.lights.buffer, snap.tints.buffer, snap.tints2.buffer, snap.biomes.buffer]);
  }
  onMessage(m) {
    const g = this.game,
      w = this.world;
    switch (m.type) {
      case 'ready':
        this.ready = true;
        break;
      case 'mesh':
        {
          this.lastMesh = performance.now();
          const cb = this.meshCb.get(m.id);
          this.meshCb.delete(m.id);
          if (cb) cb(m.error ? null : m);
          break;
        }
      case 'final':
        {
          if (m.epoch !== this.epoch || !w || !w.protoKeys) break;
          const k = ckey(m.cx, m.cz);
          w.protoKeys.delete(k);
          g.genProgressT = performance.now();
          // it was on its way while the page told the worker to forget it (game.js chunkWatchdog): the worker drops it from
          // its finished set when that message arrives, so it is told again that the page has it - without, the chunks
          // next to it waited for it there for good
          if (this.asking.has(k)) {
            const b = new Uint8Array(256);
            if (m.biome) b.set(m.biome);
            this.post({
              type: 'have',
              epoch: this.epoch,
              keys: [k],
              biomes: b
            }, [b.buffer]);
          }
          this.inQ.add(k);
          (g.finalQ || (g.finalQ = [])).push(m);
          break;
        }
      // of the chunks the page told it to forget, the ones it still holds: back on the page's list (the watchdog had them
      // generated all over again, every 8 s, and on a slow phone the area never filled in). What such a chunk waits for
      // may be a neighbour the page has and the worker forgot (pruned while the player was away for a moment): the page's
      // chunks around it are told again
      case 'held':
        {
          for (const [k, a] of this.asking) if (a === m.ask) this.asking.delete(k);
          if (m.epoch !== this.epoch || !w || !w.protoKeys) break;
          const nb = new Set();
          for (const k of m.keys) {
            if (w.chunks.has(k)) continue;
            w.protoKeys.add(k);
            const cx = Math.floor(k / 65536) - 32768,
              cz = k % 65536 - 32768;
            for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) {
              const n = ckey(cx + a, cz + b);
              if ((a || b) && w.chunks.has(n)) nb.add(n);
            }
          }
          if (nb.size) {
            const keys = [...nb],
              b = new Uint8Array(keys.length * 256);
            keys.forEach((n, i) => b.set(w.chunks.get(n).biome, i * 256));
            this.post({
              type: 'have',
              epoch: this.epoch,
              keys,
              biomes: b
            }, [b.buffer]);
          }
          break;
        }
      case 'work':
        break;
      // (the chunk it is building: this.last, for stuck())
      case 'dropped':
        if (m.epoch === this.epoch && w && w.protoKeys) for (const k of m.keys) w.protoKeys.delete(k);
        break;
      case 'stats':
        this.stats = m;
        break;
      case 'pong':
        break;
      case 'error':
        {
          const e = new Error(m.msg);
          e.stack = m.stack;
          g.reportError('区块线程 ' + m.where, e, true);
          break;
        }
    }
  }
  inflightMeshes() {
    return this.meshCb.size;
  }
}
// a chunk the worker finished: saved edits, structure loot and mobs, tints, light (like finaliseChunk)
Game.prototype.finishFromWorker = function (m) {
  const w = this.world,
    k = ckey(m.cx, m.cz),
    cw = this.chunkWorker;
  if (w.chunks.has(k) || !cw || cw.world !== w || m.epoch !== cw.epoch) return;
  // a chunk that can't be built is replaced by an empty one (it comes back generated next time the world
  // loads): a missing chunk keeps its neighbours from ever being drawn, and the world stops loading there
  if (m.broken) {
    this.reportError('chunk ' + m.cx + ',' + m.cz, new Error(m.broken), true);
    this.finishStub(w, m.cx, m.cz);
    return;
  }
  try {
    this.finishFromWorkerIn(m, w, k);
  } catch (e) {
    this.reportError('chunk ' + m.cx + ',' + m.cz, e, true);
    if (!w.chunks.has(k)) {
      try {
        this.finishChunk(new Chunk(m.cx, m.cz), false);
      } catch (e2) {
        w.chunks.set(k, new Chunk(m.cx, m.cz));
      }
    }
  }
};
Game.prototype.finishFromWorkerIn = function (m, w, k) {
  const ch = Chunk.fromWire(m.cx, m.cz, m.sec); // sections, already lit inside
  ch.biome.set(m.biome);
  ch.final = true;
  ch.sx = m.sx;
  ch.nb = m.nb;
  if (m.sx && m.sx.wl) ch.wl = new Set(m.sx.wl);
  const saved = w.savedChunks && w.savedChunks.get(k);
  if (saved) decodeChunk(saved, ch);
  if (ch.sx) this.structureExtras(ch, !!saved);
  this.chunkTints(ch);
  ch.nb = null;
  this.finishChunk(ch, !!saved);
};
// the stand-in for a chunk that can't be built (its generation hung a chunk worker, or failed): empty, or the player's
// saved chunk when there is one - its blocks don't come from the generator. (Empty, the next edit there saved the empty
// chunk over the player's build; before chunks that hung a worker were skipped, that saved chunk was built on the main
// thread.) Tints from a finished neighbour's biome
Game.prototype.finishStub = function (w, cx, cz) {
  const saved = w.savedChunks && w.savedChunks.get(ckey(cx, cz));
  if (saved) {
    try {
      const ch = new Chunk(cx, cz);
      decodeChunk(saved, ch);
      ch.final = true;
      for (const [a, b] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) {
        const n = w.chunks.get(ckey(cx + a, cz + b));
        if (n) {
          ch.biome.set(n.biome);
          break;
        }
      }
      this.chunkTints(ch);
      this.finishChunk(ch, true);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      this.reportError('chunk ' + cx + ',' + cz, e, true);
    }
  }
  if (!w.chunks.has(ckey(cx, cz))) this.finishChunk(new Chunk(cx, cz), false);
};

// (an answer without a spawn point - a worker's error - is asked for again a few times, then the world starts at 0, 0:
// it used to be NaN, and the player stood nowhere)
Game.prototype.genSpawn = function () {
  const pool = this.genPool;
  const ask = n => new Promise(res => pool.request({
    type: 'spawn'
  }, res)).then(m => m && m.type === 'spawn' && Number.isFinite(m.x) && Number.isFinite(m.z) ? [m.x, m.z] : n < 4 && !pool.dead ? new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)).then(() => ask(n + 1)) : [0, 0]);
  return pool.ready.then(() => ask(0));
};

// one streaming step for a gen-2 world: request, decorate, finalise, forget far proto chunks
Game.prototype.genStep = function (pcx, pcz, R, t0, budget) {
  const w = this.world,
    pool = this.genPool;
  if (!pool) return;
  pool.check();
  const cw = this.chunkWorker;
  if (cw) cw.check();
  const proto = w.proto || (w.proto = new Map()),
    pending = this.genPending;
  // decoration / finishing happen in the chunk worker, also when it is still loading its scripts as the world starts
  // streaming (what is sent to it waits in its queue): it used to have to be up already, and a world that started
  // before it - the title's, and on a phone often the first one opened - did all of it on the main thread for good
  if (w.useCW === undefined) w.useCW = !!(cw && !cw.failed && !proto.size);
  if (w.useCW && (!cw || cw.failed)) w.useCW = false;
  const useCW = w.useCW;
  if (useCW && cw.world !== w) cw.reset(w);
  if (!useCW && !w.spills) w.spills = new Map(); // (decoration records: Features.applySpill)
  const has = useCW ? (cx, cz) => {
    const k = ckey(cx, cz);
    return w.chunks.has(k) || w.protoKeys.has(k) || cw.asking.has(k) || cw.inQ.has(k);
  } : (cx, cz) => w.chunks.has(ckey(cx, cz)) || proto.has(ckey(cx, cz));
  // 1) request proto chunks: finalising out to R + 1.5 needs decorated neighbours (up to sqrt 2 further on the
  // diagonals), which need proto neighbours again: R + 1.5 + 2 * 1.42 -> R + 4.5
  // (not a chunk whose job is still waiting in the pool, whatever genPending says, nor one that just failed: genAnswer)
  const GR = R + 4,
    now = performance.now(),
    fails = w.genFails;
  if (pool.inflight() < pool.workers.length * 3) {
    const want = [];
    for (let dx = -GR; dx <= GR; dx++) for (let dz = -GR; dz <= GR; dz++) {
      const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
      if (d2 > (R + 4.5) * (R + 4.5)) continue;
      const cx = pcx + dx,
        cz = pcz + dz,
        k = ckey(cx, cz);
      if (pending.has(k) || has(cx, cz) || pool.asked(w.dim, k)) continue;
      if (fails) {
        const f = fails.get(k);
        if (f && now < f.until) continue;
      }
      want.push([cx, cz, d2]);
    }
    want.sort((a, b) => a[2] - b[2]);
    const epoch = this.genEpoch;
    for (const [cx, cz] of want.slice(0, pool.workers.length * 3 - pool.inflight())) {
      const k = ckey(cx, cz);
      pending.add(k);
      this.savedReady(w, k); // start reading its saved data, if any, while it generates
      pool.request({
        type: 'gen',
        cx,
        cz,
        dim: w.dim,
        height: HEIGHT,
        structures: w.structures !== false
      }, m => {
        pending.delete(k);
        if (this.genEpoch === epoch && this.world === w) this.genAnswer(w, cx, cz, m);
      });
    }
  }
  if (useCW) {
    cw.center(pcx, pcz, R);
    // finished chunks from the worker: light and add them, nearest first, within the frame's budget
    const q = this.finalQ;
    if (q && q.length) {
      q.sort((a, b) => (b.cx - pcx) ** 2 + (b.cz - pcz) ** 2 - ((a.cx - pcx) ** 2 + (a.cz - pcz) ** 2));
      const later = [];
      while (q.length && this.workFits(t0, budget * 0.8, 'finalise')) {
        const m = q.pop(),
          k = ckey(m.cx, m.cz);
        if (!this.savedReady(w, k)) {
          later.push(m);
          continue;
        } // its saved data is still being read
        cw.inQ.delete(k);
        this.timedWork('finalise', () => this.finishFromWorker(m));
      }
      for (const m of later) q.push(m);
    }
    return;
  }
  // 2) decorate / 3) finalise, nearest first, within the time budget
  const cand = [];
  for (const ch of proto.values()) {
    const dx = ch.cx - pcx,
      dz = ch.cz - pcz,
      d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    if (d2 > (R + 3) * (R + 3)) continue;
    cand.push([ch, d2]);
  }
  cand.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
  const around = (ch, ok) => {
    for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) {
      if (!a && !b) continue;
      const n = proto.get(ckey(ch.cx + a, ch.cz + b));
      if (!n || !ok(n)) {
        if (!n && w.chunks.has(ckey(ch.cx + a, ch.cz + b))) continue;
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  };
  // (a chunk the chunk worker hung on - ChunkWorker.poison - isn't built here either: it would freeze the page. Hung
  // decorating it goes on undecorated, hung finishing it becomes an empty chunk)
  const poison = cw ? cw.poisonFor(w) : null;
  for (const [ch, d2] of cand) {
    if (!this.workFits(t0, budget * 0.6, 'decorate')) break;
    // (a chunk whose decoration fails goes on without it; one that can't be finished becomes empty - either
    // way the nearest chunk isn't stuck failing every frame with everything behind it waiting)
    if (ch.stage === 1 && around(ch, () => true)) {
      if (!(poison && poison.get(ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz)) === 1)) this.timedWork('decorate', () => this.guard('decorate ' + ch.cx + ',' + ch.cz, () => this.decorateChunk(ch)));
      ch.stage = 2;
    }
  }
  for (const [ch, d2] of cand) {
    if (!this.workFits(t0, budget * 0.8, 'finalise')) break;
    if (ch.stage === 2 && d2 <= (R + 1.5) * (R + 1.5) && around(ch, n => n.stage === 2) && this.savedReady(w, ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz))) this.timedWork('finalise', () => {
      const k = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz);
      if (poison && poison.get(k) === 2) {
        proto.delete(k);
        if (!w.chunks.has(k)) this.finishStub(w, ch.cx, ch.cz);
        return;
      }
      try {
        this.finaliseChunk(ch);
      } catch (e) {
        this.reportError('chunk ' + ch.cx + ',' + ch.cz, e, true);
        const k = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz);
        proto.delete(k);
        if (!w.chunks.has(k)) this.finishChunk(new Chunk(ch.cx, ch.cz), false);
      }
    });
  }
  // 4) forget proto chunks that drifted far away
  if (this.tickCount % 40 === 0) for (const ch of [...proto.values()]) {
    const dx = ch.cx - pcx,
      dz = ch.cz - pcz;
    if (dx * dx + dz * dz > (R + 5.5) * (R + 5.5)) proto.delete(ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz)); // requested out to R + 4.5
  }
  if (this.tickCount % 40 === 0 && w.spills && typeof Features !== 'undefined') Features.pruneSpill(w, k => proto.has(k) || w.chunks.has(k));
};
// a gen job's answer: the chunk, or a failure (a worker's error, a job that hung two workers). A failed chunk is asked for
// again after a pause that doubles each time - it was asked for again at once, and a worker's error went on as a chunk:
// telemetry 11-02/03, all 28 Firefox devices, "m.blocks is undefined" here and "B is undefined" in Chunk.packFrom 26 000 -
// 158 000 times each, every frame, and the world never loaded. One that keeps failing while others generate becomes an
// empty chunk, like a chunk that can't be finished: a missing one keeps its neighbours from being drawn
Game.prototype.genAnswer = function (w, cx, cz, m) {
  const k = ckey(cx, cz);
  this.genProgressT = performance.now();
  if (m && m.type === 'chunk' && m.blocks && m.sb) {
    if (w.genFails) w.genFails.delete(k);
    this.genReceive(m);
    return;
  }
  const f = w.genFails || (w.genFails = new Map()),
    r = f.get(k) || {
      n: 0
    };
  r.n++;
  r.until = performance.now() + Math.min(10000, 250 * 2 ** r.n);
  f.set(k, r);
  if ((r.n >= 4 || m && m.timeout) && this.genPool && this.genPool.okN > 0) {
    f.delete(k);
    this.reportError('chunk ' + cx + ',' + cz, new Error('generation failed (' + String(m && m.message || 'no answer').split('\n')[0] + '): left empty'), true);
    // (an empty chunk: heightmap below the world, biome the_void)
    const bi = Math.max(0, vbiomeIndex('the_void') - VB_BASE);
    this.genReceive({
      type: 'chunk',
      cx,
      cz,
      blocks: new Uint16Array(256 * HEIGHT),
      qb: new Uint8Array(16 * (HEIGHT >> 2)).fill(bi),
      hm: new Int16Array(256).fill((w.minY || 0) - 1),
      sb: new Uint8Array(256).fill(bi)
    });
  }
};
Game.prototype.genReceive = function (m) {
  if (!m || m.type !== 'chunk' || !m.blocks || !m.sb) return; // (a chunk only: genAnswer)
  const w = this.world,
    k = ckey(m.cx, m.cz);
  if (w.useCW && this.chunkWorker && !this.chunkWorker.failed) {
    // (nor one finished and waiting in finalQ: sent again, the worker took it back as a proto and decorated it twice)
    if (w.chunks.has(k) || w.protoKeys.has(k) || this.chunkWorker.inQ.has(k)) return;
    if (m.sx) {
      const refs = w.structRefs || (w.structRefs = new Map());
      for (const [name, box, f] of m.sx.refs) refs.set(name + ':' + box[0] + ',' + box[2], {
        name,
        box,
        f
      });
    }
    const msg = {
      type: 'proto',
      epoch: this.chunkWorker.epoch,
      cx: m.cx,
      cz: m.cz,
      blocks: m.blocks,
      qb: m.qb,
      hm: m.hm,
      sb: m.sb,
      meta: m.meta,
      sx: m.sx
    };
    const tr = [m.blocks.buffer];
    if (m.meta) tr.push(m.meta.buffer);
    try {
      this.chunkWorker.post(msg, tr);
      w.protoKeys.add(k);
    } catch (e) {
      this.reportError('chunk ' + m.cx + ',' + m.cz, e, true);
    } // (not sent: asked for again)
    return;
  }
  if (w.chunks.has(k) || w.proto.has(k)) return;
  const ch = Chunk.from(m.cx, m.cz, m.blocks, m.sx ? m.meta : null);
  ch.qb = m.qb;
  ch.hm = m.hm;
  if (m.sx) {
    ch.sx = m.sx;
