      R.set(px, py, pz, s[0], s[1]);
      n++;
    }
    return n > 0;
  };
  FEATURE.huge_fungus = (ctx, cfg, r, x, y, z) => {
    const R = ctx.R,
      c = cfg.raw;
    const base = stateOf(c.valid_base_block)[0],
      stem = stateOf(c.stem_state),
      hat = stateOf(c.hat_state),
      decor = stateOf(c.decor_state);
    const repl = once(cfg, 'r', () => predicate(c.replaceable_blocks));
    if (R.id(x, y - 1, z) !== base) return false;
    let i = mthNext(r, 4, 13);
    if (r.nextInt(12) === 0) i *= 2;
    if (!c.planted && y + i + 1 >= R.maxY) return false;
    const thick = !c.planted && r.nextFloat() < 0.06;
    R.set(x, y, z, 0);
    const canRepl = (px, py, pz, stemPass) => {
      const id = R.id(px, py, pz);
      if (id === 0 || IS_FLUID[id] || REPLACEABLE[id]) return true;
      return stemPass ? repl(R, px, py, pz) : false;
    };
    const j = thick ? 1 : 0;
    for (let k = -j; k <= j; k++) for (let l = -j; l <= j; l++) {
      const corner = thick && Math.abs(k) === j && Math.abs(l) === j;
      for (let n = 0; n < i; n++) {
        if (!canRepl(x + k, y + n, z + l, true)) continue;
        if (corner) {
          if (!(r.nextFloat() < 0.1)) continue;
        }
        R.setState(x + k, y + n, z + l, stem);
      }
    }
    const wart = hat[0] === BID.nether_wart_block;
    const vines = (px, py, pz) => {
      if (!R.isAir(px, py - 1, pz)) return;
      let n = mthNext(r, 1, 5);
      if (r.nextInt(7) === 0) n *= 2;
      weepingColumn(R, r, px, py - 1, pz, n, 23, 25, -1, BID.weeping_vines, BID.weeping_vines_plant);
    };
    const hatBlock = (px, py, pz, f, g, h) => {
      if (r.nextFloat() < f) R.setState(px, py, pz, decor);else if (r.nextFloat() < g) {
        R.setState(px, py, pz, hat);
        if (r.nextFloat() < h) vines(px, py, pz);
      }
    };
    const jj = Math.min(r.nextInt(1 + (i / 3 | 0)) + 5, i),
      k0 = i - jj;
    for (let l = k0; l <= i; l++) {
      let n = l < i - r.nextInt(3) ? 2 : 1;
      if (jj > 8 && l < k0 + 4) n = 3;
      if (thick) n++;
      for (let o = -n; o <= n; o++) for (let p = -n; p <= n; p++) {
        const ex = o === -n || o === n,
          ez = p === -n || p === n,
          inner = !ex && !ez && l !== i,
          corner = ex && ez,
          low = l < k0 + 3;
        const px = x + o,
          py = y + l,
          pz = z + p;
        if (!canRepl(px, py, pz, false)) continue;
        if (low) {
          if (inner) continue;
          if (R.id(px, py - 1, pz) === hat[0]) R.setState(px, py, pz, hat);else if (r.nextFloat() < 0.15) {
            R.setState(px, py, pz, hat);
            if (wart && r.nextInt(11) === 0) vines(px, py, pz);
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (inner) {
          hatBlock(px, py, pz, 0.1, 0.2, wart ? 0.1 : 0);
          continue;
        }
        if (corner) {
          hatBlock(px, py, pz, 0.01, 0.7, wart ? 0.083 : 0);
          continue;
        }
        hatBlock(px, py, pz, 5.0E-4, 0.98, wart ? 0.07 : 0);
      }
    }
    return true;
  };
  const DELTA_NO = () => new Set(['bedrock', 'nether_bricks', 'nether_brick_fence', 'nether_brick_stairs', 'nether_wart', 'chest', 'spawner'].map(k => BID[k]));
  FEATURE.delta_feature = (ctx, cfg, r, x, y, z) => {
    const R = ctx.R,
      c = cfg.raw,
      contents = stateOf(c.contents),
      rim = stateOf(c.rim),
      size = intProvider(c.size),
      rimSize = intProvider(c.rim_size);
    const no = once(cfg, 'n', DELTA_NO);
    const clear = (px, py, pz) => {
      const id = R.id(px, py, pz);
      if (id === contents[0] || no.has(id)) return false;
      for (const d of DIR6B) {
        const air = R.isAir(px + d[0], py + d[1], pz + d[2]),
          up = d[1] === 1;
        if (air && !up || !air && up) return false;
      }
      return true;
    };
    const hasRim = r.nextDouble() < 0.9;
    const i = hasRim ? rimSize(r) : 0,
      j = hasRim ? rimSize(r) : 0,
      both = hasRim && i !== 0 && j !== 0;
    const k = size(r),
      l = size(r),
      m = Math.max(k, l);
    const pts = [];
    for (let dx = -k; dx <= k; dx++) for (let dz = -l; dz <= l; dz++) pts.push([dx, dz, Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz)]);
    pts.sort((a, b) => a[2] - b[2]);
    let any = false;
    for (const [dx, dz, d] of pts) {
      if (d > m) break;
      const px = x + dx,
        pz = z + dz;
      if (!clear(px, y, pz)) continue;
      if (both) {
        any = true;
        R.setState(px, y, pz, rim);
      }
      if (!clear(px + i, y, pz + j)) continue;
      any = true;
      R.setState(px + i, y, pz + j, contents);
    }
    return any;
  };
  FEATURE.basalt_pillar = (ctx, cfg, r, x, y, z) => {
    const R = ctx.R,
      B = BID.basalt;
    if (!R.isAir(x, y, z) || R.isAir(x, y + 1, z)) return false;
    let py = y,
      n = true,
      s = true,
      w = true,
      e = true;
    const hang = (px, ppy, pz) => {
      if (r.nextInt(10) !== 0) {
        R.set(px, ppy, pz, B);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    };
    while (R.isAir(x, py, z)) {
      if (py < R.minY || py >= R.maxY) return true;
      R.set(x, py, z, B);
      n = n && hang(x, py, z - 1);
      s = s && hang(x, py, z + 1);
      w = w && hang(x - 1, py, z);
      e = e && hang(x + 1, py, z);
      py--;
    }
    py++;
    for (const [dx, dz] of [[0, -1], [0, 1], [-1, 0], [1, 0]]) if (r.nextBoolean()) R.set(x + dx, py, z + dz, B);
    py--;
    for (let i = -3; i < 4; i++) for (let j = -3; j < 4; j++) {
      const k = Math.abs(i) * Math.abs(j);
      if (r.nextInt(10) >= 10 - k) continue;
      let qy = py,
        l = 3;
      while (R.isAir(x + i, qy - 1, z + j)) {
        qy--;
        if (--l > 0) continue;
        break;
      }
      if (R.isAir(x + i, qy - 1, z + j)) continue;
      R.set(x + i, qy, z + j, B);
    }
    return true;
  };
  const COLUMN_NO = () => new Set(['lava', 'bedrock', 'magma_block', 'soul_sand', 'nether_bricks', 'nether_brick_fence', 'nether_brick_stairs', 'nether_wart', 'chest', 'spawner'].map(k => k === 'lava' ? LAVA : BID[k]));
  FEATURE.basalt_columns = (ctx, cfg, r, x, y, z) => {
    const R = ctx.R,
      c = cfg.raw,
      sea = 32,
      B = BID.basalt,
      no = once(cfg, 'n', COLUMN_NO);
    const height = intProvider(c.height),
      reach = intProvider(c.reach);
    const airOrLava = (px, py, pz) => {
      const id = R.id(px, py, pz);
      return id === 0 || id === LAVA && py <= sea;
    };
    const canPlaceAt = (px, py, pz) => {
      if (!airOrLava(px, py, pz)) return false;
      const b = R.id(px, py - 1, pz);
      return b !== 0 && !no.has(b);
    };
    if (!canPlaceAt(x, y, z)) return false;
    const j = height(r),
      small = r.nextFloat() < 0.9,
      k = Math.min(j, small ? 5 : 8),
      l = small ? 50 : 15;
    let any = false;
    for (let t = 0; t < l; t++) {
      const px = x - k + r.nextInt(2 * k + 1),
        py = y + r.nextInt(1),
        pz = z - k + r.nextInt(2 * k + 1);
      const m = j - (Math.abs(px - x) + Math.abs(py - y) + Math.abs(pz - z));
      if (m < 0) continue;
      const rr = reach(r);
      for (let dx = -rr; dx <= rr; dx++) for (let dz = -rr; dz <= rr; dz++) {
        const qx = px + dx,
          qz = pz + dz,
          d = Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz);
        let qy = py,
          found = null;
        if (airOrLava(qx, qy, qz)) {
          let n = d;
          while (qy > R.minY + 1 && n > 0) {
            n--;
            if (canPlaceAt(qx, qy, qz)) {
              found = qy;
              break;
            }
            qy--;
          }
        } else {
          let n = d;
          while (qy <= R.maxY && n > 0) {
            n--;
            const id = R.id(qx, qy, qz);
            if (no.has(id)) break;
            if (id === 0) {
              found = qy;
              break;
            }
            qy++;
          }
        }
        if (found === null) continue;
        let h = m - (d >> 1),
          cy = found;
        while (h >= 0) {
          if (airOrLava(qx, cy, qz)) {
            R.set(qx, cy, qz, B);
            cy++;
            any = true;
          } else {
            if (R.id(qx, cy, qz) !== B) break;
            cy++;
          }
          h--;
        }
      }
    }
    return any;
  };

  // ---- decoration of one chunk ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  let ORDER = null,
    BIOME_FEATS = null;
  const ORDERS = {};
  function buildOrder(dim = 'overworld') {
    if (ORDERS[dim]) {
      ORDER = ORDERS[dim].order;
      BIOME_FEATS = ORDERS[dim].feats;
      return;
    }
    if (!LEAVES) initTags();
    // (WATERLOGGED is filled by initTags from the WLOG table)
    // possible biomes in parameter-list order, as MultiNoiseBiomeSource.possibleBiomes()
    const biomes = [];
    for (const [, b] of dim === 'nether' ? WG.netherParameters() : WG.overworldParameters()) if (!biomes.includes(b)) biomes.push(b);
    BIOME_FEATS = {};
    // FeatureSorter.buildFeaturesPerStep: a DFS topological order of (step, feature) nodes
    const ids = new Map();
    let nextId = 0,
      steps = 0;
    const nodes = new Map(),
      edges = new Map();
    const node = (f, step) => {
      let i = ids.get(f);
      if (i === undefined) {
        i = nextId++;
        ids.set(f, i);
      }
      const k = step * 100000 + i;
      if (!nodes.has(k)) nodes.set(k, {
        k,
        f,
        step,
        i
      });
      return nodes.get(k);
    };
    for (const b of biomes) {
      const L = D.biome[b] && D.biome[b].features || [],
        list = [];
      steps = Math.max(steps, L.length);
      BIOME_FEATS[b] = new Set();
      L.forEach((step, j) => {
        for (const f of [].concat(step)) {
          const n = strip(f);
          BIOME_FEATS[b].add(n);
          list.push(node(n, j));
        }
      });
      for (let j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
        if (!edges.has(list[j].k)) edges.set(list[j].k, new Set());
        if (j < list.length - 1) edges.get(list[j].k).add(list[j + 1].k);
      }
    }
    const sorted = [...edges.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const visited = new Set(),
      inProg = new Set(),
      out = [];
    const dfs = k => {
      if (visited.has(k)) return false;
      if (inProg.has(k)) return true;
      inProg.add(k);
      for (const t of [...(edges.get(k) || [])].sort((a, b) => a - b)) if (dfs(t)) return true;
      inProg.delete(k);
      visited.add(k);
      out.push(nodes.get(k));
      return false;
    };
    for (const k of sorted) {
      if (visited.has(k)) continue;
      dfs(k);
    }
    out.reverse();
    ORDER = [];
    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) ORDER.push(out.filter(n => n.step === s).map(n => n.f));
    ORDERS[dim] = {
      order: ORDER,
      feats: BIOME_FEATS
    };
  }
  function decorate(game, world, ch) {
    buildOrder(world.dim === 'nether' ? 'nether' : 'overworld');
    DIM.minY = world.minY || 0;
    DIM.height = world.dim === 'nether' ? 128 : HEIGHT;
    // (a chunk decorated before and generated again: what that decoration wrote, instead of running it once more)
    const rec = world.spills && world.spills.get(ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz));
    if (rec && rec.has(ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz))) {
      restoreSpill(world, ch, rec);
      return;
    }
    const R = new Region(world, ch.cx, ch.cz);
    if (world.spills) R.spill = new Map();
    const seedStr = world.seedStr || '0';
    if (!game._zoom || game._zoomSeed !== seedStr) {
      game._zoom = new WG.BiomeZoom(BigInt(seedStr));
      game._zoomSeed = seedStr;
    }
    const zoom = game._zoom;
    const order = self.WG_DATA.biome_order,
      zp = [0, 0, 0];
    const quartBiome = (qx, qy, qz) => {
      const c = R.chunk(qx << 2, qz << 2) || ch,
        QY = HEIGHT >> 2;
      qy = clamp(qy - (R.minY >> 2), 0, QY - 1);
      return order[c.qb[(qy * 4 + (qz & 3)) * 4 + (qx & 3)]];
    };
    const ctx = {
      R,
      top: null,
      seed: seedStr,
      biomeAt: (x, y, z) => {
        zoom.pick(x, y, z, zp);
        return quartBiome(zp[0], zp[1], zp[2]);
      },
      biomeHas: (p, top) => {
        const b = ctx.biomeAt(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
        return !!top && !!BIOME_FEATS[b] && BIOME_FEATS[b].has(top);
      }
    };
    // biomes of the 3x3 chunks (all sections), like vanilla
    const present = new Set();
    for (const c of R.ch) if (c && c.qb) for (const v of c.qb) present.add(order[v]);
    const rand = new WRand(),
      x0 = ch.cx * 16,
      z0 = ch.cz * 16;
    const decoSeed = rand.decorationSeed(BigInt(seedStr), x0, z0);
    for (let step = 0; step < ORDER.length; step++) {
      const list = ORDER[step];
      // structure pieces that are features (village decorations, ...) go in surface_structures
      if (step === 4 && ch.sx && game.structureFeatures) {
        rand.setSeed(decoSeed + BigInt(10000 * step) + 9999n);
        try {
          game.structureFeatures(ch, ctx, rand, placePF);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('structure feature', e);
        }
      }
      for (let idx = 0; idx < list.length; idx++) {
        const f = list[idx];
        let used = false;
        for (const b of present) if (BIOME_FEATS[b] && BIOME_FEATS[b].has(f)) {
          used = true;
          break;
        }
        if (!used) continue;
        rand.setSeed(decoSeed + BigInt(idx) + BigInt(10000 * step));
        try {
          placePF(ctx, f, rand, [x0, MIN_Y, z0], f);
        } catch (e) {
          if (!decorate.warned) {
            decorate.warned = true;
            console.warn('feature', f, e);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (R.spill) keepSpill(world, ch, R);
  }
  // What a chunk's decoration wrote, into itself and into its neighbours (world.spills: source key -> target key ->
  // {seq, after, d}), kept while the source or a neighbour of it is held. Vanilla never generates a chunk twice; here a
  // chunk that was unloaded (or a proto that was dropped) is generated again next to neighbours that are already
  // decorated and won't run their features again, so what they had put into it - the halves of trees and ore blobs on
  // its border - was lost; and decorated again against neighbours in another state its own trees came out elsewhere,
  // cut at the finished neighbours, their old halves left there as floating leaves that then decayed. Now it gets its
  // own decoration and its neighbours' back from these records. (`after`: written after the target's own decoration;
  // ch.got: the sources whose writes a chunk already has)
  function keepSpill(world, ch, R) {
    const sk = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz);
    let rec = world.spills.get(sk);
    if (!rec) world.spills.set(sk, rec = new Map());
    // (the chunks this decoration could write into get the new record; a finished one keeps the old record)
    for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
      const c = R.ch[j];
      if (c && !c.final) rec.delete(ckey(c.cx, c.cz));
    }
    if (!R.spill.has(ch)) R.spill.set(ch, new Set());
    for (const [c, set] of R.spill) {
      // runs of cells in a row (x) with the same block: [first cell | (length - 1) << 18, id | (meta | waterlogged 256) << 16]
      // (ore blobs are most of it: about a fifth of one entry per cell)
      const idx = Int32Array.from(set).sort(),
        d = new Int32Array(idx.length * 2),
        st = i => c.getM(i) | (c.wl && c.wl.has(i) ? 256 : 0);
      let n = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < idx.length;) {
        const i = idx[j],
          id = c.getB(i),
          m = st(i);
        let len = 1;
        while (len < 4096 && j + len < idx.length && idx[j + len] === i + len && c.getB(i + len) === id && st(i + len) === m) len++;
        d[n++] = i | len - 1 << 18;
        d[n++] = id | m << 16;
        j += len;
      }
      world.spillSeq = (world.spillSeq || 0) + 1;
      rec.set(ckey(c.cx, c.cz), {
        seq: world.spillSeq,
        after: c.stage === 2,
        d: d.slice(0, n)
      });
      if (c !== ch) (c.got || (c.got = new Set())).add(sk);
    }
  }
  function putSpill(ch, e) {
    const d = e.d;
    for (let n = 0; n < d.length; n += 2) {
      const i0 = d[n] & 0x3ffff,
        end = i0 + (d[n] >>> 18) + 1,
        id = d[n + 1] & 0xffff,
        m = d[n + 1] >>> 16;
      for (let i = i0; i < end; i++) {
        ch.setB(i, id);
        ch.setM(i, m & 255);
        if (m & 256) (ch.wl || (ch.wl = new Set())).add(i);else if (ch.wl) ch.wl.delete(i);
      }
    }
  }
  // a chunk decorated before: its own record, and its records for the neighbours that don't have them (made again since)
  function restoreSpill(world, ch, rec) {
    const k = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz);
    putSpill(ch, rec.get(k));
    for (const [tk, e] of rec) {
      const c = tk !== k && world.proto.get(tk);
      if (!c || c.final || c.got && c.got.has(k)) continue;
      putSpill(c, e);
      (c.got || (c.got = new Set())).add(k);
    }
  }
  // the records of decorated neighbours (decorated(key)) for a chunk generated again: after = false when it arrives,
  // true right after its own decoration
  function applySpill(world, ch, after, decorated) {
    if (!world.spills) return;
    const k = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz),
      list = [];
    for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) {
      if (!a && !b) continue;
      const nk = ckey(ch.cx + a, ch.cz + b),
        rec = world.spills.get(nk),
        e = rec && rec.get(k);
      if (e && e.after === after && !(ch.got && ch.got.has(nk)) && decorated(nk)) list.push([e, nk]);
    }
    list.sort((x, y) => x[0].seq - y[0].seq);
    for (const [e, nk] of list) {
      putSpill(ch, e);
      (ch.got || (ch.got = new Set())).add(nk);
    }
  }
  // records no longer needed: neither the source nor a neighbour of it is held (held(key))
  function pruneSpill(world, held) {
    if (!world.spills) return;
    for (const sk of world.spills.keys()) {
      const cx = Math.floor(sk / 65536) - 32768,
        cz = sk % 65536 - 32768;
      let keep = false;
      for (let a = -1; a <= 1 && !keep; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) if (held(ckey(cx + a, cz + b))) {
        keep = true;
        break;
      }
      if (!keep) world.spills.delete(sk);
    }
  }
  const api = {
    decorate,
    applySpill,
    pruneSpill,
    WRand,
    Region,
    stateOf,
    provider,
    predicate,
    intProvider,
    placePF,
    placeCF: (ctx, cf, r, p) => {
      if (!LEAVES) initTags();
      return placeCF(ctx, cf, r, p);
    },
    FEATURE,
    canSurvive,
    tagSet,
    withProp,
    msin,
    mcos,
    propOf,
    sturdy,
    faceUpdate
  };
  api.helpers = () => ({
    LEAVES,
    LOGS,
    DIRT,
    REPLACE_TREES,
    DIR6,
    once
  });
  return api;
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/trees.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vanilla TreeFeature: trunk placers, foliage placers, root placer, feature sizes and decorators,
// following the algorithms (and random call order) of the 1.18+ tree code.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
(() => {
  const F = Features,
    {
      stateOf,
      provider,
      predicate,
      intProvider,
      msin,
      mcos,
      withProp,
      tagSet
    } = F;
  const strip = s => typeof s === 'string' ? s.replace('minecraft:', '') : s;
  const HDIRS = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]]; // Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL: north east south west
  const AXIS_META = {
    y: 0,
    x: 1,
    z: 2
  };
  function compileTree(c) {
    const H = F.helpers();
    const T = {
      c,
      H,
      trunkP: provider(c.trunk_provider),
      foliageP: provider(c.foliage_provider),
      belowP: c.below_trunk_provider ? provider(c.below_trunk_provider) : c.dirt_provider ? provider(c.dirt_provider) : null,
      tp: c.trunk_placer,
      fp: c.foliage_placer,
      size: c.minimum_size,
      ignoreVines: !!c.ignore_vines,
      forceDirt: !!c.force_dirt,
      decorators: (c.decorators || []).map(d => ({
        t: strip(d.type),
        d
      })),
      root: c.root_placer || null
    };
    const tp = T.tp,
      tt = strip(tp.type);
    T.tpType = tt;
    T.canGrowThrough = tp.can_grow_through ? tagSet(tp.can_grow_through) : null;
    if (tt === 'cherry_trunk_placer') {
      T.branchCount = intProvider(tp.branch_count);
      T.branchLen = intProvider(tp.branch_horizontal_length);
      const s = tp.branch_start_offset_from_top;
      T.branchStart = intProvider({
        type: 'uniform',
        min_inclusive: s.min_inclusive,
        max_inclusive: s.max_inclusive
      });
      T.branchStart2 = intProvider({
        type: 'uniform',
        min_inclusive: s.min_inclusive,
        max_inclusive: s.max_inclusive - 1
      });
      T.branchEnd = intProvider(tp.branch_end_offset_from_top);
    }
    if (tt === 'bending_trunk_placer') T.bendLength = intProvider(tp.bend_length);
    if (tt === 'upwards_branching_trunk_placer') {
      T.exLen = intProvider(tp.extra_branch_length);
      T.exSteps = intProvider(tp.extra_branch_steps);
    }
    const fp = T.fp;
    T.fpType = strip(fp.type);
    T.radius = intProvider(fp.radius);
    T.offset = intProvider(fp.offset);
    if (fp.height !== undefined && typeof fp.height !== 'number') T.heightP = intProvider(fp.height);
    if (fp.trunk_height !== undefined) T.trunkHeightP = intProvider(fp.trunk_height);
    if (fp.crown_height !== undefined) T.crownP = intProvider(fp.crown_height);
    if (fp.foliage_height !== undefined) T.foliageHeightP = intProvider(fp.foliage_height);
    return T;
  }
  F.FEATURE.tree = (ctx, cfg, r, x, y, z) => {
    const T = cfg.tree || (cfg.tree = compileTree(cfg.raw));
    const R = ctx.R,
      H = T.H;
    const roots = new Map(),
      logs = new Map(),
      leaves = new Map(),
      deco = new Map();
    const key = (x, y, z) => x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
    const S = {
      R,
      r,
      T,
      setLog: (x, y, z, s) => {
        if (!s) return;
        R.set(x, y, z, s[0], s[1]);
        logs.set(key(x, y, z), [x, y, z]);
      },
      setLeaf: (x, y, z, s) => {
        if (!s) return;
        R.set(x, y, z, s[0], s[1]);
        leaves.set(key(x, y, z), [x, y, z]);
      },
      setRoot: (x, y, z, s) => {
        if (!s) return;
        R.set(x, y, z, s[0], s[1]);
        roots.set(key(x, y, z), [x, y, z]);
      },
      leafSet: (x, y, z) => leaves.has(key(x, y, z))
    };
    if (!doPlace(S, x, y, z)) return false;
    if (!logs.size && !leaves.size) return false;
    if (T.decorators.length) {
      const byY = m => [...m.values()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
      const D = {
        R,
        r,
        logs: byY(logs),
        leaves: byY(leaves),
        roots: byY(roots),
        set: (x, y, z, s) => {
          if (s) {
            R.set(x, y, z, s[0], s[1]);
            deco.set(key(x, y, z), 1);
          }
        },
        isAir: (x, y, z) => R.isAir(x, y, z)
      };
      for (const d of T.decorators) decorate(D, d, T);
    }
    return true;
  };

  // ---- TreeFeature.doPlace ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const isFreeTree = (S, x, y, z) => validTreePos(S, x, y, z) || S.T.H.LOGS.has(S.R.id(x, y, z));
  // TreeFeature.validTreePos: air or a block trees replace - what leaves and roots may take
  function baseTreePos(S, x, y, z) {
    const id = S.R.id(x, y, z);
    return id === 0 || S.T.H.REPLACE_TREES.has(id);
  }
  // TrunkPlacer.validTreePos: the upwards-branching placer (mangroves) also grows through its can_grow_through
  // blocks. Only logs use this one: leaves going by it overwrote the mangrove logs (mangrove_log is in that tag),
  // and the trunkless leaves then decayed by the thousand into dropped items
  function validTreePos(S, x, y, z) {
    if (baseTreePos(S, x, y, z)) return true;
    return !!S.T.canGrowThrough && S.T.canGrowThrough.has(S.R.id(x, y, z));
  }
  function placeLog(S, x, y, z, axis) {
    if (!validTreePos(S, x, y, z)) return false;
    let s = S.T.trunkP(S.r, x, y, z, S.R);
    if (s && axis && BLOCKS[s[0]] && BLOCKS[s[0]].axis) s = [s[0], AXIS_META[axis]];
    S.setLog(x, y, z, s);
    return true;
  }
  const placeLogIfFree = (S, x, y, z) => {
    if (isFreeTree(S, x, y, z)) placeLog(S, x, y, z);
  };
  function setDirtAt(S, x, y, z) {
    const R = S.R,
      T = S.T;
    if (!T.belowP) return;
    if (!T.forceDirt && T.H.DIRT.has(R.id(x, y, z)) && R.id(x, y, z) !== BID.grass_block && R.id(x, y, z) !== BID.mycelium) return;
    const s = T.belowP(S.r, x, y, z, R);
    if (s) R.set(x, y, z, s[0], s[1]);
  }
  function sizeAt(T, h, j) {
    var _s$limit2, _s$lower_size2, _s$upper_size2;
    const s = T.size,
      t = strip(s.type);
    if (t === 'three_layers_feature_size') {
      var _s$limit, _s$upper_limit, _s$lower_size, _s$upper_size, _s$middle_size;
      const limit = (_s$limit = s.limit) !== null && _s$limit !== void 0 ? _s$limit : 1,
        upperLimit = (_s$upper_limit = s.upper_limit) !== null && _s$upper_limit !== void 0 ? _s$upper_limit : 1;
      if (j < limit) return (_s$lower_size = s.lower_size) !== null && _s$lower_size !== void 0 ? _s$lower_size : 0;
      if (j >= h - upperLimit) return (_s$upper_size = s.upper_size) !== null && _s$upper_size !== void 0 ? _s$upper_size : 1;
      return (_s$middle_size = s.middle_size) !== null && _s$middle_size !== void 0 ? _s$middle_size : 1;
    }
    return j < ((_s$limit2 = s.limit) !== null && _s$limit2 !== void 0 ? _s$limit2 : 1) ? (_s$lower_size2 = s.lower_size) !== null && _s$lower_size2 !== void 0 ? _s$lower_size2 : 0 : (_s$upper_size2 = s.upper_size) !== null && _s$upper_size2 !== void 0 ? _s$upper_size2 : 1;
  }
  function doPlace(S, x, y, z) {
    const T = S.T,
      R = S.R,
      r = S.r,
      tp = T.tp;
    const h = tp.base_height + r.nextInt(tp.height_rand_a + 1) + r.nextInt(tp.height_rand_b + 1);
    const fh = foliageHeight(S, h);
    const k = h - fh;
    const rad = foliageRadius(S, k);
    let tx = x,
      ty = y,
      tz = z;
    if (T.root) {
      const o = rootTrunkOrigin(S, x, y, z);
      tx = o[0];
      ty = o[1];
      tz = o[2];
    }
    const lo = Math.min(y, ty),
      hi = Math.max(y, ty) + h + 1;
    if (lo < R.minY + 1 || hi > R.maxY) return false;
    const minClip = T.size.min_clipped_height;
    let free = h;
    outer: for (let j = 0; j <= h + 1; j++) {
      const s = sizeAt(T, h, j);
      for (let l = -s; l <= s; l++) for (let m = -s; m <= s; m++) {
        if (isFreeTree(S, tx + l, ty + j, tz + m) && (T.ignoreVines || R.id(tx + l, ty + j, tz + m) !== BID.vine)) continue;
        free = j - 2;
        break outer;
      }
    }
    if (free < h && (minClip === undefined || free < minClip)) return false;
    if (T.root && !placeRoots(S, x, y, z, tx, ty, tz)) return false;
    const att = placeTrunk(S, free, tx, ty, tz);
    const off = T.offset(r);
    for (const a of att) createFoliage(S, free, a, fh, rad, off);
    return true;
  }

  // ---- trunk placers (return foliage attachments {x,y,z,ro,dbl}) ------------------------------------------------
  const A = (x, y, z, ro = 0, dbl = false) => ({
    x,
    y,
    z,
    ro,
    dbl
  });
  function placeTrunk(S, h, x, y, z) {
    const T = S.T,
      r = S.r;
    switch (T.tpType) {
      case 'straight_trunk_placer':
        {
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
          for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) placeLog(S, x, y + j, z);
          return [A(x, y + h, z)];
        }
      case 'forking_trunk_placer':
        {
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
          const out = [],
            d = HDIRS[r.nextInt(4)];
          const j = h - r.nextInt(4) - 1;
          let k = 3 - r.nextInt(3),
            lx = x,
            lz = z,
            top = null;
          for (let n = 0; n < h; n++) {
            const o = y + n;
            if (n >= j && k > 0) {
              lx += d[0];
              lz += d[1];
              k--;
            }
            if (placeLog(S, lx, o, lz)) top = o + 1;
          }
          if (top !== null) out.push(A(lx, top, lz, 1));
          lx = x;
          lz = z;
          const d2 = HDIRS[r.nextInt(4)];
          if (d2 !== d) {
            const o = j - r.nextInt(2) - 1;
            let p = 1 + r.nextInt(3);
            top = null;
            for (let q = o; q < h && p > 0; q++, p--) {
              if (q < 1) continue;
              const ry = y + q;
              lx += d2[0];
              lz += d2[1];
              if (placeLog(S, lx, ry, lz)) top = ry + 1;
            }
            if (top !== null) out.push(A(lx, top, lz, 0));
          }
          return out;
        }
      case 'giant_trunk_placer':
      case 'mega_jungle_trunk_placer':
        {
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
          setDirtAt(S, x + 1, y - 1, z);
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z + 1);
          setDirtAt(S, x + 1, y - 1, z + 1);
          for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) {
            placeLogIfFree(S, x, y + j, z);
            if (j >= h - 1) continue;
            placeLogIfFree(S, x + 1, y + j, z);
            placeLogIfFree(S, x + 1, y + j, z + 1);
            placeLogIfFree(S, x, y + j, z + 1);
          }
          const out = [A(x, y + h, z, 0, true)];
          if (T.tpType === 'mega_jungle_trunk_placer') {
            for (let j = h - 2 - r.nextInt(4); j > (h / 2 | 0); j -= 2 + r.nextInt(4)) {
              const f = r.nextFloat() * (Math.PI * 2);
              let k = 0,
                l = 0;
              for (let m = 0; m < 5; m++) {
                k = Math.trunc(1.5 + mcos(f) * m);
                l = Math.trunc(1.5 + msin(f) * m);
                placeLog(S, x + k, y + j - 3 + (m >> 1), z + l);
              }
              out.push(A(x + k, y + j, z + l, -2));
            }
          }
          return out;
        }
      case 'dark_oak_trunk_placer':
        {
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
          setDirtAt(S, x + 1, y - 1, z);
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z + 1);
          setDirtAt(S, x + 1, y - 1, z + 1);
          const out = [],
            d = HDIRS[r.nextInt(4)];
          const j = h - r.nextInt(4);
          let k = 2 - r.nextInt(3),
            o = x,
            p = z;
          const q = y + h - 1;
          for (let rr = 0; rr < h; rr++) {
            if (rr >= j && k > 0) {
              o += d[0];
              p += d[1];
              k--;
            }
            const s = y + rr,
              id = S.R.id(o, s, p);
            if (!(id === 0 || T.H.LEAVES.has(id))) continue;
            placeLog(S, o, s, p);
            placeLog(S, o + 1, s, p);
            placeLog(S, o, s, p + 1);
            placeLog(S, o + 1, s, p + 1);
          }
          out.push(A(o, q, p, 0, true));
          for (let rr = -1; rr <= 2; rr++) for (let s = -1; s <= 2; s++) {
            if (rr >= 0 && rr <= 1 && s >= 0 && s <= 1 || r.nextInt(3) > 0) continue;
            const t = r.nextInt(3) + 2;
            for (let u = 0; u < t; u++) placeLog(S, x + rr, q - u - 1, z + s);
            out.push(A(x + rr, q, z + s));
          }
          return out;
        }
      case 'fancy_trunk_placer':
        return fancyTrunk(S, h, x, y, z);
      case 'bending_trunk_placer':
        {
          const d = HDIRS[r.nextInt(4)],
            j = h - 1,
            out = [];
          let px = x,
            py = y,
            pz = z;
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
          for (let k = 0; k <= j; k++) {
            if (k + 1 >= j + r.nextInt(2)) {
              px += d[0];
              pz += d[1];
            }
            if (validTreePos(S, px, py, pz)) placeLog(S, px, py, pz);
            if (k >= T.tp.min_height_for_leaves) out.push(A(px, py, pz));
            py++;
          }
          const k = T.bendLength(r);
          for (let l = 0; l <= k; l++) {
            if (validTreePos(S, px, py, pz)) placeLog(S, px, py, pz);
            out.push(A(px, py, pz));
            px += d[0];
            pz += d[1];
          }
          return out;
        }
      case 'upwards_branching_trunk_placer':
        {
          const out = [],
            tp = T.tp;
          for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) {
            const k = y + j;
            if (placeLog(S, x, k, z) && j < h - 1 && r.nextFloat() < tp.place_branch_per_log_probability) {
              const d = HDIRS[r.nextInt(4)],
                l = T.exLen(r),
                m = Math.max(0, l - T.exLen(r) - 1),
                n = T.exSteps(r);
              let nn = k + m,
                o = x,
                p = z,
                q = m,
                steps = n;
              while (q < h && steps > 0) {
                if (q >= 1) {
                  const rr = k + q;
                  nn = rr;
                  o += d[0];
                  p += d[1];
                  if (placeLog(S, o, rr, p)) nn++;
                  out.push(A(o, rr, p));
                }
                q++;
                steps--;
              }
              if (nn - k > 1) {
                out.push(A(o, nn, p));
                out.push(A(o, nn - 2, p));
              }
            }
            if (j === h - 1) out.push(A(x, k + 1, z));
          }
          return out;
        }
      case 'cherry_trunk_placer':
        {
          setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
          const j = Math.max(0, h - 1 + T.branchStart(r));
          let k = Math.max(0, h - 1 + T.branchStart2(r));
          if (k >= j) k++;
          const l = T.branchCount(r),
            three = l === 3,
            two = l >= 2;
          const m = three ? h : two ? Math.max(j, k) + 1 : j + 1;
          for (let n = 0; n < m; n++) placeLog(S, x, y + n, z);
          const out = [];
          if (three) out.push(A(x, y + m, z));
          const di = r.nextInt(4),
            d = HDIRS[di];
          out.push(cherryBranch(S, h, x, y, z, d, j, j < m - 1));
          if (two) out.push(cherryBranch(S, h, x, y, z, [-d[0], -d[1]], k, k < m - 1));
          return out;
        }
    }
    return [];
  }
  function cherryBranch(S, h, x, y, z, d, j, bl) {
    const T = S.T,
      r = S.r,
      axis = d[0] ? 'x' : 'z';
    let px = x,
      py = y + j,
      pz = z;
    const kk = h - 1 + T.branchEnd(r),
      bl2 = bl || kk < j,
      ll = T.branchLen(r) + (bl2 ? 1 : 0);
    const ex = x + d[0] * ll,
      ey = y + kk,
      ez = z + d[1] * ll;
    const mm = bl2 ? 2 : 1;
    for (let n = 0; n < mm; n++) {
      px += d[0];
      pz += d[1];
      placeLog(S, px, py, pz, axis);
    }
    const dy = ey > py ? 1 : -1;
    let o;
    while ((o = Math.abs(px - ex) + Math.abs(py - ey) + Math.abs(pz - ez)) !== 0) {
      const f = Math.fround(Math.abs(ey - py) / o),
        vert = S.r.nextFloat() < f;
      if (vert) py += dy;else {
        px += d[0];
        pz += d[1];
      }
      placeLog(S, px, py, pz, vert ? null : axis);
    }
    return A(ex, ey + 1, ez);
  }
  function fancyTrunk(S, h, x, y, z) {
    const r = S.r,
      l = h + 2,
      m = Math.floor(l * 0.618);
    setDirtAt(S, x, y - 1, z);
    const n = Math.min(1, Math.floor(1.382 + Math.pow(1 * l / 13, 2)));
    const o = y + m;
    const list = [{
      p: [x, y + m, z],
      base: o
    }];
    for (let k = l - 5; k >= 0; k--) {
      const f = treeShape(l, k);
      if (f < 0) continue;
      for (let p = 0; p < n; p++) {
        const e = 1 * f * (r.nextFloat() + 0.328),
          hh = r.nextFloat() * 2 * Math.PI;
        const q = e * Math.sin(hh) + 0.5,
          g = e * Math.cos(hh) + 0.5;
        const p2 = [x + Math.floor(q), y + k - 1, z + Math.floor(g)],
          p3 = [p2[0], p2[1] + 5, p2[2]];
        if (!makeLimb(S, p2, p3, false)) continue;
        const rx = x - p2[0],
          rz = z - p2[2];
        const t = p2[1] - Math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz) * 0.381;
        const u = t > o ? o : Math.trunc(t);
        const p4 = [x, u, z];
        if (!makeLimb(S, p4, p2, false)) continue;
        list.push({
          p: p2,
          base: p4[1]
        });
      }
    }
    makeLimb(S, [x, y, z], [x, y + m, z], true);
    for (const fc of list) {
      const j = fc.base,
        p2 = [x, j, z];
      if (p2[0] === fc.p[0] && p2[1] === fc.p[1] && p2[2] === fc.p[2] || !(j - y >= l * 0.2)) continue;
      makeLimb(S, p2, fc.p, true);
    }
    return list.filter(fc => fc.base - y >= l * 0.2).map(fc => A(fc.p[0], fc.p[1], fc.p[2]));
  }
  function treeShape(i, j) {
    const fr = Math.fround;
    if (fr(j) < fr(i * 0.3)) return -1;
    const f = fr(i / 2),
      g = fr(f - j);
    let h = fr(Math.sqrt(fr(fr(f * f) - fr(g * g))));
    if (g === 0) h = f;else if (Math.abs(g) >= f) return 0;
    return fr(h * 0.5);
  }
  function makeLimb(S, a, b, place) {
    if (!place && a[0] === b[0] && a[1] === b[1] && a[2] === b[2]) return true;
    const dx = b[0] - a[0],
      dy = b[1] - a[1],
      dz = b[2] - a[2];
    const i = Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy), Math.abs(dz));
    const f = Math.fround(dx / i),
      g = Math.fround(dy / i),
      h = Math.fround(dz / i);
    for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
      const p = [a[0] + Math.floor(Math.fround(0.5 + Math.fround(j * f))), a[1] + Math.floor(Math.fround(0.5 + Math.fround(j * g))), a[2] + Math.floor(Math.fround(0.5 + Math.fround(j * h)))];
      if (place) {
        const ax = Math.abs(p[0] - a[0]),
          az = Math.abs(p[2] - a[2]),
          k = Math.max(ax, az);
        placeLog(S, p[0], p[1], p[2], k > 0 ? ax === k ? 'x' : 'z' : 'y');
        continue;
      }
      if (!isFreeTree(S, p[0], p[1], p[2])) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // ---- foliage placers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function foliageHeight(S, h) {
    const T = S.T,
      fp = T.fp,
      r = S.r;
    switch (T.fpType) {
      case 'spruce_foliage_placer':
        return Math.max(4, h - T.trunkHeightP(r));
      case 'pine_foliage_placer':
        return T.heightP(r);
      case 'acacia_foliage_placer':
        return 0;
      case 'dark_oak_foliage_placer':
        return 4;
      case 'mega_pine_foliage_placer':
        return T.crownP(r);
      case 'random_spread_foliage_placer':
        return T.foliageHeightP(r);
      case 'cherry_foliage_placer':
        return T.heightP ? T.heightP(r) : fp.height;
    }
    return T.heightP ? T.heightP(r) : fp.height;
  }
  function foliageRadius(S, k) {
    const T = S.T,
      r = S.r,
      base = T.radius(r);
    if (T.fpType === 'pine_foliage_placer') return base + r.nextInt(Math.max(k + 1, 1));
    return base;
  }
  function tryPlaceLeaf(S, x, y, z) {
    if (!baseTreePos(S, x, y, z)) return false;
    S.setLeaf(x, y, z, S.T.foliageP(S.r, x, y, z, S.R));
    return true;
  }
  function skipLocation(S, i, j, k, l, dbl) {
    const T = S.T,
      r = S.r,
      fp = T.fp;
    switch (T.fpType) {
      case 'blob_foliage_placer':
        return i === l && k === l && (r.nextInt(2) === 0 || j === 0);
      case 'bush_foliage_placer':
        return i === l && k === l && r.nextInt(2) === 0;
      case 'fancy_foliage_placer':
        {
          const fr = Math.fround;
          return fr(fr(fr(i + 0.5) * fr(i + 0.5)) + fr(fr(k + 0.5) * fr(k + 0.5))) > fr(l * l);
        }
      case 'spruce_foliage_placer':
      case 'pine_foliage_placer':
        return i === l && k === l && l > 0;
      case 'acacia_foliage_placer':
        if (j === 0) return (i > 1 || k > 1) && i !== 0 && k !== 0;
        return i === l && k === l && l > 0;
      case 'jungle_foliage_placer':
      case 'mega_pine_foliage_placer':
        if (i + k >= 7) return true;
        return i * i + k * k > l * l;
      case 'dark_oak_foliage_placer':
        if (j === -1 && !dbl) return i === l && k === l;
        if (j === 1) return i + k > l * 2 - 2;
        return false;
      case 'cherry_foliage_placer':
        {
          if (j === -1 && (i === l || k === l) && r.nextFloat() < fp.wide_bottom_layer_hole_chance) return true;
          const corner = i === l && k === l;
          if (l > 2) return corner || i + k > l * 2 - 2 && r.nextFloat() < fp.corner_hole_chance;
          return corner && r.nextFloat() < fp.corner_hole_chance;
        }
    }
    return false;
  }
  function skipSigned(S, i, j, k, l, dbl) {
    if (S.T.fpType === 'dark_oak_foliage_placer' && j === 0 && dbl && (i === -l || i >= l) && (k === -l || k >= l)) return true;
    let m, n;
    if (dbl) {
      m = Math.min(Math.abs(i), Math.abs(i - 1));
      n = Math.min(Math.abs(k), Math.abs(k - 1));
    } else {
      m = Math.abs(i);
      n = Math.abs(k);
    }
    return skipLocation(S, m, j, n, l, dbl);
  }
  function leavesRow(S, x, y, z, rad, j, dbl) {
    const kk = dbl ? 1 : 0;
    for (let l = -rad; l <= rad + kk; l++) for (let m = -rad; m <= rad + kk; m++) {
      if (skipSigned(S, l, j, m, rad, dbl)) continue;
      tryPlaceLeaf(S, x + l, y + j, z + m);
    }
  }
  function createFoliage(S, maxH, a, fh, rad, off) {
    const T = S.T,
      r = S.r,
      fp = T.fp,
      d = a.dbl;
    switch (T.fpType) {
      case 'blob_foliage_placer':
        for (let m = off; m >= off - fh; m--) leavesRow(S, a.x, a.y, a.z, Math.max(rad + a.ro - 1 - Math.trunc(m / 2), 0), m, d);
        return;
      case 'bush_foliage_placer':
        for (let m = off; m >= off - fh; m--) leavesRow(S, a.x, a.y, a.z, rad + a.ro - 1 - m, m, d);
        return;
      case 'fancy_foliage_placer':
        for (let m = off; m >= off - fh; m--) leavesRow(S, a.x, a.y, a.z, rad + (m === off || m === off - fh ? 0 : 1), m, d);
        return;
      case 'spruce_foliage_placer':
        {
          let m = r.nextInt(2),
            n = 1,
            o = 0;
          for (let p = off; p >= -fh; p--) {
            leavesRow(S, a.x, a.y, a.z, m, p, d);
            if (m >= n) {
              m = o;
              o = 1;
              n = Math.min(n + 1, rad + a.ro);
            } else m++;
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'pine_foliage_placer':
        {
          let m = 0;
          for (let n = off; n >= off - fh; n--) {
            leavesRow(S, a.x, a.y, a.z, m, n, d);
            if (m >= 1 && n === off - fh + 1) {
              m--;
              continue;
            }
            if (m < rad + a.ro) m++;
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'acacia_foliage_placer':
        {
          const y = a.y + off;
          leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + a.ro, -1 - fh, d);
          leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad - 1, -fh, d);
          leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + a.ro - 1, 0, d);
          return;
        }
      case 'jungle_foliage_placer':
        {
          const m = d ? fh : 1 + r.nextInt(2);
          for (let n = off; n >= off - m; n--) leavesRow(S, a.x, a.y, a.z, rad + a.ro + 1 - n, n, d);
          return;
        }
      case 'mega_pine_foliage_placer':
        {
          let m = 0;
          for (let n = a.y - fh + off; n <= a.y + off; n++) {
            const o = a.y - n,
              p = rad + a.ro + Math.floor(Math.fround(Math.fround(o / fh) * 3.5));
            const q = o > 0 && p === m && (n & 1) === 0 ? p + 1 : p;
            leavesRow(S, a.x, n, a.z, q, 0, d);
            m = p;
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'dark_oak_foliage_placer':
        {
          const y = a.y + off;
          if (d) {
            leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + 2, -1, d);
            leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + 3, 0, d);
            leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + 2, 1, d);
            if (r.nextBoolean()) leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad, 2, d);
          } else {
            leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + 2, -1, d);
            leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, rad + 1, 0, d);
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'random_spread_foliage_placer':
        {
          for (let m = 0; m < fp.leaf_placement_attempts; m++) {
            const dx = r.nextInt(rad) - r.nextInt(rad),
              dy = r.nextInt(fh) - r.nextInt(fh),
              dz = r.nextInt(rad) - r.nextInt(rad);
            tryPlaceLeaf(S, a.x + dx, a.y + dy, a.z + dz);
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'cherry_foliage_placer':
        {
          const y = a.y + off,
            m = rad + a.ro - 1;
          leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, m - 2, fh - 3, d);
          leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, m - 1, fh - 4, d);
          for (let n = fh - 5; n >= 0; n--) leavesRow(S, a.x, y, a.z, m, n, d);
          cherryHanging(S, a.x, y, a.z, m, -1, d);
          cherryHanging(S, a.x, y, a.z, m - 1, -2, d);
          return;
        }
    }
  }
  function cherryHanging(S, x, y, z, i, j, dbl) {
    const fp = S.T.fp,
      r = S.r;
    leavesRow(S, x, y, z, i, j, dbl);
    const k = dbl ? 1 : 0,
      by = y - 1;
    for (let di = 0; di < 4; di++) {
      const d = HDIRS[di],
        d2 = HDIRS[di + 1 & 3]; // clockwise
      const l = d2[0] + d2[1] > 0 ? i + k : i;
      let px = x + d2[0] * l - d[0] * i,
        py = y + j - 1,
        pz = z + d2[1] * l - d[1] * i;
      for (let m = -i; m < i + k; m++) {
        const above = S.leafSet(px, py + 1, pz);
        if (above && ext(px, py, pz, fp.hanging_leaves_chance)) ext(px, py - 1, pz, fp.hanging_leaves_extension_chance);
        px += d[0];
        pz += d[1];
      }
    }
    function ext(px, py, pz, f) {
      if (Math.abs(px - x) + Math.abs(py - by) + Math.abs(pz - z) >= 7) return false;
      if (r.nextFloat() > f) return false;
      return tryPlaceLeaf(S, px, py, pz);
    }
  }

  // ---- mangrove roots ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function rootTrunkOrigin(S, x, y, z) {
    const rp = S.T.root,
      off = rp.trunk_offset_y ? intProvider(rp.trunk_offset_y)(S.r) : 0;
    return [x, y + off, z];
  }
  // MangroveRootPlacer
  function placeRoots(S, x, y, z, tx, ty, tz) {
    const rp = S.T.root,
      R = S.R,
      r = S.r,
      mp = rp.mangrove_root_placement;
    const canGrow = tagSet(mp.can_grow_through),
      muddy = new Set([].concat(mp.muddy_roots_in).map(n => BID[strip(n)]));
    const rootP = provider(rp.root_provider),
      muddyP = provider(mp.muddy_roots_provider);
    const above = rp.above_root_placement ? {
      p: provider(rp.above_root_placement.above_root_provider),
      c: rp.above_root_placement.above_root_placement_chance
    } : null;
    const ok = (px, py, pz) => baseTreePos(S, px, py, pz) || canGrow.has(R.id(px, py, pz)); // RootPlacer.canPlaceRoot
    for (let py = y; py < ty; py++) if (!ok(x, py, z)) return false;
    const list = [[tx, ty - 1, tz]];
    const maxLen = mp.max_root_length,
      maxW = mp.max_root_width,
      skew = mp.random_skew_chance;
    const potential = (p, d) => {
      const below = [p[0], p[1] - 1, p[2]],
        side = [p[0] + d[0], p[1], p[2] + d[1]];
      const i = Math.abs(p[0] - tx) + Math.abs(p[1] - ty) + Math.abs(p[2] - tz);
      if (i > maxW - 3 && i <= maxW) return r.nextFloat() < skew ? [below, [side[0], side[1] - 1, side[2]]] : [below];
      if (i > maxW) return [below];
      if (r.nextFloat() < skew) return [below];
      return r.nextBoolean() ? [side] : [below];
    };
    const simulate = (p, d, out, i) => {
      if (i === maxLen || out.length > maxLen) return false;
      for (const q of potential(p, d)) {
        if (!ok(q[0], q[1], q[2])) continue;
        out.push(q);
        if (!simulate(q, d, out, i + 1)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    };
    for (const d of HDIRS) {
      const p = [tx + d[0], ty, tz + d[1]],
        out = [];
      if (!simulate(p, d, out, 0)) return false;
      list.push(...out, p);
    }
    for (const p of list) {
      if (!ok(p[0], p[1], p[2])) continue;
      const id = R.id(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
      S.setRoot(p[0], p[1], p[2], muddy.has(id) ? muddyP(r, p[0], p[1], p[2], R) : rootP(r, p[0], p[1], p[2], R));
      if (above && r.nextFloat() < above.c && R.isAir(p[0], p[1] + 1, p[2])) R.setState(p[0], p[1] + 1, p[2], above.p(r, p[0], p[1] + 1, p[2], R));
    }
    return true;
  }

  // ---- tree decorators -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const VINE_FACE = {
    west: 'east',
    east: 'west',
    north: 'south',
    south: 'north'
  };
  function placeVine(D, x, y, z, face) {
    const id = BID.vine;
    if (id === undefined) return;
    const b = BLOCKS[id],
      i = b.states.findIndex(s => ['north', 'east', 'south', 'west', 'up'].every(k => s[k] === (k === face ? 'true' : 'false')));
    D.set(x, y, z, [id, Math.max(0, i)]);
  }
  function decorate(D, dec, T) {
    const r = D.r,
      d = dec.d;
    switch (dec.t) {
      case 'trunk_vine':
        for (const [x, y, z] of D.logs) {
          if (r.nextInt(3) > 0 && D.isAir(x - 1, y, z)) placeVine(D, x - 1, y, z, 'east');
          if (r.nextInt(3) > 0 && D.isAir(x + 1, y, z)) placeVine(D, x + 1, y, z, 'west');
          if (r.nextInt(3) > 0 && D.isAir(x, y, z - 1)) placeVine(D, x, y, z - 1, 'south');
          if (r.nextInt(3) > 0 && D.isAir(x, y, z + 1)) placeVine(D, x, y, z + 1, 'north');
        }
        return;
      case 'leave_vine':
        {
          const hang = (x, y, z, face) => {
            placeVine(D, x, y, z, face);
            let i = 4;
            y--;
            while (D.isAir(x, y, z) && i > 0) {
              placeVine(D, x, y, z, face);
              y--;
              i--;
            }
          };
          for (const [x, y, z] of D.leaves) {
            if (r.nextFloat() < d.probability && D.isAir(x - 1, y, z)) hang(x - 1, y, z, 'east');
            if (r.nextFloat() < d.probability && D.isAir(x + 1, y, z)) hang(x + 1, y, z, 'west');
            if (r.nextFloat() < d.probability && D.isAir(x, y, z - 1)) hang(x, y, z - 1, 'south');
            if (r.nextFloat() < d.probability && D.isAir(x, y, z + 1)) hang(x, y, z + 1, 'north');
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'cocoa':
        {
          if (r.nextFloat() >= d.probability || !D.logs.length || BID.cocoa === undefined) return;
          const y0 = D.logs[0][1];
          for (const [x, y, z] of D.logs.filter(p => p[1] - y0 <= 2)) {
            for (let di = 0; di < 4; di++) {
              if (r.nextFloat() > 0.25) continue;
              const dd = HDIRS[di],
                px = x - dd[0],
                pz = z - dd[1];
              if (!D.isAir(px, y, pz)) continue;
              const face = ['north', 'east', 'south', 'west'][di],
                age = r.nextInt(3);
              const b = BLOCKS[BID.cocoa],
                i = b.states.findIndex(s => s.facing === face && s.age === String(age));
              D.set(px, y, pz, [BID.cocoa, Math.max(0, i)]);
            }
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'beehive':
        {
          const L = D.leaves,
            G = D.logs;
          if (!G.length || BID.bee_nest === undefined) return;
          if (r.nextFloat() >= d.probability) return;
          const i = L.length ? Math.max(L[0][1] - 1, G[0][1] + 1) : Math.min(G[0][1] + 1 + r.nextInt(3), G[G.length - 1][1]);
          const cand = [];
          for (const p of G) if (p[1] === i) for (const [dx, dz] of [[1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]]) cand.push([p[0] + dx, p[1], p[2] + dz]);
          if (!cand.length) return;
          for (let k = cand.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
            const j = r.nextInt(k + 1);
            [cand[k], cand[j]] = [cand[j], cand[k]];
          }
          const spot = cand.find(p => D.isAir(p[0], p[1], p[2]) && D.isAir(p[0], p[1], p[2] + 1));
          if (!spot) return;
          const b = BLOCKS[BID.bee_nest],
            idx = b.states.findIndex(s => s.facing === 'south' && s.honey_level === '0');
          D.set(spot[0], spot[1], spot[2], [BID.bee_nest, Math.max(0, idx)]);
          return;
        }
      case 'alter_ground':
        {
          const prov = provider(d.provider);
          const base = D.roots.length && (!D.logs.length || D.roots[0][1] !== D.logs[0][1]) ? D.roots : D.logs.concat(D.roots.length && D.logs.length && D.roots[0][1] === D.logs[0][1] ? D.roots : []);
          if (!base.length) return;
          const y0 = base[0][1];
          const H = T.H;
          const at = (x, y, z) => {
            for (let i = 2; i >= -3; i--) {
              const id = D.R.id(x, y + i, z);
              if (H.DIRT.has(id)) {
                D.set(x, y + i, z, prov(r, x, y, z, D.R));
                break;
              }
              if (id !== 0 && i < 0) break;
            }
          };
          const circle = (x, y, z) => {
            for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) for (let j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
              if (Math.abs(i) === 2 && Math.abs(j) === 2) continue;
              at(x + i, y, z + j);
            }
          };
          for (const [x, y, z] of base) {
            if (y !== y0) continue;
            circle(x - 1, y, z - 1);
            circle(x + 2, y, z - 1);
            circle(x - 1, y, z + 2);
            circle(x + 2, y, z + 2);
            for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
              const k = r.nextInt(64),
                l = k % 8,
                m = k >> 3;
              if (l !== 0 && l !== 7 && m !== 0 && m !== 7) continue;
              circle(x - 3 + l, y, z - 3 + m);
            }
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'attached_to_leaves':
      case 'attached_to_logs':
        {
          const src = dec.t === 'attached_to_leaves' ? D.leaves.slice() : D.logs.slice();
          for (let k = src.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
            const j = r.nextInt(k + 1);
            [src[k], src[j]] = [src[j], src[k]];
          }
          const used = new Set(),
            prov = provider(d.block_provider);
          const dirs = d.directions.map(n => ({
            up: [0, 1, 0],
            down: [0, -1, 0],
            north: [0, 0, -1],
            south: [0, 0, 1],
            east: [1, 0, 0],
            west: [-1, 0, 0]
          })[n]);
          for (const [x, y, z] of src) {
            const dd = dirs[r.nextInt(dirs.length)],
              px = x + dd[0],
              py = y + dd[1],
              pz = z + dd[2],
              key = px + ',' + py + ',' + pz;
            if (used.has(key) || !(r.nextFloat() < d.probability)) continue;
            let ok = true;
            for (let i = 1; i <= (d.required_empty_blocks || 1); i++) if (!D.isAir(x + dd[0] * i, y + dd[1] * i, z + dd[2] * i)) {
              ok = false;
              break;
            }
            if (!ok) continue;
            for (let a = -d.exclusion_radius_xz; a <= d.exclusion_radius_xz; a++) for (let b = -d.exclusion_radius_y; b <= d.exclusion_radius_y; b++) for (let c = -d.exclusion_radius_xz; c <= d.exclusion_radius_xz; c++) used.add(px + a + ',' + (py + b) + ',' + (pz + c));
            D.set(px, py, pz, prov(r, px, py, pz, D.R));
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'place_on_ground':
        {
          var _d$radius, _d$height;
          const base = D.roots.length ? D.roots : D.logs;
          if (!base.length) return;
          const y0 = base[0][1],
            low = base.filter(p => p[1] === y0);
          let x0 = Infinity,
            x1 = -Infinity,
            z0 = Infinity,
            z1 = -Infinity;
          for (const p of low) {
            x0 = Math.min(x0, p[0]);
            x1 = Math.max(x1, p[0]);
            z0 = Math.min(z0, p[2]);
            z1 = Math.max(z1, p[2]);
          }
          const rad = (_d$radius = d.radius) !== null && _d$radius !== void 0 ? _d$radius : 2,
            hh = (_d$height = d.height) !== null && _d$height !== void 0 ? _d$height : 1,
            prov = provider(d.block_state_provider);
          x0 -= rad;
          x1 += rad;
          z0 -= rad;
          z1 += rad;
          for (let q = 0; q < ((_d$tries = d.tries) !== null && _d$tries !== void 0 ? _d$tries : 128); q++) {
            var _d$tries;
            const px = r.nextIntBetween(x0, x1),
              py = r.nextIntBetween(y0 - hh, y0 + hh),
              pz = r.nextIntBetween(z0, z1);
            const up = D.R.id(px, py + 1, pz);
            if ((up === 0 || up === BID.vine) && SOLIDCUBE[D.R.id(px, py, pz)] && D.R.height('MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES', px, pz) <= py + 1) D.set(px, py + 1, pz, prov(r, px, py + 1, pz, D.R));
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'pale_moss':
        {
          var _d$ground_probability;
          const MOSS = BID.pale_hanging_moss,
            CARPET = BID.pale_moss_carpet;
          for (const [x, y, z] of D.leaves) {
            var _d$leaves_probability;
            if (r.nextFloat() >= ((_d$leaves_probability = d.leaves_probability) !== null && _d$leaves_probability !== void 0 ? _d$leaves_probability : 0.4)) continue;
            if (MOSS !== undefined && D.isAir(x, y - 1, z)) {
              let k = 1 + r.nextInt(3),
                py = y - 1;
              while (k-- > 0 && D.isAir(x, py, z)) {
                D.set(x, py, z, [MOSS, k === 0 ? 1 : 0]);
                py--;
              }
            }
          }
          if (CARPET !== undefined && D.logs.length && r.nextFloat() < ((_d$ground_probability = d.ground_probability) !== null && _d$ground_probability !== void 0 ? _d$ground_probability : 0.8)) {
            const [x, y, z] = D.logs[0];
            for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
              const px = x + r.nextInt(7) - 3,
                pz = z + r.nextInt(7) - 3;
              if (D.isAir(px, y, pz) && SOLIDCUBE[D.R.id(px, y - 1, pz)]) D.set(px, y, pz, [CARPET, 0]);
            }
          }
          return;
        }
      case 'creaking_heart':
        {
          var _d$probability;
          if (r.nextFloat() >= ((_d$probability = d.probability) !== null && _d$probability !== void 0 ? _d$probability : 1) || BID.creaking_heart === undefined || D.logs.length < 3) return;
          const p = D.logs[1 + r.nextInt(D.logs.length - 2)];
          D.set(p[0], p[1], p[2], [BID.creaking_heart, 1]);
          return;
        }
    }
  }
  // FallenTreeFeature (1.21.5): a stump and a log lying next to it
  F.FEATURE.fallen_tree = (ctx, cfg, r, x, y, z) => {
    const R = ctx.R,
      c = cfg.raw,
      trunk = provider(c.trunk_provider),
      len = intProvider(c.log_length)(r);
    const s = trunk(r, x, y, z, R);
    if (!s || !SOLIDCUBE[R.id(x, y - 1, z)] || !R.isAir(x, y, z)) return false;
    R.set(x, y, z, s[0], 0);
    const di = r.nextInt(4),
      d = HDIRS[di],
      gap = 2 + r.nextInt(2),
      axis = d[0] ? 1 : 2;
    let ok = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      const px = x + d[0] * (gap + i),
        pz = z + d[1] * (gap + i);
      if (!R.isAir(px, y, pz) || !SOLIDCUBE[R.id(px, y - 1, pz)]) {
        ok = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (ok) for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) R.set(x + d[0] * (gap + i), y, z + d[1] * (gap + i), s[0], axis);
    return true;
  };
})();
</script>

  function posSeed(x, y, z) {

        t = list[i - 1];
      list[i - 1] = list[k];
      list[k] = t;

    for (const e of list) {

      if (i < 0) return e;

    return list[list.length - 1];

    east: [1, 0, 0],
    up: [0, 1, 0],
    down: [0, -1, 0]

  // StructureTemplate.transform with pivot 0 (rotation: 0 none, 1 cw 90, 2 180, 3 ccw 90)
  const rotPos = (x, y, z, rot) => rot === 1 ? [-z, y, x] : rot === 2 ? [-x, y, -z] : rot === 3 ? [z, y, -x] : [x, y, z];
  const rotPosM = (x, y, z, rot, mir, px, pz) => {

    switch (rot) {
      case 1:

      case 2:
        return [px + px - x, y, pz + pz - z];
      case 3:
        return [px - pz + z, y, px + pz - x];
    }
    return [x, y, z];

  };

    top: 'south',
    name: 'bottom',
    target: 'empty',
    pool: 'empty',

  function element(j) {

        proj: j.projection

      };

  function elBox(e, pos, rot) {
    if (e.type === 'feature') return [pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]];
    if (e.type === 'list') {
      const bs = e.list.filter(m => m.type !== 'empty').map(m => elBox(m, pos, rot));
      return bs.reduce((a, b) => [Math.min(a[0], b[0]), Math.min(a[1], b[1]), Math.min(a[2], b[2]), Math.max(a[3], b[3]), Math.max(a[4], b[4]), Math.max(a[5], b[5])]);
    }
    const s = e.tpl.size;
    return boxOf(s[0], s[1], s[2], pos, rot);
  }
  function elJigsaws(e, pos, rot, r) {
    let list;
    if (e.type === 'feature') list = [{
      ...FEATURE_JIG,
      x: pos[0],
      y: pos[1],
      z: pos[2]
    }];else if (e.type === 'list') return elJigsaws(e.list[0], pos, rot, r);else {

          pool: j[6],

          final: j[8],
          pp: j[9],
          sp: j[10]
        };
      });

    shuffle(list, r);
    list.sort((a, b) => b.sp - a.sp);
    return list;
  }
  const canAttach = (a, b) => a.front === OPP[b.front] && (a.rollable || a.top === b.top) && a.target === b.name;
  const POOLS = new Map();
  function pool(name) {
    name = strip(name);
    let p = POOLS.get(name);
    if (p) return p;
    const d = D.template_pool[name];
    if (!d) {
      POOLS.set(name, null);
      return null;
    }
