<script>
/* ==== js/gen_worker.js ==== */
'use strict';

// World generation core: the vanilla stage-1 generator (noise, aquifers, surface, carvers) and the
// structures. Runs as a Web Worker; when the page cannot start workers (opened from file://, where
// Chrome / Edge refuse them) the same core runs inside the page (see GenPool in terrain2.js).
// Messages:
//   {type:'init', seed, palette, smap}        -> builds the generator
//   {type:'gen', cx, cz, dim, height, id}     -> {type:'chunk', cx, cz, id, blocks, qb, hm, sb, [meta, sx]}
//   {type:'locate', name, cx, cz, dim, id}    -> {type:'locate', id, r}
//   {type:'spawn', id}                        -> {type:'spawn', id, x, z}
//   {type:'biomes', list: [[cx, cz]...], dim, id} -> {type:'biomes', id, qy, data} (3D biomes, 16 * qy a chunk)
(function () {
  const inWorker = typeof WorkerGlobalScope !== 'undefined' && self instanceof WorkerGlobalScope;
  if (inWorker) importScripts('worldgen_data.js', 'blockdata.js', 'modapi.js', ...(new URLSearchParams(self.location.search).get('mods') || '').split(',').filter(m => /^[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$/.test(m)).map(m => '../mods/' + m + '/data.js'), 'worldgen.js', 'structures_data.js', 'structgen.js', 'structtypes.js');
  function makeGenCore() {
    let gen = null,
      seed = null,
      palette = null,
      initErr = null;
    const gens = {};
    // one generator per dimension; chunks are padded to the world's full height. (A generator that could not be built
    // says why in every answer: the jobs used to fail with "G is null", and the page's error log never showed the cause)
    const genFor = dim => {
      if (!gen) throw new Error('generator not built' + (initErr ? ': ' + initErr : ''));
      return gens[dim] || (gens[dim] = dim === 'overworld' ? gen : new WG.Generator(BigInt(seed), self.WG_DATA, palette, dim));
    };
    return async function handle(m, post) {
      try {
        if (m.type === 'init') {
          // (again for another world - GenPool.reseed: the other dimensions' generators were the last world's)
          for (const k in gens) delete gens[k];
          gen = null;
          initErr = null;
          seed = m.seed;
          palette = m.palette;
          if (m.smap && self.SG) {
            SG.setStateMap(m.smap, m.swl);
            SG.setPalette(m.palette);
          }
          gen = new WG.Generator(BigInt(m.seed), self.WG_DATA, m.palette);
          gens.overworld = gen;
          post({
            type: 'ready'
          });
        } else if (m.type === 'gen') {
          const G = genFor(m.dim || 'overworld'),
            t0 = performance.now();
          // structures reaching this chunk: their terrain adaptation goes into the noise, their pieces
          // are placed right after the carvers (vanilla places them in the feature steps)
          // (structures that fail - their templates not unpacked, a browser without DecompressionStream - leave the chunk
          // without them and say so in msg.warn, instead of failing the chunk. Firefox before 113 runs the game but has no
          // DecompressionStream: SG.ready was rejected once and for all, every chunk of the session came back as an error,
          // and the page took the errors for chunks - telemetry 11-02/03, all Firefox devices, the world never loaded)
          let sc = null,
            warn = null;
          const noStructs = e => {
            sc = null;
            G.beard = null;
            warn = 'structures: ' + String(e && e.stack || e);
          };
          if (m.structures !== false && self.SG && G.dim !== 'end') {
            try {
              await SG.ready;
              sc = SG.forChunk(G, m.cx, m.cz);
              G.beard = sc.beard;
            } catch (e) {
              noStructs(e);
            }
          }
          const t1 = performance.now();
          let c;
          // (terrain that fails with a structure's adaptation in it is made again without)
          try {
            c = G.generate(m.cx, m.cz);
          } catch (e) {
            if (!G.beard) throw e;
            noStructs(e);
            c = G.generate(m.cx, m.cz);
          } finally {
            G.beard = null;
          }
          const t2 = performance.now();
          let sx = null;
          if (sc && sc.starts.length) {
            // (pieces that fail half placed: the terrain once more, without them)
            try {
              sx = SG.place(G, m.cx, m.cz, c.blocks, c.meta, c.heightmap, sc.starts);
            } catch (e) {
              noStructs(e);
              sx = null;
              c = G.generate(m.cx, m.cz);
            }
          }
          // surface biome per column (zoomed at the top block), for tints, weather and spawning; in the Nether
          // there is no "surface", so use the floor below y 64
          const sb = new Uint8Array(256);
          for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
            const wx = m.cx * 16 + x,
              wz = m.cz * 16 + z;
            const y = G.dim === 'nether' ? 40 : c.heightmap[z * 16 + x] + 1;
            sb[z * 16 + x] = G.biomeIdx.get(G.biomeAt(wx, y, wz));
          }
          if (m.height && m.height > G.height) {
            const b = new Uint16Array(256 * m.height);
            b.set(c.blocks);
            c.blocks = b;
            const mt = new Uint8Array(256 * m.height);
            mt.set(c.meta);
            c.meta = mt;
            const q = new Uint8Array(16 * (m.height >> 2));
            q.set(c.quartBiomes);
            for (let i = c.quartBiomes.length; i < q.length; i++) q[i] = q[i - 16];
            c.quartBiomes = q;
          }
          const msg = {
            type: 'chunk',
            cx: m.cx,
            cz: m.cz,
            id: m.id,
            blocks: c.blocks,
            qb: c.quartBiomes,
            hm: c.heightmap,
            sb,
            ms: [t1 - t0, t2 - t1, performance.now() - t2]
          };
          if (warn) msg.warn = warn;
          const tr = [c.blocks.buffer, c.quartBiomes.buffer, c.heightmap.buffer, sb.buffer];
          if (sx) {
            msg.meta = c.meta;
            msg.sx = sx;
            tr.push(c.meta.buffer);
          }
          post(msg, tr);
        } else if (m.type === 'locate') {
          await SG.ready;
          post({
            type: 'locate',
            id: m.id,
            r: SG.locate(genFor(m.dim || 'overworld'), m.name, m.cx, m.cz)
          });
        } else if (m.type === 'biomes') {
          // vanilla's 3D biomes (one per 4 x 4 x 4 cell, indices into biome_order) of some chunks, for turning a save
          // into a vanilla world (export.js)
          const G = genFor(m.dim || 'overworld'),
            QY = G.height >> 2,
            n = 16 * QY,
            out = new Uint8Array(m.list.length * n);
          G.rs.endChunk();
          m.list.forEach(([cx, cz], k) => {
            for (let qy = 0; qy < QY; qy++) for (let qz = 0; qz < 4; qz++) for (let qx = 0; qx < 4; qx++) out[k * n + (qy * 4 + qz) * 4 + qx] = G.biomeIdx.get(G.biomes.at(cx * 4 + qx, (G.minY >> 2) + qy, cz * 4 + qz));
          });
          post({
            type: 'biomes',
            id: m.id,
            qy: QY,
            data: out
          }, [out.buffer]);
        } else if (m.type === 'spawn') {
          const r = WG.findSpawn(genFor('overworld'));
          post({
            type: 'spawn',
            id: m.id,
            x: r[0],
            z: r[1]
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (m.type === 'init' && !initErr) initErr = String(err && err.message || err);
        post({
          type: 'error',
          id: m.id,
          message: String(err && err.stack || err)
        });
      }
    };
  }
  if (inWorker) {
    const handle = makeGenCore();
    self.onmessage = e => handle(e.data, (msg, tr) => self.postMessage(msg, tr || []));
  } else self.makeGenCore = makeGenCore;
})();

<script>
/* ==== js/structures.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main-thread side of the vanilla structures (the worker places the blocks, see structgen.js):
// block entities with loot tables, template entities, structure references for /locate, and the
// vanilla loot-table evaluator used to fill structure chests.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Loot = function () {
  const strip = s => typeof s === 'string' ? s.replace('minecraft:', '') : s;
  const num = (p, r) => {
    if (p === undefined) return 1;
    if (typeof p === 'number') return p;
    const t = strip(p.type || 'uniform');
    if (t === 'constant') return p.value;
    if (t === 'uniform') return num(p.min, r) + r() * (num(p.max, r) - num(p.min, r));
    if (t === 'binomial') {
      let n = 0;
      const k = num(p.n, r),
        q = num(p.p, r);
      for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) if (r() < q) n++;
      return n;
    }
    return 1;
  };
  const condOk = (conds, r) => !conds || conds.every(c => {
    const t = strip(c.condition);
    if (t === 'random_chance') return r() < (typeof c.chance === 'number' ? c.chance : num(c.chance, r));
    if (t === 'inverted') return !condOk([c.term], r);
    return true;
  });
  const itemId = k => {
    k = strip(k);
    return ITEM_KEY[k] !== undefined ? ITEM_KEY[k] : BID[k] !== undefined && ITEMS[BID[k]] ? BID[k] : null;
  };
  function applyFns(stack, fns, r) {
    for (const f of fns || []) {
      if (!condOk(f.conditions, r)) continue;
      const t = strip(f.function);
      if (t === 'set_count') stack.count = Math.max(0, Math.floor(f.add ? stack.count + num(f.count, r) : num(f.count, r)));else if (t === 'set_damage' && ITEMS[stack.id] && ITEMS[stack.id].durability) stack.dmg = Math.floor(ITEMS[stack.id].durability * (1 - num(f.damage, r)));else if (t === 'set_potion' && f.id) stack.pot = strip(f.id);
    }
    return stack;
  }
  function expand(entry, r, out) {
    if (!condOk(entry.conditions, r)) return false;
    const t = strip(entry.type);
    switch (t) {
      case 'item':
        {
          const id = itemId(entry.name);
          if (id !== null) {
            const s = applyFns({
              id,
              count: 1,
              dmg: 0
            }, entry.functions, r);
            if (s.count > 0) out.push(s);
          }
          return true;
        }
      case 'empty':
        return true;
      case 'loot_table':
        {
          const v = typeof entry.value === 'string' ? strip(entry.value) : null;
          if (v) out.push(...roll(v, r));
          return true;
        }
      case 'alternatives':
        for (const c of entry.children || []) if (expand(c, r, out)) return true;
        return false;
      case 'group':
        for (const c of entry.children || []) expand(c, r, out);
        return true;
      case 'sequence':
        for (const c of entry.children || []) if (!expand(c, r, out)) return false;
        return true;
    }
    return true;
  }
  function roll(name, r) {
    const T = self.STRUCT_DATA && self.STRUCT_DATA.loot[strip(name)];
    const out = [];
    if (!T) return out;
    for (const pool of T.pools || []) {
      if (!condOk(pool.conditions, r)) continue;
      const n = Math.floor(num(pool.rolls, r));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const ents = pool.entries.filter(e => condOk(e.conditions, () => 0.5));
        let tot = 0;
        for (const e of ents) {
          var _e$weight;
          tot += (_e$weight = e.weight) !== null && _e$weight !== void 0 ? _e$weight : 1;
        }
        if (!tot) continue;
        let k = r() * tot,
          pick = ents[0];
        for (const e of ents) {
          var _e$weight2;
          k -= (_e$weight2 = e.weight) !== null && _e$weight2 !== void 0 ? _e$weight2 : 1;
          if (k < 0) {
            pick = e;
            break;
          }
        }
        const got = [];
        expand(pick, r, got);
        for (const s of got) out.push(applyFns(s, pool.functions, r));
      }
    }
    for (const s of out) applyFns(s, T.functions, r);
    return out.filter(s => s.count > 0);
  }
  // LootTable.fill: split stacks over random empty slots
  function fill(slots, name, r) {
    const items = roll(name, r);
    const empty = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) if (!slots[i]) empty.push(i);
    for (let i = empty.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(r() * (i + 1));
      [empty[i], empty[j]] = [empty[j], empty[i]];
    }
    const list = [];
    for (const s of items) {
      const max = maxStack(s.id);
      while (s.count > max) {
        list.push({
          ...s,
          count: max
        });
        s.count -= max;
      }
      list.push(s);
    }
    while (list.length < empty.length) {
      const big = list.filter(s => s.count > 1);
      if (!big.length) break;
      const s = big[Math.floor(r() * big.length)],
        k = 1 + Math.floor(r() * (s.count / 2));
      s.count -= k;
      list.push({
        ...s,
        count: k
      });
    }
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(r() * (i + 1));
      [list[i], list[j]] = [list[j], list[i]];
    }
    for (const s of list) {
      if (!empty.length) break;
      slots[empty.pop()] = s;
    }
  }
  return {
    roll,
    fill,
    itemId
  };
}();

// block entities / entities / references the worker reported for a finished chunk
Game.prototype.structureExtras = function (ch, saved) {
  const w = this.world,
    sx = ch.sx,
    minY = w.minY || 0;
  ch.sx = null;
  if (saved) return;
  // a template's own items: [key, count, slot, potion]
  const stackOf = ([key, n,, pot]) => {
    const sid = Loot.itemId(key);
    if (sid === null) return null;
    const s = {
      id: sid,
      count: n || 1,
      dmg: 0
    };
    if (pot) s.pot = pot;
    return s;
  };
  for (const [x, vy, z, type, data] of sx.loot) {
    const y = vy - minY,
      ci = y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15,
      id = ch.getB(ci),
      b = BLOCKS[id];
    if (!b) continue;
    const k = `${x},${y},${z}`,
      chest = b.key === 'chest' || b.key === 'barrel' || b.key === 'trapped_chest';
    if (type === 'loot' && chest) {
      if (!this.blockEntities.has(k)) this.blockEntities.set(k, {
        type: 'chest',
        pos: [x, y, z],
        slots: new Array(27).fill(null),
        loot: data
      });
      if (b.key === 'chest') ch.setM(ci, ch.getM(ci) | 8);
    } else if (this.blockEntities.has(k)) continue;
    // trial chambers' dispensers (filled at once - they are emptied by dispensing) and decorated pots (dropped when broken)
    else if (type === 'loot' && (b.key === 'dispenser' || b.key === 'dropper')) {
      const be = {
        type: b.key,
        pos: [x, y, z],
        slots: new Array(9).fill(null),
        cd: 0,
        loot: data
      };
      this.blockEntities.set(k, be);
      this.fillLoot(be, x, y, z);
    } else if (type === 'loot' && b.key === 'decorated_pot') this.blockEntities.set(k, {
      type: 'pot',
      pos: [x, y, z],
      loot: data
    });
    // items written into the template (the igloo's brewing stand potion, an ancient city furnace and chest, ...)
    else if (type === 'items' && Array.isArray(data)) {
      let be = null;
      if (chest) be = {
        type: 'chest',
        pos: [x, y, z],
        slots: new Array(27).fill(null)
      };else if (b.key === 'dispenser' || b.key === 'dropper' || b.key === 'hopper') be = {
        type: b.key,
        pos: [x, y, z],
        slots: new Array(b.key === 'hopper' ? 5 : 9).fill(null),
        cd: 0
      };else if (b.key === 'brewing_stand') be = {
        type: 'brewing',
        pos: [x, y, z],
        bottles: [null, null, null],
        ingredient: null,
        fuel: null,
        fuelLeft: 0,
        brewTime: 0
      };else if (/^(furnace|smoker|blast_furnace)$/.test(b.key)) be = {
        type: 'furnace',
        pos: [x, y, z],
        input: null,
        fuel: null,
        output: null,
        burn: 0,
        burnMax: 0,
        cook: 0
      };
      if (!be) continue;
      for (const it of data) {
        const s = stackOf(it),
          i = it[2] || 0;
        if (!s) continue;
        if (be.slots) {
          if (i < be.slots.length) be.slots[i] = s;
        } else if (be.bottles) {
          if (i < 3) be.bottles[i] = s;else if (i === 3) be.ingredient = s;else if (i === 4) be.fuel = s;
        } else be[['input', 'fuel', 'output'][i] || 'output'] = s;
      }
      this.blockEntities.set(k, be);
    }
    // a spawner's mob (a template's SpawnData: the bastion's magma cubes, the mansion's spiders; the mineshaft's cave
    // spiders) - they all spawned zombies, the spawner block's default
    if (type === 'spawner' && b.key === 'spawner' && typeof data === 'string') {
      const k = `${x},${y},${z}`;
      if (!this.blockEntities.has(k)) this.blockEntities.set(k, {
        type: 'spawner',
        pos: [x, y, z],
        mob: data
      });
    }
  }
  // the chunk is saved from now on, so its structure mobs are not spawned again when it reloads
  if (sx.ent.length) ch.modified = true;
  for (const [x, vy, z, type, data] of sx.ent) {
    const cart = type === 'minecart:chest' && typeof Minecart !== 'undefined'; // (a mineshaft's chest minecart)
    if (!MOB_TYPES[type] && !cart) continue;
    const m = createMob(this, type, x, vy - minY, z);
    if (!m) continue;
    m.persistent = true;
    if (cart && data && data.loot) m.loot = data.loot;
    if (data && data.profession) m.profession = data.profession;
    if (data && data.type) m.vtype = data.type;
    this.entities.push(m);
  }
};
// structure-feature elements (village decorations, ...) for one chunk, placed in its decoration step
Game.prototype.structureFeatures = function (ch, ctx, rand, place) {
  if (!ch.sx || !ch.sx.feat) return;
  for (const [x, y, z, f] of ch.sx.feat) place(ctx, f, rand, [x, y, z], f);
};
// nearest structure of a kind (from the references seen so far)
Game.prototype.nearestStructure = function (kind, x, z) {
  let best = null,
    bd = Infinity;
  for (const r of (this.world.structRefs || new Map()).values()) {
    if (kind && !r.name.startsWith(kind)) continue;
    const cx = (r.box[0] + r.box[3]) / 2,
      cz = (r.box[2] + r.box[5]) / 2,
      d = Math.hypot(cx - x, cz - z);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      best = {
        name: r.name,
        x: Math.round(cx),
        z: Math.round(cz),
        d
      };
    }
  }
  return best;
};
