<script>
/* ==== js/nbt.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// NBT (Minecraft's binary tag format, big-endian) reader and writer, for importing vanilla worlds and turning a
// save into one for a room. Works in the page, in
// workers and in Node (multiplayer/tools). Values: byte / short / int / float / double -> number, long -> BigInt,
// string -> string, list -> array, compound -> plain object, byte / int arrays -> Int8Array / Int32Array,
// long arrays -> NBT.Longs (pairs of 32-bit halves: block state data is unpacked from them without BigInt).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
(function (root) {
  const utf8 = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
  class Longs {
    // a long array as [hi0, lo0, hi1, lo1, ...] (unsigned 32-bit halves)
    constructor(u32) {
      this.u32 = u32;
      this.length = u32.length >> 1;
    }
    hi(i) {
      return this.u32[i * 2];
    }
    lo(i) {
      return this.u32[i * 2 + 1];
    }
  }
  function parse(bytes) {
    const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    let p = 0;
    const str = () => {
      const n = dv.getUint16(p);
      p += 2;
      const s = utf8.decode(bytes.subarray(p, p + n));
      p += n;
      return s;
    };
    const read = t => {
      switch (t) {
        case 1:
          return dv.getInt8(p++);
        case 2:
          {
            const v = dv.getInt16(p);
            p += 2;
            return v;
          }
        case 3:
          {
            const v = dv.getInt32(p);
            p += 4;
            return v;
          }
        case 4:
          {
            const v = dv.getBigInt64(p);
            p += 8;
            return v;
          }
        case 5:
          {
            const v = dv.getFloat32(p);
            p += 4;
            return v;
          }
        case 6:
          {
            const v = dv.getFloat64(p);
            p += 8;
            return v;
          }
        case 7:
          {
            const n = dv.getInt32(p);
            p += 4;
            const v = new Int8Array(bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset + p, bytes.byteOffset + p + n));
            p += n;
            return v;
          }
        case 8:
          return str();
        case 9:
          {
            const et = dv.getUint8(p++),
              n = dv.getInt32(p);
            p += 4;
            const a = new Array(Math.max(0, n));
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = read(et);
            return a;
          }
        case 10:
          {
            const o = {};
            for (;;) {
              const ct = dv.getUint8(p++);
              if (ct === 0) break;
              const k = str();
              o[k] = read(ct);
            }
            return o;
          }
        case 11:
          {
            const n = dv.getInt32(p);
            p += 4;
            const a = new Int32Array(n);
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++, p += 4) a[i] = dv.getInt32(p);
            return a;
          }
        case 12:
          {
            const n = dv.getInt32(p);
            p += 4;
            const a = new Uint32Array(n * 2);
            for (let i = 0; i < n * 2; i++, p += 4) a[i] = dv.getUint32(p);
            return new Longs(a);
          }
      }
      throw new Error('NBT: unknown tag ' + t + ' at ' + p);
    };
    const t = dv.getUint8(p++);
    if (t !== 10) throw new Error('NBT: root is not a compound');
    str(); // root name (empty)
    return read(10);
  }
  // decompress with the platform's streams: 'gzip' (level.dat, region type 1) or 'deflate' (zlib, region type 2)
  async function inflate(bytes, format) {
    const ds = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream(format));
    return new Uint8Array(await new Response(ds).arrayBuffer());
  }
  // ---- writing (exporting a save for a room): plain values pick their tag (an integer number -> int, other numbers
  // -> double, boolean -> byte, BigInt -> long, array -> list of its first element's tag, Int8Array / Uint8Array -> byte
  // array, Int32Array -> int array, Longs -> long array, object -> compound; null / undefined fields are left out);
  // NBT.byte(v), NBT.short(v), NBT.float(v), NBT.long(v) ... give the other tags
  class Tag {
    constructor(t, v) {
      this.t = t;
      this.v = v;
    }
  }
  const tag = t => v => new Tag(t, v);
  const tagOf = v => v instanceof Tag ? v.t : typeof v === 'number' ? Number.isInteger(v) && v >= -2147483648 && v <= 2147483647 ? 3 : 6 : typeof v === 'boolean' ? 1 : typeof v === 'bigint' ? 4 : typeof v === 'string' ? 8 : Array.isArray(v) ? 9 : v instanceof Int8Array || v instanceof Uint8Array ? 7 : v instanceof Int32Array ? 11 : v instanceof Longs ? 12 : 10;
  const utf8e = new TextEncoder();
  function write(value) {
    let buf = new Uint8Array(1 << 16),
      dv = new DataView(buf.buffer),
      p = 0;
    const room = n => {
      if (p + n <= buf.length) return;
      let m = buf.length * 2;
      while (m < p + n) m *= 2;
      const b = new Uint8Array(m);
      b.set(buf);
      buf = b;
      dv = new DataView(buf.buffer);
    };
    const str = s => {
      const b = utf8e.encode(s);
      room(2 + b.length);
      dv.setUint16(p, b.length);
      p += 2;
      buf.set(b, p);
      p += b.length;
    };
    const put = (t, v) => {
      if (v instanceof Tag) v = v.v;
      switch (t) {
        case 1:
          room(1);
          dv.setInt8(p++, typeof v === 'boolean' ? +v : v);
          return;
        case 2:
          room(2);
          dv.setInt16(p, v);
          p += 2;
          return;
        case 3:
          room(4);
          dv.setInt32(p, v);
          p += 4;
          return;
        case 4:
          room(8);
          dv.setBigInt64(p, BigInt.asIntN(64, BigInt(v)));
          p += 8;
          return;
        case 5:
          room(4);
          dv.setFloat32(p, v);
          p += 4;
          return;
        case 6:
          room(8);
          dv.setFloat64(p, v);
          p += 8;
          return;
        case 7:
          room(4 + v.length);
          dv.setInt32(p, v.length);
          p += 4;
          buf.set(new Uint8Array(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, v.length), p);
          p += v.length;
          return;
        case 8:
          str(v);
          return;
        case 9:
          {
            const et = v.length ? tagOf(v[0]) : 0;
            room(5);
            dv.setUint8(p++, et);
            dv.setInt32(p, v.length);
            p += 4;
            for (const x of v) put(et, x);
            return;
          }
        case 10:
          for (const k in v) {
            const x = v[k];
            if (x === undefined || x === null) continue;
            const ct = tagOf(x);
            room(1);
            dv.setUint8(p++, ct);
            str(k);
            put(ct, x);
          }
          room(1);
          dv.setUint8(p++, 0);
          return;
        case 11:
          room(4 + v.length * 4);
          dv.setInt32(p, v.length);
          p += 4;
          for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++, p += 4) dv.setInt32(p, v[i]);
          return;
        case 12:
          room(4 + v.u32.length * 4);
          dv.setInt32(p, v.length);
          p += 4;
          for (let i = 0; i < v.u32.length; i++, p += 4) dv.setUint32(p, v.u32[i]);
          return;
      }
      throw new Error('NBT: cannot write tag ' + t);
    };
    room(3);
    dv.setUint8(p++, 10);
    str('');
    put(10, value);
    return buf.slice(0, p);
  }
  // compressing the same ways: 'gzip' (player files) or 'deflate' (zlib, region chunks)
  async function deflate(bytes, format) {
    const cs = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream(format));
    return new Uint8Array(await new Response(cs).arrayBuffer());
  }
  const NBT = {
    parse,
    inflate,
    Longs,
    write,
    deflate,
    Tag,
    byte: tag(1),
    short: tag(2),
    int: tag(3),
    long: tag(4),
    float: tag(5),
    double: tag(6)
  };
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = NBT;else root.NBT = NBT;
})(typeof self !== 'undefined' ? self : globalThis);
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/anvil.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Importing vanilla Java worlds (1.18 and newer). The player picks the world folder (or a .zip of it); this reads
//   - the seed: dimensions/minecraft/overworld/data/minecraft/world_gen_settings.dat (26.x), or level.dat
//     (WorldGenSettings.seed, RandomSeed) for older worlds
//   - level.dat: name, spawn, time, game mode, difficulty
//   - the region files (Anvil, r.X.Z.mca) of the three dimensions, in the 26.x layout
//     (dimensions/minecraft/<dim>/region) or the older one (region, DIM-1/region, DIM1/region)
// and turns every finished chunk into a saved chunk of a new gen-2 world with the same seed. Chunks the server
// never generated come from this game's vanilla generator, so the land around the imported area matches.
// Chests and furnaces keep their contents.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const VanillaImport = (() => {
  const DIMS = [{
    dim: 'overworld',
    minY: -64,
    paths: ['dimensions/minecraft/overworld/region/', 'region/']
  }, {
    dim: 'nether',
    minY: 0,
    paths: ['dimensions/minecraft/the_nether/region/', 'DIM-1/region/']
  }, {
    dim: 'end',
    minY: 0,
    paths: ['dimensions/minecraft/the_end/region/', 'DIM1/region/']
  }];
  const strip = s => String(s).replace(/^minecraft:/, '');
  // a text component as plain text: 26.x stores a string, a list or a compound (text / translate, extra); worlds before
  // 1.20.5 its JSON. There is no language table here, so a translation shows its fallback or its key and arguments
  const compText = (c, top) => {
    if (c == null) return '';
    if (typeof c === 'string') {
      if (top && /^\s*[{"]/.test(c)) {
        try {
          return compText(JSON.parse(c));
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      return c;
    }
    if (typeof c !== 'object') return String(c);
    if (Array.isArray(c)) return c.map(x => compText(x)).join('');
    const ks = Object.keys(c);
    if (ks.length === 1 && ks[0] === '') return compText(c['']); // a mixed-type list's element, wrapped as {"": value}
    let s = c.text != null ? compText(c.text) : '';
    if (c.text == null && c.translate != null) {
      const args = Array.isArray(c.with) ? c.with.map(x => compText(x)) : [];
      s = c.fallback != null ? String(c.fallback) : String(c.translate) + (args.length ? ' ' + args.join(', ') : '');
    }
    return s + (Array.isArray(c.extra) ? c.extra.map(x => compText(x)).join('') : '');
  };

  // ---- reading the picked files: a folder (File objects with webkitRelativePath) or a .zip ----
  // entries: Map of path inside the world folder -> () => Promise<Uint8Array>
  async function fromFileList(files) {
    const list = [...files];
    if (list.length === 1 && /\.zip$/i.test(list[0].name)) return fromZip(list[0]);
    const all = new Map();
    for (const f of list) all.set((f.webkitRelativePath || f.name).replace(/\\/g, '/'), () => f.arrayBuffer().then(b => new Uint8Array(b)));
    return rootAt(all);
  }
  // the world folder is the one holding level.dat (the shallowest, if a zip or folder holds more)
  function rootAt(all) {
    let root = null;
    for (const p of all.keys()) if (/(^|\/)level\.dat$/.test(p)) {
      const r = p.slice(0, -'level.dat'.length);
      if (root === null || r.length < root.length) root = r;
    }
    if (root === null) throw new Error('没有找到 level.dat：请选择原版存档的世界文件夹（里面有 level.dat 和 region 或 dimensions）');
    const out = new Map();
    for (const [p, get] of all) if (p.startsWith(root)) out.set(p.slice(root.length), get);
    return out;
  }
  // zip: the central directory, then each entry (stored, or deflate through DecompressionStream)
  async function fromZip(file) {
    const buf = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()),
      dv = new DataView(buf.buffer);
    let eocd = -1;
    for (let i = buf.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, buf.length - 65557); i--) if (dv.getUint32(i, true) === 0x06054b50) {
      eocd = i;
      break;
    }
    if (eocd < 0) throw new Error('不是有效的 zip 文件');
    let n = dv.getUint16(eocd + 10, true),
      p = dv.getUint32(eocd + 16, true);
    const all = new Map(),
      td = new TextDecoder();
    while (n-- > 0) {
      if (dv.getUint32(p, true) !== 0x02014b50) break;
      const method = dv.getUint16(p + 10, true),
        csize = dv.getUint32(p + 20, true),
        nlen = dv.getUint16(p + 28, true);
      const elen = dv.getUint16(p + 30, true),
        clen = dv.getUint16(p + 32, true),
        lho = dv.getUint32(p + 42, true);
      const name = td.decode(buf.subarray(p + 46, p + 46 + nlen)).replace(/\\/g, '/');
      p += 46 + nlen + elen + clen;
      if (name.endsWith('/')) continue;
      const start = lho + 30 + dv.getUint16(lho + 26, true) + dv.getUint16(lho + 28, true),
        data = buf.subarray(start, start + csize);
      if (method === 0) all.set(name, async () => data);else if (method === 8) all.set(name, () => NBT.inflate(data, 'deflate-raw'));
    }
    return rootAt(all);
  }
  async function readNbt(entries, path) {
    const get = entries.get(path);
    if (!get) return null;
    let b = await get();
    if (b[0] === 0x1f && b[1] === 0x8b) b = await NBT.inflate(b, 'gzip');
    return NBT.parse(b);
  }

  // ---- block states and items ----
  const stateCache = new Map(),
    missing = new Map(),
    substituted = new Map();
  // vanilla blocks this game shows as another one
  const SUBSTITUTE = {
    bubble_column: 'water'
  };
  function stateOf(e) {
    let key = SUBSTITUTE[strip(e.Name)] || strip(e.Name);
    if (e.Properties) {
      const ks = Object.keys(e.Properties).sort();
      if (ks.length) key += '[' + ks.map(k => k + '=' + e.Properties[k]).join(',') + ']';
    }
    let r = stateCache.get(key);
    if (r !== undefined && r[3]) {
      const n = strip(e.Name),
        M = r[3] === 'missing' ? missing : substituted;
      M.set(n, (M.get(n) || 0) + 1);
    }
    if (r === undefined) {
      r = mapVanillaStateNear(key); // blocks this game lacks: the closest one it has, or air
      if (!r) r = [0, 0, false, 'missing'];else if (r[2]) r = [r[0], r[1], true, 'near'];
      stateCache.set(key, r);
      if (r[3]) {
        const n = strip(e.Name),
          M = r[3] === 'missing' ? missing : substituted;
        M.set(n, (M.get(n) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    return r;
  }
  const stackOf = it => {
    var _ref, _it$count;
    const id = ITEM_KEY[strip(it.id)];
    if (id === undefined) return null;
    const s = makeStack(id, (_ref = (_it$count = it.count) !== null && _it$count !== void 0 ? _it$count : it.Count) !== null && _ref !== void 0 ? _ref : 1);
    const dmg = it.components && it.components['minecraft:damage'];
    if (dmg) s.dmg = dmg;
    return s;
  };

  // ---- one chunk: block states (palette + packed indices) -> flat block / meta arrays ----
  function convertChunk(nbt, minY, H, bes, stats) {
    if (nbt.Level || !nbt.sections) {
      stats.old++;
      return null;
    } // before 1.18
    const st = strip(nbt.Status || '');
    if (st !== 'full') {
      stats.partial++;
      return null;
    } // the generator makes the rest
    const B = new Uint16Array(256 * H),
      M = new Uint8Array(256 * H),
      WL = [];
    for (const sec of nbt.sections) {
      const bs = sec.block_states;
      if (!bs || !bs.palette || !bs.palette.length) continue;
      const base = (sec.Y * 16 - minY) * 256;
      if (base < 0 || base + 4096 > B.length) continue;
      // waterlogged=true: the cell keeps its water (a block this game can't fill with water, or doesn't have, gives
      // way to the water)
      const pal = bs.palette.map(e => {
        const s = stateOf(e);
        if (!(e.Properties && e.Properties.waterlogged === 'true')) return s;
        return !s[0] ? [WATER, 0] : canWaterlog(s[0], s[1]) ? [s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3], true] : s;
      });
      if (pal.length === 1 || !bs.data) {
        const [id, m,,, wl] = pal[0];
        if (id) {
          B.fill(id, base, base + 4096);
          M.fill(m, base, base + 4096);
        }
        if (wl) for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) WL.push(base + i);
        continue;
      }
      // indices: max(4, bits for the palette) bits each, as many as fit in a long, never split across longs
      const bits = Math.max(4, 32 - Math.clz32(pal.length - 1)),
        per = Math.floor(64 / bits),
        mask = (1 << bits) - 1,
        L = bs.data;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) {
        const li = i / per | 0,
          o = (i - li * per) * bits,
          lo = L.lo(li),
          hi = L.hi(li);
        const v = o >= 32 ? hi >>> o - 32 & mask : o + bits <= 32 ? lo >>> o & mask : (lo >>> o | hi << 32 - o) & mask;
        const s = pal[v] || pal[0];
        B[base + i] = s[0];
        M[base + i] = s[1];
        if (s[4]) WL.push(base + i);
      }
    }
    // containers: chests / barrels (27 slots) and furnaces, where this game has the same kind of block
    for (const be of nbt.block_entities || []) {
      const t = strip(be.id),
        x = be.x,
        y = be.y - minY,
        z = be.z;
      if (y < 0 || y >= H) continue;
      const items = be.Items || [];
      const at = BLOCKS[B[y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15]];
      if (!at) continue;
      if ((t === 'chest' || t === 'trapped_chest' || t === 'barrel') && at.key === 'chest') {
        const slots = new Array(27).fill(null);
        for (const it of items) {
          const s = stackOf(it);
          if (s && it.Slot >= 0 && it.Slot < 27) slots[it.Slot] = s;
        }
        const chest = {
          type: 'chest',
          pos: [x, y, z],
          slots
        };
        // a structure chest nobody has opened only names its loot table: filled when it is opened, as in vanilla
        if (!items.length && be.LootTable) chest.loot = strip(be.LootTable);
        bes[`${x},${y},${z}`] = chest;
        stats.containers++;
      } else if ((t === 'furnace' || t === 'blast_furnace' || t === 'smoker') && at.onUse === 'furnace') {
        var _ref2, _be$lit_time_remainin, _ref3, _be$cooking_time_spen;
        const f = {
          type: 'furnace',
          pos: [x, y, z],
          input: null,
          fuel: null,
          output: null,
          burn: 0,
          burnMax: 0,
          cook: 0
        };
        for (const it of items) {
          const s = stackOf(it);
          if (it.Slot === 0) f.input = s;else if (it.Slot === 1) f.fuel = s;else if (it.Slot === 2) f.output = s;
        }
        // one saved while burning keeps burning for the time it had left, then goes out (a lit one stayed lit for good)
        // (26.x lit_time_remaining / lit_total_time / cooking_time_spent; older worlds BurnTime / CookTime)
        f.burn = Math.max(0, ((_ref2 = (_be$lit_time_remainin = be.lit_time_remaining) !== null && _be$lit_time_remainin !== void 0 ? _be$lit_time_remainin : be.BurnTime) !== null && _ref2 !== void 0 ? _ref2 : 0) | 0);
        f.burnMax = Math.max(f.burn, be.lit_total_time | 0);
        f.cook = Math.max(0, ((_ref3 = (_be$cooking_time_spen = be.cooking_time_spent) !== null && _be$cooking_time_spen !== void 0 ? _be$cooking_time_spen : be.CookTime) !== null && _ref3 !== void 0 ? _ref3 : 0) | 0);
        bes[`${x},${y},${z}`] = f;
        stats.containers++;
      } else if (t === 'command_block' && /^(chain_|repeating_)?command_block$/.test(at.key)) {
        // a command block's command and state (vanilla BaseCommandBlock / CommandBlockEntity; cmdblock.js cmdEntity)
        bes[`${x},${y},${z}`] = {
          type: 'command_block',
          pos: [x, y, z],
          command: String(be.Command || ''),
          success: be.SuccessCount | 0,
          output: compText(be.LastOutput, true),
          track: be.TrackOutput !== 0,
          auto: !!be.auto,
          powered: !!be.powered,
          met: !!be.conditionMet
        };
      }
    }
    const rec = {
      b: new Uint16Array(rleEncode(B)),
      m: new Uint16Array(rleEncode(M))
    };
    if (WL.length) {
      rec.w = Uint32Array.from(WL);
      stats.waterlogged = (stats.waterlogged || 0) + WL.length;
    }
    return rec;
  }

  // ---- a region file: 1024 chunk slots, each at a 4 KB sector offset with length + compression ----
  async function regionChunks(bytes, dir, entries, fn) {
    const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
      const loc = dv.getUint32(i * 4),
        off = (loc >>> 8) * 4096;
      if (!off || off + 5 > bytes.length) continue;
      const len = dv.getUint32(off),
        type = bytes[off + 4];
      let data = bytes.subarray(off + 5, off + 4 + len);
      if (type & 128) {
        // stored outside the region file (c.X.Z.mcc)
        const get = entries.get(dir + `c.${i & 31}.${i >> 5}.mcc`);
        if (!get) {
          await fn(null, 'external');
          continue;
        }
        data = await get();
      }
      const c = type & 127;
      try {
        if (c === 1) data = await NBT.inflate(data, 'gzip');else if (c === 2) data = await NBT.inflate(data, 'deflate');else if (c !== 3) {
          await fn(null, 'compression ' + c);
          continue;
        } // LZ4 / custom: not supported
        await fn(NBT.parse(data), null);
      } catch (e) {
        await fn(null, 'error');
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- entities (entities/r.X.Z.mca, 1.17+) -> the records the game keeps per dimension (dims.js mobRecord),
  // restored when their chunk loads: mobs, boats and minecarts, item frames, paintings, armor stands. Left out: dropped
  // items, orbs and arrows (the game doesn't keep them either) and hostile mobs that would despawn
  const FACING3 = [2, 3, 4, 5, 0, 1]; // vanilla Direction (down up north south west east) -> DIRS
  const FACING2 = [5, 0, 4, 1]; // a painting's 2D facing (south west north east)
  const kindOk = new Map();
  const slotsOf = (list, n) => {
    const s = new Array(n).fill(null);
    for (const it of list || []) {
      const st = stackOf(it);
      if (st && it.Slot >= 0 && it.Slot < n) s[it.Slot] = st;
    }
    return s;
  };
  const blockPosOf = (e, minY) => {
    const b = e.block_pos || (e.TileX !== undefined ? [e.TileX, e.TileY, e.TileZ] : null);
    return b ? [Number(b[0]), Number(b[1]) - minY, Number(b[2])] : null;
  };
  function entityRecord(game, e, minY, stats) {
    const t = strip(e.id || ''),
      P = e.Pos;
    if (!P) return null;
    const pos = [Number(P[0]), Number(P[1]) - minY, Number(P[2])];
    const yaw = e.Rotation ? Math.PI - Number(e.Rotation[0]) * Math.PI / 180 : 0;
    let m = /^(.+?)_(chest_)?(boat|raft)$/.exec(t);
    if (m) return {
      type: (m[2] ? 'chest_boat:' : 'boat:') + m[1],
      pos,
      yaw,
      x: {
        yaw,
        slots: m[2] ? slotsOf(e.Items, 27) : undefined,
        loot: e.LootTable ? strip(e.LootTable) : undefined
      }
    };
    m = /^(?:(chest|furnace|tnt|hopper)_)?minecart$/.exec(t);
    if (m) {
      const kind = m[1] || '',
        slots = kind === 'chest' ? slotsOf(e.Items, 27) : kind === 'hopper' ? slotsOf(e.Items, 5) : undefined;
      return {
        type: 'minecart:' + kind,
        pos,
        yaw,
        x: {
          yaw,
          slots,
          fuel: Number(e.Fuel || 0),
          enabled: e.Enabled === undefined ? undefined : !!e.Enabled,
          loot: e.LootTable ? strip(e.LootTable) : undefined
        }
      };
    }
    if (t === 'item_frame' || t === 'glow_item_frame') {
      var _FACING;
      const b = blockPosOf(e, minY);
      if (!b) return null;
      return {
        type: t,
        pos: [b[0] + 0.5, b[1], b[2] + 0.5],
        yaw: 0,
        x: {
          b,
          f: (_FACING = FACING3[Number(e.Facing) || 0]) !== null && _FACING !== void 0 ? _FACING : 4,
          it: e.Item ? stackOf(e.Item) : null,
          r: Number(e.ItemRotation || 0),
          t
        }
      };
    }
    if (t === 'painting') {
      var _e$facing;
      const b = blockPosOf(e, minY);
      if (!b) return null;
      return {
        type: t,
        pos: [b[0] + 0.5, b[1], b[2] + 0.5],
        yaw: 0,
        x: {
          b,
          f: FACING2[Number((_e$facing = e.facing) !== null && _e$facing !== void 0 ? _e$facing : e.Facing) & 3],
          v: strip(e.variant || e.Motive || '')
        }
      };
    }
    if (t === 'armor_stand') {
      const q = e.equipment || {},
        A = e.ArmorItems || [],
        H = e.HandItems || [];
      const st = o => o && o.id ? stackOf(o) : null;
      const g = [st(q.feet || A[0]), st(q.legs || A[1]), st(q.chest || A[2]), st(q.head || A[3]), st(q.mainhand || H[0]), st(q.offhand || H[1])];
      return {
        type: t,
        pos,
        yaw,
        x: {
          g,
          s: !!e.Small,
          a: !!e.ShowArms,
          y: yaw
        }
      };
    }
    // mobs this game has (worked out once per kind)
    if (!kindOk.has(t)) {
      let mob = null;
      try {
        mob = createMob(game, t, 0, -1000, 0);
      } catch (err) {
        mob = null;
      }
      kindOk.set(t, mob && mob.type === t && mob instanceof Mob ? {
        hostile: !!(mob.T && mob.T.hostile)
      } : null);
    }
    const k = kindOk.get(t);
    if (!k) {
      if (!/^(item|experience_orb|arrow|spectral_arrow|trident|falling_block|tnt|marker|area_effect_cloud|interaction|.*_display|lightning_bolt)$/.test(t)) stats.entitiesMissing.set(t, (stats.entitiesMissing.get(t) || 0) + 1);
      return null;
    }
    if (k.hostile && !e.PersistenceRequired && !e.CustomName) return null;
    const age = Number(e.Age || 0);
    return {
      type: t,
      pos,
      yaw,
      health: e.Health !== undefined ? Number(e.Health) : undefined,
      sheared: !!e.Sheared,
      wool: Number(e.Color || 0),
      baby: age < 0 || e.IsBaby ? Math.max(1, Math.min(6000, Math.ceil(-age / 4) || 6000)) : 0,
      size: e.Size !== undefined ? Number(e.Size) + 1 : undefined
    };
  }

  // ---- the whole import ----
  async function run(game, files, progress) {
    var _ref4, _ref5, _D$GameType, _ref6, _D$DayTime, _peaceful$easy$normal, _D$Difficulty;
    const entries = await fromFileList(files);
    setWorldFormat(2);
    const H = HEIGHT;
    const level = await readNbt(entries, 'level.dat');
    if (!level || !level.Data) throw new Error('level.dat 读取失败');
    const D = level.Data;
    const wgs = await readNbt(entries, 'dimensions/minecraft/overworld/data/minecraft/world_gen_settings.dat');
    const seed = (_ref4 = (_ref5 = wgs && wgs.data && wgs.data.seed) !== null && _ref5 !== void 0 ? _ref5 : D.WorldGenSettings && D.WorldGenSettings.seed) !== null && _ref4 !== void 0 ? _ref4 : D.RandomSeed;
    if (seed === undefined) throw new Error('找不到世界种子');
    const version = D.Version && D.Version.Name || '未知版本';
    let spawn = null;
    if (D.spawn && D.spawn.pos) spawn = [D.spawn.pos[0], D.spawn.pos[1], D.spawn.pos[2]];else if (D.SpawnX !== undefined) spawn = [D.SpawnX, D.SpawnY, D.SpawnZ];
    const id = 'w' + Date.now().toString(36);
    const stats = {
      chunks: 0,
      old: 0,
      partial: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      containers: 0,
      regions: 0,
      perDim: {}
    };
    missing.clear();
    substituted.clear();
    const dims = {};
    // the region files of each dimension
    const jobs = [];
    for (const d of DIMS) {
      const dir = d.paths.find(pre => [...entries.keys()].some(p => p.startsWith(pre) && p.endsWith('.mca')));
      if (!dir) continue;
      for (const p of entries.keys()) if (p.startsWith(dir) && /^r\.-?\d+\.-?\d+\.mca$/.test(p.slice(dir.length))) jobs.push({
        d,
        dir,
        p
      });
    }
    if (!jobs.some(j => j.d.dim === 'overworld')) throw new Error('存档里没有主世界的区域文件（region/*.mca）');
    let done = 0,
      lastYield = performance.now();
    for (const job of jobs) {
      const {
          d,
          dir,
          p
        } = job,
        sid = d.dim === 'overworld' ? id : id + '~' + d.dim;
      const bes = (dims[d.dim] || (dims[d.dim] = {
        blockEntities: {},
        mobs: []
      })).blockEntities;
      const bytes = await entries.get(p)();
      let batch = [];
      await regionChunks(bytes, dir, entries, async (nbt, err) => {
        if (!nbt) {
          stats.skipped++;
          return;
        }
        const rec = convertChunk(nbt, d.minY, H, bes, stats);
        if (!rec) return;
        batch.push([nbt.xPos, nbt.zPos, rec]);
        stats.chunks++;
        stats.perDim[d.dim] = (stats.perDim[d.dim] || 0) + 1;
        if (batch.length >= 64) {
          await DB.putChunks(sid, batch);
          batch = [];
        }
        if (performance.now() - lastYield > 50) {
          lastYield = performance.now();
          progress && progress(done / jobs.length, stats);
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
        }
      });
      if (batch.length) await DB.putChunks(sid, batch);
      stats.regions++;
      done++;
      progress && progress(done / jobs.length, stats);
    }
    // entities, kept apart from the blocks since 1.17
    stats.entities = 0;
    stats.entitiesMissing = new Map();
    for (const d of DIMS) {
      const dir = d.paths.map(pre => pre.replace(/region\/$/, 'entities/')).find(pre => [...entries.keys()].some(p => p.startsWith(pre) && p.endsWith('.mca')));
      if (!dir || !dims[d.dim]) continue;
      const mobs = dims[d.dim].mobs;
      for (const p of entries.keys()) {
        if (!p.startsWith(dir) || !/^r\.-?\d+\.-?\d+\.mca$/.test(p.slice(dir.length))) continue;
        await regionChunks(await entries.get(p)(), dir, entries, async nbt => {
          for (const e of nbt && nbt.Entities || []) {
            let r = null;
            try {
              r = entityRecord(game, e, d.minY, stats);
            } catch (err) {
              r = null;
            }
            if (r) {
              mobs.push(r);
              stats.entities++;
            }
          }
        });
        if (performance.now() - lastYield > 50) {
          lastYield = performance.now();
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
        }
      }
    }
    stats.entitiesMissing = [...stats.entitiesMissing].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const mode = ['survival', 'creative', 'survival', 'spectator'][(_D$GameType = D.GameType) !== null && _D$GameType !== void 0 ? _D$GameType : 0] || 'survival';
    const meta = {
      id,
      name: (D.LevelName || '导入的世界') + '（导入）',
      seed: String(seed),
      gen: 2,
      mode,
      flat: false,
      created: Date.now(),
      lastPlayed: Date.now(),
      time: Number((_ref6 = (_D$DayTime = D.DayTime) !== null && _D$DayTime !== void 0 ? _D$DayTime : D.Time) !== null && _ref6 !== void 0 ? _ref6 : 1000n) || 1000,
      player: null,
      hardcore: !!(D.hardcore || D.difficulty_settings && D.difficulty_settings.hardcore),
      difficulty: (_peaceful$easy$normal = {
        peaceful: 0,
        easy: 1,
        normal: 2,
        hard: 3
      }[D.difficulty_settings && D.difficulty_settings.difficulty]) !== null && _peaceful$easy$normal !== void 0 ? _peaceful$easy$normal : (_D$Difficulty = D.Difficulty) !== null && _D$Difficulty !== void 0 ? _D$Difficulty : 2,
      cheats: true,
      structures: true,
      bonus: false,
      spawn: spawn ? [spawn[0], spawn[1] - MIN_Y, spawn[2]] : null,
      dims,
      imported: {
        version,
        dataVersion: D.DataVersion,
        chunks: stats.chunks,
        perDim: stats.perDim,
        at: Date.now()
      }
    };
    await DB.putWorld(meta);
    stats.missing = [...missing].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    stats.substituted = [...substituted].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    return {
      meta,
      stats
    };
  }
  return {
    run,
    fromFileList,
    convertChunk,
    regionChunks,
    stateOf,
    missing
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/export.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Turning a save (vanilla terrain, gen 2) into a vanilla 26.2 world for a room (CreateRoomScreen in net.js):
//   - the saved chunks of the three dimensions -> region files: block states with their palettes, vanilla's 3D
//     biomes from the generator, chests / furnaces / hoppers / signs / banners / pots as block entities. Light and
//     heightmaps are left to the server (isLightOn 0); the chunks the save never kept it generates itself from the
//     same seed, as this game did
//   - the kept mobs, boats, minecarts, item frames, paintings, armor stands -> entity region files
//   - the player (where it is, inventory, armour, health, food, experience, effects) -> the owner's player file
//   - world.json: seed, time, spawn, game rules (the room service applies them with commands once the room runs)
// all in one file (pack) that the room service unpacks into the room's world folder before its first start.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const RoomExport = (() => {
  const DATA_VERSION = 4903; // 26.2
  const MAX_BYTES = 100 << 20; // the same as everyone's cloud space
  const DIMS = [{
    dim: 'overworld',
    vdim: 'minecraft:overworld',
    dir: 'dimensions/minecraft/overworld/',
    minY: -64,
    height: 384
  }, {
    dim: 'nether',
    vdim: 'minecraft:the_nether',
    dir: 'dimensions/minecraft/the_nether/',
    minY: 0,
    height: 256
  }, {
    dim: 'end',
    vdim: 'minecraft:the_end',
    dir: 'dimensions/minecraft/the_end/',
    minY: 0,
    height: 256
  }];
  const ns = s => String(s).includes(':') ? String(s) : 'minecraft:' + s;
  const ceilLog2 = n => 32 - Math.clz32(n - 1);
  const pause = () => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));

  // the vanilla block states (vstates_data.js, 110 KB): loaded the first time a save is turned into a room's world
  function loadStates() {
    if (self.VSTATES) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = 'js/vstates_data.js';
      s.onload = res;
      s.onerror = () => rej(new Error('方块数据加载失败，请检查网络'));
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  // ---- this game's [id, meta] -> a vanilla block state ----
  // Every state of the vanilla blocks an id can come from goes through the importer's mapping (mapVanillaState); of
  // the states that land on [id, meta] the one named as the models draw it (vanillaState), then closest to what they
  // draw, then closest to the block's default state wins.
  const enumCache = new Map(); // vanilla name -> [[id, meta, props]...]
  const mapOf = str => {
    try {
      return mapVanillaState(str);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  };
  function statesOf(name) {
    let L = enumCache.get(name);
    if (L) return L;
    L = [];
    enumCache.set(name, L);
    const v = VSTATES[name];
    if (v === undefined) return L;
    if (v === 0) {
      const r = mapOf(name);
      if (r) L.push([r[0], r[1], null]);
      return L;
    }
    const props = v[0],
      idx = props.map(() => 0);
    for (;;) {
      const p = {};
      props.forEach(([k, vs], i) => {
        p[k] = vs[idx[i]];
      });
      const r = mapOf(name + '[' + props.map(([k]) => k + '=' + p[k]).join(',') + ']');
      if (r) L.push([r[0], r[1], p]);
      let i = props.length - 1;
      while (i >= 0 && ++idx[i] >= props[i][1].length) {
        idx[i] = 0;
        i--;
      }
      if (i < 0) break;
    }
    return L;
  }
  let aliasTo = null; // this game's key -> the vanilla names shown as it
  function candidates(b) {
    if (!aliasTo) {
      aliasTo = {};
      for (const [v, k] of Object.entries(STATE_ALIAS)) (aliasTo[k] || (aliasTo[k] = [])).push(v);
    }
    const out = new Set([b.key]);
    for (let m = 0; m < 2; m++) try {
      out.add(vanillaState(b, m, null).key);
    } catch (e) {}
    for (const n of aliasTo[b.key] || []) out.add(n);
    if (b.key === 'lit_furnace') out.add('furnace'); // vanilla: furnace[lit=true]
    return [...out].filter(n => VSTATES[n] !== undefined);
  }
  const revCache = new Map(); // id -> Map(meta -> {name, props})
  function stateFor(id, meta) {
    let T = revCache.get(id);
    if (!T) {
      T = new Map();
      revCache.set(id, T);
      const b = BLOCKS[id];
      if (b) for (const name of candidates(b)) {
        const v = VSTATES[name],
          def = v ? Object.fromEntries(v[0].map(([k, vs], i) => [k, vs[v[1][i]]])) : {};
        for (const [rid, m, p] of statesOf(name)) {
          if (rid !== id) continue;
          let vs = null;
          try {
            vs = vanillaState(b, m, null);
          } catch (e) {}
          let sc = vs && vs.key === name ? 1000 : 0;
          if (p) for (const k in p) {
            if (vs && vs.p[k] !== undefined && String(vs.p[k]) === p[k]) sc += 10;
            if (def[k] === p[k]) sc += 1;
          }
          const cur = T.get(m);
          if (!cur || sc > cur.sc) T.set(m, {
            sc,
            name,
            props: p
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return T.get(meta) || T.get(0) || T.values().next().value || null;
  }
  // a palette entry: {Name, Properties} with its key; ctx when the cell's neighbours decide some of its properties
  // (stairs' shapes, fence / wall / pane connections, grass under snow), wl when it can hold water
  const entryCache = new Map();
  let secSerial = 0; // every section written gets a new number (an entry remembers the last one it went into)
  const keyOf = (name, p) => name + (p ? '[' + Object.keys(p).map(k => k + '=' + p[k]).join(',') + ']' : '');
  function makeEntry(name, p) {
    return {
      key: keyOf(name, p),
      name,
      props: p,
      nbt: p ? {
        Name: ns(name),
        Properties: p
      } : {
        Name: ns(name)
      },
      sec: -1,
      pi: 0
    };
  }
  function entryOf(id, meta, stats) {
    const k = id * 256 + meta;
    let e = entryCache.get(k);
    if (e) return e;
    const s = id ? stateFor(id, meta) : null,
      b = BLOCKS[id];
    if (!s) {
      if (id && b) stats.missing.set(b.key, (stats.missing.get(b.key) || 0) + 1);
      e = makeEntry('air', null);
    } else {
      const p = s.props && {
        ...s.props
      };
      // leaves: this game keeps no distance; the default (7, not persistent) would decay them all on the server. At 1
      // they stay, and the server works out the real distance the moment a log or leaf next to them changes
      if (p && p.distance === '7' && p.persistent === 'false') p.distance = '1';
      e = makeEntry(s.name, p);
      e.ctx = !!(b && (b.stairs || b.fence) || s.props && 'snowy' in s.props);
      e.wl = !!(s.props && 'waterlogged' in s.props);
      e.b = b;
    }
    entryCache.set(k, e);
    return e;
  }
  const SNOW = () => [BID.snow, BID.snow_block];
  // the entry of a cell whose neighbours or water change its properties
  function cellEntry(e, meta, wl, get) {
    const p = {
      ...e.props
    };
    if (e.b.stairs || e.b.fence) {
      let vs = null;
      try {
        vs = vanillaState(e.b, meta, get);
      } catch (err) {}
      if (vs) for (const k in vs.p) if (k in p) p[k] = String(vs.p[k]);
    }
    if ('snowy' in p) p.snowy = SNOW().includes(get(0, 1, 0)[0]) ? 'true' : 'false';
    if (wl && e.wl) p.waterlogged = 'true';
    return makeEntry(e.name, p);
  }

  // packed palette indices: `bits` each, as many as fit in a long, never split across two
  function pack(idx, n, bits) {
    const per = Math.floor(64 / bits),
      u32 = new Uint32Array(Math.ceil(n / per) * 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const li = i / per | 0,
        o = (i - li * per) * bits,
        v = idx[i];
      if (o >= 32) u32[li * 2] |= v << o - 32;else {
        u32[li * 2 + 1] |= v << o;
        if (o + bits > 32) u32[li * 2] |= v >>> 32 - o;
      }
    }
    return new NBT.Longs(u32);
  }

  // ---- items ----
  function itemNbt(s, slot) {
    if (!s || !(s.count > 0)) return null;
    const key = s.unk || ITEMS[s.id] && ITEMS[s.id].key;
    if (!key) return null;
    const o = {};
    if (slot !== undefined) o.Slot = NBT.byte(slot);
    o.id = ns(key);
    o.count = s.count;
    const c = {};
    if (s.dmg) c['minecraft:damage'] = s.dmg | 0;
    if (s.name) c['minecraft:custom_name'] = String(s.name);
    if (s.e && s.e.length) c[key === 'enchanted_book' ? 'minecraft:stored_enchantments' : 'minecraft:enchantments'] = Object.fromEntries(s.e.map(([k, l]) => [ns(k), l | 0]));
    if (s.pot) c['minecraft:potion_contents'] = {
      potion: ns(s.pot)
    };
    if (s.color != null) c['minecraft:dyed_color'] = s.color | 0;
    if (s.pv) c['minecraft:painting/variant'] = ns(s.pv);
    if (s.instrument) c['minecraft:instrument'] = ns(s.instrument);
    if (s.base) c['minecraft:base_color'] = String(s.base);
    if (s.patterns && s.patterns.length) c['minecraft:banner_patterns'] = s.patterns.map(([p, col]) => ({
      color: String(col),
      pattern: ns(p)
    }));
    if (Object.keys(c).length) o.components = c;
    return o;
  }
  const itemList = (slots, from = 0) => (slots || []).map((s, i) => itemNbt(s, i + from)).filter(Boolean);

  // ---- block entities (the ones that hold something) ----
  function blockEntityNbt(be, name, x, y, z) {
    const o = {
      id: '',
      x,
      y,
      z,
      keepPacked: NBT.byte(0)
    };
    switch (be.type) {
      case 'chest':
        o.id = ns(name === 'barrel' || name === 'trapped_chest' ? name : /shulker_box$/.test(name) ? 'shulker_box' : 'chest');
        o.Items = itemList(be.slots);
        if (be.loot && !o.Items.length) o.LootTable = ns(be.loot);
        return o;
      case 'furnace':
        o.id = ns(['furnace', 'smoker', 'blast_furnace'].includes(name) ? name : 'furnace');
        o.Items = [itemNbt(be.input, 0), itemNbt(be.fuel, 1), itemNbt(be.output, 2)].filter(Boolean);
        o.lit_time_remaining = NBT.short(Math.min(32767, be.burn | 0));
        o.lit_total_time = NBT.short(Math.min(32767, be.burnMax | 0));
        o.cooking_time_spent = NBT.short(be.cook | 0);
        o.cooking_total_time = NBT.short(name === 'furnace' ? 200 : 100);
        return o;
      case 'hopper':
      case 'dispenser':
      case 'dropper':
        o.id = ns(be.type);
        o.Items = itemList(be.slots);
        if (be.type === 'hopper') o.TransferCooldown = 0;
        return o;
      case 'brewing':
        if (!be.bottles) return null;
        o.id = ns('brewing_stand');
        o.Items = [...be.bottles.map((s, i) => itemNbt(s, i)), itemNbt(be.ingredient, 3), itemNbt(be.fuel, 4)].filter(Boolean);
        o.BrewTime = NBT.short(be.brewTime | 0);
        o.Fuel = NBT.byte(Math.min(127, be.fuelLeft | 0));
        return o;
      case 'sign':
        {
          if (!be.text) return null;
          const side = t => ({
            messages: [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => String(t && t.l && t.l[i] || '')),
            color: t && t.c || 'black',
            has_glowing_text: NBT.byte(t && t.g ? 1 : 0)
          });
          o.id = ns(/hanging_sign$/.test(name) ? 'hanging_sign' : 'sign');
          o.front_text = side(be.text.f);
          o.back_text = side(be.text.b);
          o.is_waxed = NBT.byte(be.waxed ? 1 : 0);
          return o;
        }
      case 'banner':
        o.id = ns('banner');
        o.patterns = (be.patterns || []).map(([p, col]) => ({
          color: String(col),
          pattern: ns(p)
        }));
        if (be.name) o.CustomName = String(be.name);
        return o;
      // vanilla BaseCommandBlock.save / CommandBlockEntity.saveAdditional (cmdblock.js cmdEntity)
      case 'command_block':
        if (!/command_block$/.test(name)) return null;
        o.id = ns('command_block');
        o.Command = String(be.command || '');
        o.SuccessCount = be.success | 0;
        o.TrackOutput = NBT.byte(be.track === false ? 0 : 1);
        if (be.track !== false && be.output) o.LastOutput = String(be.output);
        o.UpdateLastExecution = NBT.byte(1);
        o.powered = NBT.byte(be.powered ? 1 : 0);
        o.conditionMet = NBT.byte(be.met ? 1 : 0);
        o.auto = NBT.byte(be.auto ? 1 : 0);
        return o;
      case 'pot':
        o.id = ns('decorated_pot');
        if (be.sherds) o.sherds = be.sherds.map(k => ns(typeof k === 'number' ? ITEMS[k].key : k));
        return o;
    }
    return null; // (the rest the server makes as it needs them)
  }

  // ---- entities ----
  const FACING3 = [2, 3, 4, 5, 0, 1]; // vanilla Direction -> DIRS (anvil.js)
  const FACING2 = [5, 0, 4, 1];
  const uuid = () => {
    const a = new Int32Array(4);
    crypto.getRandomValues(a);
    return a;
  };
  const degOf = yaw => {
    let d = (Math.PI - (yaw || 0)) * 180 / Math.PI;
    d = (d % 360 + 540) % 360 - 180;
    return d;
  };
  function entityNbt(r, minY) {
    const t = String(r.type || ''),
      P = r.pos;
    if (!P) return null;
    const x = r.x || {},
      base = id => ({
        id: ns(id),
        Pos: [P[0], P[1] + minY, P[2]].map(NBT.double),
        Motion: [0, 0, 0].map(NBT.double),
        Rotation: [NBT.float(degOf(r.yaw)), NBT.float(0)],
        UUID: uuid(),
        OnGround: NBT.byte(1),
        Fire: NBT.short(-1),
        Air: NBT.short(300)
      });
    let m = /^(chest_boat|boat):(.+)$/.exec(t);
    if (m) {
      const kind = m[2],
        raft = kind === 'bamboo',
        o = base(kind + (m[1] === 'chest_boat' ? '_chest' : '') + (raft ? '_raft' : '_boat'));
      if (m[1] === 'chest_boat') {
        o.Items = itemList(x.slots);
        if (x.loot && !o.Items.length) o.LootTable = ns(x.loot);
      }
      return o;
    }
    m = /^minecart:(.*)$/.exec(t);
    if (m) {
      const o = base((m[1] ? m[1] + '_' : '') + 'minecart');
      if (m[1] === 'chest' || m[1] === 'hopper') {
        o.Items = itemList(x.slots);
        if (x.loot && !o.Items.length) o.LootTable = ns(x.loot);
      }
      if (m[1] === 'furnace') o.Fuel = NBT.short(x.fuel | 0);
      if (m[1] === 'hopper' && x.enabled !== undefined) o.Enabled = NBT.byte(x.enabled ? 1 : 0);
      return o;
    }
    if (t === 'item_frame' || t === 'glow_item_frame') {
      if (!x.b) return null;
      const o = base(t);
      o.block_pos = Int32Array.of(x.b[0], x.b[1] + minY, x.b[2]);
      o.Facing = NBT.byte(Math.max(0, FACING3.indexOf(x.f)));
      const it = itemNbt(x.it);
      if (it) {
        o.Item = it;
        o.ItemRotation = NBT.byte(x.r | 0);
      }
      return o;
    }
    if (t === 'painting') {
      if (!x.b || !x.v) return null;
      const o = base(t);
      o.block_pos = Int32Array.of(x.b[0], x.b[1] + minY, x.b[2]);
      o.facing = NBT.byte(Math.max(0, FACING2.indexOf(x.f)));
      o.variant = ns(x.v);
      return o;
    }
    if (t === 'armor_stand') {
      const o = base(t),
        g = x.g || [],
        eq = {};
      ['feet', 'legs', 'chest', 'head', 'mainhand', 'offhand'].forEach((k, i) => {
        const it = itemNbt(g[i]);
        if (it) eq[k] = it;
      });
      o.equipment = eq;
      o.Small = NBT.byte(x.s ? 1 : 0);
      o.ShowArms = NBT.byte(x.a ? 1 : 0);
      return o;
    }
    if (!self.VENTITIES.includes(t) || /^(ender_dragon|end_crystal|player)$/.test(t)) return null;
    const o = base(t);
    if (!r.np) o.PersistenceRequired = NBT.byte(1); // (one that may despawn here may there too)
    if (r.health !== undefined) o.Health = NBT.float(r.health);
    if (r.baby) {
      if (/zombie|piglin|zoglin/.test(t)) o.IsBaby = NBT.byte(1);else o.Age = -Math.max(1, r.baby * 4);
    }
    if (t === 'sheep') {
      o.Color = NBT.byte(r.wool | 0);
      o.Sheared = NBT.byte(r.sheared ? 1 : 0);
    }
    if ((t === 'slime' || t === 'magma_cube') && r.size) o.Size = Math.max(0, r.size - 1);
    return o;
  }

  // ---- the player ----
  const xpNeeded = l => l >= 30 ? 112 + (l - 30) * 9 : l >= 15 ? 37 + (l - 15) * 5 : 7 + l * 2;
  function playerNbt(meta) {
    var _d$health, _d$food, _d$sat;
    const d = meta.player;
    if (!d || !d.pos) return null;
    const D = DIMS.find(x => x.dim === (meta.dim || 'overworld')) || DIMS[0];
    const inv = d.inv || [],
      eq = {},
      xp = Math.max(0, d.xp | 0);
    let level = 0,
      t = 0;
    while (t + xpNeeded(level) <= xp) {
      t += xpNeeded(level);
      level++;
    }
    [['head', 36], ['chest', 37], ['legs', 38], ['feet', 39], ['offhand', 40]].forEach(([k, i]) => {
      const it = itemNbt(inv[i]);
      if (it) eq[k] = it;
    });
    return {
      DataVersion: DATA_VERSION,
      Dimension: D.vdim,
      Pos: [d.pos[0], d.pos[1] + D.minY, d.pos[2]].map(NBT.double),
      Motion: [0, 0, 0].map(NBT.double),
      Rotation: [NBT.float(degOf(d.yaw)), NBT.float(-(d.pitch || 0) * 180 / Math.PI)],
      OnGround: NBT.byte(1),
      FallFlying: NBT.byte(0),
      Health: NBT.float(Math.max(1, (_d$health = d.health) !== null && _d$health !== void 0 ? _d$health : 20)),
      foodLevel: (_d$food = d.food) !== null && _d$food !== void 0 ? _d$food : 20,
      foodSaturationLevel: NBT.float((_d$sat = d.sat) !== null && _d$sat !== void 0 ? _d$sat : 5),
      XpLevel: level,
      XpP: NBT.float((xp - t) / xpNeeded(level)),
      XpTotal: xp,
      AbsorptionAmount: NBT.float(d.absorption || 0),
      SelectedItemSlot: d.sel | 0,
      Inventory: itemList(inv.slice(0, 36)),
      equipment: eq,
      active_effects: (d.effects || []).map(([k, amp, dur, amb]) => ({
        id: ns(k),
        amplifier: NBT.byte(amp | 0),
        duration: dur | 0,
        ambient: NBT.byte(amb ? 1 : 0),
        show_particles: NBT.byte(1),
        show_icon: NBT.byte(1)
      }))
    };
  }

  // ---- region files: 1024 chunk slots, each at a 4 KiB sector offset; zlib (type 2) ----
  function regionFile(chunks) {
    let sectors = 2;
    const placed = chunks.map(([lx, lz, data]) => {
      const n = Math.ceil((data.length + 5) / 4096),
        at = sectors;
      sectors += n;
      return [lx, lz, data, at, n];
    });
    const out = new Uint8Array(sectors * 4096),
      dv = new DataView(out.buffer),
      now = Date.now() / 1000 | 0;
    for (const [lx, lz, data, at, n] of placed) {
      const i = (lx & 31) + (lz & 31) * 32;
      dv.setUint32(i * 4, at << 8 | n);
      dv.setUint32(4096 + i * 4, now);
      dv.setUint32(at * 4096, data.length + 1);
      out[at * 4096 + 4] = 2;
      out.set(data, at * 4096 + 5);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---- the whole save ----
  // returns { files: Map(path -> bytes), info, stats }; progress(fraction, text)
  async function build(meta, progress) {
    if (!meta || meta.gen !== 2) throw new Error('只有新版地形的存档能用来开房间');
    if (meta.flat) throw new Error('超平坦世界暂时不能用来开房间');
    await loadStates();
    setWorldFormat(2);
    const stats = {
      chunks: 0,
      entities: 0,
      blockEntities: 0,
      missing: new Map(),
      skipped: 0
    };
    const files = new Map();
    let bytes = 0;
    const add = (path, data) => {
      files.set(path, data);
      bytes += data.length + path.length + 6;
      if (bytes > MAX_BYTES) throw new Error('存档太大了（超过 100 MB），不能用来开房间');
    };
    const pool = new GenPool(meta.seed);
    try {
      await pool.ready;
      // what each dimension holds
      const jobs = [];
      for (const D of DIMS) {
        const sid = D.dim === 'overworld' ? meta.id : meta.id + '~' + D.dim;
        const keys = [...(await DB.chunkKeys(sid))].map(k => [Math.floor(k / 65536) - 32768, k % 65536 - 32768]);
        jobs.push({
          D,
          sid,
          keys
        });
      }
      const total = jobs.reduce((n, j) => n + j.keys.length, 0) || 1;
      let done = 0,
        lastYield = performance.now();
      for (const {
        D,
        sid,
        keys
      } of jobs) {
        const d = meta.dims && meta.dims[D.dim] || {
          blockEntities: {},
          mobs: []
        };
        if (!keys.length && !(d.mobs || []).length) continue;
        // vanilla's biomes of these chunks, from the generator (several workers at once)
        const biomes = new Map();
        await Promise.all(Array.from({
          length: Math.ceil(keys.length / 16)
        }, (_, i) => new Promise(res => {
          const list = keys.slice(i * 16, i * 16 + 16);
          pool.request({
            type: 'biomes',
            list,
            dim: D.dim
          }, m => {
            const n = 16 * m.qy;
            if (m.data) list.forEach(([cx, cz], k) => biomes.set(cx + ',' + cz, m.data.subarray(k * n, k * n + n)));
            res();
          });
        })));
        // decoded chunks: the one being written and its neighbours (fence / stair shapes across a chunk's edge)
        const N = 256 * HEIGHT,
          cache = new Map(),
          saved = new Set(keys.map(([cx, cz]) => cx + ',' + cz));
        const chunk = async (cx, cz) => {
          const k = cx + ',' + cz;
          if (cache.has(k)) return cache.get(k);
          let c = null;
          if (saved.has(k)) {
            const rec = await DB.getChunk(sid, cx, cz);
            if (rec) c = {
              B: rleDecode(rec.b, N),
              M: rleDecode(rec.m, N),
              W: rec.w && rec.w.length ? new Set(rec.w) : null
            };
          }
          cache.set(k, c);
          if (cache.size > 40) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
          return c;
        };
        // by region, then row by row (neighbours stay in the cache)
        const regions = new Map();
        for (const [cx, cz] of keys) {
          const rk = (cx >> 5) + ',' + (cz >> 5);
          (regions.get(rk) || regions.set(rk, []).get(rk)).push([cx, cz]);
        }
        const beByChunk = new Map();
        for (const [k, be] of Object.entries(d.blockEntities || {})) {
          const [x,, z] = k.split(',').map(Number),
            ck = (x >> 4) + ',' + (z >> 4);
          (beByChunk.get(ck) || beByChunk.set(ck, []).get(ck)).push(be);
        }
        const secs = D.height >> 4,
          biomeNames = self.WG_DATA.biome_order;
        for (const [rk, list] of regions) {
          list.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1] || a[0] - b[0]);
          const out = [];
          for (const [cx, cz] of list) {
            const c = await chunk(cx, cz);
            if (!c) {
              stats.skipped++;
              continue;
            }
            for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) if (dx || dz) await chunk(cx + dx, cz + dz);
            const near = (x, z) => cache.get(cx + Math.floor(x / 16) + ',' + (cz + Math.floor(z / 16)));
            const sections = [],
              qb = biomes.get(cx + ',' + cz);
            for (let sy = 0; sy < secs; sy++) {
              const base = sy * 4096,
                stamp = ++secSerial,
                pal = [],
                idx = new Uint16Array(4096),
                own = new Map();
              for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) {
                const ci = base + i,
                  id = c.B[ci],
                  m = c.M[ci];
                let e = entryOf(id, m, stats);
                const wl = !!(c.W && c.W.has(ci));
                if (e.ctx || wl && e.wl) {
                  const lx = i & 15,
                    lz = i >> 4 & 15,
                    ly = ci >> 8;
                  const get = (dx, dy, dz) => {
                    const y = ly + dy,
                      x = lx + dx,
                      z = lz + dz;
                    if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return [0, 0];
                    const h = x >= 0 && x < 16 && z >= 0 && z < 16 ? c : near(x, z);
                    if (!h) return [0, 0];
                    const j = y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15;
                    return [h.B[j], h.M[j]];
                  };
                  const ce = cellEntry(e, m, wl, get);
                  e = own.get(ce.key) || (own.set(ce.key, ce), ce);
                }
                if (e.sec !== stamp) {
                  e.sec = stamp;
                  e.pi = pal.length;
                  pal.push(e.nbt);
                }
                idx[i] = e.pi;
              }
              const block_states = pal.length === 1 ? {
                palette: pal
              } : {
                palette: pal,
                data: pack(idx, 4096, Math.max(4, ceilLog2(pal.length)))
              };
              // 4 x 4 x 4 biomes: the same order as the generator's (y, z, x)
              let biomesNbt = {
                palette: [ns('plains')]
              };
              if (qb) {
                const bp = [],
                  bm = new Map(),
                  bi = new Uint8Array(64);
                for (let j = 0; j < 64; j++) {
                  const v = qb[sy * 64 + j];
                  let k = bm.get(v);
                  if (k === undefined) {
                    k = bp.length;
                    bm.set(v, k);
                    bp.push(ns(biomeNames[v]));
                  }
                  bi[j] = k;
                }
                biomesNbt = bp.length === 1 ? {
                  palette: bp
                } : {
                  palette: bp,
                  data: pack(bi, 64, ceilLog2(bp.length))
                };
              }
              sections.push({
                Y: NBT.byte((D.minY >> 4) + sy),
                block_states,
                biomes: biomesNbt
              });
            }
            const bes = [];
            for (const be of beByChunk.get(cx + ',' + cz) || []) {
              const [x, y, z] = be.pos || [];
              if (y === undefined || y < 0 || y >= D.height) continue;
              const st = stateFor(c.B[y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15], c.M[y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15]);
              let o = null;
              try {
                o = blockEntityNbt(be, st ? st.name : '', x, y + D.minY, z);
              } catch (e) {
                o = null;
              }
              if (o) {
                bes.push(o);
                stats.blockEntities++;
              }
            }
            const nbt = {
              DataVersion: DATA_VERSION,
              xPos: cx,
              yPos: D.minY >> 4,
              zPos: cz,
              Status: 'minecraft:full',
              LastUpdate: 0n,
              InhabitedTime: 0n,
              isLightOn: NBT.byte(0),
              sections,
              block_entities: bes,
              block_ticks: [],
              fluid_ticks: [],
              PostProcessing: [],
              structures: {
                References: {},
                starts: {}
              }
            };
            out.push([cx & 31, cz & 31, await NBT.deflate(NBT.write(nbt), 'deflate')]);
            stats.chunks++;
            done++;
            if (performance.now() - lastYield > 40) {
              lastYield = performance.now();
              progress && progress(done / total, `正在转换区块 ${done} / ${total}`);
              await pause();
            }
          }
          if (out.length) {
            const [rx, rz] = rk.split(',');
            add(`${D.dir}region/r.${rx}.${rz}.mca`, regionFile(out));
          }
        }
        // entities, by chunk
        const ents = new Map();
        for (const r of d.mobs || []) {
          let o = null;
          try {
            o = entityNbt(r, D.minY);
          } catch (e) {
            o = null;
          }
          if (!o) continue;
          const cx = Math.floor(r.pos[0]) >> 4,
            cz = Math.floor(r.pos[2]) >> 4,
            k = cx + ',' + cz;
          (ents.get(k) || ents.set(k, {
            cx,
            cz,
            list: []
          }).get(k)).list.push(o);
          stats.entities++;
        }
        const eRegions = new Map();
        for (const {
          cx,
          cz,
          list
        } of ents.values()) {
          const data = await NBT.deflate(NBT.write({
            DataVersion: DATA_VERSION,
            Position: Int32Array.of(cx, cz),
            Entities: list
          }), 'deflate');
          const rk = (cx >> 5) + ',' + (cz >> 5);
          (eRegions.get(rk) || eRegions.set(rk, []).get(rk)).push([cx & 31, cz & 31, data]);
        }
        for (const [rk, list] of eRegions) {
          const [rx, rz] = rk.split(',');
          add(`${D.dir}entities/r.${rx}.${rz}.mca`, regionFile(list));
        }
      }
    } finally {
      pool.terminate();
    }
    const pl = playerNbt(meta);
    if (pl) add('player.dat', await NBT.deflate(NBT.write(pl), 'gzip'));
    const rules = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(meta.gameRules || {})) if (/^[a-z_]{1,48}$/.test(k) && (typeof v === 'boolean' || Number.isInteger(v))) rules[k] = v;
    const info = {
      name: meta.name,
      seed: String(meta.seed),
      time: Math.max(0, Math.floor(meta.time || 0)) % 24000,
      spawn: meta.spawn ? [Math.floor(meta.spawn[0]), Math.floor(meta.spawn[1]) + DIMS[0].minY, Math.floor(meta.spawn[2])] : null,
      rules
    };
    add('world.json', new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(info)));
    progress && progress(1, '转换完成');
    return {
      files,
      info,
      stats,
      bytes
    };
  }

  // one file: "OMCW", the number of files, then each one's path (u16 length + UTF-8) and data (u32 length + bytes)
  function packFiles(files) {
    const te = new TextEncoder(),
      parts = [];
    let n = 8;
    for (const [p, d] of files) {
      const pb = te.encode(p);
      parts.push([pb, d]);
      n += 6 + pb.length + d.length;
    }
    const out = new Uint8Array(n),
      dv = new DataView(out.buffer);
    out.set(te.encode('OMCW'));
    dv.setUint32(4, parts.length);
    let o = 8;
    for (const [pb, d] of parts) {
      dv.setUint16(o, pb.length);
      out.set(pb, o + 2);
      o += 2 + pb.length;
      dv.setUint32(o, d.length);
      out.set(d, o + 4);
      o += 4 + d.length;
    }
    return out;
  }
  return {
    build,
    packFiles,
    MAX_BYTES,
    stateFor
  };
})();
</script>

const SPLASHES = ['也试试 Java 版！', '100% 纯手工打造！', '方块！', '在浏览器里运行！', '无需安装！', '还有苦力怕！', '挖矿与合成！', 'WebGL2！', '平滑光照！', '流动的水！', '会爆炸的 TNT！', '自带昼夜循环！', '小心岩浆！', '钻石！', '羊毛有很多颜色！'];

// importing a vanilla world (anvil.js): progress, then what came over and what didn't
class ImportScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, files) {
    super(game, '导入原版存档');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.titleY = 20;
    this.p = 0;
    this.stats = null;
    this.result = null;
    this.error = null;
    VanillaImport.run(game, files, (p, s) => {
      this.p = p;
      this.stats = s;
    }).then(r => {
      this.result = r;
      this.layout();
    }, e => {
      console.error(e);
      this.error = String(e && e.message || e);
      this.layout();
    });
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game;
    this.widgets = [];
    if (this.result) {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 154,
        y: u.h - 40,
        w: 150,
        h: 20,
        label: '进入世界',
        onClick: () => g.loadWorld(this.result.meta.id)
      });
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 4,
        y: u.h - 40,
        w: 150,
        h: 20,
        label: '返回',
        onClick: () => g.ui.open(new WorldListScreen(g))
      });
    } else if (this.error) this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 40,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '返回',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new WorldListScreen(g))
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    let y = 44;
    const line = (t, col = '#FFFFFF') => {
      Font.center(c, t, cx, y, col);
      y += 11;
    };
    if (this.error) {
      line('导入失败', '#FF5555');
      y += 4;
      line(this.error, '#FFFFFF');
      return;
    }
    const s = this.result ? this.result.stats : this.stats;
    if (!this.result) {
      line('正在读取区块…');
      const bw = 182,
        bx = Math.floor(cx - bw / 2);
      c.fillStyle = '#808080';
      c.fillRect(bx, y + 2, bw, 3);
      c.fillStyle = '#80FF80';
      c.fillRect(bx, y + 2, Math.floor(bw * this.p), 3);
      y += 12;
      if (s) line(`已导入 ${s.chunks} 个区块，区域文件 ${s.regions} 个`, '#A0A0A0');
      return;
    }
    const m = this.result.meta,
      dn = {
        overworld: '主世界',
        nether: '下界',
        end: '末地'
      };
    line(`“${m.name}” 导入完成`, '#55FF55');
    line(`原版 ${m.imported.version}，种子 ${m.seed}`, '#A0A0A0');
    line('区块：' + Object.entries(s.perDim).map(([d, n]) => `${dn[d] || d} ${n}`).join('，') + `；箱子和熔炉 ${s.containers} 个；生物和载具等 ${s.entities || 0} 个`);
    if (s.entitiesMissing && s.entitiesMissing.length) line('本游戏还没有、没导入的实体：' + s.entitiesMissing.slice(0, 4).map(([n, k]) => `${n} ×${k}`).join('，'), '#A0A0A0');
    if (s.partial || s.old || s.skipped) line(`未完成生成的区块 ${s.partial} 个（进入后由生成器补全）` + (s.old ? `，1.18 以前格式 ${s.old} 个` : '') + (s.skipped ? `，无法读取 ${s.skipped} 个` : ''), '#A0A0A0');
    if (s.substituted && s.substituted.length) {
      line(`本游戏还没有、以相近方块代替的：${s.substituted.length} 种`, '#FFFF55');
      line(s.substituted.slice(0, 5).map(([n, k]) => `${n} ×${k}`).join('，'), '#A0A0A0');
    }
    if (s.missing.length) {
      line(`本游戏还没有、以空气代替的：${s.missing.length} 种`, '#FFFF55');
      line(s.missing.slice(0, 5).map(([n, k]) => `${n} ×${k}`).join('，'), '#A0A0A0');
    }
    y += 4;
    line('没探索过的地方会按同一个种子生成，和原版地形一致', '#A0A0A0');
  }
  onEsc() {
    if (this.result || this.error) this.game.ui.open(new WorldListScreen(this.game));
  }
}
class LoadingScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, text) {
    super(game, null);
    this.text = text;
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDirt = true;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.queue = null;
  }
  // waiting for a room to start on a full server: the place in the queue, a way out, and after two minutes the
  // public rooms and local rooms suggested
  setQueue(q) {
    const was = !!this.queue;
    this.queue = q ? {
      ...q,
      since: this.queue && this.queue.since || performance.now()
    } : null;
    if (was !== !!q) this.layout();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      g = this.game,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets = !this.queue ? [] : [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h / 2 + 60,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '去公开房间（加入正在玩的）',
      onClick: () => {
        g.leaveServer();
        g.ui.open(new MultiplayerScreen(g, null));
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h / 2 + 84,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '取消排队',
      onClick: () => {
        g.leaveServer();
      }
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      g = this.game,
      q = this.queue;
    if (q) {
      Font.center(c, '服务器上的房间已经满了，正在排队', ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 - 30, '#FFFFFF');
      Font.center(c, `你的房间排在第 ${q.pos} 位（一共 ${q.of} 个在等），有位置时会自动启动`, ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 - 14, '#A0A0A0');
      const secs = Math.floor((performance.now() - q.since) / 1000);
      Font.center(c, `已经等了 ${Math.floor(secs / 60)} 分 ${secs % 60} 秒`, ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 + 2, '#A0A0A0');
      if (secs >= 120) Font.center(c, '等太久的话，可以先加入正在玩的公开房间，或者在「联机」里开本地房间', ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 + 30, '#FFFF55');
      return;
    }
    const msg = this.text || '正在生成地形…';
    Font.center(c, msg, ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 - 20, '#FFFFFF');
    const p = g.loadProgress || 0,
      bw = 182,
      bx = Math.floor(ui.w / 2 - bw / 2),
      by = Math.floor(ui.h / 2);
    c.fillStyle = '#808080';
    c.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 3);
    c.fillStyle = '#80FF80';
    c.fillRect(bx, by, Math.floor(bw * p), 3);
    Font.center(c, `区块: ${g.world ? g.world.chunks.size : 0}`, ui.w / 2, by + 10, '#A0A0A0');
  }
}

// vanilla SelectWorldScreen + WorldSelectionList
class WorldListScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, '选择世界');
    this.titleY = 8;
    this.worlds = null;
    this.sel = -1;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.filter = '';
    this.icons = {};
    // (storage that fails - blocked, full, a broken database: said, instead of 加载世界列表中 for ever)
    DB.listWorlds().then(w => {
      this.worlds = w;
      this.layout();
    }).catch(e => {
      console.error(e);
      this.worlds = [];
      this.loadErr = '读取存档失败: ' + String(e && e.message || e);
      this.layout();
    });
  }
  shown() {
    return (this.worlds || []).filter(w => !this.filter || w.name.toLowerCase().includes(this.filter.toLowerCase()));
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game;
    const list = this.shown(),
      has = this.sel >= 0 && !!list[this.sel];
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 154,
      y: u.h - 76,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '导入原版存档（文件夹）',
      onClick: () => this.pick(true),
      tip: ['选择原版 Java 版存档的世界文件夹', '（里面有 level.dat），支持 1.18 及以上']
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y: u.h - 76,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '导入原版存档（.zip）',
      onClick: () => this.pick(false),
      tip: ['选择打包成 .zip 的原版世界存档', '手机上请用这个']
    }, {
      x: cx - 154,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '进入选中的世界',
      enabled: has,
      onClick: () => this.play()
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y: u.h - 52,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '创建新的世界',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new CreateWorldScreen(g, this))
    }, {
      x: cx - 154,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 72,
      h: 20,
      label: '编辑',
      enabled: has,
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new EditWorldScreen(g, this, list[this.sel]))
    }, {
      x: cx - 76,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 72,
      h: 20,
      label: '删除',
      enabled: has,
      onClick: () => this.del()
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 72,
      h: 20,
      label: '重建',
      enabled: has,
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new CreateWorldScreen(g, this, list[this.sel]))
    }, {
      x: cx + 82,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 72,
      h: 20,
      label: '取消',
      onClick: () => this.onEsc()
    }];
    this.listTop = 48;
    this.listBottom = u.h - 88;
    this.rowW = 270;
    this.search = {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 22,
      w: 200,
      h: 20
    };
    u.showInput(this.search.x + 4, this.search.y + 6, this.search.w - 8, 10, this.filter, () => {
      if (this.sel >= 0) this.play();
    }, {
      onInput: v => {
        this.filter = v;
        this.sel = -1;
        this.scroll = 0;
        this.layout();
      },
      onEsc: () => this.onEsc(),
      max: 32
    });
  }
  play() {
    const w = this.shown()[this.sel];
    if (w) {
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      this.game.loadWorld(w.id);
    }
  }
  // the browser's file picker: a world folder, or a .zip of one
  pick(folder) {
    const inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.type = 'file';
    if (folder) {
      inp.webkitdirectory = true;
      inp.multiple = true;
    } else inp.accept = '.zip,application/zip';
    inp.onchange = () => {
      if (inp.files && inp.files.length) {
        this.game.ui.hideInput();
        this.game.ui.open(new ImportScreen(this.game, this, inp.files));
      }
    };
    inp.click();
  }
  del() {
    const w = this.shown()[this.sel];
    if (!w) return;
    const g = this.game;
    g.ui.open(new ConfirmScreen(g, '你确定要删除这个世界吗？', `“${w.name}”将会永久消失！（真的很久！）`, '删除', async yes => {
      if (yes) {
        await DB.deleteWorld(w.id);
        this.worlds = await DB.listWorlds();
        this.sel = -1;
      }
      g.ui.open(this);
    }));
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      top = this.listTop,
      bottom = this.listBottom;
    ui.listBackground(top, bottom);
    ui.nine('text_field_hl', this.search.x, this.search.y, this.search.w, this.search.h, 1);
    if (!ui.input.value && document.activeElement !== ui.input) Font.draw(c, '搜索世界', this.search.x + 4, this.search.y + 6, '#707070');
    if (DB.backend === 'memory') Font.center(c, '注意：当前浏览器禁止本地存储，存档在关闭页面后会丢失', cx, bottom + 2, '#FF5555');
    if (!this.worlds) {
      Font.center(c, '加载世界列表中', cx, top + 20, '#FFFFFF');
      return;
    }
    if (this.loadErr) Font.center(c, fitText(this.loadErr, ui.w - 8), cx, top + 20, '#FF5555');
    const list = this.shown(),
      rowH = 36,
      x0 = Math.floor(cx - this.rowW / 2) + 2;
    const vis = Math.floor((bottom - top - 4) / rowH);
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll, 0, Math.max(0, list.length - vis));
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(0, top, ui.w, bottom - top);
    c.clip();
    list.slice(this.scroll, this.scroll + vis + 1).forEach((w, i) => {
      var _w$cheats;
      const y = top + 4 + i * rowH,
        idx = i + this.scroll;
      if (idx === this.sel) {
        c.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        c.fillRect(x0 - 2, y - 2, this.rowW, 36);
        c.fillStyle = '#000000';
        c.fillRect(x0 - 1, y - 1, this.rowW - 2, 34);
      }
      // world icon: snapshot taken when the world was first played, or vanilla's "unknown" icon
      let icon = this.icons[w.id];
      if (w.icon && !icon) {
        icon = this.icons[w.id] = new Image();
        icon.src = w.icon;
      }
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      c.drawImage(icon && icon.complete && icon.naturalWidth ? icon : ui.img.unknown_server, x0, y, 32, 32);
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      const hov = ui.mouse.y >= Math.max(top, y - 2) && ui.mouse.y < Math.min(bottom, y + 34) && ui.mouse.x >= x0 - 2 && ui.mouse.x < x0 - 2 + this.rowW;
      if (hov) {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(144,144,144,0.627)';
        c.fillRect(x0, y, 32, 32);
        ui.sprite(ui.mouse.x - x0 < 32 ? 'wl_join_hl' : 'wl_join', x0, y);
      }
      Font.draw(c, w.name, x0 + 35, y + 1, '#FFFFFF');
      const d = new Date(w.lastPlayed),
        pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
      Font.draw(c, `${w.id} (${d.getFullYear()}/${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}/${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())})`, x0 + 35, y + 12, '#808080');
      let tx = x0 + 35;
      const part = (t, col) => {
        Font.draw(c, t, tx, y + 21, col);
        tx += Font.width(t);
      };
      if (w.hardcore) part('极限模式', '#FF0000');else part(w.mode === 'creative' ? '创造模式' : w.mode === 'spectator' ? '旁观模式' : '生存模式', '#808080');
      if ((_w$cheats = w.cheats) !== null && _w$cheats !== void 0 ? _w$cheats : true) part(', 命令', '#808080');
      part(', 26.2', '#808080');
    });
    c.restore();
    if (!list.length && this.filter) Font.center(c, '找不到匹配的世界', cx, top + 20, '#AAAAAA');
    if (list.length > vis) {
      const sx = Math.floor(cx + this.rowW / 2 + 4),
        h = bottom - top,
        bh = clamp(Math.floor(h * h / (list.length * rowH + 4)), 32, h - 8);
      const by = top + Math.floor((h - bh) * this.scroll / Math.max(1, list.length - vis));
      ui.nine('wscroller_bg', sx, top, 6, h, 1);
      ui.nine('wscroller', sx, by, 6, bh, 1);
    }
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    const list = this.shown(),
      x0 = Math.floor(ui.w / 2 - this.rowW / 2) + 2;
    if (this.worlds && my >= this.listTop && my < this.listBottom && mx >= x0 - 2 && mx < x0 - 2 + this.rowW) {
      const i = Math.floor((my - this.listTop - 4 + 2) / 36) + this.scroll;
      if (i < list.length && i >= 0) {
        const now = performance.now();
        Sound.init();
        Sound.click();
        if (mx - x0 < 32 || this.sel === i && now - (this.lastT || 0) < 250) {
          this.sel = i;
          this.play();
          return;
        }
        this.sel = i;
        this.lastT = now;
        this.layout();
      }
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    if (this.worlds) this.scroll += Math.sign(dy);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.ui.open(new TitleScreen(this.game));
  }
}

  create() {
    const g = this.game;
    g.ui.hideInput();
    const hc = this.mode === 'hardcore';
    this.error = null;
    // (a world that could not be made - storage refused, the generator threw: this screen again with why, instead of
    // nothing happening or the loading screen for ever)
    g.createWorld(this.name.trim() || '新的世界', this.seed.trim(), hc ? 'survival' : this.mode, this.flat, {
      hardcore: hc,
      difficulty: hc ? 3 : this.difficulty,
      cheats: !hc && this.cheats,
      structures: this.structures,
      bonus: this.bonus
    }).catch(e => {
      console.error(e);
      this.error = '创建世界失败: ' + String(e && e.message || e);
      if (g.state !== 'play' && g.state !== 'loading') g.ui.open(this);
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      t0 = this.tabs[0],
      t2 = this.tabs[2];
    // TabNavigationBar: header background, separator either side of the tabs

    ui.tile(ui.sepName('header'), 0, 22, t0.x, 2);

    this.tabs.forEach((t, i) => {
      const hov = ui.hit(t),
        sel = i === this.tab;
      ui.nine(sel ? hov ? 'tab_sel_hl' : 'tab_sel' : hov ? 'tab_hl' : 'tab', t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h, 2);
      Font.center(c, t.label, t.x + t.w / 2, t.y + (sel ? 8 : 10), sel ? '#FFFFFF' : '#A0A0A0');
      if (sel) {
        const lw = Math.min(Font.width(t.label), t.w - 4);
        c.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        c.fillRect(Math.floor(t.x + (t.w - lw) / 2), t.y + t.h - 2, lw, 1);
      }
    });
    ui.tile(ui.sepName('footer'), 0, ui.h - 35, ui.w, 2);
    if (this.error) Font.center(c, fitText(this.error, ui.w - 8), ui.w / 2, ui.h - 46, '#FF5555');
    if (this.field) {
      Font.draw(c, this.fieldLabel[0], this.field.x, this.fieldLabel[1], '#FFFFFF');
      ui.nine('text_field_hl', this.field.x, this.field.y, this.field.w, this.field.h, 1);
      if (this.tab === 1 && !ui.input.value && document.activeElement !== ui.input) Font.draw(c, '留空以生成随机种子', this.field.x + 4, this.field.y + 6, '#707070');
    }
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.tabs.length; i++) if (ui.hit(this.tabs[i], mx, my)) {
      if (this.tab !== i) {
        this.tab = i;
        this.layout();
        Sound.init();
        Sound.click();
      }
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
}

// vanilla OptionsScreen: header (title + FOV / difficulty), 2-column grid of sub-menus, 完成
class OptionsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '选项');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = game.state === 'play';
    this.titleY = 12;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      s = this.game.settings,
      g = this.game;
    const DIFF = ['和平', '简单', '普通', '困难'];
    const top = 61 + Math.floor((u.h - 33 - 61 - 116) / 2);
    const sub = (i, label, make) => ({
      x: i % 2 ? cx + 5 : cx - 155,
      y: top + Math.floor(i / 2) * 24,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label,
      enabled: !!make,
      tip: make ? null : ['本复刻版暂不支持'],
      onClick: () => make && g.ui.open(make())
    });
    this.widgets = [{
      slider: true,
      x: cx - 155,
      y: 29,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      value: (s.fov - 30) / 80,
      label: () => '视场角：' + (Math.round(s.fov) === 70 ? '中' : Math.round(s.fov) === 110 ? '超广角' : Math.round(s.fov)),
      onChange: v => {
        s.fov = Math.round(30 + v * 80);
        g.applySettings();
        g.saveSettings();
      }
    }, g.state === 'play' ? {
      x: cx + 5,
      y: 29,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '难度：' + (g.hardcore ? '极限' : DIFF[g.difficulty]),
      enabled: !g.hardcore,
      onClick: () => {
        g.difficulty = (g.difficulty + 1) % 4;
      }
    } : {
      x: cx + 5,
      y: 29,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '联机…',
      enabled: false
    }, sub(0, '皮肤自定义…', null), sub(1, '声音…', () => new OptionsListScreen(g, this, '声音选项', 'sound')), sub(2, '视频设置…', () => new OptionsListScreen(g, this, '视频设置', 'video')), sub(3, '控制…', () => new OptionsListScreen(g, this, '按键控制', 'controls')), sub(4, '语言…', null), sub(5, '聊天设置…', null), sub(6, '资源包…', null), sub(7, '辅助功能设置…', () => new OptionsListScreen(g, this, '辅助功能设置', 'access')), sub(8, '遥测数据…', () => new TelemetryScreen(g, this)), sub(9, '制作人员名单与致谢…', () => creditsRoll(g, this)), {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 27,
      w: 200,
