      onClick: () => this.done()
    }];
  }
  done() {
    this.game.saveSettings();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.done();
  }

// 选项 → 制作人员名单与致谢: the credits roll (dims.js CreditsScreen) - the button opened 游戏说明 (players' feedback
// 11-01 to 11-03, 4+). As vanilla's from the options: without the End poem; and a click or a tap goes back (a phone has
// no Esc, and the whole roll takes minutes)
function creditsRoll(g, parent) {
  const sc = new CreditsScreen(g, () => g.ui.open(parent)),
    L = sc.lines,
    i = L.findIndex(l => l.t === '============');
  if (i > 9) sc.lines = [...L.slice(0, 9), ...L.slice(i - 1)]; // (the blank lines and the logo, then the credits)
  sc.pauses = g.state === 'play';
  sc.onEsc = () => sc.finish();
  sc.mouseDown = () => sc.finish();
  return sc;
}

// vanilla OptionsSubScreen: header title, OptionsList (rows of two 150-wide buttons, 25 tall) on the list background, 完成
class OptionsListScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, title, page) {
    super(game, title);
    this.parent = parent;
    this.page = page;
    this.pauses = game.state === 'play';
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.scroll = 0;
  }
  options() {
    var _s$fovEffects3;
    const s = this.game.settings,
      g = this.game;
    const sl = (label, val, set, wide) => ({
      slider: true,
      wide,
      value: val,
      label,
      onChange: v => {
        set(v);
        g.applySettings();
        g.saveSettings();
      }
    });
    const bt = (label, fn, extra) => ({
      label,
      onClick: () => {
        fn();
        g.applySettings();
        g.saveSettings();
      },
      ...extra
    });
    const onoff = v => v ? '开' : '关';
    // vanilla accessibility: how much flying, sprinting and drawing a bow change the field of view
    if (this.page === 'access') return [sl(() => {
      var _s$fovEffects, _s$fovEffects2;
      return '视场角效果：' + (((_s$fovEffects = s.fovEffects) !== null && _s$fovEffects !== void 0 ? _s$fovEffects : 1) > 0 ? Math.round(((_s$fovEffects2 = s.fovEffects) !== null && _s$fovEffects2 !== void 0 ? _s$fovEffects2 : 1) * 100) + '%' : '关');
    }, (_s$fovEffects3 = s.fovEffects) !== null && _s$fovEffects3 !== void 0 ? _s$fovEffects3 : 1, v => s.fovEffects = Math.round(v * 20) / 20, true)];
    if (this.page === 'sound') return [sl(() => '主音量：' + (s.volume > 0 ? Math.round(s.volume * 100) + '%' : '关'), s.volume, v => s.volume = v, true), bt(() => '显示字幕：' + onoff(!!s.subtitles), () => s.subtitles = !s.subtitles, {
      tip: ['在屏幕右下角用文字列出听到的声音和方向']
    })];
    // changing one of the options a preset sets makes the preset "custom"
    const own = fn => v => {
      s.preset = 'custom';
      fn(v);
    };
    // (maxFps 0 is 60 on a 90/120 Hz phone or tablet, -1 the display's own rate there - perf.js FramePacer.playLimit)
    const fpsLabel = () => '最大帧率：' + (s.maxFps > 0 ? s.maxFps + ' fps' : s.maxFps !== -1 && this.game.pacer && this.game.pacer.auto60 ? '自动（60 fps）' : '无限制');
    return [bt(() => '画质预设：' + (PRESET_NAMES[s.preset] || '自定义') + (s.preset === 'auto' && s.autoPreset ? '（' + PRESET_NAMES[s.autoPreset] + '）' : ''), () => {
      const order = ['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'ultra'];
      applyPreset(g, order[(order.indexOf(s.preset) + 1) % order.length]);
    }, {
      tip: ['自动：按设备性能选择（' + TouchDevice.name + '）', '低 / 中 / 高 / 极高：渲染距离、分辨率、云、图形品质']
    }), bt(() => '图形品质：' + (s.graphics === 'fast' ? '流畅' : '高品质'), own(() => {
      s.graphics = s.graphics === 'fast' ? 'fancy' : 'fast';
      g.graphicsChanged();
    }), {
      tip: ['流畅：树叶不透明，相邻树叶之间的面不绘制', '省显存和显卡，森林里更流畅']
    }), bt(() => '光影：' + FX_NAMES[s.shaders || 0] + (g.renderer.fx && !g.renderer.fx.ok ? '（不支持）' : ''), () => {
      if (g.renderer.fx && g.renderer.fx.ok) s.shaders = ((s.shaders || 0) + 1) % FX_NAMES.length;
    }, {
      tip: ['关 / 低 / 中 / 高 / 极限：实时阴影、水面反射、体积光等']
    }), bt(() => '渲染分辨率：' + Math.round(s.resScale * 100) + '%', own(() => {
      s.resScale = s.resScale >= 1 ? 0.5 : s.resScale + 0.25;
    })), sl(() => '渲染距离：' + s.renderDist + '个区块', (s.renderDist - 2) / 14, own(v => s.renderDist = Math.round(2 + v * 14)), true),
    // vanilla: 10 - 260 in steps of 10, the top end is "unlimited"
    sl(fpsLabel, s.maxFps > 0 ? (s.maxFps - 10) / 250 : 1, v => {
      const f = Math.round(v * 25) * 10 + 10;
      s.maxFps = f >= 260 ? s.maxFps === -1 ? -1 : 0 : f;
    }), bt(() => '垂直同步：' + onoff(s.vsync !== false), () => s.vsync = s.vsync === false, {
      tip: ['开：帧与显示器刷新同步，不撕裂', '关：帧率可超过刷新率（浏览器需带 --disable-gpu-vsync 启动才能显示出来）']
    }), bt(() => '动态分辨率：' + onoff(s.dynRes), own(() => s.dynRes = !s.dynRes), {
      tip: ['显卡跟不上时自动降低渲染分辨率（最低 50%），恢复后再调回']
    }), bt(() => '云：' + (s.clouds ? '高品质' : '关'), own(() => s.clouds = !s.clouds)), sl(() => '亮度：' + (s.gamma < 0.01 ? '昏暗' : s.gamma > 0.99 ? '明亮' : Math.round(s.gamma * 100) + '%'), s.gamma, v => s.gamma = v), bt(() => '界面尺寸：' + (s.guiScale || '自动'), () => {
      s.guiScale = (s.guiScale + 1) % 5;
      setTimeout(() => g.ui.resize(), 0);
    }), fsSupported() ? bt(() => '全屏：' + onoff(!!fsElement()), () => toggleFullscreen()) : bt('全屏：不支持', () => {}, {
      enabled: false,
      tip: ['这个浏览器不支持网页全屏']
    }), bt(() => '视角摇晃：' + onoff(s.bobbing), () => s.bobbing = !s.bobbing), bt('平滑光照：开', () => {}, {
      enabled: false
    }), bt('复制性能报告', () => copyText(PerfMon.report(g, null, 0)).then(ok => g.ui.message(ok ? '性能报告已复制到剪贴板' : '无法写入剪贴板，报告已输出到浏览器控制台', '#FFFF55')), {
      tip: ['复制最近 240 帧的帧时间、内存和设备信息', '游戏中按 F3 + L 记录 10 秒的完整报告']
    })];
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.top = 33;
    this.bottom = u.h - 33;
    const rows = [],
      opts = this.options();
    for (let i = 0; i < opts.length;) {
      const o = opts[i];
      if (o.wide) {
        rows.push([Object.assign(o, {
          x: cx - 155,
          w: 310
        })]);
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      const r = [Object.assign(o, {
        x: cx - 155,
        w: 150
      })];
      if (opts[i + 1] && !opts[i + 1].wide) r.push(Object.assign(opts[i + 1], {
        x: cx + 5,
        w: 150
      }));
      rows.push(r);
      i += r.length;
    }
    this.rows = rows;
    this.doneBtn = {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 27,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    };
    this.place();
  }
  place() {
    const list = [];
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, this.rows.length * 25 + 4 - (this.bottom - this.top));
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll, 0, maxScroll);
    this.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      const y = this.top + 4 - this.scroll + i * 25 + 2;
      for (const w of r) {
        w.y = y;
        w.h = 20;
        if (y >= this.top && y + 20 <= this.bottom) list.push(w);
      }
    });
    this.widgets = [...list, this.doneBtn];
  }
  back() {
    this.game.saveSettings();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    ui.listBackground(this.top, this.bottom);
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    this.scroll += Math.sign(dy) * 25;
    this.place();
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
}

// vanilla PauseScreen grid (rows of 204 / 98+98, padding-top 50, aligned at 1/4 of the screen)
class PauseScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, '游戏菜单');
    this.pauses = true;
    this.titleY = 40;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game,
      y = Math.floor((u.h - 166) / 4) + 50;
    // in a room the right of the fourth row is 房间…; the game mode (owner, members, administrators) gets a row of its
    // own under it - both sat on the same place and the mode button, first in the list, took every click (10-31)
    const room = !!(g.net && g.net.room),
      roomMode = room && (g.net.opLevel | 0) >= 2;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 102,
      y,
      w: Companion.shown ? 150 : 204,
      h: 20,
      label: '回到游戏',
      onClick: () => g.ui.close()
    },
    // (the AI companion, companion.js - only where the service has it on)
    !Companion.shown ? null : {
      x: cx + 52,
      y,
      w: 50,
      h: 20,
      label: () => fitText(Companion.name, 44),
      tip: ['AI 伙伴的设置（和它聊天按 V）'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new CompanionScreen(g, this))
    }, {
      x: cx - 102,
      y: y + 24,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '进度',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new AdvancementsScreen(g, this))
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y: y + 24,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '统计信息',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new StatsScreen(g, this))
    }, {
      x: cx - 102,
      y: y + 48,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '游戏说明',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new HelpScreen(g, this))
    }, {
      x: cx + 4,
      y: y + 48,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '反馈问题',
      tip: ['遇到 bug、卡顿，或者有建议，发给我们（会附上现在的画面）'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new FeedbackScreen(g, this, feedbackShot(g)))
    }, room && !roomMode ? null : {
      x: roomMode ? cx - 102 : cx + 4,
      y: roomMode ? y + 96 : y + 72,
      w: roomMode ? 204 : 98,
      h: 20,
      label: () => '模式：' + MODE_NAMES[g.mode],
      enabled: !!g.cheats || !!g.net,
      tip: g.cheats || g.net ? ['生存 → 创造 → 旁观（也可按 F3 + F4）'] : ['需要开启“允许命令”'],
      onClick: () => g.requestMode(MODE_NEXT[g.mode])
    }, {
      x: cx - 102,
      y: y + 72,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '选项…',
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new OptionsScreen(g, this))
    }, g.net && g.net.room ? {
      x: cx + 4,
      y: y + 72,
      w: 98,
      h: 20,
      label: '房间…',
      tip: ['邀请朋友、看在场的玩家；房主可以踢人、封禁、禁言'],
      onClick: () => g.ui.open(new RoomScreen(g, this))
    } : null, {
      x: cx - 102,
      y: y + (roomMode ? 120 : 96),
      w: 204,
      h: 20,
      label: '保存并退回到标题屏幕',
      onClick: () => g.quitToTitle()
    }].filter(Boolean);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.close();
  }
}
const MODE_NAMES = {
  survival: '生存',
  creative: '创造',
  spectator: '旁观'
};
const MODE_NEXT = {
  survival: 'creative',
  creative: 'spectator',
  spectator: 'survival'
};
class AdvancementsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '进度');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = true;
    this.bgDim = 0.75;
    this.titleY = 16;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: u.w / 2 - 100,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      keys = Object.keys(ADVANCEMENTS);
    const done = keys.filter(k => this.game.adv[k]).length;
    Font.center(c, `已完成 ${done} / ${keys.length}`, ui.w / 2, 28, '#AAAAAA');
    // (scrolled by the wheel, or a finger through it: on a tablet the list ran off the bottom - feedback 11-01)
    const cols = 2,
      cw = 150,
      x0 = ui.w / 2 - cw,
      top = 40,
      bot = ui.h - 32,
      rows = Math.ceil(keys.length / cols);
    this.maxScroll = Math.max(0, rows * 20 + 4 - (bot - top));
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll || 0, 0, this.maxScroll);
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(0, top, ui.w, bot - top);
    c.clip();
    keys.forEach((k, i) => {
      const x = x0 + i % cols * cw,
        y = top + 2 + Math.floor(i / cols) * 20 - this.scroll;
      if (y > bot || y + 18 < top) return;
      const got = !!this.game.adv[k];
      c.fillStyle = got ? 'rgba(40,120,40,0.6)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
      c.fillRect(x + 2, y, cw - 4, 18);
      ui.drawItem({
        id: item(ADVANCEMENTS[k][1]),
        count: 1
      }, x + 4, y + 1);
      Font.draw(c, ADVANCEMENTS[k][0], x + 24, y + 5, got ? '#FFFF55' : '#808080');
    });
    c.restore();
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    this.scroll = clamp((this.scroll || 0) + Math.sign(dy) * 20, 0, this.maxScroll || 0);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
class StatsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '统计信息');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = true;
    this.bgDim = 0.75;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: u.w / 2 - 100,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const g = this.game,
      s = g.stats,
      c = ui.ctx;
    const lines = [['游戏天数', Math.floor(g.worldTime / 24000) + 1], ['放置的方块', s.placed], ['挖掘的方块', s.mined], ['击杀的生物', s.kills], ['经验等级', g.xpLevel()], ['世界种子', g.world.seed]];
    lines.forEach(([a, b], i) => {
      Font.draw(c, a, ui.w / 2 - 100, 50 + i * 14, '#FFFFFF');
      const t = String(b);
      Font.draw(c, t, ui.w / 2 + 100 - Font.width(t), 50 + i * 14, '#FFFF55');
    });
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}
class DeathScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, null);
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.t = performance.now();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      y = Math.floor(u.h / 4 + 72),
      g = this.game;
    // (hardcore: saved dead, as vanilla leaves - back in, the death screen again, then only to watch. It respawned the
    // player first, and the world opened again with a live survival player: "极限模式死后点标题屏幕能复活")
    const toTitle = () => {
      if (g.hardcore && !g.net && !g.p2pGuest) {
        g.quitToTitle();
        return;
      }
      g.player.health = 20;
      g.player.deathTime = 0;
      g.respawn();
      g.quitToTitle();
    };
    this.widgets = g.hardcore ? [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '旁观世界',
      onClick: () => {
        g.respawn();
        g.setMode('spectator', true);
      }
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: y + 24,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '标题屏幕',
      onClick: toTitle
    }] : [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '重生',
      onClick: () => g.respawn()
    }, {
      x: cx - 100,
      y: y + 24,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '标题屏幕',
      onClick: toTitle
    }];
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx;
    // vanilla DeathScreen: fillGradient(0x60500000 -> 0xA0803030)
    const gr = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, ui.h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(80,0,0,0.376)');
    gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(128,48,48,0.627)');
    c.fillStyle = gr;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, ui.h);
    c.save();
    c.scale(2, 2);
    Font.center(c, this.game.hardcore ? '游戏结束！' : '你死了！', ui.w / 4, 30, '#FFFFFF');
    c.restore();
    Font.center(c, this.game.deathMsg || '', ui.w / 2, 85, '#FFFFFF');
    const sc = '分数：',
      sv = String(this.game.deathScore || 0),
      sx = ui.w / 2 - Font.width(sc + sv) / 2;
    Font.draw(c, sc, sx, 100, '#FFFFFF');
    Font.draw(c, sv, sx + Font.width(sc), 100, '#FFFF55');
    const ok = performance.now() - this.t > 1000;
    for (const w of this.widgets) {
      w.enabled = ok;
      ui.button(w);
    }
  }
}
class HelpScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '游戏说明');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = true;
    this.bgDim = 0.8;
    this.bgDirt = parent instanceof TitleScreen;
    this.page = 0;
    this.titleY = 10;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 154,
      y: u.h - 26,
      w: 74,
      h: 20,
      label: '< 上一页',
      onClick: () => this.page = Math.max(0, this.page - 1)
    }, {
      x: cx - 76,
      y: u.h - 26,
      w: 152,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.game.ui.open(this.parent)
    }, {
      x: cx + 80,
      y: u.h - 26,
      w: 74,
      h: 20,
      label: '下一页 >',
      onClick: () => this.page = Math.min(HELP_PAGES.length - 1, this.page + 1)
    }];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      pg = HELP_PAGES[this.page];
    Font.center(c, `${pg.title}  (${this.page + 1}/${HELP_PAGES.length})`, ui.w / 2, 24, '#FFFF55');
    let y = 40;
    for (const line of pg.lines) {
      if (y > ui.h - 40) break;
      const [k, v] = line.split('|');
      if (v !== undefined) {
        Font.draw(c, k, ui.w / 2 - 150, y, '#FFFFA0');
        Font.draw(c, v, ui.w / 2 - 60, y, '#FFFFFF');
      } else Font.draw(c, k, ui.w / 2 - 150, y, '#E0E0E0');
      y += 11;
    }
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
}

class ChatScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, prefill = '') {
    super(game, null);
    this.blurBg = false;
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.isChat = true;
    this.prefill = prefill;
    this.hist = game.chatHistory || (game.chatHistory = []);
    this.hi = this.hist.length;
    game.ui.chatOff = 0;
  }
  // the wheel (or a finger dragged) goes back through the last 100 messages, 7 lines a notch, 1 with shift - like
  // vanilla's ChatScreen.mouseScrolled; there was no scrolling at all (players' feedback 2026-10-31)
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    ui.chatOff = clamp((ui.chatOff || 0) - Math.sign(dy) * (ui.wheelShift ? 1 : 7), 0, Math.max(0, ui.chatRowCount() - 20));
    ui.wheelShift = false;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      send = v => {
        u.close();
        if (v.trim()) {
          this.hist.push(v);
          runCommand(this.game, v.trim());
        }
      };
    // (on a touch screen a 发送 button at the end of the line, and the keyboard's return key reads 发送: iOS players
    // found no way to send - feedback 2026-11-01 12:58)
    const tb = navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0 || typeof touchOn === 'function' && touchOn(this.game),
      bw = tb ? 34 : 0;
    this.widgets = tb ? [{
      x: u.w - 2 - bw,
      y: u.h - 15,
      w: bw,
      h: 14,
      label: '发送',
      onClick: () => send(u.input.value)
    }] : [];
    // (laid out again - the window resized, as Android's on-screen keyboard coming up does - the text typed so far
    // stays: it went back to the prefill, "安卓打字时聊天框文字被清空", feedback 2026-11-01 09:15)
    const v = this.shownOnce && u.input.style.display === 'block' ? u.input.value : this.prefill;
    this.shownOnce = true;
    u.showInput(2, u.h - 14, u.w - 4 - (bw ? bw + 2 : 0), 12, v, send, {
      onEsc: () => u.close(),
      max: 256,
      enter: 'send'
    });
    const el = u.input,
      prev = el.onkeydown;
    el.onkeydown = e => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && this.hi > 0) {
        this.hi--;
        el.value = this.hist[this.hi];
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        this.hi = Math.min(this.hist.length, this.hi + 1);
        el.value = this.hist[this.hi] || '';
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.complete(el);
      }
      prev(e);
    };
  }
  complete(el) {
    const v = el.value,
      parts = v.split(' ');
    if (parts[0] === '/give' && parts.length === 2) {
      const m = Object.keys(ITEM_KEY).filter(k => k.startsWith(parts[1]));
      if (m.length) el.value = '/give ' + m[0];
    } else if (parts[0] === '/summon' && parts.length === 2) {
      const m = Object.keys(MOB_TYPES).filter(k => k.startsWith(parts[1]));
      if (m.length) el.value = '/summon ' + m[0];
    } else if (parts.length === 1) {
      const m = ['/gamemode', '/time', '/weather', '/give', '/tp', '/summon', '/kill', '/locate', '/tpdim', '/spawnpoint', '/seed', '/clear', '/xp', '/help'].filter(k => k.startsWith(v));
      if (m.length) el.value = m[0] + ' ';
    }
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      b = this.widgets[0];
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    c.fillRect(2, ui.h - 14, ui.w - 4 - (b ? b.w + 2 : 0), 12);
    if (b) ui.button(b);
  }
}

// leaving a world for the title (single player, a room on the server, a local room) takes its chat along, like vanilla's
// disconnect (the lines typed stay for ↑): a room's messages were still there in the single-player world entered next
// (players' feedback 2026-11-01 10:09)
(() => {
  const st = Game.prototype.startTitle;
  Game.prototype.startTitle = function (...a) {
    if (this.ui) {
      this.ui.chat.length = 0;
      this.ui.chatOff = 0;
    }
    return st.apply(this, a);
  };
})();

// a command as typed, made what a server accepts: runs of spaces outside quotes one space, none at the ends (a taken
// suggestion leaves a space after it; the server's parser refuses "/gamemode creative " and double spaces - the
// command just failed: players' feedback 2026-11-01). Chat stays as typed
function cmdTidy(text) {
  if (!text.startsWith('/')) return text;
  let out = '',
    q = null;
  for (const ch of text.trim()) {
    if (q) {
      out += ch;
      if (ch === q) q = null;
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") {
      q = ch;
      out += ch;
      continue;
    }
    if (/\s/.test(ch)) {
      if (!out.endsWith(' ')) out += ' ';
      continue;
    }
    out += ch;
  }
  return out.trim();
}
function runCommand(g, text) {
  text = cmdTidy(text);
  if (g.net) {
    g.net.chat(text);
    return;
  } // on a server: chat and commands are the server's
  const p = g.player,
    ui = g.ui;
  if (!text.startsWith('/')) {
    ui.message('<玩家> ' + text);
    return;
  }
  // (vanilla's syntax and most commands: cmdrun.js; /locate and /tpdim still here)
  if (typeof cmdExec === 'function' && !/^\/(locate|tpdim|dimension)\b/.test(text)) {
    cmdExec(g, text);
    return;
  }
  const [cmd, ...a] = text.slice(1).split(/\s+/);
  const err = m => ui.message(m, '#FF5555');
  if (!g.cheats && !['help', 'seed', 'me', 'msg', 'tell', 'w', 'list', 'trigger'].includes(cmd)) return err('未知或不完整的命令，错误见下\n…/' + cmd + '<--[此处]');
  try {
    switch (cmd) {
      case 'help':
        ui.message('可用命令: /gamemode /time /weather /give /tp /summon /kill [@e[type=…]] /locate /tpdim /spawnpoint /seed /clear /xp', '#FFFF55');
        break;
      case 'gamemode':
      case 'gm':
        {
          const m = {
            creative: 'creative',
            c: 'creative',
            1: 'creative',
            survival: 'survival',
            s: 'survival',
            0: 'survival',
            spectator: 'spectator',
            sp: 'spectator',
            3: 'spectator'
          }[a[0]];
          if (!m) return err('用法: /gamemode creative|survival|spectator');
          g.setMode(m);
          break;
        }
      case 'time':
        {
          if (a[0] === 'set' || a[0] === 'add') {
            var _named$a$;
            const named = {
              day: 1000,
              noon: 6000,
              night: 13000,
              midnight: 18000,
              sunrise: 23000,
              sunset: 12000
            };
            let v = (_named$a$ = named[a[1]]) !== null && _named$a$ !== void 0 ? _named$a$ : parseInt(a[1]);
            if (isNaN(v)) return err('用法: /time set day|night|noon|midnight|<数值>');
            if (a[0] === 'set') g.worldTime = Math.floor(g.worldTime / 24000) * 24000 + v;else g.worldTime += v;
            ui.message('时间已设置为 ' + v, '#AAAAAA');
          } else ui.message('当前时间: ' + g.dayTime(), '#AAAAAA');
          break;
        }
      case 'weather':
        {
          if (a[0] === 'clear') {
            g.rainTarget = 0;
            g.weather = 0;
            g.weatherTimer = 24000;
          } else if (a[0] === 'rain' || a[0] === 'thunder') {
            g.rainTarget = 1;
            g.weather = 1;
            g.weatherTimer = 12000;
          } else return err('用法: /weather clear|rain');
          ui.message('天气已更改', '#AAAAAA');
          break;
        }
      case 'give':
        {
          const key = (a[0] || '').replace('minecraft:', '');
          const id = ITEM_KEY[key];
          if (id === undefined) return err('未知物品: ' + key);
          const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(64 * 36, parseInt(a[1]) || 1));
          let left = n;
          while (left > 0) {
            const k = Math.min(left, maxStack(id));
            const r = p.inv.add({
              id,
              count: k,
              dmg: 0
            });
            if (r) {
              g.dropFromPlayer({
                id,
                count: r,
                dmg: 0
              });
            }
            left -= k;
          }
          ui.message(`已将 ${n} 个 [${ITEMS[id].cn}] 给予玩家`, '#AAAAAA');
          break;
        }
      case 'tp':
        {
          const v = a.map((s, i) => s.startsWith('~') ? p.pos[i] + (parseFloat(s.slice(1)) || 0) : parseFloat(s) - (i === 1 ? g.world.minY || 0 : 0));
          if (v.length < 3 || v.some(isNaN)) return err('用法: /tp <x> <y> <z>');
          p.pos = [v[0], v[1], v[2]];
          p.prev = [...p.pos];
          p.vel = [0, 0, 0];
          p.fallDist = 0;
          ui.message(`已传送至 ${v.map((x, i) => (x + (i === 1 ? g.world.minY || 0 : 0)).toFixed(1)).join(', ')}`, '#AAAAAA');
          break;
        }
      case 'summon':
        {
          const t = (a[0] || '').replace('minecraft:', '');
          if (t === 'tnt') {
            g.addEntity(new PrimedTNT(g, Math.floor(p.pos[0]), p.pos[1], Math.floor(p.pos[2])));
            break;
          }
          if (!MOB_TYPES[t] && t !== 'ender_dragon') return err('未知生物: ' + t + '（可用: ' + Object.keys(MOB_TYPES).join(' ') + ' ender_dragon）');
          const d = g.lookDir();
          if (t === 'ender_dragon') {
            g.addEntity(new EnderDragon(g, p.pos[0] + d[0] * 20, p.pos[1] + 15, p.pos[2] + d[2] * 20));
            ui.message('已生成 末影龙', '#AAAAAA');
            break;
          }
          const m = createMob(g, t, p.pos[0] + d[0] * 3, p.pos[1] + 0.5, p.pos[2] + d[2] * 3);
          m.persistent = true;
          g.addEntity(m);
          ui.message('已生成 ' + MOB_TYPES[t].cn, '#AAAAAA');
          break;
        }
      case 'kill':
        {
          const sel = a.join('').replace(/\s/g, '');
          if (sel.startsWith('@e')) {
            const m = sel.match(/type=(?:minecraft:)?([a-z_]+)/);
            let n = 0;
            for (const e of g.entities) {
              if (e.dead || m && e.type !== m[1]) continue;
              if (!m && !(e instanceof Living) && !(e instanceof ItemEntity) && !e.hittable) continue;
              if (e instanceof EnderDragon) {
                if (e.deathTime === 0) {
                  e.health = 0;
                  e.deathTime = 1;
                  Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.death', e.pos, 10, 1);
                  n++;
                }
                continue;
              }
              if (e instanceof EndCrystal) {
                e.dead = true;
                n++;
                continue;
              }
              if (e instanceof Living) {
                if (e.deathTime === 0) {
                  e.health = 0;
                  e.die({
                    type: 'void'
                  });
                  n++;
                }
              } else {
                e.dead = true;
                n++;
              }
            }
            ui.message(n ? `已清除 ${n} 个实体` : '没有找到匹配的实体', n ? '#AAAAAA' : '#FF5555');
            break;
          }
          if (g.mode === 'creative') {
            p.health = 0;
            p.die({
              type: 'void'
            });
          } else p.hurt(1000, {
            type: 'void'
          });
          break;
        }
      case 'locate':
        {
          const what = (a[0] === 'structure' ? a[1] : a[0]) || '';
          if (what.includes('stronghold')) {
            const s = g.nearestStronghold();
            if (!s) return err('该维度没有要塞');
            ui.message(`最近的要塞位于 [${s.x}, ~, ${s.z}]（距离 ${Math.round(Math.hypot(s.x - p.pos[0], s.z - p.pos[2]))} 格）`, '#55FF55');
          } else if (what.includes('fortress') && !g.world.gen2) {
            if (g.dim !== 'nether') return err('下界要塞只存在于下界');
            const f = g.world.nearestFortress(p.pos[0], p.pos[2]);
            if (!f) return err('附近没有下界要塞');
            ui.message(`最近的下界要塞位于 [${f.x}, ${f.y}, ${f.z}]（距离 ${Math.round(Math.hypot(f.x - p.pos[0], f.z - p.pos[2]))} 格）`, '#55FF55');
          } else if (what && g.world.gen2 && g.genPool) {
            // vanilla structures (village, bastion_remnant, pillager_outpost, ancient_city, trail_ruins, trial_chambers, ...)
            const name = what.replace('minecraft:', '');
            ui.message('正在查找 ' + name + ' ...', '#AAAAAA');
            g.genPool.request({
              type: 'locate',
              name,
              cx: Math.floor(p.pos[0]) >> 4,
              cz: Math.floor(p.pos[2]) >> 4,
              dim: g.dim
            }, m => {
              if (!m.r) {
                ui.message('附近找不到 ' + name, '#FF5555');
                return;
              }
              g.lastLocate = m.r;
              ui.message(`最近的 ${m.r.name} 位于 [${m.r.x}, ~, ${m.r.z}]（距离 ${Math.round(m.r.d)} 格）`, '#55FF55');
            });
          } else return err('用法: /locate stronghold|fortress|village|bastion_remnant|...');
          break;
        }
      case 'tpdim':
      case 'dimension':
        {
          const d = {
            overworld: 'overworld',
            nether: 'nether',
            the_nether: 'nether',
            end: 'end',
            the_end: 'end'
          }[(a[0] || '').replace('minecraft:', '')];
          if (!d) return err('用法: /tpdim overworld|nether|end');
          if (d === g.dim) return err('你已经在这个维度了');
          if (d === 'end') {
            g.enterEndPortal();
            break;
          }
          if (d === 'nether' || g.dim === 'nether') {
            g.useNetherPortal();
            break;
          }
          g.leaveEnd();
          break;
        }
      case 'spawnpoint':
        p.spawn = [Math.floor(p.pos[0]), Math.floor(p.pos[1]), Math.floor(p.pos[2])];
        p.bedSpawn = false;
        ui.message('已设置重生点', '#AAAAAA');
        break;
      case 'seed':
        ui.message('种子: [' + (g.worldMeta ? g.worldMeta.seed : g.world.seed) + ']', '#FFFFFF');
        break;
      case 'clear':
        p.inv.slots.fill(null);
        ui.message('已清空物品栏', '#AAAAAA');
        break;
      case 'xp':
        g.addXp(parseInt(a[0]) || 0);
        break;
      default:
        err('未知命令。输入 /help 查看帮助');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    err('命令出错: ' + e.message);
  }
}
Game.prototype.setMode = function (m, quiet) {
  const p = this.player,
    prev = this.mode;
  if (m !== prev) this.prevMode = prev;
  this.mode = m;
  // (into spectator: the fall speed of standing on the ground, -0.08, is dropped - it carried the player, now passing
  // through blocks, about 0.07 into the ground, and back in survival or creative the ground they were in no longer
  // held them: they fell into it and choked - "旁观/创造切回生存卡进地里", feedback 11-01 to 11-11)
  if (m === 'spectator') {
    p.flying = true;
    p.noClip = true;
    if (prev !== 'spectator') p.vel[1] = 0;
  } else {
    // out of spectator a little way into the top of a block (less than half a block): stood on it
    if (prev === 'spectator' && p.noClip) {
      const bb = p.box(),
        bs = blockBoxes(this.world, bb[0], bb[1], bb[2], bb[3], bb[4], bb[5], [], p);
      let top = bb[1];
      for (const b of bs) if (bb[0] < b[3] && bb[3] > b[0] && bb[1] < b[4] && bb[4] > b[1] && bb[2] < b[5] && bb[5] > b[2]) top = Math.max(top, b[4]);
      if (top > bb[1] && top - bb[1] < 0.5) {
        const y0 = p.pos[1];
        p.pos[1] = top;
        if (p.collides(p.box())) p.pos[1] = y0;else {
          p.prev[1] = top;
          p.vel[1] = 0;
          p.fallDist = 0;
        }
      }
    }
    p.noClip = false;
    if (m === 'survival') p.flying = false;
    if (prev === 'spectator' && m === 'creative') p.flying = true;
  }
  if (!quiet) this.ui.message('已将自己的游戏模式设置为' + {
    survival: '生存模式',
    creative: '创造模式',
    spectator: '旁观模式'
  }[m], '#AAAAAA');
};

// 「退出游戏」: most places do not let a page close itself (a tab the player opened, the Bilibili app, the Toy page's
// frame) - window.close() did nothing there and the button seemed dead (Android feedback 2026-10-31). In Toy the
// container closes it (toy.closeBrowser); elsewhere the page tries, and if it is still here a moment later, says how
async function quitGame(g) {
  const sc = g.ui.screen;
  if (fsElement()) fsExit();
  try {
    if (typeof Toy !== 'undefined' && (await Promise.race([Toy.inToy(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(false), 1500))]))) await Promise.race([Toy.closeBrowser(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500))]);
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    window.close();
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!document.hidden && g.ui.screen === sc && sc) sc.quitTip = performance.now();
  }, 600);
}

// the page full screen and back. iPhone WebKit has no element full screen at all (only a <video> can), iPads and older
// Safari only the webkit-prefixed one: requestFullscreen called where it is missing threw - telemetry 11-02/03: 878
// devices, the iOS Bilibili app and Safari. Where there is none (or the frame may not: fullscreenEnabled false) the
// 全屏 buttons say so and the key tells the player instead of doing nothing
const fsElement = () => document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement || null;
// Not on an iPad either (IOS_WEBGL, 11-07): the webkit-prefixed call there since 11-06, and iPad sessions that went full
// screen died 3x as often (33.7% vs 10.6% - the page killed and opened again); before, the call failed and none did
function fsSupported() {
  var _document$fullscreenE;
  const de = document.documentElement;
  if (typeof IOS_WEBGL !== 'undefined' && IOS_WEBGL) return false;
  return !!(de.requestFullscreen || de.webkitRequestFullscreen) && ((_document$fullscreenE = document.fullscreenEnabled) !== null && _document$fullscreenE !== void 0 ? _document$fullscreenE : document.webkitFullscreenEnabled) !== false;
}
function fsExit() {
  const ex = document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen;
  try {
    const r = ex && ex.call(document);
    if (r && r.catch) r.catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {}
}
function toggleFullscreen() {
  if (fsElement()) {
    fsExit();
    return;
  }
  const de = document.documentElement,
    req = de.requestFullscreen || de.webkitRequestFullscreen;
  const no = () => {
    if (typeof game !== 'undefined' && game.ui) game.ui.message('这个浏览器不支持网页全屏', '#FFFF55');
  };
  if (!req || !fsSupported()) {
    no();
    return;
  }
  const lock = () => {
    if (navigator.keyboard && navigator.keyboard.lock) navigator.keyboard.lock(['KeyW', 'KeyA', 'KeyS', 'KeyD', 'Escape']).catch(() => {});
  };
  try {
    const r = req.call(de);
    if (r && r.then) r.then(lock, () => {});
  } catch (e) {
    no();
  }
}
</script>

const cmdList = g => g.net ? CMDS_NET : CMDS_LOCAL;

// the suggestions for what is typed so far: { list, at (where the word being completed starts), usage }; null if none
function cmdSuggest(g, text) {
  if (!text.startsWith('/')) return null;
  // (extra spaces don't count as empty words: suggestions went away after a double space)
  const words = text.slice(1).replace(/^ +/, '').split(/ +/),
    last = words[words.length - 1].replace(/^minecraft:/, '');
  const at = text.length - words[words.length - 1].length;
  const cmds = cmdList(g);
  if (words.length === 1) {
    const list = cmds.map(c => c[0]).filter(n => n.startsWith(last));
    const exact = cmds.find(c => c[0] === last);
    return {
      list: exact && list.length === 1 ? [] : list,
      at,
      usage: exact ? exact[1] : null
    };
  }
  const spec = cmds.find(c => c[0] === words[0]);
  if (!spec) return null;
  let ch = spec[3][words.length - 2];
  if (typeof ch === 'function') ch = ch(g);
  const list = (ch || []).filter(v => v.startsWith(last) && v !== last);
  // the ones starting with the word first, then the ones where a part of the name does (… _sword)
  if (last.length > 1 && ch && list.length < 10) for (const v of ch) if (!v.startsWith(last) && v.includes('_' + last) && !list.includes(v)) list.push(v);
  return {
    list: list.slice(0, 50),
    at,
    usage: spec[1]
  };
}

// ---- the chat box: suggestions drawn above it, Up / Down choose among them, Tab takes one ----
(() => {
  const _layout = ChatScreen.prototype.layout,
    _draw = ChatScreen.prototype.draw;
  ChatScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    _layout.call(this);
    const el = this.game.ui.input,
      prev = el.onkeydown;
    this.sugSel = 0;
    this.sugFor = null;
    el.onkeydown = e => {
      const s = this.sug && this.sug.list.length ? this.sug : null;
      if (s && (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        this.sugSel = (this.sugSel + (e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 1) + s.list.length) % s.list.length;
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (s) this.takeSuggestion(el);
        return;
      }
      // /help (with nothing after it) opens the list instead of asking anyone
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && el.value.trim() === '/help') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        this.game.ui.close();
        this.game.ui.open(new CommandHelpScreen(this.game));
        return;
      }
      prev(e);
    };
  };
  ChatScreen.prototype.takeSuggestion = function (el) {
    const s = this.sug,
      v = s.list[this.sugSel] || s.list[0];
    el.value = el.value.slice(0, s.at) + v + (v.endsWith('=') || v.endsWith('[') ? '' : ' ');
    this.sugSel = 0;
  };
  ChatScreen.prototype.draw = function (ui) {
    _draw.call(this, ui);
    const el = ui.input,
      v = el.value;
    if (v !== this.sugFor) {
      this.sugFor = v;
      this.sug = cmdSuggest(this.game, v);
      this.sugSel = 0;
    }
    const s = this.sug;
    if (!s) return;
    const c = ui.ctx,
      x0 = 4 + Font.width(v.slice(0, s.at)),
      y0 = ui.h - 14;
    // the usage, just above the box (vanilla shows it in grey where the suggestions would be)
    if (!s.list.length) {
      if (s.usage) {
        const w = Font.width(s.usage) + 2;
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
        c.fillRect(2, y0 - 12, w, 12);
        Font.draw(c, s.usage, 3, y0 - 10, '#AAAAAA');
      }
      return;
    }
    // ten at a time around the chosen one
    const n = Math.min(10, s.list.length),
      first = Math.max(0, Math.min(s.list.length - n, this.sugSel - 4));
    const shown = s.list.slice(first, first + n),
      w = Math.max(...shown.map(t => Font.width(t))) + 2;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
    c.fillRect(x0 - 1, y0 - 12 * n, w, 12 * n);
    shown.forEach((t, i) => Font.draw(c, t, x0, y0 - 12 * n + 2 + i * 12, first + i === this.sugSel ? '#FFFF00' : '#AAAAAA'));
    if (s.usage) Font.draw(c, s.usage, x0 + w + 4, y0 - 10, '#AAAAAA');
  };
  // a click on a suggestion takes it
  const _md = ChatScreen.prototype.mouseDown;
  ChatScreen.prototype.mouseDown = function (ui, mx, my, button) {
    const s = this.sug;
    if (s && s.list.length && button === 0) {
      const n = Math.min(10, s.list.length),
        first = Math.max(0, Math.min(s.list.length - n, this.sugSel - 4)),
        y0 = ui.h - 14 - 12 * n;
      const i = Math.floor((my - y0) / 12);
      if (my >= y0 && i >= 0 && i < n) {
        this.sugSel = first + i;
        this.takeSuggestion(ui.input);
        ui.input.focus();
        return;
      }
    }
    if (_md) return _md.call(this, ui, mx, my, button);
  };
})();

// ---- /help: every command and what it does, a page at a time; a click puts it in the chat box ----
class CommandHelpScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game) {
    super(game, '命令');
    this.page = 0;
  }
  layout() {
    const ui = this.game.ui,
      g = this.game,
      list = cmdList(g),
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    const per = Math.max(4, Math.floor((ui.h - 90) / 22)),
      pages = Math.ceil(list.length / per);
    this.page = clamp(this.page, 0, pages - 1);
    const bw = Math.min(420, ui.w - 20);
    this.widgets = list.slice(this.page * per, this.page * per + per).map((c, i) => ({
      // the usage and, where it fits, what it does
      x: cx - bw / 2,
      y: 44 + i * 22,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      label: Font.width(c[1] + '   ' + c[2]) < bw - 12 ? c[1] + '   ' + c[2] : c[1],
      tip: [c[2], '点击填入聊天框'],
      onClick: () => {
        ui.close();
        ui.open(new ChatScreen(g, '/' + c[0] + (c[3].length ? ' ' : '')));
      }
    }));
    const y = ui.h - 30;
    if (pages > 1) {
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 150,
        y,
        w: 70,
        h: 20,
        label: '<',
        enabled: this.page > 0,
        onClick: () => {
          this.page--;
          this.layout();
        }
      });
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx + 80,
        y,
        w: 70,
        h: 20,
        label: '>',
        enabled: this.page < pages - 1,
        onClick: () => {
          this.page++;
          this.layout();
        }
      });
      this.widgets.push({
        text: `${this.page + 1} / ${pages}`,
        x: cx,
        y: y - 11,
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      });
    }
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 70,
      y,
      w: 140,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => ui.close()
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    Font.center(ui.ctx, this.game.net ? '服务器上能不能用由服务器决定' : this.game.cheats ? '' : '这个世界没有开作弊，只有 /help /seed 等可用', ui.w / 2, 32, '#AAAAAA');
  }
}
</script>

  Pause: 'Pause',
  PrintScreen: 'Print Screen',
  Mouse0: '左键',
  Mouse1: '中键',
  Mouse2: '右键'
};
function keyLabel(code) {
  if (!code) return '未指定';
  if (KEY_NAMES[code]) return KEY_NAMES[code];
  if (code.startsWith('Key')) return code.slice(3);
  if (code.startsWith('Digit')) return code.slice(5);
  if (code.startsWith('Numpad')) return '小键盘' + code.slice(6);
  if (code.startsWith('Mouse')) return '鼠标按键' + (+code.slice(5) + 1);
  return code;
}
const keyOf = (g, name) => {
  const k = g.settings.keys && g.settings.keys[name];
  return k !== undefined ? k : KEY_DEFAULT[name];
};
const bindingsFor = (g, code) => code ? Object.keys(KEY_DEFAULT).filter(n => keyOf(g, n) === code) : [];
// is the key / mouse button bound to an action held down
function bindDown(g, name) {
  if (g.touchHeld && g.touchHeld[name]) return true; // on-screen touch controls
  const k = keyOf(g, name);
  if (!k) return false;
  if (k.startsWith('Mouse')) return !!(g.rawMouse && g.rawMouse[+k.slice(5)]);
  return !!g.keys[k];
}

// ---- actions ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// a bound key / button went down while playing (no screen open)
function pressAction(g, act, e) {
  var _s$sprintWindow;
  const p = g.player,
    ui = g.ui,
    s = g.settings,
    now = performance.now();
  switch (act) {
    case 'inventory':
      // riding a tame horse, donkey, mule or llama, or a camel: its inventory, as vanilla (HasCustomInventoryScreen) -
      // only sneak + use opened it, and on a phone sneaking gets off ("手机骑乘时打不开马的背包")
      if (!g.net && !g.p2pGuest && g.mode !== 'spectator' && p.vehicle && typeof Horse !== 'undefined' && p.vehicle instanceof Horse && (p.vehicle.tame || p.vehicle instanceof Camel)) {
        ui.open(new HorseScreen(g, p.vehicle));
        return true;
      }
      if (g.mode !== 'spectator') ui.open(g.mode === 'creative' ? new CreativeScreen(g) : g.net ? g.net.inventoryScreen() : new CraftingScreen(g, 2));
      return true;
    case 'chat':
      ui.open(new ChatScreen(g));
      return true;
    case 'command':
      ui.open(new ChatScreen(g, '/'));
      return true;
    case 'help':
      ui.open(new HelpScreen(g, null));
      ui.screen.parent = null;
      return true;
    case 'advancements':
      ui.open(new AdvancementsScreen(g, null));
      return true;
    case 'companion':
      if (!Companion.shown) return false;
      if (Companion.ready) ui.open(new CompanionChatScreen(g));else ui.open(new CompanionScreen(g, null));
      return true;
    case 'toggleGui':
      ui.hideHud = !ui.hideHud;
      return false;
    case 'togglePerspective':
      g.perspective = (g.perspective + 1) % 3;
      return false;
    case 'fullscreen':
      toggleFullscreen();
      return false;
    case 'screenshot':
      g.wantScreenshot = true;
      return false;
    case 'pickItem':
      g.pickBlock();
      return false;
    case 'swapOffhand':
      if (g.mode !== 'spectator') g.swapOffhand();
      return false;
    case 'drop':
      if (g.net) {
        if (g.mode !== 'spectator' && p.inv.held) {
          g.net.drop(!!(e && e.ctrlKey));
          p.swing();
        }
        return false;
      }
      if (g.mode !== 'spectator') {
        const h = p.inv.held;
        if (h) {
          const n = e && e.ctrlKey ? h.count : 1;
          g.dropFromPlayer({
            ...h,
            count: n
          });
          h.count -= n;
          if (!h.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
          p.swing();
        }
      }
      return false;
    case 'jump':
      // creative: a double tap toggles flying first; otherwise a press in the air opens the elytra
      if (g.mode === 'creative' && now - (g.lastTap.space || 0) < 300) {
        p.flying = !p.flying;
        p.vel[1] = 0;
        p.gliding = false;
        g.lastTap.space = 0;
        return false;
      }
      g.lastTap.space = now;
      if (!p.onGround && !p.flying && g.tryGlide) g.tryGlide();
      return false;
    case 'forward':
      // double-tap forward to sprint, within the sprint window (ticks)
      if (now - (g.lastTap.w || 0) < ((_s$sprintWindow = s.sprintWindow) !== null && _s$sprintWindow !== void 0 ? _s$sprintWindow : 7) * 50) g.sprintToggle = true;
      g.lastTap.w = now;
      return false;
    case 'sneak':
      if (s.toggleSneak) g.sneakToggled = !g.sneakToggled;
      return false;
    case 'sprint':
      if (s.toggleSprint) g.sprintToggled = !g.sprintToggled;
      return false;
    case 'attack':
      if (s.toggleAttack) {
        g.mouseBtn[0] = !g.mouseBtn[0];
        if (!g.mouseBtn[0]) return false;
      } else g.mouseBtn[0] = true;
      g.mouseClicked0 = true;
      g.attackCd = Math.min(g.attackCd, 0);
      if (!g.targetEntity && !g.target) p.swing();
      return false;
    case 'use':
      if (s.toggleUse) g.mouseBtn[2] = !g.mouseBtn[2];else g.mouseBtn[2] = true;
      if (g.mouseBtn[2]) g.useClicked = true; // (kept for the next tick even if let go before it, like mouseClicked0)
      g.useCd = 0;
      return false;
  }
  if (act.startsWith('hotbar.')) p.inv.sel = +act.slice(7) - 1;
  return false;
}
function releaseAction(g, act) {
  const s = g.settings;
  if (act === 'attack' && !s.toggleAttack) g.mouseBtn[0] = false;
  if (act === 'use' && !s.toggleUse) g.mouseBtn[2] = false;
  if (act === 'forward') g.sprintToggle = false;
}
