// KeyBindsScreen: categories with each binding, its key button and a reset button; 重置按键 / 完成
class KeyBindsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '按键绑定');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.pauses = game.state === 'play';
    this.titleY = 12;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.sel = null;
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game,
      s = g.settings;
    this.top = 33;
    this.bottom = u.h - 33;
    if (!s.keys) s.keys = {};
    const rows = [];
    for (const [cat, list] of KEYBIND_CATS) {
      rows.push({
        cat
      });
      // (the AI companion's key only where the service has it on: not released yet - the user, 2026-11-02)
      for (const [n] of list) if (n !== 'companion' || typeof Companion !== 'undefined' && Companion.shown) rows.push({
        name: n
      });
    }
    this.rows = rows;
    this.rowW = 340;
    this.rowX = cx - this.rowW / 2;
    this.footer = [{
      x: cx - 155,
      y: u.h - 27,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '重置按键',
      onClick: () => {
        s.keys = {};
        this.sel = null;
        g.saveSettings();
      }
    }, {
      x: cx + 5,
      y: u.h - 27,
      w: 150,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
    this.place();
  }
  place() {
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, this.rows.length * 20 + 4 - (this.bottom - this.top));
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll, 0, maxScroll);
    const g = this.game,
      s = g.settings,
      list = [];
    const right = this.rowX + this.rowW;
    this.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      const y = this.top + 4 - this.scroll + i * 20;
      r.y = y;
      if (!r.name || y < this.top || y + 20 > this.bottom) return;
      const n = r.name,
        code = keyOf(g, n);
      const dup = !!code && bindingsFor(g, code).length > 1;
      list.push({
        x: right - 50,
        y,
        w: 50,
        h: 20,
        label: '重置',
        enabled: code !== KEY_DEFAULT[n],
        onClick: () => {
          delete s.keys[n];
          g.saveSettings();
          this.place();
        }
      });
      list.push({
        x: right - 50 - 5 - 75,
        y,
        w: 75,
        h: 20,
        keyFor: n,
        label: () => this.sel === n ? '> ' + keyLabel(keyOf(g, n)) + ' <' : keyLabel(keyOf(g, n)),
        color: this.sel === n ? '#FFFF55' : dup ? '#FF5555' : null,
        tip: dup ? ['该按键也用于：', ...bindingsFor(g, code).filter(o => o !== n).map(o => KEY_CN[o])] : null,
        onClick: () => {
          this.sel = n;
          this.place();
        }
      });
    });
    this.widgets = [...list, ...this.footer];
  }
  bind(code) {
    const g = this.game;
    g.settings.keys[this.sel] = code;
    this.sel = null;
    g.saveSettings();
    this.place();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    ui.listBackground(this.top, this.bottom);
    const c = ui.ctx;
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(0, this.top, ui.w, this.bottom - this.top);
    c.clip();
    for (const r of this.rows) {
      if (r.y + 20 < this.top || r.y > this.bottom) continue;
      if (r.cat) Font.center(c, r.cat, ui.w / 2, r.y + 6, '#FFFFFF');else Font.draw(c, KEY_CN[r.name], this.rowX, r.y + 6, '#FFFFFF');
    }
    c.restore();
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button) {
    if (this.sel) {
      this.bind('Mouse' + button);
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button);
  }
  key(ui, ev) {
    if (this.sel) {
      this.bind(ev.code === 'Escape' ? '' : ev.code);
      return true;
    }
    if (ev.key === 'Escape') {
      this.back();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    this.scroll += Math.sign(dy) * 20;
    this.place();
  }
  back() {
    this.game.saveSettings();
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/dims.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dimensions (Overworld / Nether / End), portals, fire, spawners, the dragon
// fight and the ending.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const DIM_CN = {
  overworld: '主世界',
  nether: '下界',
  end: '末地'
};
Object.assign(ADVANCEMENTS, {
  nether: ['我们需要更深入', 'obsidian'],
  fortress: ['阴森的要塞', 'nether_bricks'],
  blaze_rod: ['与火共舞', 'blaze_rod'],
  return_sender: ['见鬼去吧', 'fire_charge'],
  eye_spy: ['隔墙有眼', 'ender_eye'],
  the_end: ['结束了？', 'end_stone'],
  free_end: ['解放末地', 'dragon_egg'],
  next_gen: ['下一世代', 'dragon_egg']
});
Game.prototype.makeWorld = function (dim) {
  const w = new World(seed32(this.worldMeta ? this.worldMeta.seed : this.world.seed), dim);
  // gen-2 worlds: overworld and Nether come from the vanilla generator (the End keeps its own)
  if ((dim === 'overworld' || dim === 'nether') && this.worldMeta && this.worldMeta.gen === 2) {
    w.gen2 = true;
    w.minY = dim === 'overworld' ? MIN_Y : 0;
    w.seedStr = String(this.worldMeta.seed);
  }
  w.grassMap = this.renderer.grassMap;
  w.foliageMap = this.renderer.foliageMap;
  w.listener = this;
  w.flat = dim === 'overworld' && !!(this.worldMeta && this.worldMeta.flat);
  if (w.flat) w.flatTop = this.worldMeta.flatClassic ? 3 : 60; // (the grass layer's height)
  w.structures = !this.worldMeta || this.worldMeta.structures !== false;
  if (dim === 'end') w.oldPodium = !!(this.worldMeta && this.worldMeta.end && !this.worldMeta.end.podium2);
  return w;
};
Game.prototype.dimStoreId = function (dim) {
  return dim === 'overworld' ? this.worldMeta.id : this.worldMeta.id + '~' + dim;
};

// Called from loadWorld: prepare the starting dimension
Game.prototype.initDims = async function (meta) {
  this.dimData = {};
  this.dim = meta.dim || 'overworld';
  meta.dims = meta.dims || {};
  if (!meta.dims.overworld) meta.dims.overworld = {
    blockEntities: meta.blockEntities || {},
    mobs: meta.mobs || []
  };
  meta.portals = meta.portals || {
    overworld: [],
    nether: []
  };
  meta.end = meta.end || {
    dragonKilled: false,
    dragonSpawned: false,
    credits: false
  };
  // (podium2: the End is made with vanilla's podium; an End entered before 2026-11-12 keeps its old, higher one so
  // its saved and newly generated chunks still fit together)
  if (!meta.end.dragonSpawned && !meta.end.dragonKilled) meta.end.podium2 = true;
  const d = await this.loadDimData(this.dim);
  this.applyDim(d);
};
Game.prototype.loadDimData = async function (dim) {
  if (this.dimData[dim]) return this.dimData[dim];
  const w = this.makeWorld(dim);
  // which chunks have saved data; each record is read when its chunk loads (savedReady)
  w.savedStore = this.dimStoreId(dim);
  w.savedIndex = await DB.chunkKeys(w.savedStore);
  w.savedChunks = new Map();
  const md = this.worldMeta.dims[dim] || {
    blockEntities: {},
    mobs: []
  };
  const d = {
    dim,
    world: w,
    entities: [],
    blockEntities: new Map(Object.entries(md.blockEntities || {})),
    pendingMobs: (md.mobs || []).slice(),
    dirtySaved: new Set()
  };
  this.dimData[dim] = d;
  return d;
};
Game.prototype.applyDim = function (d) {
  this.dim = d.dim;
  this.world = d.world;
  this.entities = d.entities;
  this.blockEntities = d.blockEntities;
  this.pendingMobs = d.pendingMobs;
  this.dirtySaved = d.dirtySaved;
  this.genQueue = [];
  this._lastCC = null;
  this.particles.list = [];
  for (const e of this.entities) e.world = this.world;
};
// keep the current dimension in memory but release its chunks and GPU meshes
Game.prototype.stashDim = function () {
  const w = this.world,
    d = this.dimData[this.dim];
  for (const ch of w.chunks.values()) {
    if (ch.modified) {
      const k = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz);
      w.savedChunks.set(k, encodeChunk(ch));
      if (w.savedIndex) w.savedIndex.add(k);
      d.dirtySaved.add(k);
    }
    this.renderer.dropChunk(ch.cx, ch.cz);
  }
  w.chunks.clear();
  this.renderer.clearSections();
  d.entities = this.entities.filter(e => !e.dead && !(e instanceof ItemEntity && e.age > 5000));
  d.pendingMobs = this.pendingMobs;
};
// Switch dimension; `place` runs once the destination chunks are loaded and must position the player
Game.prototype.changeDimension = async function (target, pos, place) {
  if (this.state !== 'play') return;
  this.state = 'switching';
  const ls = new LoadingScreen(this, target === 'nether' ? '正在进入下界…' : target === 'end' ? '正在进入末地…' : '正在返回主世界…');
  ls.keepPointer = true;
  this.ui.open(ls);
  this.stashDim();
  const d = await this.loadDimData(target);
  this.applyDim(d);
  const p = this.player;
  p.world = this.world;
  p.pos = [...pos];
  p.prev = [...pos];
  p.vel = [0, 0, 0];
  p.fallDist = 0;
  p.fire = 0;
  this.sleeping = null;
  this.breaking = null;
  this.onDimReady = place || null;
  this.state = 'loading';
  Sound.ev('block.portal.travel', null, 0.25, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
};

// ---- saving all dimensions --------------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.collectDimSave = function () {
  const m = this.worldMeta,
    out = [];
  // current dimension: refresh in-memory data
  const cur = this.dimData[this.dim];
  cur.entities = this.entities;
  cur.pendingMobs = this.pendingMobs;
  for (const [dim, d] of Object.entries(this.dimData)) {
    const w = d.world,
      list = [];
    if (dim === this.dim) for (const ch of w.chunks.values()) if (ch.modified) {
      const rec = encodeChunk(ch),
        k = ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz);
      w.savedChunks.set(k, rec);
      if (w.savedIndex) w.savedIndex.add(k);
      list.push([ch.cx, ch.cz, rec]);
      ch.modified = false;
    }
    for (const k of d.dirtySaved) {
      const rec = w.savedChunks.get(k);
      if (rec) list.push([Math.floor(k / 65536) - 32768, k % 65536 - 32768, rec]);
    }
    d.dirtySaved.clear();
    const ents = dim === this.dim ? this.entities : d.entities;
    m.dims[dim] = {
      blockEntities: Object.fromEntries(d.blockEntities),
      // (and the mobs that may despawn, around the player now: vanilla saves every mob with its chunk - they were lost
      // on every reload. They come back still able to despawn; one in a chunk that unloads is dropped as before.
      // A mob in its death animation isn't saved, as in vanilla: it came back alive with 0 health and dropped its loot twice)
      mobs: ents.filter(e => !e.dead && !(e instanceof Mob && e.deathTime > 0) && (this.isSavedEntity(e) || e instanceof Mob && !e.remote && !e.p2pMirror && !e.persistent)).map(e => this.mobRecord(e)).concat(d.pendingMobs || [])
    };
    out.push([this.dimStoreId(dim), list]);
  }
  m.dim = this.dim;
  delete m.blockEntities;
  delete m.mobs;
  return out;
};

// the entities a save keeps, and the record each is saved as (restoreMob reads it back)
Game.prototype.isSavedEntity = function (e) {
  return e instanceof Mob && e.persistent || e instanceof EnderDragon || e instanceof EndCrystal || e.isVehicle || e.keepSaved;
};
Game.prototype.mobRecord = function (e) {
  return {
    type: e.type,
    pos: [...e.pos],
    yaw: e.yaw,
    health: e.health,
    sheared: e.sheared,
    wool: e.woolColor,
    baby: e.baby ? e.growT : 0,
    size: typeof e.size === 'number' ? e.size : undefined,
    x: e.saveData ? e.saveData() : undefined,
    ride: e.vehicleRef && !e.remote ? 1 : undefined,
    np: e instanceof Mob && !e.persistent ? 1 : undefined,
    ts: e.tsKey,
    dt: e.deathTime > 0 ? e.deathTime : undefined
  };
};
// Chunks that unload take their entities with them, like vanilla's: the saved kinds go back to the pending
// list (restored when the chunk loads again, and saved from there), mobs that may despawn are dropped (they
// would despawn that far away anyway), and the rest - dropped items, orbs, arrows - wait in the world's
// parked list until their chunk comes back (they are not saved, as before). Until now they all stayed in the
// entity list without ticking, so they never despawned and wandering far piled them up for good.
Game.prototype.parkEntities = function (gone) {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world,
    keep = [];
  for (const e of this.entities) {
    const k = ckey(Math.floor(e.pos[0]) >> 4, Math.floor(e.pos[2]) >> 4);
    if (e.dead || e === p || e.alwaysTick || e.remote || !gone.has(k) || p.vehicle === e || e.leashHolder === p) {
      keep.push(e);
      continue;
    }
    if (this.isSavedEntity(e)) this.pendingMobs.push(this.mobRecord(e));else if (!(e instanceof Mob)) {
      const parked = w.parked || (w.parked = new Map());
      if (!parked.has(k)) parked.set(k, []);
      parked.get(k).push(e);
    }
  }
  this.entities = keep;
};
Game.prototype.restoreMob = function (m) {
  const e = createMob(this, m.type, m.pos[0], m.pos[1], m.pos[2]);
  e.yaw = m.yaw || 0;
  if (m.health != null && e.health != null) e.health = m.health;
  if (e instanceof Mob) {
    e.sheared = m.sheared;
    e.woolColor = m.wool || 0;
    if (m.baby) {
      e.makeBaby();
      e.growT = m.baby;
    }
    if (m.size && e.setSize) {
      e.setSize(m.size);
      e.health = m.health;
    }
    if (m.x && e.loadData) e.loadData(m.x);
    if (m.ride) e.wantsRide = true; // (seatPassengers puts it back in its boat / minecart)
    e.persistent = !m.np;
    // a trial spawner's mob: tracked by its spawner again (items3.js tickTrialSpawners; m.ts names the trial, so
    // one from an earlier trial goes to a list nobody reads)
    if (m.ts) {
      e.tsKey = m.ts;
      const tsm = this._tsMobs || (this._tsMobs = new Map());
      (tsm.get(m.ts) || tsm.set(m.ts, []).get(m.ts)).push(e);
    }
  } else if (m.x && e.loadData) e.loadData(m.x); // boats, minecarts
  // one saved while dying goes on dying (vanilla keeps DeathTime / DragonDeathTime): it came back alive at 0 health -
  // a dragon /kill-ed and saved during its 10 s death hung there and only died when hit
  if (e instanceof Living && m.health != null && m.health <= 0) e.deathTime = Math.max(1, m.dt || 1);
  return e;
};

// ---- environment per dimension ----------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.dimEnv = function (env) {
  if (this.dim === 'nether') {
    // vanilla nether wastes fog #330808; the nether is "foggy": 5% .. 50% of the view distance.
    // Gen-2 Nethers take the fog colour of the surrounding biomes (blended over nearby quarts like vanilla)
    let fog = [51 / 255, 8 / 255, 8 / 255];
    const R = this.renderer.renderDist * 16,
      p = this.player;
    if (this.world.gen2 && p) {
      let r = 0,
        g = 0,
        b = 0,
        n = 0;
      for (let dx = -8; dx <= 8; dx += 4) for (let dz = -8; dz <= 8; dz += 4) {
        const v = this.vbiomeAt(Math.floor(p.pos[0]) + dx, Math.floor(p.pos[2]) + dz);
        if (v && v.fog) {
          r += v.fog[0];
          g += v.fog[1];
          b += v.fog[2];
          n++;
        }
      }
      if (n) {
        const t = [r / n / 255, g / n / 255, b / n / 255],
          f = this._netherFog || t;
        this._netherFog = f.map((v, i) => v + (t[i] - v) * 0.05);
        fog = this._netherFog;
      }
    }
    return Object.assign(env, {
      day: 0,
      fogColor: fog,
      skyColor: fog,
      starBright: 0,
      sunAlpha: 0,
      rain: 0,
      fogNear: R * 0.05,
      fogFar: Math.min(R, 192) * 0.5,
      ambient: [0.55, 0.42, 0.38],
      nightTint: [1, 1, 1],
      cloudColor: [0, 0, 0],
      sky: 'none'
    });
  }
  if (this.dim === 'end') {
    // vanilla end fog: #A080A0 x 0.15, normal terrain fog band
    const fog = [160 / 255 * 0.15, 128 / 255 * 0.15, 160 / 255 * 0.15],
      R = this.renderer.renderDist * 16;
    return Object.assign(env, {
      day: 0,
      fogColor: fog,
      skyColor: fog,
      starBright: 0,
      sunAlpha: 0,
      rain: 0,
      fogNear: R - clamp(R / 10, 4, 64),
      fogFar: R,
      ambient: [0.36, 0.33, 0.4],
      nightTint: [1, 1, 1],
      cloudColor: [0, 0, 0],
      sky: 'end'
    });
  }
  env.ambient = [0.03 + 0.11 * this.renderer.gamma, 0.03 + 0.11 * this.renderer.gamma, 0.03 + 0.11 * this.renderer.gamma];
  env.sky = 'overworld';
  return env;
};

// ---- portals -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Try to light a nether portal whose interior contains (x,y,z). Returns true on success.
Game.prototype.tryLightPortal = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world;
  if (this.dim === 'end') return false;
  const isFrame = id => id === 28;
  const inner = id => id === 0 || id === 171;
  for (const axis of [0, 1]) {
    const dx = axis === 0 ? 1 : 0,
      dz = axis === 0 ? 0 : 1;
    if (!inner(w.getBlock(x, y, z))) return false;
    let by = y;
    while (by > y - 22 && inner(w.getBlock(x, by - 1, z))) by--;
    if (!isFrame(w.getBlock(x, by - 1, z))) continue;
    let left = 0;
    while (left < 22 && inner(w.getBlock(x - dx * (left + 1), by, z - dz * (left + 1)))) left++;
    if (!isFrame(w.getBlock(x - dx * (left + 1), by, z - dz * (left + 1)))) continue;
    const x0 = x - dx * left,
      z0 = z - dz * left;
    let width = 0;
    while (width < 22 && inner(w.getBlock(x0 + dx * width, by, z0 + dz * width))) width++;
    if (width < 2 || width > 21 || !isFrame(w.getBlock(x0 + dx * width, by, z0 + dz * width))) continue;
    let height = 0;
    while (height < 22 && inner(w.getBlock(x0, by + height, z0))) height++;
    if (height < 3 || height > 21) continue;
    let ok = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < width && ok; i++) {
      if (!isFrame(w.getBlock(x0 + dx * i, by - 1, z0 + dz * i)) || !isFrame(w.getBlock(x0 + dx * i, by + height, z0 + dz * i))) ok = false;
      for (let j = 0; j < height && ok; j++) if (!inner(w.getBlock(x0 + dx * i, by + j, z0 + dz * i))) ok = false;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < height && ok; j++) if (!isFrame(w.getBlock(x0 - dx, by + j, z0 - dz)) || !isFrame(w.getBlock(x0 + dx * width, by + j, z0 + dz * width))) ok = false;
    if (!ok) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) for (let j = 0; j < height; j++) w.setBlock(x0 + dx * i, by + j, z0 + dz * i, 170, axis, 0);
    this.recordPortal(this.dim, [x0, by, z0, axis]);
    Sound.ev('block.portal.trigger', [x, y, z], 0.4, 1.4);
    this.flushMesh();
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};
Game.prototype.recordPortal = function (dim, p) {
  const list = this.worldMeta.portals[dim] || (this.worldMeta.portals[dim] = []);
  if (!list.some(q => Math.abs(q[0] - p[0]) < 4 && Math.abs(q[1] - p[1]) < 4 && Math.abs(q[2] - p[2]) < 4)) list.push(p);
};
Game.prototype.portalValid = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world,
    axis = w.getMeta(x, y, z) & 1;
  const ok = id => id === 170 || id === 28;
  const dx = axis === 0 ? 1 : 0,
    dz = axis === 0 ? 0 : 1;
  return ok(w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)) && ok(w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)) && ok(w.getBlock(x + dx, y, z + dz)) && ok(w.getBlock(x - dx, y, z - dz));
};
// player standing in portal blocks
Game.prototype.tickPortals = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world,
    b = p.box();
  if (!p.portalT) p.portalT = 0;
  let inNether = false,
    inEnd = false;
  for (let x = Math.floor(b[0]); x <= Math.floor(b[3]); x++) for (let y = Math.floor(b[1]); y <= Math.floor(b[4]); y++) for (let z = Math.floor(b[2]); z <= Math.floor(b[5]); z++) {
    const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
    if (id === 170) inNether = true;else if (id === 175 && b[1] < y + 0.75) inEnd = true;
  }
  if (inEnd && !p.portalLock) {
    p.portalLock = true;
    this.enterEndPortal();
    return;
  }
  if (inNether && p.deathTime === 0) {
    if (!p.portalLock) {
      if (p.portalT === 0) Sound.ev('block.portal.trigger', null, 0.25, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
      p.portalT++;
      if (p.portalT >= (p.creative ? 1 : 80)) {
        p.portalLock = true;
        p.portalT = 0;
        this.useNetherPortal();
      }
    }
  } else {
    p.portalT = Math.max(0, (p.portalT || 0) - 4);
    if (!inEnd && !inNether) p.portalLock = false;
  }
  this.portalOverlay = Math.min(1, (p.portalT || 0) / 80);
};
Game.prototype.useNetherPortal = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    toNether = this.dim === 'overworld';
  const target = toNether ? 'nether' : 'overworld',
    scale = toNether ? 1 / 8 : 8;
  const tx = Math.floor(p.pos[0] * scale),
    tz = Math.floor(p.pos[2] * scale);
  const list = this.worldMeta.portals[target] || [],
    range = toNether ? 16 : 128;
  let best = null,
    bd = 1e9;
  for (const q of list) {
    const d = Math.hypot(q[0] - tx, q[2] - tz);
    if (d < range && d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      best = q;
    }
  }
  const dest = best ? [best[0] + 0.5, best[1], best[2] + 0.5] : [tx + 0.5, toNether ? 70 : 80, tz + 0.5];
  this.changeDimension(target, dest, () => {
    const w = this.world;
    if (best && w.getBlock(best[0], best[1], best[2]) === 170) this.placeAtPortal(best);else this.placeAtPortal(this.buildPortalNear(best ? best[0] : tx, best ? best[2] : tz));
    if (target === 'nether') this.grant('nether');
  });
};
Game.prototype.placeAtPortal = function (q) {
  const p = this.player,
    [x, y, z, axis] = q;
  p.pos = [x + (axis === 0 ? 1 : 0.5), y, z + (axis === 0 ? 0.5 : 1)];
  p.prev = [...p.pos];
  p.yaw = axis === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  p.portalLock = true;
  p.portalT = 0;
};
// find a spot and build a 4x5 obsidian portal with platform; returns [x0,y,z0,axis]
Game.prototype.buildPortalNear = function (tx, tz) {
  const w = this.world,
    nether = this.dim === 'nether';
  const fits = (x, y, z) => {
    for (let i = -1; i <= 2; i++) for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
      if (!SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x + i, y - 1, z + k)]) return false;
      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        const id = w.getBlock(x + i, y + j, z + k);
        if (id && !REPLACEABLE[id]) return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  };
  let spot = null;
  const sea = w.flat ? 1 : SEA; // (a classic superflat's ground is at y 3)
  outer: for (let r = 0; r <= 12; r += 2) for (let a = 0; a < (r ? 8 : 1); a++) {
    const x = tx + Math.round(Math.cos(a / 8 * Math.PI * 2) * r),
      z = tz + Math.round(Math.sin(a / 8 * Math.PI * 2) * r);
    if (nether) {
      for (let y = 100; y > 33; y--) if (fits(x, y, z)) {
        spot = [x, y, z];
        break outer;
      }
    } else {
      const y = w.surfaceY(x, z) + 1;
      if (y > sea && y < HEIGHT - 16 && fits(x, y, z)) {
        spot = [x, y, z];
        break outer;
      }
    }
  }
  if (!spot) {
    let y = nether ? 70 : Math.max(sea + 2, w.surfaceY(tx, tz) + 1);
    spot = [tx, y, tz];
    for (let i = -2; i <= 3; i++) for (let k = -2; k <= 2; k++) {
      w.setBlock(tx + i, y - 1, tz + k, 28, 0, 0);
      for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) w.setBlock(tx + i, y + j, tz + k, 0, 0, 0);
    }
  }
  const [x, y, z] = spot;
  for (let i = -1; i <= 2; i++) for (let j = -1; j <= 3; j++) {
    const edge = i === -1 || i === 2 || j === -1 || j === 3;
    w.setBlock(x + i, y + j, z, edge ? 28 : 170, 0, 0);
  }
  for (let i = -1; i <= 2; i++) for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
    if (!SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x + i, y - 1, z + k)]) w.setBlock(x + i, y - 1, z + k, 28, 0, 0);
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (w.getBlock(x + i, y + j, z + k) && !REPLACEABLE[w.getBlock(x + i, y + j, z + k)]) w.setBlock(x + i, y + j, z + k, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  const q = [x, y, z, 0];
  this.recordPortal(this.dim, q);
  return q;
};

// ---- End portal ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.fillEndFrame = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world;
  w.setMeta(x, y, z, w.getMeta(x, y, z) | 4);
  // whoever stands in the eye's place goes up onto it (vanilla Block.pushEntitiesUp) - stood in it, a player was pushed
  // down to crawling: "放末影之眼被卡成趴下 / 卡进去", feedback 11-04
  for (const e of [this.player, ...this.entities]) {
    if (!e || e.dead || e.noClip || e.vehicle) continue;
    const b = e.box();
    if (b[0] < x + 0.75 && b[3] > x + 0.25 && b[2] < z + 0.75 && b[5] > z + 0.25 && b[1] < y + 1 && b[4] > y + 13 / 16) {
      e.pos[1] = y + 1;
      if (e.prev) e.prev[1] = y + 1;
    }
  }
  Sound.ev('block.end_portal_frame.fill', [x, y, z], 1, 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) this.particles.spawn('smoke', x + 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.6, y + 1, z + 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.6, 0, 0.02, 0);
  const isEye = (a, b, c) => w.getBlock(a, b, c) === 174 && w.getMeta(a, b, c) & 4;
  for (let cx = x - 2; cx <= x + 2; cx++) for (let cz = z - 2; cz <= z + 2; cz++) {
    let ok = true;
    for (let k = -1; k <= 1 && ok; k++) ok = isEye(cx + k, y, cz - 2) && isEye(cx + k, y, cz + 2) && isEye(cx - 2, y, cz + k) && isEye(cx + 2, y, cz + k);
    if (!ok) continue;
    for (let a = -1; a <= 1; a++) for (let b = -1; b <= 1; b++) w.setBlock(cx + a, y, cz + b, 175, 0);
    Sound.ev('block.end_portal.spawn', null, 1, 1);
    this.ui.message('末地传送门已激活！', '#AA55FF');
    this.flushMesh();
    return;
  }
};
Game.prototype.enterEndPortal = function () {
  if (this.dim === 'end') {
    this.leaveEnd();
    return;
  }
  this.changeDimension('end', [100.5, 49, 0.5], () => {
    const w = this.world;
    for (let x = 98; x <= 102; x++) for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
      w.setBlock(x, 48, z, 28, 0, 0);
      for (let y = 49; y <= 51; y++) w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    const p = this.player;
    p.pos = [100.5, 49, 0.5];
    p.prev = [...p.pos];
    p.yaw = Math.PI / 2;
    this.grant('the_end');
    this.setupDragonFight();
  });
};
Game.prototype.setupDragonFight = function () {
  const end = this.worldMeta.end,
    w = this.world;
  if (end.dragonKilled) return;
  if (!end.dragonSpawned) {
    end.dragonSpawned = true;
    for (const pl of w.endPillars) {
      const c = new EndCrystal(this, pl.x + 0.5, pl.h + 2, pl.z + 0.5);
      this.entities.push(c);
    }
    this.entities.push(new EnderDragon(this, 0, 110, -60));
    this.ui.message('末影龙出现了……', '#AA55FF');
  }
};
Game.prototype.dragon = function () {
  return this.dim === 'end' ? this.entities.find(e => e instanceof EnderDragon && !e.dead) : null;
};
Game.prototype.onDragonKilled = function (dr) {
  const w = this.world,
    end = this.worldMeta.end,
    first = !end.dragonKilled;
  end.dragonKilled = true;
  const yb = w.podiumY() - 1;
  for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
    const d = Math.hypot(x, z);
    if (d <= 2.5 && (x || z)) w.setBlock(x, yb + 1, z, 175, 0);
  }
  if (first) {
    w.setBlock(0, yb + 5, 0, 176, 0);
    this.dropXp(0.5, yb + 3, 0.5, 12000);
  } else this.dropXp(0.5, yb + 3, 0.5, 500);
  this.grant('free_end');
  this.ui.message('末影龙被击败了！中央的返回传送门已经开启。', '#FFFF55');
  this.flushMesh();
};
Game.prototype.leaveEnd = function () {
  const end = this.worldMeta.end;
  const go = () => {
    const s = this.player.spawn;
    // (placed as a respawn is, beside the bed if there is one: climbing out of blocks put it on the roof)
    this.changeDimension('overworld', [s[0] + 0.5, s[1], s[2] + 0.5], () => {
      this.player.respawnGround = true;
      this.respawnSettle();
    });
  };
  if (end.dragonKilled && !end.credits) {
    end.credits = true;
    this.ui.open(new CreditsScreen(this, go));
  } else go();
};

// ---- fire --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const FLAMMABLE = new Set([5, 14, 15, 25, 26, 46, 47, 48, 49, 50, 51, 58, 60, 87, 104, 105, 106, 107, 115, 116, 178, 39, 40, 45, ...Array.from({
  length: 16
}, (_, i) => 128 + i)]);
Game.prototype.fireSupported = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world,
    below = w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z);
  if (SOLIDCUBE[below] || below === 119 || below === 120) return true;
  for (const D of DIRS) if (FLAMMABLE.has(w.getBlock(x + D[0], y + D[1], z + D[2]))) return true;
  return false;
};
// the fire that goes into a cell: soul fire over soul sand / soul soil (vanilla BaseFireBlock.getState). Soul fire never
// spreads or burns out; it goes when its block below does (features.js canSurvive)
Game.prototype.fireIdAt = function (x, y, z) {
  const b = this.world.getBlock(x, y - 1, z);
  return BID.soul_fire !== undefined && (b === BID.soul_sand || b === BID.soul_soil) ? BID.soul_fire : 171;
};
Game.prototype.fireTick = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world,
    below = w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z);
  const eternal = below === 119 || below === 103 || this.dim === 'end' && below === 6;
  if (!eternal && (this.dim === 'overworld' && this.weather > 0.5 && w.skyAt(x, y, z) >= 15 || Math.random() < 0.15)) {
    let fuel = false;
    for (const D of DIRS) if (FLAMMABLE.has(w.getBlock(x + D[0], y + D[1], z + D[2]))) fuel = true;
    if (!fuel || Math.random() < 0.3) {
      w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
      return;
    }
  }
  // spread: burn neighbours and ignite nearby air
  for (const D of DIRS) {
    const nx = x + D[0],
      ny = y + D[1],
      nz = z + D[2],
      id = w.getBlock(nx, ny, nz);
    if (FLAMMABLE.has(id) && Math.random() < 0.08) {
      if (id === 26) {
        w.setBlock(nx, ny, nz, 0, 0);
        this.addEntity(new PrimedTNT(this, nx, ny, nz, 40));
      } else w.setBlock(nx, ny, nz, Math.random() < 0.6 ? this.fireIdAt(nx, ny, nz) : 0, 0);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const nx = x + (Math.random() * 3 | 0) - 1,
      ny = y + (Math.random() * 4 | 0) - 1,
      nz = z + (Math.random() * 3 | 0) - 1;
    if (w.getBlock(nx, ny, nz) === 0 && this.fireSupported(nx, ny, nz) && Math.random() < 0.3) {
      let fuel = false;
      for (const D of DIRS) if (FLAMMABLE.has(w.getBlock(nx + D[0], ny + D[1], nz + D[2]))) fuel = true;
      if (fuel) w.setBlock(nx, ny, nz, this.fireIdAt(nx, ny, nz), 0);
    }
  }
};

// lava lights what burns near it - wood, wool, leaves, TNT (vanilla LavaFluid.randomTick): it never did, "岩浆不能点燃TNT"
Game.prototype.lavaTick = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world,
    R = Math.random;
  if (this.rule && this.rule('fire_spread_radius_around_player') === 0) return;
  const burns = (a, b, c) => FLAMMABLE.has(w.getBlock(a, b, c));
  const passes = R() * 3 | 0;
  if (passes > 0) {
    let tx = x,
      ty = y,
      tz = z;
    for (let i = 0; i < passes; i++) {
      tx += (R() * 3 | 0) - 1;
      ty++;
      tz += (R() * 3 | 0) - 1;
      if (!w.isLoaded(tx, tz) || ty >= HEIGHT) return;
      const id = w.getBlock(tx, ty, tz);
      if (id === 0) {
        if (DIRS.some(D => burns(tx + D[0], ty + D[1], tz + D[2]))) {
          w.setBlock(tx, ty, tz, this.fireIdAt(tx, ty, tz), 0);
          return;
        }
      } else if (BLOCKS[id].solid) return;
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const tx = x + (R() * 3 | 0) - 1,
        tz = z + (R() * 3 | 0) - 1;
      if (!w.isLoaded(tx, tz)) return;
      if (y + 1 < HEIGHT && w.getBlock(tx, y + 1, tz) === 0 && burns(tx, y, tz)) w.setBlock(tx, y + 1, tz, this.fireIdAt(tx, y + 1, tz), 0);
    }
  }
};

// ---- spawners ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const SPAWNER_MOBS = ['zombie', 'skeleton', 'spider', 'blaze'];
// the mob a spawner spawns: its block entity's when it has one (a structure template's SpawnData, a mineshaft's cave
// spider, a spawn egg's; a placed spawner is empty, null - spawns and shows nothing, like vanilla's), else the old
// meta kinds above (dungeons, fortresses, older worlds)
Game.prototype.spawnerMob = function (x, y, z) {
  const be = this.blockEntities.get(x + ',' + y + ',' + z);
  if (be && be.type === 'spawner') return be.mob && MOB_TYPES[be.mob] ? be.mob : null;
  return SPAWNER_MOBS[this.world.getMeta(x, y, z) & 3];
};
Game.prototype.tickSpawners = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world,
    px = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
    py = Math.floor(p.pos[1]),
    pz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
  this.spawnerT = this.spawnerT || new Map();
  for (let cx = (px >> 4) - 1; cx <= (px >> 4) + 1; cx++) for (let cz = (pz >> 4) - 1; cz <= (pz >> 4) + 1; cz++) {
    const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
    if (!ch) continue;
    if (!ch.spawners) {
      ch.spawners = [];
      ch.findAll([127], i => ch.spawners.push([cx * 16 + (i & 15), i >> 8, cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15)]));
    }
    for (const s of ch.spawners) {
      const [x, y, z] = s;
      if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== 127) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(x - px, y - py, z - pz) > 16) continue;
      const type = this.spawnerMob(x, y, z);
      if (!type) continue;
      if (Math.random() < 0.3) this.particles.spawn('flame', x + Math.random(), y + Math.random(), z + Math.random(), 0, 0.01, 0);
      const k = s.join(',');
      let t = this.spawnerT.get(k);
      if (t === undefined) t = 20;
      t -= 20; // called once every 20 ticks
      if (t > 0) {
        this.spawnerT.set(k, t);
        continue;
      }
      this.spawnerT.set(k, 200 + Math.random() * 600);
      const near = this.entities.filter(e => e instanceof Mob && e.type === type && e.distTo({
        pos: [x, y, z]
      }) < 9).length;
      if (near >= 6) continue;
      for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) {
        const sx = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
          sy = y + (Math.random() * 3 | 0) - 1,
          sz = z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
        const m = createMob(this, type, Math.floor(sx) + 0.5, sy, Math.floor(sz) + 0.5);
        if (m.collides(m.box()) || !m.T.flying && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(Math.floor(sx), sy - 1, Math.floor(sz))].solid) continue;
        m.persistent = false;
        this.entities.push(m);
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) this.particles.spawn('smoke', m.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), m.pos[1] + Math.random() * m.h, m.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
      }
    }
  }
};

// ---- per-dimension mob spawning ------------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.spawnMobsDim = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world;
  if (this.difficulty === 0) return;
  if (this.dim === 'nether' && w.gen2 && this.spawnNetherV) return this.spawnNetherV();
  const hostiles = this.entities.filter(e => e instanceof Mob && e.T.hostile).length;
  if (this.dim === 'end') {
    if (hostiles >= 14) return;
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      d = 16 + Math.random() * 40;
    const x = Math.floor(p.pos[0] + Math.sin(a) * d),
      z = Math.floor(p.pos[2] + Math.cos(a) * d);
    if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) return;
    const y = w.surfaceY(x, z) + 1;
    if (y < 10 || w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z) !== 172) return;
    const m = new Enderman(this, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
    if (!m.collides(m.box())) this.entities.push(m);
    return;
  }
  if (this.dim !== 'nether' || hostiles >= 24) return;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      d = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
    const x = Math.floor(p.pos[0] + Math.sin(a) * d),
      z = Math.floor(p.pos[2] + Math.cos(a) * d);
    if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) continue;
    let y = Math.floor(p.pos[1]) + (Math.random() * 40 | 0) - 20;
    y = clamp(y, 32, 120);
    while (y > 31 && w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== 0) y++;
    while (y > 31 && w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z) === 0) y--;
    if (y <= 31 || w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) !== 0 || !SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)]) continue;
    const r = Math.random();
    let type;
    if (w.inFortress(x, y, z) && r < 0.5) type = 'blaze';else if (r < 0.55) type = 'zombified_piglin';else if (r < 0.7) type = 'magma_cube';else if (r < 0.82) type = 'ghast';else if (r < 0.88) type = 'enderman';else continue;
    if (type === 'ghast') {
      let ok = true;
      for (let dy = 2; dy < 8 && ok; dy++) for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2 && ok; dx += 2) for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2 && ok; dz += 2) if (w.getBlock(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz) !== 0) ok = false;
      if (!ok || this.entities.filter(e => e instanceof Ghast).length >= 3) continue;
      this.entities.push(new Ghast(this, x + 0.5, y + 3, z + 0.5));
      continue;
    }
    const n = type === 'zombified_piglin' ? 2 + (Math.random() * 3 | 0) : 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const m = createMob(this, type, x + 0.5 + (i ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3 : 0), y, z + 0.5 + (i ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3 : 0));
      if (type === 'magma_cube') m.setSize([1, 2, 4][Math.random() * 3 | 0]);
      if (!m.collides(m.box())) this.entities.push(m);
    }
  }
};

// endermen notice being stared at
Game.prototype.checkEnderStare = function () {
  const p = this.player;
  if (p.creative || p.deathTime > 0) return;
  const eye = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + p.eye(), p.pos[2]],
    dir = this.lookDir();
  for (const e of this.entities) {
    if (!(e instanceof Enderman) || e.angry || e.deathTime > 0) continue;
    const hx = e.pos[0] - eye[0],
      hy = e.pos[1] + 2.6 - eye[1],
      hz = e.pos[2] - eye[2],
      d = Math.hypot(hx, hy, hz);
    if (d > 64 || d < 0.5) continue;
    // (vanilla isLookingAtMe: 1 - 0.025 / d - it was half as wide again: angry without being looked at, feedback 2026-11-01/02)
    if ((hx * dir[0] + hy * dir[1] + hz * dir[2]) / d > 1 - 0.025 / d && e.canSee(p)) {
      if (p.inv.slots[36] && ITEMS[p.inv.slots[36].id].key === 'carved_pumpkin') continue;
      e.provoke(p);
      Sound.ev('entity.enderman.stare', e.pos, 1, 1);
      if (d > 8) teleportEntity(e, p.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4, p.pos[1] + 1, p.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4);
    }
  }
};

// ---- locate helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.nearestStronghold = function () {
  const p = this.player;
  let best = null,
    bd = 1e9;
  const w = this.dim === 'overworld' ? this.world : this.dimData.overworld && this.dimData.overworld.world;
  if (!w) return null;
  for (const s of w.strongholds()) {
    const d = Math.hypot(s.x - p.pos[0], s.z - p.pos[2]);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      best = s;
    }
  }
  return best;
};

// ---- bed explosions ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.bedExplode = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world,
    meta = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  const R = [4, 1, 5, 0][meta & 3],
    D2 = DIRS[meta & 4 ? OPP[R] : R];
  w.setBlock(x + D2[0], y, z + D2[2], 0, 0, 0);
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
  this.explode(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, 5, null, false, true);
};

// ---- credits ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CreditsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, onDone) {
    super(game, null);
    this.onDone = onDone;
    this.pauses = true;
    this.t = 0;
    this.last = performance.now();
    this.bgDim = 0;
    this.blurBg = false;
    const lines = [];
    const T = window.MC_TEXTS || {};
    const fmt = s => s.replace(/PLAYERNAME/g, '玩家');
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) lines.push({
      t: ''
    });
    lines.push({
      logo: true
    }, {
      t: ''
    }, {
      t: ''
    });
    if (T['end.txt']) {
      for (const raw of T['end.txt'].split('\n')) {
        let col = '#FFFFFF',
          s = fmt(raw);
        const m = s.match(/^§(.)/);
        if (m) {
          col = {
            '2': '#00AA00',
            '3': '#00AAAA',
            'f': '#FFFFFF',
            '7': '#AAAAAA'
          }[m[1]] || '#FFFFFF';
        }
        s = s.replace(/§k([^§]*)/g, (a, b) => '\u0001' + b + '\u0002').replace(/§./g, '');
        for (const w of this.wrap(s, 274)) lines.push({
          t: w,
          col
        });
        lines.push({
          t: ''
        });
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) lines.push({
      t: ''
    });
    try {
      const credits = JSON.parse(T['credits.json'] || '[]');
      for (const sec of credits) {
        lines.push({
          t: ''
        }, {
          t: '============',
          col: '#FFFFFF',
          center: true
        }, {
          t: sec.section,
          col: '#FFFF55',
          center: true
        }, {
          t: '============',
          col: '#FFFFFF',
          center: true
        }, {
          t: ''
        });
        for (const d of sec.disciplines || []) {
          if (d.discipline) lines.push({
            t: d.discipline,
            col: '#AAAAAA',
            center: true
          }, {
            t: ''
          });
          for (const ti of d.titles || []) {
            lines.push({
              t: ti.title,
              col: '#777777',
              center: true
            });
            for (const n of ti.names || []) lines.push({
              t: n,
              col: '#FFFFFF',
              center: true
            });
            lines.push({
              t: ''
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    if (T['postcredits.txt']) for (const raw of T['postcredits.txt'].split('\n')) for (const w of this.wrap(raw.replace(/§./g, ''), 274)) lines.push({
      t: w,
      col: '#FFFFFF',
      center: true
    });
    lines.push({
      t: ''
    }, {
      t: '本作品为非官方复刻 · 感谢游玩！',
      col: '#FFFF55',
      center: true
    });
    this.lines = lines;
  }
  wrap(s, maxW) {
    const out = [];
    let cur = '';
    for (const word of s.split(' ')) {
      const test = cur ? cur + ' ' + word : word;
      if (Font.width(test.replace(/[\u0001\u0002]/g, '')) > maxW && cur) {
        out.push(cur);
        cur = word;
      } else cur = test;
    }
    out.push(cur);
    return out;
  }
  layout() {}
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      now = performance.now(),
      dt = Math.min(100, now - this.last);
    this.last = now;
    const h = this.held || {},
      fast = h.Space || h.ControlLeft || h.ControlRight;
    this.t += dt * (fast ? 0.12 : 0.025);
    c.fillStyle = '#000';
    c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, ui.h);
    const x0 = Math.floor(ui.w / 2 - 137);
    let y = ui.h - this.t;
    for (const L of this.lines) {
      if (y > -20 && y < ui.h + 10) {
        if (L.logo) {
          c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
          c.drawImage(ui.img.logo, 0, 0, 1024, 256, ui.w / 2 - 137, y - 10, 274, 68);
          c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
        } else if (L.t) {
          let s = L.t;
          if (s.includes('\u0001')) s = s.replace(/\u0001([^\u0002]*)\u0002/g, (a, b) => b.split('').map(ch => ch === ' ' ? ' ' : String.fromCharCode(33 + (Math.random() * 90 | 0))).join(''));
          if (L.center) Font.center(c, s, ui.w / 2, y, L.col || '#FFFFFF');else Font.draw(c, s, x0, y, L.col || '#FFFFFF');
        }
      }
      y += L.logo ? 80 : 12;
    }
    if (y < -20) this.finish();
    Font.draw(c, '按住空格加速 · Esc 跳过', 4, ui.h - 12, '#555555');
  }
  finish() {
    if (this.done) return;
    this.done = true;
    removeEventListener('keyup', this.unhold);
    removeEventListener('blur', this.unhold);
    this.game.ui.screen = null;
    this.onDone();
  }
  // (the touch close button: through onEsc - ui.close() left the player in the End)
  onEsc() {
    this.finish();
  }
  // speeding up while space or ctrl is held (vanilla WinScreen): every key stops here, so game.keys never had them -
  // the keys are kept here, let go of on keyup / leaving the window
  key(ui, ev) {
    if (ev.key === 'Escape') {
      this.finish();
      return true;
    }
    if (ev.code === 'Space' || ev.code === 'ControlLeft' || ev.code === 'ControlRight') {
      if (!this.unhold) {
        this.unhold = e => {
          if (e.type === 'blur') this.held = {};else if (this.held) delete this.held[e.code];
        };
        addEventListener('keyup', this.unhold);
        addEventListener('blur', this.unhold);
      }
      (this.held || (this.held = {}))[ev.code] = true;
    }
    return true;
  }
  mouseDown() {}
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/nether_mobs.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mobs of the vanilla (gen-2) Nether: piglins (with bartering), hoglins and striders, golden armour,
// and biome-driven Nether spawning from the biome JSON "spawners".
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Object.assign(MOB_TYPES, {
  piglin: {
    cn: '猪灵',
    hp: 16,
    w: 0.6,
    h: 1.95,
    speed: 0.35,
    model: 'zombified_piglin',
    tex: 'piglin',
    hostile: true,
    neutral: true,
    attack: 5,
    drops: [],
    scale: 0.9375
  },
  hoglin: {
    cn: '疣猪兽',
    hp: 40,
    w: 1.3965,
    h: 1.4,
    speed: 0.3,
    model: 'hoglin',
    hostile: true,
    attack: 6,
    drops: [['porkchop', 2, 4, 'cooked_porkchop'], ['leather', 0, 1]],
    scale: 1
  },
  strider: {
    cn: '炽足兽',
    hp: 20,
    w: 0.9,
    h: 1.7,
    speed: 0.175,
    model: 'strider',
    passive: true,
    fireproof: true,
    drops: [['string', 2, 5]],
    scale: 1
  }
});
(() => {
  const prev = createMob;
  createMob = function (game, type, x, y, z) {
    if (type === 'piglin') return new Piglin(game, x, y, z);
    if (type === 'hoglin') return new Hoglin(game, x, y, z);
    if (type === 'strider') return new Strider(game, x, y, z);
    return prev(game, type, x, y, z);
  };
})();
const wearsGold = p => p.inv.slots.slice(36, 40).some(s => s && ITEMS[s.id].key.startsWith('golden_'));

// ---- Piglin ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// neutral while the player wears any golden armour; takes gold ingots (thrown or handed over),
// admires them for 6 s and throws back a bartering item
const BARTER = [['iron_boots', 8, 1, 1], ['ender_pearl', 10, 2, 4], ['string', 20, 3, 9], ['quartz', 20, 5, 12], ['obsidian', 40, 1, 1], ['crying_obsidian', 40, 1, 3], ['fire_charge', 40, 1, 1], ['leather', 40, 2, 4], ['soul_sand', 40, 2, 8], ['nether_brick', 40, 2, 8], ['arrow', 40, 6, 12], ['gravel', 40, 8, 16], ['blackstone', 40, 8, 16], ['iron_nugget', 10, 10, 36]];
class Piglin extends Mob {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, 'piglin', x, y, z);
    this.angry = 0;
    this.admire = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r && src && src.attacker) {
      for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof Piglin && e.distTo(this) < 16) {
        e.angry = 600;
        e.target = src.attacker;
        e.admire = 0;
      }
      Sound.ev('entity.piglin.angry', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
    return r;
  }
  give(stack) {
    // a gold ingot handed over or picked up
    if (this.admire > 0 || this.angry > 0) return false;
    this.admire = 120;
    this.target = null;
    this.holding = item('gold_ingot');
    Sound.ev('entity.piglin.admiring_item', this.pos, 1, 1);
    return true;
  }
  barter() {
    const L = BARTER.filter(b => ITEM_KEY[b[0]] !== undefined),
      tot = L.reduce((a, b) => a + b[1], 0);
    let r = Math.random() * tot;
    for (const [k, w, a, b] of L) {
      if ((r -= w) >= 0) continue;
      const g = this.game,
        dir = Math.atan2(g.player.pos[0] - this.pos[0], g.player.pos[2] - this.pos[2]);
      g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1.2, this.pos[2], makeStack(k, a + Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1))), [Math.sin(dir) * 0.2, 0.25, Math.cos(dir) * 0.2]);
      return;
    }
  }
  tick() {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player;
    if (this.admire > 0) {
      this.savePrev();
      this.baseTick();
      if (this.deathTick()) return;
      if (--this.admire === 0) {
        this.holding = null;
        this.barter();
      }
      this.headYaw *= 0.8;
      this.pitch = 0.5;
      this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
      this.animate();
      return;
    }
    // pick up gold ingots lying nearby
    if (this.age % 10 === 0) for (const e of g.entities) {
      if (!(e instanceof ItemEntity) || e.dead || e.stack.id !== ITEM_KEY.gold_ingot || e.distTo(this) > 8) continue;
      if (e.distTo(this) < 1.5) {
        if (this.give(e.stack)) {
          if (--e.stack.count <= 0) e.dead = true;
        }
      } else this.wander = [e.pos[0], e.pos[1], e.pos[2]], this.wanderT = 40;
      break;
    }
    // hostile unless the player shows gold (or after being provoked)
    const calm = wearsGold(p) && this.angry <= 0;
    if (this.angry > 0) this.angry--;
    this.T = calm ? PIGLIN_CALM : MOB_TYPES.piglin;
    if (calm && this.target === p) this.target = null;
    super.tick();
    this.T = MOB_TYPES.piglin;
  }
  pose(a) {
    const P = super.pose(a);
    const swing = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
      amt = this.limbAmt;
    P.rarm = {
      rx: Math.cos(swing + Math.PI) * 1.4 * amt * 0.5 + (this.swingT > 0 ? Math.sin(this.swingT / 6 * Math.PI) : 0)
    };
    P.larm = {
      rx: this.admire > 0 ? 1.2 : Math.cos(swing) * 1.4 * amt * 0.5
    };
    P.rleg = {
      rx: Math.cos(swing) * 1.4 * amt
    };
    P.lleg = {
      rx: Math.cos(swing + Math.PI) * 1.4 * amt
    };
    return P;
  }
}
const PIGLIN_CALM = Object.assign({}, MOB_TYPES.piglin, {
  hostile: false
});

// ---- Hoglin ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Hoglin extends Mob {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, 'hoglin', x, y, z);
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  tick() {
    const g = this.game,
      before = this.attackCd;
    // hoglins avoid warped fungus
    if (this.age % 20 === 0) {
      const bx = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        by = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
        bz = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      for (let dx = -6; dx <= 6 && !this.fleeing; dx += 2) for (let dz = -6; dz <= 6; dz += 2) if (this.world.getBlock(bx + dx, by, bz + dz) === BID.warped_fungus) {
        this.panic = 60;
        this.target = null;
        this.fleeing = true;
        break;
      }
      this.fleeing = false;
    }
    super.tick();
    // vanilla hoglin attack: random 3..8 damage (from the base attack) and a strong upward knockback
    if (this.attackCd === 20 && before !== 20 && this.target) {
      const t = this.target,
        dx = t.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
        dz = t.pos[2] - this.pos[2],
        d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      t.vel[0] += dx / d * 0.6;
      t.vel[2] += dz / d * 0.6;
      t.vel[1] = Math.max(t.vel[1], 0.55);
      Sound.ev('entity.hoglin.attack', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
  }
  pose(a) {
    const swing = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
      amt = this.limbAmt;
    const l = Math.cos(swing) * 1.2 * amt,
      r = Math.cos(swing + Math.PI) * 1.2 * amt;
    const attack = this.swingT > 0 ? Math.sin(this.swingT / 6 * Math.PI) * 0.6 : 0;
    return {
      head: {
        ry: this.headYaw,
        rx: -attack
      },
      leg0: {
        rx: l
      },
      leg1: {
        rx: r
      },
      leg2: {
        rx: r
      },
      leg3: {
        rx: l
      }
    };
  }
}

// ---- Strider ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// walks on lava (it stands on the surface like on a floor) and shivers on land
class Strider extends Mob {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, 'strider', x, y, z);
    this.warm = true;
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  lavaBelow() {
    return this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1] - 0.1), Math.floor(this.pos[2])) === LAVA || this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1]), Math.floor(this.pos[2])) === LAVA;
  }
  tick() {
    const w = this.world,
      x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    // float up to the lava surface and stand on it
    let iy = Math.floor(this.pos[1]);
    if (w.getBlock(x, iy, z) === LAVA) {
      while (w.getBlock(x, iy + 1, z) === LAVA) iy++;
      if (this.pos[1] < iy + 1) {
        this.vel[1] = Math.min(0.15, iy + 1 - this.pos[1]);
        this.fallDist = 0;
      }
    }
    const onLava = w.getBlock(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1] - 0.05), z) === LAVA && w.getBlock(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1] + 0.2), z) !== LAVA;
    if (onLava) {
      this.pos[1] = Math.floor(this.pos[1] - 0.05) + 1;
      this.vel[1] = Math.max(0, this.vel[1]);
      this.onGround = true;
      this.fallDist = 0;
    }
    this.warm = this.lavaBelow() || onLava;
    super.tick();
    this.fire = 0;
    if (onLava && this.vel[1] < 0) this.vel[1] = 0;
  }
  pose(a) {
    const swing = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a) * 1.5,
      amt = Math.min(1, this.limbAmt * 2);
    const t = this.age + a,
      shiver = this.warm ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.05;
    const P = {
      rleg: {
        rx: Math.sin(swing) * 2 * amt
      },
      lleg: {
        rx: Math.sin(swing + Math.PI) * 2 * amt
      },
      body: {
        rz: shiver,
        t: [0, Math.abs(Math.sin(swing)) * 0.1 * amt, 0]
      }
    };
    const wave = Math.sin(t * 0.25) * 0.1;
    P.rb0 = {
      rz: wave
    };
    P.rb1 = {
      rz: wave * 0.8
    };
    P.rb2 = {
      rz: wave * 0.6
    };
    P.lb0 = {
      rz: -wave
    };
    P.lb1 = {
      rz: -wave * 0.8
    };
    P.lb2 = {
      rz: -wave * 0.6
    };
    return P;
  }
}

// ---- spawning in the vanilla Nether: biome "spawners" lists ---------------------------------------
// the fortress (from the generator's structure references) whose box holds this column, or null
Game.prototype.fortressAt = function (x, z) {
  const refs = this.world.structRefs;
  if (!refs) return null;
  for (const s of refs.values()) if (s.name === 'fortress' && x >= s.box[0] && x <= s.box[3] && z >= s.box[2] && z <= s.box[5]) return s;
  return null;
};
// (magma cubes as vanilla's Slime.finalizeSpawn: size 1, 2 or 4 - createMob makes them all 4, the biggest)
const netherMade = m => {
  if (m.type === 'magma_cube' && m.setSize) m.setSize([1, 2, 4][randInt(0, 2)]);
};
// a spot for a nether mob at this height, by vanilla's spawn rules there: a floor a mob may stand on below (not a light
// block, magma only for the fireproof) and no solid block or fluid where it stands (striders: on the lava surface);
// endermen and skeletons only in block light up to 7 (Monster.checkMonsterSpawnRules in the nether), piglins, hoglins and
// zombified piglins never on nether wart blocks; the rest at any light. `roll`: ghasts pass one time in 20
// (Ghast.checkGhastSpawnRules) - left out, ghasts came as often as anything else and four at a time: "恶魂一次刷三只",
// "恶魂太多、刷得太快", feedback 2026-11-01..03
function netherSpot(g, type, x, y, z, roll = true) {
  const w = g.world,
    below = w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z),
    here = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    up = w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z);
  const room = id => id === 0 || !BLOCKS[id].solid && !IS_FLUID[id] && !/fire$/.test(BLOCKS[id].key);
  if (type === 'strider') return below === LAVA && here === 0;
  if (!SOLIDCUBE[below] || EMIT[below] >= 14 || below === BID.magma_block && !MOB_TYPES[type].fireproof || !room(here) || !room(up)) return false;
  if ((type === 'enderman' || type === 'skeleton' || type === 'wither_skeleton') && (w.getLight(x, y, z) & 15) > 7) return false;
  if (/piglin|hoglin/.test(type) && below === BID.nether_wart_block) return false;
  return !(roll && type === 'ghast' && Math.random() >= 1 / 20);
}
// one group from the fortress's spawn list, on a nether-brick floor of this column with room above; false if there is none
Game.prototype.spawnFortressGroup = function (fort, x, z, sp) {
  const w = this.world,
    def = self.STRUCT_DATA && STRUCT_DATA.structure.fortress,
    list = def && def.spawn_overrides && def.spawn_overrides.monster;
  if (!list) return false;
  // (inside the fortress's box, on its floors: as the spawnAttempt walk goes, of 4 mobs at most - a pack of 5 wither
  // skeletons used to land inside 2 x 2 blocks)
  const spot = (t, a, b, c) => w.getBlock(a, b - 1, c) === BID.nether_bricks && this.fortressAt(a, c) === fort && netherSpot(this, t, a, b, c);
  for (let y = Math.max(1, fort.box[1]); y <= fort.box[4]; y++) {
    if (w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z) !== BID.nether_bricks || w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== 0 || w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) !== 0) continue;
    const pick = spawnPickOf(list.spawns);
    if (!pick || !spot(pick.type.replace('minecraft:', ''), x, y, z)) continue;
    spawnAttempt(this, pick, x, y, z, sp, spot, () => spawnPickOf(list.spawns), netherMade);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};
// Spawning in the nether by its biome lists, with the overworld's area, caps and spawn attempts (spawning.js spawnArea and
// spawnAttempt): the cap here was 30 for every mob loaded anywhere, and a group came out all at one spot
Game.prototype.spawnNetherV = function () {
  if (this.difficulty === 0) return;
  const sp = spawnArea(this);
  if (!sp.n) return;
  const counts = {};
  for (const e of this.entities) {
    if (!(e instanceof Mob) || e.dead || spawnMustKeep(e) || !sp.has(e.pos[0], e.pos[2])) continue;
    const c = e.T.passive ? 'creature' : 'monster';
    counts[c] = (counts[c] || 0) + 1;
  }
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    const at = sp.pick();
    if (!at || !sp.ok(at[0], at[1])) continue;
    const [x, z] = at,
      v = this.vbiomeAt(x, z);
    if (!v || !v.def.spawners) continue;
    const cat = Math.random() < 0.1 ? 'creature' : 'monster';
    if ((counts[cat] || 0) >= Math.max(1, Math.round(SPAWN_CAPS[cat] * sp.scale))) continue;
    // inside a nether fortress, standing on its nether-brick floors, the fortress's own list replaces the biome's
    // (vanilla spawn_overrides, bounding box "piece"): blazes, wither skeletons, skeletons, magma cubes, piglins
    const fort = cat === 'monster' && this.fortressAt(x, z);
    if (fort && this.spawnFortressGroup(fort, x, z, sp)) return;
    const pick = spawnPickOf(v.def.spawners[cat]);
    if (!pick) continue;
    const type = pick.type.replace('minecraft:', '');
    // a random y with a floor below and room (the ghast's one-in-20 roll once for the attempt, not for each height)
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      const y = 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 110);
      if (!netherSpot(this, type, x, y, z, false)) continue;
      if (type === 'ghast' && Math.random() >= 1 / 20) return;
      spawnAttempt(this, pick, x, y, z, sp, (t, a, b, c) => netherSpot(this, t, a, b, c), (a, c) => {
        const vb = this.vbiomeAt(a, c);
        return vb && vb.def.spawners ? spawnPickOf(vb.def.spawners[cat]) : null;
      }, netherMade);
      return;
    }
  }
};
// Ghasts only went when more than 128 blocks away (mobs2.js), never by chance as other monsters do (vanilla
// Mob.checkDespawn: past 32 blocks, one tick in 800 once idle for 30 s): the ones spawned stayed for good and piled up
(() => {
  const _t = Ghast.prototype.tick;
  Ghast.prototype.tick = function () {
    if (!this.persistent && !this.customName && !this.remote && !this.leashHolder && this.age > 600 && Math.random() < 1 / 800 && this.distTo(this.game.player) > 32) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    return _t.call(this);
  };
})();
</script>

// villager type from the biome (VillagerType.byBiome)
function villagerTypeAt(game, x, z) {
  const v = game.vbiomeAt && game.vbiomeAt(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(z));
  const n = v && v.name || 'plains';
  if (/desert|badlands/.test(n)) return 'desert';
  if (/jungle|bamboo/.test(n)) return 'jungle';
  if (/savanna/.test(n)) return 'savanna';
  if (/snowy|frozen|ice|grove|jagged|frozen_peaks/.test(n)) return 'snow';
  if (/swamp|mangrove/.test(n)) return 'swamp';
  if (/taiga/.test(n)) return 'taiga';
  return 'plains';
}

// composite skin (base + biome type + profession), built once per combination
function villagerSkin(r, zombie, type, prof) {
  const key = (zombie ? 'zv_' : 'v_') + type + '_' + prof;
  if (r.entityTex[key]) return key;
  const I = r.images,
    base = I[zombie ? 'zombie_villager' : 'villager'];
  if (!base) return zombie ? 'zombie' : 'steve';
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = base.width;
  c.height = base.height;
  const x = c.getContext('2d');
  x.drawImage(base, 0, 0);
  const t = I[(zombie ? 'zvt_' : 'vt_') + type];
  if (t) x.drawImage(t, 0, 0);
  const p = prof !== 'none' && I[(zombie ? 'zvp_' : 'vp_') + prof];
  if (p) x.drawImage(p, 0, 0);
  r.entityTex[key] = r.tex2D(c);
  return key;
}
const entityTexOf = (r, key) => {
  if (!r.entityTex[key] && r.images[key]) r.entityTex[key] = r.tex2D(r.images[key]);
  return key;
};

// ---- Villager -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Villager extends Mob {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, 'villager', x, y, z);
    this.persistent = true;
    this.vtype = villagerTypeAt(g, x, z);
    this.profession = Math.random() < 0.6 ? PROFESSIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * PROFESSIONS.length)] : 'none';
    this.home = [x, y, z];
    this.shake = 0;
  }
  skin(r) {
    return villagerSkin(r, false, this.vtype || 'plains', this.profession || 'none');
  }
  saveData() {
    return {
      t: this.vtype,
      p: this.profession,
      h: this.home,
      tr: this.trades,
      lv: this.vlevel,
      xp: this.vxp,
      rd: this.restockDay,
      j: this.job
    };
  }
  loadData(d) {
    this.vtype = d.t || this.vtype;
    this.profession = d.p || 'none';
    if (d.h) this.home = d.h;
    if (d.tr) {
      this.trades = d.tr;
      this.vlevel = d.lv || 1;
      this.vxp = d.xp || 0;
    }
    this.restockDay = d.rd;
    this.job = d.j;
  }
  tick() {
    const g = this.game;
    // run from zombies, stay near home
    if (this.age % 10 === 0) {
      for (const e of g.entities) if (e instanceof Mob && (e.type === 'zombie' || e.type === 'zombie_villager') && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 8) {
        this.panic = 60;
        break;
      }
      if (!this.panic && !this.wander && Math.hypot(this.pos[0] - this.home[0], this.pos[2] - this.home[2]) > 24 && Math.random() < 0.2) {
        this.wander = [this.home[0], this.home[1], this.home[2]];
        this.wanderT = 200;
      }
    }
    if (this.shake > 0) this.shake--;
    if (!this.baby && this.age % 100 === 37) {
      // its job site gone (broken or swapped): vanilla lets the site go, and one that never traded loses its profession
      if (this.job && this.profession !== 'none') {
        const [jx, jy, jz] = this.job.split(',').map(Number),
          b = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(jx, jy, jz)];
        if (this.world.isLoaded(jx, jz) && !(b && JOB_SITES[b.key] === this.profession)) {
          this.job = null;
          if (!this.vxp && (this.vlevel || 1) <= 1) {
            this.profession = 'none';
            this.trades = null;
          }
        }
      }
      // unemployed adults claim a free job site nearby; one with a profession and no site looks for its own kind
      if (this.profession === 'none') this.findJob();else if (!this.job && this.profession !== 'nitwit' && this.age % 400 === 37) this.findJob(this.profession);
    }
    super.tick();
  }
  findJob(prof) {
    const g = this.game,
      w = this.world;
    // (the sites the living villagers hold: one that died or lost its job lets its site go)
    const claimed = new Set();
    for (const e of g.entities) if (e instanceof Villager && e !== this && !e.dead && e.job) claimed.add(e.job);
    // (and those of villagers waiting in unloaded chunks)
    for (const m of g.pendingMobs || []) if (m.type === 'villager' && m.x && m.x.j && !(m.health != null && m.health <= 0)) claimed.add(m.x.j);
    const bx = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      by = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
      bz = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    for (let r = 1; r <= 16; r++) for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) for (let dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
      if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) !== r) continue;
      for (let dy = -3; dy <= 3; dy++) {
        const b = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(bx + dx, by + dy, bz + dz)],
          job = b && JOB_SITES[b.key],
          k = bx + dx + ',' + (by + dy) + ',' + (bz + dz);
        if (!job || claimed.has(k) || prof && job !== prof) continue;
        this.job = k;
        if (prof) return;
        this.profession = job;
        this.trades = null;
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) g.particles.spawn('happy_villager', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), this.pos[1] + 1.5 + Math.random() * 0.5, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.05, 0);
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  interact(p) {
    // trading arrives with the merchant screen; for now villagers shake their heads like unemployed ones
    if (typeof MerchantScreen !== 'undefined' && this.profession !== 'none' && this.profession !== 'nitwit' && !this.baby) {
      this.game.ui.open(new MerchantScreen(this.game, this));
      Sound.ev('entity.villager.trade', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    this.shake = 40;
    Sound.ev('entity.villager.no', this.pos, 1, 1);
    return true;
  }
  // killed by a zombie on Normal (half the time) or Hard, it rises as a zombie villager keeping its type, profession
  // and trades, and drops nothing (vanilla Zombie.killedEntity / convertVillagerToZombieVillager)
  die(src) {
    const z = src && src.attacker,
      d = this.game.difficulty;
    if (z && /^(zombie|zombie_villager|husk|drowned|zombified_piglin)$/.test(z.type) && d >= 2 && (d === 3 || Math.random() < 0.5)) {
      const m = createMob(this.game, 'zombie_villager', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2]);
      m.vtype = this.vtype;
      m.profession = this.profession;
      m.trades = this.trades;
      m.vlevel = this.vlevel;
      m.vxp = this.vxp;
      m.yaw = this.yaw;
      m.bodyYaw = this.bodyYaw;
      m.headYaw = this.headYaw;
      if (this.baby) m.makeBaby();
      if (this.customName) m.customName = this.customName;
      // (vanilla: one that was traded with, or named, never despawns)
      if (this.vxp || this.customName) m.persistent = true;
      this.dead = true;
      if (Mob.modDeath) Mob.modDeath(this, src); // (mods' entityDeath still hears of it)
      this.game.addEntity(m);
      Sound.ev('entity.zombie.infect', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return;
    }
    super.die(src);
  }
  pose(a) {
    const swing = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
      amt = this.limbAmt;
    const l = Math.cos(swing) * 1.4 * amt * 0.5,
      r = Math.cos(swing + Math.PI) * 1.4 * amt * 0.5;
    const shake = this.shake > 0 ? 0.3 * Math.sin((this.shake - a) * 0.45) : 0;
    return {
      head: {
        ry: this.headYaw + shake,
        rx: this.pitch
      },
      rleg: {
        rx: l
      },
      lleg: {
        rx: r
      }
    };
  }
}

// ---- Iron golem ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class IronGolem extends Mob {
  // (vanilla: it doesn't jump - it steps up a whole block instead)
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, 'iron_golem', x, y, z);
    this.persistent = true;
    this.attackAnim = 0;
    this.noJump = true;
    this.stepHeight = 1;
  }
  // its texture, cracked like vanilla's below 3/4, 1/2 and 1/4 health. Without a skin of its own it looked for an
  // 'iron_golem' GL texture nobody made (the image was loaded, never uploaded) and was drawn black
  skin(r) {
    const f = this.health / this.maxHealth,
      crack = f < 0.25 ? 'high' : f < 0.5 ? 'medium' : f < 0.75 ? 'low' : null;
    const mix = crack && r.etexMix(['entity/iron_golem/iron_golem', 'entity/iron_golem/iron_golem_crackiness_' + crack]);
    return mix || entityTexOf(r, 'iron_golem');
  }
  tick() {
    const g = this.game;
    // guards the village: goes after hostile mobs nearby
    if (this.age % 20 === 0 && (!this.target || this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime > 0)) {
      this.target = null;
      let best = 16;
      for (const e of g.entities) if (e instanceof Mob && e.T.hostile && e.type !== 'creeper' && !e.dead && e.deathTime === 0) {
        const d = e.distTo(this);
        if (d < best) {
          best = d;
          this.target = e;
        }
      }
    }
    const before = this.attackCd;
    this.T = this.target ? GOLEM_HUNT : MOB_TYPES.iron_golem;
    super.tick();
    this.T = MOB_TYPES.iron_golem;
    if (this.attackCd === 20 && before !== 20) {
      this.attackAnim = 10;
      // (vanilla: the toss only when the blow did hurt - a target still hurt-immune from another golem's isn't thrown
      // higher - and less by its knockback resistance)
      const t = this.target;
      if (t && this.hitLanded && t.vel) t.vel[1] += 0.4 * Math.max(0, 1 - (t.T && t.T.kbRes || 0));
      Sound.ev('entity.iron_golem.attack', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
    if (this.attackAnim > 0) this.attackAnim--;
  }
  // (knockback resistance 1, like vanilla: never pushed back by hits - players' feedback 2026-10-31)
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (src && src.knockFrom) src = {
      ...src,
      knockFrom: null
    };
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r && src && src.attacker && src.attacker !== this.game.player) this.target = src.attacker;
    return r;
  }
  pose(a) {
    const t = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a),
      amt = this.limbAmt;
    const tri = (x, p) => (Math.abs(x % p - p * 0.5) - p * 0.25) / (p * 0.25);
    const P = {
      head: {
        ry: this.headYaw,
        rx: this.pitch
      }
    };
    P.rleg = {
      rx: -1.5 * tri(t, 13) * amt
    };
    P.lleg = {
      rx: 1.5 * tri(t, 13) * amt
    };
    if (this.attackAnim > 0) {
      const k = (this.attackAnim - a) / 10;
      const v = 2 - 4 * Math.abs(k - 0.5);
      P.rarm = {
        rx: v
      };
      P.larm = {
        rx: v
      };
    } else {
      P.rarm = {
        rx: (-0.2 + 1.5 * tri(t, 13)) * amt
      };
      P.larm = {
        rx: (-0.2 - 1.5 * tri(t, 13)) * amt
      };
    }
    return P;
  }
}
const GOLEM_HUNT = Object.assign({}, MOB_TYPES.iron_golem, {
  attack: 10,
  speed: 0.25
});

// ---- Cat ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const CAT_VARIANTS = ['tabby', 'black', 'red', 'siamese', 'british_shorthair', 'calico', 'persian', 'ragdoll', 'white', 'jellie', 'all_black'];
class Cat extends Mob {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, 'cat', x, y, z);
    this.variant = CAT_VARIANTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAT_VARIANTS.length)];
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  // (a tame one wears its collar, dyed - vanilla CatCollarLayer)
  skin(r) {
    const mix = this.owner && r.etexMix(['entity/cat/cat_' + this.variant, {
      p: 'entity/cat/cat_collar',
      c: dyeRGB(this.collar || 'red')
    }]);
    return mix || entityTexOf(r, 'cat_' + this.variant);
  }
  saveData() {
    return {
      v: this.variant,
      own: this.owner ? 1 : 0,
      sit: this.sitting ? 1 : 0,
      col: this.collar
    };
  }
  loadData(d) {
    if (d.v) this.variant = d.v;
    if (d.own) this.owner = this.game.player;
    this.sitting = !!d.sit;
    if (d.col) this.collar = d.col;
  }
  // taming as vanilla's Cat.mobInteract: raw cod or salmon, a 1 in 3 chance; tame, it sits or stands when clicked, is
  // healed or bred with the food, and its collar dyed (feeding a wild one only put it in love, it was never tamed)
  interact(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id] && ITEMS[held.id].key,
      food = k === 'cod' || k === 'salmon';
    if (Mob.prototype.interact && Mob.prototype.interact.call(this, p, held)) return true; // (name tags, leads: mobitems.js)
    if (!this.owner) {
      if (!food) return false;
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.cat.eat', this.pos, 1, 1);
      tryTame(this, p, 1 / 3);
      if (this.owner) this.sitT = undefined;
      return true;
    }
    if (this.owner !== p) return false;
    if (k && /_dye$/.test(k)) {
      if (this.collar === k.slice(0, -4)) return false;
      this.collar = k.slice(0, -4);
      useOne(g, p);
      return true;
    }
    if (food && this.health < this.maxHealth) {
      this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 2);
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.cat.eat', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (food && !this.baby && !this.loveT) {
      this.loveT = 600;
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.cat.eat', this.pos, 1, 1);
      const mate = g.entities.find(o => o !== this && o instanceof Cat && o.owner && o.loveT > 0 && !o.baby && !o.dead && o.distTo(this) < 8);
      if (mate) {
        this.loveT = mate.loveT = 0;
        const b = createMob(g, 'cat', (this.pos[0] + mate.pos[0]) / 2, this.pos[1], (this.pos[2] + mate.pos[2]) / 2).makeBaby();
        b.variant = Math.random() < 0.5 ? this.variant : mate.variant;
        b.owner = this.owner;
        g.entities.push(b);
        g.dropXp(b.pos[0], b.pos[1] + 0.5, b.pos[2], 1 + (Math.random() * 7 | 0));
      }
      return true;
    }
    if (food) return false;
    this.sitting = !this.sitting;
    this.sitT = undefined;
    this.wander = null;
    return true;
  }
  // (hurt, a tame one gets up - TamableAnimal)
  hurt(a, src) {
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r) this.sitting = false;
    return r;
  }
  tick() {
    // told to sit: stays down; otherwise sometimes sits for a while
    if (this.sitting) this.sitT = 2;else if (!this.panic && this.sitT === undefined && !this.owner && Math.random() < 0.002) this.sitT = 200 + Math.random() * 400;
    if (this.sitT !== undefined) {
      if (--this.sitT <= 0 || this.panic) this.sitT = undefined;else {
        this.wander = null;
      }
    }
    // a tame one keeps up with its owner (vanilla FollowOwnerGoal: walks after it past 6 blocks, jumps to it past 12)
    else if (this.owner && this.age % 10 === 0) {
      const c = {};
      if (PetMixin.followOwner.call(this, c) && c.goal) {
        this.wander = c.goal;
        this.wanderT = 20;
      }
    }
    // (sitting, it stays put - it still walked after the fish in a player's hand)
    const T = this.T;
    if (this.sitT !== undefined) this.T = Cat.SIT_T || (Cat.SIT_T = {
      ...T,
      speed: 0
    });
    super.tick();
    this.T = T;
  }
  pose(a) {
    const swing = lerp(this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt, this.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
      amt = this.limbAmt;
    const l = Math.cos(swing) * amt,
      r = Math.cos(swing + Math.PI) * amt;
    const P = {
      head: {
        ry: this.headYaw,
        rx: this.pitch
      },
      lfleg: {
        rx: l
      },
      rfleg: {
        rx: r
      },
      lhleg: {
        rx: r
      },
      rhleg: {
        rx: l
      }
    };
    if (this.sitT !== undefined) {
      // vanilla AdultFelineModel's sitting pose (pixel offsets y and x / rotations negated for this model's space; the
      // pose's rx adds to the part's own rotX: body pi/4, tail1 1.7278761, tail2 2.670354 in vanilla)
      const px = 1 / 16;
      P.body = {
        rx: Math.PI / 4,
        t: [0, 4 * px, 5 * px]
      };
      P.head.t = [0, 3.3 * px, 1 * px];
      P.lhleg = {
        rx: Math.PI / 2,
        t: [0, -3 * px, -4 * px]
      };
      P.rhleg = {
        rx: Math.PI / 2,
        t: [0, -3 * px, -4 * px]
      };
      P.lfleg = {
        rx: Math.PI / 20,
        t: [0, -2 * px, -2 * px]
      };
      P.rfleg = {
        rx: Math.PI / 20,
        t: [0, -2 * px, -2 * px]
      };
      P.tail1 = {
        rx: -1.7278761 + 0.9,
        t: [0, -8 * px, -2 * px]
      };
      P.tail2 = {
        rx: -2.670354 + 1.7,
        t: [0, -2 * px, -0.8 * px]
      };
    }
    return P;
  }
}

// zombie villagers: zombies with the villager body and skins
(() => {
  const prevCreate = createMob;
  createMob = function (game, type, x, y, z) {
    if (type === 'zombie_villager') {
      const m = new Mob(game, 'zombie_villager', x, y, z);
      m.vtype = villagerTypeAt(game, x, z);
      m.profession = 'none';
      m.skin = r => villagerSkin(r, true, m.vtype || 'plains', m.profession || 'none');
      // (a villager a zombie turned keeps its type, profession and trades in the save)
      m.saveData = function () {
        const o = Mob.prototype.saveData && Mob.prototype.saveData.call(this) || {};
        o.t = this.vtype;
        o.p = this.profession;
        if (this.trades) {
          o.tr = this.trades;
          o.lv = this.vlevel;
          o.xp = this.vxp;
        }
        if (this.customName) o.name = this.customName;
        return o;
      };
      // (a baby zombie villager never grows up, like baby zombies - Mob.makeBaby's 6000-tick countdown made it an adult;
      // tick holds it there too, for saves that restore the old countdown)
      m.makeBaby = function () {
        Mob.prototype.makeBaby.call(this);
        this.growT = 1e12;
        return this;
      };
      m.tick = function () {
        if (this.baby) this.growT = 1e12;
        return Mob.prototype.tick.call(this);
      };
      m.loadData = function (o) {
        if (Mob.prototype.loadData) Mob.prototype.loadData.call(this, o);
        if (!o) return;
        if (o.t) this.vtype = o.t;
        if (o.p) this.profession = o.p;
        if (o.tr) {
          this.trades = o.tr;
          this.vlevel = o.lv || 1;
          this.vxp = o.xp || 0;
        }
        if (o.name) this.customName = o.name;
      };
      m.pose = a => {
        const swing = lerp(m.limbSwing - m.limbAmt, m.limbSwing, a) * 0.6662,
          amt = m.limbAmt;
        const raise = Math.PI / 2 + Math.sin(m.age * 0.067) * 0.05;
        return {
          head: {
            ry: m.headYaw,
            rx: m.pitch
          },
          rarm: {
            rx: raise + (m.swingT > 0 ? Math.sin(m.swingT / 6 * Math.PI) * 0.6 : 0)
          },
          larm: {
            rx: raise
          },
          rleg: {
            rx: Math.cos(swing) * 1.4 * amt
          },
          lleg: {
            rx: Math.cos(swing + Math.PI) * 1.4 * amt
          }
        };
      };
      return m;
    }
    return prevCreate(game, type, x, y, z);
  };
})();

(() => {

  if (BID.carrots !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID.carrots].drops = (m, r, tool) => age(BID.carrots, m) >= 7 ? [['carrot', 1 + cropBonusCount(r, tool)]] : [['carrot', 1]];
