  weaponsmith: [[T_('coal', 15, E, 1, 16, 2), T_(E, 3, 'iron_axe', 1, 12, 1), T_(E, 2, 'iron_sword', 1, 12, 1)], [T_('iron_ingot', 4, E, 1, 12, 10), T_(E, 36, 'bell', 1, 12, 5)], [T_('flint', 24, E, 1, 12, 20)], [T_('diamond', 1, E, 1, 12, 30), T_(E, 17, 'diamond_axe', 1, 3, 15)], [T_(E, 13, 'diamond_sword', 1, 3, 30)]]
};
const LEVEL_XP = [0, 10, 70, 150, 250];
const LEVEL_CN = ['新手', '学徒', '老手', '专家', '大师'];
const hasItem = k => ITEM_KEY[k] !== undefined;

// a villager's offers: two random trades per level reached (the order is kept once chosen)
Villager.prototype.offers = function () {
  if (!this.trades) {
    this.trades = [];
    this.vlevel = 1;
    this.vxp = 0;
    this.addLevelTrades(1);
  }
  return this.trades;
};
Villager.prototype.addLevelTrades = function (lvl) {
  const L = (TRADES[this.profession] || [])[lvl - 1] || [];
  const pool = L.filter(t => hasItem(t.a) && hasItem(t.r) && (!t.b || hasItem(t.b)));
  for (let n = 0; n < 2 && pool.length; n++) {
    const t = pool.splice(Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length), 1)[0];
    this.trades.push({
      ...t,
      used: 0
    });
  }
};
Villager.prototype.gainXp = function (xp) {
  this.vxp += xp;
  while (this.vlevel < 5 && this.vxp >= LEVEL_XP[this.vlevel]) {
    this.vlevel++;
    this.addLevelTrades(this.vlevel);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) this.game.particles.spawn('happy_villager', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), this.pos[1] + 1 + Math.random(), this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.05, 0);
  }
};
// restock at most twice a day (vanilla: at the workstation)
Villager.prototype.restock = function () {
  const day = Math.floor((this.game.worldTime || 0) / 12000);
  if (this.restockDay === day) return;
  this.restockDay = day;
  for (const t of this.trades || []) t.used = 0;
};
class MerchantScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, v) {
    super(game, 'villager_gui', 276, 166, null);
    this.v = v;
    v.restock && v.restock();
    v.offers();
    this.sel = 0;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.pay = [null, null];
    this.out = null;
    this.slots.push({
      x: 136,
      y: 37,
      get: () => this.pay[0],
      set: s => {
        this.pay[0] = s;
        this.update();
      },
      group: 'container'
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 162,
      y: 37,
      get: () => this.pay[1],
      set: s => {
        this.pay[1] = s;
        this.update();
      },
      group: 'container'
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 220,
      y: 37,
      output: true,
      get: () => this.out,
      set: s => {
        this.out = s;
      },
      onTake: st => this.trade()
    });
    const inv = game.player.inv;
    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
      const i = 9 + r * 9 + c;
      this.slots.push({
        x: 108 + c * 18,
        y: 84 + r * 18,
        get: () => inv.slots[i],
        set: s => {
          inv.slots[i] = s;
        },
        group: 'main',
        idx: i
      });
    }
    for (let c = 0; c < 9; c++) this.slots.push({
      x: 108 + c * 18,
      y: 142,
      get: () => inv.slots[c],
      set: s => {
        inv.slots[c] = s;
      },
      group: 'hotbar',
      idx: c
    });
    this.pick(0);
  }
  get title2() {
    return PROFESSION_CN[this.v.profession] + ' - ' + LEVEL_CN[(this.v.vlevel || 1) - 1];
  }
  offer() {
    return this.v.offers()[this.sel];
  }
  // (every item of the name: the first wool blocks and the vanilla import's are two items - itemIds)
  matches(st, k, n) {
    return st && itemIds(k).includes(st.id) && st.count >= n;
  }
  update() {
    const o = this.offer();
    this.out = o && o.used < o.uses && this.matches(this.pay[0], o.a, o.an) && (!o.b || this.matches(this.pay[1], o.b, o.bn)) ? makeStack(o.r, o.rn) : null;
  }
  // choosing an offer moves its costs from the inventory into the payment slots (like vanilla)
  pick(i) {
    this.sel = i;
    const inv = this.game.player.inv,
      o = this.offer();
    for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (this.pay[k]) {
      this.giveBack(this.pay[k]);
      this.pay[k] = null;
    }
    if (o) [[o.a, o.an, 0], [o.b, o.bn, 1]].forEach(([key, n, k]) => {
      if (!key) return;
      const id = ITEM_KEY[key],
        ids = itemIds(key);
      let want = maxStack(id);
      for (let s = 0; s < 36 && want > 0; s++) {
        const st = inv.slots[s];
        if (!st || !ids.includes(st.id) || this.pay[k] && st.id !== this.pay[k].id) continue;
        const take = Math.min(st.count, want);
        want -= take;
        st.count -= take;
        if (!st.count) inv.slots[s] = null;
        if (this.pay[k]) this.pay[k].count += take;else this.pay[k] = {
          id: st.id,
          count: take,
          dmg: 0
        };
      }
    });
    this.update();
  }
  // (add gives back what did not fit: 0 is all of it - read the other way round the payment was both put back and
  // dropped, emeralds doubling at every change of offer: players' feedback 2026-10-31)
  giveBack(st) {
    const left = this.game.player.inv.add(st);
    if (left > 0) this.game.dropFromPlayer({
      ...st,
      count: left
    });
  }
  trade() {
    const o = this.offer();
    if (!o) return;
    this.pay[0].count -= o.an;
    if (!this.pay[0].count) this.pay[0] = null;
    if (o.b) {
      this.pay[1].count -= o.bn;
      if (!this.pay[1].count) this.pay[1] = null;
    }
    o.used++;
    this.v.gainXp(o.xp);
    this.game.addXp && this.game.addXp(3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4));
    Sound.ev('entity.villager.yes', this.v.pos, 1, 1);
    // refill the payment from the inventory to keep trading
    const keep = this.sel;
    this.pick(keep);
  }
  close() {
    for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (this.pay[k]) {
      this.giveBack(this.pay[k]);
      this.pay[k] = null;
    }
    this.out = null;
  }
  offerAt(mx, my) {
    const rx = mx - this.x - 5,
      ry = my - this.y - 18;
    if (rx < 0 || rx >= 88 || ry < 0) return -1;
    const i = Math.floor(ry / 20) + this.scroll;
    return ry < 140 && i < this.v.offers().length ? i : -1;
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const i = this.offerAt(mx, my);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.pick(i);
      Sound.click && Sound.click();
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  wheel(ui, d) {
    const n = this.v.offers().length;
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll + Math.sign(d), 0, Math.max(0, n - 7));
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      I = ui.img,
      v = this.v,
      offers = v.offers();
    const t = this.title2;
    Font.draw(c, t, this.x + 49 + 138 - Font.width(t) / 2, this.y + 6, '#404040', false);
    Font.draw(c, '交易', this.x + 5 - Font.width('交易') / 2 + 48, this.y + 6, '#404040', false);
    Font.draw(c, '物品栏', this.x + 107, this.y + 72, '#404040', false);
    // experience bar
    if (I.vxp_bg) {
      c.drawImage(I.vxp_bg, this.x + 136, this.y + 16);
      const lv = v.vlevel || 1;
      if (lv < 5 && I.vxp_cur) {
        const a = LEVEL_XP[lv - 1],
          b = LEVEL_XP[lv],
          w = Math.min(102, Math.floor(102 * (v.vxp - a) / (b - a)));
        if (w > 0) c.drawImage(I.vxp_cur, 0, 0, w, 5, this.x + 136, this.y + 16, w, 5);
      }
    }
    // offer buttons
    const hov = this.offerAt(ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    for (let r = 0; r < 7; r++) {
      const i = r + this.scroll,
        o = offers[i];
      if (!o) break;
      const bx = this.x + 5,
        by = this.y + 18 + r * 20;
      ui.nine(i === hov || i === this.sel ? 'button_hl' : 'button', bx, by, 88, 20, 3);
      const iy = by + 1;
      ui.drawItem(makeStack(o.a, o.an), this.x + 10, iy);
      if (o.b) ui.drawItem(makeStack(o.b, o.bn), this.x + 40, iy);
      const arrow = o.used >= o.uses ? I.trade_arrow_out : I.trade_arrow;
      if (arrow) c.drawImage(arrow, this.x + 60, by + 5);
      ui.drawItem(makeStack(o.r, o.rn), this.x + 73, iy);
    }
    if (offers.length > 7 && I.v_scroller) c.drawImage(I.v_scroller, this.x + 94, this.y + 18 + Math.floor(this.scroll / Math.max(1, offers.length - 7) * 112));
    const o = this.offer();
    if (o && o.used >= o.uses && I.out_of_stock) c.drawImage(I.out_of_stock, this.x + 186, this.y + 35);
    if (hov >= 0 && !ui.cursor) {
      const q = offers[hov],
        mx = ui.mouse.x;
      const which = mx < this.x + 36 ? makeStack(q.a, q.an) : mx < this.x + 60 && q.b ? makeStack(q.b, q.bn) : mx >= this.x + 70 ? makeStack(q.r, q.rn) : null;
      if (which) this.tipLater = which;
    }
  }
  draw(ui) {
    this.tipLater = null;
    super.draw(ui);
    if (this.tipLater) ui.tooltip(ui.itemLines(this.tipLater), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/effects.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status effects (vanilla's mob effects) on living things, potions, and what foods and drinks do.
// An effect: { amp (0 = level I), dur (ticks left, -1 = infinite), ambient }. On a server the server keeps them
// (net.js): here they only count down and change how this player moves, mines and sees.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// registry order (the protocol's effect ids), Chinese name, kind (1 good, -1 bad, 0 neutral), particle colour

  EFFECTS[k] = {

  };

const romanLevel = amp => amp > 0 ? ' ' + (['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V', 'VI', 'VII', 'VIII', 'IX', 'X'][amp] || String(amp + 1)) : '';

// a potion's colour: the effects' colours mixed (water's blue when it has none)
function potionColor(pot) {
  const fx = POTIONS[pot] || [];
  if (!fx.length) return pot === 'water' || !pot ? [56, 93, 198] : [0x38, 0x5D, 0xC6];
  let r = 0,
    g = 0,
    b = 0,
    n = 0;
  for (const [e,, amp] of fx) {
    const c = EFFECTS[e].color,
      w = amp + 1;
    r += (c >> 16 & 255) * w;
    g += (c >> 8 & 255) * w;
    b += (c & 255) * w;
    n += w;
  }
  return [r / n, g / n, b / n].map(Math.round);
}

  dried_kelp: 16,
  honey_bottle: 40
};

// ---- effects on living things ----
Object.assign(Living.prototype, {
  addEffect(key, amp, dur, ambient = false) {
    const E = EFFECTS[key];
    if (!E) return;
    const fx = this.effects || (this.effects = new Map()),
      cur = fx.get(key);
    // instant ones act once
    if (key === 'instant_health' || key === 'instant_damage') {
      this.instantEffect(key, amp);
      return;
    }
    // (vanilla canBeAffected: #ignores_poison_and_regen - the undead)
    if ((key === 'poison' || key === 'regeneration') && this.isUndead()) return;
    if (key === 'saturation' && this === this.game.player && !this.game.net) {
      this.food = Math.min(20, this.food + amp + 1);
      this.saturation = Math.min(this.food, this.saturation + 2 * (amp + 1));
    }
    // a stronger or longer one replaces it
    if (cur && (cur.amp > amp || cur.amp === amp && (cur.dur < 0 || dur >= 0 && cur.dur >= dur))) return;
    fx.set(key, {
      amp,
      dur,
      ambient,
      max: dur
    });
    if (key === 'health_boost') this.applyHealthBoost();
    if (key === 'absorption') this.absorption = Math.max(this.absorption || 0, 4 * (amp + 1));
  },
  removeEffect(key) {
    if (!this.effects || !this.effects.delete(key)) return;
    if (key === 'health_boost') this.applyHealthBoost();
    if (key === 'absorption') this.absorption = 0;
  },
  clearEffects() {
    if (this.effects) for (const k of [...this.effects.keys()]) this.removeEffect(k);
  },
  // the effect's amplifier, or -1 without it
  effectAmp(key) {
    const e = this.effects && this.effects.get(key);
    return e ? e.amp : -1;
  },
  hasEffect(key) {
    return !!(this.effects && this.effects.has(key));
  },
  // vanilla #undead (#inverted_healing_and_harm): healing hurts it, harming heals it (no mob type had T.undead, so
  // potions worked on zombies and skeletons as on anything else)
  isUndead() {
    return typeof ENTITY_TAGS !== 'undefined' && !!this.type && ENTITY_TAGS.undead.includes(this.type);
  },
  applyHealthBoost() {
    if (this.baseMaxHealth === undefined) this.baseMaxHealth = this.maxHealth;
    this.maxHealth = this.baseMaxHealth + 4 * (this.effectAmp('health_boost') + 1);
    this.health = Math.min(this.health, this.maxHealth);
  },
  // (scale: a lingering cloud's are at half strength, vanilla applyInstantaneousEffect's health 0.5)
  instantEffect(key, amp, scale = 1) {
    if (this.game.net && this === this.game.player) return;
    const undead = this.isUndead();
    if (key === 'instant_health' !== !!undead) this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + Math.floor(scale * (4 << amp) + 0.5));else this.hurt(Math.floor(scale * (6 << amp) + 0.5), {
      type: 'magic'
    });
  },
  tickEffects() {
    const fx = this.effects;
    if (!fx || !fx.size) return;
    const g = this.game,
      server = !!g.net && this === g.player;
    for (const [k, e] of fx) {
      if (!server && this.health > 0) {
        if (k === 'regeneration') {
          const p = 50 >> e.amp;
          if (p < 1 || e.dur % p === 0) if (this.health < this.maxHealth) this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 1);
        } else if (k === 'poison') {
          const p = 25 >> e.amp;
          if ((p < 1 || e.dur % p === 0) && this.health > 1) this.hurt(1, {
            type: 'magic',
            bypass: true
          });
        } else if (k === 'wither') {
          const p = 40 >> e.amp;
          if (p < 1 || e.dur % p === 0) this.hurt(1, {
            type: 'wither',
            bypass: true
          });
        } else if (k === 'hunger' && this.exhaust) this.exhaust(0.005 * (e.amp + 1));else if (k === 'saturation' && this === g.player && this.food !== undefined) {
          this.food = Math.min(20, this.food + e.amp + 1);
          this.saturation = Math.min(this.food, this.saturation + 2 * (e.amp + 1));
        }
      }
      // particles around the entity (not the player's own in first person)
      if (!e.hidden && (this !== g.player || g.perspective) && Math.random() < (e.ambient ? 0.05 : 0.2)) {
        const c = EFFECTS[k].color;
        g.particles.spawn('effect', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, this.pos[1] + Math.random() * this.h, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, 0, 0.02, 0, {
          col: [c >> 16 & 255, c >> 8 & 255, c & 255]
        });
      }
      if (e.dur > 0 && --e.dur === 0) this.removeEffect(k);
    }
    this.waterBreatherFx = this.hasEffect('water_breathing') || this.hasEffect('conduit_power') || this.hasEffect('breath_of_the_nautilus');
  }
});
// damage: fire resistance, resistance, absorption hearts
{
  const hurt0 = Living.prototype.hurt;
  Living.prototype.hurt = function (amount, src) {
    const t = src && src.type;
    if ((t === 'fire' || t === 'lava') && this.hasEffect('fire_resistance')) return false;
    const res = this.effectAmp('resistance');
    if (res >= 0 && t !== 'void') {
      if (res >= 4) return false;
      amount *= 1 - 0.2 * (res + 1);
    }
    if (this.absorption > 0 && t !== 'void' && !(src && src.bypass && t === 'magic')) {
      const k = Math.min(this.absorption, amount);
      this.absorption -= k;
      amount -= k;
      if (amount <= 0) {
        this.hurtTime = 10;
        return true;
      }
    }
    return hurt0.call(this, amount, src);
  };
  const base0 = Living.prototype.baseTick;
  Living.prototype.baseTick = function () {
    this.tickEffects();
    const wb = this.waterBreather;
    if (this.waterBreatherFx) this.waterBreather = true;
    base0.call(this);
    this.waterBreather = wb;
  };
}

// ---- what the effects do to this player ----
// walking speed: speed +20% a level, slowness -15% a level
// how near a mob has to be to notice someone (vanilla getVisibilityPercent + TargetingConditions): its range, a fifth
// less for someone sneaking, and for someone invisible 0.7 x how much of their armour shows (at least 0.1) - never
// under 2 blocks
function seenWithin(t, range) {
  let v = 1;
  if (t.sneaking) v *= 0.8;
  if (t.invisible || t.hasEffect && t.hasEffect('invisibility')) {
    const arm = (t.inv ? t.inv.slots.slice(36, 40) : t.armorItems || []).filter(Boolean).length;
    v *= 0.7 * Math.max(0.1, arm / 4);
  }
  return Math.max(range * v, 2);
}
function effectSpeedFactor(p) {
  return Math.max(0, (1 + 0.2 * (p.effectAmp('speed') + 1)) * (1 - 0.15 * (p.effectAmp('slowness') + 1)));
}
// mining: haste +20% a level, mining fatigue 0.3^level (the fourth level and above 0.00081)
function effectMineFactor(p) {
  let f = 1 + 0.2 * (p.effectAmp('haste') + 1) + 0.2 * (p.effectAmp('conduit_power') + 1);
  const mf = p.effectAmp('mining_fatigue');
  if (mf >= 0) f *= [0.3, 0.09, 0.0027, 0.00081][Math.min(3, mf)];
  return f;
}
// melee: strength +3 a level, weakness -4 a level
function effectAttackBonus(p) {
  return 3 * (p.effectAmp('strength') + 1) - 4 * (p.effectAmp('weakness') + 1);
}
function effectJumpBoost(p) {
  return 0.1 * (p.effectAmp('jump_boost') + 1);
}
// night vision: full brightness, flickering in its last 10 seconds
function nightVisionScale(p) {
  const e = p && p.effects && p.effects.get('night_vision');
  if (!e) return 0;
  return e.dur < 0 || e.dur > 200 ? 1 : 0.7 + Math.sin((e.dur - 1) * Math.PI * 0.2) * 0.3;
}

// ---- eating and drinking ----
Game.prototype.useTicks = function (def) {
  if (def.key === 'potion' || def.key === 'milk_bucket') return 32;
  return EAT_TICKS[def.key] || 32;
};
Game.prototype.canConsume = function (def) {
  const p = this.player;
  if (def.key === 'potion' || def.key === 'milk_bucket') return true;
  return !!def.food && (p.food < 20 || this.mode === 'creative' || ALWAYS_EDIBLE.has(def.key));
};
Game.prototype.finishEating = function (held) {
  const p = this.player,
    def = ITEMS[held.id],
    k = def.key;
  if (k === 'potion') {
    for (const [e, t, a] of POTIONS[held.pot] || []) p.addEffect(e, a, t);
    Sound.ev('entity.generic.drink', p.pos, 0.5, 1);
  } else if (k === 'milk_bucket') {
    p.clearEffects();
    Sound.ev('entity.generic.drink', p.pos, 0.5, 1);
  } else {
    if (def.food) {
      p.food = Math.min(20, p.food + def.food[0]);
      p.saturation = Math.min(p.food, p.saturation + def.food[1]);
    }
    for (const [e, t, a, ch] of FOOD_EFFECTS[k] || []) if (Math.random() < ch) p.addEffect(e, a, t);
    if (k === 'honey_bottle') p.removeEffect('poison');
    if (k === 'suspicious_stew' && held.stew) for (const [e, t] of held.stew) p.addEffect(e, 0, t);
    if (k === 'chorus_fruit') this.chorusTeleport();
    Sound.burp(p.pos);
  }
  const left = k === 'potion' ? 'glass_bottle' : k === 'milk_bucket' ? 'bucket' : FOOD_LEFTOVER[k];
  if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
    held.count--;
    if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = left ? makeStack(left) : null;else if (left) {
      const s = makeStack(left);
      if (p.inv.add(s)) this.dropFromPlayer(s);
    }
  }
  p.usingItem = null;
  p.useT = 0;
  this.useCd = 4;
};
// chorus fruit: to a safe place up to 8 blocks away (16 tries, like vanilla)
Game.prototype.chorusTeleport = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world;
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const x = p.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
      z = p.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16;
    let y = Math.min(HEIGHT - 2, Math.floor(p.pos[1] + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 16) - 8)));
    while (y > 1 && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(Math.floor(x), y - 1, Math.floor(z))].solid) y--;
    const old = p.pos;
    p.pos = [x, y, z];
    if (y > 1 && !p.collides(p.box()) && !IS_FLUID[w.getBlock(Math.floor(x), y, Math.floor(z))]) {
      p.prev = [...p.pos];
      p.vel = [0, 0, 0];
      p.fallDist = 0;
      Sound.ev('item.chorus_fruit.teleport', p.pos, 1, 1);
      return;
    }
    p.pos = old;
  }
};

// ---- splash and lingering potions ----
class ThrownPotion extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, vel, owner, stack) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.25, 0.25);
    this.vel = vel;
    this.owner = owner;
    this.stack = stack;
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip) {
    potionSprites(g, ip, ITEMS[this.stack.id].key, this.stack.pot);
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel,
      steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) / 0.3));
    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
      const nx = this.pos[0] + v[0] / steps,
        ny = this.pos[1] + v[1] / steps,
        nz = this.pos[2] + v[2] / steps;
      let hit = false;
      for (const e of g.entities) {
        if (e === this || e === this.owner && this.age < 5 || !(e instanceof Living) || e.deathTime > 0) continue;
        const b = e.box();
        if (nx > b[0] && nx < b[3] && ny > b[1] && ny < b[4] && nz > b[2] && nz < b[5]) {
          hit = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      const id = this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz));
      if (!hit && id && BLOCKS[id].solid && (!this.stack.pot || this.stack.pot === 'water')) this.dowse([Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz)]);
      if (hit || id && BLOCKS[id].solid || ny < -60) {
        this.splash();
        return;
      }
      this.pos[0] = nx;
      this.pos[1] = ny;
      this.pos[2] = nz;
    }
    v[0] *= 0.99;
    v[1] = v[1] * 0.99 - 0.05;
    v[2] *= 0.99;
  }
  // a water bottle breaking on a block (AbstractThrownPotion.onHitBlock / dowseFire): fire put out, lit candles and
  // campfires too - in the cell it was in, the block it hit and the four cells beside the first
  dowse(hitAt) {
    const g = this.game,
      w = this.world,
      e = [Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1]), Math.floor(this.pos[2])];
    for (const [x, y, z] of [e, hitAt, [e[0] + 1, e[1], e[2]], [e[0] - 1, e[1], e[2]], [e[0], e[1], e[2] + 1], [e[0], e[1], e[2] - 1]]) {
      const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
        b = BLOCKS[id];
      if (id === 171 || b && b.key === 'soul_fire') {
        w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
        Sound.ev('block.fire.extinguish', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.5, 2.6);
      } else if (b && /(^|_)candle(_cake)?$/.test(b.key) && Features.propOf(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'lit') === 'true') {
        w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'lit', 'false'));
        Sound.ev('block.candle.extinguish', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
      } else if (g.dowseCampfire) g.dowseCampfire(x, y, z, 'block.fire.extinguish');
    }
  }
  // splash: everything within 4 blocks, the closer the longer; lingering: a cloud of it left there (EffectCloud)
  splash() {
    this.dead = true;
    const g = this.game,
      pot = this.stack.pot,
      fx = POTIONS[pot] || [],
      lingering = ITEMS[this.stack.id].key === 'lingering_potion';
    const col = potionColor(pot);
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) g.particles.spawn('effect', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, Math.random() * 0.3, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, {
      col
    });
    Sound.ev('entity.splash_potion.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
    if (lingering) {
      g.entities.push(new EffectCloud(g, this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], pot, this.owner));
      return;
    }
    for (const e of g.entities.concat([g.player])) {
      if (!(e instanceof Living) || e.deathTime > 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - this.pos[0], e.pos[1] + e.h / 2 - this.pos[1], e.pos[2] - this.pos[2]);
      if (d > 4) continue;
      const f = 1 - d / 4;
      for (const [k, t, a] of fx) {
        if (k === 'instant_health' || k === 'instant_damage') e.addEffect(k, a, 1);else if (t * f > 20) e.addEffect(k, a, Math.floor(t * f));
      }
    }
  }
}
// a lingering potion's cloud (vanilla AreaEffectCloud as ThrownLingeringPotion makes it): 3 blocks across at first,
// half a second's wait, then every quarter second whoever stands in it (a second between goes for each) gets the
// potion's effects at a quarter of their time (instant ones at half strength) and it shrinks by half a block; it also
// shrinks away over 30 seconds. There was none: the potion acted once, a quarter as long, on everyone within 4 blocks
class EffectCloud extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, pot, owner) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 6, 0.5);
    this.pot = pot;
    this.owner = owner;
    this.radius = 3;
    this.duration = 600;
    this.waitTime = 10;
    this.victims = new Map();
    this.col = potionColor(pot);
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.age - this.waitTime >= this.duration) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    const g = this.game,
      wait = this.age < this.waitTime,
      r = this.radius,
      [cx, cy, cz] = this.pos;
    // (vanilla clientTick spawns pi r^2 a tick; half of that here)
    if (!wait || Math.random() < 0.5) for (let i = 0, n = wait ? 2 : Math.ceil(Math.PI * r * r / 2); i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        d = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * (wait ? 0.2 : r);
      g.particles.spawn('effect', cx + Math.cos(a) * d, cy, cz + Math.sin(a) * d, wait ? 0 : (0.5 - Math.random()) * 0.15, wait ? 0 : 0.01, wait ? 0 : (0.5 - Math.random()) * 0.15, {
        col: this.col
      });
    }
    if (wait) return;
    if ((this.radius -= 3 / this.duration) < 0.5) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    if (this.age % 5 || g.net) return;
    for (const [e, t] of this.victims) if (this.age >= t) this.victims.delete(e);
    const fx = POTIONS[this.pot] || [];
    if (!fx.length) {
      this.victims.clear();
      return;
    }
    for (const e of [g.player, ...g.entities]) {
      if (!(e instanceof Living) || e.dead || e.deathTime > 0 || this.victims.has(e)) continue;
      if (!fx.some(([k]) => !((k === 'poison' || k === 'regeneration') && e.isUndead()))) continue;
      const b = e.box();
      if (b[4] < cy || b[1] > cy + 0.5 || (e.pos[0] - cx) ** 2 + (e.pos[2] - cz) ** 2 > this.radius ** 2) continue;
      this.victims.set(e, this.age + 20);
      for (const [k, t, a] of fx) {
        if (k === 'instant_health' || k === 'instant_damage') e.instantEffect(k, a, 0.5);else e.addEffect(k, a, Math.floor(t * 0.25));
      }
      if ((this.radius -= 0.5) < 0.5) {
        this.dead = true;
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  drawSelf() {} // (only its particles show)
}
// a thrown potion as vanilla draws it (its item model): the liquid in the potion's colour, the bottle over it - only
// the liquid layer was drawn, grey and without its bottle
function potionSprites(g, ip, key, pot) {
  const pos = [ip[0], ip[1] + 0.125, ip[2]];
  g.spriteList.push({
    pos,
    size: 0.18,
    layer: T('i_potion_overlay'),
    col: potionColor(pot)
  }, {
    pos,
    size: 0.18,
    layer: T('i_' + key),
    front: 0.01
  });
}
Game.prototype.throwPotion = function (held) {
  const p = this.player,
    d = this.lookDir();
  this.entities.push(new ThrownPotion(this, p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + p.eye() - 0.1, p.pos[2], [d[0] * 0.5, d[1] * 0.5 + 0.1, d[2] * 0.5], p, {
    ...held,
    count: 1
  }));
  Sound.ev('entity.splash_potion.throw', p.pos, 0.5, 0.4 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8));
  if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
    held.count--;
    if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
  }
  p.swing();
};

// the colour of tint layer k of an item model for this stack: the potion's colour, the leather's dye, the firework
// star's explosion colours averaged (vanilla's tint sources), else the definition's own default
function stackTint(r, info, k, st) {
  const t = info && info.tints && info.tints[k];
  if (!t) return null;
  const type = (t.type || '').replace('minecraft:', '');
  if (type === 'potion') return potionColor(st && st.pot);
  if (type === 'dye' && st && st.color != null) return [st.color >> 16 & 255, st.color >> 8 & 255, st.color & 255];
  const cols = type === 'firework' && st && st.fw && st.fw.colors;
  if (cols && cols.length) {
    const s = [0, 0, 0];
    for (const c of cols) {
      const v = DYE_RGB[c] || 0xFFFFFF;
      s[0] += v >> 16 & 255;
      s[1] += v >> 8 & 255;
      s[2] += v & 255;
    }
    return s.map(v => Math.round(v / cols.length));
  }
  return r.itemTint(info.tints, k);
}
// does this stack carry data that changes its icon's colours?
const stackTinted = st => !!(st.pot || st.color != null || st.fw && st.fw.colors && st.fw.colors.length);
// a flat item's icon coloured for this stack (16 x 16, cached); null when the item isn't a flat layered model
Renderer.prototype.stackIcon = function (id, st) {
  const info = VM.ready && VM.data.items[ITEMS[id].key],
    model = info && info.m !== undefined ? VM.data.models[info.m] : null;
  if (!(model && model.layers && model.layers.length && info.tints)) return null;
  const key = id + ':' + (st.pot || '') + ':' + (st.color != null ? st.color : '') + ':' + (st.fw && st.fw.colors ? st.fw.colors.join(',') : '');
  const cache = this._stackIcons || (this._stackIcons = new Map());
  let cv = cache.get(key);
  if (cv) return cv;
  if (cache.size > 256) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
  cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = cv.height = 16;
  const c = cv.getContext('2d');
  model.layers.forEach((l, k) => {
    const col = stackTint(this, info, k, st);
    const tmp = document.createElement('canvas');
    tmp.width = tmp.height = 16;
    const x = tmp.getContext('2d');
    x.drawImage(this.stripCanvas, ...this.tileXY(T(l)), 16, 16, 0, 0, 16, 16);
    if (col) {
      const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, 16, 16);
      for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i += 4) {
        d.data[i] = d.data[i] * col[0] / 255;
        d.data[i + 1] = d.data[i + 1] * col[1] / 255;
        d.data[i + 2] = d.data[i + 2] * col[2] / 255;
      }
      x.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
    }
    c.drawImage(tmp, 0, 0);
  });
  cache.set(key, cv);
  return cv;
};
// ---- the HUD's effect icons (top right: good ones above, bad ones below), like vanilla's Gui ----
function drawEffectIcons(ui, p) {
  const fx = p && p.effects;
  if (!fx || !fx.size) return;
  const c = ui.ctx,
    I = ui.img;
  let good = 0,
    bad = 0;
  for (const [k, e] of fx) {
    const E = EFFECTS[k],
      icon = I['eff_' + k];
    if (!icon || e.hidden) continue;
    const row = E.kind < 0 ? 1 : 0,
      x = ui.w - 25 * (row ? ++bad : ++good),
      y = 1 + row * 26;
    const bg = e.ambient ? I.effect_bg_ambient : I.effect_bg;
    if (bg) c.drawImage(bg, x, y);
    // the last 10 seconds: blinking
    let a = 1;
    if (!e.ambient && e.dur >= 0 && e.dur <= 200) {
      const t = e.dur / 10 / 5 * 0.5;
      a = clamp(t + Math.cos(e.dur * Math.PI / 5) * clamp((10 - e.dur / 20) / 10 * 0.25, 0, 0.25), 0, 1);
    }
    c.globalAlpha = a;
    c.drawImage(icon, x + 3, y + 3);
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}
// tooltip lines of a potion stack in this game (single player; net.js does the server's)
function potionLines(stack, lines) {
  const fx = POTIONS[stack.pot] || [];
  if (!fx.length) {
    lines.push({
      text: '无效果',
      color: '#AAAAAA'
    });
    return;
  }
  for (const [k, t, a] of fx) {
    const s = Math.floor(t / 20),
      time = t > 1 ? ` (${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')})` : '';
    lines.push({
      text: EFFECTS[k].cn + romanLevel(a) + time,
      color: EFFECTS[k].kind < 0 ? '#FF5555' : '#5555FF'
    });
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/enchant.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Enchantments in single player: vanilla 26.2's list (recipedata.js, from the jar's data/minecraft/enchantment:
// levels, weights, costs, which items, which exclude each other), what the enchanting table offers, the anvil and
// the grindstone, and the enchantments' effects. A stack keeps them as e: [[key, level], ...] (as on a server, net.js);
// rc is its anvil repair cost.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const ENCH = {},
  ENCH_LIST = [];
for (const [key, max, weight, anvil, minC, maxC, sup, prim, ex, fl] of self.RECIPE_DATA && RECIPE_DATA.enchantments || []) {
  const E = {
    key,
    max,
    weight,
    anvil,
    minC,
    maxC,
    ex: new Set(ex),
    treasure: fl.includes('t'),
    curse: fl.includes('c'),
    table: fl.includes('e'),
    trade: fl.includes('r')
  };
  E.sup = new Set(itemIds(sup));
  E.prim = prim ? new Set(itemIds(prim)) : E.sup;
  ENCH[key] = E;
  ENCH_LIST.push(E);
}
const enchMinCost = (E, l) => E.minC[0] + E.minC[1] * (l - 1);
const enchMaxCost = (E, l) => E.maxC[0] + E.maxC[1] * (l - 1);
const enchCompatible = (a, b) => a !== b && !ENCH[a].ex.has(b) && !ENCH[b].ex.has(a);
// the level of an enchantment on a stack (0 without it)
function enchLevel(stack, key) {
  if (!stack || !stack.e) return 0;
  for (const [k, l] of stack.e) if (k === key) return l;
  return 0;
}
// the highest level of it on the player's armour (or the held item) - what most effects use
function armorEnch(p, key, slots = [36, 37, 38, 39]) {
  let m = 0;
  for (const i of slots) m = Math.max(m, enchLevel(p.inv.slots[i], key));
  return m;
}
const heldEnch = (p, key) => enchLevel(p.inv && p.inv.held, key);
const isBook = st => st && ITEMS[st.id] && ITEMS[st.id].key === 'enchanted_book';
function sameEnchants(a, b) {
  const x = a.e || [],
    y = b.e || [];
  return x.length === y.length && x.every(([k, l]) => enchLevel(b, k) === l);
}

// ---- the enchanting table (EnchantmentMenu / EnchantmentHelper) ----
// a seeded random like java.util.Random, so the same table and item show the same offers until one is taken
class JRandom {
  constructor(seed) {
    this.s = (BigInt(seed) ^ 0x5DEECE66Dn) & (1n << 48n) - 1n;
  }
  next(bits) {
    this.s = this.s * 0x5DEECE66Dn + 0xBn & (1n << 48n) - 1n;
    return Number(BigInt.asIntN(32, this.s >> BigInt(48 - bits)));
  }
  nextInt(n) {
    if ((n & -n) === n) return Number(BigInt(n) * BigInt(this.next(31)) >> 31n);
    let b, v;
    do {
      b = this.next(31);
      v = b % n;
    } while (b - v + (n - 1) < 0 || b - v + (n - 1) > 2147483647);
    return v;
  }
  nextFloat() {
    return this.next(24) / (1 << 24);
  }
}
// the cost shown on each of the three slots
function enchantCost(rand, slot, shelves, ench) {
  if (ench <= 0) return 0;
  shelves = Math.min(shelves, 15);
  const i = rand.nextInt(8) + 1 + (shelves >> 1) + rand.nextInt(shelves + 1);
  return slot === 0 ? Math.max(Math.floor(i / 3), 1) : slot === 1 ? Math.floor(i * 2 / 3) + 1 : Math.max(i, shelves * 2);
}
// the enchantments a level gives (getAvailableEnchantmentResults + selectEnchantment)
function availableEnchants(level, id, treasure) {
  const book = ITEMS[id].key === 'book',
    out = [];
  for (const E of ENCH_LIST) {
    // the table: only its own; loot may give any (treasure true), or those a filter takes (a loot table's options)
    if (typeof treasure === 'function' ? !treasure(E) : !treasure && (!E.table || E.treasure)) continue;
    if (!book && !E.prim.has(id)) continue;
    for (let l = E.max; l >= 1; l--) if (level >= enchMinCost(E, l) && level <= enchMaxCost(E, l)) {
      out.push([E.key, l]);
      break;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function weightedPick(rand, list) {
  let t = 0;
  for (const [k] of list) t += ENCH[k].weight;
  let r = rand.nextInt(t);
  for (const x of list) {
    r -= ENCH[x[0]].weight;
    if (r < 0) return x;
  }
  return list[0];
}
function selectEnchants(rand, id, level, treasure = false) {
  const e = ITEMS[id].enchantability || (ITEMS[id].key === 'book' ? 1 : 0),
    out = [];
  if (e <= 0) return out;
  level += 1 + rand.nextInt((e >> 2) + 1) + rand.nextInt((e >> 2) + 1);
  const f = (rand.nextFloat() + rand.nextFloat() - 1) * 0.15;
  level = Math.max(1, Math.round(level + level * f));
  let list = availableEnchants(level, id, treasure);
  if (!list.length) return out;
  out.push(weightedPick(rand, list));
  while (rand.nextInt(50) <= level) {
    const last = out[out.length - 1][0];
    list = list.filter(([k]) => enchCompatible(k, last) && !out.some(([o]) => o === k));
    if (!list.length) break;
    out.push(weightedPick(rand, list));
    level = Math.floor(level / 2);
  }
  return out;
}
// the three offers for an item with this many bookshelves: [{ cost, clue: [key, level], list }]
function enchantOffers(stack, shelves, seed) {
  if (!stack || stack.e && stack.e.length) return [];
  const def = ITEMS[stack.id];
  if (!(def.enchantability > 0 || def.key === 'book')) return [];
  const r = new JRandom(seed),
    costs = [0, 1, 2].map(i => enchantCost(r, i, shelves, def.enchantability || 1));
  return costs.map((c, i) => {
    if (c < i + 1) return null;
    const rr = new JRandom(seed + i),
      list = selectEnchants(rr, stack.id, c);
    if (def.key === 'book' && list.length > 1) list.splice(rr.nextInt(list.length), 1);
    // the hint: one of them, drawn by the same random (vanilla reuses the menu's seeded random)
    return list.length ? {
      cost: c,
      clue: list[rr.nextInt(list.length)],
      list
    } : null;
  });
}
// bookshelves around a table: two blocks away, on its level or one up, with air (or anything see-through) between
function countBookshelves(world, x, y, z) {
  let n = 0;
  for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
    if (Math.abs(dx) !== 2 && Math.abs(dz) !== 2) continue;
    for (let dy = 0; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      if (world.getBlock(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz) !== BID.bookshelf) continue;
      const m = world.getBlock(x + Math.trunc(dx / 2), y + dy, z + Math.trunc(dz / 2));
      if (!m || REPLACEABLE[m]) n++;
    }
  }
  return n;
}

// ---- the anvil (AnvilMenu.createResult): repair, combine, rename; the cost in levels (40 and over: too expensive) ----
function anvilResult(left, right, name, creative) {
  if (!left) return null;
  const def = ITEMS[left.id],
    out = {
      ...left,
      e: left.e ? left.e.map(x => [...x]) : undefined
    };
  let cost = 0,
    renameCost = 0,
    used = 0;
  const base = (left.rc || 0) + (right ? right.rc || 0 : 0);
  if (right) {
    const book = isBook(right);
    const repairs = def.durability && def.repair && itemIds(def.repair).includes(right.id);
    if (repairs) {
      let l = Math.min(left.dmg || 0, Math.floor(def.durability / 4));
      if (l <= 0) return null;
      let m = 0;
      for (; l > 0 && m < right.count; m++) {
        out.dmg -= l;
        cost++;
        l = Math.min(out.dmg, Math.floor(def.durability / 4));
      }
      used = m;
    } else {
      if (!book && (right.id !== left.id || !def.durability) && !(isBook(left) && book)) return null;
      if (def.durability && !book) {
        const k = def.durability - (left.dmg || 0),
          l = def.durability - (right.dmg || 0) + Math.floor(def.durability * 12 / 100);
        const o = Math.max(0, def.durability - (k + l));
        if (o < (out.dmg || 0)) {
          out.dmg = o;
          cost += 2;
        }
      }
      let some = false,
        bad = false;
      for (const [k, l2] of right.e || []) {
        const E = ENCH[k];
        if (!E) continue;
        const l1 = enchLevel(out, k);
        let lvl = l1 === l2 ? l2 + 1 : Math.max(l1, l2);
        let ok = creative || isBook(left) || E.sup.has(left.id);
        for (const [o] of out.e || []) if (o !== k && !enchCompatible(o, k)) {
          ok = false;
          cost++;
        }
        if (!ok) {
          bad = true;
          continue;
        }
        some = true;
        lvl = Math.min(lvl, E.max);
        out.e = (out.e || []).filter(([o]) => o !== k);
        out.e.push([k, lvl]);
        let c = E.anvil;
        if (book) c = Math.max(1, c >> 1);
        cost += c * lvl;
        if (left.count > 1) cost = 40;
      }
      if (bad && !some) return null;
    }
  }
  if (name !== undefined && name !== null) {
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed && trimmed !== (left.name || def.cn)) {
      renameCost = 1;
      cost += 1;
      out.name = trimmed;
    } else if (!trimmed && left.name) {
      renameCost = 1;
      cost += 1;
      delete out.name;
    }
  }
  if (cost <= 0) return null;
  let total = base + cost;
  if (renameCost === cost && renameCost > 0 && total >= 40) total = 39;
  if (total >= 40 && !creative) return {
    tooExpensive: true,
    cost: total
  };
  if (out.e && !out.e.length) delete out.e;
  let rc = Math.max(out.rc || 0, right ? right.rc || 0 : 0);
  if (renameCost !== cost || renameCost === 0) rc = rc * 2 + 1;
  out.rc = rc;
  return {
    stack: out,
    cost: total,
    used
  };
}

// ---- the grindstone: takes the enchantments off (not curses) and gives some of their experience back; two of the
// same item are combined (5% bonus durability) ----
function grindstoneResult(a, b) {
  if (!a && !b) return null;
  if (a && b) {
    if (a.id !== b.id || !ITEMS[a.id].durability || a.count > 1 || b.count > 1) return null;
    const D = ITEMS[a.id].durability,
      dur = D - (a.dmg || 0) + (D - (b.dmg || 0)) + Math.floor(D * 5 / 100);
    const out = {
      id: a.id,
      count: 1,
      dmg: Math.max(0, D - dur)
    };
    const curses = [...(a.e || []), ...(b.e || [])].filter(([k]) => ENCH[k] && ENCH[k].curse);
    const e = [];
    for (const [k, l] of curses) if (!e.some(([o]) => o === k)) e.push([k, l]);
    if (e.length) out.e = e;
    return finishGrind(out);
  }
  const s = a || b;
  if (!s.e || !s.e.some(([k]) => ENCH[k] && !ENCH[k].curse)) return null;
  const out = {
    ...s,
    count: 1,
    e: s.e.filter(([k]) => ENCH[k] && ENCH[k].curse)
  };
  if (isBook(s) && !out.e.length) {
    out.id = ITEM_KEY.book;
    delete out.e;
  }
  if (out.e && !out.e.length) delete out.e;
  return finishGrind(out);
}
function finishGrind(out) {
  let rc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < (out.e || []).length; i++) rc = rc * 2 + 1;
  if (rc) out.rc = rc;else delete out.rc;
  return out;
}
// the experience a grindstone gives back for what it took off
function grindstoneXp(...stacks) {
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of stacks) if (s) for (const [k, l] of s.e || []) if (ENCH[k] && !ENCH[k].curse) n += enchMinCost(ENCH[k], l);
  if (!n) return 0;
  const h = Math.ceil(n / 2);
  return h + Math.floor(Math.random() * h);
}

// ---- effects ----
// unbreaking: tools take damage only 1 in (level + 1) times; armour 60% + 40% / (level + 1) of the times
function unbreakingSkips(stack, armor) {
  const u = enchLevel(stack, 'unbreaking');
  if (!u) return false;
  return armor ? Math.random() >= 0.6 + 0.4 / (u + 1) : Math.random() >= 1 / (u + 1);
}
// the protection enchantments' total against a damage (EPF, at most 20; each point takes 4% off)
function protectionPoints(p, src) {
  const t = src && src.type;
  if (t === 'void' || t === 'starve') return 0;
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 36; i < 40; i++) {
    const s = p.inv.slots[i];
    if (!s || !s.e) continue;
    for (const [k, l] of s.e) {
      if (k === 'protection') n += l;else if (k === 'fire_protection' && (t === 'fire' || t === 'lava' || t === 'fireball' || t === 'hotFloor')) n += 2 * l;else if (k === 'blast_protection' && t === 'explosion') n += 2 * l;else if (k === 'projectile_protection' && (t === 'arrow' || t === 'fireball' || t === 'trident')) n += 2 * l;else if (k === 'feather_falling' && t === 'fall') n += 3 * l;
    }
  }
  return Math.min(n, 20);
}
// the extra melee damage of the held weapon's enchantments against a mob
const UNDEAD = new Set(['zombie', 'skeleton', 'zombified_piglin', 'wither_skeleton', 'husk', 'stray', 'drowned', 'zombie_villager', 'phantom', 'wither', 'zoglin', 'skeleton_horse', 'zombie_horse', 'bogged']);
const ARTHROPOD = new Set(['spider', 'cave_spider', 'bee', 'silverfish', 'endermite']);
function enchantAttackBonus(stack, e) {
  let b = 0;
  const t = e && e.type;
  const sh = enchLevel(stack, 'sharpness');
  if (sh) b += 0.5 * sh + 0.5;
  const sm = enchLevel(stack, 'smite');
  if (sm && UNDEAD.has(t)) b += 2.5 * sm;
  const ba = enchLevel(stack, 'bane_of_arthropods');
  if (ba && ARTHROPOD.has(t)) b += 2.5 * ba;
  return b;
}
// fortune: an ore's drops multiplied by 1 to level + 1 (vanilla's ore_drops formula)
function fortuneCount(n, lvl) {
  if (!lvl) return n;
  const bonus = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.random() * (lvl + 2)) - 1);
  return n * (bonus + 1);
}
// a ripe crop's extra drop (vanilla loot tables: apply_bonus binomial_with_bonus_count, extra 3, p 0.5714286): 1 plus a
// roll of 3 + fortune - fortune did nothing on crops
function cropBonusCount(r, tool) {
  let n = 1;
  for (let i = 0, k = 3 + enchLevel(tool, 'fortune'); i < k; i++) if (r() < 0.5714286) n++;
  return n;
}
// silk touch takes these as they are (others than this list drop themselves when they have an item)
const NO_SILK = new Set(['spawner', 'budding_amethyst', 'reinforced_deepslate', 'farmland', 'dirt_path', 'frosted_ice', 'trial_spawner', 'vault', 'small_dripleaf', 'hanging_roots', 'seagrass', 'vine', 'glow_lichen', 'nether_sprouts', 'sculk_vein', 'short_grass', 'fern', 'tall_grass', 'large_fern', 'dead_bush', ...WOOLS.map(([c]) => c + '_wool')]); // (the first wool blocks: the vanilla import's wool item, silk touch or not)

// ---- creative: enchanted books of every enchantment and level (vanilla's ingredients tab) ----
const _ctItems = creativeTabItems;
creativeTabItems = function (tab) {
  const c = creativeTabItems.cache || (creativeTabItems.cache = {});
  if (!c[tab]) {
    c[tab] = _ctItems.call(this, tab);
    if (tab === 'ingredients') {
      const i = c[tab].indexOf('enchanted_book');
      if (i >= 0) c[tab].splice(i, 1, ...ENCH_LIST.flatMap(E => Array.from({
        length: E.max
      }, (_, l) => ({
        key: 'enchanted_book',
        e: [[E.key, l + 1]]
      }))));
    }
  }
  return c[tab];
};

// ---- the enchantments that move the player, and frost walker (26.2's enchantment data) ----
// soul speed (boots): on soul sand / soul soil (and in the air after leaving it) 0.0405 + 0.0105 a level faster and the
// sand no longer slows; wears the boots (4% a tick) and throws up souls while running
const SOUL_SPEED_BLOCKS = new Set(['soul_sand', 'soul_soil']);
Player.prototype.speedBonus = function () {
  const l = enchLevel(this.inv.slots[39], 'soul_speed');
  if (!l || this.vehicle || this.flying) {
    this.soulSpeedOn = false;
    return 0;
  }
  const below = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1] - 0.5), Math.floor(this.pos[2]))];
  this.soulSpeedOn = this.onGround ? !!(below && SOUL_SPEED_BLOCKS.has(below.key)) : !!this.soulSpeedOn;
  return this.soulSpeedOn ? 0.0405 + 0.0105 * (l - 1) : 0;
};
// swift sneak (leggings): sneaking at 0.3 + 0.15 a level of the walking speed
Player.prototype.sneakSpeed = function () {
  return Math.min(1, 0.3 + 0.15 * enchLevel(this.inv.slots[38], 'swift_sneak'));
};
// depth strider (boots): a third of the way to walking speed in water a level
Player.prototype.waterEfficiency = function () {
  return Math.min(1, enchLevel(this.inv.slots[39], 'depth_strider') / 3);
};
(() => {
  const _tick = Player.prototype.tick;
  Player.prototype.tick = function (input) {
    const r = _tick.call(this, input),
      g = this.game;
    if (g.net || this.deathTime > 0) return r;
    const boots = this.inv.slots[39];
    // soul speed's wear and souls
    if (this.soulSpeedOn && this.onGround && boots && Math.abs(this.pos[0] - this.prev[0]) + Math.abs(this.pos[2] - this.prev[2]) > 0.01) {
      if (Math.random() < 0.04 && !this.creative && ITEMS[boots.id].durability && !unbreakingSkips(boots, true)) {
        boots.dmg = (boots.dmg || 0) + 1;
        if (boots.dmg >= ITEMS[boots.id].durability) {
          this.inv.slots[39] = null;
          Sound.ev('entity.item.break', this.pos, 0.8, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
        }
      }
      if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
        g.particles.spawn('soul', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, this.pos[1] + 0.1, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, -this.vel[0] * 0.2, 0.1, -this.vel[2] * 0.2);
        Sound.ev('particle.soul_escape', this.pos, 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4, 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4);
      }
    }
    // frost walker (boots): standing on the ground, the still water round the feet (radius 2 + level) freezes to frosted ice
    const fw = enchLevel(boots, 'frost_walker');
    if (fw && this.onGround && !this.vehicle && (this.pos[0] !== this.prev[0] || this.pos[2] !== this.prev[2])) {
      const w = this.world,
        R = Math.min(16, 3 + (fw - 1)),
        y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]) - 1,
        cx = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        cz = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      const ice = BID.frosted_ice;
      if (ice !== undefined) for (let x = cx - R; x <= cx + R; x++) for (let z = cz - R; z <= cz + R; z++) {
        if ((x + 0.5 - this.pos[0]) ** 2 + (z + 0.5 - this.pos[2]) ** 2 >= R * R) continue;
        if (w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) !== 0 || w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== WATER || w.getMeta(x, y, z) !== 0 || w.isWaterlogged && w.isWaterlogged(x, y, z)) continue;
        if (g.entities.some(e => e instanceof Living && !e.dead && Math.floor(e.pos[0]) === x && Math.floor(e.pos[2]) === z && Math.floor(e.pos[1]) === y)) continue;
        w.setBlock(x, y, z, ice, 0);
        (g.frostedIce || (g.frostedIce = new Map())).set(`${x},${y},${z}`, g.tickCount + randInt(60, 120));
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
  // frost walker's boots keep magma blocks from burning (damage_immunity: burn_from_stepping)
  const _hurt = Player.prototype.hurt;
  Player.prototype.hurt = function (a, src) {
    if (src && src.type === 'hotFloor' && enchLevel(this.inv.slots[39], 'frost_walker')) return false;
    return _hurt.call(this, a, src);
  };
  // frosted ice (vanilla FrostedIceBlock): every 1-2 seconds a 1 in 3 chance (always with fewer than 4 frosted
  // neighbours) of ageing when it is light enough; past age 3 it melts back to water
  const _gt = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function () {
    const r = _gt.call(this),
      fi = this.frostedIce;
    if (!fi || !fi.size || this.net || this.state !== 'play' || this.ui.screen && this.ui.screen.pauses) return r;
    const w = this.world,
      ice = BID.frosted_ice;
    for (const [k, t] of fi) {
      if (t > this.tickCount) continue;
      const [x, y, z] = k.split(',').map(Number);
      if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== ice) {
        fi.delete(k);
        continue;
      }
      let near = 0;
      for (const [dx, dz] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) if (w.getBlock(x + dx, y, z + dz) === ice) near++;
      const age = +(Features.propOf(ice, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'age') || 0),
        l = w.getLight(x, y + 1, z);
      const bright = Math.max(l & 15, (l >> 4) - (this.daylight ? Math.round((1 - this.daylight()) * 11) : 0));
      if ((randInt(0, 2) === 0 || near < 4) && bright > 11 - age - 1) {
        if (age < 3) {
          w.setBlock(x, y, z, ice, Features.withProp(ice, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'age', String(age + 1)));
          fi.set(k, this.tickCount + randInt(20, 40));
        } else {
          w.setBlock(x, y, z, WATER, 0);
          fi.delete(k);
        }
      } else fi.set(k, this.tickCount + randInt(20, 40));
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- the sword's sweep (vanilla Player.attack): a full-strength hit on the ground, not sprinting or critting and
// barely moving also hits everything else within a block of the target (and 3 blocks of the player) for
// 1 + sweeping ratio x the damage (sweeping edge: level / (level + 1)), knocking it back a little ----
(() => {
  const _attack = Game.prototype.attack;
  Game.prototype.attack = function (e) {
    const p = this.player,
      held = p.inv.held,
      def = held && ITEMS[held.id];
    const sword = !!(def && def.tool && def.tool.type === 'sword');
    const str = this.attackStrength(),
      moved = Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - p.prev[0], p.pos[2] - p.prev[2]);
    const crit = str > 0.9 && p.vel[1] < -0.05 && !p.onGround && !p.inWater;
    const sweep = sword && str > 0.9 && !crit && !p.sprinting && p.onGround && moved < 0.1 && !this.net && e instanceof Living;
    const base = Math.max(0, (def && def.attack ? def.attack : 1) + effectAttackBonus(p)) * (0.2 + str * str * 0.8);
    // (the sweep has its own sound instead of the strong hit's; only after a hit that landed, as vanilla)
    this.sweepHit = sweep;
    let r;
    try {
      r = _attack.call(this, e);
    } finally {
      this.sweepHit = false;
    }
    if (!sweep || !r) return r;
    const se = enchLevel(held, 'sweeping_edge'),
      dmg = 1 + se / (se + 1) * base,
      b = e.box();
    for (const o of this.entities) {
      if (o === e || o === p || !(o instanceof Living) || o.dead || o.deathTime > 0 || o.isVehicle) continue;
      if (o.owner === p) continue; // (vanilla isAlliedTo: one's own pets)
      const ob = o.box();
      if (ob[3] < b[0] - 1 || ob[0] > b[3] + 1 || ob[4] < b[1] - 0.25 || ob[1] > b[4] + 0.25 || ob[5] < b[2] - 1 || ob[2] > b[5] + 1) continue;
      if ((o.pos[0] - p.pos[0]) ** 2 + (o.pos[1] - p.pos[1]) ** 2 + (o.pos[2] - p.pos[2]) ** 2 >= 9) continue;
      o.hurt(dmg + enchantAttackBonus(held, o) * str, {
        type: 'player',
        attacker: p,
        player: true,
        knockFrom: p.pos,
        knock: 0.4,
        looting: heldEnch(p, 'looting')
      });
    }
    Sound.ev('entity.player.attack.sweep', p.pos, 1, 1);
    this.particles.spawn('sweep', p.pos[0] - Math.sin(p.yaw), p.pos[1] + p.eye() * 0.5, p.pos[2] - Math.cos(p.yaw), 0, 0, 0);
    return r;
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/workstations.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The processing blocks in single player, laid out like vanilla's screens: the enchanting table, anvil, grindstone,
// stonecutter, smithing table and brewing stand (with its block entity and the vanilla brewing recipes).
// Their own slots hold items only while open (given back on closing), except the brewing stand's.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// the Standard Galactic Alphabet (font/ascii_sga.png, the enchanting table's words): glyph widths read from the image
const SGA = {
  words: 'the elder scrolls klaatu berata niktu xyzzy bless curse light darkness fire air earth water hot dry cold wet ignite snuff embiggen twist shorten stretch fiddle destroy imbue galvanize enchant free limited range of towards inside sphere cube self other ball mental physical grow shrink demon elemental spirit animal creature beast humanoid undead fresh stale phnglui mglwnafh cthulhu rlyeh wgahnagl fhtagnbaguette'.split(' '),
  cache: new Map(),
  init(img) {
    if (this.img === img) return;
    this.img = img;
    this.cell = img.width / 16;
    this.wd = new Array(256).fill(0);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = img.width;
    cv.height = img.height;
    const k = cv.getContext('2d');
    k.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    const d = k.getImageData(0, 0, img.width, img.height).data,
      c = this.cell;
    for (let ch = 0; ch < 256; ch++) {
      let r = -1;
      for (let x = 0; x < c; x++) for (let y = 0; y < c; y++) if (d[(((ch >> 4) * c + y) * img.width + (ch & 15) * c + x) * 4 + 3]) r = Math.max(r, x);
      this.wd[ch] = ch === 32 ? 4 : r < 0 ? 0 : Math.round((r + 1) * 8 / c) + 1;
    }
  },
  width(s) {
    let w = 0;
    for (const ch of s) w += this.wd[ch.charCodeAt(0) & 255];
    return w;
  },
  // a few random words (seeded), wrapped into lines no wider than w
  name(seed, w) {
    const r = new JRandom(seed),
      n = r.nextInt(2) + 3,
      words = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) words.push(this.words[r.nextInt(this.words.length)]);
    const lines = [];
    let cur = '';
    for (const wd of words) {
      const t = cur ? cur + ' ' + wd : wd;
      if (this.width(t) > w && cur) {
        lines.push(cur);
        cur = wd;
      } else cur = t;
    }
    if (cur) lines.push(cur);
    return lines.slice(0, 2);
  },
  draw(c, s, x, y, color) {
    const key = s + '|' + color;
    let cv = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!cv) {
      cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = Math.max(1, this.width(s));
      cv.height = 8;
      const k = cv.getContext('2d'),
        C = this.cell;
      let px = 0;
      k.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      for (const ch of s) {
        const o = ch.charCodeAt(0) & 255;
        k.drawImage(this.img, (o & 15) * C, (o >> 4) * C, C, C, px, 0, 8, 8);
        px += this.wd[o];
      }
      k.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
      k.fillStyle = color;
      k.fillRect(0, 0, cv.width, 8);
      if (this.cache.size > 200) this.cache.clear();
      this.cache.set(key, cv);
    }
    c.drawImage(cv, x, y);
  }
};

// the player's experience levels: taken away keeping the progress into the level (vanilla giveExperienceLevels)
Game.prototype.addLevels = function (n) {
  const p = this.player,
    l = this.xpLevel(),
    prog = (p.xp - this.xpTotalFor(l)) / this.xpNeeded(l),
    nl = Math.max(0, l + n);
  p.xp = Math.max(0, Math.round(this.xpTotalFor(nl) + prog * this.xpNeeded(nl)));
};

// a screen's own slot: an item kept in this.held[i] while it is open
class StationScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, bg, title, pos) {
    super(game, bg, 176, 166, title);
    this.pos = pos;
    this.held = [];
    this.invLabelY = 72;
  }
  // the item in one of the screen's slots (its own, or the server's window when on a server)
  S(i) {
    return this.slots[i].get();
  }
  own(i, x, y, o = {}) {
    this.slots.push({
      x,
      y,
      group: 'container',
      get: () => this.held[i] || null,
      set: s => {
        this.held[i] = s;
      },
      ...o
    });
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    Font.draw(ui.ctx, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + this.invLabelY, '#404040', false);
    this.drawMore && this.drawMore(ui);
  }
  close() {
    for (const s of this.held) if (s) this.game.ui.returnStack(s);
    this.held = [];
    this.result = null;
  } // (see CraftingScreen.close)
  // the screen closes when its block is gone or the player walks off (vanilla stillValid: 8 blocks)
  stillValid() {
    if (!this.pos || this.net) return;
    const p = this.game.player,
      [x, y, z] = this.pos;
    if (this.game.world.getBlock(x, y, z) !== this.blockId || Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - x - 0.5, p.pos[1] - y - 0.5, p.pos[2] - z - 0.5) > 8) this.game.ui.close();
  }
}

// ---- the enchanting table ----
class EnchantingScreen extends StationScreen {
  constructor(game, pos, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_enchanting_table', title || '附魔', pos);
    this.own(0, 15, 47, {
      max: 1,
      accept: st => st.count === 1 || maxStack(st.id) === 1 || ITEMS[st.id].key === 'book'
    });
    this.own(1, 35, 47, {
      emptyIcon: 'slot_lapis_lazuli',
      accept: st => st.id === ITEM_KEY.lapis_lazuli
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
    this.shelves = pos ? countBookshelves(game.world, ...pos) : 0;
    this.changed();
  }
  changed() {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (p.enchSeed === undefined) p.enchSeed = Math.random() * 2 ** 31 | 0;
    this.offers = enchantOffers(this.S(0), this.shelves, p.enchSeed);
  }
  // the item slot takes one item at a time
  maxIn(s, st) {
    return s === this.slots[0] ? 1 : super.maxIn(s, st);
  }
  btn(i) {
    return {
      x: this.x + 60,
      y: this.y + 14 + 19 * i,
      w: 108,
      h: 19
    };
  }
  usable(i) {
    const o = this.offers[i],
      g = this.game,
      lapis = this.S(1) ? this.S(1).count : 0;
    return !!o && (g.player.creative || lapis >= i + 1 && g.xpLevel() >= o.cost);
  }
  drawMore(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      g = this.game;
    SGA.init(ui.img.font_sga);
    // the book (a still picture of vanilla's moving one)
    c.save();
    c.translate(this.x + 28, this.y + 16);
    c.scale(2, 2);
    ui.drawItem({
      id: ITEM_KEY.enchanted_book,
      count: 1,
      g: false
    }, 0, 0);
    c.restore();
    let tip = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      var _this$seed;
      const o = this.offers[i],
        r = this.btn(i);
      if (!o) {
        ui.sprite('enchanting_table_enchantment_slot_disabled', r.x, r.y);
        continue;
      }
      const s = String(o.cost),
        n = 86 - Font.width(s),
        lines = SGA.name(((_this$seed = this.seed) !== null && _this$seed !== void 0 ? _this$seed : g.player.enchSeed) + i, n);
      let col;
      if (!this.usable(i)) {
        ui.sprite('enchanting_table_enchantment_slot_disabled', r.x, r.y);
        ui.sprite('enchanting_table_level_' + (i + 1) + '_disabled', r.x + 1, r.y + 1);
        lines.forEach((l, k) => SGA.draw(c, l, r.x + 20, r.y + 2 + k * 8, '#342F25'));
        col = '#407F10';
      } else {
        const hov = ui.hit(r);
        ui.sprite(hov ? 'enchanting_table_enchantment_slot_highlighted' : 'enchanting_table_enchantment_slot', r.x, r.y);
        ui.sprite('enchanting_table_level_' + (i + 1), r.x + 1, r.y + 1);
        lines.forEach((l, k) => SGA.draw(c, l, r.x + 20, r.y + 2 + k * 8, hov ? '#FFFF80' : '#685E4A'));
        col = '#80FF20';
      }
      Font.draw(c, s, r.x + 20 + 86 - Font.width(s), r.y + 9, col);
      if (ui.hit(r) && !ui.cursor) tip = i;
    }
    if (tip !== null) {
      const o = this.offers[tip],
        E = o.clue,
        lapis = this.S(1) ? this.S(1).count : 0;
      const lines = E ? [{
        text: (NET_ENCH_CN[E[0]] || E[0]) + (ENCH[E[0]] && ENCH[E[0]].max === 1 ? '' : ' ' + romanNum(E[1])) + '…？',
        color: '#FFFFFF'
      }] : [];
      if (!g.player.creative) {
        lines.push({
          text: ''
        });
        if (g.xpLevel() < o.cost) lines.push({
          text: '等级要求：' + o.cost,
          color: '#FF5555'
        });else {
          lines.push({
            text: tip === 0 ? '花费：1颗青金石' : '花费：' + (tip + 1) + '颗青金石',
            color: lapis >= tip + 1 ? '#AAAAAA' : '#FF5555'
          });
          lines.push({
            text: tip === 0 ? '+ 1级经验' : '+ ' + (tip + 1) + '级经验',
            color: '#AAAAAA'
          });
        }
      }
      ui.tooltip(lines, ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
    }
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const i = this.offerAt(mx, my);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.pick(i);
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  offerAt(mx, my) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (this.game.ui.hit(this.btn(i), mx, my)) return i;
    return -1;
  }
  pick(i) {
    if (this.usable(i)) this.enchant(i);
  }
  enchant(i) {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      o = this.offers[i],
      st = this.held[0];
    const out = {
      ...st,
      e: o.list.map(x => [...x])
    };
    if (ITEMS[st.id].key === 'book') out.id = ITEM_KEY.enchanted_book;
    this.held[0] = out;
    if (!p.creative) {
      g.addLevels(-(i + 1));
      this.held[1].count -= i + 1;
      if (!this.held[1].count) this.held[1] = null;
    }
    p.enchSeed = Math.random() * 2 ** 31 | 0;
    g.grant && g.grant('enchant_item');
    Sound.ev('block.enchantment_table.use', [this.pos[0] + 0.5, this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2] + 0.5], 1, Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9);
    this.changed();
  }
  quickMove(s) {
    const st = s.get();
    if (!st) return;
    if (s.group !== 'container' && st.id === ITEM_KEY.lapis_lazuli) {
      const t = this.slots[1],
        ts = t.get();
      if (!ts) {
        t.set(st);
        s.set(null);
        return;
      }
      if (sameKind(ts, st)) {
        const k = Math.min(st.count, maxStack(st.id) - ts.count);
        ts.count += k;
        st.count -= k;
        if (!st.count) s.set(null);
        return;
      }
    }
    if (s.group !== 'container' && !this.held[0]) {
      this.held[0] = {
        ...st,
        count: 1
      };
      st.count--;
      if (!st.count) s.set(null);
      return;
    }
    super.quickMove(s);
  }
}

// ---- the anvil ----

    super.layout();
    const u = this.game.ui;
    u.showInput(this.x + 62, this.y + 24, 103, 12, this.name, () => {}, {
      onInput: v => {
        this.name = v;
        this.changed();
        if (this.onName) this.onName(v);
      },
      onEsc: () => u.close(),
      max: 50
    });
  }
  changed() {
    const L = this.held[0];
    // a new item in the left slot: the name field shows its name
    if (L !== this.lastLeft) {
      this.lastLeft = L;
      this.name = L ? L.name || ITEMS[L.id].cn : '';
      const inp = this.game.ui.input;
      if (inp && this.x !== undefined) inp.value = this.name;
    }
    const r = anvilResult(L, this.held[1], L ? this.name : null, this.game.player.creative);
    this.res = r;
    this.result = r && r.stack ? r.stack : null;
  }
  canTake() {
    const r = this.res;
    return r && r.stack && (this.game.player.creative || this.game.xpLevel() >= r.cost);
  }
  takeOutput(ui, s, shift) {
    if (this.canTake()) super.takeOutput(ui, s, shift);
  }
  take() {
    const g = this.game,
      r = this.res;
    if (!g.player.creative) g.addLevels(-r.cost);
    this.held[0] = null;
    const R = this.held[1];
    if (R && r.used) {
      R.count -= r.used;
      if (R.count <= 0) this.held[1] = null;
    } else this.held[1] = null;
    this.lastLeft = null;
    // 12% of the times the anvil gets more damaged (and breaks when it was damaged already)
    const [x, y, z] = this.pos,
      w = g.world,
      id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
      b = BLOCKS[id],
      c = [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5];
    if (!g.player.creative && Math.random() < 0.12) {
      const nx = ANVIL_NEXT[b.key];
      if (nx === null) {
        w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
        g.flushMesh();
        Sound.ev('block.anvil.destroy', c, 1, 1);
        g.ui.close();
        return;
      }
      if (nx && BID[nx] !== undefined) {
        const m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
        w.setBlock(x, y, z, BID[nx], Features.withProp(BID[nx], 0, 'facing', Features.propOf(id, m, 'facing')));
        this.blockId = BID[nx];
        g.flushMesh();
      }
    }
    Sound.ev('block.anvil.use', c, 1, Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9);
  }
  drawMore(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      L = this.S(0);
    if (this.net) this.netLeft(L);
    ui.sprite(L ? 'anvil_text_field' : 'anvil_text_field_disabled', this.x + 59, this.y + 20);
    if (L && this.S(1) && !this.S(2)) ui.sprite('anvil_error', this.x + 99, this.y + 45);
    const r = this.res;
    if (r && r.cost > 0) {
      const g = this.game,
        too = r.tooExpensive,
        s = too ? '过于昂贵！' : '附魔花费：' + r.cost;
      const col = too || !g.player.creative && g.xpLevel() < r.cost ? '#FF6060' : '#80FF20';
      const tx = this.x + 176 - 8 - Font.width(s) - 2;
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.31)';
      c.fillRect(tx - 2, this.y + 67, this.x + 176 - 8 - (tx - 2), 12);
      Font.draw(c, s, tx, this.y + 69, col);
    }
  }
  close() {
    super.close();
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
  }
  key(ui, ev) {
    if (document.activeElement === ui.input) return true;
    return super.key(ui, ev);
  }
}

    });

  take() {
    const g = this.game,

    Sound.ev('block.grindstone.use', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);

// ---- the stonecutter ----
class StonecutterScreen extends StationScreen {
  constructor(game, pos, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_stonecutter', title || '切石机', pos);
    this.sel = -1;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.own(0, 20, 33);
    this.slots.push({
      x: 143,
      y: 33,
      output: true,
      get: () => this.result,
      set: () => {},
      onTake: () => this.take()
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
    this.changed();
  }
  recipes() {
    const s = this.S(0);
    return s ? STONECUTTING[s.id] || [] : [];
  }
  changed() {
    const s = this.held[0];
    if ((s && s.id) !== this.lastId) {
      this.lastId = s && s.id;
      this.sel = -1;
      this.scroll = 0;
    }
    const r = this.recipes()[this.sel];
    this.result = r ? {
      id: r.result,
      count: r.count,
      dmg: 0
    } : null;
  }
  rows() {
    return Math.ceil(this.recipes().length / 4);
  }
  take() {
    const s = this.held[0];
    if (!s) return;
    s.count--;
    if (!s.count) this.held[0] = null;
    Sound.ev('ui.stonecutter.take_result', null, 1, 1);
  }
  cell(i) {
    const k = i - this.scroll * 4;
    return {
      x: this.x + 52 + k % 4 * 16,
      y: this.y + 14 + Math.floor(k / 4) * 18 + 1,
      w: 16,
      h: 18
    };
  }
  drawMore(ui) {
    const list = this.recipes(),
      max = Math.max(0, this.rows() - 3);
    const sy = this.y + 15 + (max ? Math.round(this.scroll / max * 41) : 0);
    ui.sprite(max ? 'stonecutter_scroller' : 'stonecutter_scroller_disabled', this.x + 119, sy);
    let tip = null;
    for (let i = this.scroll * 4; i < Math.min(list.length, this.scroll * 4 + 12); i++) {
      const r = this.cell(i),
        hov = ui.hit(r);
      ui.sprite(i === this.sel ? 'stonecutter_recipe_selected' : hov ? 'stonecutter_recipe_highlighted' : 'stonecutter_recipe', r.x, r.y);
      ui.drawItem({
        id: list[i].result,
        count: list[i].count
      }, r.x, r.y + 1);
      if (hov && !ui.cursor) tip = list[i];
    }
    if (tip) ui.tooltip(ui.itemLines({
      id: tip.result,
      count: tip.count
    }), ui.mouse.x, ui.mouse.y);
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const list = this.recipes();
    const i = this.offerAt(mx, my);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.pick(i);
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  offerAt(mx, my) {
    const list = this.recipes();
    for (let i = this.scroll * 4; i < Math.min(list.length, this.scroll * 4 + 12); i++) if (this.game.ui.hit(this.cell(i), mx, my)) return i;
    return -1;
  }
  pick(i) {
    this.sel = i;
    this.changed();
    Sound.ev('ui.stonecutter.select_recipe', null, 1, 1);
  }
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll + Math.sign(dy), 0, Math.max(0, this.rows() - 3));
  }
}

function smithingRecipe(t, b, a) {
  if (!t || !b || !a) return null;
  return SMITHING.find(r => r.template.includes(t.id) && r.base.includes(b.id) && r.addition.includes(a.id)) || null;
}
class SmithingScreen extends StationScreen {
  constructor(game, pos, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_smithing', title || '升级装备', pos);
    this.titleX = 44;
    this.titleY = 15;
    this.own(0, 8, 48, {
      emptyIcon: 'slot_smithing_template_netherite_upgrade',
      accept: st => SMITHING.some(r => r.template.includes(st.id))
    });
    this.own(1, 26, 48, {
      max: 1
    });
    this.own(2, 44, 48, {
      emptyIcon: 'slot_ingot'
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 98,
      y: 48,
      output: true,
      get: () => this.result,
      set: () => {},
      onTake: () => this.take()
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
    this.changed();
  }
  changed() {
    const [t, b, a] = this.held,
      r = smithingRecipe(t, b, a);
    if (!r) {
      this.result = null;
      return;
    }
    if (r.trim) {
      const mat = TRIM_MAT_OF[ITEMS[a.id].key],
        trim = {
          pattern: r.pattern,
          material: mat
        };
      this.result = b.trim && b.trim.pattern === trim.pattern && b.trim.material === mat ? null : {
        ...b,
        count: 1,
        trim
      };
    } else this.result = {
      ...b,
      id: r.result,
      count: 1
    };
  }
  take() {
    for (const i of [0, 1, 2]) {
      const s = this.held[i];
      if (s) {
        s.count--;
        if (!s.count) this.held[i] = null;
      }
    }
    Sound.ev('block.smithing_table.use', [this.pos[0] + 0.5, this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2] + 0.5], 1, 1);
  }
  drawBase(ui) {
    ui.dim(0.6);
    ui.ctx.drawImage(ui.img[this.bg], 0, 0, this.gw, this.gh, this.x, this.y, this.gw, this.gh);
    Font.draw(ui.ctx, this.title, this.x + 44, this.y + 15, '#404040', false);
  }
  drawMore(ui) {
    const t = this.S(0),
      b = this.S(1),
      a = this.S(2),
      res = this.S(3);
    if (t && b && a && !res) ui.sprite('smithing_error', this.x + 65, this.y + 46);
    // the armour stand's place: the item being worked on, big
    const show = res || b;
    if (show) {
      ui.ctx.save();
      ui.ctx.translate(this.x + 125, this.y + 28);
      ui.ctx.scale(2, 2);
      ui.drawItem({
        ...show,
        count: 1
      }, 0, 0);
      ui.ctx.restore();
    }
  }
}

const BREW_MIXES = [];

const POTION_ITEMS = new Set(['potion', 'splash_potion', 'lingering_potion']);
const isPotion = st => st && POTION_ITEMS.has(ITEMS[st.id].key);
const BREW_INGREDIENTS = new Set([...BREW_MIXES.map(m => m[1]), 'gunpowder', 'dragon_breath']);
// what a bottle becomes with an ingredient (null: nothing)
function brewResult(bottle, ing) {
  if (!isPotion(bottle) || !ing) return null;
  const k = ITEMS[ing.id].key,
    bk = ITEMS[bottle.id].key;
  if (k === 'gunpowder') return bk === 'potion' ? {
    ...bottle,
    id: ITEM_KEY.splash_potion
  } : null;
  if (k === 'dragon_breath') return bk === 'splash_potion' ? {
    ...bottle,
    id: ITEM_KEY.lingering_potion
  } : null;
  const m = BREW_MIXES.find(([a, i]) => a === (bottle.pot || 'water') && i === k);
  return m ? {
    ...bottle,
    pot: m[2]
  } : null;
}
function canBrew(be) {
  return !!be.ingredient && be.bottles.some(b => brewResult(b, be.ingredient));
}
Game.prototype.tickBrewing = function (be) {
  const [x, y, z] = be.pos,
    w = this.world;
  if (be.fuelLeft <= 0 && be.fuel && be.fuel.id === ITEM_KEY.blaze_powder) {
    be.fuelLeft = 20;
    be.fuel.count--;
    if (!be.fuel.count) be.fuel = null;
  }
  const ok = canBrew(be),
    ingId = be.ingredient && be.ingredient.id;
  if (be.brewTime > 0) {
    be.brewTime--;
    if (be.brewTime === 0 && ok) {
      be.bottles = be.bottles.map(b => brewResult(b, be.ingredient) || b);
      const k = ITEMS[be.ingredient.id].key;
      be.ingredient.count--;
      if (!be.ingredient.count) be.ingredient = k === 'dragon_breath' ? makeStack('glass_bottle') : null;
      Sound.ev('block.brewing_stand.brew', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
    } else if (!ok || ingId !== be.ingId) be.brewTime = 0;
  } else if (ok && be.fuelLeft > 0) {
    be.fuelLeft--;
    be.brewTime = 400;
    be.ingId = ingId;
  }
  // the block shows which bottles it holds
  const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (id === BID.brewing_stand) {
    let m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) m = Features.withProp(id, m, 'has_bottle_' + i, be.bottles[i] ? 'true' : 'false');
    if (m !== w.getMeta(x, y, z)) w.setMeta(x, y, z, m);
  }
};
const _tickFurnaces = Game.prototype.tickFurnaces;
Game.prototype.tickFurnaces = function () {
  _tickFurnaces.call(this);
  for (const be of this.blockEntities.values()) if (be.type === 'brewing' && this.world.isLoaded(be.pos[0], be.pos[2])) this.tickBrewing(be);
};
class BrewingScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, be, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_brewing_stand', 176, 166, title || '酿造台');
    this.be = be;
    const bottle = (i, x, y) => this.slots.push({
      x,
      y,
      group: 'container',
      emptyIcon: 'slot_potion',
      max: 1,
      get: () => be.bottles[i],
      set: s => {
        be.bottles[i] = s;
      },
      accept: st => isPotion(st) || st.id === ITEM_KEY.glass_bottle
    });
    bottle(0, 56, 51);
    bottle(1, 79, 58);
    bottle(2, 102, 51);
    this.slots.push({
      x: 79,
      y: 17,
      group: 'container',
      get: () => be.ingredient,
      set: s => {
        be.ingredient = s;
      },
      accept: st => BREW_INGREDIENTS.has(ITEMS[st.id].key)
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 17,
      y: 17,
      group: 'container',
      emptyIcon: 'slot_brewing_fuel',
      get: () => be.fuel,
      set: s => {
        be.fuel = s;
      },
      accept: st => st.id === ITEM_KEY.blaze_powder
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
  }
  maxIn(s, st) {
    return s.max || super.maxIn(s, st);
  }
  quickMove(s) {
    const st = s.get();
    if (!st) return;
    if (s.group !== 'container') {
      const key = ITEMS[st.id].key;
      const t = key === 'blaze_powder' && (!this.be.fuel || this.be.fuel.count < 64) ? this.slots[4] : BREW_INGREDIENTS.has(key) ? this.slots[3] : null;
      if (t) {
        const ts = t.get();
        if (!ts) {
          t.set(st);
          s.set(null);
          return;
        }
        if (sameKind(ts, st)) {
          const k = Math.min(st.count, maxStack(st.id) - ts.count);
          ts.count += k;
          st.count -= k;
          if (!st.count) s.set(null);
          return;
        }
      }
      if (isPotion(st)) for (const b of this.slots.slice(0, 3)) if (!b.get()) {
        b.set({
          ...st,
          count: 1
        });
        st.count--;
        if (!st.count) {
          s.set(null);
          return;
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    super.quickMove(s);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const be = this.be,
      c = ui.ctx;
    const f = clamp(Math.floor((18 * be.fuelLeft + 20 - 1) / 20), 0, 18);
    if (f > 0) c.drawImage(ui.img.brewing_stand_fuel_length, 0, 0, f, 4, this.x + 60, this.y + 44, f, 4);
    if (be.brewTime > 0) {
      const h = Math.floor(28 * (1 - be.brewTime / 400));
      if (h > 0) c.drawImage(ui.img.brewing_stand_brew_progress, 0, 0, 9, h, this.x + 97, this.y + 16, 9, h);
      const bh = [29, 24, 20, 16, 11, 6, 0][Math.floor(be.brewTime / 2) % 7];
      if (bh > 0) c.drawImage(ui.img.brewing_stand_bubbles, 0, 29 - bh, 12, bh, this.x + 63, this.y + 14 + 29 - bh, 12, bh);
    }
    Font.draw(c, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 72, '#404040', false);
  }
  close() {
    this.game.markBlockEntity(this.be);
  }
}

// ---- opening them ----
const WORKSTATIONS = {
  enchanting: (g, pos, b) => new EnchantingScreen(g, pos, b.cn),
  anvil: (g, pos) => new AnvilScreen(g, pos),
  grindstone: (g, pos) => new GrindstoneScreen(g, pos),
  stonecutter: (g, pos) => new StonecutterScreen(g, pos),
  smithing: (g, pos) => new SmithingScreen(g, pos),
  brewing: (g, pos, b) => {
    const be = g.getBlockEntity(...pos, 'brewing');
    if (!be.bottles) Object.assign(be, {
      bottles: [null, null, null],
      ingredient: null,
      fuel: null,
      fuelLeft: 0,
      brewTime: 0
    });
    return new BrewingScreen(g, be, b.cn);
  }
};
for (const [k, use] of [['enchanting_table', 'enchanting'], ['anvil', 'anvil'], ['chipped_anvil', 'anvil'], ['damaged_anvil', 'anvil'], ['grindstone', 'grindstone'], ['stonecutter', 'stonecutter'], ['smithing_table', 'smithing'], ['brewing_stand', 'brewing']]) if (BID[k] !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID[k]].onUse = use;
Game.prototype.openWorkstation = function (b, x, y, z) {
  const sc = WORKSTATIONS[b.onUse](this, [x, y, z], b);
  sc.blockId = this.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
  this.ui.open(sc);
};
