      inside = g.player && g.player.vehicle === this;
    if (!inside && !this.sndIn) return;
    const ev = g.headInWater ? 'entity.minecart.inside.underwater' : 'entity.minecart.inside';
    if (this.sndIn && this.sndInEv !== ev) {
      this.sndIn.stop();
      this.sndIn = null;
    }
    const iv = inside && f >= 0.01 ? clamp(f, 0, 1) * 0.75 : 0;
    if (iv > 0 && !(this.sndIn && this.sndIn.live)) {
      this.sndIn = Sound.loop(ev);
      this.sndInEv = ev;
    }
    if (this.sndIn) this.sndIn.update(null, iv, 1);
  }
  saveData() {
    return {
      ...super.saveData(),
      primed: this.primed,
      enabled: this.enabled,
      push: this.push
    };
  }
  loadData(d) {
    super.loadData(d);
    if (d.primed !== undefined && d.primed !== null) this.primed = d.primed;
    if (d.enabled !== undefined) this.enabled = d.enabled;
    if (d.push) this.push = d.push;
  }
  moveOnRail(bx, by, bz, id) {
    const w = this.world,
      v = this.vel,
      meta = w.getMeta(bx, by, bz),
      shape = Features.propOf(id, meta, 'shape'),
      key = BLOCKS[id].key;
    const powered = Features.propOf(id, meta, 'powered') === 'true';
    this.fallDist = 0;
    const slope = 0.0078125;
    if (shape === 'ascending_east') v[0] -= slope;else if (shape === 'ascending_west') v[0] += slope;else if (shape === 'ascending_north') v[2] += slope;else if (shape === 'ascending_south') v[2] -= slope;
    const [a, b] = RAIL_EXITS[shape] || RAIL_EXITS.north_south;
    let dx = b[0] - a[0],
      dz = b[2] - a[2];
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (v[0] * dx + v[2] * dz < 0) {
      dx = -dx;
      dz = -dz;
    }
    let sp = Math.min(2, Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]));
    v[0] = sp * dx / len;
    v[2] = sp * dz / len;
    // the rider pushes it off from standing
    const inp = this.rider && this.rider.rideInput;
    if (inp && inp.fwd > 0 && v[0] * v[0] + v[2] * v[2] < 0.01) {
      const yaw = this.rider.yaw,
        fx = -Math.sin(yaw),
        fz = -Math.cos(yaw),
        d = (fx * dx + fz * dz) / len;
      v[0] += dx / len * d * 0.1;
      v[2] += dz / len * d * 0.1;
    }
    // a powered rail without power brakes
    if (key === 'powered_rail' && !powered) {
      if (Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]) < 0.03) {
        v[0] = 0;
        v[2] = 0;
      } else {
        v[0] *= 0.5;
        v[2] *= 0.5;
      }
    }
    // the furnace minecart's push
    if (this.kind === 'furnace' && this.fuel > 0) {
      let px = this.push[0],
        pz = this.push[1];
      const pl = Math.hypot(px, pz);
      if (pl > 1e-4) {
        px /= pl;
        pz /= pl;
        if (px * dx + pz * dz < 0) {
          px = -dx / len;
          pz = -dz / len;
        } else {
          px = dx / len;
          pz = dz / len;
        }
        this.push = [px, pz];
        v[0] = v[0] * 0.8 + px * 0.05;
        v[2] = v[2] * 0.8 + pz * 0.05;
      }
    }
    // keep it on the line through the rail
    const x0 = bx + 0.5 + a[0] * 0.5,
      z0 = bz + 0.5 + a[2] * 0.5,
      x1 = bx + 0.5 + b[0] * 0.5,
      z1 = bz + 0.5 + b[2] * 0.5;
    const lx = x1 - x0,
      lz = z1 - z0;
    let t;
    if (lx === 0) t = this.pos[2] - bz;else if (lz === 0) t = this.pos[0] - bx;else t = ((this.pos[0] - x0) * lx + (this.pos[2] - z0) * lz) * 2;
    this.pos[0] = x0 + lx * t;
    this.pos[2] = z0 + lz * t;
    // (a furnace minecart is slower: FurnaceMinecart.getMaxSpeed)
    const max = this.kind === 'furnace' ? this.inWater ? 0.15 : 0.2 : this.inWater ? 0.2 : 0.4;
    const mx = clamp(v[0], -max, max),
      mz = clamp(v[2], -max, max);
    this.pos[0] += mx;
    this.pos[2] += mz;
    // height on the rail (slopes climb with the distance across the block)
    const fx = this.pos[0] - bx,
      fz = this.pos[2] - bz;
    let h = 0.0625;
    if (shape === 'ascending_east') h += fx;else if (shape === 'ascending_west') h += 1 - fx;else if (shape === 'ascending_north') h += 1 - fz;else if (shape === 'ascending_south') h += fz;
    let ny = by + h;
    // moved onto the next block: it may be one up or down
    const nbx = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      nbz = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    if (nbx !== bx || nbz !== bz) {
      // (onto a rail at the same level: its own height - the slope's sum went on and put the cart under the floor at the
      // bottom of a slope: "下坡直接卡进方块", feedback 2026-11-01/02)
      const here = w.getBlock(nbx, by, nbz);
      if (isRail(w.getBlock(nbx, by + 1, nbz))) ny = by + 1 + 0.0625;else if (isRail(here)) {
        const s2 = Features.propOf(here, w.getMeta(nbx, by, nbz), 'shape'),
          gx = this.pos[0] - nbx,
          gz = this.pos[2] - nbz;
        ny = by + 0.0625 + (s2 === 'ascending_east' ? gx : s2 === 'ascending_west' ? 1 - gx : s2 === 'ascending_north' ? 1 - gz : s2 === 'ascending_south' ? gz : 0);
      } else if (isRail(w.getBlock(nbx, by - 1, nbz))) ny = by - 1 + 0.0625 + 0.99;
    }
    // blocked by a wall: stop
    // (on a slope the box sits higher and narrower: its corner caught the block under the upper rail and the cart
    // stopped half way up - "矿车上不了坡、卡进方块", feedback 2026-11-01/02)
    const sl = shape && shape.startsWith('ascending'),
      m = sl ? 0.35 : 0.49;
    const bb = [this.pos[0] - m, ny + (sl ? 0.45 : 0.1), this.pos[2] - m, this.pos[0] + m, ny + 0.7, this.pos[2] + m];
    if (this.collides(bb)) {
      this.pos[0] -= mx;
      this.pos[2] -= mz;
      v[0] = 0;
      v[2] = 0;
    } else this.pos[1] = ny;
    v[1] = 0;
    // friction (less with someone in it); powered rails speed it up
    const fr = this.rider ? 0.997 : 0.96;
    v[0] *= fr;
    v[2] *= fr;
    if (key === 'powered_rail' && powered) {
      const s = Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]);
      if (s > 0.01) {
        v[0] += v[0] / s * 0.06;
        v[2] += v[2] / s * 0.06;
      } else if (dx === 0) {
        if (this.collides([this.pos[0] - 0.5, ny + 0.2, this.pos[2] - 1.3, this.pos[0] + 0.5, ny + 0.6, this.pos[2] - 0.6])) v[2] = 0.02;else if (this.collides([this.pos[0] - 0.5, ny + 0.2, this.pos[2] + 0.6, this.pos[0] + 0.5, ny + 0.6, this.pos[2] + 1.3])) v[2] = -0.02;
      } else {
        if (this.collides([this.pos[0] - 1.3, ny + 0.2, this.pos[2] - 0.5, this.pos[0] - 0.6, ny + 0.6, this.pos[2] + 0.5])) v[0] = 0.02;else if (this.collides([this.pos[0] + 0.6, ny + 0.2, this.pos[2] - 0.5, this.pos[0] + 1.3, ny + 0.6, this.pos[2] + 0.5])) v[0] = -0.02;
      }
    }
    // an activator rail with power: a TNT minecart is lit, a rider is thrown out
    // an activator rail: with power a TNT minecart is lit and a rider thrown out; a hopper minecart works only without
    if (key === 'activator_rail') {
      if (this.kind === 'hopper') this.enabled = !powered;
      if (powered) {
        if (this.kind === 'tnt') this.primeTnt(80);
        if (this.rider) this.rider.dismount();
      }
    }
    // facing along the rail
    if (Math.abs(v[0]) + Math.abs(v[2]) > 1e-3) {
      const want = Math.atan2(-v[0], -v[2]);
      let d = want - this.yaw;
      while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
      if (Math.abs(d) > Math.PI / 2) d += d > 0 ? -Math.PI : Math.PI;
      this.yaw += d;
    }
    this.pitch = shape && shape.startsWith('ascending') ? (shape === 'ascending_east' || shape === 'ascending_north' ? 1 : -1) * Math.PI / 4 : 0;
  }
  seat() {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] - 0.25, this.pos[2]];
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    var _this$prevYaw2;
    const r = g.renderer;
    r.initVehicleModels();
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1] + 0.375, ip[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, lerp((_this$prevYaw2 = this.prevYaw) !== null && _this$prevYaw2 !== void 0 ? _this$prevYaw2 : this.yaw, this.yaw, a) + Math.PI / 2);
    if (this.pitch) M4.rotZ(m, -this.pitch * (Math.abs(Math.cos(this.yaw)) > 0.5 ? 1 : 1));
    if (this.hurtT > 0) M4.rotX(m, Math.sin(this.hurtT - a) * (this.hurtT - a) * (this.damage / 10) * this.hurtDir * Math.PI / 180);
    // the block it carries, three quarters size, sitting in it
    const block = {
      chest: 'chest',
      furnace: 'furnace',
      tnt: 'tnt',
      hopper: 'hopper',
      command_block: 'command_block'
    }[this.kind];
    if (block && BID[block] !== undefined) {
      const bm = M4.copy(m);
      M4.scale(bm, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75);
      M4.translate(bm, -0.5, (6 - 8) / 16, -0.5);
      if (this.kind === 'tnt' && this.primed !== undefined && (this.primed / 5 | 0) % 2 === 0) {
        M4.translate(bm, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
        M4.scale(bm, 1.1, 1.1, 1.1);
        M4.translate(bm, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5);
      }
      if (block === 'chest') {
        // the chest model as the item icon draws it (its model is y-down from the block's corner)
        const cm = M4.copy(m);
        M4.scale(cm, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75);
        M4.translate(cm, 0, -2 / 16, 0);
        M4.translate(cm, -0.5, 0, -0.5);
        M4.scale(cm, -1, -1, 1);
        r.initBEModels();
        r.drawModel('chest', r.beTex('chest_normal') || 'chest_normal', cm, null, l, env);
      } else {
        // (a furnace minecart with fuel shows a lit furnace)
        const bid = block === 'furnace' && this.fuel > 0 && BID.lit_furnace !== undefined ? BID.lit_furnace : BID[block];
        r.drawMesh(g.blockMesh(bid, block === 'furnace' ? Features.withProp(bid, 0, 'facing', 'east') : 0), bm, env, l);
      }
    }
    r.gl.disable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
    r.drawModel('vh_minecart', r.beTex('minecart'), m, null, l, env);
    r.gl.enable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
  }
  savePrev() {
    super.savePrev();
    this.prevYaw = this.yaw;
  }
}

// ---- riding ----
Player.prototype.mount = function (v) {
  if (this.vehicle) this.dismount();
  this.vehicle = v;
  v.rider = this;
  this.flying = false;
  this.gliding = false;
  this.sneaking = false;
  this.followVehicle(v);
  this.savePrev();
};
Player.prototype.dismount = function () {
  const v = this.vehicle;
  if (!v) return;
  this.vehicle = null;
  v.rider = null;
  this.rideInput = null;
  this.pos = dismountSpot(this, v) || [v.pos[0], v.pos[1] + v.h, v.pos[2]];
  this.vel = [0, 0, 0];
  this.savePrev();
};
// where a rider gets off (vanilla getDismountLocationForPassenger of each kind; null: on top of it). Before, four spots
// 1.2 away at the height of its bottom, each wanting a solid block under it: from a boat the shore (a block higher than
// its bottom) never counted, nor a slab or a path, and in a low tunnel a minecart's or a horse's rider was put on its
// top, into the ceiling - "下不了船", "上了矿车/马后下不来", feedback 11-01..11. Standing, else crouching, else crawling
const DISMOUNT_H = () => [PLAYER_H.stand, PLAYER_H.crouch, PLAYER_H.swim];
// vanilla Entity.getCollisionHorizontalEscapeVector: just clear of both boxes toward (dx, dz)
function escapeVec(w1, w2, dx, dz) {
  const d = (w1 + w2 + 1e-5) / 2,
    s = Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) || 1;
  return [dx * d / s, dz * d / s];
}
// DismountHelper.offsetsForDirection: right, left, the back corners, the front corners, back, front of a cardinal facing
function dismountOffsets(fx, fz) {
  const rx = -fz,
    rz = fx;
  return [[rx, rz], [-rx, -rz], [rx - fx, rz - fz], [-rx - fx, -rz - fz], [rx + fx, rz + fz], [-rx + fx, -rz + fz], [-fx, -fz], [fx, fz]];
}
function cardinalOf(dx, dz) {
  return Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dz) ? [Math.sign(dx) || 1, 0] : [0, Math.sign(dz)];
}
function dismountSpot(p, v) {
  const w = p.world,
    H = DISMOUNT_H(),
    fl = Math.floor;
  if (typeof HappyGhast !== 'undefined' && v instanceof HappyGhast) return null;
  // a boat (AbstractBoat): out where the rider looks, on the floor at its top's height or the block below; not over water
  if (v instanceof Boat) {
    const d = escapeVec(v.w * Math.SQRT2, p.w, -Math.sin(p.yaw), -Math.cos(p.yaw)),
      x = v.pos[0] + d[0],
      z = v.pos[2] + d[1],
      ty = fl(v.pos[1] + v.h);
    if (w.waterAt(fl(x), ty - 1, fl(z))) return null;
    const ts = [ty, ty - 1].map(y => [y, blockFloor(w, fl(x), y, fl(z), false)]).filter(([, f]) => f < 1);
    for (const h of H) for (const [y, f] of ts) if (standsFree(p, x, y + f, z, h)) return [x, y + f, z];
    return null;
  }
  // a horse, donkey, llama, camel ... (AbstractHorse): its right side, else its left, from its feet up to 0.75 over its
  // top; else at its feet
  if (typeof Horse !== 'undefined' && v instanceof Horse) {
    const fx = -Math.sin(v.yaw),
      fz = -Math.cos(v.yaw),
      top = v.pos[1] + v.h + 0.75;
    for (const side of [1, -1]) {
      const d = escapeVec(v.w, p.w, -fz * side, fx * side),
        x = v.pos[0] + d[0],
        z = v.pos[2] + d[1];
      for (const h of H) for (let y = fl(v.pos[1]); y < top; y++) {
        const f = blockFloor(w, fl(x), y, fl(z), false);
        if (y + f > top) break;
        if (f < 1 && standsFree(p, x, y + f, z, h)) return [x, y + f, z];
      }
    }
    return [v.pos[0], v.pos[1], v.pos[2]];
  }
  // a strider (Strider): where the rider looks and 22.5, 45 degrees off it, from its top down to under its feet, not in lava
  if (v.type === 'strider') {
    const seen = new Set(),
      cells = [];
    for (const da of [0, 22.5, -22.5, 45, -45]) {
      // (vanilla yRot - 22.5 first: this game's yaw turns the other way)
      const a = p.yaw + da * Math.PI / 180,
        d = escapeVec(v.w, p.w, -Math.sin(a), -Math.cos(a)),
        cx = fl(v.pos[0] + d[0]),
        cz = fl(v.pos[2] + d[1]);
      for (let y = v.pos[1] + v.h, i = fl(y); y > v.pos[1] - 0.5; y--, i--) {
        const k = cx + ',' + i + ',' + cz;
        if (!seen.has(k)) {
          seen.add(k);
          cells.push([cx, i, cz]);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const [x, y, z] of cells) {
      if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) === LAVA) continue;
      const f = blockFloor(w, x, y, z, false);
      if (f < 1) for (const h of H) if (standsFree(p, x + 0.5, y + f, z + 0.5, h)) return [x + 0.5, y + f, z + 0.5];
    }
    return null;
  }
  // a minecart (AbstractMinecart: a block up or down too) or another animal (Animal: a pig ...): the eight blocks around
  // it, its sides first
  const cart = v instanceof Minecart,
    bx = fl(v.pos[0]),
    by = fl(v.pos[1]),
    bz = fl(v.pos[2]);
  const mv = Math.abs(v.vel[0]) + Math.abs(v.vel[2]) > 1e-3,
    f0 = cardinalOf(mv ? v.vel[0] : -Math.sin(v.yaw), mv ? v.vel[2] : -Math.cos(v.yaw));
  for (const h of H) for (const dy of cart ? h === PLAYER_H.swim ? [0, 1] : [0, 1, -1] : [0]) for (const [ox, oz] of dismountOffsets(f0[0], f0[1])) {
    const x = bx + ox,
      y = by + dy,
      z = bz + oz,
      f = blockFloor(w, x, y, z, cart);
    if (f < 1 && standsFree(p, x + 0.5, y + f, z + 0.5, h)) return [x + 0.5, y + f, z + 0.5];
  }
  return null;
}
Player.prototype.followVehicle = function (v) {
  const s = v.seat();
  this.pos[0] = s[0];
  this.pos[1] = s[1];
  this.pos[2] = s[2];
  this.vel = [0, 0, 0];
  this.fallDist = 0;
};
const _vPlayerTick = Player.prototype.tick;
Player.prototype.tick = function (input) {
  const v = this.vehicle;
  if (!v) return _vPlayerTick.call(this, input);
  if (v.dead || input.sneak && !this.rideSneak) {
    this.dismount();
    this.rideSneak = !!input.sneak;
    return _vPlayerTick.call(this, {
      ...input,
      sneak: false
    });
  }
  this.rideSneak = !!input.sneak;
  this.savePrev();
  this.baseTick();
  if (this.boostT > 0) this.boostT--; // (a rocket's push runs out while riding too - the on-foot tick counts it: equip.js)
  if (this.deathTime > 0) {
    this.dismount();
    this.deathTime++;
    return;
  }
  this.rideInput = input;
  this.onGround = true;
  this.sprinting = false;
  this.swimming = false;
  this.pose = 'stand';
  this.h = 1.8;
  // no view bobbing while riding: it settles to nothing. The last tick's values follow along - left as they were on
  // getting in, the hand swung between them every frame (shaking the whole ride)
  this.prevBob = this.bob;
  this.prevBobAmt = this.bobAmt;
  this.bobAmt *= 0.6;
  this.limbAmt = 0;
  // the hand, its swing, hunger and regeneration go on as on foot (skipped, a swing froze half-way and the hand
  // jumped between two heights every frame)
  this.handsTick();
  this.hungerTick();
  // a boat turns its rider with it
  if (v instanceof Boat && v.prevYaw !== undefined) this.yaw += v.yaw - v.prevYaw;
};
// sitting: legs forward, like vanilla's riding pose
const _vPose = Game.prototype.playerPose;
Game.prototype.playerPose = function (a) {
  const P = _vPose.call(this, a),
    p = this.player;
  if (p.vehicle) {
    P.rleg = {
      rx: 1.4137167,
      ry: -0.31415927
    };
    P.lleg = {
      rx: 1.4137167,
      ry: 0.31415927
    };
    if (!p.usingItem) {
      P.rarm.rx = (P.rarm.rx || 0) + 0.62831855;
      P.larm.rx = (P.larm.rx || 0) + 0.62831855;
    }
  }
  return P;
};
// not targeting the vehicle being ridden
const _rayEntity = Game.prototype.rayEntity;
Game.prototype.rayEntity = function (o, d, max) {
  const v = this.player && this.player.vehicle;
  if (!v) return _rayEntity.call(this, o, d, max);
  const was = v.hittable;
  v.hittable = false;
  v.dead = true;
  try {
    return _rayEntity.call(this, o, d, max);
  } finally {
    v.dead = false;
    v.hittable = was;
  }
};

// ---- placing: boats on water (or the ground), minecarts on rails ----
const _vUseEquipment = Game.prototype.useEquipment;
Game.prototype.useEquipment = function (held, def) {
  const k = def && def.key,
    p = this.player;
  if (BOAT_ITEM[k]) {
    const eye = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + p.eye(), p.pos[2]],
      t = this.raycast(eye, this.lookDir(), this.reach(), true);
    if (!t) return true;
    let [x, y, z] = t.point;
    if (IS_FLUID[t.id]) y = Math.floor(y) + 1 - 0.11 - 0.4;else if (t.face !== 3) return true;
    const [wood, chest] = BOAT_ITEM[k],
      b = new Boat(this, x, y, z, wood, chest);
    b.yaw = p.yaw;
    b.savePrev();
    if (b.collides(b.box()) && !IS_FLUID[t.id]) return true;
    this.entities.push(b);
    if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
      held.count--;
      if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
    }
    p.swing();
    Sound.ev('entity.boat.paddle_water', [x, y, z], 0.5, 1);
    return true;
  }
  if (CART_ITEM[k] !== undefined) {
    const t = this.target;
    if (!t || !isRail(t.id)) return true;
    const [x, y, z] = t.pos,
      c = new Minecart(this, x + 0.5, y + 0.0625, z + 0.5, CART_ITEM[k]);
    const sh = railShape(this.world, x, y, z) || 'north_south';
    c.yaw = sh.includes('east') || sh.includes('west') ? Math.PI / 2 : 0;
    c.savePrev();
    this.entities.push(c);
    if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
      held.count--;
      if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
    }
    p.swing();
    return true;
  }
  return _vUseEquipment.call(this, held, def);
};

// ---- rails join their neighbours (a simple RailState): straight, sloped up to a rail one higher, curved (plain rails) ----
const RAIL_DIRS = {
  north: [0, -1],
  south: [0, 1],
  west: [-1, 0],
  east: [1, 0]
};
function railConnects(w, x, y, z, toX, toZ) {
  // the rail at x,y,z (or one below / above) has an exit toward toX,toZ
  for (const dy of [0, -1, 1]) {
    const sh = railShape(w, x, y + dy, z);
    if (sh && RAIL_EXITS[sh].some(([ex,, ez]) => x + ex === toX && z + ez === toZ)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function railNeighbors(w, x, y, z) {
  const out = [];
  for (const [d, [dx, dz]] of Object.entries(RAIL_DIRS)) {
    for (const dy of [0, 1, -1]) if (railShape(w, x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)) {
      out.push({
        d,
        dx,
        dz,
        dy
      });
      break;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
// a T junction's curve (vanilla RailState.place with three neighbours): unpowered the last of north-west, north-east,
// south-west, south-east that it can make; powered the last of south-east, south-west, north-east, north-west.
// null when it isn't a junction
function railJunctionShape(w, x, y, z, powered) {
  const ds = new Set(railNeighbors(w, x, y, z).map(n => n.d));
  if (ds.size !== 3) return null;
  const n = ds.has('north'),
    s = ds.has('south'),
    e = ds.has('east'),
    wt = ds.has('west');
  const order = powered ? [['south_east', s && e], ['south_west', s && wt], ['north_east', n && e], ['north_west', n && wt]] : [['north_west', n && wt], ['north_east', n && e], ['south_west', s && wt], ['south_east', s && e]];
  let shape = null;
  for (const [k, ok] of order) if (ok) shape = k;
  return shape;
}
function railShapeFor(w, x, y, z, curves, fallbackNS) {
  const ns = railNeighbors(w, x, y, z);
  // the neighbours that are free to join (fewer than two links, or already pointing here)
  const free = ns.filter(n => {
    const sh = railShape(w, x + n.dx, y + n.dy, z + n.dz);
    const links = railNeighbors(w, x + n.dx, y + n.dy, z + n.dz).filter(m => railConnects(w, x + n.dx + m.dx, y + n.dy + m.dy, z + n.dz + m.dz, x + n.dx, z + n.dz)).length;
    return links < 2 || RAIL_EXITS[sh].some(([ex,, ez]) => ex === -n.dx && ez === -n.dz);
  });
  const has = d => free.find(n => n.d === d);
  const up = d => {
    const n = has(d);
    return n && n.dy === 1;
  };
  let shape;
  if (has('north') && has('south')) shape = up('north') ? 'ascending_north' : up('south') ? 'ascending_south' : 'north_south';else if (has('east') && has('west')) shape = up('east') ? 'ascending_east' : up('west') ? 'ascending_west' : 'east_west';else if (curves && (has('north') || has('south')) && (has('east') || has('west'))) shape = (has('north') ? 'north' : 'south') + '_' + (has('east') ? 'east' : 'west');else if (has('north') || has('south')) shape = up('north') ? 'ascending_north' : up('south') ? 'ascending_south' : 'north_south';else if (has('east') || has('west')) shape = up('east') ? 'ascending_east' : up('west') ? 'ascending_west' : 'east_west';else shape = fallbackNS ? 'north_south' : 'east_west';
  return shape;
}
const _vPlaceState = Game.prototype.placeState;
Game.prototype.placeState = function (b, t, hdir) {
  let m = _vPlaceState.call(this, b, t, hdir);
  if (!/(^|_)rail$/.test(b.key) || !b.states || !('shape' in b.states[0])) return m;
  const D = DIRS[t.face],
    x = t.pos[0] + D[0],
    y = t.pos[1] + D[1],
    z = t.pos[2] + D[2];
  const shape = railShapeFor(this.world, x, y, z, b.key === 'rail', hdir === 4 || hdir === 5);
  if (b.states.some(s => s.shape === shape)) m = Features.withProp(b.id, m, 'shape', shape);
  this.pendingRail = [x, y, z];
  return m;
};
const _vPlaceAt = Game.prototype.placeAt;
Game.prototype.placeAt = function (...args) {
  const r = _vPlaceAt.apply(this, args);
  const pr = this.pendingRail;
  this.pendingRail = null;
  if (pr) {
    // neighbours that had a free end turn toward the new rail
    const w = this.world,
      [x, y, z] = pr;
    for (const n of railNeighbors(w, x, y, z)) {
      const nx = x + n.dx,
        ny = y + n.dy,
        nz = z + n.dz,
        id = w.getBlock(nx, ny, nz);
      if (railConnects(w, nx, ny, nz, x, z)) continue;
      const links = railNeighbors(w, nx, ny, nz).filter(m => railConnects(w, nx + m.dx, ny + m.dy, nz + m.dz, nx, nz) && !(nx + m.dx === x && nz + m.dz === z)).length;
      if (links >= 2) continue;
      const sh = railShapeFor(w, nx, ny, nz, BLOCKS[id].key === 'rail', true);
      if (BLOCKS[id].states.some(s => s.shape === sh)) w.setMeta(nx, ny, nz, Features.withProp(id, w.getMeta(nx, ny, nz), 'shape', sh));
    }
    this.flushMesh();
  }
  return r;
};

// ---- saving: vehicles go with the mobs ----
const _vCreateMob = createMob;
createMob = function (game, type, x, y, z) {
  if (typeof type === 'string' && type.includes('boat:')) {
    const [k, wood] = type.split(':');
    return new Boat(game, x, y, z, wood, k === 'chest_boat');
  }
  if (typeof type === 'string' && type.startsWith('minecart:')) return new Minecart(game, x, y, z, type.slice(9));
  return _vCreateMob(game, type, x, y, z);
};

// ---- mobs riding boats and minecarts (vanilla AbstractBoat / AbstractMinecart pushing entities) ----------------
// A mob that bumps into a boat nobody is steering gets in (not fish, squid, dolphins ... - the
// cannot_be_pushed_onto_boats tag - nor anything as wide as the boat); one bumping into a moving minecart gets in (not
// iron golems). It stays seated until the vehicle breaks or an activator rail throws it out, and doesn't despawn
// meanwhile (Mob.requiresCustomPersistence). With a player too, a boat seats the player in front and the mob behind.
const NO_BOAT_MOBS = new Set(['elder_guardian', 'cod', 'pufferfish', 'salmon', 'tropical_fish', 'dolphin', 'squid', 'glow_squid', 'tadpole', 'creaking', 'nautilus', 'zombie_nautilus', 'sulfur_cube']);
// (a mob's feet: the vehicle's passenger point 0.1875 up, less its riding offset - about 0.6 for the humanoid ones,
// which sit with their legs out like the player; animals stand on it)
const SEATED_MOBS = /zombie|skeleton|stray|bogged|husk|drowned|villager|wandering_trader|piglin|pillager|vindicator|evoker|illusioner|witch/;
Vehicle.prototype.seatFor = function (e) {
  const s = this.seat();
  if (e === this.mob) s[1] = this.pos[1] + 0.1875 - (SEATED_MOBS.test(e.type || '') ? 0.6 : 0);
  if (this instanceof Boat && this.rider && this.mob) {
    const f = e === this.mob ? -0.6 : 0.2;
    s[0] += -Math.sin(this.yaw) * f;
    s[2] += -Math.cos(this.yaw) * f;
  }
  return s;
};
Vehicle.prototype.pickUpMob = function () {
  const boat = this instanceof Boat,
    g = this.game;
  if (boat ? !!this.rider : !(this.canRide && !this.rider && this.vel[0] ** 2 + this.vel[2] ** 2 > 0.01)) return;
  const b = this.box();
  for (const e of g.entities) {
    if (!(e instanceof Mob) || e.dead || e.deathTime || e.vehicleRef || e.remote || (e.boardAt || 0) > g.tickCount || e.rider) continue;
    if (boat ? NO_BOAT_MOBS.has(e.type) || e.w >= this.w : e.type === 'iron_golem') continue;
    const eb = e.box();
    if (eb[3] < b[0] - 0.2 || eb[0] > b[3] + 0.2 || eb[5] < b[2] - 0.2 || eb[2] > b[5] + 0.2 || eb[4] < b[1] || eb[1] > b[4]) continue;
    this.board(e);
    return;
  }
};
Vehicle.prototype.board = function (e) {
  this.mob = e;
  e.vehicleRef = this;
  e.riding = true;
  e.persistent = true;
  e.goal = null;
};
Vehicle.prototype.dropMob = function () {
  const m = this.mob;
  this.mob = null;
  if (!m || m.vehicleRef !== this) return;
  m.vehicleRef = null;
  m.riding = false;
  m.boardAt = this.game.tickCount + 60; // (vanilla's boarding cooldown)
  m.pos[1] = this.pos[1] + this.h;
  m.prev = [...m.pos];
};
const _vInteract = Vehicle.prototype.interact;
Vehicle.prototype.interact = function (p, held) {
  if (this instanceof Minecart && this.mob && !(this.slots && p.sneaking)) return false;
  return _vInteract.call(this, p, held);
}; // (one seat)
const _vHurt = Vehicle.prototype.hurt;
Vehicle.prototype.hurt = function (a, src) {
  const r = _vHurt.call(this, a, src);
  if (this.dead && this.mob) this.dropMob();
  return r;
};
// (rideable mobs - horses, pigs, striders ... - have only their seat(); boats and minecarts seat a mob passenger too)
Player.prototype.followVehicle = function (v) {
  const s = v.seatFor ? v.seatFor(this) : v.seat();
  this.pos[0] = s[0];
  this.pos[1] = s[1];
  this.pos[2] = s[2];
  this.vel = [0, 0, 0];
  this.fallDist = 0;
};
// after every entity has ticked (the vehicles have moved, the mobs' own steps are undone): passengers on their seats
Game.prototype.seatPassengers = function () {
  if (this.net) return;
  for (const v of this.entities) {
    if (!(v instanceof Vehicle) || v.dead) continue;
    // a saved world: the mob that was in it, found again near it
    if (v.wantsMob && !v.mob) {
      const m = this.entities.find(e => e instanceof Mob && e.wantsRide && !e.vehicleRef && Math.abs(e.pos[0] - v.pos[0]) < 2 && Math.abs(e.pos[1] - v.pos[1]) < 2 && Math.abs(e.pos[2] - v.pos[2]) < 2);
      if (m) {
        m.wantsRide = false;
        v.board(m);
      }
      v.wantsMob = false;
    }
    if (!v.mob) {
      v.pickUpMob();
      if (!v.mob) continue;
    }
    const m = v.mob;
    if (m.dead || m.deathTime || m.vehicleRef !== v) {
      v.dropMob();
      continue;
    }
    // an activator rail with power empties a minecart
    if (v instanceof Minecart) {
      const bx = Math.floor(v.pos[0]),
        bz = Math.floor(v.pos[2]);
      let by = Math.floor(v.pos[1]);
      if (!isRail(this.world.getBlock(bx, by, bz))) by--;
      const id = this.world.getBlock(bx, by, bz);
      if (BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].key === 'activator_rail' && Features.propOf(id, this.world.getMeta(bx, by, bz), 'powered') === 'true') {
        v.dropMob();
        continue;
      }
    }
    m.pos = v.seatFor(m);
    m.vel = [0, 0, 0];
    m.fallDist = 0;
    m.goal = null;
    m.limbAmt = 0; // (sitting, not walking)
    if (v instanceof Boat) {
      m.bodyYaw = m.yaw = v.yaw;
    }
  }
};
const _vSaveV = Vehicle.prototype.saveData,
  _vLoadV = Vehicle.prototype.loadData;
Vehicle.prototype.saveData = function () {
  return {
    ..._vSaveV.call(this),
    mob: this.mob ? 1 : 0
  };
};
Vehicle.prototype.loadData = function (d) {
  _vLoadV.call(this, d);
  if (d && d.mob) this.wantsMob = true;
};
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/redstone.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Redstone in single player, by vanilla's rules: signal strength 0-15, strong and weak power (a solid block
// powered by dust powers the components next to it but not other dust), quasi-connectivity for pistons,
// dispensers and droppers, scheduled ticks (repeaters, torches, comparators, observers, buttons).
//   sources:    lever, buttons, pressure plates, redstone block, redstone torch, daylight detector, observer,
//               target, trapped chest, detector rail, tripwire hooks
//   wire:       redstone dust (power in its block id, blocks.js WIRE_ID; connections in its meta, dot / cross)
//   components: repeater (delay, locking), comparator (compare / subtract, containers and other readable blocks)
//   powered:    redstone lamp, doors, trapdoors, fence gates, TNT, note block, bell, copper bulb, powered and
//               activator rails, pistons and sticky pistons (slime and honey blocks), dispenser, dropper, hopper
//               (locked when powered), crafter
// A direction given to a signal function is vanilla's: the way from the block asking to the block that answers.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const RS_DIRS = {
  down: [0, -1, 0],
  up: [0, 1, 0],
  north: [0, 0, -1],
  south: [0, 0, 1],
  west: [-1, 0, 0],
  east: [1, 0, 0]
};
const RS_DN = ['down', 'up', 'north', 'south', 'west', 'east'],
  RS_H = ['north', 'south', 'west', 'east'];
const RS_OPP = {
  down: 'up',
  up: 'down',
  north: 'south',
  south: 'north',
  west: 'east',
  east: 'west'
};
const RS_CW = {
  north: 'east',
  east: 'south',
  south: 'west',
  west: 'north'
};
const FACE_NAME = ['west', 'east', 'down', 'up', 'north', 'south']; // the game's face index -> vanilla direction
const rsKey = (x, y, z) => x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
const prop = (id, m, k) => Features.propOf(id, m, k);
const rsk = id => BLOCKS[id] ? BLOCKS[id].key : '';
const isWire = id => !!BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].wirePower !== undefined;
const wireP = id => BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].wirePower || 0;
const RS_PLATE = /pressure_plate$/,
  RS_BUTTON = /_button$/;
const RS = {
  wires: true,
  // false while dust works out its own power (dust doesn't feed dust through blocks)
  mem: new Map(),
  // position -> logic state vanilla keeps in the block (comparator output, daylight power, ...)
  queue: [],
  qi: 0,
  queued: new Set(),
  busy: false,
  torchHist: new Map(),
  events: [],
  evSet: new Set(),
  // pistons to act once this round of updates is done (vanilla block events)
  pistonT: new Map(),
  // position -> { t, ext }: a piston's last move (it is still moving for 2 ticks)
  meshDirty: false
};

// ---- what counts as what ----
const RS_FULL = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS); // 0 unknown, 1 full solid cube, 2 not
function rsFull(id) {
  if (!id) return false;
  let v = RS_FULL[id];
  if (!v) {
    const b = BLOCKS[id];
    let full = !!SOLIDCUBE[id];
    if (!full && b && b.solid && !b.slab && !b.stairs && !b.fence && b.shape !== SH_CROSS) {
      try {
        const bx = b.boxes ? b.boxes(0) : null;
        full = !!bx && bx.length === 1 && bx[0][0] <= 0 && bx[0][1] <= 0 && bx[0][2] <= 0 && bx[0][3] >= 16 && bx[0][4] >= 16 && bx[0][5] >= 16;
      } catch (e) {
        full = false;
      }
    }
    RS_FULL[id] = v = full ? 1 : 2;
  }
  return v === 1;
}
// conducts power: solid full blocks, but not the ones vanilla excludes
const RS_NONCOND = /^(redstone_block|observer|piston|sticky_piston|piston_head|moving_piston|slime_block|honey_block|daylight_detector|target_never|glass|.*_glass|ice|.*_leaves|tnt_never|soul_sand|mud|.*_shulker_box|shulker_box)$/;
function conductor(id) {
  return rsFull(id) && !RS_NONCOND.test(rsk(id));
}
// a block vanilla calls a signal source (dust turns toward these)
const RS_SOURCE = /^(lever|redstone_torch|redstone_wall_torch|redstone_block|repeater|comparator|observer|daylight_detector|target|trapped_chest|detector_rail|tripwire_hook|lectern|sculk_sensor|calibrated_sculk_sensor|lightning_rod)$|_button$|pressure_plate$/;
const rsSource = id => RS_SOURCE.test(rsk(id)) || isWire(id);

// ---- signals ----
function attachedDir(id, m) {
  // direction from the block a lever / button is on, toward it
  const face = prop(id, m, 'face'),
    f = prop(id, m, 'facing');
  return face === 'floor' ? 'up' : face === 'ceiling' ? 'down' : f;
}
RS.signal = function (g, x, y, z, dir) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (!id) return 0;
  const m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id);
  if (isWire(id)) {
    if (!RS.wires || dir === 'down') return 0;
    const p = wireP(id);
    if (!p) return 0;
    if (dir === 'up') return p;
    const c = prop(id, m, RS_OPP[dir]);
    return c && c !== 'none' ? p : isDotMeta(id, m) ? 0 : 0;
  }
  if (k === 'lever' || RS_BUTTON.test(k)) return prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' ? 15 : 0;
  if (RS_PLATE.test(k)) return k.includes('weighted') ? +prop(id, m, 'power') || 0 : prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'redstone_torch') return prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true' && dir !== 'up' ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'redstone_wall_torch') return prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true' && dir !== prop(id, m, 'facing') ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'redstone_block') return 15;
  if (k === 'repeater') return prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' && prop(id, m, 'facing') === dir ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'comparator') return prop(id, m, 'facing') === dir ? (RS.mem.get(rsKey(x, y, z)) || {}).out || 0 : 0;
  if (k === 'observer') return prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' && prop(id, m, 'facing') === dir ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'daylight_detector') return (RS.mem.get(rsKey(x, y, z)) || {}).power || 0;
  if (k === 'target') {
    const t = RS.mem.get(rsKey(x, y, z));
    return t && t.until > g.tickCount ? t.power : 0;
  }
  if (k === 'trapped_chest') return g.openChests && g.openChests.has(rsKey(x, y, z)) ? 1 : 0;
  if (k === 'detector_rail') return prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'tripwire_hook') return prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' ? 15 : 0;
  return 0;
};
RS.direct = function (g, x, y, z, dir) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (!id) return 0;
  const m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id);
  if (isWire(id)) return RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir);
  if (k === 'lever' || RS_BUTTON.test(k)) return attachedDir(id, m) === dir ? RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir) : 0;
  if (RS_PLATE.test(k) || k === 'trapped_chest' || k === 'detector_rail') return dir === 'up' ? RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir) : 0;
  if (k === 'redstone_torch' || k === 'redstone_wall_torch') return dir === 'down' ? RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir) : 0;
  if (k === 'repeater' || k === 'comparator' || k === 'observer') return RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir);
  if (k === 'tripwire_hook') return prop(id, m, 'facing') === dir ? RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir) : 0;
  return 0;
};
// the strong power going into a block from its neighbours
RS.directInto = function (g, x, y, z) {
  let best = 0;
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d],
      s = RS.direct(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2], d);
    if (s > best) {
      best = s;
      if (best >= 15) break;
    }
  }
  return best;
};
// Level.getSignal: what a block gives toward a neighbour (a conductor passes on the strong power it receives)
RS.get = function (g, x, y, z, dir) {
  const s = RS.signal(g, x, y, z, dir),
    id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
  return conductor(id) ? Math.max(s, RS.directInto(g, x, y, z)) : s;
};
RS.has = (g, x, y, z, dir) => RS.get(g, x, y, z, dir) > 0;
// is anything powering this block (from any side)
RS.neighborSignal = function (g, x, y, z) {
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d];
    if (RS.get(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2], d) > 0) return true;
  }
  return false;
};
RS.bestNeighbor = function (g, x, y, z) {
  let best = 0;
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d],
      s = RS.get(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2], d);
    if (s > best) {
      best = s;
      if (best >= 15) break;
    }
  }
  return best;
};
// pistons, dispensers, droppers: also powered from the block above them (quasi-connectivity)
RS.qcPowered = function (g, x, y, z, except) {
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    if (d === except) continue;
    const v = RS_DIRS[d];
    if (RS.get(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2], d) > 0) return true;
  }
  if (RS.get(g, x, y, z, 'down') > 0) return true; // vanilla also asks the block itself below
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    if (d === 'down') continue;
    const v = RS_DIRS[d];
    if (RS.get(g, x + v[0], y + 1 + v[1], z + v[2], d) > 0) return true;
  }
  return false;
};

// ---- changing state: set a block (lighting, neighbours told) and wake what may care ----
RS.set = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const w = g.world;
  if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) === id && w.getMeta(x, y, z) === m) return false;
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, m);
  RS.wake(x, y, z);
  return true;
};
RS.setProp = function (g, x, y, z, k, v) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  return RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), k, v));
};
// a change in power: the neighbours and their neighbours are checked (strong power passes through a block)
RS.wake = function (x, y, z) {
  RS.enqueue(x, y, z);
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d],
      nx = x + v[0],
      ny = y + v[1],
      nz = z + v[2];
    RS.enqueue(nx, ny, nz);
    for (const e of RS_DN) {
      const u = RS_DIRS[e];
      RS.enqueue(nx + u[0], ny + u[1], nz + u[2]);
    }
  }
};
RS.enqueue = function (x, y, z) {
  const k = rsKey(x, y, z);
  if (RS.queued.has(k)) return;
  RS.queued.add(k);
  RS.queue.push([x, y, z]);
};
RS.process = function (g) {
  if (RS.busy || !g.world) return;
  RS.busy = true;
  let n = 0;
  try {
    // (read by an index: shift() moved the whole queue each time). The updates first, then one piston's move, and
    // the updates that brings - as vanilla's block events, run after the updates
    for (;;) {
      while (RS.qi < RS.queue.length && n++ < 60000) {
        const [x, y, z] = RS.queue[RS.qi++];
        RS.queued.delete(rsKey(x, y, z));
        RS.update(g, x, y, z);
      }
      if (n >= 60000 || !RS.events.length) break;
      const [x, y, z] = RS.events.shift();
      RS.evSet.delete(rsKey(x, y, z));
      RS.pistonEvent(g, x, y, z);
    }
  } finally {
    RS.busy = false;
    if (RS.qi >= RS.queue.length || RS.queue.length - RS.qi > 60000) {
      RS.queue.length = 0;
      RS.queued.clear();
    } else RS.queue = RS.queue.slice(RS.qi);
    RS.qi = 0;
    // (the chunks the pistons changed meshed again once, not after every piston)
    if (RS.meshDirty) {
      RS.meshDirty = false;
      if (g.flushMesh) g.flushMesh();
    }
  }
};

// ---- dust ----
function isDotMeta(id, m) {
  const s = BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].states && BLOCKS[id].states[m];
  return !!s && s.north === 'none' && s.south === 'none' && s.east === 'none' && s.west === 'none';
}
// what dust turns toward (vanilla shouldConnectTo)
function connectsTo(g, x, y, z, dir) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  if (isWire(id)) return true;
  if (k === 'repeater') {
    const f = prop(id, m, 'facing');
    return f === dir || f === RS_OPP[dir];
  }
  if (k === 'observer') return dir === prop(id, m, 'facing');
  return rsSource(id) && dir !== null;
}
// the block under dust holds it (a sturdy top, or a hopper)
function dustSupported(g, x, y, z) {
  const b = g.world.getBlock(x, y - 1, z);
  return rsFull(b) || rsk(b) === 'hopper' || BLOCKS[b] && BLOCKS[b].slab && (g.world.getMeta(x, y - 1, z) & 3) !== 0;
}
// vanilla getConnectionState with the dot / cross rules
RS.wireShape = function (g, x, y, z, curMeta) {
  const w = g.world,
    wid = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  const aboveCond = conductor(w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z));
  const side = {};
  for (const d of RS_H) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d],
      nx = x + v[0],
      nz = z + v[2],
      nid = w.getBlock(nx, y, nz);
    let c = 'none';
    if (!aboveCond && BLOCKS[nid] && (BLOCKS[nid].trapdoor || rsFull(nid)) && isWire(w.getBlock(nx, y + 1, nz))) c = rsFull(nid) ? 'up' : 'side';else if (connectsTo(g, nx, y, nz, d) || !conductor(nid) && isWire(w.getBlock(nx, y - 1, nz))) c = 'side';
    side[d] = c;
  }
  const any = RS_H.some(d => side[d] !== 'none');
  if (!any && curMeta !== undefined && isDotMeta(wid, curMeta)) return side; // a dot stays a dot
  const ns = side.north !== 'none' || side.south !== 'none',
    ew = side.east !== 'none' || side.west !== 'none';
  if (!ns) {
    if (side.east === 'none') side.east = 'side';
    if (side.west === 'none') side.west = 'side';
  }
  if (!ew) {
    if (side.north === 'none') side.north = 'side';
    if (side.south === 'none') side.south = 'side';
  }
  // a single line: both ways along its axis
  return side;
};
function wireMeta(id, side) {
  const st = BLOCKS[id].states;
  const i = st.findIndex(s => s.north === side.north && s.south === side.south && s.east === side.east && s.west === side.west);
  return i < 0 ? 0 : i;
}
RS.wirePower = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world;
  RS.wires = false;
  const i = RS.bestNeighbor(g, x, y, z);
  RS.wires = true;
  let j = 0;
  if (i < 15) {
    const aboveCond = conductor(w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z));
    for (const d of RS_H) {
      const v = RS_DIRS[d],
        nx = x + v[0],
        nz = z + v[2],
        nid = w.getBlock(nx, y, nz);
      j = Math.max(j, wireP(nid));
      if (conductor(nid) && !aboveCond) j = Math.max(j, wireP(w.getBlock(nx, y + 1, nz)));else if (!conductor(nid)) j = Math.max(j, wireP(w.getBlock(nx, y - 1, nz)));
    }
  }
  return Math.max(i, j - 1);
};
RS.updateWire = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  if (!dustSupported(g, x, y, z)) {
    g.breakRS(x, y, z);
    return;
  }
  const p = RS.wirePower(g, x, y, z),
    nm = wireMeta(id, RS.wireShape(g, x, y, z, m)),
    nid = WIRE_ID[p];
  if (nid !== id || nm !== m) {
    const powerChanged = nid !== id;
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, nid, nm);
    if (powerChanged) RS.wake(x, y, z);else RS.enqueue(x, y, z);
  }
};

// ---- the update of one position (after a neighbour changed, or when placed) ----
RS.update = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world;
  if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) return;
  const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (!id) return;
  const b = BLOCKS[id],
    k = b.key,
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  if (isWire(id)) return RS.updateWire(g, x, y, z);
  switch (k) {
    case 'redstone_torch':
    case 'redstone_wall_torch':
      {
        if (!RS.torchSupported(g, x, y, z, id, m)) {
          g.breakRS(x, y, z);
          return;
        }
        const off = RS.torchPowered(g, x, y, z, id, m),
          lit = prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true';
        if (lit === off) w.schedule(x, y, z, 2);
        return;
      }
    case 'repeater':
      {
        if (!RS.diodeSupported(g, x, y, z)) {
          g.breakRS(x, y, z);
          return;
        }
        const locked = RS.repeaterLocked(g, x, y, z, id, m);
        if (locked !== (prop(id, m, 'locked') === 'true')) RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'locked', locked));
        if (locked) return;
        const should = RS.diodeInput(g, x, y, z, id, m) > 0;
        if (should !== (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true')) w.schedule(x, y, z, 2 * (+prop(id, m, 'delay') || 1));
        return;
      }
    case 'comparator':
      {
        if (!RS.diodeSupported(g, x, y, z)) {
          g.breakRS(x, y, z);
          return;
        }
        const out = RS.comparatorOut(g, x, y, z, id, m),
          mem = RS.mem.get(rsKey(x, y, z)) || {};
        if (out !== (mem.out || 0) || out > 0 !== (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true')) w.schedule(x, y, z, 2);
        return;
      }
    case 'redstone_lamp':
      {
        const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z),
          lit = prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true';
        if (p && !lit) RS.setProp(g, x, y, z, 'lit', 'true');else if (!p && lit) w.schedule(x, y, z, 4);
        return;
      }
    case 'copper_bulb':
    case 'exposed_copper_bulb':
    case 'weathered_copper_bulb':
    case 'oxidized_copper_bulb':
    case 'waxed_copper_bulb':
    case 'waxed_exposed_copper_bulb':
    case 'waxed_weathered_copper_bulb':
    case 'waxed_oxidized_copper_bulb':
      {
        const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z),
          was = prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true';
        if (p !== was) {
          let nm = Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', p);
          if (p) {
            const lit = prop(id, m, 'lit') !== 'true';
            nm = Features.withProp(id, nm, 'lit', lit);
            Sound.ev(lit ? 'block.copper_bulb.turn_on' : 'block.copper_bulb.turn_off', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
          }
          RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, nm);
        }
        return;
      }
    case 'tnt':
      if (RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z)) {
        w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
        g.entities.push(new PrimedTNT(g, x, y, z));
        Sound.ev('entity.tnt.primed', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
      }
      return;
    case 'note_block':
      return RS.edge(g, x, y, z, RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z), () => {
        Sound.note([x, y, z], m);
        g.particles.spawn('note', x + 0.5, y + 1.2, z + 0.5, 0, 0.02, 0, {
          col: [255, Math.round(m * 10), Math.round(255 - m * 10)]
        });
      });
    case 'bell':
      return RS.edge(g, x, y, z, RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z), () => Sound.ev('block.bell.use', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 2, 1));
    case 'piston':
    case 'sticky_piston':
      return RS.updatePiston(g, x, y, z, id, m);
    case 'dispenser':
    case 'dropper':
      return RS.edge(g, x, y, z, RS.qcPowered(g, x, y, z, null), () => w.schedule(x, y, z, 4));
    case 'crafter':
      {
        const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z),
          was = prop(id, m, 'triggered') === 'true';
        if (p && !was) {
          w.schedule(x, y, z, 4);
          RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'triggered', true));
        } else if (!p && was) RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'triggered', false));
        return;
      }
    // a plain rail at a junction (three rails to join) turns the other way while powered (vanilla RailState.place)
    case 'rail':
      {
        const p = !!RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z),
          mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
        if (p === !!mem.powered) return;
        mem.powered = p;
        const sh = typeof railJunctionShape === 'function' ? railJunctionShape(w, x, y, z, p) : null;
        if (sh && sh !== prop(id, m, 'shape')) RS.setProp(g, x, y, z, 'shape', sh);
        return;
      }
    case 'powered_rail':
    case 'activator_rail':
      {
        const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z) || RS.railChain(g, x, y, z, id, m);
        if (p !== (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true')) {
          RS.setProp(g, x, y, z, 'powered', p);
          for (const d of RS_H) {
            const v = RS_DIRS[d];
            for (const dy of [-1, 0, 1]) if (w.getBlock(x + v[0], y + dy, z + v[2]) === id) RS.enqueue(x + v[0], y + dy, z + v[2]);
          }
        }
        return;
      }
    case 'daylight_detector':
      return;
    case 'hopper':
      {
        const mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
        mem.locked = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z);
        return;
      }
    case 'tripwire':
    case 'tripwire_hook':
      return;
  }
  if (b.door) {
    const base = m & 8 ? y - 1 : y,
      bm = w.getMeta(x, base, z);
    const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, base, z) || RS.neighborSignal(g, x, base + 1, z);
    const mem = RS.memOf(x, base, z);
    if (p !== !!mem.powered) {
      mem.powered = p;
      if (!!(bm & 4) !== p && k !== 'iron_door_never') {
        const nm = p ? bm | 4 : bm & ~4;
        w.setMeta(x, base, z, nm);
        w.setMeta(x, base + 1, z, nm | 8);
        Sound.door([x, y, z], p, k);
        g.flushMesh && g.flushMesh();
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  if (b.trapdoor) {
    const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z),
      mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
    if (p !== !!mem.powered) {
      mem.powered = p;
      if (!!(m & 4) !== p) {
        w.setMeta(x, y, z, p ? m | 4 : m & ~4);
        Sound.door([x, y, z], p, k);
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  if (b.gate) {
    const p = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z),
      mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
    if (p !== !!mem.powered) {
      mem.powered = p;
      if (prop(id, m, 'open') === 'true' !== p) {
        w.setMeta(x, y, z, Features.withProp(id, m, 'open', p));
        Sound.door([x, y, z], p, k);
      }
    }
  }
};
RS.memOf = (x, y, z) => {
  const k = rsKey(x, y, z);
  let v = RS.mem.get(k);
  if (!v) RS.mem.set(k, v = {});
  return v;
};
// something that acts once when power comes (note block, bell, dispenser ...)
RS.edge = function (g, x, y, z, powered, fire) {
  const mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
  if (powered && !mem.powered) {
    mem.powered = true;
    fire();
  } else if (!powered && mem.powered) mem.powered = false;
};

// ---- torches ----
RS.torchAttach = function (id, m) {
  return rsk(id) === 'redstone_wall_torch' ? RS_OPP[prop(id, m, 'facing')] : 'down';
};
// (the same rule as the other torches: the middle of a fence's / wall's top, glass, a top slab ... - not only full cubes)
RS.torchSupported = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  if (typeof Features !== 'undefined' && g.survivalR) return Features.canSurvive(g.survivalR(), id, m, x, y, z);
  const d = RS.torchAttach(id, m),
    v = RS_DIRS[d];
  return rsFull(g.world.getBlock(x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2]));
};
RS.torchPowered = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const d = RS.torchAttach(id, m),
    v = RS_DIRS[d];
  return RS.has(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2], d);
};

// ---- repeaters and comparators ----
RS.diodeSupported = (g, x, y, z) => rsFull(g.world.getBlock(x, y - 1, z));
RS.diodeInput = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const f = prop(id, m, 'facing'),
    v = RS_DIRS[f],
    bx = x + v[0],
    bz = z + v[2];
  const i = RS.get(g, bx, y, bz, f);
  if (i >= 15) return i;
  return Math.max(i, wireP(g.world.getBlock(bx, y, bz)));
};
const RS_SIDES = f => [RS_CW[f], RS_OPP[RS_CW[f]]];
RS.repeaterLocked = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const w = g.world;
  for (const d of RS_SIDES(prop(id, m, 'facing'))) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d],
      sid = w.getBlock(x + v[0], y, z + v[2]),
      sk = rsk(sid);
    if ((sk === 'repeater' || sk === 'comparator') && RS.signal(g, x + v[0], y, z + v[2], d) > 0) return true;
  }
  return false;
};
RS.comparatorOut = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const w = g.world,
    f = prop(id, m, 'facing'),
    v = RS_DIRS[f];
  let a = RS.diodeInput(g, x, y, z, id, m);
  // reading a block behind it (or behind a solid block)
  const r1 = RS.analog(g, x + v[0], y, z + v[2]);
  if (r1 !== null) a = r1;else if (a < 15 && conductor(w.getBlock(x + v[0], y, z + v[2]))) {
    const r2 = RS.analog(g, x + 2 * v[0], y, z + 2 * v[2]);
    if (r2 !== null) a = r2;
  } // (replaces the block's power: ComparatorBlock.getInputSignal)
  let s = 0;
  for (const d of RS_SIDES(f)) {
    const u = RS_DIRS[d],
      sx = x + u[0],
      sz = z + u[2],
      sid = w.getBlock(sx, y, sz);
    if (!rsSource(sid) && !isWire(sid)) continue;
    s = Math.max(s, rsk(sid) === 'redstone_block' ? 15 : isWire(sid) ? wireP(sid) : RS.direct(g, sx, y, sz, d));
  }
  return prop(id, m, 'mode') === 'subtract' ? Math.max(a - s, 0) : a >= s ? a : 0;
};
// what a comparator reads from a block (containers: how full; others by their state); null: nothing to read
RS.analog = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  // (minecarts only through a detector rail they are on: DetectorRailBlock.getAnalogOutputSignal)
  const c = RS.container(g, x, y, z, k === 'detector_rail' && prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true');
  if (c) {
    let f = 0,
      any = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < c.size; i++) {
      const s = c.get(i);
      if (s) {
        f += s.count / Math.min(c.max || 64, maxStack(s.id));
        any = true;
      }
    }
    return any ? Math.floor(1 + f / c.size * 14) : 0;
  }
  if (k === 'cake') return (7 - (+prop(id, m, 'bites') || 0)) * 2;
  if (/copper_bulb$/.test(k)) return prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true' ? 15 : 0; // (it read nothing)
  if (k === 'composter') return +prop(id, m, 'level') || 0;
  if (/cauldron$/.test(k)) return k === 'water_cauldron' || k === 'powder_snow_cauldron' ? +prop(id, m, 'level') || 0 : k === 'lava_cauldron' ? 3 : 0;
  if (k === 'end_portal_frame') return prop(id, m, 'eye') === 'true' ? 15 : 0;
  if (k === 'respawn_anchor') return Math.floor((+prop(id, m, 'charges') || 0) * 15 / 4);
  if (k === 'beehive' || k === 'bee_nest') return +prop(id, m, 'honey_level') || 0;
  if (k === 'jukebox') {
    const be = g.blockEntities.get(rsKey(x, y, z));
    return be && be.disc ? 1 : 0;
  }
  return null;
};

// ---- containers (hoppers, droppers and comparators use them) ----
// { size, get(i), set(i, stack), canIn(i, stack, side), canOut(i, side) }; side: the face of the container used
RS.container = function (g, x, y, z, vehicles = true) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    b = BLOCKS[id];
  if (!b) return vehicles ? RS.vehicleContainer(g, x, y, z) : null;
  const k = b.key,
    key = rsKey(x, y, z);
  if (b.chestLike || k === 'barrel') {
    if (k === 'ender_chest') return null;
    const bes = [g.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'chest')];
    if (b.chestLike) {
      const s = chestSeam(w.getMeta(x, y, z));
      if (s && w.getBlock(x + s[0], y, z + s[1]) === id) bes.push(g.getBlockEntity(x + s[0], y, z + s[1], 'chest'));
    }
    const all = bes.flatMap(be => be.slots.map((_, i) => [be, i]));
    return {
      size: all.length,
      get: i => all[i][0].slots[all[i][1]],
      set: (i, s) => {
        all[i][0].slots[all[i][1]] = s;
      },
      canIn: () => true,
      canOut: () => true
    };
  }
  if (b.onUse === 'furnace') {
    const be = g.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'furnace'),
      f = ['input', 'fuel', 'output'];
    return {
      size: 3,
      get: i => be[f[i]],
      set: (i, s) => {
        be[f[i]] = s;
      },
      canIn: (i, s, side) => side === 'up' ? i === 0 : side === 'down' ? false : i === 1 && fuelValue(s.id) > 0,
      canOut: (i, side) => side === 'down' ? i === 2 || i === 1 && be.fuel && ITEMS[be.fuel.id].key === 'bucket' : false
    };
  }
  if (k === 'brewing_stand') {
    const be = g.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'brewing');
    if (!be.bottles) Object.assign(be, {
      bottles: [null, null, null],
      ingredient: null,
      fuel: null,
      fuelLeft: 0,
      brewTime: 0
    });
    const get = i => i < 3 ? be.bottles[i] : i === 3 ? be.ingredient : be.fuel,
      set = (i, s) => {
        if (i < 3) be.bottles[i] = s;else if (i === 3) be.ingredient = s;else be.fuel = s;
      };
    return {
      size: 5,
      max: 1,
      get,
      set,
      canIn: (i, s, side) => side === 'up' ? i === 3 : i === 4 ? s.id === ITEM_KEY.blaze_powder : i < 3 && typeof isPotion === 'function' && (isPotion(s) || s.id === ITEM_KEY.glass_bottle),
      canOut: (i, side) => i < 3 && be.brewTime === 0
    };
  }
  if (k === 'hopper' || k === 'dispenser' || k === 'dropper' || k === 'crafter') {
    const be = RS.be(g, x, y, z, k);
    return {
      size: be.slots.length,
      get: i => be.slots[i],
      set: (i, s) => {
        be.slots[i] = s;
      },
      canIn: i => k !== 'crafter' || !(be.disabled || []).includes(i),
      canOut: () => true
    };
  }
  return SOLIDCUBE[id] || !vehicles ? null : RS.vehicleContainer(g, x, y, z);
};
// no container block there: a minecart with a chest or a hopper, or a chest boat, in that block (HopperBlockEntity
// getContainerAt: the entities whose box meets the block's, one at random)
RS.vehicleContainer = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const found = [];
  for (const e of g.entities) {
    if (!e.isVehicle || !e.slots || e.dead) continue;
    const b = e.box();
    if (b[0] < x + 1 && b[3] > x && b[1] < y + 1 && b[4] > y && b[2] < z + 1 && b[5] > z) found.push(e);
  }
  if (!found.length) return null;
  const v = found[Math.random() * found.length | 0];
  if (v.unpackLoot) v.unpackLoot();
  const s = v.slots;
  return {
    size: s.length,
    get: i => s[i],
    set: (i, v) => {
      s[i] = v;
    },
    canIn: () => true,
    canOut: () => true
  };
};
RS.be = function (g, x, y, z, type) {
  const k = rsKey(x, y, z);
  let be = g.blockEntities.get(k);
  if (!be || be.type !== type) {
    be = {
      type,
      pos: [x, y, z],
      slots: new Array(type === 'hopper' ? 5 : 9).fill(null),
      cd: 0
    };
    g.blockEntities.set(k, be);
  }
  return be;
};
// put a stack into a container (all it takes), from a side; returns what is left (or null)
RS.insert = function (c, stack, side) {
  let s = {
    ...stack
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < c.size && s; i++) {
    const t = c.get(i);
    if (!t || !sameKind(t, s) || !c.canIn(i, s, side)) continue;
    const room = Math.min(c.max || 64, maxStack(s.id)) - t.count;
    if (room <= 0) continue;
    const n = Math.min(room, s.count);
    t.count += n;
    s.count -= n;
    if (!s.count) s = null;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < c.size && s; i++) {
    if (c.get(i) || !c.canIn(i, s, side)) continue;
    const n = Math.min(c.max || 64, maxStack(s.id), s.count);
    c.set(i, {
      ...s,
      count: n
    });
    s.count -= n;
    if (!s.count) s = null;
  }
  return s;
};

// ---- scheduled ticks ----
RS.tick = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  if (!id) return false;
  switch (k) {
    case 'redstone_torch':
    case 'redstone_wall_torch':
      {
        const off = RS.torchPowered(g, x, y, z, id, m),
          lit = prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true',
          pos = rsKey(x, y, z);
        const hist = (RS.torchHist.get(pos) || []).filter(t => g.tickCount - t < 60);
        if (lit && off) {
          hist.push(g.tickCount);
          RS.torchHist.set(pos, hist);
          RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'lit', false));
          // burnt out: too many changes in 3 seconds; it waits before coming back
          if (hist.length >= 8) {
            Sound.ev('block.redstone_torch.burnout', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.5, 2.6);
            w.schedule(x, y, z, 160);
          }
        } else if (!lit && !off && hist.length < 8) RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'lit', true));else if (!lit && !off) {
          RS.torchHist.set(pos, hist);
          if (hist.length) w.schedule(x, y, z, 20);else RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'lit', true));
        }
        return true;
      }
    case 'repeater':
      {
        if (prop(id, m, 'locked') === 'true') return true;
        const should = RS.diodeInput(g, x, y, z, id, m) > 0,
          on = prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true';
        if (on && !should) RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', false));else if (!on) {
          RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', true));
          if (!should) w.schedule(x, y, z, 2 * (+prop(id, m, 'delay') || 1));
        }
        return true;
      }
    case 'comparator':
      {
        const out = RS.comparatorOut(g, x, y, z, id, m),
          mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
        const changed = out !== (mem.out || 0);
        mem.out = out;
        const nm = Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', out > 0);
        if (nm !== m) RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, nm);else if (changed) RS.wake(x, y, z);
        return true;
      }
    case 'redstone_lamp':
      if (!RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z) && prop(id, m, 'lit') === 'true') RS.setProp(g, x, y, z, 'lit', 'false');
      return true;
    case 'observer':
      {
        if (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true') RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', false));else {
          RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', true));
          w.schedule(x, y, z, 2);
        }
        return true;
      }
    case 'dispenser':
    case 'dropper':
      RS.dispense(g, x, y, z, id, m);
      return true;
    case 'crafter':
      RS.craft(g, x, y, z, id, m);
      return true;
    case 'piston':
    case 'sticky_piston':
      RS.updatePiston(g, x, y, z, id, m);
      return true;
    // (done moving: pushes again if powered)
    case 'detector_rail':
      RS.detectorCheck(g, x, y, z);
      return true;
    case 'tripwire_hook':
    case 'tripwire':
      RS.tripCheck(g, x, y, z);
      return true;
  }
  if (RS_BUTTON.test(k)) {
    if (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true') {
      RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', false));
      Sound.ev(k.startsWith('stone') || k.includes('blackstone') ? 'block.stone_button.click_off' : 'block.wooden_button.click_off', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.3, 0.5);
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (RS_PLATE.test(k)) {
    RS.plateCheck(g, x, y, z);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

// ---- pressure plates, tripwire, detector rails: what stands on them ----
RS.entitiesIn = function (g, box, test) {
  const out = [];
  for (const e of [g.player, ...g.entities]) {
    if (!e || e.dead || e.deathTime > 0 || e === g.player && g.mode === 'spectator') continue;
    if (test && !test(e)) continue;
    const b = e.box();
    if (b[0] < box[3] && b[3] > box[0] && b[1] < box[4] && b[4] > box[1] && b[2] < box[5] && b[5] > box[2]) out.push(e);
  }
  return out;
};
RS.plateCheck = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  const box = [x + 0.0625, y, z + 0.0625, x + 0.9375, y + 0.25, z + 0.9375];
  const living = k.startsWith('stone') || k.includes('blackstone');
  const list = RS.entitiesIn(g, box, e => living ? e instanceof Living : true);
  if (k.includes('weighted')) {
    const n = list.reduce((a, e) => a + (e.stack ? e.stack.count : 1), 0);
    const p = k.startsWith('light') ? Math.min(n, 15) : n ? Math.ceil(Math.min(n, 150) / 10) : 0;
    const cur = +prop(id, m, 'power') || 0;
    if (p !== cur) {
      RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'power', p));
      Sound.ev(p > cur ? 'block.metal_pressure_plate.click_on' : 'block.metal_pressure_plate.click_off', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 0.3, p > cur ? 0.9 : 0.75);
    }
    if (p > 0) w.schedule(x, y, z, 10);
    return;
  }
  const on = list.length > 0,
    was = prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true';
  if (on !== was) {
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', on));
    Sound.ev(living ? on ? 'block.stone_pressure_plate.click_on' : 'block.stone_pressure_plate.click_off' : on ? 'block.wooden_pressure_plate.click_on' : 'block.wooden_pressure_plate.click_off', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 0.3, on ? 0.6 : 0.5);
  }
  if (on) w.schedule(x, y, z, 20);
};
RS.detectorCheck = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  const on = RS.entitiesIn(g, [x + 0.2, y, z + 0.2, x + 0.8, y + 0.8, z + 0.8], e => e instanceof Minecart).length > 0;
  if (on !== (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true')) RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', on));
  if (on) w.schedule(x, y, z, 20);
};
// powered rails pass power along up to 8 rails of their kind
RS.railChain = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const w = g.world,
    seen = new Set([rsKey(x, y, z)]);
  const walk = (cx, cy, cz, n) => {
    if (n > 8) return false;
    const cm = w.getMeta(cx, cy, cz),
      sh = prop(id, cm, 'shape');
    for (const [ex, ey, ez] of RAIL_EXITS[sh] || []) {
      for (const dy of [ey, 0, 1, -1]) {
        const nx = cx + ex,
          ny = cy + dy,
          nz = cz + ez,
          k = rsKey(nx, ny, nz);
        if (seen.has(k) || w.getBlock(nx, ny, nz) !== id) continue;
        seen.add(k);
        if (RS.neighborSignal(g, nx, ny, nz) || walk(nx, ny, nz, n + 1)) return true;
        break;
      }
    }
    return false;
  };
  return walk(x, y, z, 1);
};
// tripwire: hooks facing each other up to 40 blocks apart with string between; something on the string powers both
RS.tripLine = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
    f = prop(id, m, 'facing'),
    v = RS_DIRS[f];
  const wire = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 41; i++) {
    const nx = x + v[0] * i,
      nz = z + v[2] * i,
      nid = w.getBlock(nx, y, nz),
      nk = rsk(nid);
    if (nk === 'tripwire_hook') return prop(nid, w.getMeta(nx, y, nz), 'facing') === RS_OPP[f] && wire.length ? {
      other: [nx, y, nz],
      wire
    } : null;
    if (nk !== 'tripwire') return null;
    wire.push([nx, y, nz]);
  }
  return null;
};
RS.tripCheck = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    k = rsk(w.getBlock(x, y, z));
  if (k === 'tripwire') {
    // find a hook along either axis and check from there
    for (const d of RS_H) {
      const v = RS_DIRS[d];
      for (let i = 1; i <= 41; i++) {
        const nk = rsk(w.getBlock(x + v[0] * i, y, z + v[2] * i));
        if (nk === 'tripwire_hook') {
          RS.tripCheck(g, x + v[0] * i, y, z + v[2] * i);
          break;
        }
        if (nk !== 'tripwire') break;
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  if (k !== 'tripwire_hook') return;
  const line = RS.tripLine(g, x, y, z);
  const on = !!line && line.wire.some(([wx, wy, wz]) => RS.entitiesIn(g, [wx, wy, wz, wx + 1, wy + 0.15, wz + 1]).length > 0);
  for (const p of line ? [[x, y, z], line.other] : [[x, y, z]]) {
    const id = w.getBlock(...p),
      m = w.getMeta(...p);
    let nm = Features.withProp(id, m, 'attached', !!line);
    nm = Features.withProp(id, nm, 'powered', on);
    if (nm !== m) {
      if (on !== (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true')) Sound.ev(on ? 'block.tripwire.click_on' : 'block.tripwire.click_off', [p[0] + 0.5, p[1] + 0.5, p[2] + 0.5], 0.4, 0.6);
      RS.set(g, ...p, id, nm);
    }
  }
  if (line) for (const p of line.wire) {
    const id = w.getBlock(...p),
      m = w.getMeta(...p),
      nm = Features.withProp(id, m, 'attached', true);
    if (nm !== m) w.setMeta(...p, nm);
  }
  if (on) w.schedule(x, y, z, 10);
};
// targets: an arrow (or other projectile) gives power by how close to the middle it hit, for a while
RS.targetHit = function (g, x, y, z, point, arrow) {
  const fx = point[0] - x,
    fy = point[1] - y,
    fz = point[2] - z;
  const d = Math.max(Math.abs(fx - 0.5), Math.abs(fy - 0.5), Math.abs(fz - 0.5)) === 0.5 ? Math.min(...[[fx, fy], [fy, fz], [fx, fz]].map(([a, b]) => Math.max(Math.abs(a - 0.5), Math.abs(b - 0.5)))) : 0.5;
  const power = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(15 * clamp((0.5 - d) / 0.5, 0, 1)));
  RS.mem.set(rsKey(x, y, z), {
    power,
    until: g.tickCount + (arrow ? 20 : 8)
  });
  RS.wake(x, y, z);
  g.world.schedule(x, y, z, arrow ? 20 : 8);
};

// ---- pistons ----
const RS_IMMOVABLE = /^(obsidian|crying_obsidian|bedrock|barrier|end_portal_frame|end_portal|end_gateway|nether_portal|reinforced_deepslate|respawn_anchor|enchanting_table|ender_chest|beacon|command_block|chain_command_block|repeating_command_block|structure_block|jigsaw|moving_piston|piston_head|light|spawner|trial_spawner|vault|lodestone|conduit)$/;
// how a block takes being pushed: 'move', 'destroy', 'block' (stops the piston), 'push' (pushed, never pulled)
function blockPushReaction(g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (!id) return 'air';
  const b = BLOCKS[id],
    k = b.key;
  if (IS_FLUID[id]) return 'destroy';
  if (RS_IMMOVABLE.test(k) || b.hardness < 0) return 'block';
  if ((k === 'piston' || k === 'sticky_piston') && prop(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'extended') === 'true') return 'block';
  if (g.blockEntities.has(rsKey(x, y, z)) || b.chestLike || b.beRender || b.onUse === 'furnace' || /^(hopper|dispenser|dropper|crafter|brewing_stand|jukebox|lectern|beehive|bee_nest|chiseled_bookshelf|decorated_pot|bell|campfire|soul_campfire)$/.test(k) || b.be) return 'block';
  if (k.endsWith('glazed_terracotta')) return 'push';
  if (/^(end_rod|powder_snow|dead_\w+_coral(_fan|_wall_fan)?)$/.test(k)) return 'move'; // (vanilla pushes these, though not solid: end rods popped off as items; a wall fan off its wall pops after)
  if (REPLACEABLE[id] || b.needsSupport || b.door || b.bed || !b.solid || isWire(id) || /^(repeater|comparator|lever|.*_button|redstone_torch|redstone_wall_torch|.*pressure_plate|cobweb|cactus|.*_carpet_never|flower_pot|.*_flower_pot|ladder|scaffolding|snow|.*_sign|.*_hanging_sign|.*_banner|dragon_egg|.*lantern|.*_bed|.*_head|.*_skull|melon|pumpkin_never|tripwire|tripwire_hook)$/.test(k)) return 'destroy';
  return 'move';
}
const isSticky = id => {
  const k = rsk(id);
  return k === 'slime_block' || k === 'honey_block';
};
// the blocks a push or pull moves (vanilla PistonStructureResolver, at most 12); null when blocked
RS.resolve = function (g, px, py, pz, dir, extending) {
  const v = RS_DIRS[dir],
    moveDir = extending ? v : RS_DIRS[RS_OPP[dir]];
  const start = extending ? [px + v[0], py + v[1], pz + v[2]] : [px + 2 * v[0], py + 2 * v[1], pz + 2 * v[2]];
  const toMove = [],
    toDestroy = [],
    seen = new Set();
  const w = g.world,
    headKey = rsKey(px + v[0], py + v[1], pz + v[2]);
  // while retracting the head is already gone: its place is empty
  const pushReaction = (x, y, z) => !extending && rsKey(x, y, z) === headKey ? 'air' : blockPushReaction(g, x, y, z);
  const r0 = pushReaction(...start);
  if (!extending && r0 !== 'move') return {
    toMove,
    toDestroy
  };
  if (r0 === 'air') return {
    toMove,
    toDestroy
  };
  if (r0 === 'destroy') return extending ? {
    toMove,
    toDestroy: [start]
  } : {
    toMove,
    toDestroy
  };
  if (r0 === 'block') return null;
  const pistonKey = rsKey(px, py, pz);
  // add a line of blocks starting at p, going against the movement while they stick, then along it
  const addLine = p => {
    let [x, y, z] = p;
    if (seen.has(rsKey(x, y, z))) return true;
    const r = pushReaction(x, y, z);
    if (r === 'air' || r === 'destroy') return true;
    if (r === 'block') return false;
    if (rsKey(x, y, z) === pistonKey) return true;
    // blocks stuck behind (against the movement) come along
    const back = [];
    let bx = x,
      by = y,
      bz = z;
    while (isSticky(w.getBlock(bx, by, bz))) {
      const nx = bx - moveDir[0],
        ny = by - moveDir[1],
        nz = bz - moveDir[2],
        nid = w.getBlock(nx, ny, nz);
      if (rsKey(nx, ny, nz) === pistonKey) break;
      const nr = pushReaction(nx, ny, nz);
      if (nr !== 'move' || !stickTogether(w.getBlock(bx, by, bz), nid)) break;
      back.push([nx, ny, nz]);
      bx = nx;
      by = ny;
      bz = nz;
      if (toMove.length + back.length > 12) return false;
    }
    for (let i = back.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const k = rsKey(...back[i]);
      if (!seen.has(k)) {
        seen.add(k);
        toMove.push(back[i]);
      }
    }
    // this block and the ones in front of it
    for (;;) {
      const k = rsKey(x, y, z);
      if (!seen.has(k)) {
        seen.add(k);
        toMove.push([x, y, z]);
      }
      if (toMove.length > 12) return false;
      const nx = x + moveDir[0],
        ny = y + moveDir[1],
        nz = z + moveDir[2];
      if (rsKey(nx, ny, nz) === pistonKey) return false;
      const nr = pushReaction(nx, ny, nz);
      if (nr === 'air') break;
      if (nr === 'destroy') {
        toDestroy.push([nx, ny, nz]);
        break;
      }
      if (nr === 'block') return false;
      if (seen.has(rsKey(nx, ny, nz))) break;
      x = nx;
      y = ny;
      z = nz;
    }
    return true;
  };
  if (!addLine(start)) return null;
  // sticky blocks drag their neighbours sideways too
  for (let i = 0; i < toMove.length; i++) {
    const p = toMove[i],
      id = w.getBlock(...p);
    if (!isSticky(id)) continue;
    for (const d of RS_DN) {
      const u = RS_DIRS[d];
      if (u[0] === moveDir[0] && u[1] === moveDir[1] && u[2] === moveDir[2] || u[0] === -moveDir[0] && u[1] === -moveDir[1] && u[2] === -moveDir[2]) continue;
      const q = [p[0] + u[0], p[1] + u[1], p[2] + u[2]],
        qid = w.getBlock(...q);
      if (seen.has(rsKey(...q)) || pushReaction(...q) !== 'move' || !stickTogether(id, qid)) continue;
      if (!addLine(q)) return null;
    }
  }
  if (toMove.length > 12) return null;
  return {
    toMove,
    toDestroy
  };
};
function stickTogether(a, b) {
  const ka = rsk(a),
    kb = rsk(b);
  return !(ka === 'slime_block' && kb === 'honey_block' || ka === 'honey_block' && kb === 'slime_block') && (isSticky(a) || isSticky(b));
}
// a piston that should move does it as an event after the updates (vanilla checkIfExtend -> blockEvent): it moved at
// once inside them, so one powering itself (a redstone block it pushes away and pulls back) went back and forth
// 60,000 times a frame - the game froze ("粘性活塞上放红石块卡死", "飞行器卡住")
RS.updatePiston = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const f = prop(id, m, 'facing'),
    ext = prop(id, m, 'extended') === 'true';
  if (RS.qcPowered(g, x, y, z, f) === ext) return;
  const k = rsKey(x, y, z);
  if (!RS.evSet.has(k)) {
    RS.evSet.add(k);
    RS.events.push([x, y, z]);
  }
};
// the event (vanilla triggerEvent): power looked at again; what vanilla's moving blocks take 2 ticks for is kept as
// time - a piston that pulled back can push again 3 ticks later, one pulled back within 2 ticks of pushing leaves its
// block where it went (a sticky piston's short pulse)
RS.pistonEvent = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    k = rsk(id);
  if (k !== 'piston' && k !== 'sticky_piston') return;
  const m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
    ext = prop(id, m, 'extended') === 'true',
    p = RS.qcPowered(g, x, y, z, prop(id, m, 'facing'));
  if (p === ext) return;
  const key = rsKey(x, y, z),
    now = g.tickCount;
  let last = RS.pistonT.get(key);
  if (last && (last.t > now || now - last.t >= 3)) {
    RS.pistonT.delete(key);
    last = null;
  }
  if (p && last && !last.ext) {
    w.schedule(x, y, z, 3 - (now - last.t));
    return;
  }
  if (!RS.pistonMove(g, x, y, z, id, m, p, !p && !!last && last.ext)) return;
  if (RS.pistonT.size > 4096) for (const [pk, v] of RS.pistonT) if (v.t > now || now - v.t >= 3) RS.pistonT.delete(pk);
  RS.pistonT.set(key, {
    t: now,
    ext: p
  });
};
RS.pistonMove = function (g, x, y, z, id, m, extending, spit) {
  const w = g.world,
    f = prop(id, m, 'facing'),
    v = RS_DIRS[f],
    sticky = rsk(id) === 'sticky_piston';
  const head = [x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2]];
  let res = {
    toMove: [],
    toDestroy: []
  };
  if (extending || sticky && !spit) {
    res = RS.resolve(g, x, y, z, f, extending);
    if (!res) return false;
  }
  const d = extending ? v : RS_DIRS[RS_OPP[f]];
  // destroyed blocks drop their items
  for (const p of res.toDestroy) {
    const did = w.getBlock(...p);
    if (did && !IS_FLUID[did]) g.dropBlockLoot(...p, did, w.getMeta(...p), null);
    w.setBlock(...p, 0, 0);
  }
  // move: take them all out, then put them all back one step on
  // (a waterlogged block takes its water along, leaving none behind)
  // (a dead coral wall fan goes out first and back last: taken off a block moving with it, it popped and came back too)
  const blocks = res.toMove.map(p => [p, w.getBlock(...p), w.getMeta(...p), w.isWaterlogged(...p)]);
  const wallFan = bid => /_wall_fan$/.test(rsk(bid));
  blocks.sort((a, b) => wallFan(b[1]) - wallFan(a[1]));
  if (!extending) w.setBlock(...head, 0, 0); // the head goes first
  for (const [p,,, wl] of blocks) {
    if (wl) w.setWaterlogged(...p, false);
    w.setBlock(...p, 0, 0, 3);
  }
  // the head is in place before the blocks come back, and they come back from the bottom up, so nothing that
  // falls (sand, gravel, anvils ...) finds air under it on the way
  let hm = 0;
  const hid = BID.piston_head;
  if (extending) {
    hm = Features.withProp(hid, 0, 'facing', f);
    hm = Features.withProp(hid, hm, 'type', sticky ? 'sticky' : 'normal');
    hm = Features.withProp(hid, hm, 'short', 'false');
    w.setBlock(...head, hid, hm);
  }
  for (const [p, bid, bm, wl] of blocks.slice().sort((a, b) => wallFan(a[1]) - wallFan(b[1]) || a[0][1] - b[0][1])) {
    w.setBlock(p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1], p[2] + d[2], bid, bm);
    if (wl) w.setWaterlogged(p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1], p[2] + d[2], true);
  }
  // entities in the way are pushed along
  const moved = new Set(blocks.map(([p]) => rsKey(p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1], p[2] + d[2])));
  if (extending) moved.add(rsKey(...head));
  for (const e of [g.player, ...g.entities]) {
    if (!e || e.dead) continue;
    const b = e.box(),
      fx = Math.floor(e.pos[0]),
      fz = Math.floor(e.pos[2]);
    for (let yy = Math.floor(b[1]); yy <= Math.floor(b[4] - 1e-3); yy++) {
      if (!moved.has(rsKey(fx, yy, fz))) continue;
      e.pos[0] += d[0] * 1.01;
      e.pos[1] += d[1] * 1.01;
      e.pos[2] += d[2] * 1.01;
      // a slime block launches what stands on it
      if (blocks.some(([p, bid]) => rsk(bid) === 'slime_block')) {
        e.vel[0] += d[0] * 0.5;
        e.vel[1] += d[1] * 0.5;
        e.vel[2] += d[2] * 0.5;
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  if (extending) {
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'extended', true));
    Sound.ev('block.piston.extend', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.5, 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.25);
  } else {
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'extended', false));
    Sound.ev('block.piston.contract', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.5, 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.15);
  }
  // everything that moved, and around it, gets its update (observers see it too)
  for (const [p] of blocks) {
    RS.wake(...p);
    RS.wake(p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1], p[2] + d[2]);
  }
  RS.wake(...head);
  // an observer moved sees its new place once it has got there (vanilla: its shape updated when the moving block
  // finishes, 2 ticks on - a pulse 2 later); one moved while powered goes off. It never fired: flying machines stood still
  for (const [p, bid, bm] of blocks) {
    if (rsk(bid) !== 'observer') continue;
    const nx = p[0] + d[0],
      ny = p[1] + d[1],
      nz = p[2] + d[2];
    if (w.getBlock(nx, ny, nz) !== bid) continue;
    if (prop(bid, bm, 'powered') === 'true') RS.set(g, nx, ny, nz, bid, Features.withProp(bid, bm, 'powered', false));else {
      w.ticks.delete(rsKey(nx, ny, nz));
      w.schedule(nx, ny, nz, 4);
    }
  }
  RS.meshDirty = true;
  return true;
};

// ---- observers: see a change of the block in front of them ----
RS.observe = function (g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world;
  for (const d of RS_DN) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[d],
      ox = x - v[0],
      oy = y - v[1],
      oz = z - v[2],
      oid = w.getBlock(ox, oy, oz);
    if (rsk(oid) !== 'observer') continue;
    const om = w.getMeta(ox, oy, oz);
    // the observer at ox.. looks toward its facing: is that this block?
