    if (prop(oid, om, 'facing') !== d) continue;
    if (prop(oid, om, 'powered') !== 'true') w.schedule(ox, oy, oz, 2);
  }
};

// ---- dispensers and droppers ----
RS.dispense = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const w = g.world,
    be = RS.be(g, x, y, z, rsk(id)),
    f = prop(id, m, 'facing'),
    v = RS_DIRS[f];
  const full = be.slots.map((s, i) => s ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0);
  const c = [x + 0.5 + v[0] * 0.7, y + 0.5 + v[1] * 0.7 - (v[1] === 0 ? 0.15 : 0), z + 0.5 + v[2] * 0.7];
  if (!full.length) {
    Sound.ev('block.dispenser.fail', c, 1, 1.2);
    return;
  }
  const i = full[Math.floor(Math.random() * full.length)],
    st = be.slots[i],
    key = ITEMS[st.id].key;
  const take = (n = 1) => {
    st.count -= n;
    if (st.count <= 0) be.slots[i] = null;
  };
  const front = [x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2]];
  const shoot = vel => [v[0] * vel, v[1] * vel + 0.1, v[2] * vel];
  let done = true;
  if (rsk(id) === 'dropper') {
    const tc = RS.container(g, ...front);
    if (tc) {
      const left = RS.insert(tc, {
        ...st,
        count: 1
      }, RS_OPP[f]);
      if (left) done = false;else take();
    } else {
      g.dropItem(...c, {
        ...st,
        count: 1
      }, shoot(0.2));
      take();
    }
  } else if (AMMO.has(key)) {
    const a = new Arrow(g, ...c, shoot(1.1), null);
    a.stack = {
      ...st,
      count: 1
    };
    if (key !== 'arrow') a.tip = a.stack;
    g.entities.push(a);
    take();
    Sound.ev('entity.arrow.shoot', c, 1, 1.2);
  } else if (key === 'snowball' || key === 'egg') {
    const a = new Arrow(g, ...c, shoot(1.1), null);
    a.snowball = st.id;
    g.entities.push(a);
    take();
  } else if (key === 'splash_potion' || key === 'lingering_potion') {
    g.entities.push(new ThrownPotion(g, ...c, shoot(0.5), null, {
      ...st,
      count: 1
    }));
    take();
  } else if (key === 'fire_charge') {
    g.entities.push(new Fireball(g, ...c, [v[0] * 0.1, v[1] * 0.1, v[2] * 0.1], null, true));
    take();
  } else if (key === 'tnt') {
    g.entities.push(new PrimedTNT(g, ...front));
    take();
  } else if (key === 'water_bucket' || key === 'lava_bucket') {
    const cur = w.getBlock(...front);
    if (key === 'water_bucket' && canWaterlog(cur, w.getMeta(...front)) && !w.isWaterlogged(...front)) {
      w.setWaterlogged(...front, true);
      if (g.dowseCampfire) g.dowseCampfire(...front, 'entity.generic.extinguish_fire');
      be.slots[i] = makeStack('bucket');
    } else if (!cur || REPLACEABLE[cur]) {
      w.setBlock(...front, key === 'water_bucket' ? WATER : LAVA, 0);
      be.slots[i] = makeStack('bucket');
    } else done = false;
  } else if (key === 'bucket') {
    const cur = w.getBlock(...front);
    if (!IS_FLUID[cur] && w.isWaterlogged(...front)) {
      w.setWaterlogged(...front, false);
      take();
      const fill = makeStack('water_bucket');
      if (RS.insert(RS.container(g, x, y, z), fill, null)) g.dropItem(...c, fill, shoot(0.2));
    } else if (IS_FLUID[cur] && w.getMeta(...front) === 0) {
      w.setBlock(...front, 0, 0);
      take();
      const fill = makeStack(cur === WATER ? 'water_bucket' : 'lava_bucket');
      if (RS.insert(RS.container(g, x, y, z), fill, null)) g.dropItem(...c, fill, shoot(0.2));
    } else done = false;
  } else if (key === 'flint_and_steel') {
    const cur = w.getBlock(...front);
    if (rsk(cur) === 'tnt') {
      w.setBlock(...front, 0, 0);
      g.entities.push(new PrimedTNT(g, ...front));
    } else if (!cur && g.fireSupported(...front)) w.setBlock(...front, g.fireIdAt(...front), 0);else done = false;
    if (done) {
      st.dmg = (st.dmg || 0) + 1;
      if (st.dmg >= ITEMS[st.id].durability) be.slots[i] = null;
    }
  } else if (key === 'bone_meal') {
    const cur = w.getBlock(...front);
    if (cur === 64 && w.getMeta(...front) < 7) {
      w.setMeta(...front, Math.min(7, w.getMeta(...front) + 2 + (Math.random() * 3 | 0)));
      take();
      g.flushMesh();
    } else done = false;
  } else if (ITEMS[st.id].spawnEgg) {
    const mob = createMob(g, ITEMS[st.id].spawnEgg, front[0] + 0.5, front[1], front[2] + 0.5);
    mob.persistent = true;
    g.entities.push(mob);
    take();
  } else if (typeof BOAT_ITEM !== 'undefined' && BOAT_ITEM[key]) {
    const [wood, chest] = BOAT_ITEM[key],
      bt = new Boat(g, front[0] + 0.5, front[1] + (IS_FLUID[w.getBlock(...front)] ? 0.5 : 0), front[2] + 0.5, wood, chest);
    bt.yaw = Math.atan2(-v[0], -v[2]);
    g.entities.push(bt);
    take();
  } else if (typeof CART_ITEM !== 'undefined' && CART_ITEM[key] !== undefined && isRail(w.getBlock(...front))) {
    g.entities.push(new Minecart(g, front[0] + 0.5, front[1] + 0.0625, front[2] + 0.5, CART_ITEM[key]));
    take();
  } else if (key === 'shears') {
    const sheep = RS.entitiesIn(g, [front[0], front[1], front[2], front[0] + 1, front[1] + 1, front[2] + 1], e => e.type === 'sheep' && !e.sheared && !e.baby)[0];
    if (sheep) {
      sheep.sheared = true;
      for (let k = 0, n = 1 + (Math.random() * 3 | 0); k < n; k++) g.dropItem(sheep.pos[0], sheep.pos[1] + 1, sheep.pos[2], makeStack(woolKey(sheep.woolColor), 1));
      st.dmg = (st.dmg || 0) + 1;
    } else done = false;
  } else if (key === 'glass_bottle') {
    const cur = w.getBlock(...front);
    if (cur === WATER) {
      take();
      const pot = {
        id: ITEM_KEY.potion,
        count: 1,
        dmg: 0,
        pot: 'water'
      };
      if (RS.insert(RS.container(g, x, y, z), pot, null)) g.dropItem(...c, pot, shoot(0.2));
    } else done = false;
  } else {
    g.dropItem(...c, {
      ...st,
      count: 1
    }, shoot(0.2));
    take();
  }
  if (done) {
    Sound.ev('block.dispenser.dispense', c, 1, 1);
    for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) g.particles.spawn('smoke', c[0], c[1], c[2], v[0] * 0.05 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02, 0.01, v[2] * 0.05 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02);
  } else Sound.ev('block.dispenser.fail', c, 1, 1.2);
};

// ---- the crafter: crafts once per pulse, the result comes out of its front ----
RS.craftResult = function (be) {
  const grid = be.slots.map(s => s ? {
    id: s.id,
    count: s.count
  } : null);
  const r = matchRecipe(grid, 3);
  return r ? {
    id: r.result,
    count: r.count,
    dmg: 0
  } : null;
};
RS.craft = function (g, x, y, z, id, m) {
  const be = RS.be(g, x, y, z, 'crafter'),
    res = RS.craftResult(be);
  const facing = String(prop(id, m, 'orientation') || 'north_up').split('_')[0],
    v = RS_DIRS[facing] || RS_DIRS.north;
  const c = [x + 0.5 + v[0] * 0.7, y + 0.5 + v[1] * 0.7, z + 0.5 + v[2] * 0.7];
  if (!res) {
    Sound.ev('block.crafter.fail', c, 1, 1);
    return;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const s = be.slots[i];
    if (!s) continue;
    const k = ITEMS[s.id].key;
    if (k === 'water_bucket' || k === 'lava_bucket' || k === 'milk_bucket') {
      be.slots[i] = makeStack('bucket');
      continue;
    }
    s.count--;
    if (!s.count) be.slots[i] = null;
  }
  const tc = RS.container(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2]);
  const left = tc ? RS.insert(tc, res, RS_OPP[facing]) : res;
  if (left) g.dropItem(...c, left, [v[0] * 0.2, v[1] * 0.2 + 0.05, v[2] * 0.2]);
  Sound.ev('block.crafter.craft', c, 1, 1);
  be.flash = g.tickCount + 6;
};

// ---- hoppers: every 8 ticks one item out (into what they point at) and one in (from above, or lying on them) ----
RS.hopperTick = function (g, be) {
  const w = g.world,
    [x, y, z] = be.pos;
  if (rsk(w.getBlock(x, y, z)) !== 'hopper') return;
  if (be.cd > 0) {
    be.cd--;
    return;
  }
  const mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
  if (mem.locked === undefined) mem.locked = RS.neighborSignal(g, x, y, z);
  if (mem.locked) return;
  const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    f = prop(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'facing') || 'down',
    v = RS_DIRS[f];
  let moved = false;
  // out
  const out = RS.container(g, x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2]);
  if (out) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 5 && !moved; i++) {
      const s = be.slots[i];
      if (!s) continue;
      const left = RS.insert(out, {
        ...s,
        count: 1
      }, RS_OPP[f]);
      if (!left) {
        s.count--;
        if (!s.count) be.slots[i] = null;
        moved = true;
      }
    }
  }
  // in: from the container above, else items lying on it
  const self = RS.container(g, x, y, z);
  const src = RS.container(g, x, y + 1, z);
  if (src) {
    for (let i = 0; i < src.size; i++) {
      const s = src.get(i);
      if (!s || !src.canOut(i, 'down')) continue;
      const left = RS.insert(self, {
        ...s,
        count: 1
      }, 'up');
      if (!left) {
        s.count--;
        if (!s.count) src.set(i, null);
        moved = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  } else if (!conductor(w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)) || rsk(w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)) === 'hopper') {
    for (const e of g.entities) {
      if (!(e instanceof ItemEntity) || e.dead) continue;
      if (e.pos[0] < x || e.pos[0] > x + 1 || e.pos[2] < z || e.pos[2] > z + 1 || e.pos[1] < y + 0.6 || e.pos[1] > y + 2) continue;
      const left = RS.insert(self, e.stack, 'up');
      if (!left) e.dead = true;else if (left.count !== e.stack.count) e.stack = left;else continue;
      moved = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (moved) {
    be.cd = 8;
    RS.wake(x, y, z);
  }
};

// ---- daylight detectors: once a second, power from the sky light and the sun's height ----
RS.daylight = function (g) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = BID.daylight_detector;
  if (id === undefined) return;
  const p = g.player,
    pcx = Math.floor(p.pos[0]) >> 4,
    pcz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]) >> 4,
    R = Math.min(8, g.renderer ? g.renderer.renderDist : 8);
  const t = (w.time % 24000 / 24000 - 0.25 + 1) % 1,
    f0 = t,
    d0 = 0.5 - Math.cos(f0 * Math.PI) / 2,
    cel = (f0 * 2 + d0) / 3,
    sun = cel * Math.PI * 2;
  let dark = 1 - (Math.cos(sun) * 2 + 0.5);
  dark = clamp(dark, 0, 1);
  dark = 1 - dark;
  dark *= 1 - (g.weather || 0) * 5 / 16;
  dark = 1 - dark;
  const skyDarken = Math.floor(dark * 11);
  for (let cx = pcx - R; cx <= pcx + R; cx++) for (let cz = pcz - R; cz <= pcz + R; cz++) {
    const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
    if (!ch) continue;
    ch.findAll([id], i => {
      const x = cx * 16 + (i & 15),
        y = i >> 8,
        z = cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15),
        m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
      let pw = w.skyAt(x, y, z) - skyDarken;
      if (prop(id, m, 'inverted') === 'true') pw = 15 - pw;else if (pw > 0) {
        let a = sun;
        const target = a < Math.PI ? 0 : Math.PI * 2;
        a += (target - a) * 0.2;
        pw = Math.round(pw * Math.cos(a));
      }
      pw = clamp(pw, 0, 15);
      const mem = RS.memOf(x, y, z);
      if (mem.power !== pw) {
        mem.power = pw;
        RS.wake(x, y, z);
      }
    });
  }
};

// comparators near the player check what they read again (a container filled by hand, a furnace cooking ...)
RS.refreshComparators = function (g) {
  const w = g.world,
    id = BID.comparator;
  if (id === undefined) return;
  const p = g.player,
    pcx = Math.floor(p.pos[0]) >> 4,
    pcz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]) >> 4,
    R = Math.min(6, g.renderer ? g.renderer.renderDist : 6);
  for (let cx = pcx - R; cx <= pcx + R; cx++) for (let cz = pcz - R; cz <= pcz + R; cz++) {
    const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
    if (!ch) continue;
    ch.findAll([id], i => RS.enqueue(cx * 16 + (i & 15), i >> 8, cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15)));
  }
};
// ---- breaking a component that lost its support ----
Game.prototype.breakRS = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  if (!id) return;
  this.dropBlockLoot(x, y, z, id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), null);
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
  RS.wake(x, y, z);
};

// ---- using the components ----
const RS_USE = {
  lever(g, x, y, z) {
    const id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z),
      m = g.world.getMeta(x, y, z),
      on = prop(id, m, 'powered') !== 'true';
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', on));
    Sound.ev('block.lever.click', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.3, on ? 0.6 : 0.5);
    RS.process(g);
    return true;
  },
  button(g, x, y, z) {
    const id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z),
      m = g.world.getMeta(x, y, z),
      k = rsk(id);
    if (prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true') return true;
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'powered', true));
    const stone = k.startsWith('stone') || k.includes('blackstone');
    g.world.schedule(x, y, z, stone ? 20 : 30);
    Sound.ev(stone ? 'block.stone_button.click_on' : 'block.wooden_button.click_on', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.3, 0.6);
    RS.process(g);
    return true;
  },
  repeater(g, x, y, z) {
    const id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z),
      m = g.world.getMeta(x, y, z),
      d = (+prop(id, m, 'delay') || 1) % 4 + 1;
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'delay', d));
    RS.process(g);
    return true;
  },
  comparator(g, x, y, z) {
    const id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z),
      m = g.world.getMeta(x, y, z),
      sub = prop(id, m, 'mode') !== 'subtract';
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'mode', sub ? 'subtract' : 'compare'));
    Sound.ev('block.comparator.click', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 0.3, sub ? 0.55 : 0.5);
    g.world.schedule(x, y, z, 2);
    RS.process(g);
    return true;
  },
  daylight(g, x, y, z) {
    const id = g.world.getBlock(x, y, z),
      m = g.world.getMeta(x, y, z);
    RS.set(g, x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'inverted', prop(id, m, 'inverted') !== 'true'));
    RS.daylight(g);
    RS.process(g);
    return true;
  },
  // dust: a cross becomes a dot and back (only while nothing joins it)
  wire(g, x, y, z) {
    // (game.js picks the use by the target's remembered block, t.id: dust gone from there since - washed away, broken
    // by the same tick's update - left air, and air's missing states threw 'reading 0', telemetry 11-02/03)
    const w = g.world,
      id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
      m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
      st = isWire(id) && BLOCKS[id].states && BLOCKS[id].states[m];
    if (!st) return false;
    const cross = RS_H.every(d => st[d] === 'side'),
      dot = isDotMeta(id, m);
    if (!cross && !dot) return false;
    const side = {};
    for (const d of RS_H) side[d] = cross ? 'none' : 'side';
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, wireMeta(id, side));
    RS.wake(x, y, z);
    RS.process(g);
    return true;
  },
  container(g, x, y, z) {
    const k = rsk(g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)),
      be = RS.be(g, x, y, z, k);
    g.ui.open(k === 'hopper' ? new HopperScreen(g, be) : k === 'crafter' ? new CrafterScreen(g, be) : new DispenserScreen(g, be, BLOCKS[g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].cn));
    return true;
  }
};
for (const b of BLOCKS) {
  if (!b) continue;
  const k = b.key;
  if (k === 'lever') b.onUse = RS_USE.lever;else if (RS_BUTTON.test(k)) b.onUse = RS_USE.button;else if (k === 'repeater') b.onUse = RS_USE.repeater;else if (k === 'comparator') b.onUse = RS_USE.comparator;else if (k === 'daylight_detector') b.onUse = RS_USE.daylight;else if (b.wirePower !== undefined) b.onUse = RS_USE.wire;else if (/^(hopper|dispenser|dropper|crafter)$/.test(k)) b.onUse = RS_USE.container;
}

// ---- the screens of dispensers / droppers, hoppers and the crafter ----
class DispenserScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, be, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_dispenser', 176, 166, title || '发射器');
    this.be = be;
    this.titleX = 88 - Math.floor(Font.width(this.title) / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) this.slots.push({
      x: 62 + i % 3 * 18,
      y: 17 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 18,
      group: 'container',
      get: () => be.slots[i],
      set: s => {
        be.slots[i] = s;
      }
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    Font.draw(ui.ctx, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 72, '#404040', false);
  }
}
class HopperScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, be) {
    super(game, 'gui_hopper', 176, 133, '漏斗');
    this.be = be;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) this.slots.push({
      x: 44 + i * 18,
      y: 20,
      group: 'container',
      get: () => be.slots[i],
      set: s => {
        be.slots[i] = s;
      }
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(51, 109);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    Font.draw(ui.ctx, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 39, '#404040', false);
  }
}
class CrafterScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, be) {
    super(game, 'gui_crafter', 176, 166, '合成器');
    this.be = be;
    be.disabled = be.disabled || [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) this.slots.push({
      x: 26 + i % 3 * 18,
      y: 17 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 18,
      group: 'container',
      idx: i,
      accept: () => !be.disabled.includes(i),
      get: () => be.slots[i],
      set: s => {
        be.slots[i] = s;
      }
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
  }
  // clicking an empty slot with nothing held turns it off (or on again)
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    const s = this.slotAt(mx, my);
    if (s && s.idx !== undefined && !s.get() && !ui.cursor && button === 0) {
      const d = this.be.disabled,
        k = d.indexOf(s.idx);
      if (k >= 0) d.splice(k, 1);else d.push(s.idx);
      Sound.click();
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    for (const s of this.slots) if (s.idx !== undefined && this.be.disabled.includes(s.idx)) ui.sprite('crafter_disabled_slot', this.x + s.x - 1, this.y + s.y - 1);
    const res = RS.craftResult(this.be);
    if (res) ui.drawItem(res, this.x + 134, this.y + 35);
    const [x, y, z] = this.be.pos,
      id = this.game.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
    ui.sprite(prop(id, this.game.world.getMeta(x, y, z), 'triggered') === 'true' ? 'crafter_powered_redstone' : 'crafter_unpowered_redstone', this.x + 97, this.y + 34);
    Font.draw(ui.ctx, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 72, '#404040', false);
  }
}

// ---- hooks into the game ----
const RS_IDS = new Set();
for (const b of BLOCKS) if (b && (rsSource(b.id) || /^(redstone_lamp|piston|sticky_piston|piston_head|tnt|note_block|bell|dispenser|dropper|hopper|crafter|powered_rail|activator_rail|daylight_detector|tripwire|tripwire_hook|target)$|copper_bulb$/.test(b.key) || b.door || b.trapdoor || b.gate)) RS_IDS.add(b.id);
// a neighbour changed: the component checks itself (the queue keeps it from going deep)
const _rsNeighbor = Game.prototype.onNeighborUpdate;
Game.prototype.onNeighborUpdate = function (x, y, z, id) {
  _rsNeighbor.call(this, x, y, z, id);
  if (this.net || !RS_IDS.has(this.world.getBlock(x, y, z))) return;
  RS.enqueue(x, y, z);
  RS.process(this);
};
// placed, broken or changed: observers watching it, the piston's head and the piston, and new components
const _rsChanged = Game.prototype.onBlockChanged;
Game.prototype.onBlockChanged = function (x, y, z, old, id, oldMeta) {
  _rsChanged.call(this, x, y, z, old, id, oldMeta);
  if (this.net || !this.world) return;
  RS.observe(this, x, y, z);
  if (old === id) return;
  const ok = rsk(old),
    nk = rsk(id),
    w = this.world;
  // an extended piston's head goes with it, and a piston loses its head's piston
  if ((ok === 'piston' || ok === 'sticky_piston') && Features.propOf(old, oldMeta, 'extended') === 'true' && nk !== ok) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[Features.propOf(old, oldMeta, 'facing')];
    if (v && rsk(w.getBlock(x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2])) === 'piston_head') w.setBlock(x + v[0], y + v[1], z + v[2], 0, 0);
  }
  if (ok === 'piston_head' && nk !== ok && !RS.busy) {
    const v = RS_DIRS[Features.propOf(old, oldMeta, 'facing')];
    if (v) {
      const px = x - v[0],
        py = y - v[1],
        pz = z - v[2],
        pid = w.getBlock(px, py, pz);
      if (/^(sticky_)?piston$/.test(rsk(pid)) && prop(pid, w.getMeta(px, py, pz), 'extended') === 'true') this.breakBlock ? this.breakBlock(px, py, pz, true) : w.setBlock(px, py, pz, 0, 0);
    }
  }
  if (nk === 'hopper' || nk === 'dispenser' || nk === 'dropper' || nk === 'crafter') RS.be(this, x, y, z, nk);
  if (RS_IDS.has(id) || RS_IDS.has(old) || BLOCKS[old] && BLOCKS[old].wirePower !== undefined || isWire(id)) {
    RS.wake(x, y, z);
    RS.process(this);
  }
};
// a block's state changed without a new block (setMeta): observers see that too
const _rsSetMeta = World.prototype.setMeta;
World.prototype.setMeta = function (x, y, z, meta) {
  const before = this.getMeta(x, y, z);
  _rsSetMeta.call(this, x, y, z, meta);
  if (before !== meta && this.listener && this.listener.onMetaChanged) this.listener.onMetaChanged(x, y, z);
};
Game.prototype.onMetaChanged = function (x, y, z) {
  if (!this.net) RS.observe(this, x, y, z);
};
// scheduled ticks of components
const _rsFire = Game.prototype.fireTick;
Game.prototype.blockTick = function (x, y, z) {
  if (this.net) return false;
  const r = RS.tick(this, x, y, z);
  RS.process(this);
  return r;
};
const _rsTickScheduled = World.prototype.tickScheduled;
World.prototype.tickScheduled = function () {
  if (!this.ticks.size) return;
  const L = this.listener;
  if (!L || !L.blockTick) return _rsTickScheduled.call(this);
  // components' ticks are taken out first; fire and fluids go on as before
  const due = [];
  for (const [k, v] of this.ticks) if (v.t <= this.time && RS_IDS.has(this.getBlock(v.x, v.y, v.z))) {
    due.push(v);
    this.ticks.delete(k);
  }
  for (const t of due) L.blockTick(t.x, t.y, t.z);
  return _rsTickScheduled.call(this);
};
// each tick: plates, tripwires and detector rails under entities; hoppers; daylight detectors
const _rsGameTick = Game.prototype.tick;
Game.prototype.tick = function () {
  _rsGameTick.call(this);
  if (this.net || this.state !== 'play' || !this.world || this.ui.screen && this.ui.screen.pauses) return;
  const w = this.world;
  for (const e of [this.player, ...this.entities]) {
    if (!e || e.dead) continue;
    const x = Math.floor(e.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(e.pos[1] + 0.01),
      z = Math.floor(e.pos[2]),
      id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
      k = rsk(id);
    if (RS_PLATE.test(k)) {
      const m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
      if (!(prop(id, m, 'powered') === 'true' || +prop(id, m, 'power') > 0)) RS.plateCheck(this, x, y, z);
    } else if (k === 'tripwire') {
      const hookOn = false;
      if (!hookOn) RS.tripCheck(this, x, y, z);
    } else if (k === 'detector_rail' && e instanceof Minecart && prop(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'powered') !== 'true') RS.detectorCheck(this, x, y, z);
  }
  for (const be of this.blockEntities.values()) if (be.type === 'hopper' && w.isLoaded(be.pos[0], be.pos[2])) RS.hopperTick(this, be);
  if (this.tickCount % 20 === 0) RS.daylight(this);
  if (this.tickCount % 10 === 5) RS.refreshComparators(this);
  RS.process(this);
};
// placing: an observer looks the way the player looks, tripwire hooks face out of their wall, torches start lit
const _rsPlaceState = Game.prototype.placeState;
Game.prototype.placeState = function (b, t, hdir) {
  let m = _rsPlaceState.call(this, b, t, hdir);
  const k = b.key;
  if (k === 'observer') {
    const look = this.lookDir(),
      ax = Math.abs(look[0]),
      ay = Math.abs(look[1]),
      az = Math.abs(look[2]);
    m = Features.withProp(b.id, m, 'facing', ay > ax && ay > az ? look[1] > 0 ? 'up' : 'down' : ax > az ? look[0] > 0 ? 'east' : 'west' : look[2] > 0 ? 'south' : 'north');
  }
  if (k === 'tripwire_hook' && t.face !== 2 && t.face !== 3) m = Features.withProp(b.id, m, 'facing', FACE_NAME[t.face]);
  if (k === 'redstone_torch' || k === 'redstone_wall_torch') m = Features.withProp(b.id, m, 'lit', true);
  if (k === 'hopper') m = Features.withProp(b.id, m, 'facing', t.face === 3 || t.face === 2 ? 'down' : FACE_NAME[[1, 0, 2, 3, 5, 4][t.face]]);
  return m;
};
// chunks coming in: their components settle (dust power is saved; the rest checks itself)
RS.settleChunk = function (g, ch) {
  const ids = [...RS_IDS].filter(id => {
    const k = rsk(id);
    return /^(redstone_torch|redstone_wall_torch|repeater|comparator|observer|redstone_lamp|piston|sticky_piston|hopper)$/.test(k);
  });
  ch.findAll(ids, i => RS.enqueue(ch.cx * 16 + (i & 15), i >> 8, ch.cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15)));
};
// arrows that stick in a target block power it
const _rsArrowTick = Arrow.prototype.tick;
Arrow.prototype.tick = function () {
  const was = this.stuck;
  _rsArrowTick.call(this);
  if (!was && this.stuck && this.stuckAt && !this.game.net && rsk(this.game.world.getBlock(...this.stuckAt)) === 'target') RS.targetHit(this.game, ...this.stuckAt, this.pos, true);
};
// trapped chests: opening and closing them changes their power
const _rsChestOpen = ChestScreen.prototype.close;
ChestScreen.prototype.close = function () {
  _rsChestOpen.call(this);
  for (const be of this.bes || []) {
    const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
    if (rsk(this.game.world.getBlock(x, y, z)) === 'trapped_chest') {
      RS.wake(x, y, z);
      RS.process(this.game);
    }
  }
};
const _rsOpenUI = UI.prototype.open;
UI.prototype.open = function (sc) {
  const r = _rsOpenUI.call(this, sc);
  const g = this.game;
  if (sc instanceof ChestScreen && !g.net) for (const be of sc.bes || []) {
    const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
    if (rsk(g.world.getBlock(x, y, z)) === 'trapped_chest') {
      RS.wake(x, y, z);
      RS.process(g);
    }
  }
  return r;
};
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/itemuse.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Everyday right-click uses of items in single player: axes strip logs and scrape copper (oxidation, wax),
// shovels make dirt paths, honeycomb waxes copper, glass bottles fill with water, dye colours sheep; bottles
// o' enchanting, wind charges and coloured eggs are thrown; ominous bottles are drunk; fireworks fly from the
// ground. Also the drops vanilla gives that the block list left out (kelp, creaking hearts, mushroom blocks).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const IU_STAGES = ['', 'exposed_', 'weathered_', 'oxidized_'];
// a copper block's family: { stage 0-3, waxed, key(stage, waxed) }
function copperInfo(key) {
  const m = /^(waxed_)?(exposed_|weathered_|oxidized_)?(.*copper.*)$/.exec(key);
  if (!m) return null;
  const rest = m[3],
    stage = IU_STAGES.indexOf(m[2] || '');
  const name = (st, wx) => {
    let k = rest === 'copper' || rest === 'copper_block' ? st === 0 ? 'copper_block' : IU_STAGES[st] + 'copper' : IU_STAGES[st] + rest;
    if (wx) k = 'waxed_' + k;
    return BID[k] !== undefined ? k : null;
  };
  if (!name(stage, !!m[1]) || !name(1, false) && !name(0, true)) return null;
  return {
    stage,
    waxed: !!m[1],
    name
  };
}
// replace a block keeping its state (facing, axis, half ...)
Game.prototype.swapBlock = function (x, y, z, newKey) {
  const w = this.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
    b = BLOCKS[id],
    nid = BID[newKey];
  if (nid === undefined) return false;
  let nm = m;
  if (b.states && BLOCKS[nid].states) {
    const r = Features.stateOf({
      Name: newKey,
      Properties: b.states[m] || {}
    });
    if (r) nm = r[1];
  }
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, nid, nm);
  // a door's other half too
  if (b.door) {
    const oy = m & 8 ? y - 1 : y + 1;
    if (w.getBlock(x, oy, z) === id) w.setBlock(x, oy, z, nid, w.getMeta(x, oy, z));
  }
  this.flushMesh();
  return true;
};
const STRIP = /^(.*_(log|wood|stem|hyphae)|bamboo_block)$/;
const PATHABLE = new Set(['grass_block', 'dirt', 'podzol', 'mycelium', 'coarse_dirt', 'rooted_dirt']);
const DYE_COLORS = ['white', 'orange', 'magenta', 'light_blue', 'yellow', 'lime', 'pink', 'gray', 'light_gray', 'cyan', 'purple', 'blue', 'brown', 'green', 'red', 'black'];
Game.prototype.useOnBlockItem = function (held, def) {
  const p = this.player,
    t = this.target,
    w = this.world,
    k = def.key;
  if (!t || p.sneaking && false) return false;
  const [x, y, z] = t.pos,
    tb = BLOCKS[t.id],
    tk = tb.key,
    c = [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5];
  // axes: strip logs, scrape a copper stage off, take wax off
  if (def.tool && def.tool.type === 'axe') {
    if (STRIP.test(tk) && !tk.startsWith('stripped_') && BID['stripped_' + tk] !== undefined) {
      this.swapBlock(x, y, z, 'stripped_' + tk);
      Sound.ev('item.axe.strip', c, 1, 1);
      this.damageHeld(1);
      p.swing();
      return true;
    }
    const cu = copperInfo(tk);
    if (cu && cu.waxed) {
      this.swapBlock(x, y, z, cu.name(cu.stage, false));
      Sound.ev('item.axe.wax_off', c, 1, 1);
      this.particles.spawn('crit', ...c, 0, 0.1, 0);
      this.damageHeld(1);
      p.swing();
      return true;
    }
    if (cu && cu.stage > 0) {
      this.swapBlock(x, y, z, cu.name(cu.stage - 1, false));
      Sound.ev('item.axe.scrape', c, 1, 1);
      this.damageHeld(1);
      p.swing();
      return true;
    }
  }
  // shovels: a lit campfire put out (ShovelItem.useOn, not from below)
  if (def.tool && def.tool.type === 'shovel' && t.face !== 2 && /(^|_)campfire$/.test(tk) && this.dowseCampfire && this.dowseCampfire(x, y, z, 'block.fire.extinguish')) {
    this.damageHeld(1);
    p.swing();
    return true;
  }
  // shovels: a path from grass or dirt (with air above)
  if (def.tool && def.tool.type === 'shovel' && PATHABLE.has(tk) && t.face !== 2 && !w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) && BID.dirt_path !== undefined) {
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, BID.dirt_path, 0);
    Sound.ev('item.shovel.flatten', c, 1, 1);
    this.damageHeld(1);
    p.swing();
    this.flushMesh();
    return true;
  }
  // honeycomb: wax copper
  if (k === 'honeycomb') {
    const cu = copperInfo(tk);
    if (cu && !cu.waxed && cu.name(cu.stage, true)) {
      this.swapBlock(x, y, z, cu.name(cu.stage, true));
      Sound.ev('item.honeycomb.wax_on', c, 1, 1);
      if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
        held.count--;
        if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
      }
      p.swing();
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
};
// throwables: bottles o' enchanting, wind charges, coloured eggs
class Thrown extends Arrow {
  constructor(game, x, y, z, vel, shooter, kind) {
    super(game, x, y, z, vel, shooter);
    this.kind = kind;
    this.snowball = ITEM_KEY[kind];
    this.gravity = kind === 'wind_charge' ? 0 : undefined;
  }
  tick() {
    const was = this.dead;
    if (this.kind === 'wind_charge') {
      this.vel[1] += 0.05;
    } // no gravity: Arrow's fall taken back (it falls 0.05 a tick)
    super.tick();
    if (!was && (this.dead || this.stuck)) this.burst();
  }
  breakSnowball() {
    this.burst();
  }
  burst() {
    if (this.burst_) return;
    this.burst_ = true;
    this.dead = true;
    const g = this.game,
      [x, y, z] = this.pos;
    if (this.kind === 'experience_bottle') {
      Sound.ev('entity.splash_potion.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) g.particles.spawn('effect', x, y, z, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, Math.random() * 0.3, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, {
        col: [60, 140, 255]
      });
      g.dropXp(x, y, z, 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5));
    } else if (this.kind === 'wind_charge') {
      // a burst of wind: everything near is thrown away from it, no blocks broken
      Sound.ev('entity.wind_charge.wind_burst', this.pos, 1, 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) g.particles.spawn('poof', x, y, z, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6);
      for (const e of [g.player, ...g.entities]) {
        if (!e || e.dead || !e.vel) continue;
        const dx = e.pos[0] - x,
          dy = e.pos[1] + (e.h || 1) / 2 - y,
          dz = e.pos[2] - z,
          d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
        if (d > 2.4 || d < 1e-3) continue;
        const f = (1 - d / 2.4) * 1.22;
        e.vel[0] += dx / d * f;
        e.vel[1] += dy / d * f + 0.3;
        e.vel[2] += dz / d * f;
        // (vanilla ServerPlayer.onExplosionHit: a player's fall is counted from here only, for at least 2 seconds - a
        // wind charge's, not a breeze's; a mob's fall counts whole)
        if (e === g.player && !(this.shooter instanceof Mob)) {
          e.impulseY = e.pos[1];
          e.impulseGrace = Math.max(e.impulseGrace || 0, 40);
        }
        if (e === g.player) e.fallDist = 0;
      }
    } else {
      // eggs: a chick now and then
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) g.particles.spawn('poof', x, y, z, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, Math.random() * 0.2, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2);
      if (Math.random() < 0.125) {
        const ch = new Mob(g, 'chicken', x, y, z).makeBaby();
        ch.persistent = true;
        g.addEntity(ch);
      }
    }
  }
}
const _iuUseEquipment = Game.prototype.useEquipment;
Game.prototype.useEquipment = function (held, def) {
  const p = this.player,
    k = def && def.key;
  if (!held) return _iuUseEquipment.call(this, held, def);
  if (this.useOnBlockItem(held, def)) return true;
  const throwIt = (kind, speed, sound) => {
    const d = this.lookDir();
    const a = new Thrown(this, p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + p.eye() - 0.1, p.pos[2], d.map(v => v * speed), p, kind);
    this.entities.push(a);
    Sound.ev(sound, p.pos, 0.5, 0.4 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8));
    if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
      held.count--;
      if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
    }
    p.swing();
  };
  if (k === 'experience_bottle') {
    throwIt(k, 0.7, 'entity.experience_bottle.throw');
    return true;
  }
  if (k === 'wind_charge') {
    if ((p.windCd || 0) > this.tickCount) return true;
    p.windCd = this.tickCount + 10;
    throwIt(k, 1.5, 'entity.wind_charge.throw');
    return true;
  }
  if (k === 'blue_egg' || k === 'brown_egg') {
    throwIt(k, 1.5, 'entity.egg.throw');
    return true;
  }
  // glass bottle: water from a source (or a water cauldron)
  if (k === 'glass_bottle') {
    const eye = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + p.eye(), p.pos[2]],
      ft = this.raycast(eye, this.lookDir(), this.reach(), true);
    const w = this.world;
    let ok = false;
    if (ft && ft.id === WATER) ok = true;else if (ft && BLOCKS[ft.id].key === 'water_cauldron') {
      const lv = +Features.propOf(ft.id, w.getMeta(...ft.pos), 'level') || 1;
      if (lv > 1) w.setMeta(...ft.pos, Features.withProp(ft.id, w.getMeta(...ft.pos), 'level', lv - 1));else w.setBlock(...ft.pos, BID.cauldron, 0);
      ok = true;
    }
    if (ok) {
      const pot = {
        id: ITEM_KEY.potion,
        count: 1,
        dmg: 0,
        pot: 'water'
      };
      if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
        held.count--;
        if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = pot;else if (p.inv.add(pot)) this.dropFromPlayer(pot);
      }
      Sound.ev('item.bottle.fill', p.pos, 1, 1);
      p.swing();
    }
    return true;
  }
  // ominous bottle: drunk (32 ticks), gives bad omen
  if (k === 'ominous_bottle') {
    this.startUsing(held, 'main');
    return true;
  }
  // a firework from the ground: up it goes, and bursts
  if (k === 'firework_rocket' && !p.gliding && this.target) {
    const t = this.target,
      D = DIRS[t.face],
      pt = t.point || [t.pos[0] + 0.5, t.pos[1] + 1, t.pos[2] + 0.5];
    this.entities.push(new FireworkRocket(this, pt[0] + D[0] * 0.1, pt[1] + D[1] * 0.1, pt[2] + D[2] * 0.1, held));
    Sound.ev('entity.firework_rocket.launch', pt, 3, 1);
    if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
      held.count--;
      if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
    }
    p.swing();
    return true;
  }
  return _iuUseEquipment.call(this, held, def);
};
const _iuUsingTick = Game.prototype.usingTick;
Game.prototype.usingTick = function (st) {
  _iuUsingTick.call(this, st);
  const p = this.player;
  if (ITEMS[st.id].key === 'ominous_bottle') {
    if (p.useT % 4 === 0 && p.useT > 6) Sound.ev('entity.generic.drink', p.pos, 0.5, 1);
    if (p.useT >= 32) {
      p.addEffect('bad_omen', st.amp || 0, 120000);
      Sound.ev('item.ominous_bottle.dispose', p.pos, 1, 1);
      if (this.mode !== 'creative') {
        st.count--;
        if (!st.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
      }
      p.usingItem = null;
      p.useT = 0;
    }
  }
};
// a firework rocket: flies up for its flight time, then bursts. Shot from a crossbow (vel given) it flies straight
// at that speed (vanilla isShotAtAngle) and bursts on what it hits - against a block only with stars, else it waits
// out its time there (it had been an arrow with a flag nothing read: no burst, no damage)
class FireworkRocket extends Entity {
  constructor(game, x, y, z, stack, vel, shooter) {
    super(game, x, y, z, 0.25, 0.25);
    this.life = 10 * (stack && stack.flight || 1) + 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 7);
    this.vel = vel ? [...vel] : [(Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.023, 0.05, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.023];
    this.shot = !!vel;
    this.shooter = shooter || null;
    this.stackRef = stack ? {
      ...stack
    } : null;
    this.spriteLayer = T('i_firework_rocket');
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.shot) this.shotMove();else {
      this.vel[0] *= 1.15;
      this.vel[2] *= 1.15;
      this.vel[1] += 0.04;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.pos[i] += this.vel[i];
    }
    if (this.age % 2 === 0) this.game.particles.spawn('smoke', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] - 0.3, this.pos[2], 0, -0.05, 0);
    if (this.age >= this.life || !this.shot && this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1]), Math.floor(this.pos[2]))) {
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.firework_rocket.blast', this.pos, 3, 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          b = Math.acos(Math.random() * 2 - 1),
          s = 0.3;
        this.game.particles.spawn('crit', ...this.pos, Math.sin(b) * Math.cos(a) * s, Math.cos(b) * s, Math.sin(b) * Math.sin(a) * s);
      }
      this.blastDamage();
    }
  }
  // a shot rocket's step: what it runs into on the way (a burst next tick: life cut short)
  shotMove() {
    if (this.stopped) return;
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel,
      n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) / 0.3));
    const stop = burst => {
      this.stopped = true;
      if (burst) this.life = Math.min(this.life, this.age + 1);
    };
    for (let s = 0; s < n; s++) {
      const nx = this.pos[0] + v[0] / n,
        ny = this.pos[1] + v[1] / n,
        nz = this.pos[2] + v[2] / n;
      for (const e of [g.player, ...g.entities]) {
        if (!(e instanceof Living) || e.dead || e.deathTime > 0 || e === this.shooter && this.age < 5) continue;
        const b = e.box();
        if (nx > b[0] - 0.125 && nx < b[3] + 0.125 && ny > b[1] - 0.125 && ny < b[4] + 0.125 && nz > b[2] - 0.125 && nz < b[5] + 0.125) return stop(true);
      }
      const id = this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(nx), Math.floor(ny), Math.floor(nz));
      if (id && BLOCKS[id].solid) return stop(!!(this.stackRef && this.stackRef.explosions && this.stackRef.explosions.length));
      this.pos[0] = nx;
      this.pos[1] = ny;
      this.pos[2] = nz;
    }
  }
  // vanilla dealExplosionDamage: with stars, 5 + 2 a star to every living thing within 5 blocks it can see, less with
  // the distance
  blastDamage() {
    const ex = this.stackRef && this.stackRef.explosions,
      g = this.game;
    if (!ex || !ex.length || g.net) return;
    const dmg = 5 + ex.length * 2,
      o = this.pos;
    for (const e of [g.player, ...g.entities]) {
      if (!(e instanceof Living) || e.dead || e.deathTime > 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - o[0], e.pos[1] - o[1], e.pos[2] - o[2]);
      if (d > 5) continue;
      const seen = [0, 0.5].some(k => {
        const to = [e.pos[0] - o[0], e.pos[1] + e.h * k - o[1], e.pos[2] - o[2]],
          l = Math.hypot(...to);
        if (l < 1e-6) return true;
        const hit = g.raycast(o, to.map(c => c / l), l, false);
        return !hit || hit.t >= l;
      });
      if (seen) e.hurt(dmg * Math.sqrt((5 - d) / 5), {
        type: 'firework',
        attacker: this.shooter,
        knockFrom: [...o],
        knock: 0,
        player: this.shooter === g.player
      });
    }
  }
}
// dye on a sheep
const _iuMobInteract = Mob.prototype.interact;
Mob.prototype.interact = function (p, held) {
  const k = held && ITEMS[held.id] ? ITEMS[held.id].key : '';
  if (this.type === 'sheep' && /_dye$/.test(k) && !this.sheared) {
    const c = DYE_COLORS.indexOf(k.replace(/_dye$/, ''));
    if (c >= 0 && this.woolColor !== c) {
      this.woolColor = c;
      Sound.ev('item.dye.use', this.pos, 1, 1);
      if (this.game.mode !== 'creative') {
        held.count--;
        if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
      }
      return true;
    }
  }
  // flint and steel or a fire charge lights a creeper: it swells to the end whatever its target does (vanilla
  // Creeper.mobInteract, #creeper_igniters)
  if (this.type === 'creeper' && (k === 'flint_and_steel' || k === 'fire_charge') && !this.dead && !(this.deathTime > 0)) {
    Sound.ev(k === 'fire_charge' ? 'item.firecharge.use' : 'item.flintandsteel.use', this.pos, 1, Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8);
    if (!this.ignited) {
      this.ignited = true;
      if (this.fuse < 0) {
        this.fuse = 0;
        Sound.fuse(this.pos);
      }
    }
    if (k === 'flint_and_steel') this.game.damageHeld(1);else if (this.game.mode !== 'creative') {
      held.count--;
      if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
    }
    return true;
  }
  return _iuMobInteract ? _iuMobInteract.call(this, p, held) : false;
};
// drops the block list doesn't give: kelp drops kelp, a creaking heart 1-3 resin clumps, mushroom blocks 0-2 mushrooms
for (const [k, fn] of [['kelp', () => [['kelp', 1]]], ['kelp_plant', () => [['kelp', 1]]], ['creaking_heart', (m, r) => [['resin_clump', 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3)]]], ['brown_mushroom_block', (m, r) => [['brown_mushroom', Math.max(0, Math.floor(r() * 9) - 6)]]], ['red_mushroom_block', (m, r) => [['red_mushroom', Math.max(0, Math.floor(r() * 9) - 6)]]]]) if (BID[k] !== undefined && (k !== 'creaking_heart' || ITEM_KEY.resin_clump !== undefined)) BLOCKS[BID[k]].drops = fn;

// ---- cakes (vanilla CakeBlock / CandleCakeBlock): right-clicked with anything (empty hand or not) a slice is eaten
// when the player can eat (hungry, or in creative): 2 food, 0.4 saturation, bites 0 -> 6 and then gone. An uneaten
// cake takes a candle; a candle cake is eaten like a whole cake and drops its candle, its lit candle is blown out by
// an empty hand clicking it (the upper half); flint and steel / a fire charge go on to light it
function eatCake(g, x, y, z, bites) {
  const p = g.player;
  if (!(p.creative || p.food < 20)) return false;
  p.food = Math.min(20, p.food + 2);
  p.saturation = Math.min(p.food, p.saturation + 2 * 0.1 * 2);
  const cake = BID.cake;
  if (bites < 6) g.world.setBlock(x, y, z, cake, Features.withProp(cake, 0, 'bites', String(bites + 1)));else g.world.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
  g.flushMesh && g.flushMesh();
  return true;
}
if (BID.cake !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID.cake].onUse = (g, x, y, z) => {
  const p = g.player,
    held = p.inv.held,
    k = keyOfStack(held),
    w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  const bites = +Features.propOf(id, m, 'bites') || 0;
  if (k && /^(.+_)?candle$/.test(k) && BID[k + '_cake'] !== undefined) {
    if (bites !== 0) return false;
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, BID[k + '_cake'], Features.withProp(BID[k + '_cake'], 0, 'lit', 'false'));
    if (g.mode !== 'creative') {
      held.count--;
      if (!held.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
    }
    Sound.ev('block.cake.add_candle', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
    return true;
  }
  return eatCake(g, x, y, z, bites);
};
for (const k in BID) if (/^(.+_)?candle_cake$/.test(k)) BLOCKS[BID[k]].onUse = (g, x, y, z, t) => {
  const p = g.player,
    held = p.inv.held,
    hk = keyOfStack(held),
    w = g.world,
    id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
    m = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
  if (hk === 'flint_and_steel' || hk === 'fire_charge') return false;
  if (!held && t && t.point && t.point[1] - y > 0.5 && Features.propOf(id, m, 'lit') === 'true') {
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, m, 'lit', 'false'));
    Sound.ev('block.candle.extinguish', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
    return true;
  }
  if (!eatCake(g, x, y, z, 0)) return false;
  g.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, makeStack(BLOCKS[id].key.replace(/_cake$/, ''), 1));
  return true;
};
