<script>
/* ==== js/emodel.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vanilla entity models: the model layers, keyframe animations and entity data the local 26.2 client builds
// (tools/export_entities.py -> tools/build_entities.py -> entitydata.js, etex.js).
// A model is drawn the way vanilla's renderers do: in the model's own space (y down, 24 px above the feet at
// y = 0), turned into the entity's by scale(-1, -1, 1) and a 1.501 block drop; each part translates to its
// pivot, rotates Z, Y, X and scales. Animations work like vanilla's: each frame the parts go back to their
// initial pose, a mob's setupAnim moves them and keyframe animations add their offsets.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const EM = {
  models: {},
  // the model of a layer ('pig#main'), built on first use; null when the jar has no such layer
  get(r, key) {
    if (key in this.models) return this.models[key];
    const L = window.ENTITY_DATA && ENTITY_DATA.layers[key];
    if (!L) return this.models[key] = null;
    const parts = {},
      meshed = [];
    const mk = (name, a) => {
      const n = {
        name,
        ip: a.slice(0, 6),
        is: a[6] || null,
        mesh: null,
        kids: []
      };
      if (a[7]) meshed.push([n, a[7]]);
      if (a[8]) for (const k in a[8]) n.kids.push(mk(k, a[8][k]));
      if (name && !parts[name]) parts[name] = n;
      return n;
    };
    // the layer's own root is unnamed: models with a part called "root" get that one
    const m = {
      key,
      tw: L.tw,
      th: L.th,
      root: mk('', L.root),
      parts
    };
    emPack(r, meshed);
    m.all = [];
    const walk = n => {
      m.all.push(n);
      n.kids.forEach(walk);
    };
    walk(m.root);
    this.reset(m);
    return this.models[key] = m;
  },
  has(key) {
    return !!(window.ENTITY_DATA && ENTITY_DATA.layers[key]);
  },
  reset(m) {
    for (const n of m.all) {
      n.x = n.ip[0];
      n.y = n.ip[1];
      n.z = n.ip[2];
      n.xRot = n.ip[3];
      n.yRot = n.ip[4];
      n.zRot = n.ip[5];
      n.xScale = n.is ? n.is[0] : 1;
      n.yScale = n.is ? n.is[1] : 1;
      n.zScale = n.is ? n.is[2] : 1;
      n.visible = true;
      n.skipDraw = false;
    }
  },
  // the pose of src's parts copied onto dst's parts of the same name (vanilla copyPropertiesTo, for layers drawn over a model)
  copy(src, dst) {
    for (const n of dst.all) {
      const s = src.parts[n.name];
      if (!s) continue;
      n.x = s.x;
      n.y = s.y;
      n.z = s.z;
      n.xRot = s.xRot;
      n.yRot = s.yRot;
      n.zRot = s.zRot;
      n.xScale = s.xScale;
      n.yScale = s.yScale;
      n.zScale = s.zScale;
      n.visible = s.visible;
    }
  },
  // a keyframe animation (ENTITY_DATA.anims, 'WardenAnimation.WARDEN_ROAR') at t seconds, its offsets scaled by k
  anim(m, name, t, k = 1) {
    const A = ENTITY_DATA.anims[name];
    if (!A || !m) return;
    const tt = A.loop ? t % A.len : t;
    for (const bone in A.bones) {
      const n = m.parts[bone];
      if (!n) continue;
      for (const ch of A.bones[bone]) {
        const v = emSample(ch.k, tt);
        if (ch.t === 'rot') {
          n.xRot += v[0] * k;
          n.yRot += v[1] * k;
          n.zRot += v[2] * k;
        } else if (ch.t === 'pos') {
          n.x += v[0] * k;
          n.y += v[1] * k;
          n.z += v[2] * k;
        } else {
          n.xScale += v[0] * k;
          n.yScale += v[1] * k;
          n.zScale += v[2] * k;
        }
      }
    }
  },
  // a walking animation driven by the limb swing like vanilla's applyWalk: time = swing position, strength = speed
  walk(m, name, pos, speed, tMul = 1, sMul = 1) {
    this.anim(m, name, pos * 0.05 * tMul, Math.min(speed * sMul, 1));
  },
  // a one-shot / looping animation an entity started (e.anims[name] = the tick it started)
  state(m, e, name, a, k = 1) {
    const s = e.anims && e.anims[name];
    if (s == null) return;
    this.anim(m, name, (e.age - s + a) / 20, k);
  }
};
// a channel's value at t: the keyframe at or before t and the next, linear or Catmull-Rom between them
const _emV = [0, 0, 0];
function emSample(K, t) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i + 1 < K.length && K[i + 1][0] < t) i++;
  if (K.length > 1 && K[0][0] >= t) i = 0;
  const j = Math.min(K.length - 1, i + 1),
    d = K[j][0] - K[i][0];
  const al = d > 0 ? clamp((t - K[i][0]) / d, 0, 1) : 0;
  if (K[j][1] === 0) {
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) _emV[c] = lerp(K[i][5 + c], K[j][2 + c], al);
  } else {
    const p0 = K[Math.max(0, i - 1)],
      p1 = K[i],
      p2 = K[j],
      p3 = K[Math.min(K.length - 1, j + 1)];
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
      const a = p0[5 + c],
        b = p1[5 + c],
        cc = p2[5 + c],
        dd = p3[5 + c];
      _emV[c] = 0.5 * (2 * b + (-a + cc) * al + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * cc - dd) * al * al + (-a + 3 * b - 3 * cc + dd) * al * al * al);
    }
  }
  return _emV;
}
// the parts' faces ([node, faces] each; a face: [nx, ny, nz, then x y z u v for each of 4 corners] in model pixels) as
// one mesh: one buffer and VAO a layer, each part drawn from its own first quad - off, a byte offset into the shared quad
// indices - so drawEM binds a model's VAO once, not once a part (~90 binds a frame with 28 mobs in view, 11-04)
function emPack(r, list) {
  if (!list.length) return;
  let total = 0;
  for (const [, faces] of list) total += faces.length;
  const gl = r.gl,
    data = new Float32Array(total * 32);
  let o = 0;
  for (const [n, faces] of list) {
    n.mesh = {
      vao: null,
      n: faces.length * 4,
      off: o / 32 * 24
    };
    for (const f of faces) for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const b = 3 + k * 5;
      data[o++] = f[b] / 16;
      data[o++] = f[b + 1] / 16;
      data[o++] = f[b + 2] / 16;
      data[o++] = f[b + 3];
      data[o++] = f[b + 4];
      data[o++] = f[0];
      data[o++] = f[1];
      data[o++] = f[2];
    }
  }
  const vao = gl.createVertexArray();
  gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
  const buf = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, data, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 0);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 12);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 20);
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, r.quadIdx);
  gl.bindVertexArray(null);
  for (const [n] of list) n.mesh.vao = vao;
}

// an entity texture from etex.js ('entity/horse/horse_white'), made into a GL texture once its image loads
// (null until then)
Renderer.prototype.etex = function (path) {
  const k = '@' + path;
  if (this.entityTex[k]) return k;
  if (!this._etexWait) this._etexWait = new Set();
  if (this._etexWait.has(k)) return null;
  const src = window.ETEX && ETEX[path];
  if (!src) return null;
  this._etexWait.add(k);
  const im = new Image();
  im.onload = () => {
    this.images[k] = im;
    this.entityTex[k] = this.tex2D(im, false);
  };
  im.src = src;
  return null;
};
// several entity textures painted over each other (optionally tinted [r, g, b] 0..1, multiplied like vanilla's
// dyed layers) into one texture, made once per combination; null until all the images have loaded
Renderer.prototype.etexMix = function (layers) {
  const key = '@mix:' + layers.map(l => typeof l === 'string' ? l : l.p + (l.c ? '*' + l.c.join(',') : '')).join('|');
  if (this.entityTex[key]) return key;
  const ims = layers.map(l => {
    const p = typeof l === 'string' ? l : l.p;
    this.etex(p);
    return this.images['@' + p];
  });
  if (ims.some(i => !i)) return null;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = ims[0].width;
  c.height = ims[0].height;
  const x = c.getContext('2d');
  layers.forEach((l, i) => {
    const im = ims[i];
    if (typeof l !== 'string' && l.c) {
      const t = document.createElement('canvas');
      t.width = im.width;
      t.height = im.height;
      const tx = t.getContext('2d');
      tx.drawImage(im, 0, 0);
      const d = tx.getImageData(0, 0, t.width, t.height),
        p = d.data;
      for (let q = 0; q < p.length; q += 4) {
        p[q] *= l.c[0];
        p[q + 1] *= l.c[1];
        p[q + 2] *= l.c[2];
      }
      tx.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
      x.drawImage(t, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    } else x.drawImage(im, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  });
  this.entityTex[key] = this.tex2D(c, false);
  return key;
};

// draw a vanilla model posed as it is now; base: the entity's matrix (feet, body yaw applied).
// opts: overlay, tint, bright, vp, attach {part: fn(matrix)}, cull (default off: vanilla EntityModel's entityCutout
// draws both sides, so flat parts - warden tendrils, axolotl gills, allay wings, chicken legs - show from behind too;
// true for the few vanilla culls: bats, bells, books)
Renderer.prototype.drawEM = function (m, tex, base, light, env, opts = {}) {
  if (!m || !tex || !this.entityTex[tex]) return;
  const gl = this.gl,
    E = this.entBegin(tex, light, env, opts);
  // (the matrices from the renderer's pool for this frame, render.js mat: a new array per part was ~10 a mob a frame)
  const mat = this.mat(base);
  M4.scale(mat, -1, -1, 1);
  M4.translate(mat, 0, -1.501, 0);
  const cull = opts.cull === true;
  if (cull) gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);else gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  // (depth LEQUAL like vanilla's pipelines: the two faces of a flat part lie on each other, and the later one shows from
  // both sides as in vanilla)
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
  const att = [],
    glint = opts.glint ? [] : null;
  let vao = null;
  const rec = (n, pm) => {
    if (!n.visible) return;
    const mm = this.mat(pm);
    M4.translate(mm, n.x / 16, n.y / 16, n.z / 16);
    if (n.zRot) M4.rotZ(mm, n.zRot);
    if (n.yRot) M4.rotY(mm, n.yRot);
    if (n.xRot) M4.rotX(mm, n.xRot);
    if (n.xScale !== 1 || n.yScale !== 1 || n.zScale !== 1) M4.scale(mm, n.xScale, n.yScale, n.zScale);
    if (n.mesh && !n.skipDraw) {
      // (opts.glintOnly: only the enchantment glint over it, render.js drawGlint - armour under its trim)
      if (!opts.glintOnly) {
        gl.uniformMatrix4fv(E.u.u_model, false, mm);
        if (n.mesh.vao !== vao) {
          vao = n.mesh.vao;
          gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
        } // (the layer's parts share one: emPack)
        gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, n.mesh.n * 1.5, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, n.mesh.off);
      }
      if (glint) glint.push([n.mesh.vao, n.mesh.n, n.mesh.off, mm]);
    }
    if (opts.attach && opts.attach[n.name]) att.push([opts.attach[n.name], this.mat(mm)]);
    for (const k of n.kids) rec(k, mm);
  };
  rec(m.root, mat);
  if (glint) this.drawGlint(glint, opts.glint, env, opts.vp || this.vp, false);
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
  this.unit0(); // (texture unit 0 again, before what is attached draws: render.js entBegin)
  for (const [fn, mm] of att) fn(mm);
};
// the same, drawn additively over what is there (eyes, glowing layers)
Renderer.prototype.drawEMGlow = function (m, tex, base, env, opts = {}) {
  const gl = this.gl;
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
  gl.depthMask(false);
  this.drawEM(m, tex, base, [1, 1], env, {
    ...opts,
    bright: true
  });
  gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
  gl.depthMask(true);
};
// a layer drawn over the model at the same depth (markings, collars, saddles that are not inflated)
Renderer.prototype.drawEMOver = function (m, tex, base, light, env, opts = {}) {
  const gl = this.gl;
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
  this.drawEM(m, tex, base, light, env, opts);
  gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
};

// vanilla-style head turn: yaw and pitch (this game's radians) on a part in model space
function emHead(n, e, a) {
  if (!n) return;
  n.yRot = -(e.headYaw || 0);
  n.xRot = -(e.pitch || 0);
}
// the limb swing the way vanilla passes it to setupAnim: position and speed (0..1), interpolated
function emLimbs(e, a) {
  const amt = e.limbAmt || 0,
    pos = (e.limbSwing || 0) - amt * (1 - a);
  return [pos, Math.min(1, amt)];
}
// four-legged walk (vanilla QuadrupedModel)
function emQuad(m, pos, spd, names = ['right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg', 'right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg']) {
  const P = m.parts,
    c = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd,
    d = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd;
  if (P[names[0]]) P[names[0]].xRot = c;
  if (P[names[1]]) P[names[1]].xRot = d;
  if (P[names[2]]) P[names[2]].xRot = d;
  if (P[names[3]]) P[names[3]].xRot = c;
}
// humanoid arms and legs (vanilla HumanoidModel's walk; aggressive: arms held forward like zombies)
function emHumanoid(m, e, a, opts = {}) {
  const P = m.parts,
    [pos, spd] = emLimbs(e, a);
  emHead(P.head, e, a); // (the hat is the head's child in vanilla 26.x's models: it follows the head by itself)
  const ra = P.right_arm,
    la = P.left_arm,
    rl = P.right_leg,
    ll = P.left_leg;
  if (ra) {
    ra.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 2 * spd * 0.5;
    ra.zRot = 0;
    ra.yRot = 0;
  }
  if (la) {
    la.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 2 * spd * 0.5;
    la.zRot = 0;
    la.yRot = 0;
  }
  if (rl) {
    rl.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd;
    rl.yRot = 0;
    rl.zRot = 0;
  }
  if (ll) {
    ll.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd;
    ll.yRot = 0;
    ll.zRot = 0;
  }
  if (e.riding && rl && ll) {
    if (ra) ra.xRot -= Math.PI / 5;
    if (la) la.xRot -= Math.PI / 5;
    rl.xRot = -1.4137167;
    rl.yRot = Math.PI / 10;
    rl.zRot = 0.07853982;
    ll.xRot = -1.4137167;
    ll.yRot = -Math.PI / 10;
    ll.zRot = -0.07853982;
  }
  const t = e.age + a;
  if (opts.zombie && ra && la) {
    // arms forward, raised further while attacking
    const atk = e.swingT > 0 ? Math.sin((1 - e.swingT / 6) * Math.PI) : 0,
      f = Math.sin(atk * Math.PI);
    const g = Math.sin((1 - (1 - atk) * (1 - atk)) * Math.PI),
      raise = -Math.PI / (e.aggressive || e.target ? 1.5 : 2.25);
    ra.zRot = 0;
    la.zRot = 0;
    ra.yRot = -(0.1 - f * 0.6);
    la.yRot = 0.1 - f * 0.6;
    ra.xRot = raise + f * 1.2 - g * 0.4;
    la.xRot = raise + f * 1.2 - g * 0.4;
  } else if (e.swingT > 0 && ra) {
    const s = 1 - e.swingT / 6,
      f = Math.sin(Math.sqrt(s) * Math.PI);
    ra.xRot -= f * 1.2 + Math.sin(s * Math.PI) * -(P.head ? P.head.xRot - 0.7 : 0) * 0.75;
    ra.yRot += P.body ? Math.sin(Math.sqrt(s) * Math.PI * 2) * 0.2 : 0;
  }
  if (opts.bow && ra && la) {
    // vanilla bow pose: both arms toward the target
    ra.yRot = -0.1 + P.head.yRot;
    la.yRot = 0.1 + P.head.yRot + 0.4;
    ra.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 + P.head.xRot;
    la.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 + P.head.xRot;
  }
  // idle arm sway
  if (ra) {
    ra.zRot += Math.cos(t * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05;
    ra.xRot += Math.sin(t * 0.067) * 0.05;
  }
  if (la) {
    la.zRot -= Math.cos(t * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05;
    la.xRot -= Math.sin(t * 0.067) * 0.05;
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/vmobs.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mobs drawn with the vanilla models (emodel.js): the framework.
//  - VMOB: each type's settings (model layer, texture, animation, behaviour); sizes, health, speed, attack and
//    names come from the vanilla entity data (ENTITY_DATA.types)
//  - VMob: a mob with a small goal-based brain: walk / swim / fly to a goal, fight, flee, follow food, its
//    parent or its owner, breed; the subclasses in mobs_*.js add what each kind does
//  - drops from the vanilla loot tables (rollLoot)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const VMOB = {};
const VMOB_CLASS = {};
// register a type: o = { cls, layer, tex(e, r) -> etex key, anim(md, e, a), scale, ... }
function defVMob(type, o = {}) {
  const T = ENTITY_DATA.types[type] || {
      w: 0.6,
      h: 1.8,
      cat: 'creature',
      a: {}
    },
    A = T.a || {};
  const cat = o.cat || T.cat;
  VMOB[type] = o;
  if (o.cls) VMOB_CLASS[type] = o.cls;
  MOB_TYPES[type] = Object.assign({
    cn: T.cn || type,
    hp: A.max_health || 10,
    w: T.w,
    h: T.h,
    eye: T.eye,
    speed: A.movement_speed || 0.25,
    model: 'vm',
    passive: cat === 'creature' || cat === 'water_creature' || cat === 'water_ambient' || cat === 'ambient' || cat === 'axolotls' || cat === 'underground_water_creature' || cat === 'misc',
    hostile: cat === 'monster',
    attack: A.attack_damage || 0,
    fireproof: !!T.fire,
    drops: [],
    scale: 1,
    cat,
    follow: A.follow_range || 16,
    flySpeed: A.flying_speed || 0,
    kbRes: A.knockback_resistance || 0,
    armor: A.armor || 0,
    step: A.step_height || 0.6
  }, o.T || {});
  const egg = ITEM_KEY[type + '_spawn_egg'];
  if (egg !== undefined) ITEMS[egg].spawnEgg = type;
}
(() => {
  const prev = createMob;
  createMob = function (game, type, x, y, z) {
    if (VMOB[type] && !(typeof type === 'string' && type.includes(':'))) {
      const C = VMOB_CLASS[type] || VMob;
      return new C(game, type, x, y, z);
    }
    return prev(game, type, x, y, z);
  };
})();
const foodIds = tag => new Set(itemIds('#' + tag));
const _foodCache = {};
const isFood = (tag, id) => {
  if (!_foodCache[tag]) _foodCache[tag] = foodIds(tag);
  return _foodCache[tag].has(id);
};
const randInt = (a, b) => a + Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1));
const pickW = list => {
  let t = 0;
  for (const e of list) t += e[1];
  let r = Math.random() * t;
  for (const e of list) if ((r -= e[1]) < 0) return e[0];
  return list[0][0];
};
const DYES = ['white', 'orange', 'magenta', 'light_blue', 'yellow', 'lime', 'pink', 'gray', 'light_gray', 'cyan', 'purple', 'blue', 'brown', 'green', 'red', 'black'];
const dyeRGB = c => {
  const v = DYE_RGB[c] || 0xffffff;
  return [(v >> 16 & 255) / 255, (v >> 8 & 255) / 255, (v & 255) / 255];
};

// ---- loot tables -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ctx: { e: the dead entity, src: the damage source, looting, player (killed by a player), fire }
function lootNum(n) {
  if (typeof n === 'number') return n;
  if (!n) return 1;
  const t = (n.type || '').replace('minecraft:', '');
  if (t === 'uniform') return lootNum(n.min) + Math.random() * (lootNum(n.max) - lootNum(n.min));
  if (t === 'binomial') {
    let k = 0;
    const N = lootNum(n.n),
      p = lootNum(n.p);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) if (Math.random() < p) k++;
    return k;
  }
  if (t === 'constant') return n.value;
  return 1;
}
// a whole number, as vanilla's getInt: a uniform range includes its top (floor of a float in [min, max) never reached
// it - an iron golem dropped 3-4 ingots instead of 3-5, poppies 1 instead of 0-2; players' feedback 2026-10-31)
function lootInt(n) {
  if (n && typeof n === 'object' && (n.type || '').replace('minecraft:', '') === 'uniform') {
    const a = Math.floor(lootNum(n.min)),
      b = Math.floor(lootNum(n.max));
    return a + Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1));
  }
  return Math.floor(lootNum(n));
}
function lootEntityMatch(e, pred, ctx) {
  if (!e) return false;
  for (const k in pred) {
    const v = pred[k],
      key = k.replace('minecraft:', '');
    if (key === 'flags') {
      if (v.is_on_fire !== undefined && e.fire > 0 !== v.is_on_fire) return false;
      if (v.is_baby !== undefined && !!e.baby !== v.is_baby) return false;
    } else if (key === 'entity_type') {
      const want = String(v).replace('minecraft:', '');
      if (want[0] === '#') {
        if (!(ENTITY_TAGS[want.slice(1)] || []).includes(e.type)) return false;
      } else if (e.type !== want) return false;
    } else if (key === 'components') {
      for (const ck in v) if (String(e.comp ? e.comp(ck.replace('minecraft:', '')) : '').replace('minecraft:', '') !== String(v[ck]).replace('minecraft:', '')) return false;
    } else if (key.startsWith('type_specific')) {
      const ts = v;
      if (ts.sheared !== undefined && !!e.sheared !== ts.sheared) return false;
      if (ts.size) {
        const s = e.size || 1;
        if (ts.size.min != null && s < ts.size.min || ts.size.max != null && s > ts.size.max) return false;
      }
      // (a raider is a captain when it carries the ominous banner: a patrol's or a raid wave's leader)
      if (ts.is_captain !== undefined && !!(e.patrolLeader || e.raidLeader) !== ts.is_captain) return false;
    } else if (key === 'equipment') {
      const held = e.inv ? e.inv.held : null;
      const mh = v.mainhand;
      if (mh && mh.predicates && mh.predicates['minecraft:enchantments']) {
        const ok = mh.predicates['minecraft:enchantments'].some(q => {
          const want = String(q.enchantments || '');
          if (!held || !held.e) return false;
          if (want === '#minecraft:smelts_loot') return held.e.some(([k]) => k === 'fire_aspect');
          return held.e.some(([k]) => 'minecraft:' + k === want || k === want);
        });
        if (!ok) return false;
      } else if (mh) return false;
    } else if (key === 'vehicle') {
      if (!e.vehicle || !lootEntityMatch(e.vehicle, v, ctx)) return false;
    } else return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function lootCond(c, ctx) {
  const t = c.condition.replace('minecraft:', '');
  switch (t) {
    case 'killed_by_player':
      return !!ctx.player;
    case 'random_chance':
      return Math.random() < lootNum(c.chance);
    case 'random_chance_with_enchanted_bonus':
      {
        const L = ctx.looting || 0,
          ec = c.enchanted_chance;
        const p = L <= 0 ? lootNum(c.unenchanted_chance) : typeof ec === 'number' ? ec : (ec.base || 0) + (ec.per_level_above_first || 0) * (L - 1);
        return Math.random() < p;
      }
    case 'entity_properties':
      {
        const who = c.entity === 'this' ? ctx.e : c.entity === 'attacker' || c.entity === 'direct_attacker' ? ctx.src && ctx.src.attacker : null;
        return lootEntityMatch(who, c.predicate || {}, ctx);
      }
    case 'damage_source_properties':
      {
        const p = c.predicate || {},
          a = ctx.src && ctx.src.attacker;
        if (p.source_entity && !lootEntityMatch(a, p.source_entity, ctx)) return false;
        if (p.direct_entity && !lootEntityMatch(ctx.src && (ctx.src.direct || a), p.direct_entity, ctx)) return false;
        if (p.tags) return false;
        return !!(p.source_entity || p.direct_entity);
      }
    case 'any_of':
      return c.terms.some(q => lootCond(q, ctx));
    case 'all_of':
      return c.terms.every(q => lootCond(q, ctx));
    case 'inverted':
      return !lootCond(c.term, ctx);
  }
  return false;
}
const condsOk = (o, ctx) => !o.conditions || o.conditions.every(c => lootCond(c, ctx));
// a loot table's enchant_with_levels (the enchanting table's choice at that level, its primary items) and
// enchant_randomly (one enchantment of those that fit, at a random level); a book becomes an enchanted book.
// options: the #on_random_loot tag (all but the treasure ones, less curses, frost walker and mending) or a list
const LOOT_TREASURE = new Set(['binding_curse', 'vanishing_curse', 'frost_walker', 'mending']);
function lootEnchant(st, fn, f) {
  const o = f.options,
    keys = o && (typeof o !== 'string' || o[0] !== '#') ? new Set([].concat(o).map(k => String(k).replace('minecraft:', ''))) : null;
  const ok = E => keys ? keys.has(E.key) : !E.treasure || LOOT_TREASURE.has(E.key),
    book = ITEMS[st.id].key === 'book';
  let list;
  if (fn === 'enchant_with_levels') list = selectEnchants(new JRandom(Math.random() * 2 ** 31 | 0), st.id, Math.max(0, lootInt(f.levels)), ok);else {
    const can = ENCH_LIST.filter(E => ok(E) && (book || E.sup.has(st.id)));
    if (!can.length) return;
    const E = can[Math.random() * can.length | 0];
    list = [[E.key, 1 + (Math.random() * E.max | 0)]];
  }
  if (!list.length) return;
  if (book) st.id = ITEM_KEY.enchanted_book;
  st.e = list;
}
function lootEntry(en, ctx, out) {
  const t = en.type.replace('minecraft:', '');
  if (t === 'empty') return;
  if (t === 'loot_table') {
    rollLoot(String(en.value).replace('minecraft:', '').replace(/^entities\//, ''), ctx, out);
    return;
  }
  if (t === 'alternatives') {
    for (const ch of en.children) if (condsOk(ch, ctx)) {
      lootEntry(ch, ctx, out);
      return;
    }
    return;
  }
  let key;
  if (t === 'tag') {
    const ids = itemIds('#' + en.name.replace('minecraft:', ''));
    if (!ids.length) return;
    key = ITEMS[ids[Math.random() * ids.length | 0]].key;
  } else if (t === 'item') key = en.name.replace('minecraft:', '');else return;
  if (ITEM_KEY[key] === undefined) return;
  let n = 1;
  const st = {
    id: ITEM_KEY[key],
    count: 1,
    dmg: 0
  };
  for (const f of en.functions || []) {
    if (!condsOk(f, ctx)) continue;
    const fn = f.function.replace('minecraft:', '');
    if (fn === 'set_count') n = f.add ? n + lootInt(f.count) : lootInt(f.count);else if (fn === 'enchanted_count_increase' || fn === 'looting_enchant') {
      n += Math.round(lootNum(f.count) * (ctx.looting || 0));
      if (f.limit > 0) n = Math.min(n, f.limit);
    } else if (fn === 'furnace_smelt') {
      const r = COOKING.smelting && COOKING.smelting[st.id];
      if (r) st.id = r.result;
    } else if (fn === 'set_potion') st.pot = String(f.id).replace('minecraft:', '');else if (fn === 'set_ominous_bottle_amplifier') {
      const a = f.amplifier;
      st.amp = a && /uniform/.test(a.type || '') ? randInt(lootNum(a.min), lootNum(a.max)) : Math.floor(lootNum(a));
    }
    // worn and enchanted: a fished bow or boots came whole and plain (players' feedback 2026-11)
    else if (fn === 'set_damage') {
      const d = ITEMS[st.id].durability;
      if (d) st.dmg = clamp(Math.floor((1 - lootNum(f.damage)) * d), 0, d - 1);
    } else if ((fn === 'enchant_with_levels' || fn === 'enchant_randomly') && typeof selectEnchants === 'function') lootEnchant(st, fn, f);
  }
  n = Math.floor(n);
  if (n <= 0) return;
  const mx = maxStack(st.id);
  while (n > 0) {
    const k = Math.min(mx, n);
    out.push({
      ...st,
      count: k
    });
    n -= k;
  }
}
// the stacks a loot table gives (name: 'zombie', 'sheep/white', 'gameplay/fishing')
function rollLoot(name, ctx = {}, out = []) {
  const L = ENTITY_DATA.loot[name];
  if (!L || !L.pools) return out;
  for (const pool of L.pools) {
    if (!condsOk(pool, ctx)) continue;
    const rolls = Math.floor(lootInt(pool.rolls) + (pool.bonus_rolls ? lootNum(pool.bonus_rolls) * (ctx.luck || 0) : 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < rolls; i++) {
      const ok = pool.entries.filter(en => condsOk(en, ctx));
      if (!ok.length) continue;
      const tot = ok.reduce((s, en) => {
        var _en$weight;
        return s + ((_en$weight = en.weight) !== null && _en$weight !== void 0 ? _en$weight : 1) + (en.quality || 0) * (ctx.luck || 0);
      }, 0);
      let r = Math.random() * tot,
        pick = ok[0];
      for (const en of ok) {
        var _en$weight2;
        if ((r -= ((_en$weight2 = en.weight) !== null && _en$weight2 !== void 0 ? _en$weight2 : 1) + (en.quality || 0) * (ctx.luck || 0)) < 0) {
          pick = en;
          break;
        }
      }
      lootEntry(pick, ctx, out);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
const ENTITY_TAGS = {
  skeletons: ['skeleton', 'stray', 'wither_skeleton', 'skeleton_horse', 'bogged', 'parched'],
  zombies: ['zombie', 'husk', 'drowned', 'zombie_villager', 'zombified_piglin', 'zombie_horse', 'zombie_nautilus', 'camel_husk'],
  raiders: ['evoker', 'pillager', 'ravager', 'vindicator', 'illusioner', 'witch'],
  undead: ['skeleton', 'stray', 'wither_skeleton', 'skeleton_horse', 'bogged', 'parched', 'zombie', 'husk', 'drowned', 'zombie_villager', 'zombified_piglin', 'zombie_horse', 'phantom', 'wither', 'zoglin', 'zombie_nautilus', 'camel_husk'],
  arthropod: ['spider', 'cave_spider', 'bee', 'silverfish', 'endermite']
};

// ---- the mob ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class VMob extends Mob {
  constructor(game, type, x, y, z) {
    super(game, type, x, y, z);
    this.D = VMOB[type];
    this.vm = true;
    this.anims = {};
    this.stepHeight = this.T.step || 0.6;
    this.persistent = !this.T.hostile;
    this.home = [x, y, z];
    this.breedCd = 0;
    this.loveT = 0;
    this.anger = 0;
    this.owner = null;
    this.ctl = {
      fwd: 0,
      strafe: 0,
      jump: false,
      mod: 1,
      look: null,
      goal: null,
      up: 0
    };
    if (this.D.init) this.D.init(this);
  }
  get ai() {
    return this.D.ai || 'ground';
  }
  // ---- saving
  saveData() {
    const o = {
      v: this.variant,
      own: this.owner ? 1 : 0,
      sit: this.sitting ? 1 : 0,
      name: this.customName,
      love: this.breedCd,
      ...(this.extraSave ? this.extraSave() : {})
    };
    return o;
  }
  loadData(o) {
    if (!o) return;
    if (o.v !== undefined) this.variant = o.v;
    if (o.own) this.owner = this.game.player;
    if (o.sit) this.sitting = true;
    if (o.name) this.customName = o.name;
    if (o.love) this.breedCd = o.love;
    if (this.extraLoad) this.extraLoad(o);
  }
  // a component the loot tables ask about (sheep/color, frog/variant ...)
  comp(k) {
    return this.compVal ? this.compVal(k) : undefined;
  }
  makeBaby() {
    super.makeBaby();
    this.growT = 24000;
    if (this.D.babyW) {
      this.w = this.D.babyW;
      this.h = this.D.babyH;
    }
    return this;
  }
  // ---- damage, death, loot
  hurt(a, src) {
    var _src$knock;
    if (this.D.immune && src && this.D.immune.includes(src.type)) return false;
    // (natural armour and breach: Mob.hurt)
    const kb = src && src.knockFrom && this.T.kbRes ? {
      ...src,
      knock: ((_src$knock = src.knock) !== null && _src$knock !== void 0 ? _src$knock : 0.4) * (1 - this.T.kbRes)
    } : src;
    const r = super.hurt(a, kb);
    if (r) {
      if (src && src.attacker && src.attacker !== this) {
        this.lastAttacker = src.attacker;
        if (this.T.passive && !this.D.fights) {
          this.panic = 80 + randInt(0, 40);
        } else {
          this.anger = 400;
          this.target = src.attacker;
        }
        if (this.onAttacked) this.onAttacked(src);
      }
      if (this.sitting && !this.D.keepSitting) this.sitting = false;
    }
    return r;
  }
  die(src) {
    Living.prototype.die.call(this, src);
    const g = this.game;
    if (src && (src.attacker === g.player || src.player)) g.stats.kills++;
    const looting = src && src.looting || 0;
    if (!this.baby || this.D.babyLoot) {
      const out = rollLoot(this.D.loot || this.type, {
        e: this,
        src,
        looting,
        player: !!(src && (src.attacker === g.player || src.player)),
        fire: this.fire > 0
      });
      for (const st of out) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], st);
    }
    if (this.saddled) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], makeStack('saddle', 1));
    if (this.dropsOnDeath) for (const st of this.dropsOnDeath()) if (st) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], st);
    if (this.rider && this.rider.dismount) this.rider.dismount();
    if (src && (src.attacker === g.player || src.player)) {
      var _this$D$xp;
      if (this.T.hostile) g.grant && g.grant('kill');
      if (!this.baby) g.dropXp(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], (_this$D$xp = this.D.xp) !== null && _this$D$xp !== void 0 ? _this$D$xp : this.T.hostile ? 5 : randInt(1, 3));
    }
    if (this.onDeath) this.onDeath(src);
  }
  // ---- the tick
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.baseTick();
    if (this.deathTick()) return;
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      c = this.ctl;
    if (this.despawn()) return;
    if (this.D.burns && this.burnsNow()) this.fire = Math.max(this.fire, 160);
    if (this.age % 20 === 0 && Sound.warmMob && this.distTo(p) < 32) Sound.warmMob(this.D.soundType || this.type);
    if (--this.idleSound < 0) {
      this.idleSound = (this.D.idleT || 200) + Math.random() * 400;
      if (this.distTo(p) < 24 && !this.silentNow) this.sound(this.ambientKind ? this.ambientKind() : 'ambient');
    }
    if (this.attackCd > 0) this.attackCd--;
    if (this.anger > 0) this.anger--;
    if (this.breedCd > 0) this.breedCd--;
    c.fwd = 0;
    c.strafe = 0;
    c.jump = false;
    c.mod = 1;
    c.look = null;
    c.goal = null;
    c.up = 0;
    c.face = null;
    if (this.rider && this.rider.rideInput && this.ridden) this.ridden(c, this.rider.rideInput);else this.think(c);
    this.moveBy(c);
    if (this.afterMove) this.afterMove();
    this.turnHead(c.look);
    if (this.loveT > 0) {
      this.loveT--;
      if (this.age % 10 === 0) g.particles.spawn('heart', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, this.pos[1] + this.h, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w, 0, 0.02, 0);
    }
    if (this.baby && --this.growT <= 0) this.grownUp();
    if (this.swingT > 0) this.swingT--;
    if (this.leashHolder && this.leashTick) this.leashTick();
    if (this.rider) this.rider.followVehicle(this);
    this.animate();
    if (this.onGround && this.limbAmt > 0.3 && this.D.stepSound !== false && Math.floor(this.limbSwing / 2.4) !== Math.floor((this.limbSwing - this.limbAmt) / 2.4)) this.sound('step', 0.15);
  }
  grownUp() {
    this.baby = false;
    this.w = this.T.w;
    this.h = this.T.h;
    if (this.onGrown) this.onGrown();
  }
  sound(kind, vol = 1, pitch) {
    const n = this.D.sounds && this.D.sounds[kind] || 'entity.' + (this.D.soundType || this.type) + '.' + kind;
    Sound.ev(n, this.pos, vol * (this.D.vol || 1), pitch !== null && pitch !== void 0 ? pitch : (this.baby ? 1.5 : 1) + (Math.random() - Math.random()) * 0.2);
  }
  despawn() {
    if (this.persistent || this.customName || this.leashHolder || this.rider) return false;
    const d = this.distTo(this.game.player);
    if (d > 128 || d > 32 && this.age > 600 && Math.random() < 1 / 800) {
      this.dead = true;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  burnsNow() {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!g.isDay() || this.inWater || this.age % 20 || g.weather >= 0.5 || this.fire > 0) return false;
    if (this.armorItems && this.armorItems[0]) return false;
    return this.world.skyAt(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1] + this.h), Math.floor(this.pos[2])) >= 15;
  }
  // ---- the brain (subclasses add to it or replace it)
  think(c) {
    if (this.sitting) return;
    this.findTarget();
    if (this.target) {
      this.fight(c);
      return;
    }
    if (this.panic > 0) {
      this.panic--;
      c.mod = this.D.panicMod || 1.4;
      if (!this.goal || this.age % 20 === 0 || this.near(this.goal, 1.2)) this.goal = this.randomGoal(8, 4);
      c.goal = this.goal;
      return;
    }
    if (this.avoid && this.avoid(c)) return;
    if (this.breedTick(c)) return;
    if (this.tempt(c)) return;
    if (this.followOwner && this.followOwner(c)) return;
    if (this.followParent(c)) return;
    if (this.raid && this.raidGoal && this.raidGoal(c)) return; // (raids.js)
    if (this.idle) {
      if (this.idle(c)) return;
    }
    this.wanderTick(c);
  }
  near(pt, r) {
    return Math.hypot(pt[0] - this.pos[0], (pt[1] - this.pos[1]) * (this.ai === 'ground' ? 0 : 1), pt[2] - this.pos[2]) < r;
  }
  findTarget() {
    const p = this.game.player,
      T = this.T;
    const ok = t => t && !t.dead && t.deathTime === 0 && !(t === p && (p.creative || p.spectator || this.game.difficulty === 0 && T.hostile));
    if (this.target && (!ok(this.target) || this.distTo(this.target) > T.follow * 1.5 || this.target === p && this.anger <= 0 && !this.wantsPlayer())) this.target = null;
    if (!this.target && this.wantsPlayer() && ok(p) && this.distTo(p) < seenWithin(p, T.follow) && (this.age + this.id) % 10 === 0 && this.canSee(p)) this.target = p;
    if (!this.target && this.huntTarget) this.target = this.huntTarget();
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.T.hostile && !this.D.neutral && this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  fight(c) {
    const t = this.target,
      d = Math.hypot(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0], t.pos[2] - this.pos[2]);
    c.look = t;
    if (this.ranged) {
      this.ranged(c, t, d);
      return;
    }
    this.chase(c, t, d);
  }
  // run at the target and hit it when in reach
  chase(c, t = this.target, d = Math.hypot(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0], t.pos[2] - this.pos[2])) {
    var _this$jumpFromY;
    c.look = t;
    c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
    c.mod = this.D.chaseMod || 1.2;
    if (this.ai !== 'ground') c.goal[1] += t.h * 0.5 - this.h * 0.5;
    const reach = this.w / 2 + t.w / 2 + (this.D.reach || 0.7);
    // (on the ground: the bodies overlap in height, counted from where a jump started - see Mob's melee in entity.js)
    const base = Math.min(this.pos[1], (_this$jumpFromY = this.jumpFromY) !== null && _this$jumpFromY !== void 0 ? _this$jumpFromY : this.pos[1]);
    const high = this.ai !== 'ground' ? Math.abs(t.pos[1] - this.pos[1]) < Math.max(1.8, this.h) : t.pos[1] < base + Math.max(this.h, 1.2) && t.pos[1] + t.h > base;
    if (d < reach && high && this.attackCd <= 0) this.melee(t);
  }
  melee(t) {
    this.attackCd = this.D.attackCd || 20;
    this.swingT = 6;
    // an axe knocks a raised shield down for 5 seconds (vanilla)
    const g = this.game;
    if (t === g.player && t.usingItem === ITEM_KEY.shield && this.hand && /_axe$/.test(ITEMS[this.hand.id].key)) {
      t.shieldCd = g.tickCount + 100;
      t.usingItem = null;
      Sound.ev('item.shield.break', t.pos, 0.8, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
    }
    let dmg = this.T.attack || 2;
    const df = this.game.difficulty;
    if (t === this.game.player) dmg = df === 1 ? Math.min(dmg / 2 + 1, dmg) : df === 3 ? dmg * 1.5 : dmg;
    if (t.hurt(dmg, {
      type: 'mob',
      attacker: this,
      knockFrom: this.pos,
      knock: 0.4 + (this.D.knock || 0)
    })) {
      this.sound('attack', 1);
      if (this.onMeleeHit) this.onMeleeHit(t);
    }
  }
  tempt(c) {
    if (!this.D.food || this.baby && !this.D.babyTempt) return false;
    const p = this.game.player,
      held = p.inv.held;
    const off = p.inv.slots[40];
    if (!(held && isFood(this.D.food, held.id) || off && isFood(this.D.food, off.id))) return false;
    const d = this.distTo(p);
    if (d > 10 || p.deathTime) return false;
    c.look = p;
    if (d > 2.5) {
      c.goal = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1], p.pos[2]];
      c.mod = this.D.temptMod || 1.0;
    }
    return true;
  }
  breedTick(c) {
    if (this.loveT <= 0) return false;
    const mate = this.game.entities.find(o => o !== this && o.type === this.type && o.loveT > 0 && !o.baby && o.distTo(this) < 8 && !o.dead);
    if (!mate) return false;
    c.look = mate;
    c.goal = [mate.pos[0], mate.pos[1], mate.pos[2]];
    if (this.distTo(mate) < 3) {
      this.breedT = (this.breedT || 0) + 1;
      if (this.breedT > 60 && this.id < mate.id) {
        this.loveT = 0;
        mate.loveT = 0;
        this.breedT = 0;
        this.breedCd = mate.breedCd = 6000;
        this.spawnChild(mate);
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
  spawnChild(mate) {
    const g = this.game,
      b = createMob(g, this.type, (this.pos[0] + mate.pos[0]) / 2, this.pos[1], (this.pos[2] + mate.pos[2]) / 2);
    b.makeBaby();
    b.persistent = true;
    if (this.inheritFrom) this.inheritFrom(b, mate);
    if (this.owner) b.owner = this.owner;
    g.entities.push(b);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) g.particles.spawn('heart', b.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), b.pos[1] + 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5, b.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
    g.dropXp(b.pos[0], b.pos[1] + 0.5, b.pos[2], randInt(1, 7));
    return b;
  }
  followParent(c) {
    if (!this.baby || this.age % 40 && !this.parentRef) return false;
    if (!this.parentRef || this.parentRef.dead || this.age % 40 === 0) this.parentRef = this.game.entities.find(o => o.type === this.type && !o.baby && o.distTo(this) < 8);
    const P = this.parentRef;
    if (!P || this.distTo(P) < 3) return false;
    c.goal = [P.pos[0], P.pos[1], P.pos[2]];
    c.mod = 1.1;
    return true;
  }
  // (a land mob fallen into water makes for dry ground at once - vanilla WaterAvoidingRandomStrollGoal in water -
  // rather than floating there until it happens to pick a place)
  get avoidsWater() {
    return this.ai === 'ground' && !this.D.waterOk;
  }
  wanderTick(c) {
    if (this.goal && (this.near(this.goal, this.ai === 'ground' ? 0.8 : 1) || --this.wanderT <= 0)) this.goal = null;
    const ashore = this.avoidsWater && this.inWater;
    if (!this.goal && (ashore ? this.age % 10 === 0 : Math.random() < (this.D.wanderChance || (this.ai === 'ground' ? 1 / 120 : 1 / 40)))) {
      this.goal = this.randomGoal(ashore ? 14 : this.D.wanderR || 10, this.D.wanderY || 7);
      this.wanderT = 200;
    }
    if (this.goal) {
      c.goal = this.goal;
      c.mod = this.D.wanderMod || 1;
    }
  }
  // a random place to go: on the ground, in the water or in the air
  randomGoal(r, ry) {
    const w = this.world;
    for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
      const x = this.pos[0] + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * r,
        z = this.pos[2] + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * r;
      let y = this.pos[1] + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * ry;
      const fx = Math.floor(x),
        fz = Math.floor(z);
      if (!w.isLoaded(fx, fz)) continue;
      // (a swimmer's goal is all under water, not at the surface it could flop out over)
      if (this.ai === 'swim') {
        if (w.waterAt(fx, Math.floor(y), fz) && w.waterAt(fx, Math.floor(y + this.h + 0.3), fz)) return [x, y, z];
        continue;
      }
      if (this.ai === 'fly') {
        if (this.D.flyHeight) {
          let gy = Math.floor(this.pos[1]);
          while (gy > 0 && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(fx, gy, fz)].solid && this.pos[1] - gy < 30) gy--;
          y = Math.min(y, gy + 1 + this.D.flyHeight);
        }
        if (!BLOCKS[w.getBlock(fx, Math.floor(y), fz)].solid) return [x, y, z];
        continue;
      }
      let fy = Math.floor(this.pos[1] + 2);
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(fx, fy - 1, fz)].solid; i++) fy--;
      if (!BLOCKS[w.getBlock(fx, fy - 1, fz)].solid || BLOCKS[w.getBlock(fx, fy, fz)].solid) continue;
      if (this.avoidsWater && (w.waterAt(fx, fy, fz) || w.waterAt(fx, fy - 1, fz) || w.getBlock(fx, fy - 1, fz) === LAVA)) continue;
      return [x, fy, z];
    }
    return null;
  }
  // ---- moving toward the goal
  moveBy(c) {
    const D = this.D,
      g = c.goal;
    if (c.face != null) this.turnTo(c.face, 0.5);
    if (this.ai === 'fly' || this.ai === 'swim' && this.inWater || this.ai === 'amph' && this.inWater && !this.D.walkUnderwater) {
      this.move3d(c);
      return;
    }
    if (this.ai === 'swim' && !this.inWater) {
      this.flop();
      return;
    }
    if (g) {
      const dx = g[0] - this.pos[0],
        dz = g[2] - this.pos[2],
        d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (d > 0.3) {
        this.turnTo(Math.atan2(-dx, -dz), D.turn || 0.35);
        c.fwd = Math.max(c.fwd, 1);
      }
    }
    // obstacles: don't walk off cliffs or into lava; jump up blocks; climb (spiders)
    if (c.fwd > 0) {
      const ax = this.pos[0] - Math.sin(this.yaw) * (this.w / 2 + 0.5),
        az = this.pos[2] - Math.cos(this.yaw) * (this.w / 2 + 0.5);
      const fx = Math.floor(ax),
        fz = Math.floor(az),
        fy = Math.floor(this.pos[1]);
      let drop = 0;
      while (drop < 5 && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(fx, fy - 1 - drop, fz)].solid && !IS_FLUID[this.world.getBlock(fx, fy - 1 - drop, fz)]) drop++;
      const danger = this.world.getBlock(fx, fy - 1 - drop, fz) === LAVA || this.world.getBlock(fx, fy, fz) === LAVA;
      // (on land, a land mob doesn't stroll into water - following its owner or food it may swim, as in vanilla)
      const wet = this.avoidsWater && !this.target && !this.inWater && c.goal === this.goal && (this.world.waterAt(fx, fy, fz) || this.world.waterAt(fx, fy - 1 - drop, fz));
      if (danger && !this.T.fireproof || wet || drop > (this.target ? 4 : 3) && !D.fearless) {
        c.fwd = 0;
        this.goal = null;
      }
      if (this.collidedH && this.onGround) c.jump = true;
      if (this.collidedH && D.climbs) {
        this.vel[1] = 0.2;
        this.fallDist = 0;
      }
      if (fwdStuck(this)) {
        if (++this.stuck > 40) {
          this.goal = null;
          this.stuck = 0;
          this.yaw += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
        }
      } else this.stuck = 0;
    }
    if (this.inWater && !D.sinks && (this.vel[1] < 0.02 || this.collidedH)) c.jump = true;
    if (this.inLava && this.T.fireproof && D.lavaWalker) c.jump = true;
    if (c.jump && this.onGround && !this.inWater) {
      this.vel[1] = (D.jump || 0.42) * jumpFactorOf(this);
      this.jumpFromY = this.pos[1];
    } else if (this.onGround) this.jumpFromY = undefined;
    const s = this.T.speed * c.mod * (this.baby && D.babyFast ? 1.2 : 1);
    this.travel(c.fwd, c.strafe, s * s * (D.landSpeedMul || 1), c.jump);
    const d = angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw);
    this.bodyYaw += d * (D.bodyTurn || 0.3);
  }
  // swimming or flying straight toward the goal (no gravity), turning to face where it goes
  move3d(c) {
    var _D$sink;
    const D = this.D,
      v = this.vel,
      g = c.goal,
      fly = this.ai === 'fly';
    // (swimAcc: the push per tick vanilla's swim move control gives at speed modifier 1; the drag of 0.9 makes ten times that the top speed)
    const sp = (fly ? (this.T.flySpeed || 0.6) * 0.1 * (D.speed3 || 1) : D.swimAcc || this.T.speed * 0.12 * (D.speed3 || 1)) * c.mod;
    if (g) {
      const dx = g[0] - this.pos[0],
        dy = g[1] - this.pos[1],
        dz = g[2] - this.pos[2],
        d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
      if (d > 0.2) {
        v[0] += dx / d * sp;
        v[1] += dy / d * sp * (D.vert || 1);
        v[2] += dz / d * sp;
        const h = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (h > 0.3 && c.face == null) this.turnTo(Math.atan2(-dx, -dz), D.turn || 0.25);
        this.pitch3 = Math.atan2(dy, h);
      }
    }
    if (c.up) v[1] += c.up;
    if (fly) this.fallDist = 0;
    if (fly && D.hover !== false && !g) v[1] *= 0.6;
    if (!fly && !g) v[1] -= (_D$sink = D.sink) !== null && _D$sink !== void 0 ? _D$sink : 0.002;
    this.move(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
    const drag = fly ? D.airDrag || 0.91 : D.waterDrag || 0.9;
    v[0] *= drag;
    v[1] *= drag;
    v[2] *= drag;
    if (fly && D.gravity) v[1] -= D.gravity;
    this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw) * (D.bodyTurn || 0.5);
    if (this.collidedH && fly) v[1] += 0.05;
  }
  // a fish out of water: flops about
  flop() {
    const v = this.vel;
    if (this.onGround && Math.random() < 0.1) {
      v[1] = 0.4;
      v[0] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
      v[2] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
      this.sound('flop', 0.6);
    }
    this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
    this.outOfWater = (this.outOfWater || 0) + 1;
    if (this.outOfWater > (this.D.dryOut || 300) && this.age % 20 === 0) this.hurt(1, {
      type: 'drown'
    });
  }
  turnHead(look) {
    if (look) {
      const lx = look.pos ? look.pos : look,
        ly = look.pos ? look.pos[1] + (look.eyeH || look.h * 0.85 || 1) : look[1];
      const dx = lx[0] - this.pos[0],
        dz = lx[2] - this.pos[2];
      const hy = angDelta(Math.atan2(-dx, -dz), this.bodyYaw),
        lim = this.D.headYaw || 1.2;
      this.headYaw += (clamp(hy, -lim, lim) - this.headYaw) * 0.3;
      const dy = ly - (this.pos[1] + (this.T.eye || this.h * 0.85));
      this.pitch = clamp(Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)), -0.8, 0.8);
      if (Math.abs(hy) > lim && this.ai !== 'fly' && this.ctl.fwd === 0) this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.bodyYaw + hy, this.bodyYaw) * 0.1;
    } else {
      this.headYaw *= 0.9;
      this.pitch *= 0.9;
      if (this.ai !== 'ground' && this.pitch3) this.pitch = 0;
    }
  }
  // ---- feeding, taming and the like (right click); returns true when it used the click
  interact(p, held) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.preInteract && this.preInteract(p, held)) return true;
    if (held && this.D.food && isFood(this.D.food, held.id)) {
      if (this.health < this.maxHealth && this.D.healFood) {
        this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + this.D.healFood);
        useOne(g, p);
        this.sound('eat');
        return true;
      }
      if (this.baby) {
        this.growT -= Math.floor(this.growT * 0.1);
        useOne(g, p);
        g.particles.spawn('happy_villager', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h, this.pos[2], 0, 0.05, 0);
        return true;
      }
      if (this.breedCd <= 0 && this.loveT <= 0 && this.canBreed()) {
        this.loveT = 600;
        useOne(g, p);
        this.sound('eat');
        return true;
      }
    }
    if (this.postInteract && this.postInteract(p, held)) return true;
    return false;
  }
  canBreed() {
    return !this.D.tameToBreed || !!this.owner;
  }
  // ---- drawing
  layerKey() {
    const D = this.D,
      base = D.layer || this.type + '#main';
    if (this.baby) {
      const bk = D.babyLayer || base.replace('#', '_baby#');
      if (EM.has(bk)) return bk;
    }
    return base;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    const t = this.D.tex ? this.D.tex(this, r) : 'entity/' + this.type + '/' + this.type;
    if (!t) return null;
    if (typeof t === 'string') return t[0] === '@' ? t : r.etex(t);
    return r.etexMix(t);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    if (this.D.anim) this.D.anim(md, this, a);else {
      emHead(md.parts.head, this, a);
      const [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
      emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    }
  }
  // babies without a baby model of their own are the adult model at half size
  renderScale() {
    return (this.attrScale || 1) * (this.D.scale || 1) * (this.baby && this.layerKey() === (this.D.layer || this.type + '#main') ? 0.5 : 1);
  }
  drawVM(g, r, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    const md = EM.get(r, this.layerKey());
    if (!md) return;
    EM.reset(md);
    this.setupAnim(md, a);
    const tex = this.texKey(r);
    const att = this.attachments ? this.attachments(g, md, lt, env) : null;
    r.drawEM(md, tex, m, lt, env, {
      overlay,
      attach: att,
      cull: typeof this.D.cull === 'function' ? this.D.cull(this) : this.D.cull,
      bright: this.D.bright
    });
    if (this.drawLayers) this.drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay);
    if (this.D.glow) {
      const gt = r.etex(typeof this.D.glow === 'function' ? this.D.glow(this) : this.D.glow);
      if (gt) r.drawEMGlow(md, gt, m, env, {});
    }
  }
}
function angDelta(a, b) {
  let d = a - b;
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return d;
}
function fwdStuck(e) {
  return Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - e.prev[0], e.pos[2] - e.prev[2]) < 0.01;
}
function useOne(g, p, toItem) {
  if (g.mode === 'creative') return;
  const h = p.inv.held;
  if (!h) return;
  h.count--;
  if (!h.count) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = null;
  if (toItem) {
    const st = makeStack(toItem, 1);
    if (!p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel]) p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = st;else if (p.inv.add(st)) g.dropItem(p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + 1, p.pos[2], st);
  }
}
// swap the held stack for another item (milking, filling buckets): one off the stack, the new one in its place or the inventory
function swapHeld(g, p, key, extra) {
  const st = {
    ...makeStack(key, 1),
    ...(extra || {})
  };
  if (g.mode === 'creative') {
    if (!p.inv.slots.some(s => s && sameKind(s, st))) p.inv.add(st);
    return;
  }
  const h = p.inv.held;
  if (h.count <= 1) {
    p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = st;
    return;
  }
  h.count--;
  if (p.inv.add(st)) g.dropItem(p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + 1, p.pos[2], st);
}

// ---- drawing a vanilla-model mob (called from Game.drawMob) ----------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.drawVMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
  const r = this.renderer;
  let m = M4.create();
  if (e.displayMatrix) m = M4.copy(e.displayMatrix);else {
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    let by = e.bodyYaw;
    if (e.prevBodyYaw !== undefined) by = e.prevBodyYaw + angDelta(e.bodyYaw, e.prevBodyYaw) * a;
    M4.rotY(m, by);
  }
  if (e.deathTime > 0 && !e.D.noDeathFlip) M4.rotZ(m, Math.min(1, Math.sqrt((e.deathTime + a) / 20)) * Math.PI / 2);
  if (e.preDraw) e.preDraw(m, a);
  const sc = e.renderScale(a);
  M4.scale(m, sc, sc, sc);
  const overlay = e.hurtTime > 0 || e.deathTime > 0 ? [1, 0, 0, 0.4] : e.whiteFlash ? e.whiteFlash(a) : null;
  const lt = [l[0], l[1]];
  if (e.fire > 0 || e.D.bright) lt[1] = 1;
  e.drawVM(this, r, m, a, env, lt, overlay);
  if (e.customName && this.player && e.distTo(this.player) < 32 && this.drawNameTag) this.drawNameTag(e, ip, e.customName);
  if (e.deathTime === 0 && !e.displayMatrix && e.D.shadow !== false) {
    const fx = Math.floor(ip[0]),
      fz = Math.floor(ip[2]);
    let gy = Math.floor(ip[1] + 0.01);
    for (let k = 0; k < 6 && gy > 0 && !SOLIDCUBE[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)] && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)].solid; k++) gy--;
    const h = ip[1] - gy,
      rad = (e.D.shadowR || e.w * 0.6) * (e.baby ? 0.5 : 1) * (e.D.scale || 1);
    if (h < 5) r.drawShadow(ip[0], gy, ip[2], rad * (1 - h / 10), 0.55 * (1 - h / 5));
  }
};
(() => {
  const _dm = Game.prototype.drawMob;
  Game.prototype.drawMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    if (e.vm && e.drawVM) return this.drawVMob(e, ip, a, env, l);
    return _dm.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
  };
})();

// a mob drawn into a small picture for a screen (the horse's inventory), turned toward the mouse like vanilla's.
// Read back like main.js's playerPreview: into a pixel buffer, fenced, copied out once the GPU is past it (the first
// picture at once) - a plain readPixels made the CPU wait for the whole frame, the world behind the screen included,
// each time the mouse moved. The key: what changes the picture (JSON of saveData each frame took in a donkey's whole
// chest, and breedCd, counting down every tick, drew the horse again each tick)
const mobLookKey = e => {
  var _e$cvar;
  const st = s => {
    var _s$color;
    return s ? s.id + ':' + ((_s$color = s.color) !== null && _s$color !== void 0 ? _s$color : '') : '';
  };
  return [e.type, e.variant, e.baby ? 1 : 0, e.saddled ? 1 : 0, e.rider ? 1 : 0, st(e.armorItem), e.chest ? 1 : 0, st(e.carpet), e.sit ? 1 : 0, e.sitting ? 1 : 0, (_e$cvar = e.cvar) !== null && _e$cvar !== void 0 ? _e$cvar : '', e.sheared ? 1 : 0].join('/');
};
Renderer.prototype.mobPreview = function (game, e, ui, x, y, w, h) {
  const gl = this.gl,
    S = Math.max(2, ui.scale),
    W = w * S,
    H = h * S;
  const key = e.id + ',' + Math.round(ui.mouse.x / 2) + ',' + Math.round(ui.mouse.y / 2) + ',' + W + ',' + H + ',' + mobLookKey(e);
  // (asked for every frame while its screen is open: a gap means the screen was opened again)
  const now = performance.now(),
    gap = this.mpv ? now - (this.mpv.at || 0) : 1e9;
  if (this.mpv) this.mpv.at = now;
  if (this.mpv && this.mpv.sync && this.mpv.W === W && this.mpv.H === H) {
    const pv = this.mpv;
    if (pv.eid !== e.id) {
      gl.deleteSync(pv.sync);
      pv.sync = null;
      pv.key = null;
    } // (another mob's picture on its way: not wanted)
    else {
      if (gl.getSyncParameter(pv.sync, gl.SYNC_STATUS) !== gl.SIGNALED) return pv.cv;
      gl.deleteSync(pv.sync);
      pv.sync = null;
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pv.pbo);
      gl.getBufferSubData(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, 0, pv.px);
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, null);
      for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) pv.img.data.set(pv.px.subarray((H - 1 - r) * W * 4, (H - r) * W * 4), r * W * 4);
      pv.ctx.putImageData(pv.img, 0, 0);
      pv.key = pv.pendingKey;
    }
  }
  if (this.mpv && this.mpv.key === key) return this.mpv.cv;
  if (!this.mpv || this.mpv.W !== W || this.mpv.H !== H) {
    if (this.mpv) {
      gl.deleteFramebuffer(this.mpv.fb);
      gl.deleteTexture(this.mpv.tex);
      gl.deleteRenderbuffer(this.mpv.rb);
      if (this.mpv.pbo) gl.deleteBuffer(this.mpv.pbo);
      if (this.mpv.sync) gl.deleteSync(this.mpv.sync);
    }
    const fb = gl.createFramebuffer(),
      tex = gl.createTexture(),
      rb = gl.createRenderbuffer();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, W, H, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);
    gl.bindRenderbuffer(gl.RENDERBUFFER, rb);
    gl.renderbufferStorage(gl.RENDERBUFFER, gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT24, W, H);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fb);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    gl.framebufferRenderbuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, gl.RENDERBUFFER, rb);
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = W;
    cv.height = H;
    const pbo = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pbo);
    gl.bufferData(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, W * H * 4, gl.STREAM_READ);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, null);
    this.mpv = {
      fb,
      tex,
      rb,
      pbo,
      W,
      H,
      cv,
      ctx: cv.getContext('2d'),
      px: new Uint8Array(W * H * 4),
      img: cv.getContext('2d').createImageData(W, H),
      first: true
    };
  }
  const pv = this.mpv;
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, pv.fb);
  gl.viewport(0, 0, W, H);
  gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
  gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
  const size = Math.max(e.w, e.h) * (e.D.scale || 1) * 0.62 + 0.1;
  const vp = M4.create();
  M4.ortho(vp, -size, size, -size * 0.25, size * 1.75, -8, 8);
  const mx = (ui.mouse.x - (x + w / 2)) / 40;
  const m = M4.create();
  M4.rotY(m, Math.PI * 0.8 - Math.atan(mx) * 0.7);
  const env = {
    day: 1,
    fogColor: [0, 0, 0],
    fogNear: 1e8,
    fogFar: 2e8,
    nightTint: [1, 1, 1]
  };
  const savedCam = this.camPos,
    savedVP = this.vp;
  this.camPos = [0, 0, 0];
  this.vp = vp;
  const hy = e.headYaw,
    pt = e.pitch,
    la = e.limbAmt;
  e.headYaw = 0;
  e.pitch = 0;
  e.limbAmt = 0;
  const sc = e.renderScale(1);
  M4.scale(m, sc, sc, sc);
  try {
    e.drawVM(game, this, m, 1, env, [1, 0], null);
  } catch (err) {}
  e.headYaw = hy;
  e.pitch = pt;
  e.limbAmt = la;
  this.vp = savedVP;
  this.camPos = savedCam;
  const done = e.texKey && e.texKey(this) ? key : null; // (drawn again once its texture has loaded)
  if (pv.first || pv.eid !== e.id || gap > 500) {
    // the first picture of a screen (another mob, or opened again) is read at once: never a frame of the last one
    pv.first = false;
    gl.readPixels(0, 0, W, H, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, pv.px);
    for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) pv.img.data.set(pv.px.subarray((H - 1 - r) * W * 4, (H - r) * W * 4), r * W * 4);
    pv.ctx.putImageData(pv.img, 0, 0);
    pv.key = done;
  } else {
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, pv.pbo);
    gl.readPixels(0, 0, W, H, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, 0);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, null);
    pv.sync = gl.fenceSync(gl.SYNC_GPU_COMMANDS_COMPLETE, 0);
    gl.flush();
    pv.pendingKey = done;
  }
  pv.eid = e.id;
  pv.at = now;
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
  gl.viewport(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
  return pv.cv;
};
if (ITEM_KEY.ender_dragon_spawn_egg !== undefined) ITEMS[ITEM_KEY.ender_dragon_spawn_egg].spawnEgg = 'ender_dragon';
</script>
<script>

// Land animals and other friendly mobs drawn with the vanilla models (vmobs.js): horses, donkeys, mules,
// skeleton / zombie horses, camels, llamas, wolves, foxes, goats, pandas, polar bears, rabbits, ocelots,

// golems, the wandering trader and its llamas, happy ghasts.

const biomeName = (g, x, z) => {
  const v = g.vbiomeAt && g.vbiomeAt(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(z));
  return v && v.name || 'plains';
};
const lerpRot = (a, b, t) => a + angDelta(b, a) * t;

// ---- horses, donkeys, mules, skeleton and zombie horses ------------------------------------------------
const HORSE_COLORS = ['white', 'creamy', 'chestnut', 'brown', 'black', 'gray', 'darkbrown'];
const HORSE_MARKS = [null, 'white', 'whitefield', 'whitedots', 'blackdots'];
const HORSE_ARMOR = {
  leather_horse_armor: ['leather', 3],
  copper_horse_armor: ['copper', 4],
  iron_horse_armor: ['iron', 5],
  golden_horse_armor: ['gold', 7],
  diamond_horse_armor: ['diamond', 11],
  netherite_horse_armor: ['netherite', 19]

class Horse extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.tame = false;
    this.temper = 0;
    this.saddled = false;
    this.armorItem = null;
    this.chest = false;
    this.chestInv = null;
    this.eatT = 0;
    this.rearT = 0;
    this.mouthT = 0;
    this.tailT = 0;
    this.jumpCharge = 0;

    // vanilla: random speed, jump strength and health within the breed's range

      this.maxHealth = this.health = 15 + randInt(0, 8) + randInt(0, 9);
      this.spd = (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3) * 0.25;
      this.jumpStr = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.2;
    } else if (type === 'donkey' || type === 'mule') {

    }
  }
  extraSave() {

  }
  extraLoad(o) {

    this.temper = o.temper || 0;

    this.chest = !!o.ch;

    if (o.spd) this.spd = o.spd;

  }
  get undead() {
    return this.type === 'skeleton_horse' || this.type === 'zombie_horse';
  }
  canBreed() {
    return this.tame && !this.undead;
  }
  seat() {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + (this.baby ? 0.5 : 1.1) - (this.type === 'donkey' ? 0.2 : 0), this.pos[2]];
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.armorItem, this.chest ? makeStack('chest', 1) : null, ...(this.chestInv || [])];
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.armorItem && HORSE_ARMOR[ITEMS[this.armorItem.id].key]) a *= 1 - HORSE_ARMOR[ITEMS[this.armorItem.id].key][1] / 25;
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r && !this.rider) this.rearT = 20;
