  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (this.baby && !this.undead && held && isFood('horse_food', held.id)) return false;
    if (p.sneaking && this.tame) {
      g.ui.open(new HorseScreen(g, this));
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'saddle' && this.tame && !this.saddled && !this.baby) {
      this.saddled = true;
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.horse.saddle', this.pos, 0.5, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k && HORSE_ARMOR[k] && this.type === 'horse' && this.tame && !this.armorItem && !this.baby) {
      this.armorItem = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.horse.armor', this.pos, 0.5, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'chest' && (this.type === 'donkey' || this.type === 'mule') && this.tame && !this.chest && !this.baby) {
      this.chest = true;
      this.chestInv = new Array(15).fill(null);
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.donkey.chest', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (held && isFood(this.type === 'zombie_horse' ? 'zombie_horse_food' : 'horse_food', held.id)) {
      // feeding: heals, makes it friendlier; golden apples and carrots let tamed ones breed
      const heal = {
        sugar: 1,
        wheat: 2,
        apple: 3,
        carrot: 3,
        golden_carrot: 4,
        golden_apple: 10,
        enchanted_golden_apple: 10,
        hay_block: 20,
        red_mushroom: 2
      }[k] || 2;
      const temper = {
        sugar: 3,
        wheat: 3,
        apple: 3,
        carrot: 3,
        golden_carrot: 5,
        golden_apple: 10,
        enchanted_golden_apple: 10
      }[k] || 0;
      let used = false;
      if (this.health < this.maxHealth) {
        this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + heal);
        used = true;
      }
      if (!this.tame && temper && this.temper < 100) {
        this.temper = Math.min(100, this.temper + temper);
        used = true;
      }
      if (this.tame && (k === 'golden_carrot' || k === 'golden_apple' || k === 'enchanted_golden_apple') && this.breedCd <= 0 && !this.loveT && !this.undead) {
        this.loveT = 600;
        used = true;
      }
      if (used) {
        useOne(g, p);
        this.sound('eat');
        this.eatT = 20;
        this.mouthT = 10;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (!this.baby && !p.vehicle && (!held || !ITEMS[held.id].spawnEgg)) {
      p.mount(this);
      p.yaw = this.yaw;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  ridden(c, inp) {
    const p = this.rider;
    if (!this.tame) {
      // breaking it in: bucks the rider off unless its temper says yes
      if (this.age % 10 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.15) {
        if (Math.random() * 100 < this.temper) {
          this.tame = true;
          this.persistent = true;
          this.owner = p;
          for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) this.game.particles.spawn('heart', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), this.pos[1] + this.h, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
        } else {
          this.temper = Math.min(100, this.temper + 5);
          p.dismount();
          this.rearT = 20;
          this.sound('angry');
        }
      }
      c.fwd = 0;
      this.limbAmt *= 0.9;
      return;
    }
    if (!this.saddled) return;
    this.yaw = p.yaw;
    this.bodyYaw = p.yaw;
    this.headYaw = 0;
    this.pitch = p.pitch * 0.5;
    c.fwd = inp.fwd > 0 ? 1 : inp.fwd < 0 ? -0.25 : 0;
    c.strafe = (inp.strafe || 0) * 0.5;
    this.riderSpeed = this.spd;
    // jump: hold to charge (the jump bar), release to leap
    if (inp.jump && this.onGround) {
      this.jumpCharge = Math.min(1, this.jumpCharge + 0.1);
      this.chargingJump = true;
    } else if (this.chargingJump) {
      this.chargingJump = false;
      if (this.onGround && this.jumpCharge > 0) {
        const pw = this.jumpCharge >= 0.9 ? 1 : 0.4 + 0.4 * this.jumpCharge / 0.9;
        this.vel[1] = this.jumpStr * pw;
        this.vel[0] += -Math.sin(this.yaw) * 0.4 * pw * (c.fwd > 0 ? 1 : 0);
        this.vel[2] += -Math.cos(this.yaw) * 0.4 * pw * (c.fwd > 0 ? 1 : 0);
        this.sound('jump', 0.4);
        this.mouthT = 10;
      }
      this.jumpCharge = 0;
    }
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.rider && this.tame && this.saddled) {
      // the rider steers: like vanilla, the horse's own speed attribute
      this.travel(c.fwd, c.strafe, this.spd * this.spd * 4.6, false);
      return;
    }
    super.moveBy(c);
  }
  afterMove() {
    if (this.eatT > 0) this.eatT--;
    if (this.rearT > 0) this.rearT--;
    if (this.mouthT > 0) this.mouthT--;
    if (!this.rider && !this.target && this.onGround && this.ctl.fwd === 0 && Math.random() < 0.002) this.eatT = 40;
  }
  get T2() {
    return this.T;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    horseAnim(md, this, a);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    if (this.type !== 'horse') return r.etex('entity/horse/' + {
      donkey: 'donkey',
      mule: 'mule',
      skeleton_horse: 'horse_skeleton',
      zombie_horse: 'horse_zombie'
    }[this.type] + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
    const b = this.baby ? '_baby' : '',
      col = HORSE_COLORS[this.variant & 7] || 'white',
      mk = HORSE_MARKS[this.variant >> 3];
    return mk ? r.etexMix(['entity/horse/horse_' + col + b, 'entity/horse/horse_markings_' + mk + b]) : r.etex('entity/horse/horse_' + col + b);
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (this.armorItem && !this.baby) {
      const am = EM.get(r, this.undead ? 'undead_horse_armor#main' : 'horse_armor#main'),
        k = HORSE_ARMOR[ITEMS[this.armorItem.id].key];
      if (am && k) {
        EM.reset(am);
        EM.copy(md, am);
        const t = r.etex('entity/equipment/horse_body/' + k[0]);
        r.drawEM(am, t, m, lt, env, {
          overlay,
          tint: k[0] === 'leather' ? dyeTintOf(this.armorItem, [160 / 255, 101 / 255, 64 / 255]) : null
        });
        if (k[0] === 'leather') r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/horse_body/leather_overlay'), m, lt, env, {
          overlay
        });
      }
    }
    if (this.saddled && !this.baby) {
      const sm = EM.get(r, this.type + '#saddle');
      if (sm) {
        EM.reset(sm);
        EM.copy(md, sm);
        const show = !!this.rider;
        for (const n of ['left_saddle_line', 'right_saddle_line']) if (sm.parts[n]) sm.parts[n].visible = show;
        r.drawEM(sm, r.etex('entity/equipment/' + this.type + '_saddle/saddle'), m, lt, env, {
          overlay
        });
      }
    }
  }
}
// the leather colour of a dyed stack (dyed_color component from the server), or the default brown
function dyeTintOf(st, def) {
  if (st && st.color != null) return [(st.color >> 16 & 255) / 255, (st.color >> 8 & 255) / 255, (st.color & 255) / 255];
  return def;
}
function horseAnim(md, e, a) {
  const P = md.parts,
    [pos, spd] = emLimbs(e, a),
    t = e.age + a;
  const eat = e.eatT > 0 ? Math.min(1, (40 - e.eatT + a) / 6, e.eatT / 6) : 0;
  const rear = e.rearT > 0 ? Math.sin(Math.min(1, (20 - e.rearT + a) / 20) * Math.PI) : 0;
  // vanilla AbstractEquineModel.setupAnim with the baby horse / baby donkey models' own numbers, from the layer's own
  // pivots: the adult's pivots were set outright (a foal's head and legs came off) and rearing barely moved the head
  const baby = md.key.includes('_baby'),
    donkey = /^(donkey|mule)/.test(md.key),
    ageScale = baby ? 0.5 : 1;
  const C = baby && donkey ? {
    stand: Math.PI / 3,
    legY: 1,
    legZ: 0.5,
    legX: 0,
    tail: -Math.PI / 4
  } : baby ? {
    stand: Math.PI / 12,
    legY: 4,
    legZ: 0,
    legX: -Math.PI / 3,
    tail: -Math.PI / 2
  } : {
    stand: Math.PI / 12,
    legY: 12,
    legZ: 4,
    legX: -Math.PI / 3,
    tail: 0
  };
  const standing = rear,
    iStanding = 1 - standing,
    feeding = e.mouthT > 0 ? 1 : 0,
    still = 1 - Math.max(standing, eat);
  const yRot = clamp(-(e.headYaw || 0), -Math.PI / 9, Math.PI / 9);
  let hx = -(e.pitch || 0);
  if (spd > 0.2) hx += Math.cos(pos * 0.8) * 0.15 * spd;
  const hp = P.head_parts;
  if (hp) {
    if (baby && donkey) {
      const bx = -Math.PI / 6;
      hp.xRot = standing * (Math.PI / 12 + bx) + eat * (Math.PI / 2 + Math.sin(t) * 0.05) + still * (Math.PI / 6 + bx + feeding * Math.sin(t) * 0.05);
    } else hp.xRot = standing * (Math.PI / 12 + hx) + eat * (2.1816616 + Math.sin(t) * 0.05) + still * (Math.PI / 6 + hx + feeding * Math.sin(t) * 0.05);
    hp.yRot = standing * yRot + still * yRot;
    if (baby && donkey) {
      hp.y = lerp(hp.y, -1.2, eat);
      hp.z = lerp(hp.z, -3.6, standing);
    } else {
      hp.y += lerp(lerp(0, baby ? -2 : -8, standing), baby ? 2 : 7, eat);
      hp.z = lerp(hp.z, -4, standing);
    }
  }
  if (P.body) P.body.xRot = standing * (-Math.PI / 4) + iStanding * P.body.xRot;
  const LF = P.left_front_leg,
    RF = P.right_front_leg,
    LH = P.left_hind_leg,
    RH = P.right_hind_leg;
  if (LF) {
    LF.y -= C.legY * standing;
    LF.z += C.legZ * standing;
    if (RF) {
      RF.y = LF.y;
      RF.z = LF.z;
    }
  }
  const legAnim1 = Math.cos((e.inWater ? 0.2 : 1) * pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI),
    legX = legAnim1 * 0.8 * spd,
    bob = Math.cos(t * 0.6 + Math.PI);
  if (LH) LH.xRot = C.stand * standing - legAnim1 * 0.5 * spd * iStanding;
  if (RH) RH.xRot = C.stand * standing + legAnim1 * 0.5 * spd * iStanding;
  if (LF) LF.xRot = (C.legX + bob) * standing + legX * iStanding;
  if (RF) RF.xRot = (C.legX - bob) * standing - legX * iStanding;
  if (baby && donkey && LH && RH) {
    LH.y = lerp(LH.y, -0.3, standing);
    RH.y = lerp(LH.y, -0.3, standing);
  }
  if (P.tail) {
    P.tail.xRot = C.tail + Math.PI / 6 + spd * 0.75;
    P.tail.y += spd * ageScale;
    P.tail.z += spd * 2 * ageScale;
    P.tail.yRot = e.tailT > 0 ? Math.cos(t * 0.7) : 0;
  }
  if (P.upper_mouth && e.mouthT > 0) P.upper_mouth.xRot = -0.2;
  if (P.left_chest) P.left_chest.visible = !!e.chest;
  if (P.right_chest) P.right_chest.visible = !!e.chest;
}
for (const t of ['horse', 'donkey', 'mule', 'skeleton_horse', 'zombie_horse']) {
  defVMob(t, {
    cls: Horse,
    food: t === 'zombie_horse' ? 'zombie_horse_food' : 'horse_food',
    babyTempt: true,
    xp: 2,
    T: {
      hostile: false,
      passive: true
    },
    sounds: t === 'horse' ? {
      ambient: 'entity.horse.ambient'
    } : null,
    shadowR: 0.75
  });
}
// the horse's screen: saddle and armour slots, a donkey or mule's chest (llamas: carpet and chest), its picture
class HorseScreen extends ContainerScreen {
  constructor(game, horse) {
    super(game, 'gui_horse', 176, 166, horse.customName || horse.T.cn);
    this.h = horse;
    const llama = horse instanceof Llama;
    if (!llama) this.slots.push({
      x: 8,
      y: 18,
      group: 'container',
      max: 1,
      emptyIcon: 'slot_saddle',
      accept: s => ITEMS[s.id].key === 'saddle',
      get: () => horse.saddled ? makeStack('saddle', 1) : null,
      set: s => {
        horse.saddled = !!s;
      }
    });
    if (horse.type === 'horse') this.slots.push({
      x: 8,
      y: 36,
      group: 'container',
      max: 1,
      emptyIcon: 'slot_horse_armor',
      accept: s => !!HORSE_ARMOR[ITEMS[s.id].key],
      get: () => horse.armorItem,
      set: s => {
        horse.armorItem = s;
      }
    });
    if (llama) this.slots.push({
      x: 8,
      y: 36,
      group: 'container',
      max: 1,
      emptyIcon: 'slot_llama_armor',
      accept: s => /_carpet$/.test(ITEMS[s.id].key),
      get: () => horse.carpet,
      set: s => {
        horse.carpet = s;
      }
    });
    this.cols = llama ? horse.strength : 5;
    if (horse.chest) for (let i = 0; i < horse.chestInv.length; i++) this.slots.push({
      x: 80 + i % this.cols * 18,
      y: 18 + Math.floor(i / this.cols) * 18,
      group: 'container',
      get: () => horse.chestInv[i],
      set: s => {
        horse.chestInv[i] = s;
      }
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
  }
  changed() {}
  stillValid() {
    if (this.h.dead || this.h.distTo(this.game.player) > 8) this.game.ui.close();
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    Font.draw(ui.ctx, '物品栏', this.x + 8, this.y + 72, '#404040', false);
    if (this.h.chest) ui.ctx.drawImage(ui.img.horse_chest_slots, 0, 0, this.cols * 18, 54, this.x + 79, this.y + 17, this.cols * 18, 54);
    for (const s of this.slots) if (s.group === 'container' && s.emptyIcon) ui.sprite('slot_frame', this.x + s.x - 1, this.y + s.y - 1);
    const pv = this.game.renderer.mobPreview(this.game, this.h, ui, this.x + 26, this.y + 18, 52, 52);
    if (pv) ui.ctx.drawImage(pv, this.x + 26, this.y + 18, 52, 52);
  }
}

// ---- camels (and camel husks): two-humped mounts that sit down and dash ------------------------------
class Camel extends Horse {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.tame = true;
    this.spd = 0.14;
    this.jumpStr = 0.42;
    this.sit = false;
    this.sitT = 0;
    this.dashCd = 0;
    this.maxHealth = this.health = this.T.hp;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      ...super.extraSave(),
      sit: this.sit
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    super.extraLoad(o);
    this.sit = !!o.sit;
  }
  seat() {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + (this.sit ? 0.6 : 1.85) * (this.baby ? 0.5 : 1), this.pos[2]];
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (held && isFood(this.D.food, held.id)) return false;
    if (k === 'saddle' && !this.saddled && !this.baby) {
      this.saddled = true;
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('saddle', 0.5, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (p.sneaking) {
      g.ui.open(new HorseScreen(g, this));
      return true;
    }
    if (!this.baby && !p.vehicle && (!held || !ITEMS[held.id].spawnEgg)) {
      if (this.sit) this.standUp();
      p.mount(this);
      p.yaw = this.yaw;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  sitDown() {
    if (this.sit) return;
    this.sit = true;
    this.anims = {
      'CAMEL_SIT': this.age
    };
    this.sitT = 40;
    this.sound('sit');
  }
  standUp() {
    if (!this.sit) return;
    this.sit = false;
    this.anims = {
      'CAMEL_STANDUP': this.age
    };
    this.sitT = 52;
    this.sound('stand');
  }
  // the dash animation ends once it lands again (vanilla: dashing stops at a cooldown below 50 on the ground); it looped on
  endDash() {
    if (this.anims.CAMEL_DASH != null && this.onGround && this.age - this.anims.CAMEL_DASH >= 5) delete this.anims.CAMEL_DASH;
  }
  think(c) {
    this.endDash();
    if (this.sitT > 0) {
      this.sitT--;
      return;
    }
    if (this.sit) {
      if (this.panic > 0 || Math.random() < 1 / 2000) this.standUp();
      return;
    }
    if (!this.target && this.panic <= 0 && !this.loveT && Math.random() < 1 / 3000) {
      this.sitDown();
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  ridden(c, inp) {
    this.endDash();
    if (this.sitT > 0) {
      this.sitT--;
      return;
    }
    if (this.sit) {
      if (inp.fwd || inp.jump) this.standUp();
      return;
    }
    if (!this.saddled) return;
    const p = this.rider;
    this.yaw = p.yaw;
    this.bodyYaw = p.yaw;
    this.headYaw = 0;
    c.fwd = inp.fwd > 0 ? inp.sprint ? 1.6 : 1 : inp.fwd < 0 ? -0.3 : 0;
    if (this.dashCd > 0) {
      this.dashCd--;
      if (this.dashCd === 0) this.sound('dash_ready');
    }
    // dash: jump while moving, then a cooldown
    if (inp.jump && this.onGround && this.dashCd <= 0 && c.fwd > 0) {
      this.vel[0] += -Math.sin(this.yaw) * 1.2;
      this.vel[2] += -Math.cos(this.yaw) * 1.2;
      this.vel[1] = 0.6;
      this.dashCd = 55;
      this.anims['CAMEL_DASH'] = this.age;
      this.sound('dash');
    }
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.rider && this.saddled) {
      if (!this.sit && this.sitT <= 0) this.travel(c.fwd, 0, this.spd * this.spd * 4.6, false);else this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
      return;
    }
    if (this.sit || this.sitT > 0) {
      this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r && this.sit) this.standUp();
    return r;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      pre = this.baby ? 'CamelBabyAnimation.CAMEL_BABY_' : 'CamelAnimation.CAMEL_';
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = clamp(-(this.headYaw || 0), -0.52, 0.52);
      P.head.xRot = clamp(-(this.pitch || 0), -0.44, 0.44);
    }
    if (!this.sit && this.sitT <= 0) EM.walk(md, pre + 'WALK', pos, spd, 2, 2.5);
    // (like vanilla's animation states: sitting down only during its 40 ticks, then the sit pose alone; standing up during
    // its 52. A finished one stayed on at its last frame - under the sit pose that doubled the drop and turned the legs over)
    for (const k in this.anims) {
      if (k === 'CAMEL_SIT' ? !(this.sit && this.sitT > 0) : k === 'CAMEL_STANDUP' ? !(!this.sit && this.sitT > 0) : false) continue;
      EM.anim(md, pre + k.slice(6), (this.age - this.anims[k] + a) / 20);
    }
    if (this.sit && this.sitT <= 0) EM.anim(md, pre + 'SIT_POSE', 0);
    if (!this.sit && this.sitT <= 0 && spd < 0.05) EM.anim(md, pre + 'IDLE', (this.age + a) / 20);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.type === 'camel_husk' ? 'entity/camel/camel_husk' : this.baby ? 'entity/camel/camel_baby' : 'entity/camel/camel');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (!this.saddled || this.baby) return;
    const sm = EM.get(r, (this.type === 'camel_husk' ? 'camel_husk' : 'camel') + '#saddle');
    if (sm) {
      EM.reset(sm);
      EM.copy(md, sm);
      if (sm.parts.reins) sm.parts.reins.visible = !!this.rider;
      r.drawEM(sm, r.etex('entity/equipment/' + this.type + '_saddle/saddle'), m, lt, env, {
        overlay
      });
    }
  }
}
defVMob('camel', {
  cls: Camel,
  food: 'camel_food',
  layer: 'camel#main',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.7
});
defVMob('camel_husk', {
  cls: Camel,
  food: 'camel_husk_food',
  layer: 'camel#main',
  xp: 5,
  T: {
    hostile: false,
    passive: true
  },
  shadowR: 0.7
});

// ---- llamas and trader llamas: carpets, chests, spit ---------------------------------------------------
const LLAMA_COLORS = ['creamy', 'white', 'brown', 'gray'];
class Llama extends Horse {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.variant = randInt(0, 3);
    this.strength = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, randInt(1, 3) + (Math.random() < 0.04 ? 2 : 0)));
    this.carpet = null;
    this.spd = 0.175;
    this.maxHealth = this.health = randInt(15, 30);
    if (type === 'trader_llama') this.tame = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      ...super.extraSave(),
      str: this.strength,
      carpet: this.carpet
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    super.extraLoad(o);
    this.strength = o.str || 3;
    this.carpet = o.carpet || null;
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.carpet, this.chest ? makeStack('chest', 1) : null, ...(this.chestInv || [])];
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (held && isFood('llama_food', held.id)) {
      let used = false;
      if (this.health < this.maxHealth) {
        this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + (k === 'hay_block' ? 10 : 2));
        used = true;
      }
      if (!this.tame && this.temper < 100) {
        this.temper = Math.min(100, this.temper + (k === 'hay_block' ? 6 : 3));
        used = true;
      }
      if (this.tame && k === 'hay_block' && this.breedCd <= 0 && !this.loveT && !this.baby) {
        this.loveT = 600;
        used = true;
      }
      if (used) {
        useOne(g, p);
        this.sound('eat');
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (p.sneaking && this.tame) {
      g.ui.open(new HorseScreen(g, this));
      return true;
    }
    if (k && /_carpet$/.test(k) && this.tame && !this.carpet && !this.baby) {
      this.carpet = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.llama.swag', this.pos, 0.5, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'chest' && this.tame && !this.chest && !this.baby) {
      this.chest = true;
      this.chestInv = new Array(3 * this.strength).fill(null);
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('chest');
      return true;
    }
    if (!this.baby && !p.vehicle && (!held || !ITEMS[held.id].spawnEgg)) {
      p.mount(this);
      p.yaw = this.yaw;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  // llamas can't be steered: a tamed one's rider just sits on it
  ridden(c, inp) {
    if (!this.tame) return super.ridden(c, inp);
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
  }
  seat() {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + (this.baby ? 0.6 : 1.2), this.pos[2]];
  }
  // spits at whatever hurt it
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    if (d > 8) c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
    if (this.attackCd <= 0 && d < 10 && this.canSee(t)) {
      this.attackCd = 40;
      spitAt(this, t);
    }
    if (this.anger <= 0) this.target = null;
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.anger <= 0)) this.target = null;
  }
  onAttacked(src) {
    this.panic = 0;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (P.right_chest) P.right_chest.visible = !!this.chest;
    if (P.left_chest) P.left_chest.visible = !!this.chest;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/llama/llama_' + LLAMA_COLORS[this.variant | 0] + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    const dec = this.type === 'trader_llama' ? 'trader_llama' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : '') : this.carpet && !this.baby ? ITEMS[this.carpet.id].key.replace(/_carpet$/, '') : null;
    if (!dec) return;
    const dm = EM.get(r, (this.baby ? 'llama_baby' : 'llama') + '#decor');
    if (dm) {
      EM.reset(dm);
      EM.copy(md, dm);
      r.drawEM(dm, r.etex('entity/equipment/llama_body/' + dec), m, lt, env, {
        overlay
      });
    }
  }
}

function shootAt(e, t, speed, o) {
  var _o$arc;
  const g = e.game,
    sx = e.pos[0] - Math.sin(e.bodyYaw) * e.w * 0.6,
    sy = e.pos[1] + e.h * (o.yk || 0.8),
    sz = e.pos[2] - Math.cos(e.bodyYaw) * e.w * 0.6;
  const dx = t.pos[0] - sx,
    dy = t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5 - sy,
    dz = t.pos[2] - sz,
    d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  const ly = dy + d * ((_o$arc = o.arc) !== null && _o$arc !== void 0 ? _o$arc : 0.2),
    l = Math.hypot(dx, ly, dz) || 1;
  const s = new MobShot(g, sx, sy, sz, [dx / l * speed, ly / l * speed, dz / l * speed], e, o);
  g.entities.push(s);

}

// ---- tameable pets: sitting, following the owner, fighting for it -------------------------------------
// (wolves, parrots; cats and ocelots keep their own code)
const PetMixin = {
  followOwner(c) {
    const o = this.owner;
    if (!o || this.sitting || o.dead || o.vehicle && this.ai !== 'fly') return false;
    const d = this.distTo(o);
    if (d > 12 && o.onGround) {
      // too far: teleport next to the owner
      for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
        const x = Math.floor(o.pos[0]) + randInt(-3, 3),
          z = Math.floor(o.pos[2]) + randInt(-3, 3),
          y = Math.floor(o.pos[1]);
        if (Math.abs(x - o.pos[0]) < 2 && Math.abs(z - o.pos[2]) < 2) continue;
        if (BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)].solid && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].solid && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)].solid) {
          this.pos = [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5];
          this.savePrev();
          this.goal = null;
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    if (d > (this.ai === 'fly' ? 4 : 6)) {
      c.goal = [o.pos[0], o.pos[1] + (this.ai === 'fly' ? 1 : 0), o.pos[2]];
      c.mod = 1.2;
      c.look = o;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  },
  // an owner's enemies: what attacked it, what it attacked
  huntTarget() {
    const o = this.owner;
    if (!o || this.sitting) return null;
    const t = o.lastHurtBy || o.lastAttacked;
    if (t && t !== this && !t.dead && !t.deathTime && t.distTo && t.distTo(this) < 16 && !(t.owner === o) && t.type !== 'creeper') return t;
    return null;
  }
};
// the player's last attacker / victim, for pets
(() => {
  const _h = Player.prototype.hurt;
  Player.prototype.hurt = function (a, src) {
    const r = _h.call(this, a, src);
    if (r && src && src.attacker && src.attacker !== this) {
      this.lastHurtBy = src.attacker;
      this.lastHurtT = this.age;
    }
    return r;
  };
  const _a = Game.prototype.attack;
  Game.prototype.attack = function (e, ...rest) {
    const r = _a.call(this, e, ...rest);
    if (e && e instanceof Living) this.player.lastAttacked = e;
    return r;
  };
})();
const tryTame = (e, p, chance) => {
  const g = e.game;
  if (Math.random() < chance) {
    e.owner = p;
    e.persistent = true;
    e.sitting = true;
    e.target = null;
    e.panic = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) g.particles.spawn('heart', e.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * e.w, e.pos[1] + e.h * 0.8, e.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * e.w, 0, 0.02, 0);
    if (e.onTamed) e.onTamed();
  } else for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) g.particles.spawn('smoke', e.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * e.w, e.pos[1] + e.h * 0.8, e.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * e.w, 0, 0.02, 0);
};

// ---- wolves ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const WOLF_BY_BIOME = [[/^snowy_taiga/, 'ashen'], [/old_growth_pine_taiga/, 'black'], [/old_growth_spruce_taiga/, 'chestnut'], [/sparse_jungle/, 'rusty'], [/^grove/, 'snowy'], [/savanna_plateau/, 'spotted'], [/wooded_badlands/, 'striped'], [/^forest/, 'woods'], [/taiga/, 'pale']];
class Wolf extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    const b = biomeName(g, x, z);
    this.variant = (WOLF_BY_BIOME.find(([re]) => re.test(b)) || [0, 'pale'])[1];
    this.collar = 'red';
    this.armor = null;
    this.persistent = false;
    this.beg = 0;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      collar: this.collar,
      arm: this.armor
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.collar = o.collar || 'red';
    this.armor = o.arm || null;
    if (this.owner) this.persistent = true;
  }
  get angry() {
    return !!this.target && this.anger > 0;
  }
  canBreed() {
    return !!this.owner && this.health >= this.maxHealth;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.armor && src && src.type !== 'void' && src.type !== 'drown') {
      // wolf armour takes the hit until it breaks
      const max = 64;
      this.armor.dmg = (this.armor.dmg || 0) + Math.max(1, Math.round(a));
      if (this.armor.dmg >= max) {
        this.armor = null;
        Sound.ev('item.wolf_armor.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
      } else Sound.ev('item.wolf_armor.damage', this.pos, 1, 1);
      this.hurtTime = 10;
      return true;
    }
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r && src && src.attacker && !this.owner) for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof Wolf && !e.owner && e !== this && e.distTo(this) < 12) {
      e.target = src.attacker;
      e.anger = 400;
    }
    return r;
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.armor];
  }
  huntTarget() {
    const t = PetMixin.huntTarget.call(this);
    if (t) {
      this.anger = 400;
      return t;
    }
    // wild wolves hunt sheep, rabbits, foxes, baby turtles and skeletons
    if (!this.owner && (this.age + this.id) % 40 === 0) {
      const prey = this.game.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && (e.type === 'sheep' || e.type === 'rabbit' || e.type === 'fox' || e.type === 'skeleton' || e.type === 'stray' || e.type === 'turtle' && e.baby) && e.distTo(this) < 10);
      if (prey && Math.random() < 0.3) {
        this.anger = 300;
        return prey;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.anger <= 0 || this.target === this.owner)) this.target = null;
    if (!this.target && this.huntTarget) this.target = this.huntTarget();
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (this.owner === p) {
      if (k && /_dye$/.test(k)) {
        this.collar = k.replace(/_dye$/, '');
        useOne(g, p);
        return true;
      }
      if (k === 'wolf_armor' && !this.armor && !this.baby) {
        this.armor = {
          ...held,
          count: 1
        };
        useOne(g, p);
        Sound.ev('item.armor.equip_wolf', this.pos, 1, 1);
        return true;
      }
      if (k === 'shears' && this.armor) {
        g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], this.armor);
        this.armor = null;
        Sound.ev('item.armor.unequip_wolf', this.pos, 1, 1);
        return true;
      }
      if (k === 'armadillo_scute' && this.armor && this.armor.dmg) {
        this.armor.dmg = Math.max(0, this.armor.dmg - 16);
        useOne(g, p);
        Sound.ev('item.wolf_armor.repair', this.pos, 1, 1);
        return true;
      }
      if (held && isFood('wolf_food', held.id) && this.health < this.maxHealth) {
        this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + (ITEMS[held.id].food ? ITEMS[held.id].food[0] : 2));
        useOne(g, p);
        this.sound('eat');
        return true;
      }
      if (!held || !isFood('wolf_food', held.id)) {
        this.sitting = !this.sitting;
        this.target = null;
        this.goal = null;
        return true;
      }
    } else if (!this.owner && k === 'bone' && !this.angry) {
      useOne(g, p);
      tryTame(this, p, 1 / 3);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      t = this.age + a;
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (P.head && this.beg > 0) P.head.zRot = 0.4 * this.beg;
    if (this.sitting) {
      // vanilla WolfModel.setSittingPose: offsets from the model's own pivots times the age scale (0.5 on the baby model;
      // the adult's pivots set outright pulled the baby model apart), AdultWolfModel's upper body, BabyWolfModel's body
      const k = md.key.includes('_baby') ? 0.5 : 1;
      if (P.body) {
        P.body.y += 4 * k;
        P.body.z -= 2 * k;
        P.body.xRot = Math.PI / 4 - (P.upper_body ? 0 : Math.PI / 2);
      }
      if (P.tail) {
        P.tail.y += 9 * k;
        P.tail.z -= 2 * k;
      }
      for (const n of ['right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg']) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].xRot = 3 * Math.PI / 2;
        P[n].y += 6.7 * k;
        P[n].z -= 5 * k;
      }
      for (const n of ['right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg']) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].xRot = 5.811947;
        P[n].y += 1 * k;
      }
      if (P.right_front_leg) P.right_front_leg.x += 0.01 * k;
      if (P.left_front_leg) P.left_front_leg.x -= 0.01 * k;
      if (P.upper_body) {
        P.upper_body.y += 2;
        P.upper_body.xRot = 2 * Math.PI / 5;
        P.upper_body.yRot = 0;
      }
    } else emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (P.tail) P.tail.xRot = this.angry ? 1.5393804 : this.owner ? (0.55 - (this.maxHealth - this.health) * 0.02) * Math.PI : 0.62831855;
    if (P.tail && !this.sitting) P.tail.yRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    const b = this.baby ? '_baby' : '',
      base = 'entity/wolf/wolf' + (this.variant === 'pale' ? '' : '_' + this.variant) + (this.owner ? '_tame' : this.angry ? '_angry' : '');
    if (!this.owner) return r.etex(base + b);
    return r.etexMix([base + b, {
      p: 'entity/wolf/wolf_collar' + b,
      c: dyeRGB(this.collar)
    }]);
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (!this.armor || this.baby) return;
    const am = EM.get(r, 'wolf_armor#main');
    if (!am) return;
    EM.reset(am);
    EM.copy(md, am);
    r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/wolf_body/armadillo_scute'), m, lt, env, {
      overlay
    });
    if (this.armor.color != null) r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/wolf_body/armadillo_scute_overlay'), m, lt, env, {
      overlay,
      tint: dyeTintOf(this.armor)
    });
    const cr = (this.armor.dmg || 0) / 64;
    if (cr > 0.25) r.drawEMOver(am, r.etex('entity/wolf/wolf_armor_crackiness_' + (cr > 0.75 ? 'high' : cr > 0.5 ? 'medium' : 'low')), m, lt, env, {});
  }
}

// ---- foxes: sleep by day, pounce, carry things in their mouths -------------------------------------------
class Fox extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.variant = /snowy|frozen|grove|ice/.test(biomeName(g, x, z)) ? 'snow' : 'red';
    this.mouth = Math.random() < 0.2 ? makeStack(pickW([['emerald', 5], ['rabbit_foot', 10], ['rabbit_hide', 10], ['egg', 15], ['wheat', 20], ['leather', 20], ['feather', 20]]), 1) : null;
    this.sleeping = false;
    this.crouch = 0;
    this.trusts = null;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      var: this.variant,
      mouth: this.mouth,
      trust: this.trusts ? 1 : 0
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.variant = o.var || 'red';
    this.mouth = o.mouth || null;
    if (o.trust) this.trusts = this.game.player;
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.mouth];
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  avoid(c) {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (this.trusts === p || p.sneaking || p.creative) return false;
    if (this.distTo(p) < 8) {
      this.sleeping = false;
      const dx = this.pos[0] - p.pos[0],
        dz = this.pos[2] - p.pos[2],
        d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx / d * 6, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + dz / d * 6];
      c.mod = 1.6;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (g.isDay() && !this.target && this.panic <= 0 && this.world.skyAt(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1] + 1), Math.floor(this.pos[2])) < 15 + 1 && Math.random() < 0.01) this.sleeping = true;
    if (!g.isDay() || this.panic > 0 || this.target) this.sleeping = false;
    if (this.sleeping) return;
    // hunting chickens, rabbits, fish
    if (!this.target && (this.age + this.id) % 60 === 0) {
      const prey = g.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && (e.type === 'chicken' || e.type === 'rabbit' || e.type === 'cod' || e.type === 'salmon' || e.type === 'tropical_fish' || e.type === 'turtle' && e.baby) && e.distTo(this) < 10);
      if (prey && Math.random() < 0.3) {
        this.target = prey;
        this.anger = 200;
      }
    }
    // pick up food or items lying near
    if (!this.mouth && this.age % 20 === 0) {
      const it = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof ItemEntity && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 1.5);
      if (it) {
        this.mouth = {
          ...it.stack,
          count: 1
        };
        it.stack.count--;
        if (!it.stack.count) it.dead = true;
      }
    }
    if (this.mouth && ITEMS[this.mouth.id].food && this.health < this.maxHealth && Math.random() < 0.01) {
      this.mouth = null;
      this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 4);
      this.sound('eat');
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.anger <= 0)) this.target = null;
  }
  fight(c) {
    const t = this.target,
      d = this.distTo(t);
    // pounce from a few blocks away
    if (d < 5 && d > 2 && this.onGround && this.crouch === 0) this.crouch = 20;
    if (this.crouch > 0) {
      this.crouch--;
      c.look = t;
      if (this.crouch === 1) {
        const dx = t.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
          dz = t.pos[2] - this.pos[2],
          l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        this.vel[0] = dx / l * 0.6;
        this.vel[2] = dz / l * 0.6;
        this.vel[1] = 0.6;
        this.sound('bite');
      }
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.fight.call(this, c);
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    this.sleeping = false;
    return super.hurt(a, src);
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && isFood('fox_food', held.id) && !this.trusts && this.loveT > 0) this.trusts = p;
    return false;
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    const b = super.spawnChild(m);
    b.variant = Math.random() < 0.5 ? this.variant : m.variant;
    b.trusts = this.game.player;
    return b;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    if (this.sleeping) {
      if (P.body) {
        P.body.zRot = -Math.PI / 2;
        P.body.y = 21;
      }
      if (P.head) {
        P.head.x = 1;
        P.head.y = 19.49;
        P.head.zRot = -2.0943952;
        P.head.yRot = 0;
        P.head.xRot = 0;
      }
      if (P.tail) {
        P.tail.x = -1;
        P.tail.y = 4;
        P.tail.z = -1;
        P.tail.xRot = -2.1816616;
      }
      for (const n of ['right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg', 'right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg']) if (P[n]) P[n].visible = false;
      return;
    }
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (this.crouch > 0 && P.body) {
      P.body.y += 2;
      if (P.head) P.head.y += 2;
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/fox/fox' + (this.variant === 'snow' ? '_snow' : '') + (this.sleeping ? '_sleep' : '') + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    if (!this.mouth || this.sleeping) return null;
    const st = this.mouth;
    return {
      head: am => {
        M4.translate(am, 1 / 16, 1.5 / 16, -0.4);
        M4.rotX(am, -Math.PI / 2);
        M4.scale(am, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75);
        g.drawGroundItem ? g.drawGroundItem(am, st, lt, env) : g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null);
      }
    };
  }
}
defVMob('fox', {
  cls: Fox,
  food: 'fox_food',
  xp: 2,
  T: {
    attack: 2
  },
  shadowR: 0.4
});

// ---- goats: high jumps, ramming, milk and horns ---------------------------------------------------------
class Goat extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.screaming = Math.random() < 0.02;
    this.horns = [true, true];
    this.ramT = 0;
    this.ramCd = 600 + randInt(0, 1200);
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      scr: this.screaming,
      horns: this.horns
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.screaming = !!o.scr;
    this.horns = o.horns || [true, true];
  }
  sound(kind, v, p) {
    super.sound(kind, v, p);
  }
  ambientKind() {
    return this.screaming ? 'screaming.ambient' : 'ambient';
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.ramCd > 0) this.ramCd--;
    if (this.ramT > 0) {
      // the charge: lower the head, run at the target; a solid block knocks a horn off
      this.ramT--;
      const t = this.ramTarget;
      if (this.ramT > 20) {
        c.look = t;
        c.face = Math.atan2(-(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0]), -(t.pos[2] - this.pos[2]));
        return;
      }
      c.fwd = 1;
      c.mod = 3;
      if (t && !t.dead && this.distTo(t) < 1.5) {
        t.hurt(this.baby ? 1 : 2, {
          type: 'mob',
          attacker: this,
          knockFrom: this.pos,
          knock: 1.6
        });
        t.vel[1] = 0.4;
        this.sound(this.screaming ? 'screaming.ram_impact' : 'ram_impact');
        this.ramT = 0;
      } else if (this.collidedH) {
        this.ramT = 0;
        this.sound(this.screaming ? 'screaming.ram_impact' : 'ram_impact');
        const i = this.horns[0] ? 0 : this.horns[1] ? 1 : -1;
        if (i >= 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
          this.horns[i] = false;
          this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1, this.pos[2], makeStack('goat_horn', 1));
          this.sound('horn_break');
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.ramCd <= 0 && !this.baby) {
      const p = this.game.player,
        t = !p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 12 && this.canSee(p) ? p : this.game.entities.find(e => e instanceof Mob && e !== this && e.type !== 'goat' && e.distTo(this) < 12 && !e.dead);
      if (t) {
        this.ramTarget = t;
        this.ramT = 60;
        this.ramCd = this.screaming ? 100 + randInt(0, 200) : 600 + randInt(0, 1200);
        this.sound(this.screaming ? 'screaming.prepare_ram' : 'prepare_ram');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (this.onGround && Math.random() < 0.003 && !this.target) {
      this.vel[1] = 0.8;
      this.vel[0] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
      this.vel[2] += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
      this.sound(this.screaming ? 'screaming.long_jump' : 'long_jump');
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'bucket' && !this.baby) {
      swapHeld(this.game, p, 'milk_bucket');
      this.sound(this.screaming ? 'screaming.milk' : 'milk');
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (P.head && this.ramT > 0) P.head.xRot = this.ramT > 20 ? Math.min(1, (60 - this.ramT) / 10) * 0.6 : 0.6;
    if (P.left_horn) P.left_horn.visible = this.horns[0] && !this.baby;
    if (P.right_horn) P.right_horn.visible = this.horns[1] && !this.baby;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/goat/goat' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
}
defVMob('goat', {
  cls: Goat,
  food: 'goat_food',
  xp: 2,
  jump: 0.5,
  fearless: true,
  shadowR: 0.45
});

// ---- pandas: genes, bamboo, rolling and sneezing --------------------------------------------------------
const PANDA_GENES = [['normal', 15], ['lazy', 1], ['worried', 1], ['playful', 1], ['brown', 1], ['weak', 1], ['aggressive', 1]];
class Panda extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.main = pickW(PANDA_GENES);
    this.hidden = pickW(PANDA_GENES);
    this.sit = 0;
    this.rollT = 0;
    this.sneezeT = 0;
    this.eatT = 0;
    this.holding = null;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      m: this.main,
      h: this.hidden
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.main = o.m || 'normal';
    this.hidden = o.h || 'normal';
  }
  get gene() {
    const m = this.main,
      h = this.hidden;
    if ((m === 'brown' || m === 'weak') && m !== h) return 'normal';
    return m;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  fight(c) {
    if (this.gene !== 'aggressive' && !this.attacked) {
      this.target = null;
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.fight.call(this, c);
  }
  onAttacked() {
    this.attacked = true;
    if (this.gene !== 'aggressive') {
      this.target = null;
      this.panic = 60;
    }
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.rollT > 0) {
      this.rollT--;
      c.fwd = 1;
      return;
    }
    if (this.sit > 0) {
      this.sit--;
      if (this.eatT > 0 && --this.eatT === 0) {
        this.holding = null;
        this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 2);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.gene === 'playful' && this.onGround && Math.random() < 1 / 500) {
      this.rollT = 32;
      this.sound('pre_sneeze');
      return;
    }
    if (this.baby && (this.gene === 'weak' || Math.random() < 1 / 6000) && Math.random() < 1 / 300) {
      this.sneezeT = 20;
      this.sound('pre_sneeze');
    }
    if (this.sneezeT > 0 && --this.sneezeT === 0) {
      this.sound('sneeze');
      if (Math.random() < 1 / 700 * 7) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], makeStack('slime_ball', 1));
      for (const e of g.entities) if (e instanceof Panda && e !== this && e.distTo(this) < 10 && e.onGround) e.vel[1] = 0.4;
    }
    // eat bamboo lying around
    if (!this.holding && this.age % 20 === 0) {
      const it = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof ItemEntity && !e.dead && ITEMS[e.stack.id].key === 'bamboo' && e.distTo(this) < 6);
      if (it) {
        if (it.distTo(this) < 1.5) {
          this.holding = {
            ...it.stack,
            count: 1
          };
          it.stack.count--;
          if (!it.stack.count) it.dead = true;
          this.sit = 200;
          this.eatT = 200;
          this.sound('eat');
          return;
        }
        c.goal = [...it.pos];
        return;
      }
    }
    if (this.gene === 'lazy' && Math.random() < 1 / 400) {
      this.sit = 200;
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (this.sit > 0 && P.body) {
      P.body.xRot = 0.9;
      P.body.y = 14;
      P.body.z = 2;
      if (P.head) {
        P.head.y = 5;
        P.head.z = -6;
      }
      for (const n of ['right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg']) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].xRot = -0.6 + (this.eatT > 0 ? Math.sin((this.age + a) * 0.6) * 0.3 : 0);
        P[n].y = 9;
        P[n].z = -4;
      }
      for (const n of ['right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg']) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].xRot = -1.4;
        P[n].y = 21;
        P[n].z = 6;
      }
    }
    if (this.sneezeT > 0 && P.head) P.head.xRot = -0.6 * (1 - this.sneezeT / 20);
  }
  preDraw(m, a) {
    if (this.rollT > 0) {
      M4.translate(m, 0, 0.6, 0);
      M4.rotX(m, -((32 - this.rollT + a) / 32) * Math.PI * 2);
      M4.translate(m, 0, -0.6, 0);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    const ge = this.gene,
      b = this.baby;
    return r.etex(ge === 'normal' ? b ? 'entity/panda/panda_baby' : 'entity/panda/panda' : b ? 'entity/panda/' + ge + '_panda_baby' : 'entity/panda/panda_' + ge);
  }
  inheritFrom(b, m) {
    b.main = Math.random() < 0.5 ? this.main : this.hidden;
    b.hidden = Math.random() < 0.5 ? m.main : m.hidden;
    if (Math.random() < 1 / 32) b.main = pickW(PANDA_GENES);
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    if (!this.holding) return null;
    const st = this.holding;
    return {
      head: am => {
        M4.translate(am, 0, 0.3, -0.5);
        M4.rotX(am, -Math.PI / 2);
        g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null);
      }
    };
  }
}
defVMob('panda', {
  cls: Panda,
  food: 'panda_food',
  xp: 2,
  T: {
    attack: 6
  },
  shadowR: 0.8
});

// ---- polar bears: protective mothers -------------------------------------------------------------------
class PolarBear extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.stand = 0;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  findTarget() {
    super.findTarget();
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (!this.target && !this.baby && !p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 8 && this.game.entities.some(e => e instanceof PolarBear && e.baby && e.distTo(this) < 10)) {
      this.target = p;
      this.anger = 200;
    }
    if (this.target === p && this.anger <= 0 && !this.game.entities.some(e => e instanceof PolarBear && e.baby && e.distTo(this) < 10)) this.target = null;
  }
  onAttacked(src) {
    if (this.baby) {
      this.target = null;
      this.panic = 60;
      for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof PolarBear && !e.baby && e.distTo(this) < 16) {
        e.target = src.attacker;
        e.anger = 400;
      }
    }
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    this.stand = 20;
    this.sound('warning');
  }
  afterMove() {
    if (this.stand > 0) this.stand--;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    const s = this.stand > 0 ? Math.sin(Math.min(1, (20 - this.stand + a) / 10) * Math.PI / 2) * (this.stand / 20) : 0;
    if (s > 0 && P.body) {
      P.body.xRot = Math.PI / 2 - s * Math.PI * 0.35;
      P.body.y -= s * 9;
      if (P.head) {
        P.head.y -= s * 24;
        P.head.z += s * 13;
      }
      for (const n of ['right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg']) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].y -= s * 20;
        P[n].z += s * 4;
        P[n].xRot -= s * Math.PI * 0.45;
      }
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/bear/polarbear' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
}
defVMob('polar_bear', {
  cls: PolarBear,
  xp: 2,
  fights: true,
  shadowR: 0.7
});

// blocks with a random tick of their own (eggs hatching, frogspawn, dried ghasts): key -> fn(game, x, y, z, id, meta)
const BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK = {};
(() => {
  const _rt = Game.prototype.onRandomTick;
  Game.prototype.onRandomTick = function (x, y, z, id, ch) {
    const f = BLOCKS[id] && BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK[BLOCKS[id].key];
    if (f) {
      f(this, x, y, z, id, this.world.getMeta(x, y, z));
      return;
    }
    return _rt.call(this, x, y, z, id, ch);
  };
})();
const bprop = (w, x, y, z, k) => {
  const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  return Features.propOf(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), k);
};
const bsetProp = (w, x, y, z, k, v) => {
  const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, Features.withProp(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), k, v));
};
function spawnAt(g, type, x, y, z, baby) {
  const m = createMob(g, type, x, y, z);
  if (baby && m.makeBaby) m.makeBaby();
  m.persistent = true;
  g.entities.push(m);
  return m;
}

// ---- rabbits: hop everywhere, raid carrot farms ----------------------------------------------------------
class Rabbit extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    const b = biomeName(g, x, z),
      r = Math.random() * 100;
    this.variant = /desert/.test(b) ? 'gold' : /snowy|frozen|ice|grove|jagged/.test(b) ? r < 80 ? 'white' : 'white_splotched' : r < 50 ? 'brown' : r < 90 ? 'salt' : 'black';
    this.hopT = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      var: this.variant
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.variant = o.var || 'brown';
  }
  avoid(c) {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (p.creative || p.sneaking || this.distTo(p) > 8 || p.inv.held && isFood('rabbit_food', p.inv.held.id)) return false;
    const dx = this.pos[0] - p.pos[0],
      dz = this.pos[2] - p.pos[2],
      d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx / d * 6, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + dz / d * 6];
    c.mod = 2.2;
    return true;
  }
  idle(c) {
    // nibble ripe carrots (vanilla RaidGardenGoal: only with mob_griefing)
    if (this.age % 40 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.1 && this.game.rule('mob_griefing') !== false) {
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]),
        id = this.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
      if (BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].key === 'carrots') {
        const ag = +(Features.propOf(id, this.world.getMeta(x, y, z), 'age') || 0);
        if (ag > 0) bsetProp(this.world, x, y, z, 'age', ag - 1);else this.world.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.hopT > 0) this.hopT--;
    if ((c.goal || c.fwd) && this.onGround && this.hopT <= 0) {
      this.vel[1] = 0.5;
      this.hopT = 10;
      this.anims.HOP = this.age;
      this.sound('jump', 0.4);
    }
    if (!this.onGround || c.goal && this.hopT > 6) VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);else {
      c.goal = null;
      c.fwd = 0;
      VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
    }
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts;
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = 0.39 - (this.pitch || 0);
    }
    const pre = this.baby ? 'BabyRabbitAnimation.' : 'RabbitAnimation.';
    if (this.anims.HOP != null) EM.anim(md, pre + 'HOP', (this.age - this.anims.HOP + a) / 20);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    const n = this.customName === 'Toast' ? 'toast' : this.variant === 'evil' ? 'caerbannog' : this.variant;
    return r.etex('entity/rabbit/rabbit_' + n + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    const b = super.spawnChild(m);
    b.variant = Math.random() < 0.5 ? this.variant : m.variant;
    return b;
  }
}
defVMob('rabbit', {
  cls: Rabbit,
  food: 'rabbit_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.3,
  stepSound: false
});

// ---- ocelots: shy jungle cats --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Ocelot extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.trusting = false;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      trust: this.trusting
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.trusting = !!o.trust;
    if (this.trusting) this.persistent = true;
  }
  canBreed() {
    return this.trusting;
  }
  avoid(c) {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (this.trusting || p.creative || this.distTo(p) > 10) return false;
    if (p.inv.held && isFood('ocelot_food', p.inv.held.id) && (p.sneaking || Math.hypot(p.vel[0], p.vel[2]) < 0.05)) return false;
    const dx = this.pos[0] - p.pos[0],
      dz = this.pos[2] - p.pos[2],
      d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx / d * 8, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + dz / d * 8];
    c.mod = 1.6;
    return true;
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 60) return null;
    const prey = this.game.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && (e.type === 'chicken' || e.type === 'turtle' && e.baby) && e.distTo(this) < 10);
    if (prey) {
      this.anger = 200;
      return prey;
    }
    return null;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    if (!this.trusting && held && isFood('ocelot_food', held.id)) {
      useOne(this.game, p);
      this.sound('eat');
      if (Math.random() < 1 / 3) {
        this.trusting = true;
        this.persistent = true;
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) this.game.particles.spawn('heart', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), this.pos[1] + 0.6, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
      } else for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) this.game.particles.spawn('smoke', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), this.pos[1] + 0.6, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (P.tail2) P.tail2.xRot = 1.7278761 + Math.PI / 4 * Math.cos(pos) * spd;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/cat/ocelot');
  }
}
defVMob('ocelot', {
  cls: Ocelot,
  food: 'ocelot_food',
  xp: 2,
  scale: 1,
  shadowR: 0.4,
  T: {
    attack: 3
  },
  stepSound: false
});

// ---- mooshrooms: shear for mushrooms, bowl for stew, milk -----------------------------------------------
const STEW_FLOWERS = {
  dandelion: ['saturation', 7],
  poppy: ['night_vision', 100],
  blue_orchid: ['saturation', 7],
  allium: ['fire_resistance', 80],
  azure_bluet: ['blindness', 160],
  red_tulip: ['weakness', 180],
  orange_tulip: ['weakness', 180],
  white_tulip: ['weakness', 180],
  pink_tulip: ['weakness', 180],
  oxeye_daisy: ['regeneration', 160],
  cornflower: ['jump_boost', 120],
  lily_of_the_valley: ['poison', 240],
  wither_rose: ['wither', 160],
  torchflower: ['night_vision', 100],
  open_eyeblossom: ['blindness', 220],
  closed_eyeblossom: ['nausea', 140],
  cactus_flower: ['nausea', 140],
  golden_dandelion: ['saturation', 7]
};
class Mooshroom extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.variant = 'red';
    this.stew = null;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      var: this.variant,
      stew: this.stew
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.variant = o.var || 'red';
    this.stew = o.stew || null;
  }
  compVal(k) {
    return k === 'mooshroom/variant' ? this.variant : undefined;
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (k === 'shears' && !this.baby) {
      // sheared: becomes a cow, five mushrooms drop
      const cow = createMob(g, 'cow', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2]);
      cow.yaw = cow.bodyYaw = this.bodyYaw;
      cow.health = this.health;
      cow.persistent = true;
      if (this.customName) cow.customName = this.customName;
      g.entities.push(cow);
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.mooshroom.shear', this.pos, 1, 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h, this.pos[2], makeStack(this.variant + '_mushroom', 1));
      particleBurst(g, 'explosion', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], 1, 0.2);
      Sound.ev('entity.mooshroom.shear', this.pos, 1, 1);
      g.damageHeld(1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'bowl' && !this.baby) {
      if (this.stew) {
        swapHeld(g, p, 'suspicious_stew', {
          stew: this.stew
        });
        this.stew = null;
        Sound.ev('entity.mooshroom.suspicious_milk', this.pos, 1, 1);
      } else {
        swapHeld(g, p, 'mushroom_stew');
        Sound.ev('entity.mooshroom.milk', this.pos, 1, 1);
      }
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'bucket' && !this.baby) {
      swapHeld(g, p, 'milk_bucket');
      Sound.ev('entity.cow.milk', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k && STEW_FLOWERS[k] && this.variant === 'brown' && !this.stew) {
      this.stew = STEW_FLOWERS[k];
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.mooshroom.eat', this.pos, 1, 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) g.particles.spawn('smoke', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h, this.pos[2], 0, 0.05, 0);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    const b = super.spawnChild(m);
    b.variant = this.variant === m.variant ? Math.random() < 1 / 1024 ? this.variant === 'red' ? 'brown' : 'red' : this.variant : Math.random() < 0.5 ? this.variant : m.variant;
    return b;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/cow/mooshroom_' + this.variant + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (this.baby || !g.blockMesh) return;
    const id = BID[this.variant + '_mushroom'];
    if (id === undefined) return;
    const mesh = g.blockMesh(id, 0);
    // two mushrooms on the back, one on the head (vanilla's mushroom layer)
    const D = Math.PI / 180;
    const draw = (steps, head) => {
      const mm = M4.copy(m);
      M4.scale(mm, -1, -1, 1);
      M4.translate(mm, 0, -1.501, 0);
      if (head) {
        M4.translate(mm, head.x / 16, head.y / 16, head.z / 16);
        if (head.zRot) M4.rotZ(mm, head.zRot);
        if (head.yRot) M4.rotY(mm, head.yRot);
        if (head.xRot) M4.rotX(mm, head.xRot);
      }
      for (const [t, v] of steps) if (t === 't') M4.translate(mm, v[0], v[1], v[2]);else M4.rotY(mm, v * D);
      M4.scale(mm, -1, -1, 1);
      M4.translate(mm, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5);
      r.drawMesh(mesh, mm, env, lt);
    };
    draw([['t', [0.2, -0.35, 0.5]], ['r', -48]]);
    draw([['t', [0.2, -0.35, 0.5]], ['r', 42], ['t', [0.1, 0, -0.6]], ['r', -48]]);
    if (md.parts.head) draw([['t', [0, -0.7, -0.2]], ['r', -78]], md.parts.head);
  }
}
defVMob('mooshroom', {
  cls: Mooshroom,
  food: 'cow_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.7
});

// ---- armadillos: roll up when scared, shed scutes, brushed for scutes ---------------------------------------
class Armadillo extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.st = 'idle';
    this.stT = 0;
    this.shedT = 6000 + randInt(0, 6000);
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      st: this.st
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    if (o.st === 'scared') this.st = 'scared';
  }
  get pre() {
    return this.baby ? 'BabyArmadilloAnimation.ARMADILLO_BABY_' : 'ArmadilloAnimation.ARMADILLO_';
  }
  threatened() {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (this.lastHurtT && this.age - this.lastHurtT < 100) return true;
    if (!p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 7 && (p.sprinting || p.vehicle || p.flying)) return true;
    // (the distance before the list of undead, squared and in a plain loop: each tick it ran the 17-name list for every
    // mob of the world - with a few armadillos among ~120 mobs 2-3% of the game tick, 2026-11-04)
    const x = this.pos[0],
      y = this.pos[1],
      z = this.pos[2];
    for (const e of this.game.entities) {
      if (e === this || !(e instanceof Mob)) continue;
      const dx = e.pos[0] - x,
        dy = e.pos[1] - y,
        dz = e.pos[2] - z;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 49 && ENTITY_TAGS.undead.includes(e.type)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  roll(st) {
    this.st = st;
    this.stT = 0;
    this.anims = {
      [st]: this.age
    };
  }
  think(c) {
    this.stT++;
    if (--this.shedT <= 0 && !this.baby) {
      this.shedT = 6000 + randInt(0, 6000);
      for (const st of rollLoot('gameplay/armadillo_shed', {
        e: this
      })) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], st);
      this.sound('scute_drop');
    }
    const t = this.threatened();
    if (this.st === 'idle' && t) {
      this.roll('rolling');
      this.sound('roll');
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'rolling') {
      if (this.stT > 10) this.st = 'scared';
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'scared') {
      if (!t && this.stT > 100 && Math.random() < 0.02) {
        this.roll('unrolling');
        this.sound('unroll_start');
      }
      if (this.stT % 50 === 0 && !t) this.anims.peek = this.age;
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'unrolling') {
      if (t) {
        this.roll('rolling');
        return;
      }
      if (this.stT > 30) {
        this.st = 'idle';
        this.anims = {};
        this.sound('unroll_finish');
      }
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.st === 'scared') a = Math.max(0, (a - 1) / 2);
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r) {
      this.lastHurtT = this.age;
      this.panic = 0;
    }
    return r;
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'brush' && !this.baby) {
      this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], makeStack('armadillo_scute', 1));
      this.sound('brush');
      this.game.damageHeld(16);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      rolled = this.st === 'scared';
    if (P.cube) P.cube.visible = rolled;
    for (const n of ['body', 'right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg', 'right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg']) if (P[n]) P[n].visible = !rolled;
    if (this.st === 'idle') {
      if (P.head) {
        P.head.yRot = clamp(-(this.headYaw || 0), -0.55, 0.55);
        P.head.xRot = clamp(-(this.pitch || 0), -0.4, 0.4);
      }
      EM.walk(md, this.pre + 'WALK', pos, spd, 16.5, 2.5);
    } else if (this.st === 'rolling') EM.anim(md, this.pre + 'ROLL_UP', (this.stT + a) / 20);else if (this.st === 'unrolling') EM.anim(md, this.pre + 'ROLL_OUT', (this.stT + a) / 20);else if (this.anims.peek != null) {
      if (P.cube) P.cube.visible = false;
      for (const n of ['body']) if (P[n]) P[n].visible = true;
      EM.anim(md, this.pre + 'PEEK', (this.age - this.anims.peek + a) / 20);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/armadillo/armadillo' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
}
defVMob('armadillo', {
  cls: Armadillo,
  food: 'armadillo_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.4,
  stepSound: false
});

// ---- sniffers: sniff out and dig up ancient seeds; their eggs hatch into snifflets ------------------------------
class Sniffer extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.st = 'idle';
    this.stT = 0;
    this.digCd = 0;
  }
  get pre() {
    return 'SnifferAnimation.SNIFFER_';
  }
  think(c) {
    this.stT++;
    if (this.digCd > 0) this.digCd--;
    if (this.st === 'sniff') {
      if (this.stT > 60) {
        this.st = this.canDig() ? 'dig' : 'idle';
        this.stT = 0;
        if (this.st === 'dig') this.sound('digging');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'dig') {
      if (this.stT === 100) {
        const x = this.pos[0] - Math.sin(this.bodyYaw) * 2.2,
          z = this.pos[2] - Math.cos(this.bodyYaw) * 2.2;
        for (const st of rollLoot('gameplay/sniffer_digging', {
          e: this
        })) this.game.dropItem(x, this.pos[1] + 0.2, z, st);
        this.sound('drop_seed');
      }
      if (this.stT > 160) {
        this.st = 'idle';
        this.stT = 0;
        this.digCd = 4800;
        this.sound('digging_stop');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'idle' && !this.baby && this.digCd <= 0 && this.panic <= 0 && !this.loveT && Math.random() < 1 / 400) {
      this.st = 'sniff';
      this.stT = 0;
      this.sound('scenting');
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'idle' && Math.random() < 1 / 600) {
      this.anims.SNIFFSNIFF = this.age;
      this.sound('sniffing');
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  canDig() {
    const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0] - Math.sin(this.bodyYaw) * 2.2),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2] - Math.cos(this.bodyYaw) * 2.2),
      y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]) - 1;
    const k = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].key;
    return /^(dirt|grass_block|podzol|coarse_dirt|rooted_dirt|moss_block|pale_moss_block|mud|muddy_mangrove_roots)$/.test(k);
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    // sniffers lay an egg instead of having a baby
    const g = this.game,
      x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    if (BID.sniffer_egg !== undefined && this.world.getBlock(x, y, z) === 0) {
      this.world.setBlock(x, y, z, BID.sniffer_egg, 0);
      Sound.ev('block.sniffer_egg.plop', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
    g.dropXp(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], randInt(1, 7));
    return null;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = clamp(-(this.headYaw || 0), -0.5, 0.5);
      P.head.xRot = clamp(-(this.pitch || 0), -0.3, 0.3);
    }
    if (this.st === 'sniff') EM.anim(md, this.pre + 'SNIFF_SEARCH', (this.stT + a) / 20);else if (this.st === 'dig') EM.anim(md, this.pre + 'DIG', (this.stT + a) / 20);else {
      EM.walk(md, this.pre + 'WALK', pos, spd, 9, 100);
      if (this.anims.SNIFFSNIFF != null) EM.anim(md, this.pre + 'SNIFFSNIFF', (this.age - this.anims.SNIFFSNIFF + a) / 20);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.baby ? 'entity/sniffer/snifflet' : 'entity/sniffer/sniffer');
  }
}
defVMob('sniffer', {
  cls: Sniffer,
  food: 'sniffer_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 1.4,
  turn: 0.15
});
BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK.sniffer_egg = (g, x, y, z, id, m) => {
  const w = g.world,
    h = +(Features.propOf(id, m, 'hatch') || 0),
    moss = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)].key === 'moss_block';
  if (Math.random() > (moss ? 0.5 : 0.25)) return;
  if (h < 2) {
    bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'hatch', String(h + 1));
    Sound.ev('block.sniffer_egg.crack', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
    return;
  }
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
  Sound.ev('block.sniffer_egg.hatch', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
  spawnAt(g, 'sniffer', x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5, true);
};

// ---- turtles: return to their home beach to lay eggs; babies drop a scute when they grow -----------------------
class Turtle extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.homeP = [Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z)];
    this.hasEgg = false;
    this.digT = 0;
    this.waterBreather = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      home: this.homeP,
      egg: this.hasEgg
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    if (o.home) this.homeP = o.home;
    this.hasEgg = !!o.egg;
  }
  get ai() {
    return 'amph';
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    this.hasEgg = true;
    this.game.dropXp(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], randInt(1, 7));
    return null;
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.hasEgg) {
      const [hx, hy, hz] = this.homeP,
        d = Math.hypot(hx + 0.5 - this.pos[0], hz + 0.5 - this.pos[2]);
      if (d > 3 || this.inWater) {
        c.goal = [hx + 0.5, hy, hz + 0.5];
        c.mod = 1.2;
        return;
      }
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      if (/sand$/.test(BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)].key) && this.world.getBlock(x, y, z) === 0) {
        if (++this.digT > 200) {
          this.world.setBlock(x, y, z, BID.turtle_egg, Features.withProp(BID.turtle_egg, 0, 'eggs', String(randInt(1, 4))));
          Sound.ev('entity.turtle.lay_egg', this.pos, 0.3, 1);
          this.hasEgg = false;
          this.digT = 0;
        }
        return;
      }
    }
    // land turtles head back to the water now and then
    if (!this.inWater && !this.hasEgg && Math.random() < 0.01) {
      const gq = this.findWater();
      if (gq) {
        this.goal = gq;
        this.wanderT = 200;
      }
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  findWater() {
    for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) {
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]) + randInt(-10, 10),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]) + randInt(-10, 10),
        y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]);
      for (let dy = 2; dy >= -3; dy--) if (this.world.getBlock(x, y + dy, z) === WATER) return [x + 0.5, y + dy, z + 0.5];
    }
    return null;
  }
  onGrown() {
    this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], makeStack('turtle_scute', 1));
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (this.inWater) {
      for (const [n, s] of [['right_hind_leg', 1], ['left_hind_leg', -1]]) if (P[n]) P[n].xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 * 0.6) * 0.5 * spd * s;
      for (const [n, s] of [['right_front_leg', 1], ['left_front_leg', -1]]) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].zRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 * 0.6 + Math.PI) * 0.5 * spd * s;
        P[n].xRot = 0;
      }
    } else {
      for (const [n, s] of [['right_hind_leg', 1], ['left_hind_leg', -1]]) if (P[n]) P[n].xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 * 5) * 2 * spd * s;
      for (const [n, s] of [['right_front_leg', 1], ['left_front_leg', -1]]) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].yRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 * 5 + Math.PI) * 8 * spd * s * 0.1;
        P[n].zRot = 0;
      }
    }
    if (P.egg_belly) P.egg_belly.visible = this.hasEgg && !this.baby;
    if (this.digT > 0 && P.egg_belly) P.egg_belly.visible = true;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/turtle/turtle' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
}
// on land vanilla turtles plod at a quarter of their speed (TurtleMoveControl): landSpeedMul
defVMob('turtle', {
  cls: Turtle,
  food: 'turtle_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.6,
  speed3: 1.2,
  landSpeedMul: 0.12,
  waterOk: true,
  sinks: true,
  walkUnderwater: false,
  stepSound: false,
  cull: t => t.layerKey() === 'turtle_baby#main'
}); // (BabyTurtleModel is entityCutoutCull, the adult isn't)
BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK.turtle_egg = (g, x, y, z, id, m) => {
  const w = g.world,
    h = +(Features.propOf(id, m, 'hatch') || 0),
    n = +(Features.propOf(id, m, 'eggs') || 1);
  if (!/sand$/.test(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)].key)) return;
  const night = !g.isDay();
  if (!(night || Math.random() < 1 / 500)) return;
  if (h < 2) {
    bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'hatch', String(h + 1));
    Sound.ev('entity.turtle.egg_crack', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 0.7, 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.2);
    return;
  }
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
  Sound.ev('entity.turtle.egg_hatch', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 0.7, 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const t = spawnAt(g, 'turtle', x + 0.3 + i * 0.1, y, z + 0.3, true);
    t.homeP = [x, y, z];
  }
};

// ---- frogs and tadpoles: frogspawn in water, tadpoles grow into frogs of the biome's kind --------------------------
const frogVariantAt = (g, x, z) => {
  const b = biomeName(g, x, z);
  return /desert|badlands|jungle|savanna|mangrove|warm|nether|crimson|warped|basalt|soul/.test(b) ? 'warm' : /snowy|frozen|ice|grove|jagged|deep_dark|peaks|cold/.test(b) ? 'cold' : 'temperate';
};
class Frog extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.variant = frogVariantAt(g, x, z);
    this.tongueT = 0;
    this.jumpT = 0;
    this.croakT = 0;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      var: this.variant
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.variant = o.var || 'temperate';
  }
  compVal(k) {
    return k === 'frog/variant' ? 'minecraft:' + this.variant : undefined;
  }
  get ai() {
    return 'amph';
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 20) return null;
    return this.game.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && (e.type === 'slime' && (e.size || 1) === 1 || e.type === 'magma_cube' && (e.size || 1) === 1) && e.distTo(this) < 10) || null;
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime)) this.target = null;
    if (!this.target) this.target = this.huntTarget();
  }
  fight(c) {
    const t = this.target,
      d = this.distTo(t);
    c.look = t;
    if (this.tongueT > 0) {
      if (--this.tongueT === 5 && !t.dead) {
        // swallowed: the prey's loot (froglights from small magma cubes)
        t.dead = true;
        const out = rollLoot(t.type, {
          e: t,
          src: {
            attacker: this
          },
          player: false
        });
        for (const st of out) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], st);
        this.sound('eat');
        this.target = null;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (d < 3) {
      this.tongueT = 10;
      this.anims = {
        TONGUE: this.age
      };
      this.sound('tongue');
      return;
    }
    c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
    c.mod = 1.2;
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.inWater) return VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
    if (this.jumpT > 0) this.jumpT--;
    // on land: hops toward the goal
    if (c.goal && this.onGround && this.jumpT <= 0 && Math.hypot(c.goal[0] - this.pos[0], c.goal[2] - this.pos[2]) > 1.5 && Math.random() < 0.08) {
      const dx = c.goal[0] - this.pos[0],
        dz = c.goal[2] - this.pos[2],
        l = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      this.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
      this.vel[0] = dx / l * 0.35;
      this.vel[2] = dz / l * 0.35;
      this.vel[1] = 0.5;
      this.jumpT = 30;
      this.anims = {
        JUMP: this.age
      };
      this.sound('long_jump');
      return this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
    }
    if (!this.onGround) return this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
    VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
  }
  afterMove() {
    if (Math.random() < 1 / 400 && this.onGround && !this.inWater) {
      this.anims.CROAK = this.age;
      this.sound('ambient');
    }
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    // frogs lay frogspawn on a nearby water surface
    const g = this.game,
      w = this.world,
      x0 = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      y0 = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
      z0 = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
      const x = x0 + randInt(-4, 4),
        z = z0 + randInt(-4, 4);
      for (let y = y0 + 2; y >= y0 - 3; y--) if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) === WATER && w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) === 0 && BID.frogspawn !== undefined) {
        w.setBlock(x, y + 1, z, BID.frogspawn, 0);
        Sound.ev('entity.frog.lay_spawn', [x, y, z], 1, 1);
        g.dropXp(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], randInt(1, 7));
        return null;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    if (this.inWater) {
      EM.walk(md, spd > 0.1 ? 'FrogAnimation.FROG_SWIM' : 'FrogAnimation.FROG_IDLE_WATER', spd > 0.1 ? pos : this.age + a, spd > 0.1 ? spd : 1, 1, 2.5);
    } else EM.walk(md, 'FrogAnimation.FROG_WALK', pos, spd, 1.5, 2.5);
    for (const k in this.anims) EM.anim(md, 'FrogAnimation.FROG_' + k, (this.age - this.anims[k] + a) / 20);
    if (P.croaking_body && this.anims.CROAK == null) P.croaking_body.visible = false;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/frog/frog_' + this.variant);
  }
}
// (in the water vanilla frogs get 0.02 x 0.75 x 0.75 a tick; tadpoles swim like fish, AbstractFish's fixed 0.01 x the
// input: 0.01 x 0.5 idle, and panicking the input 2 is cut to length 1, so 0.01, twice that)

  waterOk: true,
  swimAcc: 0.011,
  stepSound: false
});
class Tadpole extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.grow = 24000;
    this.waterBreather = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      grow: this.grow
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    if (o.grow) this.grow = o.grow;
  }
  think(c) {
    if (--this.grow <= 0) {
      const f = createMob(this.game, 'frog', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2]);
      f.variant = frogVariantAt(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[2]);
      f.persistent = true;
      this.game.entities.push(f);
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.tadpole.grow_up', this.pos, 0.15, 1);
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'slime_ball') {
      this.grow -= Math.floor(24000 * 0.1);
      useOne(this.game, p);
      this.game.particles.spawn('happy_villager', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], 0, 0.05, 0);
      return true;
    }
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'water_bucket') {
      swapHeld(this.game, p, 'tadpole_bucket', {
        mob: {
          grow: this.grow
        }
      });
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('item.bucket.fill_tadpole', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts;
    if (P.tail) P.tail.yRot = -Math.sin((this.age + a) * (this.inWater ? 1.3 : 1.7)) * 0.25 * (this.inWater ? 1 : 2);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/tadpole/tadpole');
  }
}

BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK.frogspawn = (g, x, y, z) => {
  if (Math.random() > 0.15) return;
  g.world.setBlock(x, y, z, 0, 0);
  Sound.ev('block.frogspawn.hatch', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
  for (let i = 0, n = randInt(2, 6); i < n; i++) spawnAt(g, 'tadpole', x + Math.random(), y - 0.5, z + Math.random());
};

// ---- bats: hang from cave ceilings, flutter about in the dark ------------------------------------------------
class Bat extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.resting = false;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  think(c) {
    const w = this.world,
      x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(this.pos[1] + this.h + 0.1),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    if (this.resting) {
      this.vel = [0, 0, 0];
      const p = this.game.player;
      if (!SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y, z)] || !p.sneaking && this.distTo(p) < 4 && !p.creative || Math.random() < 1 / 2000) {
        this.resting = false;
        this.anims = {};
        this.sound('takeoff', 0.05);
      }
      return;
    }
    // erratic flight; settles under a ceiling now and then
    if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 2) || Math.random() < 0.03) this.goal = [this.pos[0] + randInt(-7, 7), this.pos[1] + randInt(-2, 4), this.pos[2] + randInt(-7, 7)];
    c.goal = this.goal;
    if (SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y, z)] && Math.random() < 0.01) {
      this.resting = true;
      this.pos[1] = y - this.h;
      this.goal = null;
    }
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    if (this.resting) EM.anim(md, 'BatAnimation.BAT_RESTING', (this.age + a) / 20);else EM.anim(md, 'BatAnimation.BAT_FLYING', (this.age + a) / 20);
    const P = md.parts;
    if (P.head && !this.resting) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/bat/bat');
  }
  preDraw(m, a) {
    if (!this.resting) M4.translate(m, 0, Math.cos((this.age + a) * 0.3) * 0.1, 0);
  }
}
defVMob('bat', {
