  ai: 'fly',
  xp: 0,
  scale: 0.35 / 0.35,
  shadowR: 0.2,
  speed3: 1.4,
  idleT: 80,
  stepSound: false,
  vol: 0.1,
  cull: true
});

// ---- parrots: fly, perch on shoulders, dance to music, imitate mobs ----------------------------------------------
const PARROT_COLORS = ['red_blue', 'blue', 'green', 'yellow_blue', 'grey'];
class Parrot extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.variant = randInt(0, 4);
    this.flapT = 0;
    this.dance = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      var: this.variant
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.variant = o.var | 0;
    if (this.owner) this.persistent = true;
  }
  get ai() {
    return this.onGround && !this.goal && !this.owner || this.sitting ? 'ground' : 'fly';
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  canBreed() {
    return false;
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player;
    // a jukebox playing within 3.5 blocks: dance
    this.dance = !!(g.jukeboxes && [...g.jukeboxes.values()].some(j => j.playing && Math.hypot(j.x + 0.5 - this.pos[0], j.y - this.pos[1], j.z + 0.5 - this.pos[2]) < 3.5));
    if (this.dance) return;
    if (this.sitting) return;
    // tamed: hop onto the owner's shoulder when it lands nearby
    if (this.owner === p && !p.shoulder && this.distTo(p) < 2 && p.onGround && !p.inWater && !this.baby && Math.random() < 0.05 && this.age > (this.offShoulderT || 0) + 60) {
      p.shoulder = {
        variant: this.variant,
        name: this.customName,
        health: this.health
      };
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.parrot.step', this.pos, 0.5, 1);
      return;
    }
    if (this.owner && PetMixin.followOwner.call(this, c)) return;
    if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 1.5) || Math.random() < 0.01) this.goal = this.randomGoal(8, 4);
    c.goal = this.goal;
    // imitate a nearby monster now and then
    if (Math.random() < 1 / 400) {
      const m = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof Mob && e.T.hostile && e.distTo(this) < 20);
      if (m) Sound.ev('entity.parrot.imitate.' + m.type, this.pos, 0.7, 1.8);
    }
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (k === 'cookie') {
      useOne(g, p);
      this.hurt(1000, {
        type: 'poison',
        attacker: p
      });
      return true;
    }
    if (!this.owner && held && isFood('parrot_food', held.id)) {
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('eat');
      tryTame(this, p, 1 / 10);
      return true;
    }
    if (this.owner === p && (!held || !isFood('parrot_food', held.id))) {
      this.sitting = !this.sitting;
      this.goal = null;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    parrotAnim(md, this, a, this.dance ? 'party' : this.sitting ? 'sit' : this.onGround ? 'stand' : 'fly');
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/parrot/parrot_' + PARROT_COLORS[this.variant | 0]);
  }
}
function parrotAnim(md, e, a, st) {
  const P = md.parts,
    t = (e.age || 0) + a,
    [pos, spd] = emLimbs(e, a);
  if (P.head) {
    P.head.xRot = -(e.pitch || 0);
    P.head.yRot = -(e.headYaw || 0);
  }
  if (st === 'fly') {
    const f = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.6 + 0.7;
    if (P.left_wing) P.left_wing.zRot = -0.0873 - f;
    if (P.right_wing) P.right_wing.zRot = 0.0873 + f;
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = 0.7;
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = 0.7;
  } else if (st === 'sit' || st === 'shoulder') {
    for (const n of ['head', 'body', 'tail', 'left_wing', 'right_wing']) if (P[n]) P[n].y += 1.9;
    for (const n of ['left_leg', 'right_leg']) if (P[n]) {
      P[n].y += 1.9;
      P[n].xRot = Math.PI / 2;
      P[n].z -= 1;
    }
    if (P.tail) P.tail.xRot += Math.PI / 6;
  } else if (st === 'party') {
    const b = Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.15;
    for (const n of ['head', 'body', 'tail', 'left_wing', 'right_wing']) if (P[n]) {
      P[n].y += b * 8;
      P[n].x += Math.cos(t * 0.4) * 1.2;
    }
    if (P.head) P.head.zRot = Math.cos(t * 0.4) * 0.4;
  } else {
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd;
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd;
  }
}
defVMob('parrot', {
  cls: Parrot,
  food: 'parrot_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.3,
  speed3: 1,
  hover: true,
  stepSound: false
});
// the parrot on the owner's shoulder: drawn on the player, steps off when the player jumps high, falls, swims or gets hurt
(() => {
  const _t = Player.prototype.tick;
  Player.prototype.tick = function (input) {
    const r = _t.call(this, input);
    const s = this.shoulder;
    if (s && (this.inWater || this.flying || this.fallDist > 0.5 || this.hurtTime > 0 || this.sneaking && input && input.jump || this.deathTime)) {
      const p = createMob(this.game, 'parrot', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1.5, this.pos[2]);
      p.variant = s.variant;
      p.owner = this;
      p.persistent = true;
      if (s.name) p.customName = s.name;
      if (s.health) p.health = s.health;
      p.offShoulderT = p.age;
      this.game.entities.push(p);
      this.shoulder = null;
    }
    return r;
  };
  const _dm = Game.prototype.drawMob;
  Game.prototype.drawMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    const res = _dm.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
    if (e === this.player && e.shoulder && this.perspective !== 0) {
      const r = this.renderer,
        md = EM.get(r, 'parrot#main'),
        tex = r.etex('entity/parrot/parrot_' + PARROT_COLORS[e.shoulder.variant | 0]);
      if (md && tex) {
        const m = M4.create();
        M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
        M4.rotY(m, e.yaw);
        if (e.sneaking) M4.translate(m, 0, -0.2, 0);
        M4.translate(m, 0.4, 1.4 * 0.9375 + 0.05, 0);
        EM.reset(md);
        parrotAnim(md, {
          age: this.player.age,
          pitch: 0,
          headYaw: 0,
          limbAmt: 0,
          limbSwing: 0
        }, a, 'shoulder');
        r.drawEM(md, tex, m, [l[0], l[1]], env, {});
      }
    }
    return res;
  };
})();

// ---- bees: pollinate flowers, fill hives with honey, sting when angered ------------------------------------------
const isFlower = k => /^(dandelion|poppy|blue_orchid|allium|azure_bluet|\w+_tulip|oxeye_daisy|cornflower|lily_of_the_valley|wither_rose|sunflower|lilac|rose_bush|peony|torchflower|pitcher_plant|pink_petals|wildflowers|flowering_azalea|flowering_azalea_leaves|spore_blossom|cherry_leaves|mangrove_propagule|chorus_flower|open_eyeblossom|cactus_flower|golden_dandelion)$/.test(k);
const isHive = k => k === 'beehive' || k === 'bee_nest';
class Bee extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.nectar = false;
    this.stung = false;
    this.hive = null;
    this.flower = null;
    this.pollT = 0;
    this.stingT = 0;
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      nec: this.nectar,
      hive: this.hive,
      st: this.stung
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.nectar = !!o.nec;
    this.hive = o.hive || null;
    this.stung = !!o.st;
  }
  get angry() {
    return this.anger > 0 && !!this.target;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  onAttacked(src) {
    for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof Bee && e !== this && e.distTo(this) < 16 && !e.stung) {
      e.target = src.attacker;
      e.anger = 400;
    }
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.anger <= 0)) {
      this.target = null;
    }
  }
  melee(t) {
    if (this.stung) return;
    this.attackCd = 20;
    if (t.hurt(2, {
      type: 'mob',
      attacker: this,
      knockFrom: this.pos
    })) {
      const df = this.game.difficulty;
      if (df >= 2 && t.addEffect) t.addEffect('poison', 0, (df === 3 ? 18 : 10) * 20);
      this.stung = true;
      this.stingT = 1200 + randInt(0, 100);
      this.target = null;
      this.anger = 0;
      this.sound('sting');
    }
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game,
      w = this.world;
    if (this.stung && --this.stingT <= 0) {
      this.hurt(1000, {
        type: 'generic'
      });
      return;
    }
    if (this.target) {
      this.fight(c);
      return;
    }
    // find a hive close by
    if (!this.hive && this.age % 100 === 0) {
      const x0 = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        y0 = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
        z0 = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      for (let dx = -10; dx <= 10 && !this.hive; dx++) for (let dy = -5; dy <= 5 && !this.hive; dy++) for (let dz = -10; dz <= 10 && !this.hive; dz++) if (isHive(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz)].key)) this.hive = [x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz];
    }
    const night = !g.isDay() || g.weather > 0.5;
    if (this.hive && (this.nectar || night)) {
      const [hx, hy, hz] = this.hive;
      if (!isHive(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(hx, hy, hz)].key)) {
        this.hive = null;
        return;
      }
      if (Math.hypot(hx + 0.5 - this.pos[0], hy + 0.5 - this.pos[1], hz + 0.5 - this.pos[2]) < 1.6) {
        beeEnterHive(g, this);
        return;
      }
      c.goal = [hx + 0.5, hy + 0.5, hz + 0.5];
      return;
    }
    // collecting nectar from a flower
    if (!this.nectar && !night) {
      if (this.flower) {
        const [fx, fy, fz] = this.flower;
        if (!isFlower(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(fx, fy, fz)].key)) {
          this.flower = null;
          return;
        }
        const d = Math.hypot(fx + 0.5 - this.pos[0], fy + 0.6 - this.pos[1], fz + 0.5 - this.pos[2]);
        c.goal = [fx + 0.5, fy + 0.6, fz + 0.5];
        if (d < 0.8 && ++this.pollT > 400) {
          this.nectar = true;
          this.flower = null;
          this.pollT = 0;
        }
        return;
      } else if (this.age % 40 === 0) {
        const x0 = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
          y0 = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
          z0 = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
        for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
          const x = x0 + randInt(-8, 8),
            y = y0 + randInt(-3, 3),
            z = z0 + randInt(-8, 8);
          if (isFlower(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)].key)) {
            this.flower = [x, y, z];
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // with nectar: crops it flies over grow
    if (this.nectar && this.age % 30 === 0) {
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      for (let dy = 1; dy <= 2; dy++) {
        const y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]) - dy,
          id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
          ag = Features.propOf(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'age');
        if (ag != null && /^(wheat|carrots|potatoes|beetroots|melon_stem|pumpkin_stem|sweet_berry_bush|cave_vines)$/.test(BLOCKS[id].key) && Math.random() < 0.3) {
          const mx = BLOCKS[id].key === 'beetroots' || BLOCKS[id].key === 'sweet_berry_bush' ? 3 : 7;
          if (+ag < mx) bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'age', String(+ag + 1));
        }
      }
    }
    if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 1.2) || Math.random() < 0.01) this.goal = this.randomGoal(8, 3);
    c.goal = this.goal;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    const f = Math.cos(t * 2.1) * Math.PI * 0.15;
    if (P.right_wing) {
      P.right_wing.xRot = 0;
      P.right_wing.zRot = f;
    }
    if (P.left_wing) {
      P.left_wing.xRot = 0;
      P.left_wing.zRot = -f;
    }
    for (const n of ['front_legs', 'middle_legs', 'back_legs']) if (P[n]) P[n].xRot = Math.PI / 4;
    if (P.bone && !this.angry) {
      P.bone.xRot = 0.1 + Math.cos(t * 0.18) * 0.05;
      P.bone.y = 19 - Math.cos(t * 0.18) * 0.9;
    }
    if (P.stinger) P.stinger.visible = !this.stung;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/bee/bee' + (this.angry ? '_angry' : '') + (this.nectar ? '_nectar' : '') + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  ambientKind() {
    return this.angry ? 'loop_aggressive' : 'loop';
  }
}
defVMob('bee', {
  cls: Bee,
  ai: 'fly',
  food: 'bee_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.3,
  speed3: 1,
  idleT: 60,
  stepSound: false,
  vol: 0.3
});
// a bee in its hive: the hive keeps it (and fills with honey when it brought nectar); it leaves again by day
function beeEnterHive(g, bee) {
  const [x, y, z] = bee.hive,
    be = g.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'hive');
  be.bees = be.bees || [];
  if (be.bees.length >= 3) {
    bee.goal = null;
    return;
  }
  be.bees.push({
    nec: bee.nectar,
    t: 0,
    name: bee.customName,
    h: bee.health
  });
  if (bee.nectar) {
    const lv = +(bprop(g.world, x, y, z, 'honey_level') || 0);
    if (lv < 5) bsetProp(g.world, x, y, z, 'honey_level', String(lv + 1));
  }
  bee.dead = true;
  Sound.ev('block.beehive.enter', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
}
(() => {
  const _t = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function (...args) {
    const r = _t.apply(this, args);
    if (this.net || !this.blockEntities || this.tickCount % 20) return r;
    const day = this.isDay() && this.weather < 0.5;
    for (const be of this.blockEntities.values()) {
      if (be.type !== 'hive' || !be.bees || !be.bees.length) continue;
      const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
      if (!this.world.isLoaded(x, z) || !isHive(BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].key)) continue;
      for (const b of be.bees) b.t += 20;
      if (!day) continue;
      const out = be.bees.filter(b => b.t > 600);
      be.bees = be.bees.filter(b => b.t <= 600);
      for (const b of out) {
        const bee = createMob(this, 'bee', x + 0.5, y + 1.1, z + 0.5);
        bee.hive = [x, y, z];
        bee.nectar = false;
        if (b.name) bee.customName = b.name;
        if (b.h) bee.health = b.h;
        this.entities.push(bee);
        Sound.ev('block.beehive.exit', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- allays: bring the player items like the one they were given ---------------------------------------------
class Allay extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.item = null;
    this.liked = null;
    this.throwCd = 0;
    this.dance = false;
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      item: this.item,
      liked: this.liked ? 1 : 0
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.item = o.item || null;
    if (o.liked) this.liked = this.game.player;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (src && src.attacker === this.liked) return false;
    return super.hurt(a, src);
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game;
    this.dance = !!(g.jukeboxes && [...g.jukeboxes.values()].some(j => j.playing && Math.hypot(j.x + 0.5 - this.pos[0], j.y - this.pos[1], j.z + 0.5 - this.pos[2]) < 8));
    if (this.throwCd > 0) this.throwCd--;
    const p = this.liked;
    if (this.item && p && !p.dead) {
      // look for matching items; when carrying some, fly them to the player and drop them
      const held = this.carried;
      if (held && this.distTo(p) < 2.5 && this.throwCd <= 0) {
        g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], held, [(p.pos[0] - this.pos[0]) * 0.1, 0.2, (p.pos[2] - this.pos[2]) * 0.1]);
        this.carried = null;
        this.throwCd = 60;
        this.sound('throw');
        return;
      }
      if (!held || held.count < maxStack(held.id)) {
        const it = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof ItemEntity && !e.dead && e.pickup <= 0 && sameKind(e.stack, this.item) && e.distTo(this) < 32);
        if (it) {
          if (this.distTo(it) < 1.2) {
            if (held) held.count += it.stack.count;else this.carried = {
              ...it.stack
            };
            it.dead = true;
            this.sound('item_taken');
            return;
          }
          c.goal = [it.pos[0], it.pos[1] + 0.5, it.pos[2]];
          return;
        }
      }
      if (this.distTo(p) > 3) {
        c.goal = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + 1.5, p.pos[2]];
        c.mod = held ? 1.4 : 1;
        return;
      }
      c.look = p;
      return;
    }
    if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 1.2) || Math.random() < 0.01) this.goal = this.randomGoal(8, 3);
    c.goal = this.goal;
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!this.item && held) {
      this.item = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      this.liked = p;
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('item_given');
      return true;
    }
    if (this.item && !held) {
      g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], this.item);
      if (this.carried) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], this.carried);
      this.item = null;
      this.carried = null;
      this.liked = null;
      this.sound('item_taken');
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.item, this.carried];
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a,
      f = Math.cos(t * 0.9) * 0.5 + 0.6;
    if (P.right_wing) {
      P.right_wing.yRot = -0.785 + f * 0.4;
      P.right_wing.xRot = 0.43;
      P.right_wing.zRot = -0.47;
    }
    if (P.left_wing) {
      P.left_wing.yRot = 0.785 - f * 0.4;
      P.left_wing.xRot = 0.43;
      P.left_wing.zRot = 0.47;
    }
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
    if (P.body) P.body.xRot = 0.2;
    if (this.item) for (const n of ['right_arm', 'left_arm']) if (P[n]) {
      P[n].xRot = -1.0;
      P[n].yRot = n === 'right_arm' ? 0.2 : -0.2;
    }
    if (this.dance && P.head) {
      P.head.zRot = Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.3;
      if (P.body) P.body.yRot = Math.sin(t * 0.25) * 0.4;
    }
    if (P.root) P.root.y = 23.5 + Math.cos(t * 0.15) * 0.8;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/allay/allay');
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    const st = this.carried || this.item;
    if (!st) return null;
    return {
      body: am => {
        M4.translate(am, 0, 0.3, -0.3);
        M4.scale(am, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6);
        g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null);
      }
    };
  }
}
defVMob('allay', {
  cls: Allay,
  ai: 'fly',
  xp: 0,
  shadowR: 0.25,
  bright: false,
  stepSound: false
});

// ---- snow golems: throw snowballs at monsters, leave snow behind, melt in the heat ---------------------------
class SnowGolem extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.pumpkin = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      pk: this.pumpkin
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.pumpkin = o.pk !== false;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 10) return null;
    return this.game.entities.find(e => e instanceof Mob && e.T.hostile && e.type !== 'creeper' && !e.dead && !e.deathTime && e.distTo(this) < 10 && this.canSee(e)) || null;
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.distTo(this.target) > 16)) this.target = null;
    if (!this.target) this.target = this.huntTarget();
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    if (d > 8) c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
    if (this.attackCd <= 0 && d < 10) {
      this.attackCd = 20;
      shootAt(this, t, 1.6, {
        layer: ITEMS[ITEM_KEY.snowball].tex,
        grav: 0.03,
        arc: 0.2,
        yk: 0.85,
        onHit: e => {
          e.hurt(e.type === 'blaze' ? 3 : 0.0001, {
            type: 'mob',
            attacker: this,
            knockFrom: this.pos,
            knock: 0.4
          });
        }
      });
      Sound.ev('entity.snow_golem.shoot', this.pos, 1, 0.4 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8));
    }
  }
  afterMove() {
    const g = this.game,
      w = this.world,
      x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    const b = biomeName(g, x, z);
    const hot = /desert|badlands|savanna|jungle|nether|crimson|warped|basalt|soul|mangrove|warm/.test(b);
    if ((hot || this.inWater || g.weather > 0.5 && w.skyAt(x, y + 2, z) >= 15) && this.age % 20 === 0) this.hurt(1, {
      type: 'melt'
    });
    // snow trail (vanilla: only with mob_griefing)
    if (!hot && g.rule('mob_griefing') !== false && BID.snow !== undefined && w.getBlock(x, y, z) === 0 && SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)] && this.age % 4 === 0) w.setBlock(x, y, z, BID.snow, 0);
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'shears' && this.pumpkin) {
      this.pumpkin = false;
      this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1.7, this.pos[2], makeStack('carved_pumpkin', 1));
      Sound.ev('entity.snow_golem.shear', this.pos, 1, 1);
      this.game.damageHeld(1);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts;
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (P.upper_body) P.upper_body.yRot = (P.head ? P.head.yRot : 0) * 0.25;
    const s = Math.sin(P.upper_body ? P.upper_body.yRot : 0),
      c2 = Math.cos(P.upper_body ? P.upper_body.yRot : 0);
    if (P.left_arm) {
      P.left_arm.x = c2 * 5;
      P.left_arm.z = -s * 5;
      P.left_arm.yRot = P.upper_body.yRot;
    }
    if (P.right_arm) {
      P.right_arm.x = -c2 * 5;
      P.right_arm.z = s * 5;
      P.right_arm.yRot = P.upper_body.yRot + Math.PI;
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/snow_golem/snow_golem');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt) {
    if (!this.pumpkin || !g.blockMesh || BID.carved_pumpkin === undefined) return;
    const H = md.parts.head;
    if (!H) return;
    const mm = M4.copy(m);
    M4.scale(mm, -1, -1, 1);
    M4.translate(mm, 0, -1.501, 0);
    M4.translate(mm, H.x / 16, H.y / 16, H.z / 16);
    M4.rotY(mm, H.yRot);
    M4.rotX(mm, H.xRot);
    M4.translate(mm, 0, -0.34375, 0);
    M4.rotY(mm, Math.PI);
    M4.scale(mm, 0.625, -0.625, -0.625);
    M4.translate(mm, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5);
    r.drawMesh(g.blockMesh(BID.carved_pumpkin, 0), mm, env, lt);
  }
}
defVMob('snow_golem', {
  cls: SnowGolem,
  xp: 0,
  shadowR: 0.4,
  T: {
    passive: false,
    hostile: false
  },
  immune: ['fall']
});

// ---- copper golems: carry items from copper chests to other chests; oxidize unless waxed -------------------------
const GOLEM_OX = ['', '_exposed', '_weathered', '_oxidized'];
class CopperGolem extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.ox = 0;
    this.waxed = false;
    this.oxT = 24000 + randInt(0, 24000);
    this.carry = null;
    this.task = null;
    this.taskT = 0;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      ox: this.ox,
      wax: this.waxed,
      carry: this.carry
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.ox = o.ox | 0;
    this.waxed = !!o.wax;
    this.carry = o.carry || null;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.carry];
  }
  chestsNear(copper) {
    const g = this.game,
      out = [];
    for (const be of g.blockEntities.values()) {
      if (be.type !== 'chest' || !be.slots) continue;
      const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
      if (Math.abs(x - this.pos[0]) > 16 || Math.abs(y - this.pos[1]) > 8 || Math.abs(z - this.pos[2]) > 16) continue;
      const k = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].key;
      if (/copper_chest$/.test(k) === copper && /chest$/.test(k)) out.push(be);
    }
    return out.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.pos[0] - this.pos[0], a.pos[2] - this.pos[2]) - Math.hypot(b.pos[0] - this.pos[0], b.pos[2] - this.pos[2]));
  }
  think(c) {
    if (!this.waxed && this.ox < 3 && --this.oxT <= 0) {
      this.ox++;
      this.oxT = 24000 + randInt(0, 24000);
    }
    if (this.ox === 3 && !this.waxed && Math.random() < 1 / 20000 && BID.oxidized_copper_golem_statue !== undefined) {
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      if (this.world.getBlock(x, y, z) === 0) {
        this.world.setBlock(x, y, z, BID.oxidized_copper_golem_statue, 0);
        this.dead = true;
        return;
      }
    }
    if (this.taskT > 0) {
      this.taskT--;
      return;
    }
    const spd = [1, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7][this.ox];
    if (this.age % 20 === 0 && !this.task) {
      if (!this.carry) {
        const src = this.chestsNear(true).find(be => be.slots.some(s => s));
        if (src) this.task = {
          be: src,
          take: true
        };
      } else {
        const dst = this.chestsNear(false).find(be => be.slots.some(s => s && sameKind(s, this.carry) && s.count < maxStack(s.id)) || be.slots.every(s => !s)) || this.chestsNear(false).find(be => be.slots.some(s => !s));
        if (dst) this.task = {
          be: dst,
          take: false
        };
      }
    }
    if (this.task) {
      const be = this.task.be,
        [x, y, z] = be.pos;
      if (Math.hypot(x + 0.5 - this.pos[0], z + 0.5 - this.pos[2]) < 1.8 && Math.abs(y - this.pos[1]) < 2) {
        c.look = [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5];
        if (this.task.take) {
          const i = be.slots.findIndex(s => s);
          if (i >= 0) {
            const s = be.slots[i],
              n = Math.min(16, s.count);
            this.carry = {
              ...s,
              count: n
            };
            s.count -= n;
            if (!s.count) be.slots[i] = null;
            this.anims = {
              'CHEST_INTERACTION_NOITEM_GET': this.age
            };
            Sound.ev('entity.copper_golem.item_get', this.pos, 1, 1);
          }
        } else {
          const left = chestInsert(be.slots, this.carry);
          this.carry = left ? {
            ...this.carry,
            count: left
          } : null;
          this.anims = {
            'CHEST_INTERACTION_ITEM_DROP': this.age
          };
          Sound.ev('entity.copper_golem.item_drop', this.pos, 1, 1);
        }
        this.task = null;
        this.taskT = 60;
        return;
      }
      c.goal = [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5];
      c.mod = spd;
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
    c.mod *= spd;
  }
  postInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (k === 'honeycomb' && !this.waxed) {
      this.waxed = true;
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('item.honeycomb.wax_on', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k && /_axe$/.test(k)) {
      if (this.waxed) {
        this.waxed = false;
        Sound.ev('item.axe.wax_off', this.pos, 1, 1);
        g.damageHeld(1);
        return true;
      }
      if (this.ox > 0) {
        this.ox--;
        Sound.ev('item.axe.scrape', this.pos, 1, 1);
        g.damageHeld(1);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      pre = 'CopperGolemAnimation.COPPER_GOLEM_';
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (spd > 0.05) EM.walk(md, pre + (this.carry ? 'WALK_ITEM' : 'WALK'), pos, spd, 2, 2.5);else EM.anim(md, pre + 'IDLE', (this.age + a) / 20);
    for (const k in this.anims) EM.anim(md, pre + k, (this.age - this.anims[k] + a) / 20);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/copper_golem/copper_golem' + GOLEM_OX[this.ox]);
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env) {
    const t = r.etex('entity/copper_golem/copper_golem_eyes' + GOLEM_OX[this.ox]),
      em = EM.get(r, 'copper_golem#eyes');
    if (t && em) {
      EM.reset(em);
      EM.copy(md, em);
      r.drawEMGlow(em, t, m, env, {});
    }
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    const st = this.carry;
    if (!st) return null;
    return {
      body: am => {
        M4.translate(am, 0, 0.1, -0.35);
        M4.scale(am, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7);
        g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null);
      }
    };
  }
}
function chestInsert(slots, st) {
  let n = st.count;
  for (const s of slots) if (s && sameKind(s, st) && s.count < maxStack(s.id)) {
    const k = Math.min(n, maxStack(s.id) - s.count);
    s.count += k;
    n -= k;
    if (!n) return 0;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) if (!slots[i]) {
    slots[i] = {
      ...st,
      count: n
    };
    return 0;
  }
  return n;
}
defVMob('copper_golem', {
  cls: CopperGolem,
  xp: 0,
  shadowR: 0.35,
  T: {
    passive: true
  }
});

// ---- the wandering trader: odd trades for emeralds, two llamas on leads, leaves after a while ----------------------
const WT_SELL = [['sea_pickle', 1, 2], ['slime_ball', 1, 4], ['glowstone', 1, 2], ['nautilus_shell', 5, 1], ['fern', 1, 1], ['sugar_cane', 1, 1], ['pumpkin', 1, 1], ['kelp', 3, 1], ['cactus', 3, 1], ['dandelion', 1, 1], ['poppy', 1, 1], ['blue_orchid', 1, 1], ['allium', 1, 1], ['azure_bluet', 1, 1], ['red_tulip', 1, 1], ['orange_tulip', 1, 1], ['white_tulip', 1, 1], ['pink_tulip', 1, 1], ['oxeye_daisy', 1, 1], ['cornflower', 1, 1], ['lily_of_the_valley', 1, 1], ['open_eyeblossom', 1, 1], ['wheat_seeds', 1, 1], ['beetroot_seeds', 1, 1], ['pumpkin_seeds', 1, 1], ['melon_seeds', 1, 1], ['acacia_sapling', 5, 1], ['birch_sapling', 5, 1], ['dark_oak_sapling', 5, 1], ['jungle_sapling', 5, 1], ['oak_sapling', 5, 1], ['spruce_sapling', 5, 1], ['cherry_sapling', 5, 1], ['pale_oak_sapling', 5, 1], ['mangrove_propagule', 5, 1], ['red_dye', 1, 3], ['white_dye', 1, 3], ['blue_dye', 1, 3], ['pink_dye', 1, 3], ['black_dye', 1, 3], ['green_dye', 1, 3], ['light_gray_dye', 1, 3], ['magenta_dye', 1, 3], ['yellow_dye', 1, 3], ['gray_dye', 1, 3], ['purple_dye', 1, 3], ['light_blue_dye', 1, 3], ['lime_dye', 1, 3], ['orange_dye', 1, 3], ['brown_dye', 1, 3], ['cyan_dye', 1, 3], ['brain_coral_block', 3, 1], ['bubble_coral_block', 3, 1], ['fire_coral_block', 3, 1], ['horn_coral_block', 3, 1], ['tube_coral_block', 3, 1], ['vine', 1, 3], ['brown_mushroom', 1, 3], ['red_mushroom', 1, 3], ['lily_pad', 1, 5], ['small_dripleaf', 1, 2], ['sand', 1, 8], ['red_sand', 1, 4], ['pointed_dripstone', 1, 2], ['rooted_dirt', 1, 2], ['moss_block', 1, 2], ['pale_moss_block', 1, 2], ['firefly_bush', 1, 1], ['wildflowers', 1, 1], ['leaf_litter', 1, 1], ['packed_ice', 3, 1], ['blue_ice', 6, 1], ['gunpowder', 1, 1], ['podzol', 3, 3], ['name_tag', 5, 1], ['tropical_fish_bucket', 5, 1], ['pufferfish_bucket', 5, 1]];
const WT_BUY = [['water_bucket', 1, 2], ['milk_bucket', 1, 2], ['fermented_spider_eye', 1, 3], ['baked_potato', 4, 1], ['hay_block', 1, 1]];
class WanderingTrader extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.despawnT = 48000;
    this.trades = null;
    this.profession = 'none';
    this.vlevel = 1;
    this.drinkT = 0;
    this.invis = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      dt: this.despawnT,
      tr: this.trades
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.despawnT = o.dt || 24000;
    this.trades = o.tr || null;
  }
  offers() {
    if (!this.trades) {
      const has = k => ITEM_KEY[k] !== undefined,
        pick = (l, n) => l.filter(t => has(t[0])).sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, n);
      this.trades = [...pick(WT_BUY, 2).map(([k, n, e]) => ({
        a: k,
        an: n,
        r: 'emerald',
        rn: e,
        uses: 2,
        used: 0,
        xp: 1
      })), ...pick(WT_SELL, 5).map(([k, e, n]) => ({
        a: 'emerald',
        an: e,
        r: k,
        rn: n,
        uses: 8,
        used: 0,
        xp: 1
      }))];
    }
    return this.trades;
  }
  gainXp() {}
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (--this.despawnT <= 0 && !this.customName) {
      this.dead = true;
      for (const e of g.entities) if (e.leashHolder === this) {
        e.leashHolder = null;
        e.dead = true;
      }
      return;
    }
    // invisibility at night, milk again in the morning
    if (this.drinkT > 0) {
      if (--this.drinkT === 0) this.invis = !g.isDay();
      return;
    }
    if (!g.isDay() !== this.invis && Math.random() < 0.05) {
      this.drinkT = 32;
      Sound.ev(this.invis ? 'entity.wandering_trader.drink_milk' : 'entity.wandering_trader.drink_potion', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return;
    }
    if (g.ui.screen instanceof MerchantScreen && g.ui.screen.v === this) {
      c.look = g.player;
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].spawnEgg) return false;
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'name_tag') return false;
    this.game.ui.open(new TraderScreen(this.game, this));
    this.sound('trade');
    return true;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd * 0.5;
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd * 0.5;
    if (P.head && this.drinkT > 0) P.head.xRot = -0.6;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/wandering_trader/wandering_trader');
  }
  drawVM(g, r, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (this.invis && this.drinkT <= 0) return;
    super.drawVM(g, r, m, a, env, lt, overlay);
  }
}
class TraderScreen extends MerchantScreen {
  get title2() {
    return '流浪商人';
  }
}
defVMob('wandering_trader', {
  cls: WanderingTrader,
  xp: 0,
  shadowR: 0.4,
  T: {
    passive: true
  },
  panicMod: 1.6
});
// a trader turns up near the player now and then with two llamas in tow (vanilla: a 2.5% .. 7.5% chance each 20 minutes)
Game.prototype.trySpawnTrader = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world;
  if (this.dim !== 'overworld' && this.dim) return;
  if (this.entities.some(e => e instanceof WanderingTrader)) return;
  this.traderChance = Math.min(75, (this.traderChance || 25) + 25);
  if (Math.random() * 1000 >= this.traderChance) return;
  for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
    const x = Math.floor(p.pos[0]) + randInt(-32, 32),
      z = Math.floor(p.pos[2]) + randInt(-32, 32);
    if (!w.isLoaded(x, z) || Math.hypot(x - p.pos[0], z - p.pos[2]) < 12) continue;
    const y = w.surfaceY(x, z) + 1;
    if (IS_FLUID[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)] || w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== 0) continue;
    const t = spawnAt(this, 'wandering_trader', x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const l = spawnAt(this, 'trader_llama', x + 0.5 + (i ? 2 : -2), y, z + 0.5);
      l.leashHolder = t;
    }
    this.traderChance = 25;
    return;
  }
};

// ---- happy ghasts: gentle flying mounts with a harness; ghastlings come from dried ghasts in water -------------------
class HappyGhast extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.harness = null;
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      har: this.harness
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.harness = o.har || null;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  seat() {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h + 0.05, this.pos[2]];
  }
  // (vanilla HappyGhast.checkFallDamage does nothing: flown down onto the ground with a rider it died of the fall)
  onLand() {}
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.harness];
  }
  think(c) {
    const p = this.game.player;
    // a player on top of it (or just above): it stops in place, so one can stand on it (scanPlayerAboveGhast -> stopInPlace)
    const r = p.vehicle || p,
      b = this.box();
    if (!p.spectator && !(r instanceof HappyGhast) && r.pos[0] >= b[0] - 1 && r.pos[0] < b[3] + 1 && r.pos[2] >= b[2] - 1 && r.pos[2] < b[5] + 1 && r.pos[1] >= b[4] - 1e-5 && r.pos[1] < b[4] + this.h / 2) {
      this.vel[0] = this.vel[1] = this.vel[2] = 0;
      this.goal = null;
      c.look = p;
      return;
    }
    // follows a player holding snowballs or a harness
    if (p.inv.held && (ITEMS[p.inv.held.id].key === 'snowball' || /_harness$/.test(ITEMS[p.inv.held.id].key)) && this.distTo(p) < 16 && this.distTo(p) > 4) {
      c.goal = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + 2, p.pos[2]];
      c.look = p;
      return;
    }
    if (this.harness && this.distTo(p) < 8) {
      c.look = p;
      return;
    }
    if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 2) || Math.random() < 0.005) this.goal = this.randomGoal(12, 4);
    c.goal = this.goal;
    c.mod = 0.6;
  }
  ridden(c, inp) {
    const p = this.rider;
    this.yaw = p.yaw;
    const f = inp.fwd || 0,
      s = inp.strafe || 0,
      sy = Math.sin(p.pitch);
    const sp = 0.035;
    const ax = (-Math.sin(p.yaw) * f + Math.cos(p.yaw) * s) * Math.cos(p.pitch),
      az = (-Math.cos(p.yaw) * f - Math.sin(p.yaw) * s) * Math.cos(p.pitch);
    this.vel[0] += ax * sp;
    this.vel[2] += az * sp;
    this.vel[1] += (f * sy + (inp.jump ? 0.6 : 0)) * sp;
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.rider && this.harness) {
      this.move(this.vel[0], this.vel[1], this.vel[2]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.vel[i] *= 0.91;
      this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw) * 0.3;
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (k === 'snowball' && this.health < this.maxHealth) {
      this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 1);
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('eat');
      return true;
    }
    if (k && /_harness$/.test(k) && !this.harness && !this.baby) {
      this.harness = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.happy_ghast.equip', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'shears' && this.harness && !this.rider) {
      g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1, this.pos[2], this.harness);
      this.harness = null;
      Sound.ev('entity.happy_ghast.unequip', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (this.harness && !p.vehicle && !this.rider) {
      p.mount(this);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const n = P['tentacle' + i];
      if (n) n.xRot = 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 0.3 + i) + 0.4;
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/ghast/happy_ghast' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (!this.harness || this.baby) return;
    const hm = EM.get(r, 'happy_ghast_harness#main'),
      col = ITEMS[this.harness.id].key.replace(/_harness$/, '');
    // (the harness box is the body's own box: drawn with depth LESS it lost to the body everywhere but the goggles. Vanilla's
    // equipment layers are pulled toward the camera (VIEW_OFFSET_Z_LAYERING): here a polygon offset and LEQUAL)
    if (hm) {
      EM.reset(hm);
      if (hm.parts.goggles) hm.parts.goggles.y = this.rider ? 14 : 14 - 1.5;
      const gl = r.gl,
        po = gl.isEnabled(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);
      gl.enable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);
      gl.polygonOffset(-1, -1);
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
      r.drawEM(hm, r.etex('entity/equipment/happy_ghast_body/' + col + '_harness'), m, lt, env, {
        overlay
      });
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
      if (!po) gl.disable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);
    }
    if (this.rider) {
      const rm = EM.get(r, 'happy_ghast_ropes#main');
      if (rm) {
        EM.reset(rm);
        EM.copy(md, rm);
        r.drawEM(rm, r.etex('entity/ghast/happy_ghast_ropes'), m, lt, env, {
          overlay
        });
      }
    }
  }
}
defVMob('happy_ghast', {

  },

BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK.dried_ghast = (g, x, y, z, id, m) => {
  const w = g.world,
    h = +(Features.propOf(id, m, 'hydration') || 0),
    wet = Features.propOf(id, m, 'waterlogged') === 'true' || w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) === WATER;
  if (!wet) {
    if (h > 0 && Math.random() < 0.3) bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'hydration', String(h - 1));
    return;
  }
  if (Math.random() > 0.4) return;
  if (h < 3) {
    bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'hydration', String(h + 1));
    Sound.ev('block.dried_ghast.transition', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
    return;
  }
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, WATER, 0);
  Sound.ev('entity.ghastling.spawn', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
  spawnAt(g, 'happy_ghast', x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5, true);
};
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/mobs_water.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Water mobs drawn with the vanilla models (vmobs.js): cod, salmon, pufferfish, tropical fish, squid and glow
// squid, dolphins, axolotls, nautiluses and zombie nautiluses, guardians and elder guardians.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const inWaterAt = (w, x, y, z) => w.waterAt(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z));
// a fish out of water lies on its side (vanilla fish renderers turn it 90 degrees)
const fishFlop = (e, m, a) => {
  if (!e.inWater) {
    M4.translate(m, 0.1, 0.1, -0.1);
    M4.rotZ(m, Math.PI / 2);
  }
};
const finWag = (e, a, k = 1) => -(e.inWater ? 1 : 1.5) * 0.45 * Math.sin((e.inWater ? 0.6 : 1.7) * (e.age + a)) * k;

// ---- fish ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Fish extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.waterBreather = true;
    this.persistent = false;
    this.fromBucket = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      fb: this.fromBucket
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.fromBucket = !!o.fb;
    if (this.fromBucket) this.persistent = true;
  }
  despawn() {
    if (this.fromBucket) return false;
    return super.despawn();
  }
  think(c) {
    // schools: follow a nearby fish of the same kind
    if (this.age % 40 === 0 && !this.leader) this.leader = this.game.entities.find(e => e !== this && e.type === this.type && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 8 && !e.leader);
    if (this.leader && (this.leader.dead || this.leader.distTo(this) > 12)) this.leader = null;
    if (this.leader && this.distTo(this.leader) > 2.5) {
      c.goal = [...this.leader.pos];
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  bucketData() {
    return {};
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'water_bucket' && ITEM_KEY[this.type + '_bucket'] !== undefined) {
      swapHeld(this.game, p, this.type + '_bucket', {
        mob: this.bucketData()
      });
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('item.bucket.fill_fish', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  preDraw(m, a) {
    fishFlop(this, m, a);
  }
  ambientKind() {
    return this.inWater ? 'ambient' : 'flop';
  }
}
class Cod extends Fish {
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    if (md.parts.tail_fin) md.parts.tail_fin.yRot = finWag(this, a);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/fish/cod');
  }
}

class Pufferfish extends Fish {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.puff = 0;
    this.puffT = 0;
    this.deflT = 0;
  }
  layerKey() {
    return ['pufferfish_small#main', 'pufferfish_medium#main', 'pufferfish_big#main'][this.puff];
  }
  afterMove() {
    const g = this.game,
      near = g.entities.filter(e => e !== this && e instanceof Living && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 2.5 && !(e instanceof Fish) && e.type !== 'axolotl' && !(e === g.player && (g.player.creative || g.player.spectator)));
    if (near.length && this.inWater) {
      this.deflT = 0;
      if (this.puff < 2 && ++this.puffT > (this.puff ? 40 : 1)) {
        this.puff++;
        this.puffT = 0;
        this.sound('blow_up');
      }
    } else if (this.puff > 0 && ++this.deflT > 60) {
      this.puff--;
      this.deflT = 0;
      this.puffT = 0;
      this.sound('blow_out');
    }
    if (this.puff > 0) for (const e of near) if (e.distTo(this) < 0.6 + this.puff * 0.4) {
      if (e.hurt(1 + this.puff, {
        type: 'mob',
        attacker: this,
        knockFrom: this.pos
      })) {
        if (e.addEffect) e.addEffect('poison', 0, 60 * this.puff);
        this.sound('sting');
      }
    }
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    for (const n of ['left_blue_fin', 'right_blue_fin', 'left_fin', 'right_fin']) if (P[n]) P[n].zRot = (n.startsWith('left') ? -1 : 1) * (0.2 + Math.cos(t * 1.3) * Math.PI * 0.05);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/fish/pufferfish');
  }
}

});
// tropical fish: two shapes, six patterns each, a body and a pattern colour (vanilla's packed variant number)
class TropicalFish extends Fish {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.shape = randInt(0, 1);
    this.pattern = randInt(0, 5);
    this.base = randInt(0, 15);
    this.pcol = randInt(0, 15);
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      ...super.extraSave(),
      v: [this.shape, this.pattern, this.base, this.pcol]
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    super.extraLoad(o);
    if (o.v) [this.shape, this.pattern, this.base, this.pcol] = o.v;
  }
  bucketData() {
    return {
      v: [this.shape, this.pattern, this.base, this.pcol]
    };
  }
  get packed() {
    return this.shape | this.pattern << 8 | this.base << 16 | this.pcol << 24;
  }
  layerKey() {
    return this.shape ? 'tropical_fish_large#main' : 'tropical_fish_small#main';
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    if (md.parts.tail) md.parts.tail.yRot = finWag(this, a);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    const s = this.shape ? 'b' : 'a';
    return r.etexMix([{
      p: 'entity/fish/tropical_' + s,
      c: dyeRGB(DYES[this.base])
    }, {
      p: 'entity/fish/tropical_' + s + '_pattern_' + (this.pattern + 1),
      c: dyeRGB(DYES[this.pcol])
    }]);
  }
}

// ---- squid and glow squid: drift with their tentacles, squirt ink when hurt -------------------------------------
class Squid extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.waterBreather = true;
    this.tent = 0;
    this.tentSpd = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.1;
    this.bodyPitch = 0;
    this.darkT = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  think(c) {
    this.tent += this.tentSpd;
    if (this.tent > Math.PI * 2) {
      this.tent -= Math.PI * 2;
      if (Math.random() < 0.1) this.tentSpd = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.1;
    }
    // (fleeing, vanilla's SquidFleeGoal throws it straight away from the attacker within 10 blocks at the raw offset
    // x 3 / 20 a stroke (its normalize() is thrown away), the 3 lowered past 5 blocks: 0.45 b/t at 3, 1 at 10;
    // kept flat if that spot is air, the last flee way kept if it is neither water nor air; pushed on the stroke half)
    if (this.panic > 0) {
      this.panic--;
      const a = this.lastAttacker,
        d = a && !a.dead && a.pos ? [this.pos[0] - a.pos[0], this.pos[1] - a.pos[1], this.pos[2] - a.pos[2]] : null,
        L = d ? Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]) : 99;
      if (this.inWater && L > 0.01 && L < 10) {
        const w = this.world,
          fx = Math.floor(this.pos[0] + d[0]),
          fy = Math.floor(this.pos[1] + d[1]),
          fz = Math.floor(this.pos[2] + d[2]),
          air = w.getBlock(fx, fy, fz) === 0;
        if (air) d[1] = 0;
        if (air || w.waterAt(fx, fy, fz)) {
          const l = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]);
          this.fleeV = l > 0.01 ? [d[0] / l, d[1] / l, d[2] / l, Math.max(1, l * (3 - Math.max(0, L - 5) / 5) / 4)] : null;
        }
        const f = this.fleeV;
        if (f) {
          if (this.tent < Math.PI) {
            c.mod = f[3];
            c.goal = [this.pos[0] + f[0] * 4, this.pos[1] + f[1] * 4, this.pos[2] + f[2] * 4];
          }
          return;
        }
      }
    } else this.fleeV = null;
    // a push each tentacle stroke, then drift
    if (this.tent < Math.PI && this.inWater) {
      if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 1.5) || Math.random() < 0.01) this.goal = this.randomGoal(10, 4);
      c.goal = this.goal;
    }
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (r && this.inWater) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const p = this.game.particles.spawn('smoke', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3);
        if (p) p.col = this.type === 'glow_squid' ? [60, 220, 210] : [10, 10, 20];
      }
      this.sound('squirt');
      if (this.type === 'glow_squid') this.darkT = 100;
    }
    return r;
  }
  afterMove() {
    if (this.darkT > 0) this.darkT--;
    const v = this.vel;
    this.bodyPitch += (Math.atan2(Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]), v[1] + 0.001) * (this.inWater ? 1 : 0) - this.bodyPitch) * 0.1;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.tent + this.tentSpd * a;
    const ang = this.inWater ? (Math.abs(Math.sin(t)) < 0.5 ? 0 : 0) + (1 - Math.cos(t * 2) * 0.5 - 0.5) * Math.PI * 0.25 + 0.15 : 0.0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (P['tentacle' + i]) P['tentacle' + i].xRot = this.inWater ? ang : Math.PI / 2 * 0.0 + 0.1;
  }
  preDraw(m, a) {
    // pitched along the way it swims, around the middle of the body
    M4.translate(m, 0, 0.5, 0);
    M4.rotX(m, -(this.bodyPitch - Math.PI / 2) * 0.6 * (this.inWater ? 1 : 0));
    M4.translate(m, 0, -0.5, 0);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/squid/' + this.type + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
}
// (a vanilla squid's stroke throws it along at 0.2 blocks a tick, which then dies away)
defVMob('squid', {
  cls: Squid,
  ai: 'swim',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.4,
  stepSound: false,
  swimAcc: 0.02
});
defVMob('glow_squid', {
  cls: Squid,
