  shadowR: 0.4,
  stepSound: false,
  swimAcc: 0.02,
  bright: true
});
Object.defineProperty(VMOB.glow_squid, 'bright', {
  get() {
    return true;
  }
});

// ---- dolphins: fast swimmers that need air, leap out of the water, give the player Dolphin's Grace -------------------
class Dolphin extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.waterBreather = true;
    this.breath = 4800;
    this.persistent = false;
    this.fed = false;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      w = this.world;
    if (!this.inWater) {
      this.flop();
      return;
    }
    this.breath--;
    if (this.breath < 400) {
      // swim up for air
      let y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]);
      while (y < 320 && inWaterAt(w, this.pos[0], y + 1, this.pos[2])) y++;
      c.goal = [this.pos[0], y + 1.5, this.pos[2]];
      c.mod = 1.5;
      if (!inWaterAt(w, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h + 0.2, this.pos[2])) this.breath = 4800;
      return;
    }
    if (this.breath <= 0 && this.age % 20 === 0) this.hurt(2, {
      type: 'drown'
    });
    // swim alongside a swimming player, grant Dolphin's Grace
    // (vanilla DolphinSwimWithPlayerGoal at speed 4 runs only while the player is swimming, not just in the water)
    if (p.inWater && p.swimming && !p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 10) {
      if (p.addEffect && this.age % 20 === 0) p.addEffect('dolphins_grace', 0, 100);
      if (this.distTo(p) > 3) {
        c.goal = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1], p.pos[2]];
        c.mod = 4;
        c.look = p;
        return;
      }
    }
    // leap out of the water now and then
    if (Math.random() < 1 / 300 && !inWaterAt(w, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 2, this.pos[2]) && inWaterAt(w, this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2])) {
      this.vel[1] = 0.8;
      this.vel[0] += -Math.sin(this.yaw) * 0.6;
      this.vel[2] += -Math.cos(this.yaw) * 0.6;
      this.sound('jump');
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (!this.inWater) {
      this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
      this.dry = (this.dry || 0) + 1;
      if (this.dry > 2400 && this.age % 20 === 0) this.hurt(1, {
        type: 'drown'
      });
      return;
    }
    this.dry = 0;
    VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && /^(cod|salmon)$/.test(ITEMS[held.id].key)) {
      useOne(this.game, p);
      this.sound('eat');
      this.fed = true;
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) this.game.particles.spawn('happy_villager', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5), this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      v = this.vel;
    if (P.body) P.body.xRot = clamp(-Math.atan2(v[1], Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]) + 0.001), -1, 1) * (this.inWater ? 1 : 0.3);
    if (P.head) P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0) * 0.3;
    const sw = Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]) > 1e-4 ? 1 : 0.2;
    if (P.tail) P.tail.xRot = -0.1 * Math.cos((this.age + a) * 0.3) * sw;
    if (P.tail_fin) P.tail_fin.xRot = -0.2 * Math.cos((this.age + a) * 0.3) * sw;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/dolphin/dolphin' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  ambientKind() {
    return this.inWater ? 'ambient_water' : 'ambient';
  }
}
// (vanilla: speed 1.2 x 0.02 in water; swimming with a player at 4 times that)
defVMob('dolphin', {
  cls: Dolphin,
  ai: 'swim',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.5,
  stepSound: false,
  swimAcc: 0.024,
  fights: true,
  T: {
    attack: 3
  }
});

// ---- axolotls: play dead, hunt fish and drowned, help players fight underwater --------------------------------------
const AXOLOTL_COLORS = ['lucy', 'wild', 'gold', 'cyan', 'blue'];
class Axolotl extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.variant = Math.random() < 1 / 1200 ? 4 : randInt(0, 3);
    this.deadT = 0;
    this.dry = 0;
    this.fromBucket = false;
    this.waterBreather = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      var: this.variant,
      fb: this.fromBucket
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.variant = o.var | 0;
    this.fromBucket = !!o.fb;
    if (this.fromBucket) this.persistent = true;
  }
  compVal(k) {
    return k === 'axolotl/variant' ? AXOLOTL_COLORS[this.variant] : undefined;
  }
  get ai() {
    return 'amph';
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 20) return null;
    return this.game.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && e.inWater && /^(cod|salmon|pufferfish|tropical_fish|squid|glow_squid|drowned|guardian|elder_guardian|tadpole)$/.test(e.type) && e.distTo(this) < 8) || null;
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || !this.target.inWater)) this.target = null;
    if (!this.target) this.target = this.huntTarget();
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    // plays dead when badly hurt in water: regenerates and stops being a target
    if (r && this.health > 0 && this.health < this.maxHealth / 2 && this.inWater && Math.random() < 1 / 3 && this.deadT <= 0) {
      this.deadT = 200;
      if (this.addEffect) this.addEffect('regeneration', 0, 200);
      this.target = null;
    }
    return r;
  }
  onDeath(src) {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (src && src.attacker && src.attacker !== p && p.inWater && this.distTo(p) < 16 && p.addEffect) p.addEffect('regeneration', 0, 100);
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.deadT > 0) {
      this.deadT--;
      this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 0.025);
      return;
    }
    if (!this.inWater) {
      if (++this.dry > 6000 && this.age % 20 === 0) this.hurt(1, {
        type: 'drown'
      });
    } else this.dry = 0;
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    if (t.dead || t.deathTime) {
      const p = this.game.player;
      if (p.inWater && this.distTo(p) < 16 && p.addEffect) p.addEffect('regeneration', 0, 100);
    }
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'water_bucket' && ITEM_KEY.axolotl_bucket !== undefined) {
      swapHeld(this.game, p, 'axolotl_bucket', {
        mob: {
          var: this.variant,
          baby: this.baby ? this.growT : 0
        }
      });
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('item.bucket.fill_axolotl', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (held && isFood('axolotl_food', held.id)) {
      // fed with a bucket of tropical fish: the empty water bucket comes back
      if (this.baby) {
        this.growT -= Math.floor(this.growT * 0.1);
        swapHeld(this.game, p, 'water_bucket');
        return true;
      }
      if (this.breedCd <= 0 && !this.loveT) {
        this.loveT = 600;
        swapHeld(this.game, p, 'water_bucket');
        this.sound('eat');
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  }
  spawnChild(m) {
    const b = super.spawnChild(m);
    b.variant = Math.random() < 1 / 1200 ? 4 : Math.random() < 0.5 ? this.variant : m.variant;
    return b;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      t = this.age + a;
    if (this.baby) {
      const B = 'BabyAxolotlAnimation.';
      if (this.deadT > 0) EM.anim(md, B + 'BABY_AXOLOTL_PLAY_DEAD', t / 20);else if (this.inWater) EM.anim(md, spd > 0.05 ? B + 'BABY_AXOLOTL_SWIM' : B + 'IDLE_UNDERWATER', t / 20);else EM.walk(md, spd > 0.05 ? B + 'AXOLOTL_WALK_FLOOR' : B + 'BABY_AXOLOTL_IDLE_FLOOR', spd > 0.05 ? pos : t, spd > 0.05 ? spd : 1, 1, 2);
      return;
    }
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0) * 0.5;
    }
    if (this.deadT > 0) {
      if (P.body) P.body.zRot = Math.PI / 2 * 0.9;
      for (const n of ['right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg', 'right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg']) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].xRot = 0.5;
        P[n].zRot = n.startsWith('right') ? -0.6 : 0.6;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.inWater) {
      const s = spd > 0.05 ? 1 : 0.3,
        k = t * (spd > 0.05 ? 0.33 : 0.09);
      if (P.body) P.body.xRot = clamp(-this.vel[1] * 4, -0.6, 0.6);
      if (P.tail) P.tail.yRot = Math.sin(k) * 0.5 * s;
      if (P.head) P.head.yRot += Math.sin(k + 1) * 0.15 * s;
      for (const [n, sg] of [['right_front_leg', 1], ['left_front_leg', -1], ['right_hind_leg', 1], ['left_hind_leg', -1]]) if (P[n]) {
        P[n].xRot = spd > 0.05 ? 1.88 : 0.2;
        P[n].zRot = sg * (spd > 0.05 ? 0 : 0.6 + Math.cos(k) * 0.1);
      }
    } else {
      emQuad(md, pos * 1.5, spd);
      if (P.tail) P.tail.yRot = Math.sin(pos * 0.6662) * 0.3 * spd;
    }
    for (const n of ['top_gills', 'left_gills', 'right_gills']) if (P[n]) {
      const f = Math.sin(t * 0.1) * 0.15;
      if (n === 'top_gills') P[n].xRot = -0.2 + f;else P[n].yRot = (n === 'left_gills' ? -1 : 1) * (0.3 + f);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/axolotl/axolotl_' + AXOLOTL_COLORS[this.variant | 0] + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  ambientKind() {
    return this.inWater ? 'idle_water' : 'idle_air';
  }
}
// on land vanilla axolotls crawl (their stroll speed there is 0.15 of the 0.5 they swim with): landSpeedMul;
// in the water they get 0.1 x 0.5 x 0.5 a tick
defVMob('axolotl', {
  cls: Axolotl,
  food: 'axolotl_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.3,
  stepSound: false,
  waterOk: true,
  swimAcc: 0.025,
  landSpeedMul: 0.015,
  fights: true,
  T: {
    attack: 2
  }
});

// ---- nautiluses: saddled underwater mounts that dash; zombie nautiluses carry drowned ------------------------------------
const NAUTILUS_ARMOR = {
  copper_nautilus_armor: 'copper',
  iron_nautilus_armor: 'iron',
  golden_nautilus_armor: 'gold',
  diamond_nautilus_armor: 'diamond',
  netherite_nautilus_armor: 'netherite'
};
class Nautilus extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.waterBreather = true;
    this.saddled = false;
    this.armorItem = null;
    this.tame = type === 'nautilus' ? false : true;
    this.dashCd = 0;
    this.coral = type === 'zombie_nautilus' && Math.random() < 0.5;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      sad: this.saddled,
      arm: this.armorItem,
      tame: this.tame,
      cor: this.coral
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.saddled = !!o.sad;
    this.armorItem = o.arm || null;
    this.tame = !!o.tame;
    this.coral = !!o.cor;
  }
  dropsOnDeath() {
    return [this.armorItem];
  }
  seat() {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.8, this.pos[2]];
  }
  get ai() {
    return 'swim';
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.type === 'zombie_nautilus' && !this.tame && this.game.difficulty > 0 && !this.rider;
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (held && isFood('nautilus_food', held.id)) {
      if (!this.tame) {
        swapBucketFood(g, p, held);
        tryTame(this, p, 1 / 3);
        this.tame = !!this.owner;
        this.sitting = false;
        return true;
      }
      if (this.health < this.maxHealth) {
        this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 3);
        swapBucketFood(g, p, held);
        this.sound('eat');
        return true;
      }
      if (this.breedCd <= 0 && !this.loveT && !this.baby) {
        this.loveT = 600;
        swapBucketFood(g, p, held);
        return true;
      }
    }
    if (!this.tame) return false;
    if (k === 'saddle' && !this.saddled && !this.baby) {
      this.saddled = true;
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.nautilus.saddle', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (k && NAUTILUS_ARMOR[k] && !this.armorItem && !this.baby) {
      this.armorItem = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('item.armor.equip_nautilus', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (this.saddled && !p.vehicle) {
      p.mount(this);
      p.yaw = this.yaw;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  ridden(c, inp) {
    const p = this.rider;
    if (!this.saddled) return;
    this.yaw = p.yaw;
    const f = inp.fwd || 0;
    if (this.inWater) {
      const sp = 0.035 * (this.armorItem ? 1 : 1);
      this.vel[0] += -Math.sin(p.yaw) * Math.cos(p.pitch) * f * sp;
      this.vel[2] += -Math.cos(p.yaw) * Math.cos(p.pitch) * f * sp;
      this.vel[1] += Math.sin(p.pitch) * f * sp + (inp.jump ? 0.02 : 0);
      if (this.dashCd > 0) this.dashCd--;
      if (inp.sprint && this.dashCd <= 0 && f > 0) {
        this.vel[0] += -Math.sin(p.yaw) * 1.2;
        this.vel[2] += -Math.cos(p.yaw) * 1.2;
        this.vel[1] += Math.sin(p.pitch) * 1.2;
        this.dashCd = 40;
        this.sound('dash');
      }
    } else c.fwd = f > 0 ? 0.3 : 0;
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.rider && this.saddled && this.inWater) {
      this.move(this.vel[0], this.vel[1], this.vel[2]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.vel[i] *= 0.9;
      this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw) * 0.4;
      return;
    }
    if (!this.inWater) {
      this.travel(c.fwd, 0, 0.02, false);
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.moveBy.call(this, c);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    EM.walk(md, 'NautilusAnimation.SWIMMING', this.age + a, 1, 1, Math.max(0.2, spd * 3));
    if (P.body) P.body.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0) * 0.3;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.type === 'zombie_nautilus' ? 'entity/nautilus/zombie_nautilus' : 'entity/nautilus/nautilus' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (this.coral) {
      const cm = EM.get(r, 'zombie_nautilus_coral#main');
      if (cm) {
        EM.reset(cm);
        EM.copy(md, cm);
        r.drawEM(cm, r.etex('entity/nautilus/zombie_nautilus_coral'), m, lt, env, {
          overlay,
          cull: false
        });
      }
    }
    if (this.armorItem && !this.baby) {
      const am = EM.get(r, 'nautilus_armor#main');
      if (am) {
        EM.reset(am);
        EM.copy(md, am);
        r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/nautilus_body/' + NAUTILUS_ARMOR[ITEMS[this.armorItem.id].key]), m, lt, env, {
          overlay
        });
      }
    }
    if (this.saddled && !this.baby) {
      const sm = EM.get(r, 'nautilus#saddle');
      if (sm) {
        EM.reset(sm);
        EM.copy(md, sm);
        r.drawEM(sm, r.etex('entity/equipment/nautilus_saddle/saddle'), m, lt, env, {
          overlay
        });
      }
    }
  }
}
// food from a bucket of fish leaves the water bucket behind
function swapBucketFood(g, p, held) {
  if (/_bucket$/.test(ITEMS[held.id].key)) swapHeld(g, p, 'water_bucket');else useOne(g, p);
}
// (vanilla: 0.011 x their speed a tick in the water)
defVMob('nautilus', {
  cls: Nautilus,
  food: 'nautilus_food',
  xp: 2,
  shadowR: 0.5,
  stepSound: false,
  swimAcc: 0.011
});
defVMob('zombie_nautilus', {
  cls: Nautilus,
  xp: 5,
  shadowR: 0.5,
  stepSound: false,
  swimAcc: 0.012,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  }
});

// ---- guardians and elder guardians: charge a laser at what they see in the water -----------------------------------------
class Guardian extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.waterBreather = true;
    this.beamT = -1;
    this.spikes = 0;
    this.tailT = 0;
    this.persistent = type === 'elder_guardian';
    this.curseT = 0;
  }
  get elder() {
    return this.type === 'elder_guardian';
  }
  get beamTime() {
    return this.elder ? 60 : 80;
  }
  despawn() {
    return this.elder ? false : super.despawn();
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    // thorns from the spikes when hit up close while they're out
    if (r && src && src.attacker && src.type === 'mob' && this.beamT < 0 && src.attacker.hurt && Math.random() < 0.6) src.attacker.hurt(2, {
      type: 'thorns',
      attacker: this
    });
    return r;
  }
  findTarget() {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.distTo(this.target) > 16 || !this.canSee(this.target))) {
      this.target = null;
      this.beamT = -1;
    }
    if (!this.target && (this.age + this.id) % 10 === 0) {
      if (!p.creative && this.game.difficulty > 0 && p.inWater && this.distTo(p) < 16 && this.canSee(p)) this.target = p;else this.target = this.game.entities.find(e => (e.type === 'squid' || e.type === 'glow_squid' || e.type === 'axolotl') && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 16 && this.canSee(e)) || null;
    }
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    c.look = t;
    c.face = Math.atan2(-(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0]), -(t.pos[2] - this.pos[2]));
    if (this.beamT < 0) {
      this.beamT = 0;
      this.sound(this.inWater ? 'attack' : 'attack', 1);
    }
    if (++this.beamT >= this.beamTime) {
      const df = this.game.difficulty;
      t.hurt(1 + (df === 3 ? 2 : 0), {
        type: 'magic',
        attacker: this
      });
      t.hurt((this.elder ? 5 : 6) * (df === 1 ? 0.5 : df === 3 ? 1.5 : 1), {
        type: 'mob',
        attacker: this
      });
      this.beamT = -1;
      this.target = this.target === this.game.player ? this.target : null;
      this.attackCd = 40;
    }
  }
  think(c) {
    if (!this.inWater) {
      this.flop();
      return;
    }
    // elder guardians curse players near them with Mining Fatigue
    if (this.elder && --this.curseT <= 0) {
      this.curseT = 1200;
      const p = this.game.player;
      if (!p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 50 && p.addEffect) {
        p.addEffect('mining_fatigue', 2, 6000);
        Sound.ev('entity.elder_guardian.curse', p.pos, 1, 1);
      }
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  afterMove() {
    this.spikes += ((this.ctl.goal && this.inWater && this.beamT < 0 ? 0 : 1) - this.spikes) * 0.06;
    this.tailT += this.ctl.goal ? 0.3 : 0.06;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    // spikes out while still, in while swimming; the eye follows the target
    const ext = (1 - this.spikes) * 0 + this.spikes;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const n = P['spike' + i];
      if (n) {
        const k = 1 + (1 - ext) * -0.15 + Math.sin(t * 0.1 + i) * 0.02;
        n.x *= k;
        n.y = 16 + (n.y - 16) * k;
        n.z *= k;
      }
    }
    if (P.eye) {
      P.eye.z = -8.25;
      const lk = this.target || this.ctl.look;
      if (lk) {
        P.eye.x = clamp(-(this.headYaw || 0) * 2, -1.5, 1.5);
        P.eye.y = clamp(-(this.pitch || 0) * 4, -1.5, 1.5);
      }
    }
    const wag = Math.sin(this.tailT) * Math.PI * 0.05;
    if (P.tail0) P.tail0.yRot = wag;
    if (P.tail1) P.tail1.yRot = wag;
    if (P.tail2) P.tail2.yRot = wag;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.elder ? 'entity/guardian/guardian_elder' : 'entity/guardian/guardian');
  }
  ambientKind() {
    return this.inWater ? 'ambient' : 'ambient_land';
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt) {
    if (this.beamT < 0 || !this.target) return;
    // the beam: from the eye to the target, a strip that brightens as it charges
    const t = this.target,
      k = this.beamT / this.beamTime;
    const s = this.D.scale || 1,
      e0 = [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.5, this.pos[2]],
      e1 = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5, t.pos[2]];
    if (g.drawBeam) g.drawBeam(e0, e1, 0.2 * s, [64 + k * 191, 32 + k * 191, 128 - k * 64].map(v => v / 255), 'entity/guardian/guardian_beam', this.age + a);
  }
}
defVMob('guardian', {
  cls: Guardian,
  ai: 'swim',
  xp: 10,
  shadowR: 0.5,
  stepSound: false,
  speed3: 1,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  }
});
defVMob('elder_guardian', {
  cls: Guardian,
  layer: 'elder_guardian#main',
  ai: 'swim',
  xp: 10,
  shadowR: 1.2,
  stepSound: false,
  speed3: 0.6,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  }
});
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/mobs_hostile.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Hostile and neutral mobs drawn with the vanilla models (vmobs.js): skeleton kinds (stray, bogged, parched,
// wither skeleton), zombie kinds (husk, drowned, giant), cave spiders, silverfish, endermites, slimes, sulfur
// cubes, phantoms, witches, illagers (pillager, vindicator, evoker, illusioner) and vexes, ravagers, breezes,
// creakings, the warden, shulkers, piglin brutes, zoglins and the wither.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const diffMul = (g, d) => g.difficulty === 1 ? Math.min(d / 2 + 1, d) : g.difficulty === 3 ? d * 1.5 : d;
const lookVec = (e, t) => {
  const dx = t.pos[0] - e.pos[0],
    dy = t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5 - (e.pos[1] + e.h * 0.85),
    dz = t.pos[2] - e.pos[2],
    l = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1;
  return [dx / l, dy / l, dz / l, l];
};

// ---- humanoid monsters: an item in hand, armour, the humanoid animation ------------------------------------------
class Humanoid extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.hand = this.D.hand ? makeStack(typeof this.D.hand === 'function' ? this.D.hand(this) : this.D.hand, 1) : null;
    this.armorItems = [];
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      hand: this.hand,
      arm: this.armorItems
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    if (o.hand !== undefined) this.hand = o.hand;
    if (o.arm) this.armorItems = o.arm;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    emHumanoid(md, this, a, {
      zombie: !!this.D.zombieArms,
      bow: !!(this.D.bow && this.target)
    });
    if (this.charging && md.parts.right_arm) {
      md.parts.right_arm.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 + md.parts.head.xRot;
      md.parts.left_arm.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 + md.parts.head.xRot;
      md.parts.left_arm.yRot = 0.6;
    }
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    if (!this.hand) return null;
    const st = this.hand;
    return {
      right_arm: am => g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null)
    };
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    if (this.D.outer) {
      const om = EM.get(r, this.layerKey().replace('#main', '#outer'));
      if (om) {
        EM.reset(om);
        EM.copy(md, om);
        r.drawEM(om, r.etex(this.D.outer + (this.baby && this.D.outerBaby ? '_baby' : '')), m, lt, env, {
          overlay
        });
      }
    }
    if (this.armorItems.some(s => s)) drawVArmor(g, r, this, md, m, lt, env, overlay);
  }
}
// worn armour on a vanilla humanoid model: the layer's helmet / chestplate / leggings / boots parts, the equipment texture
function drawVArmor(g, r, e, md, m, lt, env, overlay) {
  const base = e.layerKey().split('#')[0];
  ['helmet', 'chestplate', 'leggings', 'boots'].forEach((slot, i) => {
    const st = e.armorItems[i];
    if (!st) return;
    const a = ITEMS[st.id].armor,
      mat = a && a.mat;
    if (!mat || mat === 'elytra') return;
    const am = EM.get(r, base + '#' + slot);
    if (!am) return;
    EM.reset(am);
    EM.copy(md, am);
    // (a baby model's armour layers take the 64x64 baby textures in every slot, like vanilla HUMANOID_BABY)
    const dir = /_baby$/.test(base) ? 'humanoid_baby' : slot === 'leggings' ? 'humanoid_leggings' : 'humanoid',
      m2 = mat === 'golden' ? 'gold' : mat === 'chain' || mat === 'chainmail' ? 'chainmail' : mat === 'turtle' ? 'turtle_scute' : mat;
    r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/' + dir + '/' + m2), m, lt, env, {
      overlay,
      tint: m2 === 'leather' ? dyeTintOf(st, [160 / 255, 101 / 255, 64 / 255]) : null,
      cull: false
    });
    // enchanted: the armour glint over that first layer only (render.js drawGlint; the overlay and trim cover it)
    if (typeof stackGlint === 'function' && stackGlint(st)) r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/' + dir + '/' + m2), m, lt, env, {
      overlay,
      cull: false,
      glint: 'armor',
      glintOnly: true
    });
    if (m2 === 'leather') r.drawEM(am, r.etex('entity/equipment/' + dir + '/leather_overlay'), m, lt, env, {
      overlay,
      cull: false
    });
    // its trim over it (equip.js trimTex; vanilla draws none on babies)
    const tt = st.trim && r.trimTex && !e.baby ? r.trimTex(st.trim, mat, slot === 'leggings') : null;
    if (tt) {
      r.gl.depthFunc(r.gl.LEQUAL);
      r.drawEM(am, tt, m, lt, env, {
        overlay,
        cull: false
      });
      r.gl.depthFunc(r.gl.LESS);
    }
  });
}
// random armour on spawn (vanilla: chance by difficulty, mostly leather / gold / chain / iron)
function randomArmor(e) {
  const g = e.game;
  if (Math.random() > 0.15 * (g.difficulty / 3)) return;
  const mat = pickW([['leather', 37], ['golden', 49], ['chainmail', 13], ['iron', 1]]);
  ['helmet', 'chestplate', 'leggings', 'boots'].forEach((s, i) => {
    if (Math.random() < (i === 0 ? 1 : 0.6)) {
      const k = mat + '_' + s;
      if (ITEM_KEY[k] !== undefined) e.armorItems[i] = makeStack(k, 1);
    }
  });
}

// ---- skeletons: keep their distance and shoot ---------------------------------------------------------------------
class SkeletonKind extends Humanoid {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    randomArmor(this);
    this.strafeT = 0;
    this.strafeDir = 1;
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    if (this.D.melee) return this.chase(c, t, d);
    c.look = t;
    if (d > 15) {
      c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
      this.drawT = 0;
      return;
    }
    if (d < 6) {
      const dx = this.pos[0] - t.pos[0],
        dz = this.pos[2] - t.pos[2],
        l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx / l * 3, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + dz / l * 3];
      c.mod = 0.8;
    }
    if (++this.strafeT > 20 && Math.random() < 0.3) {
      this.strafeDir *= -1;
      this.strafeT = 0;
    }
    c.strafe = this.strafeDir * 0.5;
    c.face = Math.atan2(-(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0]), -(t.pos[2] - this.pos[2]));
    if (!this.canSee(t)) {
      this.drawT = 0;
      return;
    }
    this.drawT = (this.drawT || 0) + 1;
    if (this.drawT >= (this.game.difficulty === 3 ? 20 : 40)) {
      this.drawT = 0;
      const [vx, vy, vz, l] = lookVec(this, t),
        sp = 1.6,
        err = (14 - this.game.difficulty * 4) * 0.0075;
      const arr = new Arrow(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.85, this.pos[2], [vx * sp + (Math.random() - 0.5) * err, vy * sp + l * 0.2 * 0.05 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * err, vz * sp + (Math.random() - 0.5) * err], this);
      if (this.D.tip) arr.tip = makeStack('tipped_arrow', 1), arr.tip.pot = this.D.tip;
      arr.baseDmg = 2 + this.game.difficulty * 0.11;
      if (this.fire > 0) arr.fire = 100;
      this.game.entities.push(arr);
      Sound.ev('entity.' + (this.D.soundType || this.type) + '.shoot', this.pos, 1, 1 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8));
    }
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    if (this.type === 'wither_skeleton' && t.addEffect) t.addEffect('wither', 0, 200);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    emHumanoid(md, this, a, {
      bow: !this.D.melee && !!this.target
    });
    if (this.D.melee && this.target && md.parts.right_arm) {
      const ra = md.parts.right_arm;
      ra.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 * 0.6 + (this.swingT > 0 ? -Math.sin((1 - this.swingT / 6) * Math.PI) * 1.2 : 0);
    }
  }
  // strays turn from skeletons in powder snow; skeletons in the hot desert don't burn as parched
}
for (const [t, o] of [['stray', {
  outer: 'entity/skeleton/stray_overlay',
  tip: 'slowness',
  tex: 'entity/skeleton/stray'
}], ['bogged', {
  outer: 'entity/skeleton/bogged_overlay',
  tip: 'poison',
  tex: 'entity/skeleton/bogged'
}], ['parched', {
  tex: 'entity/skeleton/parched',
  tip: 'weakness',
  burns: false
}], ['wither_skeleton', {
  tex: 'entity/skeleton/wither_skeleton',
  melee: true,
  hand: 'stone_sword',
  burns: false
}]]) {
  defVMob(t, {
    cls: SkeletonKind,
    hand: o.hand || 'bow',
    burns: o.burns !== false,
    xp: 5,
    shadowR: 0.4,
    bow: !o.melee,
    ...o,
    tex: () => o.tex,
    T: {
      hostile: true
    }
  });
}
// bogged can be sheared for their mushrooms
VMOB.bogged.postInteract = null;
SkeletonKind.prototype.postInteract = function (p, held) {
  if (this.type === 'bogged' && held && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'shears' && !this.sheared) {
    this.sheared = true;
    this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1.7, this.pos[2], makeStack('brown_mushroom', 1));
    this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1.7, this.pos[2], makeStack('red_mushroom', 1));
    Sound.ev('entity.bogged.shear', this.pos, 1, 1);
    this.game.damageHeld(1);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};
(() => {
  const _s = SkeletonKind.prototype.setupAnim;
  SkeletonKind.prototype.setupAnim = function (md, a) {
    _s.call(this, md, a);
    if (this.type === 'bogged' && md.parts.mushrooms) md.parts.mushrooms.visible = !this.sheared;
  };
})();

// ---- zombie kinds: husks (hunger, no burning), drowned (swim, tridents), giants ------------------------------------------
class ZombieKind extends Humanoid {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    randomArmor(this);
    if (type === 'drowned') {
      const r = Math.random();
      this.hand = r < 0.0625 ? makeStack('trident', 1) : r < 0.1 ? makeStack('fishing_rod', 1) : Math.random() < 0.03 ? makeStack('nautilus_shell', 1) : null;
      this.waterBreather = true;
    }
    if (Math.random() < 0.05 && type !== 'giant') this.makeBaby();
  }
  get ai() {
    return this.type === 'drowned' && this.inWater ? 'amph' : 'ground';
  }
  makeBaby() {
    super.makeBaby();
    this.growT = 1e12;
    return this;
  }
  // (vanilla Drowned.okTarget: at night, or a target in the water - by day one in the water hunted players on dry land too)
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0 && (this.type !== 'drowned' || !this.game.isDay() || this.game.player.inWater);
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 20) return null;
    return this.game.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && (e.type === 'villager' || e.type === 'wandering_trader' || e.type === 'iron_golem' || e.type === 'turtle' && e.baby) && e.distTo(this) < 16 && this.canSee(e)) || null;
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    // drowned with a trident throw it from a distance
    if (this.hand && ITEMS[this.hand.id].key === 'trident' && d > 3 && d < 16 && this.canSee(t)) {
      c.look = t;
      c.face = Math.atan2(-(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0]), -(t.pos[2] - this.pos[2]));
      this.charging = true;
      if (this.attackCd <= 0) {
        this.attackCd = 40;
        this.charging = false;
        const [vx, vy, vz, l] = lookVec(this, t);
        const tr = typeof ThrownTrident !== 'undefined' ? new ThrownTrident(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.85, this.pos[2], [vx * 1.6, vy * 1.6 + l * 0.01, vz * 1.6], this, makeStack('trident', 1)) : new Arrow(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.85, this.pos[2], [vx * 1.6, vy * 1.6, vz * 1.6], this);
        tr.noPickup = true;
        tr.baseDmg = 8;
        this.game.entities.push(tr);
        Sound.ev('entity.drowned.shoot', this.pos, 1, 1);
      }
      return;
    }
    this.charging = false;
    this.chase(c, t, d);
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    if (this.type === 'husk' && t.addEffect) t.addEffect('hunger', 0, 140 * this.game.difficulty);
    if (t === this.game.player && Math.random() < 0.05 * this.game.difficulty && this.type !== 'giant') this.callHelp = true;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.D.tex2 + (this.baby && this.type !== 'giant' ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.type === 'drowned' && this.inWater) {
      // drowned swim toward their target (or sink to the bottom)
      if (c.goal) {
        const dy = c.goal[1] - this.pos[1];
        this.vel[1] += clamp(dy, -1, 1) * 0.01;
      } else this.vel[1] -= 0.005;
      const s = this.T.speed * 0.6;
      if (c.goal) {
        const dx = c.goal[0] - this.pos[0],
          dz = c.goal[2] - this.pos[2],
          l = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (l > 0.3) {
          this.turnTo(Math.atan2(-dx, -dz), 0.3);
          this.vel[0] += dx / l * s * 0.1;
          this.vel[2] += dz / l * s * 0.1;
        }
      }
      this.move(this.vel[0], this.vel[1], this.vel[2]);
      this.vel[0] *= 0.9;
      this.vel[1] *= 0.9;
      this.vel[2] *= 0.9;
      this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw) * 0.3;
      return;
    }
    super.moveBy(c);
  }
}
const ZD = (t, tex, o = {}) => defVMob(t, {

  burns: true,
  xp: 5,
  shadowR: 0.4,
  tex2: tex,
  T: {
    hostile: true,
    attack: 3
  },
  ...o
});

// ---- cave spiders: small, poisonous, climb walls -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CaveSpider extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0 && (!this.game.isDay() || this.world.skyAt(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), Math.floor(this.pos[1] + 1), Math.floor(this.pos[2])) < 8 || this.anger > 0);
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    const d = this.game.difficulty;
    if (d >= 2 && t.addEffect) t.addEffect('poison', 0, (d === 3 ? 15 : 7) * 20);
  }
  fight(c) {
    const t = this.target,
      d = this.distTo(t);
    if (this.onGround && d < 4 && d > 2 && Math.random() < 0.1) {
      const dx = t.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
        dz = t.pos[2] - this.pos[2],
        l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      this.vel[1] = 0.4;
      this.vel[0] += dx / l * 0.3;
      this.vel[2] += dz / l * 0.3;
    }
    VMob.prototype.fight.call(this, c);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    spiderAnim(md, this, a);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/spider/cave_spider');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env) {
    const t = r.etex('entity/spider/spider_eyes');
    if (t) r.drawEMGlow(md, t, m, env, {});
  }
}
function spiderAnim(md, e, a) {
  const P = md.parts,
    [pos, spd] = emLimbs(e, a);
  emHead(P.head, e, a);
  const legs = [['right_hind_leg', 'left_hind_leg'], ['right_middle_hind_leg', 'left_middle_hind_leg'], ['right_middle_front_leg', 'left_middle_front_leg'], ['right_front_leg', 'left_front_leg']];
  legs.forEach(([rn, ln], i) => {
    const ph = [0, Math.PI, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5][i];
    const y = -Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 * 2 + ph) * 0.4 * spd,
      z = Math.abs(Math.sin(pos * 0.6662 + ph)) * 0.4 * spd;
    if (P[rn]) {
      P[rn].yRot += y;
      P[rn].zRot += z;
    }
    if (P[ln]) {
      P[ln].yRot -= y;
      P[ln].zRot -= z;
    }
  });
}
defVMob('cave_spider', {
  cls: CaveSpider,
  climbs: true,
  xp: 5,
  shadowR: 0.35,
  T: {
    hostile: true,
    attack: 2
  }
});

// ---- silverfish and endermites: small crawling pests ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Crawler extends VMob {
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  onAttacked(src) {
    // silverfish wake the ones hiding in infested blocks nearby
    if (this.type !== 'silverfish') return;
    const w = this.world,
      x0 = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      y0 = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
      z0 = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    for (let dx = -5; dx <= 5; dx++) for (let dy = -3; dy <= 3; dy++) for (let dz = -5; dz <= 5; dz++) {
      const k = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz)].key;
      if (k && k.startsWith('infested_') && Math.random() < 0.3) {
        // without mob_griefing the block turns back into its host block (infested_deepslate keeps its axis)
        const host = this.game.rule('mob_griefing') === false ? BID[k.slice(9)] : undefined;
        if (host !== undefined) w.setBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz, host, w.getMeta(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz));else w.setBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz, 0, 0);
        const s = spawnAt(this.game, 'silverfish', x0 + dx + 0.5, y0 + dy, z0 + dz + 0.5);
        s.target = src.attacker;
        s.persistent = false;
      }
    }
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const n = P['segment' + i];
      if (!n) continue;
      n.yRot = Math.cos(t * 0.9 + i * 0.15 * Math.PI) * Math.PI * 0.05 * (1 + Math.abs(i - 2));
      n.x = Math.sin(t * 0.9 + i * 0.15 * Math.PI) * Math.PI * 0.2 * Math.abs(i - 2);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const n = P['layer' + i],
        s = P['segment' + [2, 4, 1][i]];
      if (n && s) {
        n.yRot = s.yRot;
        n.x = s.x;
      }
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/' + this.type + '/' + this.type);
  }
}
defVMob('silverfish', {
  cls: Crawler,
  xp: 5,
  shadowR: 0.3,
  T: {
    hostile: true,
    attack: 1
  },
  stepSound: true
});

// ---- slimes and sulfur cubes: hop, split when they die --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Slime extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.setSize([1, 2, 4][randInt(0, 2)]);
    this.squish = 0;
    this.prevSquish = 0;
    this.jumpT = randInt(10, 30);
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  setSize(s) {
    this.size = s;
    this.w = this.h = 0.52 * s;
    this.maxHealth = this.health = s * s;
    this.T = {
      ...MOB_TYPES[this.type],
      speed: 0.2 + 0.1 * s,
      attack: s > 1 ? s : 0
    };
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      sz: this.size
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    if (o.sz) {
      const h = this.health;
      this.setSize(o.sz);
      this.health = Math.min(h, this.maxHealth);
    }
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.size > 1 && this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  think(c) {
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
    if (!this.target && !c.goal && Math.random() < 0.02) this.goal = this.randomGoal(8, 2);
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    this.prevSquish = this.squish;
    this.squish *= 0.6;
    if (this.onGround) {
      if (this.wasAir) {
        this.squish = -0.5;
        this.sound(this.size > 1 ? 'squish' : 'squish_small', 0.4 * this.size);
      }
      this.wasAir = false;
      if (--this.jumpT <= 0 && (c.goal || this.target)) {
        const gq = c.goal || this.target.pos,
          dx = gq[0] - this.pos[0],
          dz = gq[2] - this.pos[2],
          l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        this.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
        this.vel[1] = 0.42;
        const s = this.T.speed * 0.35;
        this.vel[0] = dx / l * s;
        this.vel[2] = dz / l * s;
        this.jumpT = this.target ? randInt(5, 15) : randInt(10, 30);
        this.squish = 1;
        this.sound(this.size > 1 ? 'jump' : 'jump_small', 0.4 * this.size);
      }
    } else this.wasAir = true;
    this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
    if (!this.onGround) {
      const v = this.vel;
      this.move(0, 0, 0);
      v[0] *= 1.0;
      v[2] *= 1.0;
    }
    this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw) * 0.5;
  }
  afterMove() {
    // touching damage from big slimes
    const t = this.target;
    if (t && this.size > 1 && this.attackCd <= 0 && this.distTo(t) < this.w * 0.6 + t.w * 0.5 + 0.3) {
      this.attackCd = 10;
      t.hurt(diffMul(this.game, this.T.attack), {
        type: 'mob',
        attacker: this,
        knockFrom: this.pos
      });
      this.sound('attack');
    }
  }
  fight(c) {
    c.look = this.target;
    c.goal = [...this.target.pos];
  }
  onDeath() {
    if (this.size <= 1) return;
    for (let i = 0, n = randInt(2, 4); i < n; i++) {
      const s = createMob(this.game, this.type, this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w / 2, this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.w / 2);
      s.setSize(this.size / 2);
      s.persistent = this.persistent;
      if (this.customName) s.customName = this.customName;
      this.game.entities.push(s);
    }
  }
  layerKey() {
    return 'slime#main';
  }
  renderScale(a) {
    return 0.999 * this.size;
  }
  preDraw(m, a) {
    const sq = lerp(this.prevSquish, this.squish, a) / (this.size * 0.5 + 1),
      k = 1 / (sq + 1);
    M4.scale(m, 1 / k, k, 1 / k);
  }
  setupAnim() {}
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/slime/slime');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    const om = EM.get(r, 'slime#outer'),
      gl = r.gl;
    if (!om) return;
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    r.drawEM(om, r.etex('entity/slime/slime'), m, lt, env, {
      overlay
    });
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
  }
}

    hostile: true
  },
  stepSound: false,
  noDeathFlip: false
});

  };

// sulfur cubes (26.2): bouncy cubes that swallow a block and carry it; grow on slime balls, fit in a bucket when small
const SULFUR_BLOCK_IMMUNE = new Set(['mob', 'player', 'arrow', 'trident', 'pearl', 'fall', 'cactus', 'berry', 'freeze', 'hotFloor', 'explosion']);
class SulfurCube extends Slime {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.setSize(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2);
    this.block = null;
  }
  setSize(s) {
    this.size = s;
    this.w = this.h = 0.49 * s;
    this.maxHealth = this.health = 10 * s;
    this.T = {
      ...MOB_TYPES[this.type],
      speed: 0.25,
      attack: 0
    };
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      sz: this.size,
      blk: this.block
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    if (o.sz) this.setSize(o.sz);
    this.block = o.blk || null;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  // with a block inside, vanilla takes all its goals away: it no longer hops about, it only rolls where it is knocked
  think(c) {
    if (this.block) {
      this.goal = null;
      this.target = null;
      return;
    }
    super.think(c);
  }
  // ... and shrugs off blows, shots, falls, magma blocks, explosions and the like (damage tag
  // sulfur_cube_with_block_immune_to - fire, lava and fireballs are not in it), only knocked back by them
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.block && src && SULFUR_BLOCK_IMMUNE.has(src.type) && !this.dead && !this.deathTime) {
      var _src$knock;
      if (src.knockFrom && ((_src$knock = src.knock) !== null && _src$knock !== void 0 ? _src$knock : 0.4) > 0) {
        var _src$knock2;
        const dx = this.pos[0] - src.knockFrom[0],
          dz = this.pos[2] - src.knockFrom[2],
          d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1,
          k = (_src$knock2 = src.knock) !== null && _src$knock2 !== void 0 ? _src$knock2 : 0.4;
        this.vel[0] = this.vel[0] / 2 + dx / d * k;
        this.vel[2] = this.vel[2] / 2 + dz / d * k;
        if (this.onGround) this.vel[1] = Math.min(0.4, this.vel[1] / 2 + 0.36);
      }
      return true;
    }
    return super.hurt(a, src);
  }
  onDeath() {
    if (this.block) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.3, this.pos[2], this.block);
  }
  preInteract(p, held) {
    const g = this.game,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (k === 'slime_ball' && this.size < 2) {
      this.setSize(2);
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('eat');
      return true;
    }
    if (k === 'bucket' && this.size === 1 && ITEM_KEY.sulfur_cube_bucket !== undefined) {
      swapHeld(g, p, 'sulfur_cube_bucket', {
        mob: {
          blk: this.block
        }
      });
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('item.bucket.fill_sulfur_cube', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id].block !== undefined && !this.block && SOLIDCUBE[ITEMS[held.id].block]) {
      this.block = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      this.sound('absorb');
      return true;
    }
    if (!held && this.block) {
      g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h, this.pos[2], this.block);
      this.block = null;
      this.sound('eject');
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  layerKey() {
    return this.size > 1 ? 'sulfur_cube#main' : 'sulfur_cube_small#main';
  }
  renderScale() {
    return 1;
  }
  // (vanilla: no squish while it holds a block)
  preDraw(m, a) {
    M4.translate(m, 0, this.h / 2, 0);
    const sq = this.block ? 0 : lerp(this.prevSquish, this.squish, a) * 0.3,
      k = 1 / (sq + 1);
    M4.scale(m, 1 / k, k, 1 / k);
    M4.translate(m, 0, -1.501, 0);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/sulfur_cube/sulfur_cube_inner' + (this.size > 1 ? '' : '_small'));
  }
  drawVM(g, r, m, a, env, lt, overlay) {
    const big = this.size > 1,
      im = EM.get(r, big ? 'sulfur_cube#inner' : 'sulfur_cube_small#inner'),
      om = EM.get(r, this.layerKey());
    // the swallowed block takes the inner cube's place at its size (vanilla SulfurCubeInnerLayer: the block instead of
    // the cube - drawn smaller inside the opaque cube, it was never seen)
    const blk = this.block && g.blockMesh && ITEMS[this.block.id] ? ITEMS[this.block.id].block : undefined;
    if (blk !== undefined) {
      const mm = M4.copy(m);
      M4.translate(mm, 0, 1.501, 0);
      const s = big ? 1 : 0.5;
      M4.translate(mm, -s / 2, -0.518 * s, -s / 2);
      M4.scale(mm, s, s, s);
      r.drawMesh(g.blockMesh(blk, 0), mm, env, lt);
    } else if (im) r.drawEM(im, this.texKey(r), m, lt, env, {
      overlay
    });
    if (om) {
      const gl = r.gl;
      gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
      r.drawEM(om, r.etex('entity/sulfur_cube/sulfur_cube_outer' + (big ? '' : '_small')), m, lt, env, {
        overlay
      });
      gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    }
  }
}

// ---- phantoms: circle overhead at night, swoop at players who haven't slept ---------------------------------------------------
class Phantom extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.circle = [x, y, z];
    this.ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    this.swoop = 0;
    this.size = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player;
    this.ang += 0.04;
    if (this.target && this.swoop <= 0 && this.age % 100 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) this.swoop = 60;
    if (this.target && this.swoop > 0) {
      this.swoop--;
      const t = this.target;
      c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5, t.pos[2]];
      c.mod = 2;
      if (this.distTo(t) < 1.5 && this.attackCd <= 0) {
        this.melee(t);
        this.swoop = 0;
        this.circle = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1] + 20 + randInt(0, 10), t.pos[2]];
        this.sound('bite');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.target) this.circle = [this.target.pos[0], Math.max(this.circle[1], this.target.pos[1] + 15), this.target.pos[2]];
    c.goal = [this.circle[0] + Math.cos(this.ang) * 12, this.circle[1] + Math.sin(this.ang * 2) * 2, this.circle[2] + Math.sin(this.ang) * 12];
    if (this.age % 40 === 0) this.sound('swoop', 0.3);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = (this.age + this.id * 3 + a) * 7.448451 * Math.PI / 180,
      f = Math.cos(t) * 16 * Math.PI / 180;
    if (P.left_wing_base) P.left_wing_base.zRot = f;
    if (P.left_wing_tip) P.left_wing_tip.zRot = f;
    if (P.right_wing_base) P.right_wing_base.zRot = -f;
    if (P.right_wing_tip) P.right_wing_tip.zRot = -f;
    if (P.tail_base) P.tail_base.xRot = -(5 + Math.cos(t * 2) * 5) * Math.PI / 180;
    if (P.tail_tip) P.tail_tip.xRot = -(5 + Math.cos(t * 2) * 5) * Math.PI / 180;
  }
  preDraw(m) {
    M4.translate(m, 0, 1.3125, 0.1875);
    M4.rotX(m, -(this.pitch3 || 0));
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/phantom/phantom');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env) {
    const t = r.etex('entity/phantom/phantom_eyes');
    if (t) r.drawEMGlow(md, t, m, env, {});
  }
}

// phantoms come for players who haven't slept for three nights (vanilla's insomnia, the TIME_SINCE_REST stat), at night,
// from the sea level up under open sky (PhantomSpawner). Lying down in a bed sets the count back (trySleep below): it never
// did, so after an hour of play they came every night, sleeping or not - "睡觉时还会刷幻翼", feedback 2026-11-02. And none
// by day in the rain: vanilla needs the sky darkened by 5, which by day takes a thunderstorm (there are none here)
Game.prototype.trySpawnPhantoms = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world;
  if (this.difficulty === 0 || p.creative || this.dim && this.dim !== 'overworld') return;
  p.sinceRest = (p.sinceRest || 0) + 1200;
  if (this.sleeping || spawnDarken(this) < 5) return;
  if (p.sinceRest < 72000 || Math.random() * p.sinceRest < 72000) return;
  if (Math.floor(p.pos[1]) < (w.flat ? 0 : SEA + 1) || w.skyAt(Math.floor(p.pos[0]), Math.floor(p.pos[1] + 2), Math.floor(p.pos[2])) < 15) return;
  const n = 1 + randInt(0, this.difficulty);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const m = spawnAt(this, 'phantom', p.pos[0] + randInt(-10, 10), p.pos[1] + 20 + randInt(0, 14), p.pos[2] + randInt(-10, 10));
    m.persistent = false;
    m.target = p;
  }
};
(() => {
  const _sleep = Game.prototype.trySleep;
  Game.prototype.trySleep = function (...a) {
    const r = _sleep.apply(this, a);
    if (this.sleeping && this.player) this.player.sinceRest = 0;
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- witches: throw harmful potions, drink helpful ones -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Witch extends Humanoid {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.hand = null;
    this.drinkT = 0;
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    c.look = t;
    if (this.drinkT > 0) return;
    if (d > 8) c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
    if (this.attackCd <= 0 && d < 10 && this.canSee(t)) {
      this.attackCd = 60;
      const hasFx = k => t.hasEffect && t.hasEffect(k);
      const pot = d >= 8 && !hasFx('slowness') ? 'slowness' : t.health >= 8 && !hasFx('poison') ? 'poison' : d <= 3 && !hasFx('weakness') && Math.random() < 0.25 ? 'weakness' : 'harming';
      const [vx, vy, vz, l] = lookVec(this, t),
        st = makeStack('splash_potion', 1);
      st.pot = pot;
      if (typeof ThrownPotion !== 'undefined') this.game.entities.push(new ThrownPotion(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.85, this.pos[2], [vx * 0.75, vy * 0.75 + l * 0.02 + 0.2, vz * 0.75], this, st));
      this.sound('throw');
    }
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.drinkT > 0) {
      if (--this.drinkT === 0 && this.hand) {
        const k = this.hand.pot;
        for (const [e, t, amp] of typeof POTIONS !== 'undefined' && POTIONS[k] || []) {
          if (e === 'instant_health') this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 4 * (amp + 1));else if (this.addEffect) this.addEffect(e, amp, t);
        }
        this.hand = null;
      }
      return;
    }
    const pot = this.inWater && this.air < 200 ? 'water_breathing' : this.fire > 0 ? 'fire_resistance' : this.health < this.maxHealth && Math.random() < 0.05 ? 'healing' : this.target && this.distTo(this.target) > 11 && Math.random() < 0.05 ? 'swiftness' : null;
    if (pot) {
      this.hand = makeStack('potion', 1);
      this.hand.pot = pot;
      this.drinkT = 32;
      this.sound('drink');
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd * 0.5;
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd * 0.5;
    if (P.nose) {
      P.nose.x = 0;
      P.nose.z = 0;
      if (this.drinkT > 0) P.nose.y = -2 + Math.sin(this.age * 0.8) * 0.5;
    }
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    if (!this.hand) return null;
    const st = this.hand;
    return {
      arms: am => {
        M4.translate(am, 0, 0.25, -0.15);
        M4.rotX(am, Math.PI);
        M4.scale(am, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75);
        g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null);
      }
    };
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/witch/witch');
  }
}

  shadowR: 0.4,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  },
  immune: []
});

// ---- illagers -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Illager extends Humanoid {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.spellT = 0;
    this.spell = null;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 20) return null;
    return this.game.entities.find(e => !e.dead && !e.deathTime && (e.type === 'villager' || e.type === 'wandering_trader' || e.type === 'iron_golem') && e.distTo(this) < 16 && this.canSee(e)) || null;
  }
  get aggressive() {
    return !!this.target;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd * 0.5;
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd * 0.5;
    const crossed = !(this.target || this.spellT > 0 || this.charging || this.type === 'pillager' && this.hand);
    if (P.arms) P.arms.visible = crossed;
    if (P.right_arm) P.right_arm.visible = !crossed;
    if (P.left_arm) P.left_arm.visible = !crossed;
    if (crossed) return;
    const t = this.age + a;
    if (this.spellT > 0) {
      // spellcasting: both arms up, waving
      P.right_arm.z = 0;
      P.right_arm.x = -5;
      P.left_arm.z = 0;
      P.left_arm.x = 5;
      P.right_arm.xRot = Math.cos(t * 0.6662) * 0.25;
      P.left_arm.xRot = Math.cos(t * 0.6662) * 0.25;
      P.right_arm.zRot = 2.3561945;
      P.left_arm.zRot = -2.3561945;
      P.right_arm.yRot = 0;
      P.left_arm.yRot = 0;
    } else if (this.charging || this.type === 'pillager' && this.target) {
      // crossbow held up and aimed
      P.right_arm.yRot = -0.3 + P.head.yRot;
      P.left_arm.yRot = 0.6 + P.head.yRot;
      P.right_arm.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 + P.head.xRot + 0.1;
      P.left_arm.xRot = -1.5 + P.head.xRot;
    } else {
      // melee: arms forward, swinging the weapon
      const s = this.swingT > 0 ? Math.sin((1 - this.swingT / 6) * Math.PI) : 0;
      P.right_arm.xRot = -Math.PI / 2 * 0.8 - s * 1.2;
      P.left_arm.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 0.5 * spd;
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/illager/' + this.type);
  }
}
class Pillager extends Illager {
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    c.look = t;
    if (d > 12) {
      c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
      this.charging = false;
      return;
    }
    if (d < 5) {
      const dx = this.pos[0] - t.pos[0],
        dz = this.pos[2] - t.pos[2],
        l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx / l * 3, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + dz / l * 3];
    }
    c.face = Math.atan2(-(t.pos[0] - this.pos[0]), -(t.pos[2] - this.pos[2]));
    this.charging = true;
    if (!this.canSee(t)) return;
    this.loadT = (this.loadT || 0) + 1;
    if (this.loadT === 1) Sound.ev('item.crossbow.loading_start', this.pos, 1, 1);
    if (this.loadT >= 25 && this.attackCd <= 0) {
      this.loadT = 0;
      this.attackCd = 20 + randInt(0, 20);
      const [vx, vy, vz, l] = lookVec(this, t),
        sp = 1.6;
      const arr = new Arrow(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.85, this.pos[2], [vx * sp, vy * sp + l * 0.015, vz * sp], this);
      arr.baseDmg = 3;
      this.game.entities.push(arr);
      Sound.ev('item.crossbow.shoot', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    const st = this.hand;
    if (!st) return null;
    const k = this.target ? 'right_arm' : 'right_arm';
    return {
      [k]: am => g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null)
    };
  }
}
class Vindicator extends Illager {
  get johnny() {
    return this.customName === 'Johnny';
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if (this.johnny && (this.age + this.id) % 20 === 0) return this.game.entities.find(e => e instanceof Mob && e !== this && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 16 && !(e instanceof Illager) && e.type !== 'ravager') || null;
    return super.huntTarget();
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    if (!this.target || !this.hand) return null;
    const st = this.hand;
    return {
      right_arm: am => g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null)
    };
  }
}
class Evoker extends Illager {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.hand = null;
    this.castCd = 0;
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    c.look = t;
    if (this.spellT > 0) {
      if (--this.spellT === 0) this.castSpell(t);
      return;
    }
    if (d < 8) {
      const dx = this.pos[0] - t.pos[0],
        dz = this.pos[2] - t.pos[2],
        l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx / l * 4, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + dz / l * 4];
      c.mod = 0.6;
    } else if (d > 12) c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
    if (--this.castCd <= 0 && this.canSee(t)) {
      const vexes = this.game.entities.filter(e => e.type === 'vex' && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 16).length;
      this.spell = vexes < 8 && Math.random() < 0.4 ? 'vex' : 'fangs';
      this.spellT = this.spell === 'vex' ? 100 : 40;
      this.castCd = this.spell === 'vex' ? 340 : 100;
      Sound.ev(this.spell === 'vex' ? 'entity.evoker.prepare_summon' : 'entity.evoker.prepare_attack', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
  }
  castSpell(t) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.spell === 'vex') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const v = spawnAt(g, 'vex', this.pos[0] + randInt(-2, 2), this.pos[1] + 1, this.pos[2] + randInt(-2, 2));
        v.owner = this;
        v.target = t;
        v.life = 30 * (20 + randInt(0, 90));
        v.persistent = false;
      }
      Sound.ev('entity.evoker.cast_spell', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return;
    }
    // a line of fangs toward the target, or a ring around itself when it is close
    const near = this.distTo(t) < 3;
    if (near) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = i * Math.PI * 2 / 5;
        evokerFang(g, this, this.pos[0] + Math.cos(a) * 1.5, this.pos[2] + Math.sin(a) * 1.5, 0);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = i * Math.PI * 2 / 8 + 1.2566371;
        evokerFang(g, this, this.pos[0] + Math.cos(a) * 2.5, this.pos[2] + Math.sin(a) * 2.5, 3);
      }
    } else {
      const a = Math.atan2(t.pos[2] - this.pos[2], t.pos[0] - this.pos[0]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const d = 1.25 * (i + 1);
        evokerFang(g, this, this.pos[0] + Math.cos(a) * d, this.pos[2] + Math.sin(a) * d, i);
      }
    }
    Sound.ev('entity.evoker.cast_spell', this.pos, 1, 1);
  }
}
// evoker fangs: snap shut a moment after appearing, biting what stands on them
class EvokerFangs extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, delay, owner) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.5, 0.8);
    this.delay = delay;
    this.owner = owner;
    this.life = 0;
    this.yaw = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    if (--this.delay > 0) return;
    this.life++;
    if (this.life === 1) Sound.ev('entity.evoker_fangs.attack', this.pos, 1, Math.random() * 0.2 + 0.85);
    if (this.life === 4) for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof Living && e !== this.owner && !(e instanceof Illager) && !e.dead && Math.abs(e.pos[0] - this.pos[0]) < 0.6 + e.w / 2 && Math.abs(e.pos[2] - this.pos[2]) < 0.6 + e.w / 2 && Math.abs(e.pos[1] - this.pos[1]) < 1) e.hurt(6, {
      type: 'magic',
      attacker: this.owner
    });
    if (this.life > 22) this.dead = true;
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a) {
    if (this.delay > 0) return;
    const r = g.renderer,
      md = EM.get(r, 'evoker_fangs#main'),
      tex = r.etex('entity/illager/evoker_fangs');
    if (!md || !tex) return;
    EM.reset(md);
    const t = Math.min(1, (this.life + a) / 20),
      bite = t > 0.9 ? 1 : 0,
      open = Math.sin(Math.min(1, t * 2) * Math.PI);
    if (md.parts.upper_jaw) md.parts.upper_jaw.zRot = Math.PI - (1 - bite) * open * 0.35 * Math.PI;
    if (md.parts.lower_jaw) md.parts.lower_jaw.zRot = Math.PI + (1 - bite) * open * 0.35 * Math.PI;
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1] - (t > 0.9 ? (t - 0.9) * 10 : 0) * 0.5 - (1 - Math.min(1, t * 4)) * 0.7, ip[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, this.yaw);
    r.drawEM(md, tex, m, this.lightAt(), g.envCache || {
      day: 1,
      fogColor: [0, 0, 0],
      fogNear: 1e8,
      fogFar: 2e8,
      nightTint: [1, 1, 1]
    }, {});
  }
}
function evokerFang(g, owner, x, z, delay) {
  let y = Math.floor(owner.pos[1]) + 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < 6 && !SOLIDCUBE[g.world.getBlock(Math.floor(x), y - 1, Math.floor(z))]; k++) y--;
  if (SOLIDCUBE[g.world.getBlock(Math.floor(x), y, Math.floor(z))]) return;
  g.entities.push(new EvokerFangs(g, x, y, z, delay, owner));
}
// vexes: fly through walls with a sword, die after a while
class Vex extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.noClip = true;
    this.life = 0;
    this.hand = makeStack('iron_sword', 1);
    this.chargeT = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  // its limited life is saved (vanilla LifeTicks); an evoker's vex doesn't come back as the player's
  extraSave() {
    return {
      own: this.owner && this.owner === this.game.player ? 1 : 0,
      life: this.life
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.life = o.life | 0;
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.life > 0 && --this.life === 0) {
      this.hurt(1000, {
        type: 'generic'
      });
      return;
    }
    if (this.target) {
      const t = this.target;
      if (this.chargeT <= 0 && Math.random() < 0.02) this.chargeT = 20;
      if (this.chargeT > 0) {
        this.chargeT--;
        c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5, t.pos[2]];
        c.mod = 2;
        if (this.distTo(t) < 1.2 && this.attackCd <= 0) {
          this.melee(t);
          this.chargeT = 0;
        }
        return;
      }
      c.goal = [t.pos[0] + Math.cos(this.age * 0.05) * 3, t.pos[1] + 2, t.pos[2] + Math.sin(this.age * 0.05) * 3];
      c.look = t;
      return;
    }
    const o = this.owner && !this.owner.dead ? this.owner.pos : this.pos;
    if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 1) || Math.random() < 0.02) this.goal = [o[0] + randInt(-7, 7), o[1] + randInt(0, 4), o[2] + randInt(-7, 7)];
    c.goal = this.goal;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    emHead(P.head, this, a);
    const f = Math.cos(t * 5.5 * Math.PI / 180) * 0.1;
    if (P.right_arm) {
      P.right_arm.zRot = Math.PI / 5 + f;
      P.right_arm.xRot = this.chargeT > 0 ? -Math.PI * 0.8 : -0.3;
    }
    if (P.left_arm) P.left_arm.zRot = -(Math.PI / 5 + f);
    if (P.right_wing) {
      P.right_wing.yRot = 0.47 + Math.cos(t * 45.836624 * Math.PI / 180) * 0.3;
      P.right_wing.xRot = 0.47;
      P.right_wing.zRot = -0.47;
    }
    if (P.left_wing) {
      P.left_wing.yRot = -(0.47 + Math.cos(t * 45.836624 * Math.PI / 180) * 0.3);
      P.left_wing.xRot = 0.47;
      P.left_wing.zRot = 0.47;
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.chargeT > 0 ? 'entity/illager/vex_charging' : 'entity/illager/vex');
  }
  attachments(g, md, lt, env) {
    const st = this.hand;
    return {
      right_arm: am => {
        M4.translate(am, 0.0625, 0.4, 0);
        M4.scale(am, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6);
        g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, this, null);
      }
    };
  }
}

// ---- ravagers: charge and roar --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Ravager extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.roarT = 0;
    this.stunT = 0;
    this.atkT = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.stunT > 0) {
      this.stunT--;
      if (this.stunT === 0) {
        this.roarT = 20;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.roarT > 0) {
      if (--this.roarT === 10) {
        this.sound('roar');
        for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e instanceof Living && e !== this && !(e instanceof Illager) && e.distTo(this) < 4) {
          e.hurt(6, {
            type: 'mob',
            attacker: this
          });
          const dx = e.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
            dz = e.pos[2] - this.pos[2],
            l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
          e.vel[0] += dx / l * 1;
          e.vel[2] += dz / l * 1;
          e.vel[1] = 0.3;
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
    // tramples leaves and crops in the way (vanilla: only with mob_griefing)
    if (this.collidedH && this.age % 5 === 0 && this.game.rule('mob_griefing') !== false) {
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0] - Math.sin(this.yaw) * 1.6),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2] - Math.cos(this.yaw) * 1.6);
      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
        const id = this.world.getBlock(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1]) + dy, z),
          k = BLOCKS[id].key;
        if (/leaves$|^(wheat|carrots|potatoes|beetroots|melon_stem|pumpkin_stem)$/.test(k)) this.game.breakBlockAt ? this.game.breakBlockAt(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1]) + dy, z) : this.world.setBlock(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1]) + dy, z, 0, 0);
      }
    }
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    this.atkT = 10;
    if (t.usingItem && t.inv && t.inv.held && ITEMS[t.inv.held.id].key === 'shield') this.stunT = 40;
  }
  afterMove() {
    if (this.atkT > 0) this.atkT--;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
    emQuad(md, pos, spd * 0.4);
    if (P.mouth) P.mouth.xRot = this.atkT > 0 ? Math.sin(this.atkT / 10 * Math.PI) * 0.6 : this.roarT > 0 ? 0.8 : 0;
    if (P.neck && this.stunT > 0) P.neck.y = -7 + Math.sin(this.age) * 1;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/illager/ravager');
  }
}

  cls: Ravager,
  xp: 20,
  shadowR: 1.1,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  },
  reach: 1.2,
  attackCd: 10
});

// ---- breezes: hop around and blast wind charges -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Breeze extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.st = 'idle';
    this.stT = 0;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (src && (src.type === 'arrow' || src.projectile)) {
      this.sound('deflect');
      return false;
    }
    return super.hurt(a, src);
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  ranged(c, t, d) {
    c.look = t;
    this.stT++;
    if (this.st === 'idle' && this.stT > 30) {
      if (d < 20 && this.canSee(t) && Math.random() < 0.5) {
        this.st = 'shoot';
        this.stT = 0;
        this.anims = {
          SHOOT: this.age
        };
        this.sound('inhale');
      } else if (this.onGround) {
        this.st = 'jump';
        this.stT = 0;
        this.anims = {
          JUMP: this.age
        };
        this.sound('charge');
      }
    } else if (this.st === 'shoot' && this.stT === 20) {
      const [vx, vy, vz] = lookVec(this, t);
      const wc = typeof Thrown !== 'undefined' ? new Thrown(this.game, this.pos[0] + vx, this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.6, this.pos[2] + vz, [vx * 0.7, vy * 0.7, vz * 0.7], this, 'wind_charge') : null;
      if (wc) {
        wc.breeze = true;
        this.game.entities.push(wc);
      }
      this.sound('shoot');
    } else if (this.st === 'jump' && this.stT === 10) {
      const a2 = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      this.vel[1] = 0.9;
      this.vel[0] = Math.cos(a2) * 0.4;
      this.vel[2] = Math.sin(a2) * 0.4;
      this.sound('jump');
    } else if (this.stT > 40) {
      this.st = 'idle';
      this.stT = 0;
      this.anims = {};
    }
  }
  think(c) {
    if (!this.target) {
      this.st = 'idle';
      this.stT = 0;
    }
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  onLand(d) {
    if (this.st === 'jump') this.sound('land');
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    EM.anim(md, 'BreezeAnimation.IDLE', t / 20);
    for (const k in this.anims) EM.anim(md, 'BreezeAnimation.' + k, (this.age - this.anims[k] + a) / 20);
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
    if (P.rods) P.rods.yRot = t * Math.PI * 0.1;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/breeze/breeze');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt) {
    const wm = EM.get(r, 'breeze#wind'),
      et = r.etex('entity/breeze/breeze_eyes'),
      em = EM.get(r, 'breeze#eyes');
    if (wm) {
      EM.reset(wm);
      EM.copy(md, wm);
      const gl = r.gl;
      gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
      r.drawEM(wm, r.etex('entity/breeze/breeze_wind'), m, [1, 1], env, {
        cull: false
      });
      gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    }
    if (em && et) {
      EM.reset(em);
      EM.copy(md, em);
      r.drawEMGlow(em, et, m, env, {});
    }
  }
}

  T: {
    hostile: true
  },
  stepSound: false,
  immune: ['fall']
});

// ---- creakings: freeze while watched; tied to a creaking heart that protects them -------------------------------------------------------------------
class Creaking extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.heart = null;
    this.frozen = false;
    this.persistent = false;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      heart: this.heart
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.heart = o.heart || null;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  watched() {
    const p = this.game.player;
    if (p.creative || this.distTo(p) > 24) return false;
    const dx = this.pos[0] - p.pos[0],
      dy = this.pos[1] + 1.5 - (p.pos[1] + 1.6),
      dz = this.pos[2] - p.pos[2],
      l = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1;
    const lx = -Math.sin(p.yaw) * Math.cos(p.pitch),
      ly = Math.sin(p.pitch),
      lz = -Math.cos(p.yaw) * Math.cos(p.pitch);
    return (dx * lx + dy * ly + dz * lz) / l > 0.8 && this.canSee(p);
  }
  think(c) {
    if (this.heart) {
      const [x, y, z] = this.heart,
        k = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].key;
      if (k !== 'creaking_heart' || this.game.isDay()) {
        this.dead = true;
        particleBurst(this.game, 'poof', this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 1, this.pos[2], 20, 1.5);
        this.sound('death');
        return;
      }
      if (Math.hypot(x - this.pos[0], z - this.pos[2]) > 32) {
        c.goal = [x, y, z];
        return;
      }
    }
    const was = this.frozen;
    this.frozen = this.watched();
    if (this.frozen) {
      if (!was) this.sound('freeze');
      return;
    }
    if (was) this.sound('unfreeze');
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.heart) {
      this.anims.INVULNERABLE = this.age;
      this.sound('sway');
      Sound.ev('block.creaking_heart.hurt', [this.heart[0], this.heart[1], this.heart[2]], 1, 1);
      this.hurtTime = 0;
      return false;
    }
    return super.hurt(a, src);
  }
  moveBy(c) {
    if (this.frozen) {
      this.travel(0, 0, 0, false);
      return;
    }
    super.moveBy(c);
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    this.anims.ATTACK = this.age;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
    if (!this.frozen) EM.walk(md, 'CreakingAnimation.CREAKING_WALK', pos, spd, 1, 1);
    for (const k in this.anims) EM.anim(md, 'CreakingAnimation.CREAKING_' + k, (this.age - this.anims[k] + a) / 20);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/creaking/creaking');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env) {
    if (this.frozen) return;
    const t = r.etex('entity/creaking/creaking_eyes'),
      em = EM.get(r, 'creaking#eyes');
    if (t && em) {
      EM.reset(em);
      EM.copy(md, em);
      r.drawEMGlow(em, t, m, env, {});
    }
  }
}
