  xp: 0,
  shadowR: 0.6,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  },
  reach: 0.8
});
// an active creaking heart (between two pale oak logs, at night) brings out its creaking
BLOCK_RANDOM_TICK.creaking_heart = (g, x, y, z, id, m) => {
  if (g.isDay() || g.difficulty === 0) return;
  const w = g.world,
    ax = Features.propOf(id, m, 'axis') || 'y',
    D = {
      x: [1, 0, 0],
      y: [0, 1, 0],
      z: [0, 0, 1]
    }[ax];
  const log = (dx, dy, dz) => /pale_oak_(log|wood)$/.test(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)].key);
  if (!log(D[0], D[1], D[2]) || !log(-D[0], -D[1], -D[2])) return;
  if (g.entities.some(e => e instanceof Creaking && e.heart && e.heart[0] === x && e.heart[1] === y && e.heart[2] === z)) return;
  for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
    const sx = x + randInt(-16, 16),
      sz = z + randInt(-16, 16);
    let sy = y + 8;
    while (sy > y - 8 && !SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(sx, sy - 1, sz)]) sy--;
    if (w.getBlock(sx, sy, sz) || w.getBlock(sx, sy + 1, sz) || w.getBlock(sx, sy + 2, sz)) continue;
    const c = spawnAt(g, 'creaking', sx + 0.5, sy, sz + 0.5);
    c.heart = [x, y, z];
    c.persistent = false;
    Sound.ev('block.creaking_heart.spawn', [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5], 1, 1);
    return;
  }
};

// ---- the warden: blind, hunts by sound and smell, a sonic boom for what it can't reach -----------------------------------------------------------------
class Warden extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.st = 'emerge';
    this.stT = 0;
    this.anims = {
      EMERGE: this.age
    };
    this.angerAt = new Map();
    this.boomCd = 0;
    this.sniffT = 0;
    this.persistent = true;
    this.idleCalm = 0;
    this.sound('emerge');
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      st: this.st === 'dig' ? 'idle' : this.st
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.st = 'idle';
    this.anims = {};
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return false;
  }
  // (vanilla: not hurt while coming out of the ground or going back in; a creative player is never its target - hit by
  // one it roared and turned on them every time, then forgot them at once: "出场时一直打他，动画循环鬼畜", "每次攻击都重新咆哮")
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.st === 'emerge' || this.st === 'dig') return false;
    const atk = src && src.attacker,
      ignored = !!atk && atk === this.game.player && this.game.player.creative;
    const r = super.hurt(a, src);
    if (ignored && this.target === atk) this.target = null;else if (r && atk) this.addAnger(atk, 100);
    return r;
  }
  addAnger(e, n) {
    if (e === this.game.player && this.game.player.creative) return;
    this.angerAt.set(e, Math.min(150, (this.angerAt.get(e) || 0) + n));
    if ((this.angerAt.get(e) || 0) >= 80 && this.target !== e) this.roarAt(e);
  }
  // (vanilla setAttackTarget: no sonic boom for the first 10 s)
  roarAt(e) {
    this.target = e;
    this.anims.ROAR = this.age;
    this.roarT = 84;
    this.sound('roar');
    this.sonicT = 0;
    this.boomCd = 200;
  }
  // a target dead (or gone creative) is let go and its anger forgotten; then the one it is angriest at (80 or more) is
  // next, as vanilla's AngerManagement - it went on swinging at the dead one
  findTarget() {
    const p = this.game.player,
      bad = e => e.dead || e.deathTime || e === p && (p.creative || p.spectator);
    if (this.target && bad(this.target)) {
      this.angerAt.delete(this.target);
      this.target = null;
      this.sonicT = 0;
    }
    if (this.target) return;
    let best = null,
      bv = 79;
    for (const [e, v] of this.angerAt) if (v > bv && !bad(e)) {
      best = e;
      bv = v;
    }
    if (best) this.roarAt(best);
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player;
    this.stT++;
    if (this.st === 'emerge') {
      if (this.stT > 134) {
        this.st = 'idle';
        this.anims = {};
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.st === 'dig') {
      if (this.stT > 100) this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    if (this.roarT > 0) {
      this.roarT--;
      return;
    }
    // vibrations: a player moving without sneaking, nearby; darkness to the players around it
    if (!p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 16 && !p.sneaking && Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - p.prev[0], p.pos[1] - p.prev[1], p.pos[2] - p.prev[2]) > 0.05 && this.age % 10 === 0) {
      this.addAnger(p, 10);
      this.sound('listening', 0.6);
    }
    if (this.age % 120 === 0 && !p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 20 && p.addEffect) p.addEffect('darkness', 0, 260);
    if (this.boomCd > 0) this.boomCd--;
    for (const [e, v] of this.angerAt) {
      if (v <= 1 || e.dead) this.angerAt.delete(e);else if (this.age % 20 === 0) this.angerAt.set(e, v - 1);
    }
    this.findTarget();
    if (this.roarT > 0) return;
    if (this.target) {
      const t = this.target,
        d = this.distTo(t);
      c.look = t;
      // the sonic boom: when out of reach for a while; the next no sooner than 2 s after this one is over (vanilla
      // SonicBoom.stop - the cooldown ran out while it charged, so they came one right after another)
      if (this.sonicT > 0) {
        if (--this.sonicT === 26) {
          const [vx,, vz] = lookVec(this, t),
            kr = 1 - (t.T && t.T.kbRes || 0);
          if (t.hurt(10, {
            type: 'sonic_boom',
            attacker: this
          }) && kr > 0) {
            t.vel[0] += vx * 2.5 * kr;
            t.vel[1] += 0.5 * kr;
            t.vel[2] += vz * 2.5 * kr;
          }
          this.sound('sonic_boom', 3);
          for (let i = 1; i < Math.floor(d); i++) g.particles.spawn('poof', this.pos[0] + vx * i, this.pos[1] + 1.6 + (t.pos[1] - this.pos[1]) * i / d, this.pos[2] + vz * i, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        if (this.sonicT === 0) this.boomCd = 40;
        return;
      }
      if (d > 4 && d < 15 && this.boomCd <= 0 && this.canSee(t) && Math.random() < 0.05) {
        this.sonicT = 60;
        this.anims.SONIC_BOOM = this.age;
        this.sound('sonic_charge', 3);
        return;
      }
      c.goal = [t.pos[0], t.pos[1], t.pos[2]];
      c.mod = 1.2;
      if (d < 2.5 && this.attackCd <= 0) {
        this.melee(t);
        this.anims.ATTACK = this.age;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (Math.random() < 1 / 300) {
      this.anims.SNIFF = this.age;
      this.sound('sniff');
      const near = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof Living && e !== this && !(e instanceof Warden) && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 24 && !(e === p && p.creative));
      if (near) this.addAnger(near, 35);
    }
    // calm for a long while: digs back into the ground
    if (++this.idleCalm > 1200 && !this.angerAt.size) {
      this.st = 'dig';
      this.stT = 0;
      this.anims = {
        DIG: this.age
      };
      this.sound('dig');
      return;
    }
    if (this.angerAt.size) this.idleCalm = 0;
    VMob.prototype.think.call(this, c);
  }
  melee(t) {
    this.boomCd = 40;
    super.melee(t);
    if (t.usingItem && t.inv && t.inv.held && ITEMS[t.inv.held.id].key === 'shield') t.shieldDown = 100;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a),
      t = this.age + a;
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
    // a heavy walk, tendrils quivering
    const w = Math.cos(pos * 0.8) * spd;
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd * 0.7;
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd * 0.7;
    if (P.body) P.body.zRot = w * 0.1;
    if (P.left_arm) P.left_arm.xRot = -Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.0 * spd;
    if (P.right_arm) P.right_arm.xRot = -Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.0 * spd;
    const tq = Math.sin(t * 0.25) * 0.1 * (this.target ? 2 : 1);
    if (P.left_tendril) P.left_tendril.xRot = tq;
    if (P.right_tendril) P.right_tendril.xRot = -tq;
    for (const k in this.anims) EM.anim(md, 'WardenAnimation.WARDEN_' + k, (this.age - this.anims[k] + a) / 20);
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/warden/warden');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env) {
    const t = this.age + a,
      beat = Math.max(0, Math.cos(t * 0.045 * (this.target ? 2 : 1)) * 0.5 + 0.2);
    const layer = (k, tex, alpha) => {
      const lm = EM.get(r, 'warden#' + k),
        tx = r.etex(tex);
      if (!lm || !tx || alpha <= 0.02) return;
      EM.reset(lm);
      EM.copy(md, lm);
      const gl = r.gl;
      gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE);
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
      r.drawEM(lm, tx, m, [1, 1], env, {
        alpha,
        bright: true
      });
      gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
      gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
    };
    layer('bioluminescent', 'entity/warden/warden_bioluminescent_layer', 1);
    layer('pulsating_spots', 'entity/warden/warden_pulsating_spots_1', Math.max(0, Math.cos(t * 0.045) * 0.25 + 0.25));
    layer('pulsating_spots', 'entity/warden/warden_pulsating_spots_2', Math.max(0, Math.cos(t * 0.045 + Math.PI) * 0.25 + 0.25));
    layer('heart', 'entity/warden/warden_heart', beat);
    layer('tendrils', 'entity/warden/warden', this.target ? 0.6 : 0.2);
  }
}
defVMob('warden', {
  cls: Warden,
  xp: 5,
  shadowR: 0.8,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  },
  reach: 1,
  attackCd: 18,
  knock: 0.8,
  immune: ['fire', 'lava', 'drown'],
  fearless: true
});

// ---- shulkers: hide in their shells on a block, shoot homing bullets ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Shulker extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.peek = 0;
    this.peekGoal = 0;
    this.color = null;
    this.pos[0] = Math.floor(x) + 0.5;
    this.pos[2] = Math.floor(z) + 0.5;
    this.pos[1] = Math.floor(y);
    this.persistent = true;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      col: this.color
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.color = o.col || null;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.peek < 0.1 && src && src.type === 'arrow') return false;
    const r = super.hurt(this.peek < 0.1 ? a * 0.2 : a, src);
    if (r && this.health < this.maxHealth / 2 && Math.random() < 0.25) this.teleport();
    return r;
  }
  teleport() {
    const w = this.world;
    for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
      const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]) + randInt(-8, 8),
        y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]) + randInt(-8, 8),
        z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]) + randInt(-8, 8);
      if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) === 0 && SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)]) {
        this.pos = [x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5];
        this.savePrev();
        this.sound('teleport');
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  think(c) {
    if (Math.random() < 1 / 40) this.peekGoal = Math.random() < 0.3 ? Math.random() * 0.3 : 0;
    if (this.target) {
      const t = this.target;
      c.look = t;
      this.peekGoal = 1;
      if (this.attackCd <= 0 && this.distTo(t) < 16) {
        this.attackCd = 20 + randInt(0, 10) * 2;
        this.game.entities.push(new ShulkerBullet(this.game, this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], this, t));
        this.sound('shoot');
      }
    }
    this.findTarget();
  }
  moveBy() {
    this.vel = [0, 0, 0];
  }
  afterMove() {
    const was = this.peek;
    this.peek += clamp(this.peekGoal - this.peek, -0.05, 0.05);
    if (was < 0.05 && this.peek >= 0.05) this.sound('open');
    if (was >= 0.05 && this.peek < 0.05) this.sound('close');
    this.T.armor = this.peek < 0.05 ? 20 : 0;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      k = (0.5 + this.peek) * Math.PI,
      t = this.age + a;
    if (P.lid) {
      P.lid.y = 24 - (-0.5 + Math.sin(k) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 16 * 0.5 - Math.sin(k) * 8 * 0;
      P.lid.y = 16 + (1 - this.peek) * 8 - this.peek * 0;
      P.lid.y = 24 - this.peek * 8;
      P.lid.yRot = this.peek > 0.3 ? Math.sin(t * 0.05) * 0.0 + this.peek * Math.PI * 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 0.1) : 0;
    }
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/shulker/shulker' + (this.color ? '_' + this.color : ''));
  }
  preDraw(m) {}
}
// the homing bullet: drifts toward its target, gives levitation
class ShulkerBullet extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, owner, target) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.3125, 0.3125);
    this.owner = owner;
    this.target = target;
    this.vel = [0, 0.15, 0];
    this.spriteLayer = undefined;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const t = this.target,
      v = this.vel;
    if (!t || t.dead || this.age > 300) {
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    const dx = t.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
      dy = t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5 - this.pos[1],
      dz = t.pos[2] - this.pos[2],
      l = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1;
    v[0] += (dx / l * 0.15 - v[0]) * 0.2;
    v[1] += (dy / l * 0.15 - v[1]) * 0.2;
    v[2] += (dz / l * 0.15 - v[2]) * 0.2;
    this.noClip = false;
    this.move(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
    if (l < 0.6) {
      t.hurt(4, {
        type: 'mob',
        attacker: this.owner
      });
      if (t.addEffect) t.addEffect('levitation', 0, 200);
      Sound.ev('entity.shulker_bullet.hit', this.pos, 1, 1);
      this.dead = true;
      return;
    }
    if (this.collidedH || this.onGround) {
      Sound.ev('entity.shulker_bullet.hit', this.pos, 1, 1);
      this.dead = true;
    }
    if (this.age % 2 === 0) this.game.particles.spawn('glint', this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], 0, 0, 0);
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      md = EM.get(r, 'shulker_bullet#main'),
      tex = r.etex('entity/shulker/spark');
    if (!md || !tex) return;
    EM.reset(md);
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1] + 0.15, ip[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, (this.age + a) * 0.3);
    M4.rotX(m, (this.age + a) * 0.2);
    M4.translate(m, 0, -0.15, 0);
    r.drawEM(md, tex, m, [1, 1], env, {
      bright: true,
      cull: false
    });
  }
}
defVMob('shulker', {
  cls: Shulker,
  xp: 5,
  shadowR: 0,
  T: {
    hostile: true
  },
  stepSound: false,
  noDeathFlip: true
});

  emHumanoid(md, e, a, {});
  const P = md.parts;
  if (P.right_ear) P.right_ear.zRot = 0.52 + Math.cos(e.age * 0.1) * 0.1;
  if (P.left_ear) P.left_ear.zRot = -0.52 - Math.cos(e.age * 0.1) * 0.1;
  if (e.target && P.right_arm) P.right_arm.xRot = -1.2 - (e.swingT > 0 ? Math.sin((1 - e.swingT / 6) * Math.PI) : 0);
};
class Zoglin extends VMob {
  wantsPlayer() {
    return this.game.difficulty > 0;
  }
  huntTarget() {
    if ((this.age + this.id) % 20) return null;
    return this.game.entities.find(e => e instanceof Mob && e !== this && e.type !== 'zoglin' && e.type !== 'creeper' && !e.dead && e.distTo(this) < 16) || null;
  }
  melee(t) {
    super.melee(t);
    t.vel[1] += 0.4;
    this.atkT = 10;
  }
  afterMove() {
    if (this.atkT > 0) this.atkT--;
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      [pos, spd] = emLimbs(this, a);
    emQuad(md, pos, spd);
    if (P.head) {
      P.head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.head.xRot = 0.87 + (this.atkT > 0 ? -Math.sin((10 - this.atkT) / 10 * Math.PI) * 0.6 : 0);
    }
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex('entity/hoglin/zoglin' + (this.baby ? '_baby' : ''));
  }
}

// ---- the wither: three heads, wither skulls, armour below half health ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Wither extends VMob {
  constructor(g, type, x, y, z) {
    super(g, type, x, y, z);
    this.invulT = 220;
    this.headTargets = [null, null];
    this.skullCd = [0, 0, 0];
    this.persistent = true;
    this.health = this.maxHealth / 3;
    this.blockCd = 0;
  }
  extraSave() {
    return {
      inv: this.invulT
    };
  }
  extraLoad(o) {
    this.invulT = o.inv || 0;
  }
  get armored() {
    return this.health <= this.maxHealth / 2;
  }
  wantsPlayer() {
    return true;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.invulT > 0 || src && src.type === 'drown') return false;
    if (this.armored && src && (src.type === 'arrow' || src.projectile)) return false;
    return super.hurt(a, src);
  }
  think(c) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.invulT > 0) {
      // charging up after being built, then a big explosion
      this.invulT--;
      this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + this.maxHealth / 220 * (2 / 3));
      if (this.invulT === 0) {
        g.explode(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h / 2, this.pos[2], 7, this, false, false, true);
        Sound.ev('entity.wither.spawn', null, 1, 1);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (this.age % 20 === 0) this.health = Math.min(this.maxHealth, this.health + 1);
    // the extra heads look for any living thing that isn't undead
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) if (!this.headTargets[i] || this.headTargets[i].dead || this.headTargets[i].deathTime || Math.random() < 0.005) this.headTargets[i] = g.entities.find(e => e instanceof Living && e !== this && !e.dead && !ENTITY_TAGS.undead.includes(e.type) && e.distTo(this) < 20 && !(e === g.player && g.player.creative)) || null;
    const t = this.target;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const ht = i === 0 ? t : this.headTargets[i - 1];
      if (!ht || --this.skullCd[i] > 0) continue;
      this.skullCd[i] = i === 0 ? 40 : 30 + randInt(0, 30);
      this.shootSkull(i, ht, i > 0 && Math.random() < 0.001);
    }
    // break blocks it gets stuck in (vanilla: only with mob_griefing)
    if (--this.blockCd <= 0 && this.collidedH && g.rule('mob_griefing') !== false) {
      this.blockCd = 20;
      const x0 = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
        y0 = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
        z0 = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy <= 3; dy++) for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
        const id = this.world.getBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz);
        if (id && BLOCKS[id].hardness >= 0 && BLOCKS[id].hardness < 50 && !IS_FLUID[id]) this.world.setBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz, 0, 0);
      }
    }
    // fly: above the target, circling
    if (t) {
      c.look = t;
      const hh = this.armored ? 0 : 5;
      c.goal = [t.pos[0] + Math.cos(this.age * 0.02) * 6, t.pos[1] + hh, t.pos[2] + Math.sin(this.age * 0.02) * 6];
    } else {
      this.findTarget();
      if (!this.goal || this.near(this.goal, 2)) this.goal = this.randomGoal(10, 3);
      c.goal = this.goal;
    }
  }
  findTarget() {
    if (this.target && (this.target.dead || this.target.deathTime || this.target === this.game.player && this.game.player.creative)) this.target = null;
    if (!this.target) {
      const p = this.game.player;
      this.target = !p.creative && this.distTo(p) < 40 ? p : this.headTargets[0];
    }
  }
  headPos(i) {
    const a = this.bodyYaw + [0, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2][i],
      d = i ? 1.3 : 0;
    return [this.pos[0] + Math.cos(a) * d * (i ? 1 : 0), this.pos[1] + (i ? 2.2 : 3), this.pos[2] + Math.sin(a) * d * (i ? 1 : 0)];
  }
  shootSkull(i, t, blue) {
    const g = this.game,
      [x, y, z] = this.headPos(i),
      dx = t.pos[0] - x,
      dy = t.pos[1] + t.h * 0.5 - y,
      dz = t.pos[2] - z,
      l = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz) || 1;
    const sk = new WitherSkull(g, x, y, z, [dx / l * 0.4, dy / l * 0.4, dz / l * 0.4], this, blue);
    g.entities.push(sk);
    Sound.ev('entity.wither.shoot', this.pos, 1, 1);
  }
  onDeath() {
    Sound.ev('entity.wither.death', null, 1, 1);
  }
  setupAnim(md, a) {
    const P = md.parts,
      t = this.age + a;
    if (P.ribcage) P.ribcage.xRot = (0.065 + 0.05 * Math.cos(t * 0.1)) * Math.PI;
    if (P.tail) {
      P.tail.xRot = (0.265 + 0.1 * Math.cos(t * 0.1)) * Math.PI;
      P.tail.y = 6.9 + Math.cos(P.ribcage.xRot) * 10;
      P.tail.z = -0.5 + Math.sin(P.ribcage.xRot) * 10;
    }
    if (P.center_head) {
      P.center_head.yRot = -(this.headYaw || 0);
      P.center_head.xRot = -(this.pitch || 0);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const n = P[i ? 'left_head' : 'right_head'],
        ht = this.headTargets[i];
      if (!n) continue;
      if (ht) {
        const dx = ht.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
          dz = ht.pos[2] - this.pos[2];
        n.yRot = -angDelta(Math.atan2(-dx, -dz), this.bodyYaw) * 0.8;
      }
    }
  }
  renderScale() {
    return 2;
  }
  texKey(r) {
    return r.etex(this.invulT > 0 && Math.floor(this.invulT / 5) % 2 === 0 ? 'entity/wither/wither_invulnerable' : 'entity/wither/wither');
  }
  drawLayers(g, r, md, m, a, env, lt) {
    if (!this.armored && this.invulT <= 0) return;
    const am = EM.get(r, 'wither#armor'),
      tex = r.etex('entity/wither/wither_armor');
    if (!am || !tex) return;
    EM.reset(am);
    EM.copy(md, am);
    const gl = r.gl;
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE);
    gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
    r.drawEM(am, tex, m, [1, 1], env, {
      bright: true,
      alpha: 0.6
    });
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
  }
}
class WitherSkull extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, vel, owner, blue) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.3125, 0.3125);
    this.vel = vel;
    this.owner = owner;
    this.blue = blue;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const g = this.game,
      v = this.vel,
      n = [this.pos[0] + v[0], this.pos[1] + v[1], this.pos[2] + v[2]];
    for (const e of g.entities) {
      if (e === this.owner || !(e instanceof Living) || e.dead) continue;
      const b = e.box();
      if (n[0] > b[0] - 0.15 && n[0] < b[3] + 0.15 && n[1] > b[1] - 0.15 && n[1] < b[4] + 0.15 && n[2] > b[2] - 0.15 && n[2] < b[5] + 0.15) {
        this.hit(e);
        return;
      }
    }
    this.noClip = true;
    this.pos = n;
    this.noClip = false;
    if (SOLIDCUBE[this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(n[0]), Math.floor(n[1]), Math.floor(n[2]))] || this.age > 300) {
      this.hit(null);
      return;
    }
    if (this.age % 2 === 0) g.particles.spawn('smoke', n[0], n[1], n[2], 0, 0, 0);
  }
  hit(e) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (e) {
      if (e.hurt(8, {
        type: 'mob',
        attacker: this.owner,
        projectile: true
      })) {
        const d = g.difficulty;
        if (d >= 2 && e.addEffect) e.addEffect('wither', 1, (d === 3 ? 40 : 10) * 20);
        if (e.dead || e.deathTime) {
          if (this.owner) this.owner.health = Math.min(this.owner.maxHealth, this.owner.health + 5);
        }
      }
    }
    g.explode(this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], 1, this.owner, false, false, true);
    this.dead = true;
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      md = EM.get(r, 'wither_skull#main'),
      tex = r.etex(this.blue ? 'entity/wither/wither_invulnerable' : 'entity/wither/wither');
    if (!md || !tex) return;
    EM.reset(md);
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, Math.atan2(-this.vel[0], -this.vel[2]));
    r.drawEM(md, tex, m, [l[0], 1], env, {});
  }
}

  },
  speed3: 1.6,

  noDeathFlip: true
});
// building one: a T of soul sand / soul soil with three wither skeleton skulls on top
(() => {
  const _p = Game.prototype.placeAt;
  if (!_p) return;
  Game.prototype.placeAt = function (x, y, z, ...rest) {
    const r = _p.call(this, x, y, z, ...rest);
    const w = this.world,
      k = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)].key;
    if (k === 'wither_skeleton_skull') checkWitherBuild(this, x, y, z);
    return r;
  };
})();
function checkWitherBuild(g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    soul = (a, b, c) => /^soul_(sand|soil)$/.test(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(a, b, c)].key),
    skull = (a, b, c) => BLOCKS[w.getBlock(a, b, c)].key === 'wither_skeleton_skull';
  for (const [ax, az] of [[1, 0], [0, 1]]) for (let o = -1; o <= 1; o++) {
    const cx = x - ax * o,
      cz = z - az * o,
      cy = y - 1;
    if (!skull(cx, y, cz) || !skull(cx + ax, y, cz + az) || !skull(cx - ax, y, cz - az)) continue;
    if (!soul(cx, cy, cz) || !soul(cx + ax, cy, cz + az) || !soul(cx - ax, cy, cz - az) || !soul(cx, cy - 1, cz)) continue;
    for (const [a, b, c] of [[cx, y, cz], [cx + ax, y, cz + az], [cx - ax, y, cz - az], [cx, cy, cz], [cx + ax, cy, cz + az], [cx - ax, cy, cz - az], [cx, cy - 1, cz]]) w.setBlock(a, b, c, 0, 0);
    spawnAt(g, 'wither', cx + 0.5, cy - 1, cz + 0.5);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

<script>
/* ==== js/mobitems.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Items for mobs: saddles (pigs and striders steered with a carrot / warped fungus on a stick), leads and lead
// knots, name tags (with vanilla's name easter eggs), buckets of fish / axolotls / tadpoles / sulfur cubes, the
// powder snow bucket; the vanilla models for pigs, cows, chickens and sheep (their warm / cold variants, saddles
// and baby models); names drawn over mobs.

// ---- pigs, cows, chickens and sheep with the vanilla models and climate variants -----------------------------------------
const climateAt = (g, x, z) => {
  const b = biomeName(g, x, z);
  return /desert|badlands|savanna|jungle|mangrove|warm|nether|crimson|warped|basalt|soul/.test(b) ? 'warm' : /snowy|frozen|ice|grove|jagged|peaks|taiga|cold|deep_dark/.test(b) ? 'cold' : 'temperate';
};
const FARM_SKIN = {
  pig: e => ({
    layer: e.baby ? 'pig_baby#main' : e.cvar === 'cold' ? 'cold_pig#main' : 'pig#main',
    tex: 'entity/pig/pig_' + e.cvar + (e.baby ? '_baby' : '')
  }),
  cow: e => ({
    layer: e.baby ? e.cvar === 'cold' ? 'cold_cow_baby#main' : e.cvar === 'warm' ? 'warm_cow_baby#main' : 'cow_baby#main' : e.cvar === 'cold' ? 'cold_cow#main' : e.cvar === 'warm' ? 'warm_cow#main' : 'cow#main',
    tex: 'entity/cow/cow_' + e.cvar + (e.baby ? '_baby' : '')
  }),
  chicken: e => ({
    layer: e.baby ? 'chicken_baby#main' : e.cvar === 'cold' ? 'cold_chicken#main' : 'chicken#main',
    tex: 'entity/chicken/chicken_' + e.cvar + (e.baby ? '_baby' : '')
  }),
  sheep: e => ({
    layer: e.baby ? 'sheep_baby#main' : 'sheep#main',
    tex: 'entity/sheep/sheep' + (e.baby ? '_baby' : '')
  })
};
(() => {
  const sd = Mob.prototype.saveData,
    ld = Mob.prototype.loadData;
  Mob.prototype.saveData = function () {
    const o = sd ? sd.call(this) : {};
    if (FARM_SKIN[this.type] || this.type === 'strider') {
      o.cv = this.cvar;
      o.sad = this.saddled;
      if (this.customName) o.name = this.customName;
    }
    return o;
  };
  Mob.prototype.loadData = function (o) {
    if (ld) ld.call(this, o);
    if (o && (FARM_SKIN[this.type] || this.type === 'strider')) {
      if (o.cv) this.cvar = o.cv;
      this.saddled = !!o.sad;
      if (o.name) this.customName = o.name;
    }
  };
})();
function farmAnim(md, e, a) {
  const P = md.parts,
    [pos, spd] = emLimbs(e, a);
  emHead(P.head, e, a);
  if (e.type === 'chicken') {
    if (P.right_leg) P.right_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * spd;
    if (P.left_leg) P.left_leg.xRot = Math.cos(pos * 0.6662 + Math.PI) * 1.4 * spd;
    const flap = e.onGround ? 0 : Math.sin((e.age + a) * 1.5) * 0.8 + 0.8;
    if (P.right_wing) P.right_wing.zRot = flap;
    if (P.left_wing) P.left_wing.zRot = -flap;
    return;
  }
  emQuad(md, pos, spd);
  if (e.type === 'sheep' && e.eatT > 0 && P.head) {
    const k = Math.min(1, Math.min(e.eatT, 40 - e.eatT) / 4);
    P.head.y += 9 * k;
    P.head.xRot = 0.8 * k + P.head.xRot * (1 - k);
  }
}
// draw an old-style farm animal with the vanilla model (called by Game.drawMob)
Game.prototype.drawFarmMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
  const r = this.renderer;
  if (!e.cvar) e.cvar = climateAt(this, e.pos[0], e.pos[2]);
  const sk = FARM_SKIN[e.type](e),
    md = EM.get(r, sk.layer),
    tex = r.etex(sk.tex);
  if (!md) return false;
  if (!tex) return true;
  let m = M4.create();
  if (e.displayMatrix) m = M4.copy(e.displayMatrix);else {
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    const by = e.prevBodyYaw !== undefined ? e.prevBodyYaw + angDelta(e.bodyYaw, e.prevBodyYaw) * a : e.bodyYaw;
    M4.rotY(m, by);
  }
  if (e.deathTime > 0) M4.rotZ(m, Math.min(1, Math.sqrt((e.deathTime + a) / 20)) * Math.PI / 2);
  upsideDown(e, m);
  EM.reset(md);
  farmAnim(md, e, a);
  const overlay = e.hurtTime > 0 || e.deathTime > 0 ? [1, 0, 0, 0.4] : null,
    lt = [l[0], e.fire > 0 ? 1 : l[1]];
  r.drawEM(md, tex, m, lt, env, {
    overlay
  });
  if (e.type === 'pig' && e.saddled && !e.baby) {
    const sm = EM.get(r, 'pig#saddle');
    if (sm) {
      EM.reset(sm);
      EM.copy(md, sm);
      r.drawEM(sm, r.etex('entity/equipment/pig_saddle/saddle'), m, lt, env, {
        overlay
      });
    }
  }
  if (e.type === 'sheep' && !e.sheared) {
    const wm = EM.get(r, e.baby ? 'sheep_baby#wool' : 'sheep#wool');
    if (wm) {
      EM.reset(wm);
      EM.copy(md, wm);
      let col = WOOL_RGB[e.woolColor] || [1, 1, 1];
      if (e.customName === 'jeb_') {
        const t = (e.age + a) / 25,
          i = Math.floor(t) % 16,
          f = t % 1,
          c0 = dyeRGB(DYES[i]),
          c1 = dyeRGB(DYES[(i + 1) % 16]);
        col = [lerp(c0[0], c1[0], f), lerp(c0[1], c1[1], f), lerp(c0[2], c1[2], f)];
      }
      r.drawEM(wm, r.etex('entity/sheep/sheep_wool' + (e.baby ? '_baby' : '')), m, lt, env, {
        overlay,
        tint: col
      });
    }
  }
  if (e.customName && this.drawNameTag) this.drawNameTag(e, ip, e.customName);
  if (e.deathTime === 0 && !e.displayMatrix) {
    const fx = Math.floor(ip[0]),
      fz = Math.floor(ip[2]);
    let gy = Math.floor(ip[1] + 0.01);
    for (let k = 0; k < 4 && gy > 0 && !SOLIDCUBE[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)] && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)].solid; k++) gy--;
    const h = ip[1] - gy;
    if (h < 3) r.drawShadow(ip[0], gy, ip[2], e.w * 0.75 * (1 - h / 6), 0.55 * (1 - h / 3));
  }
  return true;
};
// mobs named Dinnerbone or Grumm are drawn upside down (vanilla's easter egg)
function upsideDown(e, m) {
  if (e.customName === 'Dinnerbone' || e.customName === 'Grumm') {
    M4.translate(m, 0, e.h + 0.1, 0);
    M4.rotZ(m, Math.PI);
  }
}

// ---- babies of the old-style humanoids with vanilla's baby models (zombie_baby#main ... and their _baby textures); the
// old model at half size was only a small adult - vanilla's babies have a big head and short limbs ----------------------
const BABY_HUMANOID = {
  zombie: {
    layer: 'zombie_baby#main',
    tex: () => 'entity/zombie/zombie_baby',
    zombie: true
  },
  zombie_villager: {
    layer: 'zombie_villager_baby#main',
    tex: e => ['entity/zombie_villager/zombie_villager_baby', 'entity/zombie_villager/baby/' + (e.vtype || 'plains')],
    zombie: true
  },
  zombified_piglin: {
    layer: 'zombified_piglin_baby#main',
    tex: () => 'entity/piglin/zombified_piglin_baby',
    zombie: true
  },
  piglin: {
    layer: 'piglin_baby#main',
    tex: () => 'entity/piglin/piglin_baby'
  }
};
Game.prototype.drawBabyHumanoid = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    B = BABY_HUMANOID[e.type],
    md = EM.get(r, B.layer);
  if (!md || e.invisible || e.hasEffect && e.hasEffect('invisibility')) return false; // (invisible: the old path, which keeps armour and items)
  const t = B.tex(e),
    tex = typeof t === 'string' ? r.etex(t) : r.etexMix(t);
  if (!tex) return true;
  let m = M4.create();
  if (e.displayMatrix) m = M4.copy(e.displayMatrix);else {
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    const by = e.prevBodyYaw !== undefined ? e.prevBodyYaw + angDelta(e.bodyYaw, e.prevBodyYaw) * a : e.bodyYaw;
    M4.rotY(m, by);
  }
  if (e.deathTime > 0) M4.rotZ(m, Math.min(1, Math.sqrt((e.deathTime + a) / 20)) * Math.PI / 2);
  upsideDown(e, m);
  EM.reset(md);
  emHumanoid(md, e, a, {
    zombie: B.zombie
  });
  // (vanilla PiglinModel ADMIRING_ITEM: head down, left arm up with the gold in the off hand)
  const admire = e.type === 'piglin' && e.admire > 0,
    P = md.parts;
  if (admire && P.head && P.left_arm) {
    P.head.xRot = 0.5;
    P.head.yRot = 0;
    P.left_arm.yRot = 0.5;
    P.left_arm.xRot = -0.9;
  }
  const overlay = e.hurtTime > 0 || e.deathTime > 0 ? [1, 0, 0, 0.4] : null,
    lt = [l[0], e.fire > 0 ? 1 : l[1]];
  // what it holds, as drawMob gives it (a server's mob: its own item)
  const held = e.heldId != null ? e.heldId : e.type === 'zombified_piglin' ? item('golden_sword') : e.type === 'piglin' ? e.holding || null : null; // (vanilla baby piglins get no spawn weapon)
  const st = held != null ? {
    id: held,
    count: 1,
    dmg: 0
  } : null;
  const att = st ? admire ? {
    left_arm: am => this.drawHeldItem(am, st, true, lt, env, e, null)
  } : {
    right_arm: am => this.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, lt, env, e, null)
  } : null;
  r.drawEM(md, tex, m, lt, env, {
    overlay,
    attach: att
  });
  if (e.armorItems && e.armorItems.some(s => s)) drawVArmor(this, r, {
    layerKey: () => B.layer,
    armorItems: e.armorItems
  }, md, m, lt, env, overlay);
  if (e.deathTime === 0 && !e.displayMatrix) {
    const fx = Math.floor(ip[0]),
      fz = Math.floor(ip[2]);
    let gy = Math.floor(ip[1] + 0.01);
    for (let k = 0; k < 4 && gy > 0 && !SOLIDCUBE[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)] && !BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(fx, gy - 1, fz)].solid; k++) gy--;
    const h = ip[1] - gy;
    if (h < 3) r.drawShadow(ip[0], gy, ip[2], e.w * 0.75 * (1 - h / 6), 0.55 * (1 - h / 3));
  }
  return true;
};
(() => {
  const _dm = Game.prototype.drawMob;
  Game.prototype.drawMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    if (!e.vm && FARM_SKIN[e.type] && e !== this.player && this.drawFarmMob(e, ip, a, env, l)) return;
    if (!e.vm && e.baby && BABY_HUMANOID[e.type] && e !== this.player && this.drawBabyHumanoid(e, ip, a, env, l)) return;
    return _dm.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
  };
  const _pd = VMob.prototype.preDraw;
  const _dv = Game.prototype.drawVMob;
  Game.prototype.drawVMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    if (e.customName === 'Dinnerbone' || e.customName === 'Grumm') {
      const pd = e.preDraw;
      e.preDraw = function (m, aa) {
        upsideDown(this, m);
        if (pd) pd.call(this, m, aa);
      };
      _dv.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
      if (pd) e.preDraw = pd;else delete e.preDraw;
      return;
    }
    return _dv.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
  };
})();

// ---- saddled pigs and striders ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const STICK_FOR = {
  pig: 'carrot_on_a_stick',
  strider: 'warped_fungus_on_a_stick'
};
(() => {
  const _it = Mob.prototype.interact;
  Mob.prototype.interact = function (p, held) {
    if (_it && _it.call(this, p, held)) return true;
    const g = this.game,
      k = keyOfStack(held); // (equip.js: null for an id not in ITEMS - no throw)
    if (STICK_FOR[this.type] && !this.baby) {
      if (k === 'saddle' && !this.saddled) {
        this.saddled = true;
        useOne(g, p);
        Sound.ev('entity.' + this.type + '.saddle', this.pos, 0.5, 1);
        return true;
      }
      if (this.saddled && !p.vehicle && !p.sneaking && (!held || !(ITEMS[held.id] && ITEMS[held.id].spawnEgg))) {
        p.mount(this);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return nameTagUse(this, p, held) || leadUse(this, p, held);
  };
  Mob.prototype.seat = function () {
    return [this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + this.h * (this.type === 'strider' ? 1.0 : 0.62), this.pos[2]];
  };
  const _tk = Mob.prototype.tick;
  Mob.prototype.tick = function () {
    if (!this.rider || this.vm || !STICK_FOR[this.type]) {
      _tk.call(this);
      if (this.leashHolder) this.leashTick();
      return;
    }
    // ridden: goes where the rider looks while it holds the stick; a click with the stick gives a boost
    this.savePrev();
    this.baseTick();
    if (this.deathTick()) return;
    // (an id not in ITEMS in the hand threw here every tick of the ride)
    const p = this.rider,
      held = p.inv.held,
      steer = !!held && keyOfStack(held) === STICK_FOR[this.type];
    if (this.boostT > 0) this.boostT--;
    let fwd = 0;
    if (steer) {
      this.yaw = p.yaw;
      fwd = 1;
    }
    this.bodyYaw += angDelta(this.yaw, this.bodyYaw) * 0.5;
    const base = this.type === 'pig' ? 0.225 : this.inLava ? 0.35 : 0.2,
      s = base * (1 + (this.boostT > 0 ? Math.sin(this.boostT / 140 * Math.PI) * 1.15 : 0));
    if (this.collidedH && this.onGround && fwd) this.vel[1] = 0.42;
    if (this.type === 'strider' && this.inLava) {
      this.vel[1] = Math.max(this.vel[1], 0.05);
    }
    this.travel(fwd, 0, s * s * 1.5, false);
    if (this.type === 'strider' && this.inLava) {
      this.vel[1] = 0;
      const fy = Math.floor(this.pos[1]);
      if (this.world.getBlock(Math.floor(this.pos[0]), fy + 1, Math.floor(this.pos[2])) === LAVA) this.pos[1] += 0.1;
    }
    p.followVehicle(this);
    this.animate();
  };
})();
// the boost: right click with the stick while riding (it wears the stick)
(() => {

function nameTagUse(e, p, held) {
  if (!held || keyOfStack(held) !== 'name_tag' || !held.name || e === p) return false;
  e.customName = held.name;
  e.persistent = true;
  useOne(e.game, p);
  return true;
}
(() => {

  VMob.prototype.interact = function (p, held) {
    if (nameTagUse(this, p, held)) return true;

  };
})();
// the name over a named mob or a player: text on a dark plate in the world, facing the camera, 0.025 blocks a pixel
// (a fixed size over the head, like vanilla's). o: { color, max (distance), through: also seen through walls, faint
// (vanilla's nameplate when not sneaking), faded: the dim, walls-hide-it plate of one sneaking }
Game.prototype.drawNameTag = function (e, ip, name, o = {}) {
  var _o$h;
  const r = this.renderer,
    gl = r.gl;
  if (!this.player || e.distTo(this.player) > (o.max || 32)) return;
  // (a player's name prefix in front: the sign-in event's potato icon, cosmetics.js)
  if (typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined') name = Cosmetics.tagName(this, e, name);
  if (!r.nameTex) r.nameTex = new Map();
  const col = o.color || '#FFFFFF',
    key = name + '|' + col;
  let nt = r.nameTex.get(key);
  if (!nt) {
    // three looks: the plate with the text (mobs), the plate with faint text (through walls / sneaking), the text alone
    const w = Font.width(name) + 2,
      mk = (plate, alpha) => {
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = w * 2;
        c.height = 20;
        const x = c.getContext('2d');
        if (plate) {
          x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
          x.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        }
        x.scale(2, 2);
        x.globalAlpha = alpha;
        Font.draw(x, name, 1, 1, col, false);
        return r.tex2D(c, false);
      };
    nt = {
      tex: mk(true, 1),
      faint: mk(true, 32 / 255),
      text: mk(false, 1),
      w,
      h: 10
    };
    r.nameTex.set(key, nt);
    if (r.nameTex.size > 200) {
      const k = r.nameTex.keys().next().value,
        old = r.nameTex.get(k);
      for (const t of [old.tex, old.faint, old.text]) gl.deleteTexture(t);
      r.nameTex.delete(k);
    }
  }
  const T2 = r.progTex,
    cam = r.camPos;
  const y = ip[1] + ((_o$h = o.h) !== null && _o$h !== void 0 ? _o$h : e.h * (e.renderScale ? e.renderScale(1) / (e.D && e.D.scale || 1) : 1)) + 0.5;
  const dx = cam[0] - ip[0],
    dz = cam[2] - ip[2],
    yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz),
    dy = cam[1] - y,
    pitch = Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz));
  const s = 0.025,
    m = M4.create();
  M4.translate(m, ip[0], y, ip[2]);
  M4.rotY(m, yaw);
  M4.rotX(m, -pitch);
  M4.rotX(m, Math.PI / 2);
  M4.scale(m, nt.w * s / 2, 1, nt.h * s / 2);
  gl.useProgram(T2.p);
  gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_vp, false, r.vp);
  gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_model, false, m);
  gl.uniform4f(T2.u.u_color, 1, 1, 1, 1);
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
  gl.bindVertexArray(r.quadVao);
  const quad = t => {
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
  };
  // the letters write depth (vanilla's NORMAL text does): without, clouds and water drawn later came over the tag
  // (feedback 11-01 22:24). On their letters only - vanilla's text shader drops texels under 0.1 alpha: a whole quad's
  // depth cut a box out of the water and clouds behind it (11-04, a named horse before a water wall: the plate's 5867
  // px showed the stone behind the water, grey 105 instead of the water's blue). The plates follow vanilla: the faint
  // see-through one (no depth test) and a mob's leave the depth alone (vanilla's mob plate is a see-through one), the
  // plate of one sneaking (NORMAL text_background) writes it
  const cut = () => {
    if (r.progTexCut === undefined) try {
      r.progTexCut = compile(gl, TEX_VS, TEX_FS.replace('o = t * u_color;', 'if (t.a < 0.1) discard; o = t * u_color;'));
    } catch (err) {
      r.progTexCut = null;
    }
    const T3 = r.progTexCut;
    if (T3) {
      gl.useProgram(T3.p);
      gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T3.u.u_vp, false, r.vp);
      gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T3.u.u_model, false, m);
      gl.uniform4f(T3.u.u_color, 1, 1, 1, 1);
    }
    return !!T3;
  };
  if (o.through) {
    gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    gl.depthMask(false);
    quad(nt.faint);
    gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
    if (cut()) gl.depthMask(true);
    quad(nt.text);
  } else if (o.faded) {
    gl.depthMask(true);
    quad(nt.faint);
  } else {
    // (the letters' depth in a pass of its own, colour untouched: the picture is the plate's alone)
    gl.depthMask(false);
    quad(nt.tex);
    if (cut()) {
      gl.colorMask(false, false, false, false);
      gl.depthMask(true);
      quad(nt.text);
      gl.colorMask(true, true, true, true);
    }
  }
  gl.depthMask(true);
  gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
};
(() => {
  // old-style mobs show their names too
  const _dm = Game.prototype.drawMob;
  Game.prototype.drawMob = function (e, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = _dm.call(this, e, ip, a, env, l);
    if (!e.vm && e.customName && !FARM_SKIN[e.type] && e !== this.player) this.drawNameTag(e, ip, e.customName);
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- leads and lead knots ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const LEASHABLE = e => e instanceof Mob && !(e.T.hostile && !['zoglin', 'hoglin'].includes(e.type)) && !['villager', 'wandering_trader', 'bat', 'ender_dragon', 'wither', 'warden', 'shulker'].includes(e.type);
function leadUse(e, p, held) {
  const g = e.game;
  if (e.leashHolder === p) {
    e.leashHolder = null;
    if (g.mode !== 'creative') g.dropItem(e.pos[0], e.pos[1] + 0.5, e.pos[2], makeStack('lead', 1));
    Sound.ev('item.lead.untied', e.pos, 1, 1);
    return true;
  }
  if (held && keyOfStack(held) === 'lead' && LEASHABLE(e) && !e.leashHolder) {
    e.leashHolder = p;
    useOne(g, p);
    Sound.ev('item.lead.tied', e.pos, 1, 1);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}
Mob.prototype.leashTick = function () {
  const h = this.leashHolder;
  if (!h) return;
  if (h.dead || h.deathTime && h.deathTime > 0) {
    this.leashHolder = null;
    return;
  }
  const d = this.distTo(h);
  if (d > 10) {
    this.leashHolder = null;
    if (!(h instanceof LeashKnot) || true) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], makeStack('lead', 1));
    Sound.ev('item.lead.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
    return;
  }
  if (d > 6) {
    const k = (d - 6) * 0.05,
      dx = h.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
      dy = h.pos[1] - this.pos[1],
      dz = h.pos[2] - this.pos[2];
    this.vel[0] += dx / d * k;
    this.vel[1] += Math.max(0, dy / d * k);
    this.vel[2] += dz / d * k;
  }
  if (d > 4 && this.vm && !this.rider) this.goal = [h.pos[0], h.pos[1], h.pos[2]];
};
VMob.prototype.leashTick = Mob.prototype.leashTick;
// the knot on a fence post that holds leashed mobs
class LeashKnot extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, x + 0.5, y + 0.375, z + 0.5, 0.375, 0.5);
    this.post = [x, y, z];
    this.isVehicle = false;
    this.knot = true;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const [x, y, z] = this.post;
    if (!/fence$|_wall$/.test(BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].key) || this.age % 20 === 0 && !this.game.entities.some(e => e.leashHolder === this)) {
      for (const e of this.game.entities) if (e.leashHolder === this) {
        e.leashHolder = null;
        this.game.dropItem(e.pos[0], e.pos[1], e.pos[2], makeStack('lead', 1));
      }
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.leash_knot.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
  }
  saveData() {
    return {
      post: this.post
    };
  }
  loadData(o) {
    if (o && o.post) {
      this.post = o.post;
      this.pos = [o.post[0] + 0.5, o.post[1] + 0.375, o.post[2] + 0.5];
    }
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      md = EM.get(r, 'leash_knot#main'),
      tex = r.etex('entity/lead_knot/lead_knot');
    if (!md || !tex) return;
    // (vanilla LeashKnotRenderer only turns the model over - the knot, -8..0 px, spans 0..0.5 above the entity at the post's
    // y + 0.375; drawEM also drops a mob model by 1.501, taken back here: the knot hung over a block above the fence)
    EM.reset(md);
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1] - 1.501, ip[2]);
    r.drawEM(md, tex, m, l, env, {});
  }
}

      }

// the rope: a sagging brown ribbon from the holder's hand to the mob
Renderer.prototype.drawRibbon = function (pts, w, col) {
  const gl = this.gl,
    C = this.progCol,
    v = [],
    cam = this.camPos;
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const p = pts[i],
      q = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)],
      o = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
    const tx = q[0] - o[0],
      ty = q[1] - o[1],
      tz = q[2] - o[2],
      vx = cam[0] - p[0],
      vy = cam[1] - p[1],
      vz = cam[2] - p[2];
    let nx = ty * vz - tz * vy,
      ny = tz * vx - tx * vz,
      nz = tx * vy - ty * vx;
    const l = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz) || 1;
    nx *= w / l;
    ny *= w / l;
    nz *= w / l;
    const c = col(i / (pts.length - 1));
    v.push(p[0] - nx, p[1] - ny, p[2] - nz, ...c, p[0] + nx, p[1] + ny, p[2] + nz, ...c);
  }
  gl.useProgram(C.p);
  gl.uniformMatrix4fv(C.u.u_vp, false, this.vp);
  gl.uniformMatrix4fv(C.u.u_model, false, this.identity);
  gl.uniform4fv(C.u.u_color, [1, 1, 1, 1]);
  gl.uniform3fv(C.u.u_cam, this.camPos);
  gl.uniform2f(C.u.u_fog, 1e9, 2e9);
  gl.uniform1f(C.u.u_psize, 1);
  gl.bindVertexArray(this.lineVao);
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, this.lineBuf);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array(v), gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 0);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 12);
  gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, v.length / 7);
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
};
(() => {
  const _de = Game.prototype.drawEntities;
  Game.prototype.drawEntities = function (a, env) {
    const r = _de.call(this, a, env);
    for (const e of this.entities) {
      const h = e.leashHolder;
      if (!h || e.dead) continue;
      const ip = e.ipos(a),
        hp = h.ipos ? h.ipos(a) : h.pos;
      let hx = hp[0],
        hy = hp[1] + (h instanceof LeashKnot ? 0.25 : h.h * 0.7),
        hz = hp[2];
      if (h === this.player) {
        const yw = h.yaw;
        hx += -Math.cos(yw) * 0.35 * (this.perspective ? 1 : 0.6) - Math.sin(yw) * (this.perspective ? 0.1 : 0.4);
        hz += Math.sin(yw) * 0.35 * (this.perspective ? 1 : 0.6) - Math.cos(yw) * (this.perspective ? 0.1 : 0.4);
        hy = hp[1] + (this.perspective ? 1.0 : 1.3);
      }
      const ex = ip[0] - Math.sin(e.bodyYaw) * e.w * 0.4,
        ey = ip[1] + e.h * 0.7,
        ez = ip[2] - Math.cos(e.bodyYaw) * e.w * 0.4;
      const pts = [],
        n = 24;
      for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        const t = i / n;
        pts.push([lerp(hx, ex, t), lerp(hy, ey, t) - Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.25 * Math.min(1, Math.hypot(hx - ex, hz - ez) / 4), lerp(hz, ez, t)]);
      }
      const L = e.lightAt(),
        k = Math.max(0.15, Math.max(L[0], L[1] * env.day));
      this.renderer.drawRibbon(pts, 0.025, t => {
        const dark = Math.floor(t * 24) % 2 ? 0.7 : 1;
        return [0.5 * k * dark, 0.4 * k * dark, 0.3 * k * dark, 1];
      });
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

const MOB_BUCKET = {

  salmon_bucket: 'salmon',
  pufferfish_bucket: 'pufferfish',
  tropical_fish_bucket: 'tropical_fish',
  axolotl_bucket: 'axolotl',
  tadpole_bucket: 'tadpole',
  sulfur_cube_bucket: 'sulfur_cube'

(() => {
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    const p = this.player,
      w = this.world,
      held = p.inv.held,
      t = this.target,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id] && ITEMS[held.id].key; // (an id not in ITEMS: no throw)

      if (this.mode !== 'creative') p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = makeStack(water ? 'bucket' : 'bucket');
      p.swing();
      this.flushMesh();

    }

  };
})();
// powder snow: things sink into it and freeze (leather boots let players walk on it)
(() => {
  const FREEZE_IMMUNE = /^leather_(helmet|chestplate|leggings|boots|horse_armor)$/;
  const isImmune = s => !!(s && ITEMS[s.id] && FREEZE_IMMUNE.test(ITEMS[s.id].key));
  const wearsFreezeImmune = e => {
    const a = e.inv ? e.inv.slots : e.armorItems,
      o = e.inv ? 36 : 0;
    if (a) for (let i = o; i < o + 4; i++) if (isImmune(a[i])) return true;
    return isImmune(e.armorItem);
  };
  const _bt = Living.prototype.baseTick;
  Living.prototype.baseTick = function () {
    _bt.call(this);
    if (BID.powder_snow === undefined) return;
    const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]);
    // (a noClip one - spectator, vex - isn't in the snow at all: vanilla isAffectedByBlocks)
    const inSnow = !this.noClip && (this.world.getBlock(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1] + 0.1), z) === BID.powder_snow || this.world.getBlock(x, Math.floor(this.pos[1] + this.h * 0.8), z) === BID.powder_snow);
    if (!inSnow && !(this.frozenT > 0)) return;
    // canFreeze: not a spectator, not these types (freeze_immune_entity_types, and Skeleton.canFreeze), nor anyone with
    // leather armor in any armor slot (FREEZE_IMMUNE_WEARABLES, horse armor included); whoever can't freeze thaws even
    // in the snow and takes no freeze damage
    const immune = this.spectator || /^(stray|polar_bear|snow_golem|wither|skeleton)$/.test(this.type) || wearsFreezeImmune(this);
    if (inSnow) {
      this.vel[0] *= 0.9;
      this.vel[2] *= 0.9;
      if (this.vel[1] < -0.05) this.vel[1] = -0.05;
      this.fallDist = 0;
      if (!immune) this.frozenT = Math.min(140, (this.frozenT || 0) + 1);
      if (this.jumpHeld) this.vel[1] = 0.1;
    }
    if ((!inSnow || immune) && this.frozenT > 0) this.frozenT = Math.max(0, this.frozenT - 2);
    if (!immune && this.frozenT >= 140 && this.age % 40 === 0) this.hurt(this.type === 'blaze' || this.type === 'strider' || this.type === 'magma_cube' ? 5 : 1, {
      type: 'freeze'
    });
  };
})();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Natural spawning in the overworld from each vanilla biome's spawn lists (worldgen data "spawners"): mob
// categories with their caps (monster, creature, ambient, water creature, water ambient, underground water
// creature, axolotls), vanilla's light rules, pack sizes; plus the wandering trader, phantoms and patrols.
