const SPAWN_CAPS = {
  monster: 70,
  creature: 10,
  ambient: 15,
  water_creature: 5,
  water_ambient: 20,
  underground_water_creature: 5,
  axolotls: 5
};
const SPAWN_GROUND = {
  mooshroom: /^mycelium$/,
  polar_bear: /snow|ice/,
  goat: /stone|snow|gravel|calcite|packed_ice/,
  rabbit: /grass_block|snow|sand/,
  turtle: /sand$/,
  frog: /mud|grass_block|mangrove_roots/,
  armadillo: /grass_block|red_sand|coarse_dirt|terracotta/,
  camel: /sand$/,
  parrot: /grass_block|leaves|log/,
  ocelot: /grass_block|leaves/,
  fox: /grass_block|snow|podzol|coarse_dirt/,
  wolf: /grass_block|snow|podzol|coarse_dirt/,
  panda: /grass_block|podzol|bamboo/,
  llama: /grass_block|stone|snow/,
  sniffer: /grass_block/
};
function spawnCatOf(e) {
  return e.T ? e.T.cat || (e.T.hostile ? 'monster' : 'creature') : null;
}
// vanilla leaves only the mobs that must be kept (named, leashed, ridden, from a bucket) out of the counts;
// animals never despawn but still fill their category's cap (`persistent` here only means "never despawns")
function spawnMustKeep(e) {
  return !!(e.customName || e.leashHolder || e.rider || e.fromBucket || e.remote);
}
// the most of one kind a spawn attempt places (vanilla getMaxSpawnClusterSize: 4; ghasts 1, wolves 8, salmon 5)
const SPAWN_CLUSTER = {
  ghast: 1,
  wolf: 8,
  salmon: 5
};
// The area spawning covers and counts in (vanilla: the 17 x 17 chunks around a player, each cap scaled by the chunks it
// can spawn in, cap * chunks / 289): the loaded chunks whose middle is within 104 blocks (Mob despawns past 100), mobs
// placed 24..96 blocks away, uniformly over the area like vanilla's one try per chunk. Before, the whole cap (70 from
// a view distance of 8) went into a 24..80 ring, thicker toward its inner edge: two to four times vanilla's density
// around the player - "晚上怪太多、成群", feedback 2026-10-31..11-03 (the nether uses it too: nether_mobs.js)
function spawnArea(g) {
  const p = g.player,
    w = g.world,
    px = p.pos[0],
    pz = p.pos[2],
    pcx = Math.floor(px) >> 4,
    pcz = Math.floor(pz) >> 4,
    list = [];
  const rd = Math.max(2, Math.min(16, g.settings && g.settings.renderDist || 8)),
    R = Math.min(104, (rd + 1) * 16);
  for (let dx = -7; dx <= 7; dx++) for (let dz = -7; dz <= 7; dz++) {
    const cx = pcx + dx,
      cz = pcz + dz;
    if (Math.hypot(cx * 16 + 8 - px, cz * 16 + 8 - pz) <= R && w.chunks.has(ckey(cx, cz))) list.push(cx, cz);
  }
  const n = list.length / 2;
  return {
    n,
    scale: n / 289,
    has: (x, z) => Math.hypot(x - px, z - pz) <= R,
    pick: () => {
      if (!n) return null;
      const i = Math.floor(Math.random() * n) * 2;
      return [list[i] * 16 + randInt(0, 15), list[i + 1] * 16 + randInt(0, 15)];
    },
    ok: (x, z) => {
      const d = Math.hypot(x + 0.5 - px, z + 0.5 - pz);
      return d >= 24 && d <= Math.min(96, R) && w.isLoaded(x, z);
    }
  };
}
// vanilla's sky darkening (Level.updateSkyBrightness): 0 by day, 11 at night, rain takes up to 5/16 off the daylight
function spawnDarken(g) {
  return Math.floor((1 - g.daylight() * (1 - clamp(g.weather || 0, 0, 1) * 5 / 16)) * 11);
}
// vanilla's slime chunks (WorldgenRandom.seedSlimeChunk with salt 987234911, then nextInt(10) == 0): the same chunks as
// vanilla's for the seed
function slimeChunk(g, cx, cz) {
  const w = g.world,
    m = w.slimeChunks || (w.slimeChunks = new Map()),
    k = cx + ',' + cz;
  let r = m.get(k);
  if (r === undefined) {
    let seed = 0n;
    try {
      seed = BigInt(g.worldMeta && g.worldMeta.seed != null ? g.worldMeta.seed : w.seed | 0);
    } catch (e) {
      seed = BigInt(w.seed | 0);
    }
    const s = BigInt.asIntN(64, seed + BigInt(Math.imul(Math.imul(cx, cx), 4987142)) + BigInt(Math.imul(cx, 5947611)) + BigInt(Math.imul(cz, cz)) * 4392871n + BigInt(Math.imul(cz, 389711))) ^ 987234911n;
    r = new WG.JavaRandom(s).nextIntB(10) === 0;
    if (m.size > 4096) m.clear();
    m.set(k, r);
  }
  return r;
}
const MOON_BRIGHT = [1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75];
// vanilla's Halloween (Oct 20 .. Nov 3): bats come in darker light
function spawnHalloween() {
  const d = new Date(),
    mo = d.getMonth() + 1,
    day = d.getDate();
  return mo === 10 && day >= 20 || mo === 11 && day <= 3;
}
// One spawn attempt as vanilla's NaturalSpawner.spawnCategoryForPosition: one height for the whole attempt (the start
// spot at `y` has already passed), up to three groups walking out from the start column by -5..5 blocks a step, each
// of one kind (the first `pick`, later ones from `again(x, z)`) with the list's count of tries, every mob on a spot of
// its own at that same height that passes `spot(type, x, y, z)` (its own light roll too), at most 4 in all (ghasts 1).
// Before: one group of the list's full count within +-3 blocks, each mob free to move 2 blocks up or down for a floor
// with a light roll at each height (none that could fail at night): packs of 4 nearly every time - "怪成群", feedback
// 2026-11-01..03. Returns how many were placed.
function spawnAttempt(g, pick, x0, y, z0, sp, spot, again, made) {
  let total = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    let x = x0,
      z = z0,
      s = k ? null : pick,
      type = null,
      n = k ? Math.ceil(Math.random() * 4) : 1;
    for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) {
      if (k || q) {
        x += randInt(0, 5) - randInt(0, 5);
        z += randInt(0, 5) - randInt(0, 5);
        if (!sp.ok(x, z)) continue;
      }
      if (!s && !(s = again(x, z))) break;
      if (!type) {
        type = s.type.replace('minecraft:', '');
        n = s.minCount + randInt(0, s.maxCount - s.minCount);
      }
      if ((k || q) && !spot(type, x, y, z)) continue;
      const m = createMob(g, type, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
      if (!m || m.collides(m.box())) continue;
      if (made) made(m);
      g.entities.push(m);
      if (++total >= (SPAWN_CLUSTER[type] || 4)) return total;
    }
  }
  return total;
}
// a kind from a spawn list (only the mobs this game has), by weight
function spawnPickOf(list) {
  if (!list || !list.length) return null;
  let tot = 0,
    last = null;
  for (const s of list) if (MOB_TYPES[s.type.replace('minecraft:', '')]) {
    tot += s.weight;
    last = s;
  }
  if (!last) return null;
  let r = Math.random() * tot;
  for (const s of list) {
    if (!MOB_TYPES[s.type.replace('minecraft:', '')]) continue;
    if ((r -= s.weight) < 0) return s;
  }
  return last;
}
// the biome whose spawn lists apply here: a superflat world (the older format, no vanilla biome data) is vanilla's
// default superflat, all plains - it had the older generator's spawning, five monsters and no slimes
let SPAWN_FLAT = null;
function spawnBiome(g, x, z) {
  if (g.world && g.world.flat) return SPAWN_FLAT || (SPAWN_FLAT = self.WG_DATA && WG_DATA.biome.plains ? {
    name: 'plains',
    def: WG_DATA.biome.plains
  } : null);
  return g.vbiomeAt ? g.vbiomeAt(x, z) : null;
}
// a structure's own spawn list for the category at this spot, or null (vanilla NaturalSpawner.mobsAt: spawn_overrides -
// pillager outposts their pillagers, swamp huts witches, ancient cities nothing); inside the structure's box. The pieces'
// own boxes are not kept, so of the "piece" ones only the swamp hut's (one piece) counts - not the trial chambers' whole
// box of rock. Without `y`, by the column only
function spawnOverride(g, cat, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    refs = w.structRefs,
    S = self.STRUCT_DATA && STRUCT_DATA.structure;
  if (!refs || !refs.size || !S) return null;
  // (only the refs of structures with overrides, kept while the map does not change: it holds every structure seen)
  let c = w._spawnOvr;
  if (!c || c.refs !== refs || c.n !== refs.size) {
    c = w._spawnOvr = {
      refs,
      n: refs.size,
      list: []
    };
    for (const s of refs.values()) if (S[s.name] && S[s.name].spawn_overrides && Object.keys(S[s.name].spawn_overrides).length) c.list.push(s);
  }
  const vy = y == null ? null : y + (w.minY || 0);
  for (const s of c.list) {
    const o = S[s.name].spawn_overrides[cat],
      b = s.box;
    if (o && (o.bounding_box !== 'piece' || s.name === 'swamp_hut') && x >= b[0] && x <= b[3] && z >= b[2] && z <= b[5] && (vy == null || vy >= b[1] && vy <= b[4])) return o.spawns || [];
  }
  return null;
}
// the block a land animal stands on in this column: below the leaves (vanilla's MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES heightmap for
// animals; surfaceY stops on the canopy, so no animal came under the trees of a forest or taiga), stopping at a fluid
function spawnGroundY(w, x, z) {
  let y = w.surfaceY(x, z);
  for (let id = w.getBlock(x, y, z); y > 1 && (/_leaves$/.test(BLOCKS[id].key) || !BLOCKS[id].solid && !IS_FLUID[id]); id = w.getBlock(x, --y, z));
  return y;
}
// the block a creature stands on: parrots and ocelots also on the canopy (vanilla SpawnPlacements: MOTION_BLOCKING)
function spawnStandY(w, type, x, z) {
  return type === 'parrot' || type === 'ocelot' ? w.surfaceY(x, z) : spawnGroundY(w, x, z);
}
Game.prototype.spawnPick = function (cat, x, z, y) {
  const o = y != null ? spawnOverride(this, cat, x, y, z) : null;
  if (o) return spawnPickOf(o);
  const v = spawnBiome(this, x, z);
  return spawnPickOf(v && v.def && v.def.spawners && v.def.spawners[cat]);
};
const _oldSpawnMobs = Game.prototype.spawnMobs;
Game.prototype.spawnMobs = function () {
  const p = this.player;
  // worlds from the older generator have no vanilla biome data: their own spawning
  const v0 = spawnBiome(this, Math.floor(p.pos[0]), Math.floor(p.pos[2]));
  if (!v0 || !v0.def || !v0.def.spawners) return _oldSpawnMobs.call(this);
  // occasional ones
  if (this.tickCount % 24000 === 1200 && this.trySpawnTrader) this.trySpawnTrader();
  if (this.tickCount % 1200 === 0 && this.trySpawnPhantoms) this.trySpawnPhantoms();
  const sp = spawnArea(this);
  if (!sp.n) return;
  const counts = {};
  for (const e of this.entities) {
    if (!(e instanceof Mob) || e.dead || spawnMustKeep(e) || !sp.has(e.pos[0], e.pos[2])) continue;
    const c = spawnCatOf(e);
    counts[c] = (counts[c] || 0) + 1;
  }
  const dark = spawnDarken(this);
  for (const cat in SPAWN_CAPS) {
    const cap = Math.max(1, Math.round(SPAWN_CAPS[cat] * sp.scale));
    if ((counts[cat] || 0) >= cap) continue;
    if (cat === 'monster' && this.difficulty === 0) continue;
    // animals (vanilla: mostly with new chunks - Game.spawnAnimals -, then every 400 ticks a try in each chunk around,
    // up to the cap; it was one try in 20 seconds for the whole area)
    if (cat === 'creature' && this.tickCount % 400 !== 0) continue;
    for (let attempt = 0, tries = cat === 'creature' ? sp.n : cat === 'monster' ? 3 : 1; attempt < tries && (counts[cat] || 0) < cap; attempt++) {
      const at = sp.pick();
      if (!at || !sp.ok(at[0], at[1])) continue;
      const [x, z] = at;
      // (a structure's own list where there is one for this column: pillager outposts - checked again at the height; an
      // empty one, an ancient city's, only decides at the height, so the ground and caves above it keep the biome's)
      const own = spawnOverride(this, cat, x, null, z),
        fromOwn = !!(own && own.length);
      let pick = fromOwn ? spawnPickOf(own) : this.spawnPick(cat, x, z);
      if (!pick) continue;
      const y = this.spawnY(cat, pick.type.replace('minecraft:', ''), x, z, dark);
      if (y == null) continue;
      if (own) {
        const at = spawnOverride(this, cat, x, y, z);
        if ((at ? at !== own || !fromOwn : fromOwn) && (!(pick = at ? spawnPickOf(at) : this.spawnPick(cat, x, z)) || this.spawnY(cat, pick.type.replace('minecraft:', ''), x, z, dark, y) == null)) continue;
      }
      counts[cat] = (counts[cat] || 0) + spawnAttempt(this, pick, x, y, z, sp, (t, sx, sy, sz) => this.spawnY(cat, t, sx, sz, dark, sy) != null, (sx, sz) => this.spawnPick(cat, sx, sz, y), m => {
        if (cat !== 'creature') m.persistent = false;else if (Math.random() < 0.1 && m.makeBaby && !m.T.hostile) m.makeBaby();
      });
      if (cat !== 'creature') break;
    }
  }
};
// vanilla Slime.checkSlimeSpawnRules: in a swamp at 51..69 by the moon's brightness and the light, or below 40 in a slime
// chunk (one in 10) one time in 10, at any light. The list has slimes in every biome: before, below -24 (a y counted from
// the bottom, 40) every pick of them spawned, in every chunk - slimes all through the deep caves; above it only in swamps
// a new chunk's animals (vanilla NaturalSpawner.spawnMobsForChunkGeneration; Game.spawnAnimals made the first roll under
// the biome's creature_spawn_probability): a group from the biome's creature list - wolves, horses, rabbits, foxes ... as
// the biome has them, it was pigs, cows, sheep and chickens everywhere - then another while a roll stays under it; each of
// the kind's count, on the ground of a column walking from the group's start within the chunk, 4 tries each
Game.prototype.spawnChunkAnimals = function (ch, v) {
  var _v$def$creature_spawn;
  const w = this.world,
    x0 = ch.cx * 16,
    z0 = ch.cz * 16,
    prob = (_v$def$creature_spawn = v.def.creature_spawn_probability) !== null && _v$def$creature_spawn !== void 0 ? _v$def$creature_spawn : 0.1;
  do {
    const pick = spawnPickOf(v.def.spawners.creature);
    if (!pick) return;
    const type = pick.type.replace('minecraft:', ''),
      n = pick.minCount + randInt(0, pick.maxCount - pick.minCount);
    const sx = x0 + randInt(0, 15),
      sz = z0 + randInt(0, 15);
    let x = sx,
      z = sz;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      for (let a = 0, done = false; !done && a < 4; a++) {
        const y = this.spawnY('creature', type, x, z, 0, spawnStandY(w, type, x, z) + 1),
          m = y != null && createMob(this, type, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        if (m && !m.collides(m.box())) {
          if (i > 0 && Math.random() < 0.05 && m.makeBaby) m.makeBaby();
          this.entities.push(m);
          done = true;
        }
        x += randInt(0, 4) - randInt(0, 4);
        z += randInt(0, 4) - randInt(0, 4);
        while (x < x0 || x >= x0 + 16 || z < z0 || z >= z0 + 16) {
          x = sx + randInt(0, 4) - randInt(0, 4);
          z = sz + randInt(0, 4) - randInt(0, 4);
        }
      }
    }
  } while (Math.random() < prob);
};
// (a superflat world's ground is vanilla superflat's, from -64: slimes in its slime chunks as there)
Game.prototype.slimeSpawnOk = function (x, y, z, sky, blk, dark) {
  const wy = y + (this.world.flat ? -64 : this.world.minY || 0),
    moon = MOON_BRIGHT[(Math.floor(this.worldTime / 24000) % 8 + 8) % 8];
  if (wy > 50 && wy < 70 && /swamp/.test(biomeName(this, x, z)) && Math.random() < 0.5 && Math.random() < moon && Math.max(sky - dark, blk) <= randInt(0, 7)) return true;
  return wy < 40 && Math.random() < 0.1 && slimeChunk(this, x >> 4, z >> 4);
};
// a y to spawn at in this column for a category, or null (the light and block rules); `dark`: the sky darkening
// (spawnDarken); `near`: only that height (the rest of a spawn attempt, which keeps the attempt's one height)
Game.prototype.spawnY = function (cat, type, x, z, dark, near) {
  const w = this.world,
    surf = w.surfaceY(x, z),
    py = Math.floor(this.player.pos[1]);
  // (not a cell with water: kelp and seagrass are neither solid nor a fluid, so monsters spawned on the dark sea floor
  // among them and swam up - "白天海上刷怪", feedback 2026-11-01/02)
  const air = y => {
    const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
    return id === 0 || !BLOCKS[id].solid && !IS_FLUID[id] && !WLOG[id] && !w.isWaterlogged(x, y, z);
  };
  const water = y => {
    const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
    return id === WATER || !!WLOG[id];
  };
  if (cat === 'water_creature' || cat === 'water_ambient' || cat === 'underground_water_creature' || cat === 'axolotls') {
    const deep = cat === 'underground_water_creature' || cat === 'axolotls';
    // vanilla heights (this world's y counts from its bottom, SEA is its top water layer): squid, fish and dolphins 13
    // below the sea level up to it with water below and above (WaterAnimal.checkSurfaceWaterAnimalSpawnRules); glow
    // squids 33 and more below it where no light reaches (GlowSquid.checkGlowSquidSpawnRules). Written for a y from
    // 0, fish and squid were looked for inside the sea floor (only flooded caves under it got them) and glow squids
    // only far deeper (its 30 meant vanilla's y), in block light too
    let y = near;
    if (y == null) {
      const lo = deep ? Math.max(1, py - 48) : SEA - 12,
        hi = deep ? Math.min(SEA - 32, py + 24) : SEA - 1;
      if (lo > hi) return null;
      y = randInt(lo, hi);
    }
    if (!water(y) || !water(y + 1)) return null;
    if (deep ? w.getLight(x, y, z) !== 0 : !water(y - 1)) return null;
    return y;
  }
  if (cat === 'ambient') {
    // vanilla Bat.checkBatSpawnRules: below the sea level, on a floor, in the light the hour leaves within a roll of
    // 0..3 (0..6 around Halloween; outside it half the tries fail first) - it was capped at 62 counted from the bottom
    let y = near;
    if (y == null) {
      const lo = Math.max(1, py - 48),
        hi = Math.min(SEA, surf - 4, py + 24);
      if (lo > hi) return null;
      y = randInt(lo, hi);
    }
    if (y > SEA || !SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z)] || !air(y) || !air(y + 1)) return null;
    const l = w.getLight(x, y, z),
      hw = spawnHalloween();
    if (!hw && Math.random() < 0.5) return null;
    if (Math.max((l >> 4) - dark, l & 15) > randInt(0, hw ? 6 : 3)) return null;
    return y;
  }
  // drowned: vanilla Drowned.checkDrownedSpawnRules (placed in water): water there and below, no solid block above, dark
  // enough as any monster, then one try in 15 in rivers, or one in 40 at least 5 below the sea level elsewhere. Since
  // water stopped counting as room for the monsters below (11-02), none spawned at all (no tridents from them)
  if (type === 'drowned') {
    let y = near;
    if (y == null) {
      const lo = Math.max(1, Math.min(surf + 2, py - 48)),
        hi = SEA;
      if (lo > hi) return null;
      y = randInt(lo, hi);
    }
    if (!water(y) || !water(y - 1) || SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)]) return null;
    const l = w.getLight(x, y, z),
      sky = l >> 4,
      blk = l & 15;
    if (sky > randInt(0, 31) || blk > 0 || Math.max(sky - dark, blk) > randInt(0, 7)) return null;
    return Math.random() < (/river/.test(biomeName(this, x, z)) ? 1 / 15 : y <= SEA - 5 ? 1 / 40 : 0) ? y : null;
  }
  // guardians (an ocean monument's list): vanilla Guardian.checkGuardianSpawnRules, placed in water - water there and
  // below, no solid block above, then one try in 20 where the sky shows through the water (no light rule). They went down
  // the land path, which wants air, so none spawned
  if (type === 'guardian' || type === 'elder_guardian') {
    let y = near;
    if (y == null) {
      const lo = Math.max(1, Math.min(surf, py - 48)),
        hi = SEA;
      if (lo > hi) return null;
      y = randInt(lo, hi);
    }
    if (!water(y) || !water(y - 1) || SOLIDCUBE[w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)]) return null;
    return surf < y && Math.random() >= 1 / 20 ? null : y;
  }
  // monsters and creatures: on a solid block with room above
  const cand = near != null ? [near] : cat === 'creature' ? [spawnStandY(w, type, x, z) + 1] : Math.random() < 0.4 ? [surf + 1] : [randInt(Math.max(1, Math.min(surf, py - 48)), surf)];
  for (const y0 of cand) {
    let y = y0;
    if (near == null && cat === 'monster' && !air(y)) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 12 && !air(y); k++) y++;
    }
    const below = w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z),
      bk = BLOCKS[below].key;
    // (leaves are not opaque: parrots and ocelots may still stand on them - vanilla LeavesBlock isValidSpawn)
    if (!(SOLIDCUBE[below] || (type === 'parrot' || type === 'ocelot') && /_leaves$/.test(bk)) || !air(y) || !air(y + 1)) continue;
    if (bk === 'bedrock' || bk === 'barrier' || bk === 'magma_block' && !MOB_TYPES[type].fireproof) continue;
    const l = w.getLight(x, y, z),
      sky = l >> 4,
      blk = l & 15;
    if (cat === 'monster') {
      // vanilla Monster.isDarkEnoughToSpawn: the sky light over a roll of 0..31 fails at any hour, any block light fails,
      // then the light the hour leaves (the sky less the darkening, or the block light) must be within a roll of 0..7.
      // Before, only the last, with the sky scaled to nothing at night: every dark spot took a mob, open ground at night
      // four times as often as vanilla
      if (type === 'slime') {
        if (!this.slimeSpawnOk(x, y, z, sky, blk, dark)) continue;
      }
      // (pillagers at an outpost: any sky light, block light up to 8 - PatrollingMonster.checkPatrollingMonsterSpawnRules)
      else if (type === 'pillager') {
        if (blk > 8) continue;
      } else if (sky > randInt(0, 31) || blk > 0 || Math.max(sky - dark, blk) > randInt(0, 7)) continue;
    } else {
      if (l >> 4 < 9 && blk < 9) continue;
      const g2 = SPAWN_GROUND[type];
      if (g2 ? !g2.test(bk) : bk !== 'grass_block') continue;
    }
    return y;
  }
  return null;
};
// the spawn lists know about the mobs of 26.2; the old hostile list stays as the fallback without biome data
// Worlds saved before the counts above were fixed can hold hundreds of plain animals spawned while idling.
// Once per dimension: in each 128x128 area keep at most 40 of them (named, owned, tamed, saddled or bucket
// mobs are always kept).
const SPAWN_CLEAN_MAX = 40;
const _loadDimDataSpawn = Game.prototype.loadDimData;
Game.prototype.loadDimData = async function (dim) {
  const had = !!this.dimData[dim],
    d = await _loadDimDataSpawn.call(this, dim);
  const md = this.worldMeta && this.worldMeta.dims && this.worldMeta.dims[dim];
  const fixed = this.worldMeta && (this.worldMeta.capFix || (this.worldMeta.capFix = {}));
  if (had || !md || !fixed || fixed[dim]) return d;
  fixed[dim] = 1;
  const cells = new Map(),
    drop = new Set();
  for (const m of d.pendingMobs) {
    const T = MOB_TYPES[m.type],
      x = m.x || {};
    if (!T || T.cat !== 'creature' || x.name || x.own || x.tame || x.trust || x.fb || x.sad || x.sit) continue;
    const k = Math.floor(m.pos[0] / 128) + ',' + Math.floor(m.pos[2] / 128);
    if (!cells.has(k)) cells.set(k, []);
    cells.get(k).push(m);
  }
  for (const list of cells.values()) {
    if (list.length <= SPAWN_CLEAN_MAX) continue;
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [list[i], list[j]] = [list[j], list[i]];
    }
    for (let i = SPAWN_CLEAN_MAX; i < list.length; i++) drop.add(list[i]);
  }
  if (drop.size) {
    d.pendingMobs = d.pendingMobs.filter(m => !drop.has(m));
    console.log('[spawning] removed ' + drop.size + ' extra animals from the save (' + dim + ')');
  }
  return d;
};
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/draw2.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drawing for the Ender Dragon and End crystals
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function lerpAngle(a, b, t) {
  let d = b - a;
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return a + d * t;
}

// The dragon's neck and tail follow its own recent flight path: each segment takes the yaw/height the
// body had a few ticks earlier (neck: recent, tail: older), so it snakes through turns, banks and dives.
const wrapA = d => {
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return d;
};
EnderDragon.prototype.latency = function (i, a) {
  // [yaw, y] i ticks ago, interpolated with the partial tick
  const h = this.hist,
    cur = i === 0 ? [this.yaw, this.pos[1]] : h[Math.min(i - 1, h.length - 1)] ? [h[Math.min(i - 1, h.length - 1)][3], h[Math.min(i - 1, h.length - 1)][1]] : [this.yaw, this.pos[1]];
  const o = h[Math.min(i, h.length - 1)],
    old = o ? [o[3], o[1]] : cur;
  return [old[0] + wrapA(cur[0] - old[0]) * a, lerp(old[1], cur[1], a)];
};
Game.prototype.drawDragon = function (e, ip, a, env) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    gl = r.gl,
    D = r.dragon;
  const f = lerp(e.prevFlap, e.flap, a),
    fr = f * Math.PI * 2;
  const sitting = e.phase === 'perch';
  const landing = e.phase === 'land' || e.phase === 'takeoff';
  const L = e.lightAt();
  L[0] = Math.max(L[0], 0.8);
  const dying = e.deathTime > 0;
  const opts = {
    overlay: e.hurtTime > 0 ? [1, 0, 0, 0.35] : dying ? [1, 1, 1, Math.min(0.85, e.deathTime / 220)] : null
  };
  const lat = i => e.latency(i, a);
  const l5 = lat(5),
    l6 = lat(6),
    l10 = lat(10);
  const turn = wrapA(l5[0] - l10[0]); // recent turn rate -> banking
  const midYaw = l5[0] + turn / 2;
  const climb = l5[1] - l10[1]; // recent climb -> body pitch
  // body bob with the wingbeat
  let bob = Math.sin(fr - 1) + 1;
  bob = (bob * bob + bob * 2) * 0.05;
  const base = M4.create();
  M4.translate(base, ip[0], ip[1] + 2.75 + bob * 0.5, ip[2]);
  M4.rotY(base, lat(7)[0]);
  M4.rotX(base, clamp(climb * 10 * Math.PI / 180, -0.7, 0.7) + bob * 2 * Math.PI / 180);
  M4.translate(base, 0, 0, -1.5);
  // the body and everything on it banks around a point one block up
  const body = M4.copy(base);
  M4.translate(body, 0, 1, 0);
  M4.rotZ(body, clamp(turn * 1.5, -0.8, 0.8));
  M4.translate(body, 0, -1, 0);
  const at = (m, x, y, z) => {
    const c = M4.copy(m);
    M4.translate(c, x / 16, y / 16, z / 16);
    return c;
  };
  const draw = (mesh, m) => r.drawPart(mesh, 'dragon', m, L, env, opts);
  gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  // pitch of a neck part: height difference along the path, or bowed down while perched
  const partPitch = (i, hp) => {
    let d;
    if (landing) {
      const dist = Math.hypot(e.pos[0], e.pos[2]);
      d = i / Math.max(dist / 4, 1);
      return -d * 7.5 * Math.PI / 180;
    }
    if (sitting) return -i * 7.5 * Math.PI / 180;
    if (i === 6) return 0;
    return (hp[1] - l6[1]) * 7.5 * Math.PI / 180;
  };
  // neck: 5 segments, each 10px along its own direction
  let px = 0,
    py = -16,
    pz = -12;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const h = lat(5 - i);
    const yaw = wrapA(h[0] - l6[0]) * 1.5,
      pitch = Math.cos(i * 0.45 + fr) * 0.15 + clamp(partPitch(i, h), -1.2, 1.2);
    const m = at(base, px, py, pz);
    M4.rotY(m, yaw);
    M4.rotX(m, pitch);
    M4.rotZ(m, -wrapA(h[0] - midYaw) * 1.5);
    draw(D.seg, m);
    py += Math.sin(pitch) * 10;
    pz -= Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch) * 10;
    px -= Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch) * 10;
  }
  // head + jaw
  const h0 = lat(0);
  const head = at(base, px, py, pz);
  M4.rotY(head, wrapA(h0[0] - l6[0]));
  M4.rotX(head, clamp(partPitch(6, h0), -1.2, 1.2));
  M4.rotZ(head, -wrapA(h0[0] - midYaw));
  draw(D.head, head);
  const jaw = at(head, 0, -4, -14);
  M4.rotX(jaw, -(Math.sin(fr) + 1) * 0.2);
  draw(D.jaw, jaw);
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);
  r.drawPart(D.head, 'dragon_eyes', head, [1, 1], env, {
    bright: true
  });
  gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
  gl.depthFunc(gl.LESS);
  // body
  draw(D.body, body);
  // wings: big slow beats, the tip trailing the main wing
  for (const side of [1, -1]) {
    const wm = at(body, 12 * side, -1, 2);
    if (side < 0) M4.scale(wm, -1, 1, 1);
    M4.rotZ(wm, (Math.sin(fr) + 0.125) * 0.8);
    M4.rotY(wm, -0.25);
    M4.rotX(wm, -(0.125 - Math.cos(fr) * 0.2));
    draw(D.wing, wm);
    const tm = at(wm, 56, 0, 0);
    M4.rotZ(tm, -(Math.sin(fr + 2) + 0.5) * 0.75);
    draw(D.tip, tm);
  }
  // legs tucked back, swinging slightly with the bob
  for (const side of [1, -1]) {
    const fl = at(body, 12 * side, -16, 2);
    M4.rotX(fl, -(1.3 + bob * 0.1));
    draw(D.fleg, fl);
    const ft = at(fl, 0, -20, -1);
    M4.rotX(ft, 0.5 + bob * 0.1);
    draw(D.ftip, ft);
    const ff = at(ft, 0, -23, 0);
    M4.rotX(ff, -(0.75 + bob * 0.1));
    draw(D.ffoot, ff);
    const rl = at(body, 16 * side, -12, 42);
    M4.rotX(rl, -(1.0 + bob * 0.1));
    draw(D.rleg, rl);
    const rt = at(rl, 0, -32, -4);
    M4.rotX(rt, -(0.5 + bob * 0.1));
    draw(D.rtip, rt);
    const rf = at(rt, 0, -31, 4);
    M4.rotX(rf, -(0.75 + bob * 0.1));
    draw(D.rfoot, rf);
  }
  // tail: 12 segments trailing behind, using older parts of the path
  const l11 = lat(11);
  let tx = 0,
    ty = -6,
    tz = 60,
    wave = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
    const h = lat(12 + k);
    wave += Math.sin(k * 0.45 + fr) * 0.05;
    const yaw = Math.PI + wrapA(h[0] - l11[0]) * 1.5,
      pitch = wave + clamp((h[1] - l11[1]) * 7.5 * Math.PI / 180, -1, 1);
    const m = at(base, tx, ty, tz);
    M4.rotY(m, yaw);
    M4.rotX(m, pitch);
    M4.rotZ(m, wrapA(h[0] - midYaw) * 1.5);
    draw(D.seg, m);
    ty += Math.sin(pitch) * 10;
    tz -= Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch) * 10;
    tx -= Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch) * 10;
  }
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  if (dying) r.drawRays([ip[0], ip[1] + 2.5, ip[2]], e.deathTime + a, 30, 4242);
};
Game.prototype.drawCrystal = function (e, ip, a, env) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    gl = r.gl;
  const t = e.age + a + e.spin;
  let bob = Math.sin(t * 0.2) / 2 + 0.5;
  bob = (bob * bob + bob) * 0.4 - 1.4;
  const L = [1, 1];
  if (e.showBase) {
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    M4.scale(m, 2, 2, 2);
    r.drawPart(r.models.crystal_base.parts[0].mesh, 'end_crystal', m, L, env, {
      bright: true
    });
  }
  const c = [ip[0], ip[1] + 1.2 + bob * 0.5 + 0.6, ip[2]];
  const spin = t * 3 * Math.PI / 180;
  gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  let s = 2;
  const parts = [[r.models.crystal_glass, 'end_crystal'], [r.models.crystal_glass, 'end_crystal'], [r.models.crystal_core, 'end_crystal']];
  parts.forEach(([mdl, tex], i) => {
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, spin * (i % 2 ? -1 : 1));
    M4.rotX(m, 0.785);
    M4.rotZ(m, 0.615);
    M4.scale(m, s, s, s);
    r.drawPart(mdl.parts[0].mesh, tex, m, L, env, {
      bright: true
    });
    s *= 0.875;
  });
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  const dr = this.dragon(),
    bt = e.beamTarget;
  // a beam to a block (the server's beam_target: respawning the dragon, the exit portal's pillars): to its centre
  if (bt) r.drawBeam([c[0], c[1], c[2]], [bt[0] + 0.5, bt[1] + 0.5, bt[2] + 0.5], 'end_crystal_beam', 0.35, [1, 0.8, 1, 1], -(this.worldTime + a) * 0.05);
  if (dr && dr.healer === e && dr.deathTime === 0) {
    const di = dr.ipos(a);
    r.drawBeam([c[0], c[1], c[2]], [di[0], di[1] + 2.5, di[2]], 'end_crystal_beam', 0.35, [1, 0.8, 1, 1], -(this.worldTime + a) * 0.05);
  }
};

// the small mob spinning inside each nearby spawner (vanilla SpawnerRenderer)
Game.prototype.drawSpawners = function (a, env) {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world,
    px = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
    pz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
  const r = this.renderer,
    dist = Math.min(64, r.renderDist * 16);
  this.spawnerDummies = this.spawnerDummies || {};
  this.spawnerSpin = this.spawnerSpin || new Map();
  for (let cx = px - dist >> 4; cx <= px + dist >> 4; cx++) for (let cz = pz - dist >> 4; cz <= pz + dist >> 4; cz++) {
    const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
    if (!ch) continue;
    if (!ch.spawners) {
      ch.spawners = [];
      ch.findAll([127], i => ch.spawners.push([cx * 16 + (i & 15), i >> 8, cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15)]));
    }
    for (const s of ch.spawners) {
      const [x, y, z] = s;
      if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) !== 127) continue;
      if (!aabbInFrustum(r.planes, x, y, z, x + 1, y + 1, z + 1)) continue;
      const type = this.spawnerMob(x, y, z);
      if (!type) continue;
      let d = this.spawnerDummies[type];
      if (!d) {
        d = this.spawnerDummies[type] = createMob(this, type, 0, 0, 0);
        d.displayMatrix = null;
      }
      // spin speeds up as the next spawn approaches, and only while a player is in range
      const k = s.join(','),
        sp = this.spawnerSpin.get(k) || {
          spin: 0,
          prev: 0,
          t: -1
        };
      const near = Math.hypot(x + 0.5 - p.pos[0], y + 0.5 - p.pos[1], z + 0.5 - p.pos[2]) <= 16;
      if (sp.t !== this.tickCount) {
        const ticks = sp.t < 0 ? 0 : Math.min(20, this.tickCount - sp.t);
        sp.t = this.tickCount;
        sp.prev = sp.spin;
        if (near) {
          const left = this.spawnerT && this.spawnerT.get(k) || 200;
          sp.spin += ticks * 1000 / (Math.max(0, left) + 200) * Math.PI / 180;
        }
        this.spawnerSpin.set(k, sp);
      }
      const spin = lerp(sp.prev, sp.spin, a);
      let sc = 0.53125;
      const big = Math.max(d.w, d.h);
      if (big > 1) sc /= big;
      const m = M4.create();
      M4.translate(m, x + 0.5, y + 0.4, z + 0.5);
      M4.rotY(m, spin);
      M4.translate(m, 0, -0.2, 0);
      M4.rotX(m, -30 * Math.PI / 180);
      M4.scale(m, sc, sc, sc);
      // light from the air above: the spawner block itself may block light
      d.pos = [x + 0.5, y + 1.1, z + 0.5];
      const L = d.lightAt();
      d.displayMatrix = m;
      d.age = this.tickCount;
      d.hurtTime = 0;
      d.fire = 0;
      this.drawMob(d, d.pos, a, env, L);
      d.displayMatrix = null;
    }
  }
};

// chests are block entities: drawn as models so the lid can open
const CHEST_ROT = {
  5: 0,
  1: Math.PI / 2,
  4: Math.PI,
  0: -Math.PI / 2
}; // front face -> rotation of the south-facing model
Game.prototype.tickChestLids = function () {
  for (const k of this.openChests) if (!this.chestLids.has(k)) this.chestLids.set(k, {
    o: 0,
    prev: 0
  });
  for (const [k, l] of this.chestLids) {
    l.prev = l.o;
    const [x, y, z] = k.split(',').map(Number),
      m = this.world.getMeta(x, y, z),
      s = chestSeam(m);
    const open = this.openChests.has(k) || s && this.openChests.has(`${x + s[0]},${y},${z + s[1]}`);
    l.o = clamp(l.o + (open ? 0.1 : -0.1), 0, 1);
    if (!open && l.o === 0 && l.prev === 0) this.chestLids.delete(k);
  }
};

<script>

// banners, heads and skulls, decorated pots, conduits and copper golem statues. Their blocks are data blocks of
// kind 'entity' (tools/build_blocks.py; chests keep the chest's own facing / double-chest meta); the state picks
// the pose. Models are in pixels, y up, facing -z (like the mob models), drawn at the block's bottom centre.

// vanilla's dye colours (DyeColor texture colours), for banners
const DYE_RGB = {
  white: 0xF9FFFE,
  orange: 0xF9801D,
  magenta: 0xC74EBD,
  light_blue: 0x3AB3DA,
  yellow: 0xFED83D,
  lime: 0x80C71F,
  pink: 0xF38BAA,
  gray: 0x474F52,
  light_gray: 0x9D9D97,

  brown: 0x835432,

  red: 0xB02E26,
  black: 0x1D1D21
};
const dyeOf = key => {
  for (const c in DYE_RGB) if (key.startsWith(c + '_')) return c;
  return 'white';
};
// facing -> vanilla angle (0 south, 90 west, 180 north, 270 east)
const FACING_DEG = {
  south: 0,

// the model rotation that turns the -z-facing models to a vanilla angle
const beYaw = deg => Math.PI - deg * Math.PI / 180;

// textures of the block-entity models: GL textures made from ASSETS.images the first time they are drawn

  }
  return k;
};

// what to draw for a block entity block: [model, texture, model matrix, opts] parts
function beParts(r, b, m, x, y, z) {
  const st = b.states && b.states[m] || {},
    key = b.key;
  const rot16 = (st.rotation !== undefined ? +st.rotation : 0) * 22.5;
  switch (b.be) {
    case 'head':
    case 'wall_head':
      {
        var _FACING_DEG$st$facing;
        const wall = b.be === 'wall_head',
          deg = wall ? (_FACING_DEG$st$facing = FACING_DEG[st.facing]) !== null && _FACING_DEG$st$facing !== void 0 ? _FACING_DEG$st$facing : 0 : rot16;
        const kind = key.replace(/_(wall_)?(head|skull)$/, '');
        const [model, tex] = kind === 'skeleton' ? ['be_head', 'skeleton'] : kind === 'wither_skeleton' ? ['be_head', 'wither_skeleton'] : kind === 'creeper' ? ['be_head', 'creeper'] : kind === 'zombie' ? ['be_head64', 'zombie'] : kind === 'piglin' ? ['be_piglin_head', 'piglin'] : kind === 'dragon' ? ['be_dragon_head', 'dragon'] : ['be_player_head', 'steve'];
        const t = M4.create();
        M4.translate(t, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        M4.rotY(t, beYaw(deg));
        if (wall) M4.translate(t, 0, 4 / 16, 4 / 16);
        if (kind === 'dragon') M4.scale(t, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75);
        return [[model, tex, t]];
      }
    case 'banner':
    case 'wall_banner':
      {
        var _FACING_DEG$st$facing2;
        const wall = b.be === 'wall_banner',
          deg = wall ? (_FACING_DEG$st$facing2 = FACING_DEG[st.facing]) !== null && _FACING_DEG$st$facing2 !== void 0 ? _FACING_DEG$st$facing2 : 0 : rot16;
        const t = M4.create();
        M4.translate(t, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        M4.rotY(t, beYaw(deg));
        const c = DYE_RGB[dyeOf(key)],
          tint = [(c >> 16 & 255) / 255, (c >> 8 & 255) / 255, (c & 255) / 255];
        if (wall) {
          const f = new Float32Array(t);
          M4.translate(f, 0, -24 / 16, 6 / 16);
          return [['be_banner_bar', 'banner_base', t], ['be_banner_flag', 'banner_pattern_base', f, {
            tint
          }]];
        }
        const f = new Float32Array(t);
        M4.translate(f, 0, 2 / 16, 0);
        return [['be_banner_pole', 'banner_base', t], ['be_banner_flag', 'banner_pattern_base', f, {
          tint
        }]];
      }
    case 'shulker_box':
      {
        const t = M4.create();
        M4.translate(t, x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5);
        const f = st.facing || 'up';
        if (f === 'down') M4.rotX(t, Math.PI);else if (f !== 'up') {
          M4.rotY(t, beYaw(FACING_DEG[f]));
          M4.rotX(t, -Math.PI / 2);
        }
        M4.translate(t, 0, -0.5, 0);
        const color = key === 'shulker_box' ? '' : '_' + key.replace(/_shulker_box$/, '');
        return [['be_shulker', 'shulker' + color, t]];
      }
    case 'decorated_pot':
      {
        var _FACING_DEG$st$facing3;
        const t = M4.create();
        M4.translate(t, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        M4.rotY(t, beYaw((_FACING_DEG$st$facing3 = FACING_DEG[st.facing]) !== null && _FACING_DEG$st$facing3 !== void 0 ? _FACING_DEG$st$facing3 : 0));
        return [['be_pot_base', 'decorated_pot_base', t], ['be_pot_sides', 'decorated_pot_side', t]];
      }
    case 'conduit':
      {
        const t = M4.create();
        M4.translate(t, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        return [['be_conduit', 'conduit_base', t]];
      }
    case 'golem_statue':
      {
        var _FACING_DEG$st$facing4;
        const t = M4.create();
        M4.translate(t, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        M4.rotY(t, beYaw((_FACING_DEG$st$facing4 = FACING_DEG[st.facing]) !== null && _FACING_DEG$st$facing4 !== void 0 ? _FACING_DEG$st$facing4 : 0));
        const ox = key.replace(/^waxed_/, '').replace(/copper_golem_statue$/, '').replace(/_$/, '');
        return [['be_golem', 'copper_golem' + (ox ? '_' + ox : ''), t]];
      }
  }
  return [];
}
// a block-entity block drawn in the world or as an icon (opts.vp: the icon's projection)
Renderer.prototype.drawBE = function (b, m, x, y, z, light, env, opts = {}) {
  this.initBEModels();
  for (const [model, tex, mat, o] of beParts(this, b, m, x, y, z)) {
    if (!this.beTex(tex)) continue;
    let mm = mat;
    if (opts.base) {
      mm = new Float32Array(16);
      M4.mul(mm, opts.base, mat);
    }
    this.drawModel(model, tex, mm, null, light, env, {
      ...(o || {}),
      vp: opts.vp
    });
  }
};

// chests: the chest renderer's model per kind (normal, trapped, ender, copper in four stages; waxed the same)
function chestTexBase(key) {
  const k = key.replace(/^waxed_/, '');
  if (k === 'chest') return 'chest_normal';
  if (k === 'trapped_chest') return 'chest_trapped';
  if (k === 'ender_chest') return 'chest_ender';
  const st = k.replace(/_?copper_chest$/, '');
  return 'chest_copper' + (st ? '_' + st : '');
}

// every block entity block in range: chests (lids open with their screens) and the others
Game.prototype.drawChests = function (a, env) {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world,
    r = this.renderer,
    px = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
    pz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
  const dist = Math.min(64, r.renderDist * 16);
  if (!BE_IDS.length) return;
  r.gl.disable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
  for (let cx = px - dist >> 4; cx <= px + dist >> 4; cx++) for (let cz = pz - dist >> 4; cz <= pz + dist >> 4; cz++) {
    const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
    if (!ch) continue;
    if (!ch.chests) {
      ch.chests = [];
      ch.findAll(BE_IDS, i => ch.chests.push([cx * 16 + (i & 15), i >> 8, cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15)]));
    }
    for (const [x, y, z] of ch.chests) {
      const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
        b = BLOCKS[id];
      if (!b || !(b.beRender || BOOK_BLOCKS.has(id) || id === BELL_ID || typeof b.beDraw === 'function')) continue;
      if (!aabbInFrustum(r.planes, x - 1, y - 2, z - 1, x + 2, y + 3, z + 2)) continue;
      const m = w.getMeta(x, y, z),
        l = w.getLight(x, y, z),
        L = [(l >> 4) / 15, (l & 15) / 15];
      // (a mod's block entity drawing: what its block holds - fluids, items - besides its block model)
      if (typeof b.beDraw === 'function') {
        r.gl.enable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
        b.beDraw(this, b, x, y, z, L, env);
        r.gl.disable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
        continue;
      }
      if (BOOK_BLOCKS.has(id)) {
        this.drawBook(b, m, x, y, z, L, env, a);
        continue;
      }
      if (id === BELL_ID) {
        this.drawBell(x, y, z, L, env, a);
        continue;
      }
      if (!b.chestLike) {
        r.drawBE(b, m, x, y, z, L, env);
        continue;
      }
      const t = chestType(m);
      // a double chest's lid opens together: use whichever half has the most open lid
      const s = chestSeam(m),
        k = `${x},${y},${z}`;
      const la = this.chestLids.get(k),
        lb = s && this.chestLids.get(`${x + s[0]},${y},${z + s[1]}`);
      const lid = Math.max(la ? lerp(la.prev, la.o, a) : 0, lb ? lerp(lb.prev, lb.o, a) : 0);
      const ang = (1 - Math.pow(1 - lid, 3)) * Math.PI / 2;
      const mat = M4.create();
      M4.translate(mat, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
      M4.rotY(mat, CHEST_ROT[m & 7] || 0);
      M4.translate(mat, -0.5, 0, -0.5);
      M4.scale(mat, -1, -1, 1);
      const model = t === 1 ? 'chest_left' : t === 2 ? 'chest_right' : 'chest';
      // (the plain chest's halves are chest_left / chest_right in the assets, the other kinds <base>_left / _right;
      // asking for chest_normal_left fell back to the single chest's texture and each half looked like a chest of its own)
      const base = chestTexBase(b.key),
        hb = base === 'chest_normal' ? 'chest' : base,
        tex = t === 1 ? hb + '_left' : t === 2 ? hb + '_right' : base;
      r.drawModel(model, r.beTex(tex) || 'chest_normal', mat, {
        lid: {
          rx: ang
        },
        lock: {
          rx: ang
        }
      }, L, env, {});
    }
  }
  r.gl.enable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
  if (this.signs && this.signs.size) this.drawSignTexts(env);
};

// ---- sign texts (from the server: net.js; signs placed here have none yet) ----
// vanilla's text colours of the dyes
const SIGN_TEXT_RGB = {
  white: '#FFFFFF',
  orange: '#FF681F',
  magenta: '#FF00FF',
  light_blue: '#9AC0CD',
  yellow: '#FFFF00',
  lime: '#BFFF00',
  pink: '#FF69B4',
  gray: '#808080',
  light_gray: '#D3D3D3',
  cyan: '#00FFFF',
  purple: '#A020F0',
  blue: '#0000FF',
  brown: '#8B4513',
  green: '#00FF00',
  red: '#FF0000',
  black: '#000000'
};
// the colour text is drawn in without glowing ink, and glowing text's outline: the dye's colour at 0.4 (vanilla
// SignRenderer.getDarkColor; black glowing text's outline is 0xF0EBCC)
function signDark(c, glow) {
  if (c === 'black' && glow) return '#F0EBCC';
  const h = (SIGN_TEXT_RGB[c] || '#000000').slice(1),
    ch = i => Math.floor(parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16) * 0.4).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  return '#' + ch(0) + ch(2) + ch(4);
}
// a side's text as a texture (the board's 96 x 48 font units, 4 lines of 10), cached by content. Drawn at 2 pixels a
// unit, unsmoothed: the font's glyphs are 16 pixels for 8 units (unifont: every Chinese character), and at one pixel a
// unit - as it was - each was squeezed to 8 and smeared, too blurred to read (the user, 11-13). As vanilla's: plain ink
// the dye's colour darkened (0.4), glowing ink the colour itself with an outline of the dark one all round
const SIGN_SCALE = 2;
Renderer.prototype.signTextTex = function (side) {
  const key = 'sign:' + side.c + (side.g ? '*' : '') + side.l.join('|');
  if (this.entityTex[key]) return key;
  const S = SIGN_SCALE,
    cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = 96 * S;
  cv.height = 48 * S;
  const c = cv.getContext('2d');
  c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  c.scale(S, S);
  const glow = !!side.g,
    dark = signDark(side.c, glow),
    ink = glow ? SIGN_TEXT_RGB[side.c] || '#000000' : dark;
  side.l.slice(0, 4).forEach((t, i) => {
    if (!t) return;
    const x = Math.round(48 - Font.width(t) / 2),
      y = 4 + i * 10;
    // (the outline half a unit out - one pixel here: a whole unit, as vanilla, buried the Chinese glyphs' half-unit strokes)
    if (glow) for (let ox = -1; ox <= 1; ox++) for (let oy = -1; oy <= 1; oy++) if (ox || oy) Font.draw(c, t, x + ox / S, y + oy / S, dark, false);
    Font.draw(c, t, x, y, ink, false);
  });
  this.entityTex[key] = this.tex2D(cv, false);
  (this.signTexKeys || (this.signTexKeys = [])).push(key);
  // keep the most recent 256
  while (this.signTexKeys.length > 256) {
    const k = this.signTexKeys.shift();
    this.gl.deleteTexture(this.entityTex[k]);
    delete this.entityTex[k];
  }
  return key;
};
Game.prototype.drawSignTexts = function (env) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    w = this.world,
    cam = r.camPos;
  r.initBEModels();
  if (!r.models.be_sign_text) {
    const P = boxes => ({
      parts: [{
        name: 'p',
        pivot: [0, 0, 0],
        boxes,
        mesh: r.makeModelPart(boxes, 16, 8)
      }]
    });
    r.models.be_sign_text = P([[0, 0, -8, 9.333, -0.75, 16, 8, 0]]);
    r.models.be_wall_sign_text = P([[0, 0, -8, 4.333, 6.25, 16, 8, 0]]);
    r.models.be_hanging_sign_text = P([[0, 0, -7, 1, -1.05, 14, 8, 0]]);
  }
  r.gl.disable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
  for (const [k, t] of this.signs) {
    var _FACING_DEG$st$facing5;
    const [x, y, z] = k.split(',').map(Number);
    if ((x - cam[0]) ** 2 + (y - cam[1]) ** 2 + (z - cam[2]) ** 2 > 32 * 32) continue;
    const b = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)];
    if (!b || !b.key.endsWith('sign') || !aabbInFrustum(r.planes, x, y, z, x + 1, y + 1, z + 1)) continue;
    const st = b.states && b.states[w.getMeta(x, y, z)] || {};
    const wall = b.key.includes('wall'),
      hanging = b.key.includes('hanging');
    const deg = st.rotation !== undefined ? +st.rotation * 22.5 : (_FACING_DEG$st$facing5 = FACING_DEG[st.facing]) !== null && _FACING_DEG$st$facing5 !== void 0 ? _FACING_DEG$st$facing5 : 0;
    const model = hanging ? 'be_hanging_sign_text' : wall ? 'be_wall_sign_text' : 'be_sign_text';
    const l = w.getLight(x, y, z);
    for (const [side, flip] of [[t.f, 0], [t.b, Math.PI]]) {
      if (!side || !side.l.some(Boolean) || wall && !hanging && flip) continue;
      const m = M4.create();
      M4.translate(m, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
      M4.rotY(m, beYaw(deg) + flip);
      const tex = r.signTextTex(side);
      r.drawModel(model, tex, m, null, side.g ? [1, 1] : [(l >> 4) / 15, (l & 15) / 15], env, {
        bright: side.g
      });
    }
  }
  r.gl.enable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
};
// the blocks drawn above (filled once the blocks exist)
const BE_IDS = [];
for (const b of BLOCKS) if (b && b.beRender) BE_IDS.push(b.id);

// bells (vanilla BellRenderer): the block model is only the frame - the bell itself is this model, drawn the same
// for every attachment; a right click rings it (block.bell.use) and it swings for 50 ticks across the way it was
// struck. It was never drawn and could not be rung (players' feedback 2026-10-31「钟看不见不能敲」)
const BELL_ID = BID.bell;
if (BELL_ID !== undefined) {
  BE_IDS.push(BELL_ID);
  BLOCKS[BELL_ID].beDraw = true;
  // (vanilla BellBlock's shape: the frame and the bell - BELL_TOP_SHAPE and BELL_BOTTOM_SHAPE - to aim at and bump into)
  const frame = BLOCKS[BELL_ID].boxes;
  BLOCKS[BELL_ID].boxes = m => (frame ? frame(m) || [] : []).concat([[5, 6, 5, 11, 13, 11], [4, 4, 4, 12, 6, 12]]);
  BLOCKS[BELL_ID].onUse = function (g, x, y, z) {
    const p = g.player,
      dx = x + 0.5 - p.pos[0],
      dz = z + 0.5 - p.pos[2];
    (g.bells || (g.bells = new Map())).set(x + ',' + y + ',' + z, {
      t: g.tickCount,
      alongX: Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dz)
    });
    Sound.ev('block.bell.use', [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5], 2, 1);
    return true;
  };
}
Game.prototype.drawBell = function (x, y, z, L, env, a) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    m = EM.get(r, 'bell#main'),
    tex = r.etex('entity/bell/bell_body');
  if (!m || !tex) return;
  EM.reset(m);
  const s = this.bells && this.bells.get(x + ',' + y + ',' + z),
    f = s ? this.tickCount - s.t + a : 0;
  if (s && f >= 50) this.bells.delete(x + ',' + y + ',' + z);
  const swing = s && f < 50 ? Math.sin(f / Math.PI) / (4 + f / 3) : 0;
  const mat = M4.create();
  M4.translate(mat, x, y, z);
  // the swing turns the bell about its top (vanilla: bell_body's pivot, 12 px up)
  if (swing) {
    M4.translate(mat, 0.5, 0.75, 0.5);
    if (s.alongX) M4.rotZ(mat, -swing);else M4.rotX(mat, swing);
    M4.translate(mat, -0.5, -0.75, -0.5);
  }
  // drawEM turns entity models over (scale -1, -1, 1 and a 1.501 drop); block-entity models are drawn as they are
  M4.translate(mat, 0, 1.501, 0);
  M4.scale(mat, -1, -1, 1);
  r.drawEM(m, tex, mat, L, env, {
    cull: true
  });
  r.gl.disable(r.gl.CULL_FACE);
};

// a block-entity block as an item in a hand or on the ground (banners, chests, heads, pots, shulker boxes ...): its
// block entity model in the item's 0..1 space, like vanilla's special item renderers (it used to be a white cube)
Game.prototype.drawBEItem = function (b, mat, light, env, vp) {
  const r = this.renderer;
  const st = b.states ? Math.max(0, b.states.findIndex(s => (s.rotation === undefined || s.rotation === '0') && (s.facing === undefined || s.facing === 'south' || s.facing === 'up'))) : 0;
  if (b.chestLike) {
    r.initBEModels();
    const m = new Float32Array(mat);
    M4.scale(m, -1, -1, 1); // (the chest model's own south-facing pose, like the world's)
    r.drawModel('chest', r.beTex(chestTexBase(b.key)) || 'chest_normal', m, null, light, env, {
      vp
    });
    return;
  }
  r.drawBE(b, st, 0, 0, 0, light, env, {
    vp,
    base: mat
  });
};

// ---- the book on a lectern and over an enchanting table (vanilla LecternRenderer, EnchantTableRenderer, BookModel) ----
const BOOK_BLOCKS = new Set(['lectern', 'enchanting_table'].map(k => BID[k]).filter(id => id !== undefined));
BE_IDS.push(...BOOK_BLOCKS);
// Direction.getClockWise().toYRot() of a lectern's facing
const BOOK_CW_YROT = {
  north: 270,
  east: 0,
  south: 90,
  west: 180
};
// BookModel.setupAnim: the covers and pages open by `open`, the two loose pages turned by the flips
function bookPose(m, time, rightFlip, leftFlip, open) {
  EM.reset(m);
  const P = m.parts,
    f = (Math.sin(time * 0.02) * 0.1 + 1.25) * open,
    s = Math.sin(f);
  P.left_lid.yRot = Math.PI + f;
  P.right_lid.yRot = -f;
  P.left_pages.yRot = f;
  P.right_pages.yRot = -f;
  P.flip_page1.yRot = f - f * 2 * rightFlip;
  P.flip_page2.yRot = f - f * 2 * leftFlip;
  P.left_pages.x = s;
  P.right_pages.x = s;
  P.flip_page1.x = s;
  P.flip_page2.x = s;
}
// EnchantingTableBlockEntity.bookAnimationTick: opens and turns toward a player within 3 blocks and flips pages,
// otherwise closes and drifts round
function enchBookTick(s, x, y, z, players) {
  s.oOpen = s.open;
  s.oRot = s.rot;
  let pl = null;
  for (const p of players) if ((p.pos[0] - x - 0.5) ** 2 + (p.pos[1] - y - 0.5) ** 2 + (p.pos[2] - z - 0.5) ** 2 < 9) {
    pl = p;
    break;
  }
  if (pl) {
    s.tRot = Math.atan2(pl.pos[2] - (z + 0.5), pl.pos[0] - (x + 0.5));
    s.open += 0.1;
    if (s.open < 0.5 || Math.random() < 1 / 40) {
      const f1 = s.flipT;
      do {
        s.flipT += (Math.random() * 4 | 0) - (Math.random() * 4 | 0);
      } while (f1 === s.flipT);
    }
  } else {
    s.tRot += 0.02;
    s.open -= 0.1;
  }
  const wrap = v => {
    while (v >= Math.PI) v -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (v < -Math.PI) v += Math.PI * 2;
    return v;
  };
  s.rot = wrap(s.rot);
  s.tRot = wrap(s.tRot);
  s.rot += wrap(s.tRot - s.rot) * 0.4;
  s.open = clamp(s.open, 0, 1);
  s.time++;
  s.oFlip = s.flip;
  const f = clamp((s.flipT - s.flip) * 0.4, -0.2, 0.2);
  s.flipA += (f - s.flipA) * 0.9;
  s.flip += s.flipA;
}
Game.prototype.drawBook = function (b, meta, x, y, z, L, env, a) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    m = EM.get(r, 'book#main'),
    tex = r.etex('entity/enchantment/enchanting_table_book');
  if (!m || !tex) return;
  const mat = M4.create(),
    k = x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
  if (b.key === 'lectern') {
    const be = this.blockEntities && this.blockEntities.get(k);
    if (!(this.net ? this.net.lecternBooks.has(k) : be && be.book)) return;
    const st = b.states && b.states[meta] || {};
    M4.translate(mat, x + 0.5, y + 1.0625, z + 0.5);
    M4.rotY(mat, -(BOOK_CW_YROT[st.facing] || 0) * Math.PI / 180);
    M4.rotZ(mat, 67.5 * Math.PI / 180);
    M4.translate(mat, 0, -0.125, 0);
    bookPose(m, 0, 0.1, 0.9, 1.2);
  } else {
    const books = this.enchBooks || (this.enchBooks = new Map());
    let s = books.get(k);
    if (!s) {
      s = {
        time: 0,
        open: 0,
        oOpen: 0,
        rot: 0,
        oRot: 0,
        tRot: 0,
        flip: 0,
        oFlip: 0,
        flipT: 0,
        flipA: 0,
        at: this.tickCount
      };
      books.set(k, s);
      if (books.size > 64) books.delete(books.keys().next().value);
    }
    if (this.tickCount - s.at > 20) s.at = this.tickCount - 20; // (out of view for a while: catch up a second at most)
    if (s.at < this.tickCount) {
      const players = [this.player, ...(this.net ? [...this.net.ents.values()].filter(e => e.type === 'player') : [])];
      while (s.at < this.tickCount) {
        enchBookTick(s, x, y, z, players);
        s.at++;
      }
    }
    const t = s.time + a;
    let d = s.rot - s.oRot;
    while (d >= Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
    M4.translate(mat, x + 0.5, y + 0.75 + 0.1 + Math.sin(t * 0.1) * 0.01, z + 0.5);
    M4.rotY(mat, -(s.oRot + d * a));
    M4.rotZ(mat, 80 * Math.PI / 180);
    const fl = lerp(s.oFlip, s.flip, a),
      frac = v => v - Math.floor(v);
    bookPose(m, t, clamp(frac(fl + 0.25) * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1), clamp(frac(fl + 0.75) * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1), lerp(s.oOpen, s.open, a));
  }
  // drawEM turns entity models over (scale -1, -1, 1 and a 1.501 drop); these books are drawn as they are
  M4.translate(mat, 0, 1.501, 0);
  M4.scale(mat, -1, -1, 1);
  r.drawEM(m, tex, mat, L, env, {
    cull: true
  });
  r.gl.disable(r.gl.CULL_FACE); // (drawChests draws with culling off; drawEM turns it back on)
};
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/decor.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Decorations: item frames and glow item frames, paintings (every vanilla painting variant), armor stands,
// banner patterns (banners and shields show them; the loom adds them), signs written in single player (the
// editing screen; dyes, glow ink, ink sacs and honeycomb on signs).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const EXTRA = window.ENTITY_DATA && ENTITY_DATA.extra || {};
const zhT = (k, d) => EXTRA.lang && EXTRA.lang[k] || d || k;
// a mesh from a vanilla block model by name ('block/item_frame'), cached
Renderer.prototype.namedMesh = function (name) {
  if (!this._named) this._named = new Map();
  if (this._named.has(name)) return this._named.get(name);
  let mb = null;
  if (typeof VM !== 'undefined' && VM.ready) {
    const i = VM.data.models.findIndex(m => m.name === name);
    if (i >= 0) {
      const quads = VM.bake(i);
      mb = new MeshBuffer(quads.length * 4 + 4);
      for (const q of quads) {
        const sh = q.shade ? q.dir >= 0 ? FACE_SHADE[q.dir] : 0.85 : 1;
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) mb.v(q.p[k][0], q.p[k][1], q.p[k][2], q.uv[k][0], q.uv[k][1], q.layer, 0, 255, 255, 255, Math.round(sh * 255), 255, 255, q.anim);
      }
    }
  }
  this._named.set(name, mb);
  return mb;
};
// an item shown in a fixed place (item frames, armor stand hands use the hand code): flat items half a block, blocks a quarter
Game.prototype.drawItemFixed = function (st, m, l, env) {
  const def = ITEMS[st.id],
    r = this.renderer;
  if (!def) return;
  // the shield: its model with its 'fixed' transform (vanilla ItemFrameRenderer: half size; m is turned half round
  // for the flat items, which the transform's own 180 degrees does in vanilla)
  if (def.key === 'shield' && this.drawShieldItem) {
    const sm = r.mat(m);
    M4.rotY(sm, -Math.PI);
    M4.scale(sm, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
    this.drawShieldItem(st, sm, l, env, 'fixed');
    return;
  }
  const b = def.block !== undefined ? BLOCKS[def.block] : null,
    vim = r.itemModel(st.id);
  const flat = vim ? vim.gen || !b : !b || def.flat || b.shape === SH_CROSS || b.shape === SH_TORCH || b.ladder || b.door;
  const mm = new Float32Array(m),
    go = {
      glint: typeof stackGlint === 'function' && stackGlint(st) && 'item'
    }; // (enchanted: the glint)
  if (flat) {
    const stTex = itemStateTex ? itemStateTex(st, null) : null;
    const layer = stTex ? T(stTex) : vim && vim.gen && vim.model.layers && vim.model.layers.length ? T(vim.model.layers[0]) : b ? def.flat ? T(def.flat) : b.tex[0] : def.tex;
    M4.scale(mm, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
    M4.translate(mm, -0.5, -0.5, -1 / 32);
    r.drawMesh(this.spriteMesh(layer), mm, env, l, go);
  } else {
    M4.scale(mm, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25);
    M4.rotY(mm, Math.PI);
    M4.translate(mm, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5);
    if (vim && vim.mesh && !b.bed) r.drawMesh(vim.mesh, mm, env, l, go);else r.drawMesh(this.blockMesh(def.block, b.facing ? 4 : 0), mm, env, l, go);
  }
};
// the rotation that turns a -z facing model to face direction d (DIRS index)
function faceRot(m, d) {
  switch (d) {
    case 5:
      M4.rotY(m, Math.PI);
      break;
    case 1:
      M4.rotY(m, -Math.PI / 2);
      break;
    case 0:
      M4.rotY(m, Math.PI / 2);
      break;
    case 3:
      M4.rotX(m, Math.PI / 2);
      break;
    case 2:
      M4.rotX(m, -Math.PI / 2);
      break;
  }
}
const DIR_NAME = ['west', 'east', 'down', 'up', 'north', 'south'];

// ---- things hanging on a block face ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Hanging extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, face) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.5, 0.5);
    this.block = [x, y, z];
    this.face = face !== null && face !== void 0 ? face : 4 /* (0 is west) */;
    this.keepSaved = true;
    this.hittable = true;
    this.place();
  }
  get support() {
    const D = DIRS[this.face];
    return [this.block[0] - D[0], this.block[1] - D[1], this.block[2] - D[2]];
  }
  place() {
    const D = DIRS[this.face],
      [x, y, z] = this.block;
    this.pos = [x + 0.5 - D[0] * 0.46875, y + (D[1] ? 0.5 - D[1] * 0.46875 : 0.5) - this.h / 2, z + 0.5 - D[2] * 0.46875];
    this.prev = [...this.pos];
  }
  saveData() {
    return {
      b: this.block,
      f: this.face,
      ...(this.more ? this.more() : {})
    };
  }
  loadData(o) {
    if (!o) return;
    this.block = o.b;
    this.face = o.f;
    this.place();
    if (this.load) this.load(o);
  }
  survives() {
    const [x, y, z] = this.support,
      b = BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)];
    return !b || !!b.solid;
  } // (one it doesn't know: kept - 11-13)
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.age % 100 === 0 && !this.survives()) this.breakOff(null);
  }
  breakOff(src) {
    this.dead = true;
    if (!(src && src.attacker === this.game.player && this.game.mode === 'creative')) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], makeStack(this.type, 1));
    if (this.onBreak) this.onBreak(src);
  }
}
// ---- item frames --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ItemFrame extends Hanging {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, face, glow) {
    super(g, x, y, z, face);
    this.type = glow ? 'glow_item_frame' : 'item_frame';
    this.item = null;
    this.rot = 0;
    this.w = 0.75;
    this.h = 0.75;
    this.place();
  }
  more() {
    return {
      it: this.item,
      r: this.rot,
      t: this.type
    };
  }
  load(o) {
    this.item = o.it || null;
    this.rot = o.r | 0;
    if (o.t) this.type = o.t;
  }
  interact(p, held) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!this.item) {
      if (!held) return false;
      this.item = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      Sound.ev('entity.' + this.type + '.add_item', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    this.rot = (this.rot + 1) % 8;
    Sound.ev('entity.' + this.type + '.rotate_item', this.pos, 1, 1);
    for (const [x, y, z] of [this.support]) if (g.world && typeof RS !== 'undefined') {
      RS.wake && RS.wake(g, x, y, z);
    }
    return true;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    if (this.item) {
      if (!(src && src.attacker === this.game.player && this.game.mode === 'creative')) this.game.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], this.item);
      this.item = null;
      Sound.ev('entity.' + this.type + '.remove_item', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    Sound.ev('entity.' + this.type + '.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
    this.breakOff(src);
    return true;
  }
  // comparators behind a frame read its rotation
  get comparator() {
    return this.item ? this.rot + 1 : 0;
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      isMap = !!this.item && !!ITEMS[this.item.id] && ITEMS[this.item.id].key === 'filled_map',
      glow = this.type === 'glow_item_frame';
    const D = DIRS[this.face],
      [bx, by, bz] = this.block;
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, bx + 0.5, by + 0.5, bz + 0.5);
    faceRot(m, this.face);
    const lt = glow ? [1, 1] : l;
    if (!this.invisible) {
      const mb = r.namedMesh('block/' + this.type + (isMap ? '_map' : ''));
      if (mb) {
        const mm = M4.copy(m);
        M4.translate(mm, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5);
        r.drawMesh(mb, mm, env, l);
      }
    }
    if (!this.item) return;
    const im = M4.copy(m);
    M4.translate(im, 0, 0, 0.5 - 1 / 16 - 0.01);
    M4.rotZ(im, this.rot * Math.PI / 4 * (isMap ? 2 : 1)); // clockwise as seen from the front
    if (isMap && g.drawMapInFrame) {
      g.drawMapInFrame(this.item, im, lt, env);
      return;
    }
    M4.rotY(im, Math.PI);
    g.drawItemFixed(this.item, im, lt, env);
  }
}
// ---- paintings -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const PAINTINGS = Object.entries(EXTRA.painting_variant || {}).map(([k, v]) => ({
  key: k,
  w: v.width,
  h: v.height,
  asset: String(v.asset_id).replace('minecraft:', ''),
  title: zhT('painting.minecraft.' + k + '.title', k),
  author: zhT('painting.minecraft.' + k + '.author', '')
}));
// the ones a player can get from placing a painting (vanilla tag: placeable) - the newer and hidden ones are left out
const PAINTING_PLACEABLE = new Set(['kebab', 'aztec', 'alban', 'aztec2', 'bomb', 'plant', 'wasteland', 'pool', 'courbet', 'sea', 'sunset', 'creebet', 'wanderer', 'graham', 'match', 'bust', 'stage', 'void', 'skull_and_roses', 'wither', 'fighters', 'pointer', 'pigscene', 'burning_skull', 'skeleton', 'donkey_kong', 'baroque', 'humble', 'meditative', 'prairie_ride', 'unpacked', 'backyard', 'bouquet', 'cavebird', 'changing', 'cotan', 'endboss', 'fern', 'finding', 'lowmist', 'orb', 'owlemons', 'passage', 'pond', 'sunflowers', 'tides']);
class Painting extends Hanging {
  constructor(g, x, y, z, face, v) {
    super(g, x, y, z, face);
    this.type = 'painting';
    this.v = v || PAINTINGS[0];
    this.resize();
  }
  resize() {
    const v = this.v || {
      w: 1,
      h: 1
    };
    this.w = Math.max(v.w, 0.0625);
    this.h = v.h;
    this.place();
  }
  place() {
    const D = DIRS[this.face],
      [x, y, z] = this.block,
      v = this.v || {
        w: 1,
        h: 1
      };
    // the art is centred on the block, offset by half a block for even sizes (vanilla)
    const ox = v.w % 2 === 0 ? 0.5 : 0,
      oy = v.h % 2 === 0 ? 0.5 : 0;
    const side = [D[2], 0, -D[0]];
    this.center = [x + 0.5 - D[0] * 0.46875 + side[0] * -ox, y + 0.5 + oy, z + 0.5 - D[2] * 0.46875 + side[2] * -ox];
    this.pos = [this.center[0], this.center[1] - v.h / 2, this.center[2]];
    this.prev = [...this.pos];
  }
  more() {
    return {
      v: this.v && this.v.key
    };
  }
  load(o) {
    this.v = PAINTINGS.find(p => p.key === o.v) || PAINTINGS[0];
    this.resize();
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    Sound.ev('entity.painting.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
    this.breakOff(src);
    return true;
  }
  survives() {
    return paintingFits(this.world, this.block, this.face, this.v, this);
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      v = this.v;
    if (!v) return;
    const tex = r.etex('painting/' + v.asset),
      back = r.etex('painting/back');
    if (!tex) return;
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, this.center[0], this.center[1], this.center[2]);
    faceRot(m, this.face);
    const T2 = r.progTex,
      gl = r.gl,
      L = Math.max(l[0], l[1] * env.day) * 0.85 + 0.15;
    const quad = (texKey, mm, sh) => {
      gl.useProgram(T2.p);
      gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_vp, false, r.vp);
      gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_model, false, mm);
      gl.uniform4f(T2.u.u_color, sh, sh, sh, 1);
      gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, r.entityTex[texKey]);
      gl.bindVertexArray(r.quadVao);
      gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
    };
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    // the quad helper lies flat (xz); stand it up facing -z, the picture's top left (uv 0, 0) at the top left as seen from the
    // front (it was turned half round: every painting upside down)
    const f = M4.copy(m);
    M4.translate(f, 0, 0, -1 / 32);
    M4.rotX(f, -Math.PI / 2);
    M4.scale(f, -v.w / 2, 1, -v.h / 2);
    quad(tex, f, L);
    if (back) {
      const b2 = M4.copy(m);
      M4.translate(b2, 0, 0, 1 / 32);
      M4.rotX(b2, -Math.PI / 2);
      M4.scale(b2, v.w / 2, 1, v.h / 2);
      quad(back, b2, L * 0.7);
    }
    gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  }
}
// does a painting of variant v fit on face d of the block before `block` (wall behind, nothing in front)?
function paintingFits(w, block, face, v, self) {
  if (face === 2 || face === 3) return false;
  const D = DIRS[face],
    side = [D[2], 0, -D[0]],
    [x, y, z] = block;
  const x0 = -Math.floor((v.w - 1) / 2) - (v.w % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0) * 0,
    y0 = -Math.floor((v.h - 1) / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < v.w; i++) for (let j = 0; j < v.h; j++) {
    const k = x0 + i - (v.w % 2 === 0 ? v.w / 2 - Math.floor((v.w - 1) / 2) - 1 : 0),
      yy = y + y0 + j;
    const bx = x + side[0] * -k,
      bz = z + side[2] * -k;
    if (!BLOCKS[w.getBlock(bx - D[0], yy, bz - D[2])].solid) return false;
    const id = w.getBlock(bx, yy, bz);
    if (id && !BLOCKS[id].replaceable) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
// ---- armor stands --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class ArmorStand extends Entity {
  constructor(g, x, y, z) {
    super(g, x, y, z, 0.5, 1.975);
    this.type = 'armor_stand';
    this.keepSaved = true;
    this.hittable = true;
    this.gear = [null, null, null, null, null, null];
    this.lastHit = -100;
    this.wobble = 0;
    this.small = false;
    this.arms = false;
    this.bodyYaw = 0;
  }
  saveData() {
    return {
      g: this.gear,
      s: this.small,
      a: this.arms,
      y: this.yaw
    };
  }
  loadData(o) {
    if (!o) return;
    this.gear = o.g || this.gear;
    this.small = !!o.s;
    this.arms = !!o.a;
    if (o.y !== undefined) this.yaw = o.y;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    if (this.wobble > 0) this.wobble--;
    this.vel[1] -= 0.04;
    this.move(0, this.vel[1], 0);
    this.vel[1] *= 0.98;
    if (this.onGround) this.vel[1] = 0;
  }
  // which slot a click at height y aims at: feet / legs / chest / head
  slotAt(y) {
    const h = (y - this.pos[1]) / (this.small ? 0.5 : 1);
    return h >= 1.6 ? 3 : h >= 0.9 ? 2 : h >= 0.4 ? 1 : 0;
  }
  interact(p, held) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (held) {
      const d = ITEMS[held.id];
      if (!d) return false; // (an id not in ITEMS: nothing, instead of throwing)
      const ar = d.armor;
      const slot = ar ? 3 - ar.slot : /_(head|skull)$|^carved_pumpkin$/.test(d.key) ? 3 : this.arms ? 4 : -1;
      if (slot < 0) return false;
      const old = this.gear[slot];
      this.gear[slot] = {
        ...held,
        count: 1
      };
      useOne(g, p);
      if (old) {
        if (g.mode !== 'creative') {
          if (p.inv.held) p.inv.add(old) && g.dropItem(p.pos[0], p.pos[1], p.pos[2], old);else p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = old;
        }
      }
      Sound.ev('entity.armor_stand.place', this.pos, 0.5, 1.3);
      return true;
    }
    const hd = Math.hypot(this.pos[0] - p.pos[0], this.pos[2] - p.pos[2]),
      hit = p.pos[1] + p.eye() + Math.tan(p.pitch) * hd;
    let slot = this.slotAt(hit);
    if (!this.gear[slot]) slot = this.gear.findIndex(s => s);
    if (slot < 0) return false;
    p.inv.slots[p.inv.sel] = this.gear[slot];
    this.gear[slot] = null;
    return true;
  }
  hurt(a, src) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (src && src.attacker === g.player && g.mode === 'creative') {
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.armor_stand.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
      return true;
    }
    if (this.age - this.lastHit < 5) {
      this.dead = true;
      Sound.ev('entity.armor_stand.break', this.pos, 1, 1);
      g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], makeStack('armor_stand', 1));
      for (const s of this.gear) if (s) g.dropItem(this.pos[0], this.pos[1] + 0.5, this.pos[2], s);
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) g.particles.spawn('block', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, this.pos[1] + Math.random() * 1.8, this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, 0, 0.05, 0, {
        id: BID.oak_planks || 5
      });
    } else {
      this.lastHit = this.age;
      this.wobble = 5;
      Sound.ev('entity.armor_stand.hit', this.pos, 1, 1);
    }
    return true;
  }
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      base = this.small ? 'armor_stand_small' : 'armor_stand',
      md = EM.get(r, base + '#main'),
      tex = r.etex('entity/armorstand/armorstand');
    if (!md || !tex) return;
    EM.reset(md);
    const P = md.parts,
      D = Math.PI / 180;
    // vanilla's default pose
    if (P.left_arm) {
      P.left_arm.xRot = -10 * D;
      P.left_arm.zRot = -10 * D;
      P.left_arm.visible = this.arms;
    }
    if (P.right_arm) {
      P.right_arm.xRot = -15 * D;
      P.right_arm.zRot = 10 * D;
      P.right_arm.visible = this.arms;
    }
    if (P.left_leg) {
      P.left_leg.xRot = -1 * D;
      P.left_leg.zRot = -1 * D;
    }
    if (P.right_leg) {
      P.right_leg.xRot = 1 * D;
      P.right_leg.zRot = 1 * D;
    }
    if (P.base_plate) P.base_plate.yRot = 0;
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1], ip[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, this.yaw + (this.wobble > 0 ? Math.sin((this.wobble - a) / 1.5 * Math.PI) * 0.15 : 0));
    const att = {};
    if (this.gear[4]) {
      const st = this.gear[4];
      att.right_arm = am => g.drawHeldItem(am, st, false, l, env, this, null);
    }
    if (this.gear[5]) {
      const st = this.gear[5];
      att.left_arm = am => g.drawHeldItem(am, st, true, l, env, this, null);
    }
    r.drawEM(md, tex, m, l, env, {
      attach: att,
      cull: false
    });
    const fake = {
      layerKey: () => base + '#main',
      armorItems: [this.gear[3], this.gear[2], this.gear[1], this.gear[0]]
    };
    if (fake.armorItems.some(s => s)) drawVArmor(g, r, fake, md, m, l, env, null);
  }
}
// placing them (and frames, paintings) from items; recreated from saves by type
(() => {
  const prev = createMob;
  createMob = function (game, type, x, y, z) {
    if (type === 'item_frame' || type === 'glow_item_frame') return new ItemFrame(game, Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z), 4, type === 'glow_item_frame');
    if (type === 'painting') return new Painting(game, Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z), 4, null);
    if (type === 'armor_stand') return new ArmorStand(game, x, y, z);
    if (type === 'leash_knot') {
      const k = new LeashKnot(game, Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z));
      k.keepSaved = true;
      k.type = 'leash_knot';
      return k;
    }
    return prev(game, type, x, y, z);
  };
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    const p = this.player,
      w = this.world,
      held = p.inv.held,
      t = this.target,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id] && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (t && !this.targetEntity && (k === 'item_frame' || k === 'glow_item_frame' || k === 'painting' || k === 'armor_stand')) {
      const D = DIRS[t.face],
        x = t.pos[0] + D[0],
        y = t.pos[1] + D[1],
        z = t.pos[2] + D[2];
      if (k === 'armor_stand') {
        if (t.face !== 3 || w.getBlock(x, y, z) && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)].replaceable) return;
        const s = new ArmorStand(this, x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5);
        s.yaw = Math.round((p.yaw + Math.PI) / (Math.PI / 4)) * Math.PI / 4;
        if (held.name) s.customName = held.name;
        this.entities.push(s);
        Sound.ev('entity.armor_stand.place', s.pos, 0.75, 0.8);
        useOne(this, p);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      if (this.entities.some(e => e instanceof Hanging && !e.dead && e.block[0] === x && e.block[1] === y && e.block[2] === z && e.face === t.face)) return;
      if (k === 'painting') {
        const fits = PAINTINGS.filter(v => PAINTING_PLACEABLE.has(v.key) && paintingFits(w, [x, y, z], t.face, v));
        if (!fits.length) return;
        const best = Math.max(...fits.map(v => v.w * v.h)),
          pool = fits.filter(v => v.w * v.h === best);
        const pt = new Painting(this, x, y, z, t.face, held.pv ? PAINTINGS.find(v => v.key === held.pv) || pool[0] : pool[Math.random() * pool.length | 0]);
        this.entities.push(pt);
        Sound.ev('entity.painting.place', pt.pos, 1, 1);
      } else {
        const f = new ItemFrame(this, x, y, z, t.face, k === 'glow_item_frame');
        if (!f.survives()) return;
        this.entities.push(f);
        Sound.ev('entity.' + k + '.place', f.pos, 1, 1);
      }
      useOne(this, p);
      p.swing();
      return;
    }
    return _use.call(this);
  };
})();

class LoomScreen extends StationScreen {
  constructor(game, pos, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_loom', title || '织布机', pos);
    this.sel = -1;
    this.scroll = 0;
    this.own(0, 13, 26, {
      accept: s => /_banner$/.test(ITEMS[s.id].key),
      emptyIcon: 'slot_banner'
    });
    this.own(1, 33, 26, {
      accept: s => /_dye$/.test(ITEMS[s.id].key),
      emptyIcon: 'slot_dye'
    });
    this.own(2, 23, 45, {
      accept: s => !!PATTERN_ITEM[ITEMS[s.id].key],
      emptyIcon: 'slot_banner_pattern',
      max: 1
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 143,
      y: 58,
      output: true,
      get: () => this.result,
      set: () => {},
      onTake: () => this.take()
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
    this.changed();
  }
  // the choices in vanilla's order (its tags): the pattern item's own, or the ones that need no item
  patterns() {
    const T = ENTITY_DATA.extra && ENTITY_DATA.extra.tags || {},
      it = this.S(2),
      key = it && ITEMS[it.id].key,
      k = key && PATTERN_ITEM[key];
    const tag = n => T['banner_pattern:' + n] && T['banner_pattern:' + n].map(x => x.replace('minecraft:', ''));
    if (k) return tag('pattern_item/' + key.replace(/_banner_pattern$/, '')) || [k];
    return tag('no_item_required') || BANNER_PATTERNS.filter(p => p !== 'base' && !PATTERN_NEEDS_ITEM.has(p));
  }
  changed() {
    const ban = this.S(0),
      dye = this.S(1),
      list = this.patterns();
    if (this.sel >= list.length) this.sel = -1;
    if (list.length === 1 && this.S(2)) this.sel = 0;
    this.result = null;
    if (ban && dye && this.sel >= 0 && (ban.patterns || []).length < 6) {
      this.result = {
        ...ban,
        count: 1,
        patterns: [...(ban.patterns || []), [list[this.sel], ITEMS[dye.id].key.replace(/_dye$/, '')]]
      };
    }
  }
  pick(i) {
    this.sel = i;
    this.changed();
  }
  take() {
    for (const i of [0, 1]) {
      const s = this.held[i];
      if (s) {
        s.count--;
        if (!s.count) this.held[i] = null;
      }
    }
    Sound.ev('ui.loom.take_result', null, 1, 1);
    this.changed();
  }
  cell(i) {
    const j = i - this.scroll * 4;
    return {
      x: this.x + 60 + j % 4 * 14,
      y: this.y + 13 + Math.floor(j / 4) * 14,
      w: 14,
      h: 14
    };
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift) {
    if (this.S(0) && this.S(1)) {
      const list = this.patterns();
      for (let i = this.scroll * 4; i < Math.min(list.length, this.scroll * 4 + 16); i++) if (ui.hit(this.cell(i), mx, my)) {
        this.pick(i);
        Sound.ev('ui.loom.select_pattern', null, 1, 1);
        return;
      }
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, button, shift);
  }
  wheel(ui, d) {
    this.scroll = clamp(this.scroll + Math.sign(d), 0, Math.max(0, Math.ceil(this.patterns().length / 4) - 4));
  }
  drawMore(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      r = this.game.renderer,
      ban = this.S(0),
      dye = this.S(1);
    const list = this.patterns(),
      ok = ban && dye && (ban.patterns || []).length < 6;
    if (ban && (ban.patterns || []).length >= 6) ui.sprite('loom_error', this.x + 133, this.y + 16);
    if (ok) for (let i = this.scroll * 4; i < Math.min(list.length, this.scroll * 4 + 16); i++) {
      const cl = this.cell(i);
      ui.sprite(i === this.sel ? 'loom_pattern_selected' : ui.hit(cl) ? 'loom_pattern_highlighted' : 'loom_pattern', cl.x, cl.y);
      drawPatternPreview(ui, r, 'white', [[list[i], ITEMS[dye.id].key.replace(/_dye$/, '')]], cl.x + 4, cl.y + 2, 5, 10, true);
    }
    ui.sprite(list.length > 16 ? 'loom_scroller' : 'loom_scroller_disabled', this.x + 119, this.y + 13 + (list.length > 16 ? Math.floor(this.scroll / Math.max(1, Math.ceil(list.length / 4) - 4) * 41) : 0));
    // the banner as it would come out
    const show = this.S(3) || ban; // (the result slot: this screen's or the server's)
    if (show) drawPatternPreview(ui, r, bannerColor(ITEMS[show.id].key), show.patterns || [], this.x + 141, this.y + 8, 20, 40, false);
  }
}
// a small picture of a banner's cloth (from the banner texture's front face: 20 x 40 px at 1,1)

  const im = key && r.mixCanvas && r.mixCanvas.get(key);
