  ui.ctx.drawImage(im, 1, 1, 20, 40, x, y, w, h);
}
// keep the mixed canvases for screens to draw from
(() => {
  const _mix = Renderer.prototype.etexMix;
  Renderer.prototype.etexMix = function (layers) {
    const k = _mix.call(this, layers);
    if (k && !(this.mixCanvas && this.mixCanvas.has(k))) {
      // rebuild the canvas once for screens (cheap: banner textures are 64 x 64)
      const ims = layers.map(l => this.images['@' + (typeof l === 'string' ? l : l.p)]);
      if (ims.every(Boolean)) {
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = ims[0].width;
        c.height = ims[0].height;
        const x = c.getContext('2d');
        layers.forEach((l, i) => {
          const t = document.createElement('canvas');
          t.width = ims[i].width;
          t.height = ims[i].height;
          const tx = t.getContext('2d');
          tx.drawImage(ims[i], 0, 0);
          if (l.c) {
            const d = tx.getImageData(0, 0, t.width, t.height);
            for (let q = 0; q < d.data.length; q += 4) {
              d.data[q] *= l.c[0];
              d.data[q + 1] *= l.c[1];
              d.data[q + 2] *= l.c[2];
            }
            tx.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
          }
          x.drawImage(t, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        });
        (this.mixCanvas || (this.mixCanvas = new Map())).set(k, c);
      }
    }
    return k;
  };
})();

const signSideKey = (g, x, y, z) => {
  var _FACING_DEG$st$facing;
  const w = g.world,
    b = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)],
    st = b.states && b.states[w.getMeta(x, y, z)] || {},
    p = g.player;
  if (b.key.includes('wall') && !b.key.includes('hanging')) return 'f';
  const deg = st.rotation !== undefined ? +st.rotation * 22.5 : (_FACING_DEG$st$facing = FACING_DEG[st.facing]) !== null && _FACING_DEG$st$facing !== void 0 ? _FACING_DEG$st$facing : 0;
  // the front faces the way the board's text faces (vanilla angle 0 = south)
  const a = deg * Math.PI / 180,
    fx = -Math.sin(a),
    fz = Math.cos(a);
  return (p.pos[0] - x - 0.5) * fx + (p.pos[2] - z - 0.5) * fz >= 0 ? 'f' : 'b';
};
Game.prototype.signAt = function (x, y, z) {
  const k = x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
  let t = this.signs.get(k);
  if (!t) {
    const be = this.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'sign');
    be.text = be.text || {
      f: {
        l: ['', '', '', ''],
        c: 'black',
        g: false
      },
      b: {
        l: ['', '', '', ''],
        c: 'black',
        g: false
      }
    };
    t = be.text;
    this.signs.set(k, t);
  }
  return t;
};
Game.prototype.openSignEditor = function (x, y, z, front) {
  if (!/sign$/.test(BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(x, y, z)].key)) return;
  const t = this.signAt(x, y, z),
    side = front === true ? 'f' : front || signSideKey(this, x, y, z);
  this.ui.open(new SignScreen(this, [x, y, z], t[side]));
};
class SignScreen {
  constructor(game, pos, side) {
    this.game = game;
    this.pos = pos;
    this.side = side;
    this.line = 0;
    const b = BLOCKS[game.world.getBlock(...pos)];
    this.wood = b.key.replace(/_(wall_)?(hanging_)?sign$/, '');
    this.hanging = b.key.includes('hanging');
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.x = Math.floor(u.w / 2);
    this.y = 40;
    this.edit();
  }
  edit() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      s = this;
    u.showInput(this.x - 45, this.y + 40 + this.line * 10, 90, 10, this.side.l[this.line], () => {
      s.line = (s.line + 1) % 4;
      s.edit();
    }, {
      max: 15,
      onInput: v => {
        s.side.l[s.line] = v;
      },
      onEsc: () => u.close()
    });
    const el = u.input,
      prev = el.onkeydown;
    el.onkeydown = e => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        s.line = (s.line + (e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? 3 : 1)) % 4;
        s.edit();
        return;
      }
      prev(e);
    };
  }
  close() {
    this.game.ui.hideInput();
    this.game.flushMesh && this.game.flushMesh();
    if (this.onDone) this.onDone();
  }
  key(ui, ev) {
    return true;
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my) {
    if (ui.hit({
      x: this.x - 100,
      y: this.y + 140,
      w: 200,
      h: 20
    }, mx, my)) ui.close();
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      r = this.game.renderer;
    ui.dim(0.4);
    Font.center(c, '编辑告示牌信息', this.x, this.y, '#FFFFFF');
    // the board: the sign texture's front face, scaled up
    const im = r.images['@entity/signs/' + (this.hanging ? 'hanging/' : '') + this.wood];
    if (!im) r.etex('entity/signs/' + (this.hanging ? 'hanging/' : '') + this.wood);
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    if (im) {
      if (this.hanging) c.drawImage(im, 0, 0, 16, 16, this.x - 48, this.y + 22, 96, 96);else c.drawImage(im, 2, 2, 24, 12, this.x - 60, this.y + 30, 120, 60);
    } else {
      c.fillStyle = '#9C7F4E';
      c.fillRect(this.x - 60, this.y + 30, 120, 60);
    }
    const col = SIGN_TEXT_RGB[this.side.c] || '#000000';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      if (i === this.line) continue;
      Font.center(c, this.side.l[i] || '', this.x, this.y + 41 + i * 10, col, false);
    }
    ui.drawInputText && ui.drawInputText();
    const done = {
      x: this.x - 100,
      y: this.y + 140,
      w: 200,
      h: 20
    };
    ui.button({
      ...done,
      label: '完成'
    });
  }
}
// dyes and the rest on a sign (vanilla SignApplicator items); otherwise a right click edits it unless it is waxed
(() => {
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    // (a held id not in ITEMS, a block id not in BLOCKS - a server's: nothing of this, instead of throwing)
    const p = this.player,
      t = this.target,
      held = p.inv.held,
      k = held && ITEMS[held.id] && ITEMS[held.id].key;
    if (t && !this.targetEntity && !p.sneaking && BLOCKS[t.id] && /sign$/.test(BLOCKS[t.id].key) && !this.net) {

        s = this.signAt(x, y, z),

      const pos = [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5];
      if (s.wax) {
        Sound.ev('block.sign.waxed_interact_fail', pos, 1, 1);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      if (k && /_dye$/.test(k)) {
        const c = k.replace(/_dye$/, '');
        if (side.c !== c) {
          side.c = c;
          useOne(this, p);
          Sound.ev('item.dye.use', pos, 1, 1);
        }
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      if (k === 'glow_ink_sac' && !side.g) {
        side.g = true;
        useOne(this, p);
        Sound.ev('item.glow_ink_sac.use', pos, 1, 1);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      if (k === 'ink_sac' && side.g) {
        side.g = false;
        useOne(this, p);
        Sound.ev('item.ink_sac.use', pos, 1, 1);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      if (k === 'honeycomb') {
        s.wax = true;
        useOne(this, p);
        Sound.ev('item.honeycomb.wax_on', pos, 1, 1);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      this.openSignEditor(x, y, z);
      return;
    }
    return _use.call(this);
  };
  // signs written here are saved with the block entities: put them back on load
  const _ds = Game.prototype.drawSignTexts;
  Game.prototype.drawSignTexts = function (env) {
    return _ds.call(this, env);
  };
  const _dc = Game.prototype.drawChests;
  Game.prototype.drawChests = function (a, env) {
    if (this.blockEntities && this._signSync !== this.blockEntities) {
      this._signSync = this.blockEntities;
      for (const [k, be] of this.blockEntities) if (be.type === 'sign' && be.text) this.signs.set(k, be.text);
    }
    return _dc.call(this, a, env);
  };
})();

<script>
/* ==== js/items3.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Items with systems of their own: bundles, fishing rods, maps (and the cartography table), books and quills,
// written books and lecterns, jukeboxes and music discs, spyglasses, goat horns, brushes on suspicious sand and
// gravel, trial keys with vaults and trial spawners; the wandering trader's vanilla trade lists.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const keyOf3 = st => st && ITEMS[st.id] ? ITEMS[st.id].key : '';
const LUCK = st => enchLevel(st, 'luck_of_the_sea') || 0;

// ---- bundles: hold up to a stack's worth of mixed items ------------------------------------------------------------------
const isBundle = st => !!st && /(^|_)bundle$/.test(keyOf3(st));
const bundleWeight = st => isBundle(st) ? 4 + (st.bundle || []).reduce((s, x) => s + bundleWeight(x) * (isBundle(x) ? 1 : 0) + (isBundle(x) ? 0 : 64 / maxStack(x.id) * x.count), 0) : 64 / maxStack(st.id) * st.count;
const bundleFill = b => (b.bundle || []).reduce((s, x) => s + (isBundle(x) ? bundleWeight(x) : 64 / maxStack(x.id) * x.count), 0);
// put as much of st as fits into bundle b; returns what is left (or the same stack)
function bundleInsert(b, st) {
  if (!st || isBundle(st) && st === b) return st;
  if (st.bundle && st.bundle.length && isBundle(st)) {/* bundles go in whole */}
  const per = isBundle(st) ? bundleWeight(st) : 64 / maxStack(st.id),
    room = 64 - bundleFill(b),
    n = Math.min(st.count, Math.floor(room / per));
  if (n <= 0) return st;
  b.bundle = b.bundle || [];
  const same = b.bundle.find(x => sameKind(x, st) && x.count < maxStack(x.id) && !isBundle(x));
  if (same) {
    const k = Math.min(n, maxStack(same.id) - same.count);
    same.count += k;
    if (n > k) b.bundle.unshift({
      ...st,
      count: n - k
    });
  } else b.bundle.unshift({
    ...st,
    count: n
  });
  Sound.ev('item.bundle.insert', null, 0.8, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
  return st.count - n > 0 ? {
    ...st,
    count: st.count - n
  } : null;
}
function bundleTake(b) {
  if (!b.bundle || !b.bundle.length) return null;
  const st = b.bundle.shift();
  Sound.ev('item.bundle.remove_one', null, 0.8, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
  return st;
}
(() => {
  const _cs = ContainerScreen.prototype.clickSlot;
  ContainerScreen.prototype.clickSlot = function (ui, s, button) {
    const st = s.get(),
      cur = ui.cursor;
    if (button === 2 && !s.output) {
      if (isBundle(cur) && st && !isBundle(st)) {
        const left = bundleInsert(cur, st);
        s.set(left);
        this.changed();
        return;
      }
      if (isBundle(cur) && !st) {
        const out = bundleTake(cur);
        if (out) {
          s.set(out);
          this.changed();
        }
        return;
      }
      if (isBundle(st) && cur) {
        const left = bundleInsert(st, cur);
        ui.cursor = left;
        this.changed();
        return;
      }
      if (isBundle(st) && !cur && st.bundle && st.bundle.length) {
        ui.cursor = bundleTake(st);
        this.changed();
        return;
      }
    }
    return _cs.call(this, ui, s, button);
  };
  const _il = UI.prototype.itemLines;

// ---- fishing ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FishingHook extends Entity {
  constructor(g, owner, rod) {
    const p = owner,
      eye = [p.pos[0], p.pos[1] + p.eye(), p.pos[2]];
    super(g, eye[0], eye[1], eye[2], 0.25, 0.25);
    const d = g.lookDir();
    this.owner = owner;
    this.rod = rod;
    this.vel = [d[0] * 1.5 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02, d[1] * 1.5 + 0.1, d[2] * 1.5 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02];
    this.wait = 0;
    this.nibble = 0;
    this.bite = 0;
    this.hooked = null;
    this.inWaterT = 0;
    const lure = enchLevel(rod, 'lure') || 0;
    this.lure = lure;
    this.resetWait();
  }
  resetWait() {
    this.wait = Math.max(20, randInt(100, 600) - this.lure * 100);
    this.nibble = 0;
    this.bite = 0;
  }
  tick() {
    this.savePrev();
    this.age++;
    const g = this.game,
      o = this.owner,
      v = this.vel;
    // (a rod in either hand keeps it: vanilla shouldStopFishing)
    if (o.dead || o.deathTime || !(keyOf3(o.inv.held) === 'fishing_rod' || keyOf3(o.inv.slots[40]) === 'fishing_rod') || this.distTo(o) > 32) {
      this.dead = true;
      o.fishHook = null;
      return;
    }
    if (this.hooked) {
      if (this.hooked.dead) {
        this.hooked = null;
        return;
      }
      this.pos = [this.hooked.pos[0], this.hooked.pos[1] + this.hooked.h * 0.8, this.hooked.pos[2]];
      return;
    }
    // hits an entity on the way
    if (!this.bobbing) for (const e of g.entities) {
      if (e === this || e === o || !(e instanceof Living) || e.dead || e.deathTime) continue;
      const b = e.box();
      if (this.pos[0] > b[0] - 0.1 && this.pos[0] < b[3] + 0.1 && this.pos[1] > b[1] - 0.1 && this.pos[1] < b[4] + 0.1 && this.pos[2] > b[2] - 0.1 && this.pos[2] < b[5] + 0.1) {
        this.hooked = e;
        e.hurt(0.0001, {
          type: 'mob',
          attacker: o
        });
        return;
      }
    }
    const x = Math.floor(this.pos[0]),
      y = Math.floor(this.pos[1]),
      z = Math.floor(this.pos[2]),
      id = this.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
    const water = this.world.waterAt(x, y, z);
    // vanilla FishingHook.tick: flying, it is slowed hard as it lands in water (it slid on along the surface) and
    // then bobs - pulled toward the water's top in its own block (a whole block when water is above: up from deep
    // water - it sank and stayed under, aimed at the top of whatever block it was in); flying, it stops dead on the
    // ground or against a wall (it slid along)
    if (water && !this.bobbing) {
      this.bobbing = true;
      v[0] *= 0.3;
      v[1] *= 0.2;
      v[2] *= 0.3;
      Sound.ev('entity.fishing_bobber.splash', this.pos, 0.25, 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4);
      return;
    }
    if (this.bobbing) {
      const m = id === WATER ? this.world.getMeta(x, y, z) : 0;
      const h = !water ? 0 : this.world.waterAt(x, y + 1, z) ? 1 : (m === 0 || m >= 8 ? 8 : 8 - m) / 9;
      let force = this.pos[1] + v[1] - y - h;
      if (Math.abs(force) < 0.01) force += Math.sign(force) * 0.1;
      v[0] *= 0.9;
      v[1] -= force * Math.random() * 0.2;
      v[2] *= 0.9;
      if (water) {
        this.inWaterT++;
        this.openWater = true;
        this.fishTick(x, y, z);
      } else this.inWaterT = 0;
    }
    if (!water && !this.onGround) v[1] -= 0.03;
    this.move(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
    if (!this.bobbing && (this.onGround || this.collidedH)) {
      v[0] = 0;
      v[1] = 0;
      v[2] = 0;
    }
    v[0] *= 0.92;
    v[1] *= 0.92;
    v[2] *= 0.92;
  }
  fishTick(x, y, z) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.bite > 0) {
      if (--this.bite === 0) this.resetWait();
      return;
    }
    if (this.nibble > 0) {
      // a fish swims in: bubbles toward the hook
      if (--this.nibble === 0) {
        this.vel[1] -= 0.2 * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4);
        this.bite = randInt(20, 40);
        Sound.ev('entity.fishing_bobber.splash', this.pos, 0.25, 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4);
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) g.particles.spawn('bubble', this.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, this.pos[1], this.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0, 0.1, 0);
      } else if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          d = this.nibble * 0.05;
        g.particles.spawn('splash', this.pos[0] + Math.sin(a) * d, this.pos[1] + 0.1, this.pos[2] + Math.cos(a) * d, 0, 0.05, 0);
      }
      return;
    }
    const sky = this.world.skyAt(x, y + 1, z) >= 15,
      rain = g.weather > 0.3 && sky;
    this.wait -= (rain && Math.random() < 0.25 ? 2 : 1) * (sky ? 1 : 0.5);
    if (this.wait <= 0) this.nibble = randInt(20, 80);
  }
  // reeled in: the catch, the hooked entity pulled in, or nothing
  retrieve() {
    const g = this.game,
      o = this.owner;
    let dmg = 0;
    if (this.hooked) {
      const e = this.hooked,
        dx = o.pos[0] - e.pos[0],
        dy = o.pos[1] - e.pos[1],
        dz = o.pos[2] - e.pos[2];
      e.vel[0] += dx * 0.1;
      e.vel[1] += dy * 0.1 + Math.sqrt(Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz)) * 0.08;
      e.vel[2] += dz * 0.1;
      dmg = 5;
    } else if (this.bite > 0) {
      const out = rollLoot('gameplay/fishing', {
        e: this,
        luck: LUCK(this.rod),
        player: true
      });
      for (const st of out) {
        const it = new ItemEntity(g, this.pos[0], this.pos[1], this.pos[2], st, null);
        const dx = o.pos[0] - this.pos[0],
          dy = o.pos[1] - this.pos[1],
          dz = o.pos[2] - this.pos[2];
        it.vel = [dx * 0.1, dy * 0.1 + Math.sqrt(Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz)) * 0.08, dz * 0.1];
        g.entities.push(it);
      }
      g.dropXp(o.pos[0], o.pos[1] + 0.5, o.pos[2] + 0.5, randInt(1, 6));
      if (g.stats) g.stats.fish = (g.stats.fish || 0) + 1;
      dmg = 1;
    } else if (this.onGround) dmg = 2;
    this.dead = true;
    o.fishHook = null;
    return dmg;
  }
  comp() {}
  drawSelf(g, ip, a, env, l) {
    const r = g.renderer,
      gl = r.gl,
      tex = r.beTex('fishing_hook');
    if (!tex) return;
    const cam = r.camPos,
      dx = cam[0] - ip[0],
      dz = cam[2] - ip[2],
      yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz),
      pitch = Math.atan2(cam[1] - ip[1], Math.hypot(dx, dz));
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, ip[0], ip[1] + 0.1, ip[2]);
    M4.rotY(m, yaw);
    M4.rotX(m, -pitch);
    M4.rotX(m, Math.PI / 2);
    M4.scale(m, 0.25, 1, 0.25);
    const T2 = r.progTex;
    gl.useProgram(T2.p);
    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_vp, false, r.vp);
    gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_model, false, m);
    const L = Math.max(l[0], l[1] * env.day) * 0.8 + 0.2;
    gl.uniform4f(T2.u.u_color, L, L, L, 1);
    // (cut out like vanilla's entity_cutout: drawn unblended, its clear pixels came out black)
    if (T2.u.u_cut) gl.uniform1f(T2.u.u_cut, 0.1);
    gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, r.entityTex[tex]);
    gl.bindVertexArray(r.quadVao);
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
    gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
    if (T2.u.u_cut) gl.uniform1f(T2.u.u_cut, 0);
    // the line (vanilla FishingHookRenderer): from the hand holding the rod - in first person a point on the view's near
    // plane (right 0.525, down 0.1, scaled by 960 / fov) swung with the arm, else 0.35 right of and 0.8 ahead of the body,
    // 0.45 below the eye - to the top of the hook, sagging as y * (a² + a) / 2. It was guessed from the yaw alone, on
    // the left side
    const o = this.owner,
      op = o.ipos ? o.ipos(a) : o.pos,
      fp = g.perspective === 0 && o === g.player;
    const side = !o.inv || keyOf3(o.inv.held) === 'fishing_rod' ? 1 : -1; // (a rod cast from the off hand: the left side)
    const eye = [op[0], op[1] + (o === g.player && g.smoothEye != null ? g.smoothEye : o.eye ? o.eye() : o.sneaking ? 1.27 : 1.62), op[2]];
    const st = o.swingT > 0 ? clamp((6 - o.swingT + a) / 6, 0, 1) : 0,
      sw = Math.sin(Math.sqrt(st) * Math.PI);
    let h;
    if (fp) {
      const yw = o.yaw,
        f = g.lookDir(),
        R = [Math.cos(yw), 0, -Math.sin(yw)],
        U = [R[1] * f[2] - R[2] * f[1], R[2] * f[0] - R[0] * f[2], R[0] * f[1] - R[1] * f[0]];
      const fov = g.settings.fov || 70,
        k = 960 / fov,
        hh = Math.tan(fov * Math.PI / 360) * 0.05,
        ww = hh * r.canvas.width / r.canvas.height;
      h = [0, 1, 2].map(i => (f[i] * 0.05 + U[i] * hh * -0.1 + R[i] * ww * 0.525 * side) * k);
      // (Vec3.yRot then xRot, by the swing)
      const ay = sw * 0.5,
        ax = -sw * 0.7;
      h = [h[0] * Math.cos(ay) + h[2] * Math.sin(ay), h[1], h[2] * Math.cos(ay) - h[0] * Math.sin(ay)];
      h = [h[0], h[1] * Math.cos(ax) + h[2] * Math.sin(ax), h[2] * Math.cos(ax) - h[1] * Math.sin(ax)];
    } else {
      var _o$bodyYaw;
      const by = o === g.player && g.playerBodyYaw ? g.playerBodyYaw(a) : (_o$bodyYaw = o.bodyYaw) !== null && _o$bodyYaw !== void 0 ? _o$bodyYaw : o.yaw,
        R = [Math.cos(by), -Math.sin(by)],
        F = [-Math.sin(by), -Math.cos(by)];
      h = [R[0] * 0.35 * side + F[0] * 0.8, (o.sneaking && !o.flying ? -0.1875 : 0) - 0.45, R[1] * 0.35 * side + F[1] * 0.8];
    }
    const top = [ip[0], ip[1] + 0.35, ip[2]],
      d = [eye[0] + h[0] - top[0], eye[1] + h[1] - top[1], eye[2] + h[2] - top[2]];
    const v = [],
      n = 16,
      at = t => [top[0] + d[0] * t, top[1] + d[1] * (t * t + t) * 0.5, top[2] + d[2] * t];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (const t of [i / n, (i + 1) / n]) v.push(...at(t), 0, 0, 0, 1);
    r.drawLines(v, [0, 0, 0, 1]);
  }
}
Game.prototype.useRod = function (held) {
  const p = this.player;
  if (p.fishHook && !p.fishHook.dead) {
    const dmg = p.fishHook.retrieve();
    if (dmg && this.mode !== 'creative') this.damageHeld(dmg);
    Sound.ev('entity.fishing_bobber.retrieve', p.pos, 1, 0.4 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8));
  } else {
    p.fishHook = new FishingHook(this, p, held);
    this.entities.push(p.fishHook);
    Sound.ev('entity.fishing_bobber.throw', p.pos, 0.5, 0.4 / (Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8));
  }
  p.swing();
};

// ---- maps --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const MAP_PAL = (EXTRA.mappalette || []).map(v => [v >> 16 & 255, v >> 8 & 255, v & 255, v >>> 24 & 255]);
const mapColorOf = (id, meta) => {
  var _c$meta;
  const b = BLOCKS[id];
  if (!b) return 0;
  const c = EXTRA.mapcolors && EXTRA.mapcolors[b.key];
  if (c == null) return b.solid ? 11 : 0;
  return Array.isArray(c) ? (_c$meta = c[meta]) !== null && _c$meta !== void 0 ? _c$meta : c[0] : c;
};
Game.prototype.mapData = function (id) {
  const M = this.worldMeta.maps || (this.worldMeta.maps = {});
  const m = M[id];
  if (!m) return null;
  if (!m.px) {
    m.px = new Uint8Array(16384);
    if (m.data) {
      const b = atob(m.data);
      for (let i = 0; i < b.length && i < 16384; i++) m.px[i] = b.charCodeAt(i);
    }
  }
  return m;
};
Game.prototype.newMap = function (held, scale = 0, src = null) {
  const p = this.player,
    M = this.worldMeta.maps || (this.worldMeta.maps = {});
  const id = (this.worldMeta.nextMap = (this.worldMeta.nextMap || 0) + 1) - 1;
  const size = 128 << scale;
  const cx = src ? src.cx : Math.floor((p.pos[0] + 64) / size) * size + size / 2 - 64,
    cz = src ? src.cz : Math.floor((p.pos[2] + 64) / size) * size + size / 2 - 64;
  M[id] = {
    cx,
    cz,
    scale,
    dim: this.dim || 'overworld',
    locked: false,
    px: new Uint8Array(16384)
  };
  if (!held) return id;
  const st = makeStack('filled_map', 1);
  st.mapId = id;
  swapHeld(this, p, 'filled_map', {
    mapId: id
  });
  Sound.ev('ui.cartography_table.take_result', p.pos, 1, 1);
  p.swing();
  return id;
};
// a map fills in around the player holding it: one pass over a few columns each tick (vanilla's map updates)
Game.prototype.updateMap = function (m) {
  if (m.locked || (m.dim || 'overworld') !== (this.dim || 'overworld')) return;
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world,
    s = 1 << m.scale;
  const ppx = Math.floor((p.pos[0] - m.cx) / s) + 64,
    ppz = Math.floor((p.pos[2] - m.cz) / s) + 64,
    R = Math.floor(128 / s);
  m.col = ((m.col || 0) + 1) % 16;
  for (let px = ppx - R + 1; px < ppx + R; px++) {
    if ((px & 15) !== m.col || px < 0 || px >= 128) continue;
    let prevH = 0;
    for (let pz = ppz - R - 1; pz < ppz + R; pz++) {
      if (pz < -1 || pz >= 128 || (px - ppx) ** 2 + (pz - ppz) ** 2 > R * R) continue;
      const wx = m.cx + (px - 64) * s,
        wz = m.cz + (pz - 64) * s;
      if (!w.isLoaded(wx, wz)) continue;
      // the column's top (most common colour over the scaled area, its average height)
      let h = 0,
        col = 0,
        depth = 0;
      const counts = {};
      for (let ix = 0; ix < s; ix++) for (let iz = 0; iz < s; iz++) {
        // (from the top with water: it isn't solid, the sea showed as its floor; seagrass and kelp are water to it)
        let y = w.surfaceY(wx + ix, wz + iz, true) + 1,
          id = 0;
        do {
          y--;
          id = w.getBlock(wx + ix, y, wz + iz);
          if (WLOG[id]) id = WATER;
        } while (y > -64 && (id === 0 || mapColorOf(id, 0) === 0));
        let c = mapColorOf(id, w.getMeta(wx + ix, y, wz + iz));
        if (id === WATER) {
          let yy = y,
            b;
          while (yy > -64 && (IS_FLUID[b = w.getBlock(wx + ix, yy, wz + iz)] || WLOG[b])) {
            yy--;
            depth++;
          }
        }
        h += y;
        counts[c] = (counts[c] || 0) + 1;
      }
      h /= s * s;
      depth /= s * s;
      col = +Object.keys(counts).reduce((a2, b2) => counts[a2] >= counts[b2] ? a2 : b2);
      let br;
      if (col === 12) {
        const dd = depth * 0.1 + (px + pz & 1) * 0.2;
        br = dd < 0.5 ? 2 : dd > 0.9 ? 0 : 1;
      } else {
        const dd = (h - prevH) * 4 / (s + 4) + ((px + pz & 1) - 0.5) * 0.4;
        br = dd > 0.6 ? 2 : dd < -0.6 ? 0 : 1;
      }
      prevH = h;
      if (pz < 0) continue;
      const v = col * 4 + br;
      if (m.px[pz * 128 + px] !== v) {
        m.px[pz * 128 + px] = v;
        m.dirty = true;
      }
    }
  }
};
(() => {
  const _t = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function (...args) {
    const r = _t.apply(this, args);
    const p = this.player;
    if (p && this.state === 'play' && !this.net) for (const st of [p.inv.held, p.inv.slots[40]]) if (st && keyOf3(st) === 'filled_map' && st.mapId != null) {
      const m = this.mapData(st.mapId);
      if (m) this.updateMap(m);
    }
    return r;
  };
  // saved with the world as base64
  const _cs = Game.prototype.collectDimSave;
  Game.prototype.collectDimSave = function () {
    for (const id in this.worldMeta.maps || {}) {
      const m = this.worldMeta.maps[id];
      if (m.px && m.dirtySave !== false) {
        let s = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < m.px.length; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(m.px[i]);
        m.data = btoa(s);
      }
    }
    const px = {};
    for (const id in this.worldMeta.maps || {}) {
      px[id] = this.worldMeta.maps[id].px;
      delete this.worldMeta.maps[id].px;
    }
    try {
      return _cs.call(this);
    } finally {
      for (const id in px) this.worldMeta.maps[id].px = px[id];
    }
  };
})();
// the map's picture on a 2D canvas (screens)
function mapPicture(m) {
  if (!m || !m.px) return null;
  const cv = mapPicture.cv || (mapPicture.cv = document.createElement('canvas'));
  cv.width = 128;
  cv.height = 128;
  const x = cv.getContext('2d'),
    im = x.createImageData(128, 128);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16384; i++) {
    const v = m.px[i],
      col = v >= 4 ? MAP_PAL[v] : null;
    if (col) {
      im.data[i * 4] = col[0];
      im.data[i * 4 + 1] = col[1];
      im.data[i * 4 + 2] = col[2];
      im.data[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  x.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
  return cv;
}
// the map's picture as a texture (with the player's marker drawn on top when drawn), rebuilt when it changed
Renderer.prototype.mapTex = function (g, id) {
  const m = g.mapData(id);
  if (!m) return null;
  const k = '@map:' + id;
  if (!this.entityTex[k] || m.dirty) {
    const c = this._mapCanvas || (this._mapCanvas = document.createElement('canvas'));
    c.width = 128;
    c.height = 128;
    const x = c.getContext('2d'),
      im = x.createImageData(128, 128);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16384; i++) {
      const v = m.px[i],
        col = v >= 4 ? MAP_PAL[v] : null;
      if (col) {
        im.data[i * 4] = col[0];
        im.data[i * 4 + 1] = col[1];
        im.data[i * 4 + 2] = col[2];
        im.data[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
      }
    }
    x.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
    if (this.entityTex[k]) {
      const gl = this.gl;
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.entityTex[k]);
      gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, c);
    } else this.entityTex[k] = this.tex2D(c, false);
    m.dirty = false;
  }
  return k;
};
// a 1 x 1 textured quad facing -z (m at its centre)
function texQuad(r, tex, m, L, w = 1, h = 1) {
  const gl = r.gl,
    T2 = r.progTex,
    f = M4.copy(m);
  M4.rotX(f, -Math.PI / 2);
  M4.rotZ(f, Math.PI);
  M4.scale(f, -w / 2, 1, h / 2);
  gl.useProgram(T2.p);
  gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_vp, false, r.vp);
  gl.uniformMatrix4fv(T2.u.u_model, false, f);
  gl.uniform4f(T2.u.u_color, L, L, L, 1);
  gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, r.entityTex[tex]);
  gl.bindVertexArray(r.quadVao);
  const bl = gl.isEnabled(gl.BLEND);
  if (!bl) {
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  }
  gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
  gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE);
  if (!bl) gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
}
Game.prototype.drawMapInFrame = function (st, m, lt, env) {
  const r = this.renderer,
    t = st.mapId != null ? r.mapTex(this, st.mapId) : null,
    L = Math.max(lt[0], lt[1] * env.day) * 0.85 + 0.15;
  const bg = r.etex('map/map_background');
  if (bg) {
    const b = M4.copy(m);
    M4.translate(b, 0, 0, 0.002);
    texQuad(r, bg, b, L, 1, 1);
  }
  if (t) {
    const f = M4.copy(m);
    M4.translate(f, 0, 0, -0.002);
    texQuad(r, t, f, L, -7 / 8, -7 / 8);
  } // seen from -z: north at the top, east on the right
};
// held in the hand: the map in front of the view (both hands when the other one is empty)
(() => {
  const _dh = Game.prototype.drawHand;
  Game.prototype.drawHand = function (a, env) {
    var _p$oHandH, _p$handH;
    const p = this.player,
      st = p.inv.held;
    if (!(st && keyOf3(st) === 'filled_map') || this.perspective !== 0) return _dh.call(this, a, env);
    const r = this.renderer,
      gl = r.gl,
      D = Math.PI / 180;
    if (!r.fxOn) gl.clear(gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT); // (with the shader pack the hand goes in front by its depth range; post needs the world's depth)
    const proj = M4.create();
    M4.perspective(proj, 70 * Math.PI / 180, r.canvas.width / r.canvas.height, 0.05, 10);
    const savedVP = r.vp,
      savedCam = r.camPos;
    r.vp = proj;
    r.camPos = [0, 0, 0];
    // vanilla ItemInHandRenderer.renderTwoHandedMap: low and nearly flat while looking ahead, up in front when looking
    // down (calculateMapTilt), the swing and lowering of the hands; both arms hold it
    const sw = p.swingT > 0 ? clamp((6 - p.swingT + a) / 6, 0, 1) : 0,
      sq = Math.sqrt(sw);
    const eq = 1 - lerp((_p$oHandH = p.oHandH) !== null && _p$oHandH !== void 0 ? _p$oHandH : 1, (_p$handH = p.handH) !== null && _p$handH !== void 0 ? _p$handH : 1, a);
    const tf = clamp(1 - -p.pitch / D / 45 + 0.1, 0, 1),
      tilt = -Math.cos(tf * Math.PI) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    const m = M4.create();
    M4.translate(m, 0, 0.2 * Math.sin(sw * Math.PI) / 2, -0.4 * Math.sin(sq * Math.PI));
    M4.translate(m, 0, 0.04 - eq * 1.2 - tilt * 0.5, -0.72);
    M4.rotX(m, tilt * -85 * D);
    const lt = p.lightAt(),
      env2 = {
        ...env,
        fogNear: 1e8,
        fogFar: 2e8
      };
    if (!p.invisible) for (const side of [1, -1]) {
      const h = M4.copy(m);
      M4.rotY(h, 90 * D);
      M4.rotY(h, 92 * D);
      M4.rotX(h, 45 * D);
      M4.rotZ(h, side * -41 * D);
      M4.translate(h, side * 0.3, -1.1, 0.45);
      // renderRightHand / renderLeftHand: the arm part (its pivot and box), turned from this game's model space to vanilla's
      M4.translate(h, side * -6 / 16, 2 / 16, 0);
      M4.rotZ(h, Math.PI);
      r.drawModel(typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.armOf(this, side < 0) : side > 0 ? 'arm' : 'arm_left', typeof Skins !== 'undefined' ? Skins.texOf(this, p) : 'steve', h, null, lt, env2, {
        vp: proj
      });
    }
    M4.rotX(m, Math.sin(sq * Math.PI) * 20 * D);
    // the map: 128 pixels across 0.76 (2 x 0.38), its background 142
    const l = lt,
      L = Math.max(l[0], l[1] * env.day) * 0.8 + 0.2;
    const bg = r.etex('map/map_background'),
      t = st.mapId != null ? r.mapTex(this, st.mapId) : null;
    const S = 0.76;
    if (bg) texQuad(r, bg, m, L, S * 142 / 128, S * 142 / 128);
    if (t) {
      const f = M4.copy(m);
      M4.translate(f, 0, 0, 0.003);
      texQuad(r, t, f, L, S, -S);
    } // north at the top
    // the player's marker
    const md = st.mapId != null && this.mapData(st.mapId),
      mk = r.etex('map/decorations/player');
    if (md && md.net && md.icons) {
      // a server's map: the markers it sent (x, z in half-pixels from the centre, direction in sixteenths)
      for (const [type, ix, iz, dir] of md.icons) {
        const t = r.etex('map/decorations/' + type);
        if (!t) continue;
        const f = M4.copy(m);
        M4.translate(f, ix / 128 * S / 2, -iz / 128 * S / 2, 0.006);
        M4.rotZ(f, -dir * Math.PI / 8);
        texQuad(r, t, f, 1, S / 16, S / 16);
      }
    } else if (md && mk) {
      const s = 1 << md.scale,
        mx = (p.pos[0] - md.cx) / s / 64,
        mz = (p.pos[2] - md.cz) / s / 64;
      if (Math.abs(mx) < 1 && Math.abs(mz) < 1) {
        const f = M4.copy(m);
        M4.translate(f, mx * S / 2, -mz * S / 2, 0.006);
        M4.rotZ(f, p.yaw + Math.PI);
        texQuad(r, mk, f, 1, S / 16, S / 16);
      }
    }
    r.vp = savedVP;
    r.camPos = savedCam;
  };
  const _il = UI.prototype.itemLines;
  UI.prototype.itemLines = function (st) {
    const lines = _il.call(this, st);
    if (keyOf3(st) === 'filled_map' && st.mapId != null) {
      const m = this.game.mapData(st.mapId);
      lines.splice(1, 0, {
        text: '#' + st.mapId,
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      });
      if (m) lines.push({
        text: '比例尺 1:' + (1 << m.scale),
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      }, {
        text: '(级别 ' + m.scale + '/4)',
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      });
      if (m && m.locked) lines.push({
        text: '已锁定',
        color: '#AAAAAA'
      });
    }
    return lines;
  };
})();
// the cartography table: copy a map, zoom it out with paper, lock it with a glass pane
class CartographyScreen extends StationScreen {
  constructor(game, pos, title) {
    super(game, 'gui_cartography_table', title || '制图台', pos);
    this.own(0, 15, 15, {
      accept: s => keyOf3(s) === 'filled_map'
    });
    this.own(1, 15, 52, {
      accept: s => /^(map|paper|glass_pane)$/.test(keyOf3(s))
    });
    this.slots.push({
      x: 145,
      y: 39,
      output: true,
      get: () => this.result,
      set: () => {},
      onTake: () => this.take()
    });
    this.addPlayerSlots(84, 142);
    this.changed();
  }
  changed() {
    const a = this.S(0),
      b = this.S(1);
    this.result = null;
    this.mode = null;
    if (!a || !b) return;
    const m = this.game.mapData(a.mapId),
      k = keyOf3(b);
    if (k === 'map') {
      this.result = {
        ...a,
        count: 2
      };
      this.mode = 'copy';
    } else if (k === 'paper' && m && m.scale < 4 && !m.locked) {
      this.result = {
        ...a,
        count: 1,
        zoom: true
      };
      this.mode = 'zoom';
    } else if (k === 'glass_pane' && m && !m.locked) {
      this.result = {
        ...a,
        count: 1,
        lock: true
      };
      this.mode = 'lock';
    }
  }
  // zooming out or locking makes a new map, as the result is taken and before it is handed over: made in take(), it
  // came after the old map had gone to the cursor - the new one thrown away, the paper used for nothing
  takeOutput(ui, s, shift) {
    if (!s.output || this.mode !== 'zoom' && this.mode !== 'lock') return super.takeOutput(ui, s, shift);
    const inv = this.game.player.inv;
    while (this.result && (this.mode === 'zoom' || this.mode === 'lock')) {
      if (shift ? !inv.slots.slice(0, 36).some(t => !t) : ui.cursor) break;
      const st = this.make();
      if (shift) inv.add(st);else ui.cursor = st;
      this.take();
      this.changed();
      if (!shift) break;
    }
  }
  make() {
    const g = this.game,
      a = this.S(0),
      src = g.mapData(a.mapId);
    const id = g.newMap(null, this.mode === 'zoom' ? src.scale + 1 : src.scale, this.mode === 'zoom' ? null : src),
      nm = g.mapData(id);
    nm.dim = src.dim;
    if (this.mode === 'zoom') {
      const s = 128 << nm.scale;
      nm.cx = Math.floor((src.cx + 64) / s) * s + s / 2 - 64;
      nm.cz = Math.floor((src.cz + 64) / s) * s + s / 2 - 64;
    } else {
      nm.px.set(src.px);
      nm.locked = true;
    }
    return {
      ...a,
      count: 1,
      mapId: id
    };
  }
  take() {
    for (const i of [0, 1]) {
      const s = this.held[i];
      if (s) {
        s.count--;
        if (!s.count) this.held[i] = null;
      }
    }
    Sound.ev('ui.cartography_table.take_result', null, 1, 1);
  }
  // the preview in the middle: the map on its paper - smaller inside a bigger sheet when zooming out, two sheets
  // when copying, a padlock when locking
  drawMore(ui) {
    const a = this.S(0);
    if (!a) return;
    const m = this.game.mapData(a.mapId),
      c = ui.ctx,
      X = this.x,
      Y = this.y;
    const pic = (x, y, s) => {
      const cv = mapPicture(m);
      if (cv) {
        c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
        c.drawImage(cv, X + x, Y + y, Math.round(128 * s), Math.round(128 * s));
      }
    };
    if (this.mode === 'zoom') {
      ui.sprite('cartography_table_scaled_map', X + 67, Y + 13, 66, 66);
      pic(85, 31, 0.226);
    } else if (this.mode === 'copy') {
      ui.sprite('cartography_table_duplicated_map', X + 83, Y + 13, 50, 66);
      pic(86, 16, 0.34);
      ui.sprite('cartography_table_duplicated_map', X + 67, Y + 29, 50, 66);
      pic(70, 32, 0.34);
    } else {
      ui.sprite('cartography_table_map', X + 67, Y + 13, 66, 66);
      pic(71, 17, 0.45);
    }
    if (this.mode === 'lock') ui.sprite('cartography_table_locked', X + 118, Y + 60);
    if (m && m.locked && this.S(1)) ui.sprite('cartography_table_error', X + 35, Y + 31);
  }
}
if (typeof WORKSTATIONS !== 'undefined') {
  WORKSTATIONS.cartography = (g, pos, b) => new CartographyScreen(g, pos, b.cn);
  if (BID.cartography_table !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID.cartography_table].onUse = 'cartography';
}

// ---- books ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class BookScreen {
  constructor(game, stack, edit, lectern) {
    this.game = game;
    this.st = stack;
    this.edit = edit;
    this.lectern = lectern;
    this.pages = stack.pages ? [...stack.pages] : [''];
    this.page = lectern ? lectern.page || 0 : 0;
    this.signing = false;
    this.title = '';
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.x = Math.floor((u.w - 192) / 2);
    this.y = 2;
    if (this.edit) this.focus();
  }
  focus() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      s = this;
    if (this.signing) {
      this.hideArea();
      u.showInput(this.x + 36 + 10, this.y + 50, 100, 12, this.title, () => s.sign(), {
        max: 32,
        onInput: v => {
          s.title = v;
        },
        onEsc: () => u.close()
      });
      u.inputBox = null;
      return;
    }
    u.hideInput();
    // a page takes line breaks: typed into a hidden text area, drawn on the page
    let ta = u.bookArea;
    if (!ta) {
      ta = u.bookArea = document.createElement('textarea');
      Object.assign(ta.style, {
        position: 'fixed',
        left: '-2000px',
        top: '0',
        width: '200px',
        height: '200px',
        opacity: '0'
      });
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
    }
    ta.value = this.pages[this.page] || '';
    ta.style.display = 'block';
    ta.oninput = () => {
      let v = ta.value.slice(0, 1024);
      while (s.wrap(v, true).length > 14) v = v.slice(0, -1);
      if (v !== ta.value) ta.value = v;
      s.pages[s.page] = v;
      s.save();
    };
    ta.onkeydown = e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.key === 'Escape') u.close();
      if (e.key === 'PageUp' && s.page > 0) {
        s.page--;
        s.turned();
      }
      if (e.key === 'PageDown') {
        if (s.page === s.pages.length - 1 && s.pages.length < 100) s.pages.push('');
        s.page++;
        s.turned();
      }
    };
    setTimeout(() => ta.focus(), 0);
  }
  hideArea() {
    const ta = this.game.ui.bookArea;
    if (ta) {
      ta.style.display = 'none';
      ta.oninput = null;
      ta.onkeydown = null;
      ta.blur();
    }
  }
  save() {
    if (this.edit && !this.signing) this.st.pages = [...this.pages];
  }
  close() {
    const u = this.game.ui;
    this.hideArea();
    u.hideInput();
    this.save();
    if (this.edit && !this.signed) this.netSend(null);
  }
  // on a server the book is the server's: the pages (and the title when signed) are sent as edit_book
  netSend(title) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!g.net) return;
    const p = g.player,
      slot = p.inv.slots.indexOf(this.st);
    g.net.send({
      t: 'book',
      slot: slot < 0 ? p.inv.sel : slot,
      pages: this.pages,
      title
    });
  }
  key(ui, ev) {
    return true;
  }
  btns() {
    const x = this.x,
      y = this.y,
      b = [];
    if (this.page > 0) b.push({
      x: x + 43,
      y: y + 154,
      w: 23,
      h: 13,
      act: 'prev',
      sprite: 'page_backward'
    });
    if (this.page < this.pages.length - 1 || this.edit && this.pages.length < 100 && this.pages[this.page]) b.push({
      x: x + 116,
      y: y + 154,
      w: 23,
      h: 13,
      act: 'next',
      sprite: 'page_forward'
    });
    if (this.edit) {
      b.push({
        x: x + 1,
        y: y + 196,
        w: 94,
        h: 20,
        act: 'sign',
        label: this.signing ? '署名并关闭' : '署名'
      }, {
        x: x + 98,
        y: y + 196,
        w: 94,
        h: 20,
        act: this.signing ? 'cancel' : 'done',
        label: this.signing ? '取消' : '完成'
      });
    } else if (this.lectern) b.push({
      x: x + 1,
      y: y + 196,
      w: 94,
      h: 20,
      act: 'take',
      label: '取书'
    }, {
      x: x + 98,
      y: y + 196,
      w: 94,
      h: 20,
      act: 'done',
      label: '完成'
    });else b.push({
      x: x + 48,
      y: y + 196,
      w: 96,
      h: 20,
      act: 'done',
      label: '完成'
    });
    return b;
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my) {
    for (const b of this.btns()) if (ui.hit(b, mx, my)) {
      Sound.click && Sound.click();
      if (b.act === 'prev') {
        this.page--;
        this.turned();
      }
      if (b.act === 'next') {
        if (this.page === this.pages.length - 1) this.pages.push('');
        this.page++;
        this.turned();
      }
      if (b.act === 'done') ui.close();
      if (b.act === 'sign') {
        if (this.signing) this.sign();else {
          this.signing = true;
          this.focus();
        }
      }
      if (b.act === 'cancel') {
        this.signing = false;
        this.focus();
      }
      if (b.act === 'take') {
        const g = this.game,
          l = this.lectern;
        if (l && l.book) {
          if (g.player.inv.add(l.book)) g.dropFromPlayer(l.book);
          l.book = null;
          bsetProp(g.world, ...l.pos, 'has_book', 'false');
        }
        ui.close();
      }
      return;
    }
  }
  turned() {
    if (this.lectern) {
      this.lectern.page = this.page;
      Sound.ev('item.book.page_turn', this.lectern.pos, 1, 1);
    } else Sound.ev('item.book.page_turn', null, 1, 1);
    if (this.edit) this.focus();
  }
  sign() {
    if (!this.title.trim()) return;
    const g = this.game,
      p = g.player,
      st = this.st;
    if (g.net) {
      this.signed = true;
      this.netSend(this.title.trim());
      g.ui.close();
      return;
    }
    const wb = {
      ...makeStack('written_book', 1),
      pages: this.pages.filter((t, i) => t || i === 0),
      title: this.title.trim(),
      author: g.playerName || g.worldMeta && g.worldMeta.playerName || '玩家',
      gen: 0
    };
    const i = p.inv.slots.indexOf(st);
    if (i >= 0) p.inv.slots[i] = wb;
    g.ui.close();
  }
  wrap(text) {
    const out = [];
    for (const para of String(text).split('\n')) {
      let line = '';
      for (const ch of para) {
        if (Font.width(line + ch) > 114) {
          out.push(line);
          line = '';
        }
        line += ch;
      }
      out.push(line);
    }
    return out.slice(0, 14);
  }
  draw(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      x = this.x,
      y = this.y,
      im = this.game.renderer.images['@gui/book'] || ui.img.book_gui;
    if (im) c.drawImage(im, 0, 0, 192, 192, x, y, 192, 192);else {
      c.fillStyle = '#F5EBD0';
      c.fillRect(x + 20, y, 150, 180);
    }
    if (this.signing) {
      Font.center(c, '输入书名：', x + 96, y + 34, '#000000', false);
      Font.center(c, this.title + (Math.floor(performance.now() / 300) % 2 ? '_' : ''), x + 96, y + 50, '#000000', false);
      Font.center(c, '作者：' + (this.game.playerName || '玩家'), x + 96, y + 62, '#444444', false);
      Font.center(c, '注意！署名后此书将不可再编辑。', x + 96, y + 82, '#000000', false);
    } else {
      const pg = '第 ' + (this.page + 1) + ' 页，共 ' + Math.max(this.pages.length, 1) + ' 页';
      Font.draw(c, pg, x + 148 - Font.width(pg), y + 16, '#000000', false);
      const lines = this.wrap(this.pages[this.page] || '');
      lines.forEach((l, i) => Font.draw(c, l, x + 36, y + 32 + i * 9, '#000000', false));
      if (this.edit && Math.floor(performance.now() / 300) % 2) {
        const last = lines[lines.length - 1] || '';
        Font.draw(c, '_', x + 36 + Font.width(last), y + 32 + (lines.length - 1) * 9, '#000000', false);
      }
    }
    for (const b of this.btns()) {
      if (b.sprite) {
        const hov = ui.hit(b);
        ui.sprite('widget_' + b.sprite + (hov ? '_highlighted' : ''), b.x, b.y);
        if (!ui.img['widget_' + b.sprite]) Font.draw(c, b.act === 'prev' ? '<' : '>', b.x + 8, b.y + 3, hov ? '#AA0000' : '#000000', false);
      } else ui.button(b);
    }
  }
}

// lecterns: put a book on, read it, take it back; comparators read the page

// ---- jukeboxes and music discs: a disc goes in and comes out (comparators read it) and the notes rise, but nothing
// plays - the music discs' songs were taken out with the background music (user, 2026-10-29) ----
const SONGS = EXTRA.jukebox_song || {};
const discSong = st => {
  const k = keyOf3(st);
  if (!/^music_disc_/.test(k)) return null;
  const s = k.replace(/^music_disc_/, '');
  return SONGS[s] ? {
    key: s,
    ...SONGS[s]
  } : null;
};
Game.prototype.jukeboxPlay = function (pos, disc) {
  this.jukeboxes = this.jukeboxes || new Map();
  const k = pos.join(','),
    song = discSong(disc);
  this.jukeboxStop(pos);
  if (!song) return;
  const j = {
    x: pos[0],
    y: pos[1],
    z: pos[2],
    playing: true,
    song,
    t0: this.tickCount
  };
  this.jukeboxes.set(k, j);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.particles.spawn('note', pos[0] + 0.5, pos[1] + 1.2, pos[2] + 0.5, 0, 0.05, 0, {
    col: [255, 80, 200]
  });
};
Game.prototype.jukeboxStop = function (pos) {
  const k = pos.join(','),
    j = this.jukeboxes && this.jukeboxes.get(k);
  if (!j) return;
  this.jukeboxes.delete(k);
};
(() => {
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    const p = this.player,
      t = this.target,
      held = p.inv.held;
    if (t && !this.targetEntity && BLOCKS[t.id].key === 'jukebox' && !this.net) {
      const be = this.getBlockEntity(...t.pos, 'jukebox');
      if (be.disc) {
        this.dropItem(t.pos[0] + 0.5, t.pos[1] + 1.1, t.pos[2] + 0.5, be.disc);
        be.disc = null;
        this.jukeboxStop(t.pos);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      if (held && discSong(held) && !p.sneaking) {
        be.disc = {
          ...held,
          count: 1
        };
        useOne(this, p);
        this.jukeboxPlay(t.pos, be.disc);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
    }
    return _use.call(this);
  };
  const _db = Game.prototype.dropBlockLoot;
  Game.prototype.dropBlockLoot = function (x, y, z, id, meta, tool, ...rest) {
    const k = x + ',' + y + ',' + z,
      b = BLOCKS[id];
    if (b && b.key === 'jukebox') {
      const be = this.blockEntities.get(k);
      if (be && be.disc) {
        this.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, be.disc);
        be.disc = null;
      }
      this.jukeboxStop([x, y, z]);
    }
    if (b && b.key === 'lectern') {
      const be = this.blockEntities.get(k);
      if (be && be.book) {
        this.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, be.book);
        be.book = null;
      }
    }
    return _db.call(this, x, y, z, id, meta, tool, ...rest);
  };
  // the music fades with distance; ends with the song
  const _t = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function (...args) {
    const r = _t.apply(this, args);
    if (!this.jukeboxes || !this.player) return r;
    for (const [k, j] of this.jukeboxes) {
      if (BLOCKS[this.world.getBlock(j.x, j.y, j.z)].key !== 'jukebox') {
        this.jukeboxStop([j.x, j.y, j.z]);
        continue;
      }
      const d = Math.hypot(this.player.pos[0] - j.x - 0.5, this.player.pos[1] - j.y, this.player.pos[2] - j.z - 0.5);
      if ((this.tickCount - j.t0) / 20 > j.song.length_in_seconds) j.playing = false;
      if (j.playing && this.tickCount % 20 === 0 && d < 32) this.particles.spawn('note', j.x + 0.5, j.y + 1.2, j.z + 0.5, 0, 0.05, 0, {
        col: [Math.random() * 255 | 0, Math.random() * 255 | 0, Math.random() * 255 | 0]
      });
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- brushes: dust off suspicious sand and gravel ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Game.prototype.brushTick = function (st) {
  const p = this.player,
    t = this.target;
  if (!t || this.targetEntity) {
    p.usingItem = null;
    return;
  }
  if (p.useT % 10 !== 5) return;
  const [x, y, z] = t.pos,
    b = BLOCKS[t.id],
    w = this.world;
  const sus = b.key === 'suspicious_sand' || b.key === 'suspicious_gravel',
    sand = /sand/.test(b.key);
  Sound.ev(sand ? 'item.brush.brushing.sand' : /gravel/.test(b.key) ? 'item.brush.brushing.gravel' : 'item.brush.brushing.generic', t.pos, 1, 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.particles.spawn('block', x + 0.5 + DIRS[t.face][0] * 0.55, y + 0.5 + DIRS[t.face][1] * 0.55, z + 0.5 + DIRS[t.face][2] * 0.55, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1, 0.05, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1, {
    id: t.id,
    meta: w.getMeta(x, y, z)
  });
  if (!sus) return;
  const be = this.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'brushable');
  be.brush = (be.brush || 0) + 1;
  const d = Math.min(3, Math.floor(be.brush / 2));
  if (be.brush < 8) {
    bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'dusted', String(d));
    return;
  }
  // done: the find pops out of the top face, the block turns plain
  const table = be.loot || defaultArchaeology(this, x, z, sand);
  for (const s of rollLoot(table, {
    e: p,
    player: true
  })) this.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 1.1, z + 0.5, s);
  this.blockEntities.delete(x + ',' + y + ',' + z);
  w.setBlock(x, y, z, BID[sand ? 'sand' : 'gravel'], 0);
  Sound.ev(sand ? 'item.brush.brushing.sand.complete' : 'item.brush.brushing.gravel.complete', t.pos, 1, 1);
  this.damageHeld(1);
  p.usingItem = null;
  this.flushMesh();
};
function defaultArchaeology(g, x, z, sand) {
  const b = biomeName(g, x, z);
  if (/warm_ocean|lukewarm/.test(b)) return 'archaeology/ocean_ruin_warm';
  if (/ocean/.test(b)) return 'archaeology/ocean_ruin_cold';
  if (sand) return /desert/.test(b) ? 'archaeology/desert_pyramid' : 'archaeology/desert_well';
  return Math.random() < 0.1 ? 'archaeology/trail_ruins_rare' : 'archaeology/trail_ruins_common';
}

// ---- vaults and trial spawners -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(() => {
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    const p = this.player,
      t = this.target,
      held = p.inv.held,
      k = keyOf3(held);
    if (t && !this.targetEntity && BLOCKS[t.id].key === 'vault' && !this.net) {
      const [x, y, z] = t.pos,
        ominous = Features.propOf(t.id, this.world.getMeta(x, y, z), 'ominous') === 'true';
      const be = this.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'vault');
      be.rewarded = be.rewarded || [];
      const want = ominous ? 'ominous_trial_key' : 'trial_key';
      if (k !== want || be.rewarded.includes('player') || be.eject) {
        Sound.ev('block.vault.insert_item_fail', t.pos, 1, 1);
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      useOne(this, p);
      be.rewarded.push('player');
      be.eject = rollLoot(ominous ? 'chests/trial_chambers/reward_ominous' : 'chests/trial_chambers/reward', {
        e: p,
        player: true
      });
      be.ejectT = 0;
      bsetProp(this.world, x, y, z, 'vault_state', 'unlocking');
      Sound.ev('block.vault.insert_item', t.pos, 1, 1);
      p.swing();
      return;
    }
    return _use.call(this);
  };
  const _t = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function (...args) {
    const r = _t.apply(this, args);
    if (!this.blockEntities || this.net || this.state !== 'play') return r;
    for (const be of this.blockEntities.values()) {
      if (be.type === 'vault' && be.eject) {
        const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
        if (++be.ejectT % 20 !== 0) continue;
        if (be.ejectT === 20) bsetProp(this.world, x, y, z, 'vault_state', 'ejecting');
        const st = be.eject.shift();
        if (st) {
          const it = new ItemEntity(this, x + 0.5, y + 1.1, z + 0.5, st, [(Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1, 0.2, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1]);
          this.entities.push(it);
          Sound.ev('block.vault.eject_item', be.pos, 1, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
        } else {
          be.eject = null;
          bsetProp(this.world, x, y, z, 'vault_state', 'inactive');
          Sound.ev('block.vault.deactivate', be.pos, 1, 1);
        }
      }
    }
    if (this.tickCount % 2 === 0) this.tickTrialSpawners();
    return r;
  };
})();
const TS_KEYS = Object.keys(EXTRA.trial_spawner || {});
Game.prototype.tickTrialSpawners = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world;
  if (!p || this.difficulty === 0) return;
  // nearby trial spawner blocks are found as the player moves (they are rare)
  if (this.tickCount % 40 === 0) {
    const x0 = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
      y0 = Math.floor(p.pos[1]),
      z0 = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
    this._ts = [];
    if (BID.trial_spawner !== undefined) for (let dx = -14; dx <= 14; dx++) for (let dy = -6; dy <= 6; dy++) for (let dz = -14; dz <= 14; dz++) if (w.getBlock(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz) === BID.trial_spawner) this._ts.push([x0 + dx, y0 + dy, z0 + dz]);
    // (when each one came into range: its saved mobs still waiting for their chunk count only for a while after that)
    const seen = this._tsSeen || new Map();
    this._tsSeen = new Map(this._ts.map(([x, y, z]) => {
      var _seen$get;
      const k = this.dim + ':' + x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
      return [k, (_seen$get = seen.get(k)) !== null && _seen$get !== void 0 ? _seen$get : this.tickCount];
    }));
  }
  for (const [x, y, z] of this._ts || []) {
    var _ref;
    const be = this.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'trial_spawner');
    be.pos = [x, y, z];
    const ominous = Features.propOf(BID.trial_spawner, w.getMeta(x, y, z), 'ominous') === 'true';
    if (!be.config) {
      const pool = TS_KEYS.filter(k => k.endsWith(ominous ? '/ominous' : '/normal'));
      be.config = pool[Math.random() * pool.length | 0];
    }
    const C = EXTRA.trial_spawner[be.config] || {},
      tc = this.tickCount;
    if (be.cooldown && tc < be.cooldown) continue;
    if (be.cooldown) {
      be.cooldown = 0;
      bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'trial_spawner_state', 'waiting_for_players');
    }
    const near = Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - x - 0.5, p.pos[1] - y, p.pos[2] - z - 0.5) < 14 && !p.creative;
    // the mobs it waits on are kept out of the block entity: live mobs in it made every save fail (DataCloneError).
    // Like vanilla's shouldMobBeUntracked, one gone from the world or over 47 blocks away no longer counts
    const tsm = this._tsMobs || (this._tsMobs = new Map()),
      mk = this.dim + ':' + x + ',' + y + ',' + z;
    if ('mobs' in be) delete be.mobs;
    if (!be.active) {
      if (!near) continue;
      tsm.delete(mk + '#' + (be.trial || 0));
      be.trial = (be.trial || 0) + 1;
      be.active = true;
      be.spawned = 0;
      be.total = (C.total_mobs || 6) + (C.total_mobs_added_per_player || 2) * 0;
      bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'trial_spawner_state', 'active');
      Sound.ev('block.trial_spawner.detect_player', [x, y, z], 1, 1);
    }
    const d47 = q => (q[0] - x - 0.5) ** 2 + (q[1] - y) ** 2 + (q[2] - z - 0.5) ** 2 <= 47 * 47;
    // (the key names this trial, so a mob left over from an earlier one never counts again)
    const tk = mk + '#' + (be.trial || 0),
      was = tsm.get(tk) || [];
    const mobs = was.filter(m => !m.dead && m.deathTime === 0 && this.entities.includes(m) && d47(m.pos));
    for (const m of was) if (!mobs.includes(m)) delete m.tsKey; // untracked for good, as in vanilla
    tsm.set(tk, mobs);
    // (each one carries the trial's key and is saved with it, like vanilla's saved UUIDs: restoreMob tracks it again
    // after a reload, and one still waiting for its chunk to load counts too - no early rewards, no extra spawns.
    // That lasts 10 s after the spawner comes into range; then, like vanilla's unloaded mob, it is untracked for good)
    const grace = tc - ((_ref = this._tsSeen && this._tsSeen.get(mk)) !== null && _ref !== void 0 ? _ref : tc) < 200;
    const pend = (this.pendingMobs || []).reduce((n, r) => {
      if (r.ts !== tk) return n;
      if (grace && d47(r.pos)) return n + 1;
      delete r.ts;
      return n;
    }, 0);
    if (be.spawned < be.total) {
      if (mobs.length < (C.simultaneous_mobs || 2) && tc - (be.lastSpawn || 0) >= (C.ticks_between_spawn || 40) && mobs.length + pend < (C.simultaneous_mobs || 2)) {
        const pot = C.spawn_potentials || [{
          data: {
            entity: {
              id: 'minecraft:zombie'
            }
          },
          weight: 1
        }];
        const type = pickW(pot.map(q => [q.data.entity.id.replace('minecraft:', ''), q.weight || 1]));
        const sx = x + 0.5 + randInt(-4, 4),
          sz = z + 0.5 + randInt(-4, 4);
        if (MOB_TYPES[type] || type === 'zombie') {
          const m = createMob(this, type, sx, y, sz);
          m.persistent = true;
          m.target = p;
          m.tsKey = tk;
          if (be.config.includes('baby_zombie') && m.makeBaby) m.makeBaby();
          if (!m.collides(m.box())) {
            this.entities.push(m);
            mobs.push(m);
            be.spawned++;
            be.lastSpawn = tc;
            Sound.ev('block.trial_spawner.spawn_mob', [x, y, z], 1, 1);
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) this.particles.spawn('flame', sx + (Math.random() - 0.5), y + Math.random() * 2, sz + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.02, 0);
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (!mobs.length && !pend) {
      // the trial is over: the rewards pop out, then a long cooldown
      const tables = C.loot_tables_to_eject || [{
        data: 'minecraft:spawners/' + (ominous ? 'ominous/' : '') + 'trial_chamber/consumables',
        weight: 1
      }, {
        data: 'minecraft:spawners/' + (ominous ? 'ominous/' : '') + 'trial_chamber/key',
        weight: 1
      }];
      const tb = pickW(tables.map(q => [String(q.data).replace('minecraft:', ''), q.weight || 1]));
      for (const st of rollLoot(tb, {
        e: p,
        player: true
      })) this.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 1.2, z + 0.5, st);
      Sound.ev('block.trial_spawner.eject_item', [x, y, z], 1, 1);
      be.active = false;
      be.cooldown = tc + (C.target_cooldown_length || 36000);
      bsetProp(w, x, y, z, 'trial_spawner_state', 'cooldown');
    }
  }
};

// ---- the wandering trader's vanilla trade lists (trade_set: buying 2, common 5, uncommon 1) -------------------------------------------------
(() => {
  if (typeof WanderingTrader === 'undefined' || !EXTRA.trade_set) return;
  const tagList = name => {
    const t = EXTRA.tags && EXTRA.tags['villager_trade:' + name];
    return (t || []).flatMap(v => typeof v === 'string' ? v[0] === '#' ? tagList(v.slice(11)) : [v.replace('minecraft:', '')] : []);
  };
  const toOffer = k => {
    const T2 = EXTRA.villager_trade[k];
    if (!T2 || !T2.wants || !T2.gives) return null;
    const id = o => String(o.id).replace('minecraft:', ''),
      n = o => typeof o.count === 'number' ? o.count : o.count ? Math.round(lootNum(o.count)) : 1;
    const o = {
      a: id(T2.wants),
      an: n(T2.wants),
      r: id(T2.gives),
      rn: n(T2.gives),
      uses: T2.max_uses || 1,
      used: 0,
      xp: T2.xp || 1
    };
    if (T2.additional_wants) {
      o.b = id(T2.additional_wants);
      o.bn = n(T2.additional_wants);
    }
    return ITEM_KEY[o.a] !== undefined && ITEM_KEY[o.r] !== undefined && (!o.b || ITEM_KEY[o.b] !== undefined) ? o : null;
  };
  const _of = WanderingTrader.prototype.offers;
  WanderingTrader.prototype.offers = function () {
    if (!this.trades) {
      const out = [];
      for (const set of ['wandering_trader/buying', 'wandering_trader/common', 'wandering_trader/uncommon']) {
        const S = EXTRA.trade_set[set];
        if (!S) continue;
        const pool = tagList(String(S.trades).replace(/^#minecraft:/, '')).map(toOffer).filter(Boolean);
        const amt = typeof S.amount === 'number' ? S.amount : Math.round(lootNum(S.amount));
        for (let i = 0; i < amt && pool.length; i++) out.push(pool.splice(Math.random() * pool.length | 0, 1)[0]);
      }
      if (out.length) this.trades = out;
    }
    return this.trades || _of.call(this);
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/specials.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vanilla's special crafting recipes (the ones without a recipe file): shield decoration, banner and book
// copying, firework stars and their fade colours, firework rockets with stars, tipped arrows, dyed leather;
// shields drawn with their banner patterns; decorated pots with their sherds on the four sides; firework
// explosions in their stars' colours.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const STAR_SHAPE = {
  fire_charge: 'large_ball',
  gold_nugget: 'star',
  feather: 'burst'
};
const isHead = k => /_(head|skull)$/.test(k);
const DYE_RGB_ARR = c => {
  const v = DYE_RGB[c] || 0xffffff;
  return v;
};
// the special recipe for a grid, or null: { result, keep: grid index left in place }
function specialRecipe(grid) {
  const items = grid.map((s, i) => s ? {
    s,
    i,
    k: ITEMS[s.id] ? ITEMS[s.id].key : ''
  } : null).filter(Boolean);
  if (!items.length) return null;
  const by = re => items.filter(o => re.test(o.k));
  const dyes = by(/_dye$/);
  // shield + banner: the shield takes the banner's colour and patterns
  if (items.length === 2) {
    const sh = items.find(o => o.k === 'shield'),
      bn = items.find(o => /_banner$/.test(o.k));
    if (sh && bn && !sh.s.base) return {
      result: {
        ...sh.s,
        count: 1,
        base: bn.k.replace(/_banner$/, ''),
        patterns: (bn.s.patterns || []).map(p => [...p])
      }
    };
    // banner copy: a patterned banner and a blank one of the same colour
    const bs = by(/_banner$/);
    if (bs.length === 2 && bs[0].k === bs[1].k) {
      const src = bs.find(o => o.s.patterns && o.s.patterns.length),
        blank = bs.find(o => !(o.s.patterns && o.s.patterns.length));
      if (src && blank) return {
        result: {
          ...src.s,
          count: 1
        },
        keep: src.i
      };
    }
  }
  // book copying: a written book (original or copy) and books and quills
  const wb = items.find(o => o.k === 'written_book'),
    wq = by(/^writable_book$/);
  if (wb && wq.length && wq.length + 1 === items.length && (wb.s.gen | 0) < 2) return {
    result: {
      ...wb.s,
      count: wq.length,
      gen: (wb.s.gen | 0) + 1
    },
    keep: wb.i
  };
  // filled map copying: a map and empty maps
  const fm = items.find(o => o.k === 'filled_map'),
    em = by(/^map$/);
  if (fm && em.length && em.length + 1 === items.length) return {
    result: {
      ...fm.s,
      count: em.length + 1
    }
  };
  // tipped arrows: eight arrows round a lingering potion
  if (items.length === 9 && items[4].k === 'lingering_potion' && items.filter(o => o.k === 'arrow').length === 8) return {
    result: {
      ...makeStack('tipped_arrow', 8),
      pot: grid[4].pot
    }
  };
  // firework star: gunpowder, dyes, maybe a shape, a diamond (trail) and glowstone dust (twinkle)
  const gp = by(/^gunpowder$/);
  if (gp.length === 1 && dyes.length && !items.some(o => o.k === 'paper' || o.k === 'firework_star')) {
    const shapeIt = items.filter(o => STAR_SHAPE[o.k] || isHead(o.k));
    const rest = items.filter(o => !/_dye$/.test(o.k) && o.k !== 'gunpowder' && !STAR_SHAPE[o.k] && !isHead(o.k) && o.k !== 'diamond' && o.k !== 'glowstone_dust');
    if (shapeIt.length <= 1 && !rest.length && by(/^diamond$/).length <= 1 && by(/^glowstone_dust$/).length <= 1) {
      const sk = shapeIt[0] ? STAR_SHAPE[shapeIt[0].k] || 'creeper' : 'small_ball';
      return {
        result: {
          ...makeStack('firework_star', 1),
          fw: {
            shape: sk,
            colors: dyes.map(o => o.k.replace(/_dye$/, '')),
            fade: [],
            trail: !!by(/^diamond$/).length,
            twinkle: !!by(/^glowstone_dust$/).length
          }
        }
      };
    }
  }
  // fade colours on a star
  const fs = items.filter(o => o.k === 'firework_star');
  if (fs.length === 1 && dyes.length && dyes.length + 1 === items.length && fs[0].s.fw) return {
    result: {
      ...fs[0].s,
      count: 1,
      fw: {
        ...fs[0].s.fw,
        fade: dyes.map(o => o.k.replace(/_dye$/, ''))
      }
    }
  };
  // rocket: paper, 1-3 gunpowder, any stars
  const pp = by(/^paper$/);
  if (pp.length === 1 && gp.length >= 1 && gp.length <= 3 && pp.length + gp.length + fs.length === items.length) return {
    result: {
      ...makeStack('firework_rocket', 3),
      flight: gp.length,
      explosions: fs.map(o => o.s.fw).filter(Boolean)
    }
  };
  // dyed leather (armour, horse armour, wolf armour): the colours averaged like vanilla
  const lt = items.filter(o => /^leather_(helmet|chestplate|leggings|boots|horse_armor)$|^wolf_armor$/.test(o.k));
  if (lt.length === 1 && dyes.length && dyes.length + 1 === items.length) {
    const cols = dyes.map(o => DYE_RGB_ARR(o.k.replace(/_dye$/, '')));
    if (lt[0].s.color != null) cols.push(lt[0].s.color);
    let r = 0,
      g = 0,
      b = 0,
      mx = 0;
    for (const c of cols) {
      const cr = c >> 16 & 255,
        cg = c >> 8 & 255,
        cb = c & 255;
      mx += Math.max(cr, cg, cb);
      r += cr;
      g += cg;
      b += cb;
    }
    const n = cols.length;
    r /= n;
    g /= n;
    b /= n;
    const avgMax = mx / n,
      cur = Math.max(r, g, b) || 1;
    r = r * avgMax / cur;
    g = g * avgMax / cur;
    b = b * avgMax / cur;
    return {
      result: {
        ...lt[0].s,
        count: 1,
        color: Math.round(r) << 16 | Math.round(g) << 8 | Math.round(b)
      }
    };
  }
  return null;
}

// the debug stick (creative): right click cycles the selected property of a block's state, sneak + right click
// picks the next property (vanilla uses the attack button for that; here it stays on the use button)
(() => {
  // the first blocks and those sharing their meta layout (slabs, stairs, doors, beds, logs, furnaces ...) keep no
  // state list - "没有属性" on every one of them (players' feedback 2026-11): their properties as vanillaState names
  // them, a log's axis and a furnace's or chest's facing, with the lowest meta for each set of values. Stair shapes,
  // fence and wall connections come from the neighbours: nothing to set
  const SIDE = {
    0: 'west',
    1: 'east',
    4: 'north',
    5: 'south'
  }; // (meta: the DIRS index faced)
  function metaStates(id) {
    const c = metaStates.cache || (metaStates.cache = new Map());
    if (c.has(id)) return c.get(id);
    const b = BLOCKS[id],
      seen = new Map(),
      dom = {};
    if (!b.fence) for (let m = 0; m < 256; m++) {
      if (b.ladder && !SIDE[m]) continue;
      if (b.key === 'torch' && m && m !== 1 && m !== 4 && m !== 5) continue; // standing + the 3 wall metas the game places
      const vs = vanillaState(b, m, null),
        p = {};
      for (const k in vs.p) if (k !== 'shape' && k !== 'occupied') p[k] = String(vs.p[k]);
      if (b.axis) {
        if ((m & 3) === 3) continue;
        p.axis = ['y', 'x', 'z'][m & 3];
      }
      if (b.facing && b.key !== 'crafting_table') {
        if (!SIDE[m]) continue;
        p.facing = SIDE[m];
      }
      const s = vs.key + JSON.stringify(p);
      if (!seen.has(s)) {
        seen.set(s, {
          meta: m,
          key: vs.key,
          p
        });
        for (const k in p) (dom[k] = dom[k] || new Set()).add(p[k]);
      }
    }
    const list = [...seen.values()],
      props = Object.keys(dom).filter(k => dom[k].size > 1);
    const r = list.length && props.length ? {
      list,
      props
    } : null;
    c.set(id, r);
    return r;
  }
  // [the state's properties, all its states (each with .p), the meta for a state] of a block without a state list
  function legacyState(id, meta) {
    const S = metaStates(id);
    if (!S) return null;
    const vs = vanillaState(BLOCKS[id], meta, null);
    const cur = S.list.find(e => e.meta === meta) || S.list.find(e => e.key === vs.key && Object.keys(e.p).every(k => vs.p[k] === undefined || String(vs.p[k]) === e.p[k]));
    if (!cur) return null;
    const list = S.list.filter(e => e.key === cur.key),
      st = {};
    for (const k of S.props) if (k in cur.p && new Set(list.map(e => e.p[k])).size > 1) st[k] = cur.p[k];
    return [st, list.map(e => Object.assign({}, e.p)), (k, v) => {
      const e = list.find(e => e.p[k] === v && Object.keys(st).every(o => o === k || e.p[o] === st[o]));
      return e ? e.meta : meta;
    }];
  }
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    const p = this.player,
      t = this.target,
      held = p.inv.held;
    // (an id not in ITEMS in the hand - telemetry 11-02/03, 'reading key': using anything threw here)
    if (held && ITEMS[held.id] && ITEMS[held.id].key === 'debug_stick' && t && !this.targetEntity && !this.net) {
      const w = this.world,
        [x, y, z] = t.pos,
        id = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
        b = BLOCKS[id];
      const L = !b.states && legacyState(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z));
      const st = L ? L[0] : b.states && b.states[w.getMeta(x, y, z)];
      if (!st || !Object.keys(st).length) {
        this.ui.actionBar = {
          text: 'minecraft:' + b.key + ' 没有属性',
          t: performance.now()
        };
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      const props = Object.keys(st);
      held.dbg = held.dbg || {};
      let k = held.dbg[b.key] && props.includes(held.dbg[b.key]) ? held.dbg[b.key] : props[0];
      if (p.sneaking) {
        k = props[(props.indexOf(k) + 1) % props.length];
        held.dbg[b.key] = k;
        this.ui.actionBar = {
          text: '已选择“' + k + '”（' + st[k] + '）',
          t: performance.now()
        };
        p.swing();
        return;
      }
      const vals = [...new Set((L ? L[1] : b.states).map(s => s[k]))];
      const nv = vals[(vals.indexOf(st[k]) + 1) % vals.length];
      w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, L ? L[2](k, nv) : Features.withProp(id, w.getMeta(x, y, z), k, nv));
      held.dbg[b.key] = k;
      this.ui.actionBar = {
        text: '“' + k + '”设为' + nv,
        t: performance.now()
      };
      this.flushMesh && this.flushMesh();
      p.swing();
      return;
    }
    return _use.call(this);
  };
})();
