        this.blockEntities.delete(be.pos.join(','));
        continue;
      }
      const on = lit(w, x, y, z, id);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const s = be.items[i];
        if (!s) continue;
        const rec = COOKING.campfire_cooking[s.id];
        if (!on) {
          be.times[i] = Math.max(0, be.times[i] - 2);
          continue;
        }
        if (++be.times[i] >= (rec ? rec.time : 600)) {
          be.items[i] = null;
          be.times[i] = 0;
          if (rec) this.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 1, z + 0.5, {
            id: rec.result,
            count: 1,
            dmg: 0
          }, [0, 0.1, 0]);
          this.markBlockEntity(be);
        }
      }
    }
    // (the lit ones near the player, found per chunk like the spawners)
    if (!CAMP.length || !p) return;
    const px = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
      pz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]);
    for (let cx = (px >> 4) - 2; cx <= (px >> 4) + 2; cx++) for (let cz = (pz >> 4) - 2; cz <= (pz >> 4) + 2; cz++) {
      const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
      if (!ch) continue;
      if (!ch.campfires || this.tickCount - ch.campfiresT > 100) {
        ch.campfires = [];
        ch.campfiresT = this.tickCount;
        ch.findAll(CAMP, i => ch.campfires.push([cx * 16 + (i & 15), i >> 8, cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15)]));
      }
      for (const [x, y, z] of ch.campfires) {
        const id = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
        if (!isCamp(id) || !lit(w, x, y, z, id)) continue;
        if (Math.random() < 0.12) this.particles.spawn('smoke', x + 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4, y + 0.6, z + 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4, 0, 0.07, 0);
        const P = p.pos;
        if (P[0] > x - 0.3 && P[0] < x + 1.3 && P[2] > z - 0.3 && P[2] < z + 1.3 && P[1] >= y && P[1] < y + 0.7 && !p.creative && p.deathTime === 0) p.hurt(BLOCKS[id].key === 'soul_campfire' ? 2 : 1, {
          type: 'fire'
        });
      }
    }
  };
  // the food on top: flat, one in each corner, turned to the campfire's sides (vanilla CampfireRenderer)
  const _dc = Game.prototype.drawChests;
  Game.prototype.drawChests = function (a, env) {
    const r = _dc.call(this, a, env);
    if (!this.blockEntities) return r;
    const p = this.player,
      w = this.world;
    for (const be of this.blockEntities.values()) {
      if (be.type !== 'campfire' || !be.items.some(Boolean)) continue;
      const [x, y, z] = be.pos;
      if (Math.abs(x - p.pos[0]) > 48 || Math.abs(z - p.pos[2]) > 48 || !isCamp(w.getBlock(x, y, z))) continue;
      const l = w.getLight(x, y + 1, z),
        L = [(l >> 4) / 15, Math.max(l & 15, 13) / 15];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const s = be.items[i];
        if (!s) continue;
        const m = M4.create();
        M4.translate(m, x + 0.5, y + 0.45, z + 0.5);
        M4.rotY(m, -i * Math.PI / 2);
        M4.translate(m, -0.3125, 0, -0.3125);
        M4.rotX(m, -Math.PI / 2);
        M4.scale(m, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75);
        this.drawItemFixed(s, m, L, env);
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- shulker boxes and the ender chest: neither opened at all ("潜影盒、末影箱打不开", feedback 2026-11-01/02). A
// shulker box keeps its 27 slots in the item when broken (stack.sb) and gets them back when placed; the ender chest
// is the player's own 27 slots in this world (worldMeta.ender), the same from every ender chest. Sneaking still
// places a block against them, as vanilla ----
(() => {
  const SHULKER = new Set(BLOCKS.map((b, i) => b && /(^|_)shulker_box$/.test(b.key) ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0));
  const ENDER = BLOCKS.findIndex(b => b && b.key === 'ender_chest');
  const itemOf = id => ITEM_KEY[BLOCKS[id].key];
  const _use = Game.prototype.use;
  Game.prototype.use = function () {
    const p = this.player,
      t = this.target;
    if (t && !this.targetEntity && !this.net && !this.p2pGuest && !p.sneaking && (SHULKER.has(t.id) || ENDER >= 0 && t.id === ENDER)) {
      const [x, y, z] = t.pos,
        b = BLOCKS[t.id],
        c = [x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5];
      if (t.id === ENDER) {
        const m = this.worldMeta,
          slots = m.ender || (m.ender = new Array(27).fill(null));
        this.ui.open(new ChestScreen(this, [{
          type: 'ender',
          pos: [x, y, z],
          slots
        }], b.cn));
        Sound.ev('block.ender_chest.open', c, 0.5, 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1);
      } else {
        this.ui.open(new ChestScreen(this, [this.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'chest')], b.cn));
        Sound.ev('block.shulker_box.open', c, 0.5, 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1);
      }
      p.swing();
      return;
    }
    // a shulker box placed from an item with contents: they go into its block entity
    const held = p.inv.held,
      sb = held && held.sb;
    const r = _use.call(this);
    if (sb && t && !this.net) {
      const D = DIRS[t.face] || [0, 0, 0];
      for (const [x, y, z] of [[t.pos[0] + D[0], t.pos[1] + D[1], t.pos[2] + D[2]], t.pos]) {
        if (!SHULKER.has(this.world.getBlock(x, y, z))) continue;
        const be = this.getBlockEntity(x, y, z, 'chest');
        if (!be.slots.some(Boolean)) {
          be.slots = sb.map(s => s ? {
            ...s
          } : null);
          while (be.slots.length < 27) be.slots.push(null);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
  // broken (by hand, in a blast): the box drops with what it holds
  const _dl = Game.prototype.dropBlockLoot;
  Game.prototype.dropBlockLoot = function (x, y, z, id, meta, tool) {
    if (!SHULKER.has(id) || itemOf(id) === undefined) return _dl.call(this, x, y, z, id, meta, tool);
    const k = x + ',' + y + ',' + z,
      be = this.blockEntities.get(k),
      st = makeStack(itemOf(id), 1);
    if (be && be.slots && be.slots.some(Boolean)) st.sb = be.slots.map(s => s ? {
      ...s
    } : null);
    this.blockEntities.delete(k);
    this.dropItem(x + 0.5, y + 0.3, z + 0.5, st);
  };
  // (creative: no loot, but a box that holds something still drops, as vanilla)
  const _bb = Game.prototype.breakBlock;
  Game.prototype.breakBlock = function (x, y, z, natural, silent) {
    const id = this.world.getBlock(x, y, z);
    if (SHULKER.has(id) && this.mode === 'creative' && !natural && !this.net) {
      const be = this.blockEntities.get(x + ',' + y + ',' + z);
      if (be && be.slots && be.slots.some(Boolean)) this.dropBlockLoot(x, y, z, id, this.world.getMeta(x, y, z), null);
    }
    return _bb.call(this, x, y, z, natural, silent);
  };
})();

// ---- anvils and concrete powder fall, as vanilla (FallingBlock) - "铁砧不会下落", feedback 2026-11-01/02 ----
for (const b of BLOCKS) if (b && (/^(chipped_|damaged_)?anvil$/.test(b.key) || /_concrete_powder$/.test(b.key))) b.gravity = true;
// (the wandering trader walks at 0.35 of its 0.7 speed, as vanilla's goals ask - at the full 0.7 it ran three times a
// villager's pace and snapped its llamas' leads: "流浪商人跑得比闪电侠还快", feedback 2026-11-01/02)
if (typeof MOB_TYPES !== 'undefined' && MOB_TYPES.wandering_trader && MOB_TYPES.wandering_trader.speed > 0.5) MOB_TYPES.wandering_trader.speed = 0.245;

// ---- bubble columns: the bubbles themselves (vanilla's bubble_column_up / whirlpool particles) - they only pushed,
// nothing showed, "灵魂沙上面没有气泡柱", feedback 2026-11-01/02. Soul sand and magma blocks under water near the
// player, found per chunk now and then ----
(() => {
  const _tick = Game.prototype.tickFurnaces;
  Game.prototype.tickFurnaces = function () {
    _tick.call(this);
    const p = this.player,
      w = this.world;
    if (!p || BID.soul_sand === undefined || BID.magma_block === undefined) return;
    const px = Math.floor(p.pos[0]),
      pz = Math.floor(p.pos[2]),
      ids = [BID.soul_sand, BID.magma_block];
    for (let cx = (px >> 4) - 1; cx <= (px >> 4) + 1; cx++) for (let cz = (pz >> 4) - 1; cz <= (pz >> 4) + 1; cz++) {
      const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
      if (!ch) continue;
      if (!ch.bubbleSrc || this.tickCount - ch.bubbleSrcT > 100) {
        ch.bubbleSrc = [];
        ch.bubbleSrcT = this.tickCount;
        ch.findAll(ids, i => {
          const x = cx * 16 + (i & 15),
            y = i >> 8,
            z = cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15);
          if (w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z) === WATER) ch.bubbleSrc.push([x, y, z]);
        });
      }
      for (const [x, y, z] of ch.bubbleSrc) {
        if (Math.abs(x - px) > 24 || Math.abs(z - pz) > 24 || Math.random() > 0.5) continue;
        const up = w.getBlock(x, y, z) === BID.soul_sand;
        let top = y + 1;
        while (top < y + 64 && w.getBlock(x, top + 1, z) === WATER && w.getMeta(x, top + 1, z) === 0) top++;
        if (!w.bubbleColumnAt(x, y + 1, z)) continue;
        const yy = y + 1 + Math.random() * (top - y);
        this.particles.spawn('bubble', x + 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4, yy, z + 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4, 0, up ? 0.12 : -0.08, 0);
      }
    }
  };
})();

// ---- fluids in a newly generated chunk that have somewhere to go (springs in cave walls, aquifer edges, lava in
// ravines): their flow is scheduled, as vanilla's spring feature and aquifers do - they stood still until something
// next to them changed, "新区块的水和岩浆不流动", feedback 2026-11-01/02. Sections without a fluid are skipped ----
(() => {
  const _fc = Game.prototype.finishChunk;
  Game.prototype.finishChunk = function (ch, saved) {
    const r = _fc.call(this, ch, saved);
    if (saved || this.net || this.p2pGuest || !ch || !ch.bs) return r;
    const w = this.world,
      x0 = ch.cx * 16,
      z0 = ch.cz * 16;
    const at = (x, y, z) => {
      if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return -1;
      const lx = x - x0,
        lz = z - z0;
      return lx >= 0 && lx < 16 && lz >= 0 && lz < 16 ? ch.getB(y << 8 | lz << 4 | lx) : w.isLoaded(x, z) ? w.getBlock(x, y, z) : -1;
    };
    const free = (x, y, z) => {
      const id = at(x, y, z);
      return id === 0 || id > 0 && !!REPLACEABLE[id] && !IS_FLUID[id] && !WLOG[id];
    };
    const wet = (x, y, z) => {
      const id = at(x, y, z);
      return id === WATER || id > 0 && !!WLOG[id];
    };
    // (lava touching water - a ruined portal's in a lake or a river - is ticked too, past the cap: it has nowhere free
    // to flow, so it stayed lava in the water, "水里废弃传送门的岩浆不变黑曜石")
    let n = 0;
    for (let si = 0; si < ch.bs.length; si++) {
      const s = ch.bs[si];
      if (!s || !s.p.some(id => IS_FLUID[id])) continue;
      const both = s.p.includes(LAVA) && s.p.includes(WATER); // (lava and water in the section)
      if (n >= 400 && !both) continue;
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096 && (n < 400 || both); j++) {
        const i = si << 12 | j,
          id = ch.getB(i);
        if (!IS_FLUID[id]) continue;
        const y = i >> 8,
          x = x0 + (i & 15),
          z = z0 + (i >> 4 & 15);
        if (n < 400 && (free(x, y - 1, z) || free(x + 1, y, z) || free(x - 1, y, z) || free(x, y, z + 1) || free(x, y, z - 1))) {
          w.schedule(x, y, z, id === WATER ? 5 : 30);
          n++;
        } else if (both && id === LAVA && (wet(x, y + 1, z) || wet(x + 1, y, z) || wet(x - 1, y, z) || wet(x, y, z + 1) || wet(x, y, z - 1))) w.schedule(x, y, z, 2);
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- pointed dripstone has a collision shape, as vanilla's (by its thickness; the tip short at the free end) - it had
// none, things passed through it: "滴水石锥没有碰撞", feedback 2026-11-01/02 ----
(() => {
  const id = BLOCKS.findIndex(b => b && b.key === 'pointed_dripstone');
  if (id < 0) return;
  const b = BLOCKS[id],
    W = {
      tip_merge: 5,
      tip: 5,
      frustum: 4,
      middle: 3,
      base: 2
    };
  b.solid = true;
  b.collide = m => {
    var _W$st$thickness;
    const st = b.states && b.states[m] || {},
      a = (_W$st$thickness = W[st.thickness]) !== null && _W$st$thickness !== void 0 ? _W$st$thickness : 3,
      e = 16 - a;
    if (st.thickness === 'tip') return st.vertical_direction === 'up' ? [[a, 0, a, e, 11, e]] : [[a, 5, a, e, 16, e]];
    return [[a, 0, a, e, 16, e]];
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/raids.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Raids (vanilla Raid / Raids / BadOmenMobEffect / RaidOmenMobEffect). A player with Bad Omen who walks into a
// village gets Raid Omen for 30 seconds instead; when it runs out a raid starts there (or one already there takes
// the omen, up to level 5). A red boss bar counts 15 seconds down, then waves of illagers come from about 64 blocks
// out, each announced by the raid horn: 3 / 5 / 7 waves on easy / normal / hard, and a bonus wave when the omen level
// is over 1. Each wave's first raider is its captain; ravagers of the later waves carry a pillager, evoker or
// vindicator. Raiders head for the village and attack villagers, golems and players. Every wave beaten -> Hero of the
// Village (omen level, 40 minutes) for each player who killed a raider; the village gone (no bed, bell or job site
// left near the raid) -> defeat. Single player only: on a server the server runs its raids.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const RAID_MAX_OMEN = 5,
  RAID_COOLDOWN = 300;
// Raid.RaiderType: how many of each come in waves 1-7 (index 0 unused; the bonus wave uses the index of the last)
const RAIDER_WAVES = [['vindicator', [0, 0, 2, 0, 1, 4, 2, 5]], ['evoker', [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2]], ['pillager', [0, 4, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 2]], ['witch', [0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 1]], ['ravager', [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 2]]];
const RAIDER_TYPES = new Set(RAIDER_WAVES.map(r => r[0]).concat(['illusioner']));
const raidGroups = d => d === 1 ? 3 : d === 3 ? 7 : 5;

// ---- villages: the point-of-interest blocks (beds, bells, job sites) -------------------------------------------
let VILLAGE_POI = null;
function villagePoi() {
  if (VILLAGE_POI) return VILLAGE_POI;
  const ids = [];
  for (const b of BLOCKS) if (b && (/_bed$/.test(b.key) || b.key === 'bell' || typeof JOB_SITES !== 'undefined' && JOB_SITES[b.key])) ids.push(b.id);
  return VILLAGE_POI = ids;
}
// does this 16-block section hold a village point of interest
function sectionHasPoi(w, cx, sy, cz) {
  const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz),
    b = ch && ch.bs && ch.bs[sy],
    ids = villagePoi();
  if (!b) return false;
  if (b.n >= 0) {
    let any = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < b.n; k++) if (ids.includes(b.p[k])) {
      any = true;
      break;
    }
    if (!any) return false;
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) if (ids.includes(b.p[b.d[j]])) return true;
  return false;
}
// vanilla ServerLevel.isVillage: a point of interest in this section or one next to it
function isVillage(g, x, y, z) {
  const w = g.world,
    cx = x >> 4,
    sy = y >> 4,
    cz = z >> 4;
  for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
    if (sy + dy < 0 || sy + dy >= SECTIONS) continue;
    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) if (sectionHasPoi(w, cx + dx, sy + dy, cz + dz)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
// the village points of interest within r blocks
function poiNear(g, x, y, z, r) {
  const w = g.world,
    ids = villagePoi(),
    out = [];
  for (let cx = x - r >> 4; cx <= x + r >> 4; cx++) for (let cz = z - r >> 4; cz <= z + r >> 4; cz++) {
    const ch = w.getChunk(cx, cz);
    if (!ch) continue;
    ch.findAll(ids, i => {
      const px = cx * 16 + (i & 15),
        py = i >> 8,
        pz = cz * 16 + (i >> 4 & 15);
      if ((px - x) ** 2 + (py - y) ** 2 + (pz - z) ** 2 <= r * r) out.push([px, py, pz]);
    });
  }
  return out;
}
class Raid {
  constructor(g, center) {
    this.g = g;
    this.center = center;
    this.omen = 0;
    this.groups = 0;
    this.numGroups = raidGroups(g.difficulty);
    this.cooldown = RAID_COOLDOWN;
    this.status = 'ongoing';
    this.ticksActive = 0;
    this.started = false;
    this.stopped = false;
    this.postTicks = 0;
    this.celebT = 0;
    this.raiders = new Set();
    this.heroes = new Set();
    this.totalHealth = 0;
    this.spawnPos = null;
    this.name = '袭击';
    this.progress = 0;
    this.visible = true;
  }
  save() {
    return {
      c: this.center,
      o: this.omen,
      gs: this.groups,
      n: this.numGroups,
      cd: this.cooldown,
      s: this.status,
      ta: this.ticksActive,
      st: this.started,
      pt: this.postTicks,
      ct: this.celebT,
      th: this.totalHealth
    };
  }
  static load(g, d) {
    const r = new Raid(g, d.c);
    Object.assign(r, {
      omen: d.o,
      groups: d.gs,
      numGroups: d.n,
      cooldown: d.cd,
      status: d.s,
      ticksActive: d.ta,
      started: d.st,
      postTicks: d.pt,
      celebT: d.ct,
      totalHealth: d.th
    });
    r.adopt = true;
    return r;
  }
  get over() {
    return this.status === 'victory' || this.status === 'loss';
  }
  alive() {
    let n = 0;
    for (const e of this.raiders) if (!e.dead && !e.deathTime) n++;
    return n;
  }
  health() {
    let h = 0;
    for (const e of this.raiders) if (!e.dead && !e.deathTime) h += e.health;
    return h;
  }
  hasBonus() {
    return this.omen > 1;
  }
  hasMoreWaves() {
    return this.hasBonus() ? this.groups <= this.numGroups : this.groups !== this.numGroups;
  }
  shouldSpawnBonus() {
    return this.groups === this.numGroups && this.alive() === 0 && this.hasBonus();
  }
  shouldSpawnGroup() {
    return this.cooldown === 0 && (this.groups < this.numGroups || this.shouldSpawnBonus()) && this.alive() === 0;
  }
  stop() {
    this.stopped = true;
    for (const e of this.raiders) e.raid = null;
    this.raiders.clear();
  }
  absorbOmen(p) {
    const amp = p.effectAmp('raid_omen');
    if (amp < 0) return false;
    this.omen = clamp(this.omen + amp + 1, 0, RAID_MAX_OMEN);
    return true;
  }
  tick() {
    const g = this.g;
    if (this.stopped) return;
    // (a saved raid: its raiders, saved as plain mobs, found again around it)
    if (this.adopt) {
      this.adopt = false;
      for (const e of g.entities) if (RAIDER_TYPES.has(e.type) && !e.dead && e.distTo && Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - this.center[0], e.pos[2] - this.center[2]) < 112) this.join(e, this.groups);
    }
    if (this.status === 'ongoing') {
      if (g.difficulty === 0) {
        this.stop();
        return;
      }
      this.visible = g.world.isLoaded(this.center[0], this.center[2]);
      if (!this.visible) return;
      if (!isVillage(g, ...this.center)) {
        // vanilla moveRaidCenterToNearbyVillageSection: the nearest village section within two
        const [x, y, z] = this.center;
        let best = null,
          bd = Infinity;
        for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
          const sx = x + dx * 16,
            sy = y + dy * 16,
            sz = z + dz * 16;
          if (sy < 0 || sy >= HEIGHT || !sectionHasPoi(g.world, sx >> 4, sy >> 4, sz >> 4)) continue;
          const d = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
          if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            best = [sx, sy, sz];
          }
        }
        if (best) this.center = best;else if (this.groups > 0) this.status = 'loss';else {
          this.stop();
          return;
        }
      }
      if (++this.ticksActive >= 48000) {
        this.stop();
        return;
      }
      const alive = this.alive();
      if (alive === 0 && this.hasMoreWaves()) {
        if (this.cooldown > 0) {
          if (!this.spawnPos && this.cooldown % 5 === 0) this.spawnPos = this.findSpawn();
          this.cooldown--;
          this.progress = clamp((RAID_COOLDOWN - this.cooldown) / RAID_COOLDOWN, 0, 1);
        } else if (this.groups > 0) {
          this.cooldown = RAID_COOLDOWN;
          this.name = '袭击';
          return;
        }
      }
      if (this.ticksActive % 20 === 0) {
        for (const e of [...this.raiders]) if (e.dead) this.raiders.delete(e);
        this.name = alive > 0 && alive <= 2 ? `袭击 - 剩余${alive}名袭击者` : '袭击';
      }
      if (alive > 0 && this.totalHealth > 0) this.progress = clamp(this.health() / this.totalHealth, 0, 1);
      let horn = false;
      for (let i = 0; this.shouldSpawnGroup(); i++) {
        const pos = this.spawnPos || this.findSpawn();
        if (pos) {
          this.started = true;
          this.spawnGroup(pos);
          if (!horn) {
            this.horn(pos);
            horn = true;
          }
        } else i++;
        if (i > 5) {
          this.stop();
          return;
        }
      }
      if (this.started && !this.hasMoreWaves() && this.alive() === 0) {
        if (this.postTicks < 40) this.postTicks++;else {
          this.status = 'victory';
          for (const h of this.heroes) if (!h.dead && h.deathTime === 0 && !h.spectator) h.addEffect('hero_of_the_village', this.omen - 1, 48000);
        }
      }
      this.raidersTick();
    } else if (this.over) {
      if (++this.celebT >= 600) {
        this.stop();
        return;
      }
      if (this.celebT % 20 === 0) {
        if (this.status === 'victory') {
          this.progress = 0;
          this.name = '袭击 - 胜利';
        } else this.name = '袭击 - 失败';
      }
      this.raidersTick();
    }
  }
  // vanilla findRandomSpawnPos: around the village 64 blocks out (32 and then right at the village if that fails),
  // on top of the ground in a loaded spot outside the village (except the last try)
  findSpawn() {
    const g = this.g,
      w = g.world,
      [cx, cy, cz] = this.center;
    for (let m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
      const f = m === 0 ? 2 : 2 - m;
      for (let t = 0; t < 20; t++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const x = cx + Math.floor(Math.cos(a) * 32 * f) + randInt(0, 4),
          z = cz + Math.floor(Math.sin(a) * 32 * f) + randInt(0, 4);
        if (!w.isLoaded(x, z) || !w.isLoaded(x + 10, z + 10) || !w.isLoaded(x - 10, z - 10)) continue;
        let y = HEIGHT - 1;
        while (y > 0 && !w.getBlock(x, y, z)) y--;
        const top = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)];
        if (!top || !top.solid || Math.abs(y + 1 - cy) > 96) continue;
        if (BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)].solid || BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y + 2, z)].solid) continue;
        if (!isVillage(g, x, y + 1, z) || m >= 2) return [x, y + 1, z];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  // vanilla getPotentialBonusSpawns
  bonusSpawns(type, wave, bonus) {
    const d = this.g.difficulty,
      easy = d === 1,
      normal = d === 2;
    let i;
    if (type === 'witch') {
      if (easy || wave <= 2 || wave === 4) return 0;
      i = 1;
    } else if (type === 'vindicator' || type === 'pillager') i = easy ? randInt(0, 1) : normal ? 1 : 2;else if (type === 'ravager') i = !easy && bonus ? 1 : 0;else return 0;
    return i > 0 ? randInt(0, i) : 0;
  }
  spawnGroup(pos) {
    const g = this.g,
      wave = this.groups + 1,
      bonus = this.shouldSpawnBonus();
    let leader = false;
    this.totalHealth = 0;
    const make = type => {
      const e = createMob(g, type, pos[0] + 0.5, pos[1], pos[2] + 0.5);
      if (!e) return null;
      g.entities.push(e);
      this.join(e, wave);
      return e;
    };
    for (const [type, counts] of RAIDER_WAVES) {
      const n = counts[bonus ? this.numGroups : wave] + this.bonusSpawns(type, wave, bonus);
      let k = 0;
      for (let l = 0; l < n; l++) {
        const e = make(type);
        if (!e) continue;
        if (!leader && type !== 'witch' && type !== 'ravager') {
          e.raidLeader = true;
          leader = true;
        }
        if (type === 'ravager') {
          // (the waves when ravagers carry a raider)
          const rider = wave === raidGroups(2) ? 'pillager' : wave >= raidGroups(3) ? k === 0 ? 'evoker' : 'vindicator' : null;
          k++;
          if (rider) {
            const r = make(rider);
            if (r) {
              r.raidMount = e;
              e.raidRider = r;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    this.spawnPos = null;
    this.groups++;
  }
  join(e, wave) {
    e.raid = this;
    e.raidWave = wave;
    e.persistent = true;
    this.raiders.add(e);
    this.totalHealth += e.maxHealth || e.health || 0;
  }
  // the raid horn, heard by every player near the raid from the direction of the wave (vanilla playSound)
  horn(pos) {
    const p = this.g.player,
      dx = pos[0] - p.pos[0],
      dz = pos[2] - p.pos[2],
      d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - this.center[0], p.pos[2] - this.center[2]) > 96 && d > 64) return;
    const k = d > 13 ? 13 / d : 1;
    Sound.ev('event.raid.horn', [p.pos[0] + dx * k, p.pos[1] + 1.6, p.pos[2] + dz * k], 64, 1);
  }
  // ravagers' passengers ride along
  raidersTick() {
    for (const e of this.raiders) {
      const m = e.raidMount;
      if (!m) continue;
      if (m.dead || m.deathTime || e.dead) {
        e.raidMount = null;
        e.riding = false;
        continue;
      }
      e.riding = true;
      e.pos = [m.pos[0], m.pos[1] + m.h - 0.6 + 0.0625, m.pos[2]];
      e.prev = [...e.pos];
      e.vel = [0, 0, 0];
      e.fallDist = 0;
      if (!e.target) {
        e.yaw = m.yaw;
        e.bodyYaw = m.bodyYaw;
      }
    }
  }
}

// ---- the game's raids -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the raid around a point (vanilla getRaidAt: the nearest within 96 blocks)
Game.prototype.raidAt = function (x, y, z) {
  let best = null,
    bd = 96 * 96;
  for (const r of this.raids || []) {
    if (r.stopped) continue;
    const d = (r.center[0] - x) ** 2 + (r.center[1] - y) ** 2 + (r.center[2] - z) ** 2;
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      best = r;
    }
  }
  return best;
};
// vanilla Raids.createOrExtendRaid: centred on the village's points of interest within 64 blocks
Game.prototype.createOrExtendRaid = function (p, pos) {
  if (p.spectator || this.dim !== 'overworld' || this.net || !this.rule('raids')) return null;
  const poi = poiNear(this, pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], 64);
  const center = poi.length ? [0, 1, 2].map(i => Math.floor(poi.reduce((s, q) => s + q[i], 0) / poi.length)) : [...pos];
  let raid = this.raidAt(...center);
  if (!raid) {
    raid = new Raid(this, center);
    (this.raids || (this.raids = [])).push(raid);
  }
  if (!raid.started || raid.omen < RAID_MAX_OMEN) raid.absorbOmen(p);
  return raid;
};
// the boss bars of the raids the player is in (vanilla: within 96 blocks of the centre)
Game.prototype.raidBars = function () {
  const p = this.player,
    out = [];
  if (!p || this.dim !== 'overworld') return out;
  for (const r of this.raids || []) if (!r.stopped && r.visible && Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - r.center[0], p.pos[1] - r.center[1], p.pos[2] - r.center[2]) < 96) out.push({
    name: r.name,
    progress: r.progress,
    color: 'red',
    notch: 10
  });
  return out;
};
(() => {
  // Bad Omen in a village becomes Raid Omen; Raid Omen running out starts the raid where it was taken
  const _te = Living.prototype.tickEffects;
  Living.prototype.tickEffects = function () {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this === g.player && this.effects && this.effects.size && !g.net && g.dim === 'overworld' && !this.spectator) {
      const ro = this.effects.get('raid_omen');
      if (ro && ro.dur === 1) {
        g.createOrExtendRaid(this, this.raidOmenPos || this.pos.map(Math.floor));
        this.raidOmenPos = null;
        this.removeEffect('raid_omen');
      }
      const bo = this.effects.get('bad_omen');
      if (bo && g.difficulty > 0 && (g.tickCount + 7) % 10 === 0) {
        const bp = this.pos.map(Math.floor);
        if (isVillage(g, ...bp)) {
          const raid = g.raidAt(...bp);
          if (!raid || raid.omen < RAID_MAX_OMEN) {
            this.removeEffect('bad_omen');
            this.addEffect('raid_omen', bo.amp, 600);
            this.raidOmenPos = bp;
            Sound.ev('event.mob_effect.raid_omen', this.pos, 1, 1);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return _te.call(this);
  };
  // the raids go on with the world (single player, the overworld, not while paused)
  const _tick = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function () {
    const r = _tick.call(this);
    if (this.raids && this.raids.length && !this.net && this.state === 'play' && !(this.ui.screen && this.ui.screen.pauses) && this.dim === 'overworld') {
      for (const raid of this.raids) this.guard('raid', () => raid.tick());
      this.raids = this.raids.filter(r => !r.stopped);
    }
    return r;
  };
  // whoever kills a raider is a hero of the village if the raid is won
  // (Living.die: both kinds of mob come through it)
  const _die = Living.prototype.die;
  Living.prototype.die = function (src) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (this.raid && src && (src.attacker === g.player || src.player)) this.raid.heroes.add(g.player);
    return _die.call(this, src);
  };
  // raiders not fighting head for the village (vanilla PathfindToRaidGoal: 15 blocks at a time)
  VMob.prototype.raidGoal = function (c) {
    const r = this.raid;
    if (!r || r.stopped || r.over || this.raidMount) return false;
    const dx = r.center[0] + 0.5 - this.pos[0],
      dz = r.center[2] + 0.5 - this.pos[2],
      d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d < 12) return false;
    const k = Math.min(1, 15 / d);
    c.goal = [this.pos[0] + dx * k, r.center[1], this.pos[2] + dz * k];
    c.mod = 1;
    return true;
  };
  // saved with the world
  const _save = Game.prototype.saveWorld;
  Game.prototype.saveWorld = function (quiet) {
    if (this.worldMeta && this.state === 'play') this.worldMeta.raids = (this.raids || []).filter(r => !r.stopped).map(r => r.save());
    return _save.call(this, quiet);
  };
  const _load = Game.prototype.loadWorld;
  Game.prototype.loadWorld = async function (id) {
    this.raids = [];
    const r = await _load.call(this, id);
    const m = this.worldMeta;
    this.raids = m && Array.isArray(m.raids) ? m.raids.map(d => Raid.load(this, d)) : [];
    return r;
  };
})();

// ---- patrols (vanilla PatrolSpawner): from the fifth day on, by day, about every 10-11 minutes a one-in-five chance
// of a pillager patrol 24-48 blocks from the player (not in a village): a captain and as many again as the
// difficulty (easy 1, normal 2, hard 3 more). A captain (patrol or raid wave leader) drops an ominous bottle, Bad
// Omen I-V (its loot table, vmobs.js) - how a player comes to start a raid
Game.prototype.patrolTick = function () {
  if (this.net || this.dim !== 'overworld' || this.difficulty === 0 || !this.rule('spawn_patrols')) return;
  if (this.patrolNext === undefined) this.patrolNext = 12000;
  if (--this.patrolNext > 0) return;
  this.patrolNext += 12000 + randInt(0, 1199);
  const day = Math.floor(this.worldTime / 24000),
    tod = (this.worldTime % 24000 + 24000) % 24000;
  if (day < 5 || tod >= 12000 || randInt(0, 4) !== 0) return;
  const p = this.player,
    w = this.world;
  if (p.spectator || p.deathTime > 0) return;
  const pp = p.pos.map(Math.floor);
  // (vanilla isCloseToVillage(pos, 2): no patrols starting inside a village)
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) if (isVillage(this, pp[0] + dx * 16, pp[1], pp[2] + dz * 16)) return;
  let x = pp[0] + (24 + randInt(0, 23)) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    z = pp[2] + (24 + randInt(0, 23)) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  if (!w.isLoaded(x - 10, z - 10) || !w.isLoaded(x + 10, z + 10)) return;
  const n = Math.ceil([0, 0.75, 1.5, 2.25][this.difficulty]) + 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let y = HEIGHT - 1;
    while (y > 0 && (!w.getBlock(x, y, z) || /leaves$/.test(BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)].key))) y--;
    const below = BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y, z)];
    if (below && below.solid && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y + 1, z)].solid && !BLOCKS[w.getBlock(x, y + 2, z)].solid && (w.getLight(x, y + 1, z) & 15) <= 8) {
      const e = createMob(this, 'pillager', x + 0.5, y + 1, z + 0.5);
      if (e) {
        if (i === 0) e.patrolLeader = true;
        this.entities.push(e);
      }
    } else if (i === 0) return;
    x += randInt(0, 4) - randInt(0, 4);
    z += randInt(0, 4) - randInt(0, 4);
  }
};
(() => {
  const _tick = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function () {
    const r = _tick.call(this);
    if (!this.net && this.state === 'play' && !(this.ui.screen && this.ui.screen.pauses)) this.guard('patrols', () => this.patrolTick());
    return r;
  };
  // the captain stays a captain in a saved world
  const _sv = VMob.prototype.saveData,
    _ld = VMob.prototype.loadData;
  if (_sv && _ld) {
    VMob.prototype.saveData = function () {
      const d = _sv.call(this);
      if (this.patrolLeader && d) d.pl = 1;
      return d;
    };
    VMob.prototype.loadData = function (d) {
      _ld.call(this, d);
      if (d && d.pl) this.patrolLeader = true;
    };
  }
})();
</script>

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Commands in single player, in vanilla's syntax: target selectors (@s @p @a @r @e with type= name= distance= limit=
// sort= x= y= z= dx= dy= dz= tag=), coordinates (absolute, ~relative, ^local), block states (oak_stairs[facing=east]),

};

// a game rule's value in this world (the default when never set)
Game.prototype.rule = function (k) {
  const r = this.gameRules;
  return r && r[k] !== undefined ? r[k] : GAME_RULES[k];

// ---- reading arguments --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// words, keeping [...] {...} and "..." together
function cmdWords(s) {
  const out = [];
  let cur = '',
    depth = 0,
    q = false;
  for (const c of s) {
    if (q) {
      cur += c;
      if (c === '"') q = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '"') {
      q = true;
      cur += c;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '[' || c === '{') depth++;
    if (c === ']' || c === '}') depth--;
    if (c === ' ' && depth <= 0) {
      if (cur) out.push(cur);
      cur = '';
      continue;
    }
    cur += c;
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur);
  return out;
}
const stripNs = s => String(s || '').replace(/^minecraft:/, '');
const vanillaY = g => g.world && g.world.minY || 0;
// a position from three words (absolute, ~relative to the source, ^local along its view): internal coordinates
function cmdPos(ctx, a, b, c, centre = false) {
  if ([a, b, c].some(w => w === undefined)) cmdFail('坐标不完整（需要 x y z）');
  const g = ctx.g,
    ws = [a, b, c];
  if (ws.some(w => w[0] === '^')) {
    if (!ws.every(w => w[0] === '^')) cmdFail('不能混用世界坐标和局部坐标（^）');
    const [l, u, f] = ws.map(w => parseFloat(w.slice(1)) || 0),
      y = ctx.rot[0],
      p = ctx.rot[1];
    const F = [-Math.sin(y) * Math.cos(p), Math.sin(p), -Math.cos(y) * Math.cos(p)],
      L = [-Math.cos(y), 0, Math.sin(y)];
    const U = [F[1] * L[2] - F[2] * L[1], F[2] * L[0] - F[0] * L[2], F[0] * L[1] - F[1] * L[0]];
    return [0, 1, 2].map(i => ctx.pos[i] + L[i] * l + U[i] * u + F[i] * f);
  }
  return ws.map((w, i) => {
    if (w[0] === '~') return ctx.pos[i] + (parseFloat(w.slice(1)) || 0);
    const v = parseFloat(w);
    if (isNaN(v)) cmdFail('无效的坐标：' + w);
    // (a whole number for x or z means the middle of that block, like vanilla's Vec3Argument)
    return i === 1 ? v - vanillaY(g) : v + (centre && i !== 1 && !w.includes('.') ? 0.5 : 0);
  });
}
const cmdBlockPos = (ctx, a, b, c) => cmdPos(ctx, a, b, c).map(Math.floor);
function cmdInt(w, name, min = -Infinity, max = Infinity) {
  const v = Number(w);
  if (!Number.isInteger(v)) cmdFail(`${name}应为整数，实际为 ${w}`);
  if (v < min) cmdFail(`${name}不能小于 ${min}，实际为 ${v}`);
  if (v > max) cmdFail(`${name}不能大于 ${max}，实际为 ${v}`);
  return v;
}
// ticks from a time argument: 100, 100t, 5s, 1d
function cmdTime(w) {
  const m = /^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([tsd]?)$/.exec(String(w || ''));
  if (!m) cmdFail('无效的时间：' + w);
  return Math.round(parseFloat(m[1]) * {
    '': 1,
    t: 1,
    s: 20,
    d: 24000
  }[m[2]]);
}
// a block and its state: oak_stairs[facing=east,half=top] -> [id, meta]
function cmdBlock(w) {
  var _BID$key;
  const m = /^(?:minecraft:)?([a-z0-9_]+)(?:\[(.*)\])?$/.exec(String(w || ''));
  if (!m) cmdFail('无效的方块：' + w);
  const key = m[1];
  if (key === 'air' || key === 'cave_air' || key === 'void_air') return [0, 0];
  const alias = typeof STATE_ALIAS !== 'undefined' ? STATE_ALIAS[key] : undefined,
    id = (_BID$key = BID[key]) !== null && _BID$key !== void 0 ? _BID$key : BID[alias];
  if (id === undefined) cmdFail('未知的方块：' + key);
  const b = BLOCKS[id];
  // blocks with vanilla's state list: each property checked; the older hand-made ones (stairs, slabs ...) and the
  // default state: the world importer's mapping (terrain2.js)
  if (m[2] && b.states) {
    let meta = typeof mapVanillaState === 'function' && (mapVanillaState(key) || [])[1] || 0;
    for (const kv of m[2].split(',')) {
      const [k, v] = kv.split('=').map(q => q.trim());
      if (!k) continue;
      if (!b.states.some(st => k in st)) cmdFail(`方块 ${key} 没有属性 ${k}`);
      const nm = Features.withProp(id, meta, k, v);
      if (!b.states[nm] || b.states[nm][k] !== v) cmdFail(`方块 ${key} 的属性 ${k} 不能为 ${v}`);
      meta = nm;
    }
    return [id, meta];
  }
  const r = typeof mapVanillaState === 'function' ? mapVanillaState(key + (m[2] ? '[' + m[2] + ']' : '')) : null;
  return r || [id, 0];
}
// an item: diamond_sword[enchantments={sharpness:5}] -> a stack of 1 (the enchantments and a custom name are read)
function cmdItem(w) {
  const m = /^(?:minecraft:)?([a-z0-9_]+)(?:\[(.*)\])?$/.exec(String(w || ''));
  if (!m || ITEM_KEY[m[1]] === undefined) cmdFail('未知的物品：' + stripNs(w));
  const st = {
    id: ITEM_KEY[m[1]],
    count: 1,
    dmg: 0
  };
  if (m[2]) {
    const en = /enchantments=\{([^}]*)\}/.exec(m[2]);
    if (en) st.e = en[1].split(',').map(kv => kv.split(':').map(s => s.trim().replace(/"/g, ''))).filter(kv => kv.length >= 2).map(kv => kv.length === 3 ? [kv[1], +kv[2]] : [stripNs(kv[0]), +kv[1]]).filter(([k]) => typeof ENCH === 'undefined' || ENCH[k]);
    const nm = /custom_name=(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')/.exec(m[2]);
    if (nm) st.name = nm[1] || nm[2];
  }
  return st;
}
// the type name selectors use
function cmdType(e) {
  if (e instanceof Player) return 'player';
  if (typeof ItemEntity !== 'undefined' && e instanceof ItemEntity) return 'item';
  if (typeof ExperienceOrb !== 'undefined' && e instanceof ExperienceOrb) return 'experience_orb';
  if (e.type) return String(e.type);
  return e.constructor.name.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1_$2').toLowerCase();
}
const cmdName = (g, e) => e === g.player ? g.playerName || '玩家' : e.customName || e.T && e.T.cn || (typeof ItemEntity !== 'undefined' && e instanceof ItemEntity && e.stack ? ITEMS[e.stack.id].cn : cmdType(e));
// a selector's arguments: split at the commas outside {} [] and quotes
function cmdSplitArgs(s) {
  const out = [];
  let cur = '',
    depth = 0,
    q = false;
  for (const c of s) {
    if (q) {
      cur += c;
      if (c === '"') q = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '"') {
      q = true;
      cur += c;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '[' || c === '{') depth++;
    if (c === ']' || c === '}') depth--;
    if (c === ',' && depth === 0) {
      out.push(cur);
      cur = '';
      continue;
    }
    cur += c;
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur);
  return out;
}
// a range: 5, ..5, 5.., 1..5
function cmdRange(s) {
  s = String(s);
  const num = v => {
    const n = parseFloat(v);
    if (isNaN(n)) cmdFail('无效的范围：' + s);
    return n;
  };
  if (!s.includes('..')) {
    const v = num(s);
    return [v, v];
  }
  const [a, b] = s.split('..');
  return [a === '' ? -Infinity : num(a), b === '' ? Infinity : num(b)];
}
// entities picked by a selector or a name
function cmdTargets(ctx, w, opts = {}) {
  const g = ctx.g,
    p = g.player;
  if (w === undefined) cmdFail('缺少目标');
  if (w[0] !== '@') {
    // a name: the player's, or an entity with that custom name / UUID-less id
    const byName = g.entities.filter(e => !e.dead && e.customName === w);
    if (byName.length) return byName;
    if (opts.entities === false || w === (g.playerName || '') || /^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,16}$/.test(w)) return [p];
    cmdFail('未找到实体');
  }
  const m = /^@([parse])(?:\[(.*)\])?$/.exec(w);
  if (!m) cmdFail('无效的选择器：' + w);
  const kind = m[1],
    args = {};
  if (m[2]) for (const kv of cmdSplitArgs(m[2])) {
    const i = kv.indexOf('=');
    if (i < 0) continue;
    const k = kv.slice(0, i).trim(),
      v = kv.slice(i + 1).trim();
    (args[k] || (args[k] = [])).push(v);
  }
  const one = k => args[k] && args[k][0];
  if (kind === 's') {
    const s = ctx.src ? ctx.entity : ctx.entity || p;
    return s ? filterTargets(ctx, [s], args) : [];
  }
  let list = kind === 'e' ? [p, ...g.entities.filter(e => !e.dead && !(e.deathTime > 0))] : [p];
  list = filterTargets(ctx, list, args);
  const org = ['x', 'y', 'z'].map((k, i) => one(k) !== undefined ? i === 1 ? parseFloat(one(k)) - vanillaY(g) : parseFloat(one(k)) : ctx.pos[i]);
  const dist = e => Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - org[0], e.pos[1] - org[1], e.pos[2] - org[2]);
  const sort = one('sort') || (kind === 'p' ? 'nearest' : kind === 'r' ? 'random' : 'arbitrary');
  if (sort === 'nearest') list.sort((a, b) => dist(a) - dist(b));else if (sort === 'furthest') list.sort((a, b) => dist(b) - dist(a));else if (sort === 'random') list.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
  const lim = one('limit') !== undefined ? cmdInt(one('limit'), 'limit', 1) : kind === 'p' || kind === 'r' ? 1 : Infinity;
  return list.slice(0, lim);
}
function filterTargets(ctx, list, args) {
  const g = ctx.g;
  const one = k => args[k] && args[k][0];
  const org = ['x', 'y', 'z'].map((k, i) => one(k) !== undefined ? i === 1 ? parseFloat(one(k)) - vanillaY(g) : parseFloat(one(k)) : ctx.pos[i]);
  for (const t of args.type || []) {
    const neg = t[0] === '!',
      want = stripNs(neg ? t.slice(1) : t);
    list = list.filter(e => cmdType(e) === want !== neg);
  }
  for (const t of args.name || []) {
    const neg = t[0] === '!',
      want = (neg ? t.slice(1) : t).replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
    list = list.filter(e => cmdName(g, e) === want !== neg);
  }
  for (const t of args.tag || []) {
    const neg = t[0] === '!',
      want = neg ? t.slice(1) : t;
    list = list.filter(e => (want === '' ? !!(e.tags && e.tags.size) : !!(e.tags && e.tags.has(want))) !== neg);
  }
  if (one('distance')) {
    const [lo, hi] = cmdRange(one('distance'));
    list = list.filter(e => {
      const d = Math.hypot(e.pos[0] - org[0], e.pos[1] - org[1], e.pos[2] - org[2]);
      return d >= lo && d <= hi;
    });
  }
  if (['dx', 'dy', 'dz'].some(k => one(k) !== undefined)) {
    const d = ['dx', 'dy', 'dz'].map(k => parseFloat(one(k)) || 0);
    const lo = org.map((v, i) => Math.min(v, v + d[i])),
      hi = org.map((v, i) => Math.max(v, v + d[i]) + 1);
    list = list.filter(e => {
      const b = e.box ? e.box() : [e.pos[0], e.pos[1], e.pos[2], e.pos[0], e.pos[1], e.pos[2]];
      return b[0] < hi[0] && b[3] > lo[0] && b[1] < hi[1] && b[4] > lo[1] && b[2] < hi[2] && b[5] > lo[2];
    });
  }
  for (const t of args.gamemode || []) {
    const neg = t[0] === '!',
      want = neg ? t.slice(1) : t;
    list = list.filter(e => (e instanceof Player && g.mode === want) !== neg);
  }
  if (one('level')) {
    const [lo, hi] = cmdRange(one('level'));
    list = list.filter(e => e instanceof Player && g.xpLevel() >= lo && g.xpLevel() <= hi);
  }
  return list;
}
const needTargets = list => {
  if (!list.length) cmdFail('未找到实体');
  return list;
};
const needPlayers = list => {
  list = list.filter(e => e instanceof Player);
  if (!list.length) cmdFail('未找到玩家');
  return list;
};

// ---- the commands -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const MODE_CN = {
  survival: '生存模式',
  creative: '创造模式',
  spectator: '旁观模式',
  adventure: '冒险模式'
};
const DIFF_NAMES = ['peaceful', 'easy', 'normal', 'hard'],
  DIFF_CN = ['和平', '简单', '普通', '困难'];
function cmdMode(w) {
  const m = {
    survival: 'survival',
    s: 'survival',
    0: 'survival',
    creative: 'creative',
    c: 'creative',
    1: 'creative',
    adventure: 'adventure',
    a: 'adventure',
    2: 'adventure',
    spectator: 'spectator',
    sp: 'spectator',
    3: 'spectator'
  }[w];
  if (!m) cmdFail('未知的游戏模式：' + w);
  // (adventure mode isn't a mode of its own here: survival)
  return m === 'adventure' ? 'survival' : m;
}
// removes a block entity left where a block was replaced
function cmdSetBlock(g, x, y, z, id, meta) {
  const w = g.world,
    k = `${x},${y},${z}`;
  if (g.blockEntities && g.blockEntities.has(k)) g.blockEntities.delete(k);
  // vanilla /setblock and /fill don't check the placed block itself (a lone door half stays, the other half can
  // follow); its neighbours still get their update, and sand still falls
  g.cmdPlaced = k;
  try {
    w.setBlock(x, y, z, id, meta);
  } finally {
    g.cmdPlaced = null;
  }
}
const CMD_RUN = {
  help() {
    this.ui.open(new CommandHelpScreen(this));
  },
  seed(ctx) {
    ctx.say('种子：[' + (this.worldMeta ? this.worldMeta.seed : this.world.seed) + ']', '#FFFFFF', true);
  },
  list(ctx) {
    ctx.say(`当前共有 1 名玩家在线（最大玩家数为 1）：${this.playerName || '玩家'}`, '#FFFFFF', true);
  },
  gamemode(ctx, a) {
    if (!a[0]) cmdFail('用法：/gamemode <模式> [目标]');
    const m = cmdMode(a[0]),
      ts = a[1] ? needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[1])) : [this.player];
    // (setMode tells the player itself)
    if (m === this.mode) cmdFail('游戏模式未改变');
    this.setMode(m);
  },
  defaultgamemode(ctx, a) {
    const m = cmdMode(a[0]);
    if (this.worldMeta) this.worldMeta.defaultMode = m;
    ctx.say(`默认游戏模式现在为${MODE_CN[m]}`);
  },
  difficulty(ctx, a) {
    if (!a[0]) {
      ctx.say(`难度为${DIFF_CN[this.difficulty]}`, '#FFFFFF', true);
      return;
    }
    const d = DIFF_NAMES.indexOf(a[0]) >= 0 ? DIFF_NAMES.indexOf(a[0]) : ['0', '1', '2', '3'].indexOf(a[0]);
    if (d < 0) cmdFail('无效的难度：' + a[0]);
    if (this.hardcore) cmdFail('极限模式下不能修改难度');
    if (d === this.difficulty) cmdFail(`难度未改变，它已被设置为${DIFF_CN[d]}`);
    this.difficulty = d;
    ctx.say(`难度已被设置为${DIFF_CN[d]}`);
  },
  time(ctx, a) {
    const named = {
      day: 1000,
      noon: 6000,
      night: 13000,
      midnight: 18000,
      sunrise: 23000,
      sunset: 12000
    };
    if (a[0] === 'set' || a[0] === 'add') {
      var _named$a$;
      const v = (_named$a$ = named[a[1]]) !== null && _named$a$ !== void 0 ? _named$a$ : cmdTime(a[1]);
      if (a[0] === 'set') this.worldTime = Math.floor(this.worldTime / 24000) * 24000 + v;else this.worldTime += v;
      ctx.say('已将时间设为 ' + (this.worldTime % 24000 + 24000) % 24000);
    } else if (a[0] === 'query') {
      const t = a[1] === 'gametime' ? this.tickCount : a[1] === 'day' ? Math.floor(this.worldTime / 24000) : (this.worldTime % 24000 + 24000) % 24000;
      ctx.say('时间是 ' + t, '#FFFFFF', true);
    } else cmdFail('用法：/time set|add|query …');
  },
  weather(ctx, a) {
    const dur = a[1] ? cmdTime(a[1]) : null;
    if (a[0] === 'clear') {
      this.rainTarget = 0;
      this.weather = 0;
      this.thunder = false;
      this.weatherTimer = dur !== null && dur !== void 0 ? dur : 12000 + Math.random() * 168000;
      ctx.say('天气已设为晴天');
    } else if (a[0] === 'rain') {
      this.rainTarget = 1;
      this.weather = 1;
      this.thunder = false;
      this.weatherTimer = dur !== null && dur !== void 0 ? dur : 12000 + Math.random() * 12000;
      ctx.say('天气已设为雨天');
    } else if (a[0] === 'thunder') {
      this.rainTarget = 1;
      this.weather = 1;
      this.thunder = true;
      this.weatherTimer = dur !== null && dur !== void 0 ? dur : 3600 + Math.random() * 12000;
      ctx.say('天气已设为雷暴');
    } else cmdFail('用法：/weather clear|rain|thunder [时长]');
  },
  give(ctx, a) {
    // (/give <item> [count] still works, as it did here before)
    let ts, iw, cw;
    if (a[0] && (a[0][0] === '@' || ITEM_KEY[stripNs(a[0]).replace(/\[.*$/, '')] === undefined && a[1])) {
      ts = needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
      iw = a[1];
      cw = a[2];
    } else {
      ts = [this.player];
      iw = a[0];
      cw = a[1];
    }
    const st = cmdItem(iw),
      n = cw !== undefined ? cmdInt(cw, '数量', 1, 6400) : 1,
      p = this.player;
    let left = n;
    while (left > 0) {
      const k = Math.min(left, maxStack(st.id));
      const r = p.inv.add({
        ...st,
        count: k
      });
      if (r) this.dropFromPlayer({
        ...st,
        count: r
      });
      left -= k;
    }
    ctx.say(`已将 ${n} 个 [${ITEMS[st.id].cn}] 给予 ${cmdName(this, p)}`);
  },
  clear(ctx, a) {
    const ts = a[0] ? needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0])) : [this.player],
      st = a[1] ? cmdItem(a[1]) : null,
      max = a[2] !== undefined ? cmdInt(a[2], '数量', 0) : Infinity;
    const p = this.player;
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.inv.slots.length && n < max; i++) {
      const s = p.inv.slots[i];
      if (!s || st && s.id !== st.id) continue;
      const k = Math.min(s.count, max - n);
      n += k;
      if (max !== 0) {
        s.count -= k;
        if (!s.count) p.inv.slots[i] = null;
      }
    }
    if (!n) cmdFail(`未在 ${cmdName(this, p)} 身上找到物品`);
    ctx.say(max === 0 ? `在 ${cmdName(this, p)} 身上找到了 ${n} 个匹配的物品` : `已从 ${cmdName(this, p)} 移除 ${n} 个物品`);
  },
  tp(ctx, a) {
    // /tp <destination> | <x y z> [yaw pitch] | <targets> <destination> | <targets> <x y z> [yaw pitch]
    let ts,
      dest = null,
      rot = null;
    const isPos = w => w !== undefined && /^[~^]?-?[\d.]*$/.test(w);
    if (a.length === 1) {
      ts = [ctx.entity || this.player];
      dest = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]))[0];
    } else if (a.length >= 3 && isPos(a[0]) && isPos(a[1]) && isPos(a[2])) {
      ts = [ctx.entity || this.player];
      dest = cmdPos(ctx, a[0], a[1], a[2], true);
      if (a[3] !== undefined) rot = [a[3], a[4]];
    } else if (a.length === 2) {
      ts = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
      dest = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[1]))[0];
    } else if (a.length >= 4) {
      ts = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
      dest = cmdPos(ctx, a[1], a[2], a[3], true);
      if (a[4] !== undefined) rot = [a[4], a[5]];
    } else cmdFail('用法：/tp <目标> | <x> <y> <z>');
    const to = Array.isArray(dest) ? dest : [...dest.pos];
    for (const e of ts) {
      if (e.vehicle && e.dismount) e.dismount();
      e.pos = [...to];
      e.prev = [...to];
      if (e.vel) e.vel = [0, 0, 0];
      e.fallDist = 0;
      if (!Array.isArray(dest)) {
        e.yaw = dest.yaw;
        e.pitch = dest.pitch;
      }
      if (rot) {
        const ry = (w, cur) => w === undefined ? cur : w[0] === '~' ? cur + (parseFloat(w.slice(1)) || 0) : parseFloat(w);
        // (vanilla yaw: 0 south, 90 west; here 0 is north, radians)
        if (rot[0] !== undefined) e.yaw = rot[0][0] === '~' ? e.yaw - (parseFloat(rot[0].slice(1)) || 0) * Math.PI / 180 : Math.PI - parseFloat(rot[0]) * Math.PI / 180;
        if (rot[1] !== undefined) e.pitch = -ry(rot[1], -e.pitch * 180 / Math.PI) * Math.PI / 180;
      }
    }
    const shown = to.map((v, i) => (v + (i === 1 ? vanillaY(this) : 0)).toFixed(2)).join(', ');
    ctx.say(ts.length === 1 ? `已将 ${cmdName(this, ts[0])} 传送至 ${Array.isArray(dest) ? shown : cmdName(this, dest)}` : `已将 ${ts.length} 个实体传送至 ${Array.isArray(dest) ? shown : cmdName(this, dest)}`);
  },
  summon(ctx, a) {
    const t = stripNs(a[0]);
    if (!t) cmdFail('用法：/summon <实体> [x y z]');
    const pos = a[1] !== undefined ? cmdPos(ctx, a[1], a[2], a[3], true) : (() => {
      const p = this.player,
        d = this.lookDir();
      return [p.pos[0] + d[0] * 3, p.pos[1] + 0.5, p.pos[2] + d[2] * 3];
    })();
    let e = null;
    if (t === 'tnt') e = new PrimedTNT(this, Math.floor(pos[0]), pos[1], Math.floor(pos[2]));else if (t === 'lightning_bolt') {
      this.strikeLightning(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
      ctx.say('已召唤新的闪电');
      return;
    } else if (t === 'ender_dragon') e = new EnderDragon(this, pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);else if (t === 'experience_orb' && typeof ExperienceOrb !== 'undefined') {
      this.dropXp(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], 1);
      ctx.say('已召唤新的经验球');
      return;
    } else if (MOB_TYPES[t]) {
      e = createMob(this, t, pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
      if (e) e.persistent = true;
    }
    if (!e) cmdFail('无法召唤实体：' + t);
    const nm = /CustomName:"([^"]*)"|CustomName:'([^']*)'/.exec(a.slice(4).join(' '));
    if (nm) e.customName = nm[1] || nm[2];
    if (/NoAI:1b|NoAI:true/.test(a.slice(4).join(' '))) e.noAI = true;
    this.addEntity(e);
    ctx.say('已召唤新的' + cmdName(this, e));
  },
  kill(ctx, a) {
    const ts = needTargets(a[0] ? cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]) : [ctx.entity || this.player]);
    let n = 0;
    for (const e of ts) {
      if (e === this.player) {
        if (this.mode === 'creative' || this.mode === 'spectator') {
          e.health = 0;
          e.die({
            type: 'void'
          });
        } else e.hurt(Infinity, {
          type: 'void',
          bypass: true
        });
        n++;
        continue;
      }
      if (typeof EnderDragon !== 'undefined' && e instanceof EnderDragon) {
        if (e.deathTime === 0) {
          e.health = 0;
          e.deathTime = 1;
          Sound.ev('entity.ender_dragon.death', e.pos, 10, 1);
          n++;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (e instanceof Living) {
        if (e.deathTime === 0) {
          e.health = 0;
          e.die({
            type: 'void'
          });
          n++;
        }
      } else {
        e.dead = true;
        n++;
      }
    }
    ctx.say(n === 1 ? `已清除 ${cmdName(this, ts[0])}` : `已清除 ${n} 个实体`);
  },
  effect(ctx, a) {
    if (a[0] === 'clear') {
      const ts = needTargets(a[1] ? cmdTargets(ctx, a[1]) : [this.player]).filter(e => e instanceof Living),
        k = a[2] ? stripNs(a[2]) : null;
      if (k && !EFFECTS[k]) cmdFail('未知的状态效果：' + k);
      let n = 0;
      for (const e of ts) {
        if (k) {
          if (e.hasEffect(k)) {
            e.removeEffect(k);
            n++;
          }
        } else if (e.effects && e.effects.size) {
          e.clearEffects();
          n++;
        }
      }
      if (!n) cmdFail('目标没有可移除的效果');
      ctx.say(k ? `已移除 ${ts.length === 1 ? cmdName(this, ts[0]) : ts.length + ' 个目标'} 的 ${EFFECTS[k].cn} 效果` : `已移除 ${ts.length === 1 ? cmdName(this, ts[0]) : ts.length + ' 个目标'} 的所有效果`);
      return;
    }
    if (a[0] !== 'give') cmdFail('用法：/effect give <目标> <效果> [秒数] [等级] [隐藏粒子]  或  /effect clear [目标] [效果]');
    const ts = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[1])).filter(e => e instanceof Living),
      k = stripNs(a[2]);
    if (!EFFECTS[k]) cmdFail('未知的状态效果：' + k);
    const instant = k === 'instant_health' || k === 'instant_damage';
    const secs = a[3] === 'infinite' ? -1 : a[3] !== undefined ? cmdInt(a[3], '秒数', 1, 1000000) : instant ? 1 : 30;
    const amp = a[4] !== undefined ? cmdInt(a[4], '等级', 0, 255) : 0,
      hide = a[5] === 'true';
    let n = 0;
    for (const e of ts) {
      e.addEffect(k, amp, secs < 0 ? -1 : instant ? 1 : secs * 20, false);
      const fx = e.effects && e.effects.get(k);
      if (fx && hide) fx.hidden = true;
      n++;
    }
    if (!n) cmdFail('无法应用此效果（目标对效果免疫，或已有更强的效果）');
    ctx.say(`已将 ${EFFECTS[k].cn} 效果应用于 ${ts.length === 1 ? cmdName(this, ts[0]) : ts.length + ' 个目标'}`);
  },
  enchant(ctx, a) {
    const ts = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0])),
      k = stripNs(a[1]),
      E = ENCH[k];
    if (!E) cmdFail('未知的魔咒：' + k);
    const lvl = a[2] !== undefined ? cmdInt(a[2], '等级', 1) : 1;
    if (lvl > E.max) cmdFail(`${lvl} 级超过了该魔咒支持的最高等级 ${E.max}`);
    const p = this.player,
      st = p.inv.held;
    if (!st) cmdFail(`${cmdName(this, p)} 手上没有物品`);
    if (!E.sup.has(st.id) && ITEMS[st.id].key !== 'book') cmdFail(`${ITEMS[st.id].cn} 不支持该魔咒`);
    const cn = q => typeof NET_ENCH_CN !== 'undefined' && NET_ENCH_CN[q] || q;
    for (const [ek] of st.e || []) if (ek !== k && !enchCompatible(ek, k)) cmdFail(`${cn(k)} 与物品上已有的 ${cn(ek)} 冲突`);
    st.e = [...(st.e || []).filter(([ek]) => ek !== k), [k, lvl]];
    ctx.say(`已将魔咒 ${cn(k)}${E.max === 1 ? '' : ' ' + romanNum(lvl)} 施加于 ${cmdName(this, p)} 的物品上`);
  },
  xp(ctx, a) {
    // (/xp <amount> still works, as before)
    if (a[0] !== undefined && /^-?\d+L?$/i.test(a[0])) {
      const v = parseInt(a[0]);
      if (/L$/i.test(a[0])) a = ['add', '@s', String(v), 'levels'];else a = ['add', '@s', String(v)];
    }
    const op = a[0],
      p = this.player;
    if (!['add', 'set', 'query'].includes(op)) cmdFail('用法：/xp add|set|query <目标> [数量] [points|levels]');
    needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[1] || '@s'));
    const levels = (op === 'query' ? a[2] : a[3]) === 'levels';
    if (op === 'query') {
      ctx.say(levels ? `${cmdName(this, p)} 拥有 ${this.xpLevel()} 级经验` : `${cmdName(this, p)} 拥有 ${p.xp - this.xpTotalFor(this.xpLevel())} 点经验`, '#FFFFFF', true);
      return;
    }
    const n = cmdInt(a[2], '数量');
    const before = this.xpLevel();
    if (levels) {
      const target = op === 'add' ? Math.max(0, before + n) : Math.max(0, n),
        into = p.xp - this.xpTotalFor(before);
      p.xp = this.xpTotalFor(target) + Math.min(into, this.xpNeeded(target) - 1);
    } else if (op === 'add') p.xp = Math.max(0, p.xp + n);else {
      if (n > this.xpNeeded(before)) cmdFail('经验点数不能超过玩家当前等级所需的点数');
      p.xp = this.xpTotalFor(before) + Math.max(0, n);
    }
    if (this.xpLevel() > before) Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', p.pos, 0.75, 1);
    ctx.say(op === 'add' ? `已给予 ${cmdName(this, p)} ${n} ${levels ? '级' : '点'}经验` : `已将 ${cmdName(this, p)} 的经验${levels ? '等级' : '点数'}设为 ${n}`);
  },
  setblock(ctx, a) {
    const [x, y, z] = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[0], a[1], a[2]),
      [id, meta] = cmdBlock(a[3]),
      mode = a[4] || 'replace',
      w = this.world;
    if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT || !w.isLoaded(x, z)) cmdFail('该位置尚未加载');
    const old = w.getBlock(x, y, z);
    if (mode === 'keep' && old) cmdFail('无法放置方块');
    if (old === id && w.getMeta(x, y, z) === meta) cmdFail('无法放置方块');
    if (mode === 'destroy' && old) {
      this.dropBlockLoot(x, y, z, old, w.getMeta(x, y, z), null);
      this.particles.blockBreak(x, y, z, old, w.getMeta(x, y, z));
    }
    cmdSetBlock(this, x, y, z, id, meta);
    this.flushMesh();
    ctx.say(`已更改位于 ${x}, ${y + vanillaY(this)}, ${z} 的方块`);
  },
  fill(ctx, a) {
    const A = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[0], a[1], a[2]),
      B = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[3], a[4], a[5]),
      [id, meta] = cmdBlock(a[6]);
    const mode = a[7] || 'replace',
      filter = mode === 'replace' && a[8] ? cmdBlock(a[8]) : null,
      w = this.world;
    const lo = A.map((v, i) => Math.min(v, B[i])),
      hi = A.map((v, i) => Math.max(v, B[i]));
    const vol = (hi[0] - lo[0] + 1) * (hi[1] - lo[1] + 1) * (hi[2] - lo[2] + 1),
      max = this.rule('max_block_modifications');
    if (vol > max) cmdFail(`指定区域内的方块太多（最大值为 ${max}，指定值为 ${vol}）`);
    if (lo[1] < 0 || hi[1] >= HEIGHT) cmdFail('该位置超出了世界的范围');
    for (let x = lo[0]; x <= hi[0]; x += 16) for (let z = lo[2]; z <= hi[2]; z += 16) if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) cmdFail('该位置尚未加载');
    if (!w.isLoaded(hi[0], hi[2])) cmdFail('该位置尚未加载');
    let n = 0;
    for (let x = lo[0]; x <= hi[0]; x++) for (let y = lo[1]; y <= hi[1]; y++) for (let z = lo[2]; z <= hi[2]; z++) {
      const edge = x === lo[0] || x === hi[0] || y === lo[1] || y === hi[1] || z === lo[2] || z === hi[2];
      const old = w.getBlock(x, y, z),
        om = w.getMeta(x, y, z);
      let nid = id,
        nm = meta;
      if (mode === 'outline' && !edge) continue;
      if (mode === 'hollow' && !edge) {
        nid = 0;
        nm = 0;
      }
      if (mode === 'keep' && old) continue;
      if (filter && (old !== filter[0] || a[8].includes('[') && om !== filter[1])) continue;
      if (old === nid && om === nm) continue;
      if (mode === 'destroy' && old) this.dropBlockLoot(x, y, z, old, om, null);
      cmdSetBlock(this, x, y, z, nid, nm);
      n++;
    }
    if (!n) cmdFail('没有方块被填充');
    this.flushMesh();
    ctx.say(`成功填充了 ${n} 个方块`);
  },
  clone(ctx, a) {
    const A = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[0], a[1], a[2]),
      B = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[3], a[4], a[5]),
      D = cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[6], a[7], a[8]),
      w = this.world;
    const mask = a[9] || 'replace',
      flow = a[10] || 'normal';
    const lo = A.map((v, i) => Math.min(v, B[i])),
      hi = A.map((v, i) => Math.max(v, B[i])),
      size = hi.map((v, i) => v - lo[i] + 1);
    const vol = size[0] * size[1] * size[2],
      max = this.rule('max_block_modifications');
    if (vol > max) cmdFail(`指定区域内的方块太多（最大值为 ${max}，指定值为 ${vol}）`);
    if (lo[1] < 0 || hi[1] >= HEIGHT || D[1] < 0 || D[1] + size[1] > HEIGHT) cmdFail('该位置超出了世界的范围');
    for (const [x, z] of [[lo[0], lo[2]], [hi[0], hi[2]], [D[0], D[2]], [D[0] + size[0] - 1, D[2] + size[2] - 1]]) if (!w.isLoaded(x, z)) cmdFail('该位置尚未加载');
    const overlap = [0, 1, 2].every(i => D[i] <= hi[i] && D[i] + size[i] - 1 >= lo[i]);
    if (overlap && flow !== 'force') cmdFail('源区域和目标区域不能重叠');
    const copy = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < size[0]; x++) for (let y = 0; y < size[1]; y++) for (let z = 0; z < size[2]; z++) {
      const sx = lo[0] + x,
        sy = lo[1] + y,
        sz = lo[2] + z,
        id = w.getBlock(sx, sy, sz);
      if (mask === 'masked' && !id) continue;
      if (mask === 'filtered' && a[11] && id !== cmdBlock(a[11])[0]) continue;
      const be = this.blockEntities && this.blockEntities.get(`${sx},${sy},${sz}`);
      copy.push([x, y, z, id, w.getMeta(sx, sy, sz), be ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(be)) : null, sx, sy, sz]);
    }
    if (flow === 'move') for (const c of copy) cmdSetBlock(this, c[6], c[7], c[8], 0, 0);
    let n = 0;
    for (const [x, y, z, id, meta, be] of copy) {
      const tx = D[0] + x,
        ty = D[1] + y,
        tz = D[2] + z;
      if (ty < 0 || ty >= HEIGHT) continue;
      cmdSetBlock(this, tx, ty, tz, id, meta);
      if (be && this.blockEntities) {
        be.pos = [tx, ty, tz];
        this.blockEntities.set(`${tx},${ty},${tz}`, be);
      }
      n++;
    }
    this.flushMesh();
    ctx.say(`成功复制了 ${n} 个方块`);
  },
  gamerule(ctx, a) {
    if (!a[0]) cmdFail('用法：/gamerule <规则> [值]');
    const k = RULE_ALIAS[a[0]] || stripNs(a[0]);
    if (!(k in GAME_RULES)) cmdFail('未知的游戏规则：' + a[0]);
    if (a[1] === undefined) {
      ctx.say(`游戏规则 ${k} 目前为：${this.rule(k)}`, '#FFFFFF', true);
      return;
    }
    const def = GAME_RULES[k];
    let v;
    if (typeof def === 'boolean') {
      if (a[1] !== 'true' && a[1] !== 'false') cmdFail('应为 true 或 false');
      v = a[1] === 'true';
    } else v = cmdInt(a[1], '值', 0);
    (this.gameRules || (this.gameRules = {}))[k] = v;
    ctx.say(`游戏规则 ${k} 已被设置为：${v}`);
  },
  spawnpoint(ctx, a) {
    const p = this.player;
    const pos = a[1] !== undefined ? cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[1], a[2], a[3]) : p.pos.map(Math.floor);
    if (a[0]) needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
    p.spawn = pos;
    p.bedSpawn = false;
    if (this.dim !== 'overworld') p.spawnDim = this.dim;
    ctx.say(`已将 ${cmdName(this, p)} 的重生点设置为 (${pos[0]}, ${pos[1] + vanillaY(this)}, ${pos[2]})`);
  },
  setworldspawn(ctx, a) {
    const pos = a[0] !== undefined ? cmdBlockPos(ctx, a[0], a[1], a[2]) : this.player.pos.map(Math.floor);
    if (this.worldMeta) this.worldMeta.spawn = pos;
    ctx.say(`已将世界重生点设置为 (${pos[0]}, ${pos[1] + vanillaY(this)}, ${pos[2]})`);
  },
  say(ctx, a) {
    if (!a.length) cmdFail('用法：/say <消息>');
    this.ui.message(`[${ctx.name || this.playerName || '玩家'}] ${a.join(' ')}`);
  },
  me(ctx, a) {
    this.ui.message(`* ${ctx.name || this.playerName || '玩家'} ${a.join(' ')}`);
  },
  msg(ctx, a) {
    if (a.length < 2) cmdFail('用法：/msg <玩家> <消息>');
    needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
    const t = a.slice(1).join(' ');
    this.ui.message(`你悄悄地对 ${this.playerName || '玩家'} 说：${t}`, '#AAAAAA');
    this.ui.message(`${this.playerName || '玩家'} 悄悄地对你说：${t}`, '#AAAAAA');
  },
  tellraw(ctx, a) {
    needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
    const j = a.slice(1).join(' ');
    let comp;
    try {
      comp = JSON.parse(j);
    } catch (e) {
      comp = j.replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
    }
    const parts = [];
    const walk = (c, color) => {
      if (c == null) return;
      if (typeof c === 'string' || typeof c === 'number' || typeof c === 'boolean') {
        parts.push([String(c), color]);
        return;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(c)) {
        c.forEach(x => walk(x, color));
        return;
      }
      const col = c.color && (CMD_COLORS[c.color] || (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(c.color) ? c.color : null)) || color;
      if (c.text !== undefined) parts.push([String(c.text), col]);else if (c.translate) parts.push([c.translate, col]);
      for (const x of c.extra || []) walk(x, col);
    };
    walk(comp, '#FFFFFF');
    // (one colour per line here: the first part's)
    this.ui.message(parts.map(x => x[0]).join(''), parts[0] && parts[0][1] || '#FFFFFF');
  },
  title(ctx, a) {
    needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]));
    const ui = this.ui,
      op = a[1];
    const text = () => {
      const j = a.slice(2).join(' ');
      try {
        var _c$text;
        const c = JSON.parse(j);
        return typeof c === 'string' ? c : Array.isArray(c) ? c.map(x => {
          var _x$text;
          return (_x$text = x.text) !== null && _x$text !== void 0 ? _x$text : x;
        }).join('') : ((_c$text = c.text) !== null && _c$text !== void 0 ? _c$text : '') + (c.extra || []).map(x => {
          var _x$text2;
          return (_x$text2 = x.text) !== null && _x$text2 !== void 0 ? _x$text2 : x;
        }).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        return j.replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
      }
    };
    const t = ui.titleState || (ui.titleState = {
      fadeIn: 10,
      stay: 70,
      fadeOut: 20
    });
    if (op === 'title') {
      t.title = text();
      t.start = this.tickCount;
      if (t.sub === undefined) t.sub = '';
    } else if (op === 'subtitle') t.sub = text();else if (op === 'actionbar') ui.actionBar = {
      text: text(),
      t: performance.now()
    };else if (op === 'clear') {
      t.title = null;
    } else if (op === 'reset') {
      ui.titleState = {
        fadeIn: 10,
        stay: 70,
        fadeOut: 20
      };
    } else if (op === 'times') {
      t.fadeIn = cmdTime(a[2]);
      t.stay = cmdTime(a[3]);
      t.fadeOut = cmdTime(a[4]);
    } else cmdFail('用法：/title <目标> title|subtitle|actionbar|clear|reset|times …');
    ctx.say(op === 'times' ? '已更改标题显示时间' : op === 'clear' ? '已清除标题' : op === 'reset' ? '已重置标题选项' : '已显示标题');
  },
  playsound(ctx, a) {
    const s = stripNs(a[0]);
    if (!s) cmdFail('用法：/playsound <声音> [来源] [目标] [x y z] [音量] [音调]');
    if (a[2]) needPlayers(cmdTargets(ctx, a[2]));
    const pos = a[3] !== undefined ? cmdPos(ctx, a[3], a[4], a[5], true) : [...this.player.pos];
    const vol = a[6] !== undefined ? parseFloat(a[6]) : 1,
      pitch = a[7] !== undefined ? parseFloat(a[7]) : 1;
    if (!Sound.ev(s, pos, vol, pitch) && typeof SOUND_EVENTS !== 'undefined' && !SOUND_EVENTS[s]) cmdFail('未知的声音：' + s);
    ctx.say(`已向 ${cmdName(this, this.player)} 播放声音 ${s}`);
  },
  stopsound(ctx) {
    if (Sound.stopAll) Sound.stopAll();
    ctx.say('已停止所有声音');
  },
  particle(ctx, a) {
    const name = stripNs(a[0]);
    if (!name) cmdFail('用法：/particle <粒子> [x y z] [dx dy dz] [速度] [数量]');
    const pos = a[1] !== undefined ? cmdPos(ctx, a[1], a[2], a[3], true) : [...this.player.pos];
    const d = [a[4], a[5], a[6]].map(v => parseFloat(v) || 0),
      speed = parseFloat(a[7]) || 0,
      count = a[8] !== undefined ? cmdInt(a[8], '数量', 0, 2000) : 1;
    const type = CMD_PARTICLES[name] || name;
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(1, count); i++) {
      const g2 = () => (Math.random() + Math.random() + Math.random() - 1.5) * 0.8;
      this.particles.spawn(type, pos[0] + d[0] * g2(), pos[1] + d[1] * g2(), pos[2] + d[2] * g2(), (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed, (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed, (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed);
    }
    ctx.say(`正在显示粒子 ${name}`);
  },
  damage(ctx, a) {
    const ts = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0])).filter(e => e instanceof Living),
      n = parseFloat(a[1]);
    if (isNaN(n) || n < 0) cmdFail('伤害量无效');
    const type = stripNs(a[2] || 'generic'),
      src = {
        type: type === 'generic' ? 'magic' : type
      };
    if (a[3] === 'by' && a[4]) {
      const by = cmdTargets(ctx, a[4])[0];
      if (by) {
        src.attacker = by;
        src.knockFrom = by.pos;
      }
    }
    for (const e of ts) e.hurt(n, src);
    ctx.say(`已对 ${ts.length === 1 ? cmdName(this, ts[0]) : ts.length + ' 个实体'} 造成 ${n} 点伤害`);
  },
  ride(ctx, a) {
    const t = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0]))[0];
    if (a[1] === 'dismount') {
      if (t === this.player && t.vehicle) {
        t.dismount();
        ctx.say(`${cmdName(this, t)} 已停止骑乘`);
        return;
      }
      cmdFail('该实体没有在骑乘');
    }
    if (a[1] !== 'mount') cmdFail('用法：/ride <目标> mount <载具> | dismount');
    const v = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[2]))[0];
    if (t !== this.player) cmdFail('这里只有玩家能被设为骑乘');
    if (v === t) cmdFail('实体不能骑乘自己');
    t.mount(v);
    ctx.say(`${cmdName(this, t)} 开始骑乘 ${cmdName(this, v)}`);
  },
  tag(ctx, a) {
    const ts = needTargets(cmdTargets(ctx, a[0])),
      op = a[1],
      name = a[2];
    if (op === 'list') {
      const all = [...new Set(ts.flatMap(e => [...(e.tags || [])]))];
      ctx.say(all.length ? `${ts.length === 1 ? cmdName(this, ts[0]) : ts.length + ' 个实体'} 共有 ${all.length} 个标签：${all.join(', ')}` : '没有标签', '#FFFFFF', true);
      return;
    }
    if (!name) cmdFail('用法：/tag <目标> add|remove|list <名称>');
    let n = 0;
    for (const e of ts) {
      const s = e.tags || (e.tags = new Set());
      if (op === 'add' ? !s.has(name) && s.add(name) : s.delete(name)) n++;
    }
    if (!n) cmdFail(op === 'add' ? '无法添加标签：目标已有此标签' : '无法移除标签：目标没有此标签');
    ctx.say(`已${op === 'add' ? '为' : '从'} ${ts.length === 1 ? cmdName(this, ts[0]) : n + ' 个实体'} ${op === 'add' ? '添加' : '移除'}标签 ${name}`);
  },
  random(ctx, a) {
    const r = a[1] || a[0];
    if (!r) cmdFail('用法：/random value|roll <范围>');
    const [lo, hi] = cmdRange(r);
    if (!isFinite(lo) || !isFinite(hi) || hi < lo) cmdFail('无效的范围');
    const v = randInt(lo, hi);
    if (a[0] === 'roll') this.ui.message(`${this.playerName || '玩家'} 掷出了 ${v}（从 ${lo} 到 ${hi}）`);else ctx.say('随机数：' + v, '#FFFFFF', true);
  }
};
CMD_RUN.teleport = CMD_RUN.tp;
