// runs one command line (the chat box, without the slash already checked); the commands the old runCommand had
// and these new ones are all here. src: a command block or command block minecart running it (cmdblock.js) - its
// position, its entity for @s (none for a block), its name for /say ("@"), and where feedback and errors go
// (say / fail); then the slash is optional, cheats don't matter, and it returns whether the command succeeded
function cmdExec(g, text, src) {
  const ui = g.ui,
    p = g.player;
  if (src && text[0] !== '/') text = '/' + text;
  const words = cmdWords(text.slice(1)),
    cmd = (words[0] || '').replace(/^minecraft:/, ''),
    a = words.slice(1);
  const ctx = src ? {
    g,
    pos: [...src.pos],
    rot: src.rot || [0, 0],
    entity: src.entity || null,
    src,
    name: src.name,
    say: (m, color, always = false) => src.say(m, always)
  } : {
    g,
    pos: [...p.pos],
    rot: [p.yaw, p.pitch],
    entity: p,
    say: (m, color = '#AAAAAA', always = false) => {
      if (always || g.rule('send_command_feedback')) ui.message(m, color);
    }
  };
  const err = m => {
    if (src) src.fail(m);else ui.message(m, '#FF5555');
    return false;
  };
  if (!src && !g.cheats && !['help', 'seed', 'me', 'msg', 'tell', 'w', 'list', 'trigger', 'random'].includes(cmd) && !(self.CMD_FREE && CMD_FREE.has(cmd))) return err('未知或不完整的命令，错误见下\n…/' + cmd + '<--[此处]');
  const fn = CMD_RUN[cmd];
  if (!fn) return err(`未知或不完整的命令「${cmd}」。输入 /help 查看命令`);
  try {
    fn.call(g, ctx, a);
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof CmdError) return err(e.message);
    err('执行命令时出现意外错误：' + e.message);
    console.error(e);
    return false;
  }
}

// ---- what the game rules do ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(() => {
  // advance_time / advance_weather
  const _tick = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function () {
    const t0 = this.worldTime,
      w0 = this.weatherTimer;
    const r = _tick.call(this);
    if (!this.net && this.state === 'play') {
      if (this.rule('advance_time') === false && this.worldTime !== t0 && !(this.ui.screen && this.ui.screen.pauses) && this.worldTime === t0 + 1) this.worldTime = t0;
      if (this.rule('advance_weather') === false && w0 !== undefined) this.weatherTimer = w0;
      // a thunderstorm: now and then a bolt within 64 blocks (vanilla ServerLevel.tickThunder: 1 in 100000 per chunk)
      if (this.thunder && this.weather > 0.8 && this.dim === 'overworld' && Math.random() < 1 / 400) {
        const p = this.player,
          x = Math.floor(p.pos[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 128),
          z = Math.floor(p.pos[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 128);
        if (this.world.isLoaded(x, z)) this.strikeLightning(x + 0.5, this.world.surfaceY(x, z) + 1, z + 0.5);
      }
      if (!this.rainTarget) this.thunder = false;
    }
    return r;
  };
  // keep_inventory, show_death_messages, immediate_respawn
  const _death = Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath;
  Game.prototype.onPlayerDeath = function (src) {
    const p = this.player;
    if (!this.net && this.rule('keep_inventory')) {
      const keep = p.inv.slots.slice(),
        xp = p.xp,
        msgs = this.ui.chat.length;
      p.inv.slots.fill(null);
      const r = _death.call(this, src);
      p.inv.slots = keep;
      p.xp = xp;
      this.deathScore = xp;
      if (!this.rule('show_death_messages')) this.ui.chat.length = msgs;
      return r;
    }
    const msgs = this.ui.chat.length,
      r = _death.call(this, src);
    if (!this.net && !this.rule('show_death_messages')) this.ui.chat.length = msgs;
    if (!this.net && this.rule('immediate_respawn')) setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.state === 'play' && this.player.deathTime > 0) {
        this.ui.close();
        this.respawn();
      }
    }, 1050);
    return r;
  };
  // fall / fire / drowning / freeze damage
  const _hurt = Player.prototype.hurt;
  Player.prototype.hurt = function (amount, src) {
    const g = this.game,
      t = src && src.type;
    if (!g.net) {
      if (t === 'fall' && !g.rule('fall_damage')) return false;
      if ((t === 'fire' || t === 'lava' || t === 'hotFloor') && !g.rule('fire_damage')) return false;
      if (t === 'drown' && !g.rule('drowning_damage')) return false;
      if (t === 'freeze' && !g.rule('freeze_damage')) return false;
    }
    return _hurt.call(this, amount, src);
  };
  // natural_health_regeneration: the full-food healing (peaceful's too)
  const _hunger = Player.prototype.hungerTick;
  Player.prototype.hungerTick = function () {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!g.net && !g.rule('natural_health_regeneration')) {
      const h = this.health;
      const r = _hunger.call(this);
      if (this.health > h && !this.creative) this.health = h;
      return r;
    }
    return _hunger.call(this);
  };
  // spawn_mobs / spawn_monsters / spawn_phantoms / spawn_wandering_traders
  const _spawn = Game.prototype.spawnMobs;
  Game.prototype.spawnMobs = function () {
    if (!this.rule('spawn_mobs')) return;
    const n0 = this.entities.length,
      ph = this.trySpawnPhantoms,
      tr = this.trySpawnTrader;
    if (!this.rule('spawn_phantoms')) this.trySpawnPhantoms = null;
    if (!this.rule('spawn_wandering_traders')) this.trySpawnTrader = null;
    try {
      _spawn.call(this);
    } finally {
      this.trySpawnPhantoms = ph;
      this.trySpawnTrader = tr;
    }
    if (!this.rule('spawn_monsters')) for (let i = n0; i < this.entities.length; i++) {
      const e = this.entities[i];
      if (e instanceof Mob && e.T && e.T.hostile) e.dead = true;
    }
  };
  // random_tick_speed: the random ticks each section gets (vanilla 3)
  const _rt = World.prototype.randomTick;
  World.prototype.randomTick = function (px, pz, rng) {
    const n = this.listener && this.listener.rule ? this.listener.rule('random_tick_speed') : 3;
    if (n === 3) return _rt.call(this, px, pz, rng);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.floor(n / 3); i++) _rt.call(this, px, pz, rng);
    if (n % 3 && Math.random() < n % 3 / 3) _rt.call(this, px, pz, rng);
  };
  // mob_drops / block_drops
  const _drop = Game.prototype.dropBlockLoot;
  Game.prototype.dropBlockLoot = function (...a) {
    if (!this.net && !this.rule('block_drops')) return;
    return _drop.apply(this, a);
  };
  // saved with the world
  const _save = Game.prototype.saveWorld;
  Game.prototype.saveWorld = function (quiet) {
    if (this.worldMeta && this.state === 'play') {
      this.worldMeta.gameRules = this.gameRules || {};
      this.worldMeta.thunder = !!this.thunder;
    }
    return _save.call(this, quiet);
  };
  const _load = Game.prototype.loadWorld;
  Game.prototype.loadWorld = async function (id) {
    this.gameRules = {};
    this.thunder = false;
    const r = await _load.call(this, id);
    if (this.worldMeta) {
      this.gameRules = Object.assign({}, this.worldMeta.gameRules || {});
      this.thunder = !!this.worldMeta.thunder;
    }
    return r;
  };
  const _create = Game.prototype.createWorld;
  // a new world, every mode: keep_inventory on from the start (the user's choice, 2026-11-01; /gamerule and the
  // options can still turn it off); older worlds keep what they had
  Game.prototype.createWorld = function (...a) {
    const fresh = () => ({
      keep_inventory: true
    });
    this.gameRules = fresh();
    this.thunder = false;
    const set = () => {
      const r = this.gameRules || (this.gameRules = {});
      if (r.keep_inventory === undefined) r.keep_inventory = true;
      if (this.worldMeta) this.worldMeta.gameRules = Object.assign({}, r);
    };
    const r = _create.apply(this, a);
    if (r && r.then) return r.then(v => {
      set();
      return v;
    });
    set();
    return r;
  };
})();
// mob_drops: no loot or experience from mobs (both kinds of mob drop through dropItem / dropXp while dying)
for (const C of [Mob, VMob]) {
  const _die = C.prototype.die;
  C.prototype.die = function (src) {
    const g = this.game;
    if (!g.net && !g.rule('mob_drops')) {
      const d = g.dropItem,
        x = g.dropXp;
      g.dropItem = () => {};
      g.dropXp = () => {};
      try {
        return _die.call(this, src);
      } finally {
        g.dropItem = d;
        g.dropXp = x;
      }
    }
    return _die.call(this, src);
  };
}

// ---- lightning (vanilla LightningBolt): a flash and thunder, 5 damage and fire around where it strikes (also
// what the channeling enchantment calls) ----
Game.prototype.strikeLightning = function (x, y, z) {
  const w = this.world;
  this.lightningFlash = 4;
  const p = this.player,
    d = Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - x, p.pos[2] - z);
  Sound.ev('entity.lightning_bolt.thunder', d < 32 ? [x, y, z] : null, 10000 / 16, 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.2);
  Sound.ev('entity.lightning_bolt.impact', [x, y, z], 2, 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.2);
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) this.particles.spawn('smoke', x + (Math.random() - 0.5), y + Math.random() * 2, z + (Math.random() - 0.5), 0, 0.05, 0);
  if (this.difficulty > 0 && this.rule('fire_spread_radius_around_player') !== 0) {
    const bx = Math.floor(x),
      by = Math.floor(y),
      bz = Math.floor(z);
    if (!w.getBlock(bx, by, bz) && BLOCKS[w.getBlock(bx, by - 1, bz)].solid) w.setBlock(bx, by, bz, this.fireIdAt(bx, by, bz), 0);
  }
  for (const e of [p, ...this.entities]) {
    if (!(e instanceof Living) || e.dead || e.deathTime) continue;
    if (Math.abs(e.pos[0] - x) > 3 || Math.abs(e.pos[2] - z) > 3 || e.pos[1] < y - 3 || e.pos[1] > y + 6) continue;
    if (e.onLightning && e.onLightning()) continue;
    if (!e.fireproof) e.fire = Math.max(e.fire || 0, 160);
    e.hurt(5, {
      type: 'lightning'
    });
  }
  this.flushMesh && this.flushMesh();
};

// ---- /title on the screen (vanilla Gui.renderTitle): fades in, stays, fades out; the subtitle under it ----
(() => {
  // (drawn with the HUD, before the chat: under any open screen, like vanilla)
  const _draw = UI.prototype.drawChat;
  UI.prototype.drawChat = function () {
    const t = this.titleState,
      g = this.game;
    if (t && t.title != null && g && g.state === 'play') {
      const age = g.tickCount - t.start,
        total = t.fadeIn + t.stay + t.fadeOut;
      if (age >= total) t.title = null;else {
        const a = age < t.fadeIn ? age / Math.max(1, t.fadeIn) : age > t.fadeIn + t.stay ? (total - age) / Math.max(1, t.fadeOut) : 1;
        const c = this.ctx;
        c.save();
        c.globalAlpha = clamp(a, 0, 1);
        c.translate(this.w / 2, this.h / 2);
        c.scale(4, 4);
        Font.center(c, t.title, 0, -10, '#FFFFFF');
        c.restore();
        if (t.sub) {
          c.save();
          c.globalAlpha = clamp(a, 0, 1);
          c.translate(this.w / 2, this.h / 2);
          c.scale(2, 2);
          Font.center(c, t.sub, 0, 5, '#FFFFFF');
          c.restore();
        }
      }
    }
    return _draw.apply(this, arguments);
  };
})();
</script>

/* ==== js/mods_ui.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The mods' screen (title: the 模组 button: download / delete), the mods each world has (ticked in 创建新的世界,
// 编辑世界 and the world list's 模组管理; the page loads the world's own - mods.js), the mods' credits.
// (the user 11-12: the lists scroll up and down - smoothly, no pages; each mod a card: an item it is known for
// (index.json "icon"), its Chinese and English names, a line of what it is; a world's mods ticked in a list)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const MOD_BLUE = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.55)';

// ---- smooth scrolling: the list follows a finger / the mouse dragging it and flies on when let go, slowing down;
// past either end it gives like rubber and springs back; the wheel glides to where it points ----
class SmoothScroll {
  constructor() {
    this.y = 0;
    this.goal = 0;
    this.v = 0;
    this.max = 0;
    this.held = false;
    this.t = 0;
    this.trail = [];
  }
  setMax(m) {
    this.max = Math.max(0, m);
    if (!this.held && !this.v) this.goal = clamp(this.goal, 0, this.max);
  }
  // the finger moved by d (GUI px, down +): the list goes with it - less and less the further past an end
  drag(d) {
    const out = this.y < 0 ? -this.y : this.y > this.max ? this.y - this.max : 0;
    this.y -= d * (out > 0 ? Math.max(0.12, 0.5 - out / 100) : 1);
    this.goal = this.y;
    this.held = true;
    this.v = 0;
    const now = performance.now();
    this.trail.push([now, this.y]);
    while (this.trail.length > 2 && now - this.trail[0][0] > 90) this.trail.shift();
  }
  // let go: on at the speed it was moving the last moment (none if the finger had stopped)
  release() {
    const tr = this.trail,
      now = performance.now();
    this.held = false;
    this.trail = [];
    this.goal = clamp(this.y, 0, this.max);
    if (tr.length < 2 || now - tr[tr.length - 1][0] > 70) return;
    const dt = (tr[tr.length - 1][0] - tr[0][0]) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.005) this.v = clamp((tr[tr.length - 1][1] - tr[0][1]) / dt, -3000, 3000);
  }
  wheel(d) {
    this.v = 0;
    this.goal = clamp(this.goal + d, 0, this.max);
  }
  // each frame: flying on (slowing down; hard past the ends), else gliding to the goal (a wheel's, or back in)
  step() {
    const now = performance.now(),
      dt = this.t ? Math.min(0.05, (now - this.t) / 1000) : 0;
    this.t = now;
    if (this.held || !dt) return;
    const out = () => this.y < 0 || this.y > this.max;
    if (this.v) {
      this.y += this.v * dt;
      this.v *= Math.exp(-(out() ? 30 : 3) * dt);
      if (Math.abs(this.v) < 8) this.v = 0;
      this.goal = clamp(this.y, 0, this.max);
      if (!out()) return;
    }
    const goal = clamp(this.goal, 0, this.max),
      d = goal - this.y;
    this.y = Math.abs(d) < 0.05 ? goal : this.y + d * (1 - Math.exp(-15 * dt));
  }
  moving() {
    return this.held || !!this.v || Math.abs(clamp(this.goal, 0, this.max) - this.y) > 0.05;
  }
}

// ---- a screen with a list of rows that scrolls that way: rows [{ h }] top to bottom, drawRow(ui, row, y) and
// clickRow(row, mx, y in the row) of its own; the list in this.area ----
class ModListScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, title) {
    super(game, title);
    this.titleY = 10;
    this.pauses = false;
    this.sc = new SmoothScroll();
    this.rows = [];
    this.contentH = 0;
    this.area = {
      x: 0,
      y: 34,
      w: 0,
      h: 0
    };
    this.t0 = performance.now();
  }
  // the rows' places in the list (y from its top) and how far it scrolls
  place() {
    let y = 4;
    for (const r of this.rows) {
      r.y = y;
      y += r.h + 4;
    }
    this.contentH = y;
    this.sc.setMax(y - this.area.h);
  }
  // (the scroll on whole device pixels: smooth, and the pixel font stays sharp)
  offset(ui) {
    return Math.round(this.sc.y * ui.scale) / ui.scale;
  }
  // (a mouse notch is ~100 CSS px; a touchpad sends small steps as it goes)
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    this.sc.wheel(Math.abs(dy) < 4 ? Math.sign(dy) * 30 : clamp(dy * ui.dpr / ui.scale, -90, 90));
  }
  // touch (touch.js): a finger down stops the list flying (and that tap isn't a click), its move, letting go
  touchHold() {
    this.halted = Math.abs(this.sc.v) > 60;
    this.sc.v = 0;
  }
  scrollPx(d) {
    this.sc.drag(d);
  }
  scrollRelease() {
    this.sc.release();
  }
  inArea(mx, my) {
    const a = this.area;
    return mx >= a.x - 4 && mx < a.x + a.w + 8 && my >= a.y && my < a.y + a.h;
  }
  // the mouse: pressed in the list, it drags it once moved; let go without moving, a click on the row there
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    if (b === 0 && this.inArea(mx, my)) {
      this.press = {
        y: my,
        ly: my,
        moved: false,
        stop: this.halted || Math.abs(this.sc.v) > 60
      };
      this.halted = false;
      this.sc.v = 0;
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  mouseMove(ui, mx, my) {
    const p = this.press;
    if (p && ui.mouse.down) {
      if (!p.moved && Math.abs(my - p.y) > 3) {
        p.moved = true;
        p.ly = p.y;
      }
      if (p.moved) {
        this.sc.drag(my - p.ly);
        p.ly = my;
      }
      return;
    }
    super.mouseMove(ui, mx, my);
  }
  mouseUp(ui, mx, my) {
    const p = this.press;
    this.press = null;
    if (p && p.moved) this.sc.release();else if (p && !p.stop && this.inArea(mx, my)) {
      const ly = my - this.area.y + this.offset(ui),
        r = this.rows.find(r => ly >= r.y && ly < r.y + r.h);
      if (r) this.clickRow(r, mx, ly - r.y);
    }
    super.mouseUp(ui, mx, my);
  }
  // the row under the mouse (not while the list is dragged; a finger leaves the mouse off the screen)
  hover(ui, r, y) {
    const a = this.area,
      mx = ui.mouse.x,
      my = ui.mouse.y;
    return !(this.press && this.press.moved) && !this.sc.held && mx >= a.x && mx < a.x + a.w && my >= Math.max(a.y, y) && my < Math.min(a.y + a.h, y + r.h);
  }
  // the list: its background, the rows in view (each fading in a little after the one above when the list comes),
  // shadows where it goes on under the edges, the bar on the right
  drawList(ui) {
    this.sc.step();
    const c = ui.ctx,
      a = this.area,
      oy = this.offset(ui),
      t = performance.now() - this.t0;
    ui.listBackground(a.y, a.y + a.h);
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(0, a.y, ui.w, a.h);
    c.clip();
    this.rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      const y = a.y + r.y - oy;
      if (y + r.h < a.y || y > a.y + a.h) return;
      const k = clamp((t - i * 45) / 220, 0, 1);
      if (k <= 0) return;
      c.globalAlpha = k;
      this.drawRow(ui, r, y + Math.round((1 - k) * (1 - k) * 8));
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    });
    let g = c.createLinearGradient(0, a.y, 0, a.y + 6);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, a.y, ui.w, 6);
    g = c.createLinearGradient(0, a.y + a.h - 6, 0, a.y + a.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, a.y + a.h - 6, ui.w, 6);
    c.restore();
    if (this.sc.max > 0) {
      const h = a.h - 4,
        bh = Math.max(16, Math.round(h * a.h / this.contentH)),
        f = clamp(this.sc.y / this.sc.max, 0, 1);
      const bx = a.x + a.w + 4,
        by = a.y + 2 + Math.round((h - bh) * f);
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      c.fillRect(bx, a.y + 2, 3, h);
      c.fillStyle = this.sc.moving() ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
      c.fillRect(bx, by, 3, bh);
    }
  }
}

// a mod's icon (index.json "icon": 16 px pictures drawn sharp, the 3D block ones bigger and smooth) in a slot like
// the inventory's; a mod without one (one installed with the SDK): the first character of its name
const modIconImgs = new Map();
function drawModIcon(ui, m, x, y, s) {
  const c = ui.ctx;
  c.fillStyle = '#373737';
  c.fillRect(x, y, s + 2, s + 2);
  c.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
  c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, s + 1, s + 1);
  c.fillStyle = '#8B8B8B';
  c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, s, s);
  let im = m.icon ? modIconImgs.get(m.id) : null;
  if (m.icon && !im) {
    im = new Image();
    im.src = m.icon;
    modIconImgs.set(m.id, im);
  }
  if (im && im.complete && im.naturalWidth) {
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = im.naturalWidth > 16;
    c.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    c.drawImage(im, x + 1, y + 1, s, s);
    c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  } else Font.center(c, String(m.name || m.id).slice(0, 1), x + 1 + s / 2, y + 1 + Math.floor((s - 8) / 2), '#FFFFFF');
}
// a card's frame: 1 px round it
function modFrame(c, x, y, w, h) {
  c.fillRect(x, y, w, 1);
  c.fillRect(x, y + h - 1, w, 1);
  c.fillRect(x, y + 1, 1, h - 2);
  c.fillRect(x + w - 1, y + 1, 1, h - 2);
}
// text in lines of at most w, at most max of them (the last cut with …); a line ends after a comma / 、 / space near its
// end when there is one (金属 was split over two lines), and no line starts with one
function modWrap(text, w, max) {
  const lines = [],
    BRK = '，、。；：！？ ,;:';
  let line = '';
  for (const ch of String(text || '')) {
    if (line && Font.width(line + ch) > w && !BRK.includes(ch)) {
      let cut = -1;
      for (let i = line.length - 1; i >= Math.max(1, line.length - 8); i--) if (BRK.includes(line[i])) {
        cut = i + 1;
        break;
      }
      if (cut > 0 && cut < line.length) {
        lines.push(line.slice(0, cut));
        line = line.slice(cut);
      } else {
        lines.push(line);
        line = '';
      }
    }
    line += ch;
  }
  if (line) lines.push(line);
  if (lines.length > max) {
    lines.length = max;
    lines[max - 1] = fitText(lines[max - 1] + '……', w);
  }
  return lines.length ? lines : [''];
}
const modMB = n => n < 102400 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 1024)) + ' KB' : (n / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
// the name: Chinese, then the English one in grey (cut to what is left of w)
function drawModName(c, m, x, y, w) {
  const zh = fitText(m.name || m.id, w),
    nw = Font.width(zh);
  Font.draw(c, zh, x, y, '#FFFFFF');
  if (m.en && nw + 6 < w - 12) Font.draw(c, fitText(m.en, w - nw - 6), x + nw + 6, y, '#9A9A9A');
}

// ---- the mods' screen: every mod as a card - download, delete, or built in ----
class ModsScreen extends ModListScreen {
  constructor(game, parent) {
    super(game, '模组');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.list = null;
    this.note = '正在读取模组列表…';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    Mods.loadIndex().then(ix => {
      this.list = Mods.listed(ix);
      this.note = '';
      this.t0 = performance.now();
      this.layout();
      if (Mods.dl && !Mods.dl.background) this.follow((ix.mods || []).find(m => m.id === Mods.dl.id));
    }).catch(e => {
      this.list = [];
      this.note = e.message;
      this.noteColor = '#FF5555';
      this.layout();
    });
    this.takeGift();
  }
  // the chef's hat (the user 11-13): given the first time the screen is really opened, logged in - the room service
  // gives it once (POST /api/account/gift/mods); shown as a little ceremony over the list. A guest is told to log in
  // and come back
  async takeGift() {
    const C = typeof Cosmetics !== 'undefined' ? Cosmetics : null;
    if (!C || typeof Account === 'undefined' || typeof RoomService === 'undefined' || !RoomService.base()) return;
    if (!Account.loggedIn) {
      this.guestGift = !C.has(MODS_GIFT);
      return;
    }
    if (C.has(MODS_GIFT) || ModsScreen.giftAsked) return;
    ModsScreen.giftAsked = true;
    try {
      const r = await Account.api('/api/account/gift/mods', {});
      if (r.account) Account.took({
        account: r.account
      });
      if (!r.fresh) return;
      if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('mods_gift');
      this.pop = {
        id: r.gift || MODS_GIFT,
        t0: performance.now()
      };
      Sound.ev && Sound.ev('entity.player.levelup', null, 0.8, 1);
      this.layout();
    } catch (e) {
      ModsScreen.giftAsked = false;
    } // (asked again next time)
  }
  // the gift's card: its two buttons
  popButtons() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = Math.floor(u.w / 2),
      cy = Math.floor(u.h / 2),
      P = {
        x: cx - 110,
        y: cy - 62,
        w: 220,
        h: 124
      };
    return {
      P,
      wear: {
        x: cx - 104,
        y: P.y + P.h - 26,
        w: 102,
        h: 20,
        label: '去穿戴',
        gold: true,
        act: () => {
          this.pop = null;
          Cosmetics.openWardrobe(this.game, this, MODS_GIFT);
        }
      },
      ok: {
        x: cx + 2,
        y: P.y + P.h - 26,
        w: 102,
        h: 20,
        label: '好的',
        act: () => {
          this.pop = null;
          this.layout();
        }
      }
    };
  }
  mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b) {
    if (this.pop) {
      if (b === 0 && performance.now() - this.pop.t0 > 400) for (const k of ['wear', 'ok']) {
        const w = this.popButtons()[k];
        if (ui.hit(w, mx, my)) {
          Sound.click();
          w.act();
          return;
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    super.mouseDown(ui, mx, my, b);
  }
  drawPop(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      t = (performance.now() - this.pop.t0) / 1000,
      {
        P,
        wear,
        ok
      } = this.popButtons();
    const k = Math.min(1, t / 0.35),
      e = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (0.55 * e).toFixed(3) + ')';
    c.fillRect(0, 0, ui.w, ui.h);
    c.save();
    // (the card flies in: grows from the middle, a little overshoot)
    const s = k < 1 ? 0.6 + 0.4 * e + Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 0.08 : 1,
      cx = P.x + P.w / 2,
      cy = P.y + P.h / 2;
    c.translate(cx, cy);
    c.scale(s, s);
    c.translate(-cx, -cy);
    c.globalAlpha = e;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(16,12,4,0.92)';
    c.fillRect(P.x, P.y, P.w, P.h);
    c.fillStyle = '#F2C94C';
    modFrame(c, P.x, P.y, P.w, P.h);
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(242,201,76,0.35)';
    modFrame(c, P.x + 2, P.y + 2, P.w - 4, P.h - 4);
    // the light behind the hat: rays turning slowly, sparks
    const ix = cx,
      iy = P.y + 38;
    c.save();
    c.translate(ix, iy);
    c.rotate(t * 0.6);
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      c.rotate(Math.PI / 6);
      c.fillStyle = i % 2 ? 'rgba(255,226,122,0.18)' : 'rgba(255,240,190,0.10)';
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(0, 0);
      c.lineTo(-5, -34);
      c.lineTo(5, -34);
      c.closePath();
      c.fill();
    }
    c.restore();
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const a = i * 2.4 + t * 0.9,
        r = 20 + (t * 18 + i * 7) % 18,
        tw = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 5 + i * 1.7));
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,236,150,' + (0.8 * tw).toFixed(3) + ')';
      c.fillRect(Math.round(ix + Math.cos(a) * r), Math.round(iy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.8), 1, 1);
    }
    const bounce = t < 0.9 ? Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7)) * (0.9 - t) * 10 : Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 1.2,
      S = 32;
    Cosmetics.drawIcon(c, this.pop.id, Math.round(ix - S / 2), Math.round(iy - S / 2 - bounce), S, false);
    Font.center(c, '第一次来模组界面', cx, P.y + 64, '#E0E0E0');
    Font.center(c, '送你一顶「' + Cosmetics.name(this.pop.id) + '」！', cx, P.y + 76, '#FFD24A');
    ui.button(wear);
    ui.button(ok);
    c.restore();
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      W = Math.min(u.w - 28, 340);
    this.area = {
      x: Math.floor(cx - W / 2),
      y: 34,
      w: W,
      h: u.h - 34 - 48
    };
    this.textW = W - 45 - 72;
    // (a tapped card opens under it to its usage - index.json "usage", the user 11-13: players didn't know how to use
    // 连锁挖矿; it stays open as the list is laid out again)
    const was = new Set((this.rows || []).filter(r => r.open).map(r => r.m.id));
    this.rows = (this.list || []).map(m => {
      const lines = modWrap(m.brief || m.desc || '', this.textW, 2),
        top = 32 + lines.length * 10 + (m.usage && m.usage.length ? 10 : 0),
        open = was.has(m.id) && !!(m.usage && m.usage.length);
      const use = open ? m.usage.flatMap(t => modWrap(t, W - 51, 4)) : [];
      return {
        m,
        lines,
        top,
        open,
        use,
        h: top + (open ? use.length * 10 + 16 : 0)
      };
    });
    this.place();
    this.widgets = [{
      x: cx - 100,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.back()
    }];
  }
  back() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.back();
  }
  // the player's download going on (not one fetched ahead), or its bar still running
  busy(id) {
    return !!Mods.dl && !Mods.dl.background && Mods.dl.id === id || !!this.anim && this.anim.id === id;
  }
  anyBusy() {
    return !!Mods.dl && !Mods.dl.background || !!this.anim;
  }
  // the bar: the real progress - but at least a second and a half from the click to full, also when everything was
  // already fetched ahead
  shown() {
    const d = Mods.dl,
      real = d && !d.background ? d.total ? Math.min(1, d.done / d.total) : 0 : 1;
    return this.anim ? Math.min(real, (performance.now() - this.anim.t0) / 1500) : real;
  }
  download(m) {
    this.anim = {
      id: m.id,
      t0: performance.now()
    };
    Mods.download(m).catch(() => {});
    this.layout();
    this.follow(m);
  }
  // the end of a download (started here or before): its note, the buttons again
  async follow(m) {
    if (!m || !Mods.dl) {
      this.anim = null;
      return;
    }
    let ok = true;
    try {
      await Mods.dl.promise;
    } catch (e) {
      ok = false;
      this.note = '下载失败：' + e.message + '（再点下载会从断开的地方接着下）';
      this.noteColor = '#FF5555';
    }
    if (ok && this.anim) {
      const left = 1500 - (performance.now() - this.anim.t0);
      if (left > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, left));
    }
    this.anim = null;
    if (ok) {
      this.note = m.name + ' 下载好了：在「单人游戏」里选中世界，点「模组管理」装上';
      this.noteColor = '#80FF80';
    }
    if (this.game.ui.screen === this) this.layout();
  }
  remove(m) {
    Mods.remove(m.id);
    this.note = '已删除 ' + m.name + ' 的资源';
    this.noteColor = '#A0A0A0';
    this.layout();
  }
  // a card's button (none for one built in), at the card's y
  // the right column of a card: its button (download / delete; none built in) over its tutorial map's, when it has one -
  // the two centred together
  btnY(r, y, i) {
    const two = !!r.m.tutorial && (typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('mods.tutorials'));
    return y + Math.floor(((r.top || r.h) - (two ? 38 : 18)) / 2) + (two ? i * 20 : 0);
  }
  action(r, y) {
    const m = r.m,
      a = this.area;
    if (Mods.always.includes(m.id)) return null;
    const got = Mods.isDownloaded(m.id),
      busy = this.busy(m.id);
    return {
      x: a.x + a.w - 66,
      y: this.btnY(r, y, 0),
      w: 60,
      h: 18,
      enabled: !this.anyBusy(),
      glowBlue: !got && !busy,
      label: busy ? Math.round(this.shown() * 100) + '%' : got ? '删除' : '下载',
      act: () => got ? this.remove(m) : this.download(m)
    };
  }
  // 教程地图 (the user 11-13: the demo maps made for the videos, in the game): a world of its own with the mod and the map
  tutorial(r, y) {
    const m = r.m,
      a = this.area,
      t = m.tutorial;
    if (!t || !(typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('mods.tutorials'))) return null; // (the admin panel can hide them: js/live.js)
    const got = Mods.isDownloaded(m.id);
    return {
      x: a.x + a.w - 66,
      y: this.btnY(r, y, 1),
      w: 60,
      h: 18,
      enabled: got && !this.anyBusy(),
      gold: got,
      label: '教程地图',
      tip: got ? ['一张专门的教程世界：沿路线体验' + m.name + '的玩法', '输入 /demo reset 整张地图重置'] : ['先下载' + m.name],
      act: () => openTutorial(this.game, m)
    };
  }
  clickRow(r, mx, ry) {
    for (const b of [this.action(r, 0), this.tutorial(r, 0)]) {
      if (b && b.enabled && mx >= b.x && mx < b.x + b.w && ry >= b.y - 1 && ry < b.y + b.h + 1) {
        Sound.init();
        Sound.click();
        b.act();
        return;
      }
    }
    // (anywhere else on the card: its usage, open or shut)
    if (r.m.usage && r.m.usage.length) {
      Sound.init();
      Sound.click();
      r.open = !r.open;
      this.layout();
    }
  }
  draw(ui) {
    super.draw(ui);
    if (this.pop) this.drawPop(ui);
  }
  // (the list stays put under the gift's card)
  wheel(ui, dy) {
    if (!this.pop) super.wheel(ui, dy);
  }
  scrollPx(d) {
    if (!this.pop) super.scrollPx(d);
  }
  drawRow(ui, r, y) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      a = this.area,
      m = r.m,
      hov = this.hover(ui, r, y),
      x = a.x,
      W = a.w;
    const built = Mods.always.includes(m.id),
      got = Mods.isDownloaded(m.id),
      busy = this.busy(m.id);
    c.fillStyle = hov ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.09)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)';
    c.fillRect(x, y, W, r.h);
    c.fillStyle = hov ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.13)';
    modFrame(c, x, y, W, r.h);
    // (a strip down the left: gold built in, green downloaded)
    if (built || got) {
      c.fillStyle = built ? '#E8B73A' : '#5FD35F';
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 2, r.h - 2);
    }
    drawModIcon(ui, m, x + 6, y + Math.floor((r.top - 34) / 2), 32);
    const tx = x + 45,
      tw = this.textW;
    drawModName(c, m, tx, y + 6, tw);
    r.lines.forEach((l, i) => Font.draw(c, l, tx, y + 17 + i * 10, '#D2D2D2'));
    const my = y + 17 + r.lines.length * 10,
      meta = (m.author || '') + ' · ' + (m.license || '') + (built ? '' : ' · ' + modMB(m.size || 0));
    const mt = fitText(meta, tw - 36);
    Font.draw(c, mt, tx, my, '#7F7F7F');
    if (got && !built && !busy) Font.draw(c, '已下载', tx + Font.width(mt) + 6, my, '#7FD87F');
    const b = this.action(r, y),
      tb = this.tutorial(r, y);
    if (b) ui.button(b);else Font.center(c, '已内置', x + W - 36, tb ? this.btnY(r, y, 0) + 5 : y + Math.floor((r.top - 8) / 2), '#F2C94C');
    // the usage: a hint to tap while shut; open, its lines under a thin rule
    if (m.usage && m.usage.length) {
      if (!r.open) Font.draw(c, '点开看用法 »', tx, my + 10, '#6FB8FF');else {
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
        c.fillRect(x + 6, y + r.top, W - 12, 1);
        Font.draw(c, '用法', x + 6, y + r.top + 5, '#FFD24A');
        r.use.forEach((l, i) => Font.draw(c, l, x + 33, y + r.top + 5 + i * 10, '#E6E6E6'));
        Font.draw(c, '« 收起', x + W - 6 - Font.width('« 收起'), y + r.h - 11, '#6FB8FF');
      }
    }
    if (tb) ui.button(tb);
    if (busy) {
      c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + r.h - 3, W - 2, 2);
      c.fillStyle = '#4AA8FF';
      c.fillRect(x + 1, y + r.h - 3, Math.round((W - 2) * this.shown()), 2);
    }
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    if (this.guestGift) Font.center(c, fitText('登录后再打开这里，送你一顶厨师帽', ui.w - 16), cx, 22, '#FFD24A');else Font.center(c, fitText('下载后，在「单人游戏」里选中世界，点「模组管理」勾选要装的模组', ui.w - 16), cx, 22, '#A0A0A0');
    this.drawList(ui);
    if (this.list && !this.list.length && !this.note) Font.center(c, '还没有模组', cx, this.area.y + 20, '#A0A0A0');
    if (this.note) Font.center(c, fitText(this.note, ui.w - 16), cx, ui.h - 42, this.noteColor);
  }
}

// ---- a world's mods (创建新的世界 / 编辑世界 / 模组管理): every mod with a box to tick; one not downloaded yet
// is shown greyed out - a tap on it opens the mods' screen to download it ----
class ModPickScreen extends ModListScreen {
  constructor(game, parent, chosen, onDone, opts = {}) {
    super(game, opts.title || '世界的模组');
    this.parent = parent;
    this.chosen = new Set(chosen || []);
    this.was = new Set(opts.was || chosen || []);
    this.onDone = onDone;
    this.opts = opts;
    this.list = null;
    Mods.loadIndex().then(ix => {
      this.list = Mods.listed(ix);
      this.t0 = performance.now();
      this.layout();
    }).catch(() => {
      this.list = [];
      this.layout();
    });
  }
  layout() {
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      W = Math.min(u.w - 28, 320);
    this.area = {
      x: Math.floor(cx - W / 2),
      y: 34,
      w: W,
      h: u.h - 34 - 50
    };
    this.rows = (this.list || []).map(m => ({
      m,
      h: 32
    }));
    this.place();
    const bw = Math.min(100, Math.floor((Math.min(u.w - 16, 316) - 8) / 3)),
      x0 = Math.floor(cx - (bw * 3 + 8) / 2);
    this.widgets = [{
      x: x0,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      label: '完成',
      onClick: () => this.done()
    }, {
      x: x0 + bw + 4,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      label: '下载模组…',
      onClick: () => this.toDownloads()
    }, {
      x: x0 + 2 * bw + 8,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: bw,
      h: 20,
      label: '取消',
      onClick: () => this.onEsc()
    }];
  }
  // (back here after, with the ticks as they are)
  toDownloads() {
    this.game.ui.open(new ModsScreen(this.game, new ModPickScreen(this.game, this.parent, [...this.chosen], this.onDone, Object.assign({}, this.opts, {
      was: [...this.was]
    }))));
  }
  done() {
    this.onDone([...this.chosen]);
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  onEsc() {
    this.game.ui.open(this.parent);
  }
  gone() {
    return [...this.was].filter(id => !this.chosen.has(id));
  }
  clickRow(r) {
    const id = r.m.id;
    Sound.init();
    Sound.click();
    if (!Mods.isDownloaded(id)) {
      this.toDownloads();
      return;
    }
    if (this.chosen.has(id)) this.chosen.delete(id);else this.chosen.add(id);
    r.flip = performance.now();
  }
  drawRow(ui, r, y) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      a = this.area,
      m = r.m,
      hov = this.hover(ui, r, y),
      x = a.x,
      W = a.w;
    const got = Mods.isDownloaded(m.id),
      on = got && this.chosen.has(m.id);
    if (!got) c.globalAlpha *= 0.6;
    c.fillStyle = on ? hov ? 'rgba(70,150,255,0.34)' : 'rgba(50,130,255,0.24)' : hov ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.09)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)';
    c.fillRect(x, y, W, r.h);
    c.fillStyle = on ? 'rgba(120,190,255,0.85)' : hov ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.13)';
    modFrame(c, x, y, W, r.h);
    // the box: ticked with a pop (it grows from small for a moment)
    const bx = x + 8,
      by = y + 10;
    c.fillStyle = hov ? '#FFFFFF' : '#A0A0A0';
    modFrame(c, bx, by, 12, 12);
    c.fillStyle = on ? '#2F7FE0' : '#101010';
    c.fillRect(bx + 1, by + 1, 10, 10);
    if (on) {
      const k = r.flip ? clamp((performance.now() - r.flip) / 140, 0, 1) : 1,
        s = 0.55 + 0.45 * k;
      c.save();
      c.translate(bx + 6, by + 6);
      c.scale(s, s);
      c.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
      // (the tick, 2 px thick: down the short side, up the long one)
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) c.fillRect(-4 + i, -1 + i, 2, 2);
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) c.fillRect(-1 + i, 1 - i, 2, 2);
      c.restore();
    }
    drawModIcon(ui, m, x + 26, y + 3, 24);
    const tx = x + 58,
      tw = W - 58 - (got ? 8 : 52);
    drawModName(c, m, tx, y + 6, tw);
    Font.draw(c, fitText(m.brief || m.desc || '', tw), tx, y + 18, '#A8A8A8');
    if (!got) Font.draw(c, '未下载', x + W - 46, y + 12, '#FF9090');
    if (!got) c.globalAlpha /= 0.6;
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2;
    Font.center(c, fitText(this.opts.world ? '世界：' + this.opts.world.name : '勾选这个世界要装的模组（可以装多个）', ui.w - 16), cx, 22, '#A0A0A0');
    this.drawList(ui);
    if (!this.list) Font.center(c, '正在读取模组列表…', cx, this.area.y + 20, '#A0A0A0');else if (!this.list.length) Font.center(c, '还没有模组', cx, this.area.y + 20, '#A0A0A0');
    // (taking one away from a world that has it: its blocks and items there are gone)
    const gone = this.gone();
    if (this.opts.existing && gone.length) Font.center(c, fitText('去掉 ' + gone.map(id => Mods.nameOf(id)).join('、') + ' 后，世界里它的方块和物品会消失', ui.w - 16), cx, ui.h - 43, '#FF5555');else Font.center(c, fitText('已选 ' + [...this.chosen].filter(id => Mods.isDownloaded(id)).length + ' 个 · 只在单人游戏里生效', ui.w - 16), cx, ui.h - 43, '#A0A0A0');
  }
}
// the way into the mods' screen (the title's 模组 button, the wardrobe's chef's hat): one place, so a condition can be
// put in front of it later (the user 11-13: e.g. following and 三连 a new video)
const MODS_GIFT = 'hat:chef';
// a mod's tutorial map (index.json "tutorial": { mod, name, seed, difficulty }): its world if there is one, else made -
// superflat, survival with cheats on, with the mod and the map's own (it builds itself on entering: tcdemo, fddemo)
async function openTutorial(g, m) {
  const t = m.tutorial;
  if (!t) return;
  if (!Mods.isDownloaded(t.mod)) Mods.markDownloaded(t.mod); // (the mod downloaded before tutorials came)
  if (typeof Telemetry !== 'undefined' && Telemetry.count) Telemetry.count('mods_tutorial:' + m.id);
  let list = [];
  try {
    list = await DB.listWorlds();
  } catch (e) {}
  const w = list.find(x => (x.mods || []).includes(t.mod));
  if (w) {
    g.ui.hideInput && g.ui.hideInput();
    g.loadWorld(w.id);
    return;
  }
  Mods.reloadWith([m.id, t.mod], {
    create: [t.name, t.seed, 'survival', true, {
      cheats: true,
      difficulty: t.difficulty || 0
    }]
  });
}
// the 模组 screen, and choosing a world's mods, ask what playing online asks (the user, 11-13): an account that follows
// the UP and gave the new video a 三连 (the service's gate, /api/gate). What the service already saw is enough - an
// account logged in by its identity code somewhere without Bilibili goes straight in; in Bilibili it's checked again
// on the way (unfollowed, it's asked again). A super administrator, and a page without a room service (a test page),
// go straight in. Only past this does the 模组 screen open - and give its gift (ModsScreen.takeGift)
async function modsGate(g, then, parent) {
  return then(); // 离线包：不要求登录/关注/三连，任何入口直接放行
  const gate = await Account.loadGate();
  if (!gate.requireAccount && !gate.follow && !gate.triple) return then();
  if (!Account.loggedIn) {
    Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_mods_login');
    return g.ui.open(new LoginScreen(g, () => modsGate(g, then, parent), () => g.ui.open(parent || new TitleScreen(g))));
  }
  if (Account.data && Account.data.super || Account.has('online')) {
    then();
    Account.checkUnlocks(true).catch(() => {});
    return;
  }
  try {
    await Account.checkUnlocks(true);
  } catch (e) {}
  if (Account.has('online')) return then();
  Telemetry.count && Telemetry.count('gate_mods');
  g.ui.open(new UnlockScreen(g, parent, gate.triple && gate.videos && gate.videos.length ? '模组需要关注 UP 主并给新视频三连（老视频的三连不算）' : '模组需要关注 UP 主', () => modsGate(g, then, parent)));
}
function openModsScreen(g, parent) {
  // 离线包：没有 B站账号服务，直接打开模组界面（不弹登录）
  g.ui.open(new ModsScreen(g, parent));
}
const modNames = ids => ids && ids.length ? ids.map(id => Mods.nameOf(id)).join('、') : '无';

// the title: a 模组 button under the others
(() => {
  const lay = TitleScreen.prototype.layout;
  TitleScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    lay.call(this);
    // (under 皮肤和披风 / 反馈问题; the options row moves 12 down to make room - at l + 108 it covered the bottom lines)
    // (glowBlue: the blue shine of 触控设置 - the flat light-blue fill looked plain, the user 11-07)
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      l = Math.floor(u.h / 4 + 48);
    // (the admin panel can take the mods' ways in away: js/live.js title.mods)
    if (typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('title.mods')) {
      for (const w of this.widgets) if (w.y === l + 84) w.y += 12;
      this.widgets.push({
        x: cx - 100,
        y: l + 72,
        w: 200,
        h: 20,
        label: '模组',
        glowBlue: true,
        tip: ['下载模组；在「单人游戏」里选中世界，点「模组管理」勾选'],
        onClick: () => openModsScreen(this.game, this)
      });
    }
    // (the page loaded again for a world: on into it, once)
    const b = Mods.boot;
    if (b && !b.done && (b.open || b.create)) {
      b.done = true;
      const g = this.game;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (b.open) g.loadWorld(b.open);else g.createWorld(...b.create);
      }, 0);
    }
  };
  Mods.loadIndex().catch(() => {});
})();

// ---- a world's mods ----
(() => {
  // making one: the mods picked (CreateWorldScreen's 游戏 tab); other than those loaded - the page loads again with them
  const cl = CreateWorldScreen.prototype.layout;
  CreateWorldScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    if (this.mods === undefined) this.mods = this.from && this.from.mods ? [...this.from.mods] : (window.__OFFLINE_MODS ? window.__OFFLINE_MODS.slice() : []);
    cl.call(this);
    if (this.tab !== 0) return;
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      foot = this.widgets.find(w => w.label === '创建新的世界');
    const last = this.widgets.filter(w => w !== foot && w.label !== '取消').reduce((a, w) => Math.max(a, w.y), 0);
    const y = Math.min(last + 28, u.h - 56);
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 105,
      y,
      w: 210,
      h: 20,
      glowBlue: true,
      label: () => fitText('模组：' + modNames(this.mods), 200),
      tip: ['这个世界装的模组（可以装多个）'],
      onClick: () => {
        this.game.ui.hideInput();
        modsGate(this.game, () => this.game.ui.open(new ModPickScreen(this.game, this, this.mods, m => {
          this.mods = m;
        })), this);
      }
    });
  };
  const cc = CreateWorldScreen.prototype.create;
  CreateWorldScreen.prototype.create = function () {
    const mods = this.mods || [];
    if (!Mods.same(mods, Mods.active)) {
      const hc = this.mode === 'hardcore';
      this.game.ui.hideInput();
      Mods.reloadWith(mods, {
        create: [this.name.trim() || '新的世界', this.seed.trim(), hc ? 'survival' : this.mode, this.flat, {
          hardcore: hc,
          difficulty: hc ? 3 : this.difficulty,
          cheats: !hc && this.cheats,
          structures: this.structures,
          bonus: this.bonus
        }]
      });
      return;
    }
    return cc.call(this);
  };
  // (重建 keeps the world's mods: CreateWorldScreen(game, parent, from) - this.from)
  // a world saved without a list of mods (one just made - createWorld saves it, then opens it): it has the mods this
  // page runs (the page always runs the mods of the world being played)
  if (typeof DB !== 'undefined' && DB.putWorld) {
    const pw = DB.putWorld.bind(DB);
    DB.putWorld = function (m, ...a) {
      if (m && m.mods === undefined) m.mods = Mods.active.slice();
      return pw(m, ...a);
    };
  }
  // editing one: its mods changed (a mod taken away: its blocks there are gone the next time it is opened)
  const el = EditWorldScreen.prototype.layout;
  EditWorldScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    if (this.mods === undefined) this.mods = [...(this.world.mods || [])];
    el.call(this);
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2;
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 100,
      y: 197,
      w: 200,
      h: 20,
      glowBlue: true,
      label: () => fitText('模组：' + modNames(this.mods), 190),
      tip: ['这个世界装的模组（可以装多个）'],
      onClick: () => {
        this.game.ui.hideInput();
        modsGate(this.game, () => this.game.ui.open(new ModPickScreen(this.game, this, this.mods, m => {
          this.mods = m;
        }, {
          existing: true
        })), this);
      }
    });
  };
  const es = EditWorldScreen.prototype.save;
  EditWorldScreen.prototype.save = async function () {
    this.world.mods = [...(this.mods || [])];
    return es.call(this);
  };
  // opening one: its mods downloaded (else the mods' screen), the page loaded with them (else loaded again for it)
  const lw = Game.prototype.loadWorld;
  Game.prototype.loadWorld = async function (id) {
    const meta = await DB.getWorld(id),
      want = meta && meta.mods || [];
    // (the list only names the mods: not waited for without any, nor more than 3 s - on a stalled connection the click
    // seemed to do nothing, 11-10)
    if (want.length) try {
      await Promise.race([Mods.loadIndex(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000))]);
    } catch (e) {}
    const missing = want.filter(m => !Mods.isDownloaded(m));
    if (missing.length) {
      this.ui.open(new ConfirmScreen(this, '这个世界用了模组：' + modNames(missing), '先在「模组」里下载，再打开这个世界', '去模组', yes => yes ? openModsScreen(this, new WorldListScreen(this)) : this.ui.open(new WorldListScreen(this))));
      return;
    }
    if (!Mods.same(want, Mods.active)) {
      this.ui.hideInput && this.ui.hideInput();
      this.ui.open(new LoadingModsScreen(this, want));
      Mods.reloadWith(want, {
        open: id
      });
      return;
    }
    this.modTips = Mods.active.length ? {
      at: 0
    } : null;
    return lw.call(this, id);
  };
  // (the user 11-13: many didn't know how to use 连锁挖矿 - on entering a world with mods, a line for each in the chat,
  // index.json "hint", a moment after the welcome line; again each time a world is opened)
  const tk = Game.prototype.tick;
  Game.prototype.tick = function (...a) {
    const T = this.modTips;
    if (T && this.state === 'play' && !this.net) {
      if (!T.at) T.at = performance.now();else if (performance.now() - T.at > 1500) {
        this.modTips = null;
        const ms = (Mods.index && Mods.index.mods || []).filter(m => Mods.active.includes(m.id) && m.hint);
        if (ms.length) {
          this.ui.message('这个世界装了模组（「模组」界面里点开卡片能看详细用法）：', '#FFD24A');
          for (const m of ms) this.ui.message('【' + m.name + '】' + m.hint, '#9FDCFF');
        }
      }
    }
    return tk.apply(this, a);
  };
  // the world list: 模组管理 - a row of its own under the other buttons (they and the list's bottom move up for it), lit
  // and clickable once a world is picked: its mods ticked in a list (the user 11-12)
  const wl = WorldListScreen.prototype.layout;
  WorldListScreen.prototype.layout = function () {
    wl.call(this);
    if (!(typeof Live === 'undefined' || Live.on('title.mods'))) return;
    const u = this.game.ui,
      cx = u.w / 2,
      g = this.game,
      w = this.shown()[this.sel];
    for (const b of this.widgets) b.y -= 24;
    this.listBottom -= 24;
    this.widgets.push({
      x: cx - 154,
      y: u.h - 28,
      w: 308,
      h: 20,
      enabled: !!w,
      glowBlue: !!w,
      label: () => !w ? '模组管理（先选中一个世界）' : fitText('模组管理' + (w.mods && w.mods.length ? '：' + modNames(w.mods) : '：没有装模组'), 296),
      tip: ['选中的世界装哪些模组：勾选（可以装多个）'],
      onClick: () => {
        g.ui.hideInput();
        modsGate(g, () => g.ui.open(new ModPickScreen(g, this, w.mods || [], async m => {
          w.mods = m;
          try {
            await DB.putWorld(w);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
          }
        }, {
          existing: true,
          title: '模组管理',
          world: w
        })), this);
      }
    });
  };
  // the world list: a world's mods under its name
  const wd = WorldListScreen.prototype.drawExtra;
  WorldListScreen.prototype.drawExtra = function (ui) {
    wd.call(this, ui);
    if (!this.worlds) return;
    const c = ui.ctx,
      cx = ui.w / 2,
      top = this.listTop,
      bottom = this.listBottom,
      rowH = 36,
      x0 = Math.floor(cx - this.rowW / 2) + 2;
    const list = this.shown(),
      vis = Math.floor((bottom - top - 4) / rowH);
    c.save();
    c.beginPath();
    c.rect(0, top, ui.w, bottom - top);
    c.clip();
    list.slice(this.scroll, this.scroll + vis + 1).forEach((w, i) => {
      if (!w.mods || !w.mods.length) return;
      const y = top + 4 + i * rowH,
        t = '模组：' + modNames(w.mods),
        tw = Font.width(t);
      Font.draw(c, fitText(t, 110), x0 + this.rowW - 6 - Math.min(110, tw), y + 1, '#80C8FF');
    });
    c.restore();
  };
})();
// (while the page loads again for a world's mods)
class LoadingModsScreen extends MenuScreen {
  constructor(game, mods) {
    super(game, null);
    this.mods = mods;
    this.pauses = false;
  }
  layout() {
    this.widgets = [];
  }
  drawExtra(ui) {
    Font.center(ui.ctx, mods_loadingText(this.mods), ui.w / 2, ui.h / 2 - 4, '#FFFFFF');
  }
}
const mods_loadingText = mods => mods.length ? '正在加载模组：' + modNames(mods) + '…' : '正在卸下模组…';

// the SDK's local test (?modtest=... on this computer - tools/modsdk): straight on to the title and the test world, without
// the agreement and the first-run questions (patched once every script is in: onboard.js comes after this file)
if (Mods.testing.length && typeof location !== 'undefined' && /^(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)$/.test(location.hostname)) {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const st = Game.prototype.startTitle;
    Game.prototype.startTitle = function (...a) {
      const s = this.settings;
      if (!s.onboarded) {
        s.onboarded = true;
        s.playerKind = s.playerKind || 'vet';
      }
      s.seenBuild = GAME_BUILD;
      if (typeof LEGAL !== 'undefined') s.legalV = LEGAL.v;
      if (typeof FPS_TEST_V !== 'undefined' && (s.fpsTestV || 0) < FPS_TEST_V) s.fpsTestV = FPS_TEST_V;
      this.saveSettings();
      return st.apply(this, a);
    };
  });
}

(function(){'use strict';// 匠魂 Tinkers' Construct (SlimeKnights, MIT licence) - the tool system: parts and tools made of materials (tools.js:
// self.TCON). A part stack carries its material (stack.tc = { m: 'iron' }), a tool stack its parts' materials in the
// tool definition's order (stack.tc = { m: ['iron', 'wood', 'flint'] }, broken: true when worn out). Their icons are
// the mod's own generated sprites for that material (sprites/<n>.png), stacked in the tool model's layer order.
(function(){const TC=self.TCON;const T=TC.tools,P=TC.parts,M=TC.materials;const L=(k,d)=>TC.lang[k]!==undefined?TC.lang[k]:d;// a material by its id - a variant (rock#andesite, wood#crimson) has its base's stats and traits
const MB=m=>M[String(m).split('#')[0]];// ---- the sprite sheets ----
const sheets=[];for(let i=0;i<TC.sheets;i++){const im=new Image();im.src='mods/tconstruct/sprites/'+i+'.png';sheets.push(im);}const sheetsReady=()=>sheets.every(im=>im.complete&&im.naturalWidth);// a material's look on a sprite base (MaterialRenderInfo): its own texture, then its fallback styles', then the grey
// base recoloured by its palette (grey_to_color: the grey level through the palette's points)
function spriteFor(base,mat){const S=TC.sprites,m=MB(mat),b=String(mat).split('#')[0];// (a pulled frame's own: limb_bottom#2 in a material is limb_bottom#2_wood)
if(base.includes('#')){const v=S[base+'_'+String(mat).replace('#','_')]||S[base+'_'+b];if(v)return{s:v};}// (a variant's own texture - head_rock_andesite - then its base material's)
if(S[base+'#'+String(mat).replace('#','_')])return{s:S[base+'#'+String(mat).replace('#','_')]};if(S[base+'#'+b])return{s:S[base+'#'+b]};// (a fallback style's sprite is grey: the material's colour multiplies it, as the vertex colour does in Java)
for(const f of m&&m.fallbacks||[])if(S[base+'#'+f])return{s:S[base+'#'+f],tint:m.color};if(S[base])return{s:S[base],pal:m&&m.palette,color:m&&m.color};return null;}const palCache=new Map();function paletteLUT(pal,color){const key=JSON.stringify(pal)+color;if(palCache.has(key))return palCache.get(key);const pts=pal?Object.entries(pal).map(([g,c])=>[+g,parseInt(c,16)]).sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]):null;const lut=new Uint8ClampedArray(256*4);for(let g=0;g<256;g++){let c;if(pts){let i=0;while(i<pts.length-1&&pts[i+1][0]<g)i++;const a=pts[i],b=pts[Math.min(i+1,pts.length-1)],t=b[0]===a[0]?0:clamp((g-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]),0,1);const ch=(v,s)=>v>>>s&255;c=[16,8,0].map(s=>Math.round(ch(a[1],s)+(ch(b[1],s)-ch(a[1],s))*t));}else{const v=parseInt(color||'FFFFFFFF',16);c=[v>>>16&255,v>>>8&255,v&255].map(x=>Math.round(x*g/255));}lut.set([c[0],c[1],c[2],255],g*4);}palCache.set(key,lut);return lut;}// (out: the size drawn at - 16, or 32 for a large tool in the world; dx, dy: a part's offset, in 16ths)
function drawSprite(k,base,mat,dx,dy,out=16){const f=spriteFor(base,mat);if(!f)return;const[si,sx,sy,w,h]=f.s,im=sheets[si];if(!im.complete||!im.naturalWidth)return;const scale=out/Math.min(w,h),ox=dx*out/16,oy=dy*out/16;if(!f.pal&&!f.color&&!f.tint){k.drawImage(im,sx,sy,w,h,ox,oy,w*scale,h*scale);return;}const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=h;const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.drawImage(im,sx,sy,w,h,0,0,w,h);const d=c.getImageData(0,0,w,h);if(f.tint){const v=parseInt(f.tint,16),rgb=[v>>>16&255,v>>>8&255,v&255];for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4)for(let j=0;j<3;j++)d.data[i+j]=d.data[i+j]*rgb[j]/255;}else{const lut=paletteLUT(f.pal,f.color);for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){if(!d.data[i+3])continue;const g=Math.round(d.data[i]*0.299+d.data[i+1]*0.587+d.data[i+2]*0.114)*4;d.data[i]=lut[g];d.data[i+1]=lut[g+1];d.data[i+2]=lut[g+2];}}c.putImageData(d,0,0);k.drawImage(cv,0,0,w,h,ox,oy,w*scale,h*scale);}self.tcDrawSprite=drawSprite;self.tcSheetsReady=()=>sheetsReady();// a stack drawn onto a canvas of its size
// ---- the ammo on a drawn bow, a loaded crossbow (TC ToolModel "ammo", in the pulled models - the user, 11-13): the
// ammo item's own picture over the tool, mirrored when "flip", at the model's offset for that frame (a large tool's
// large offset in its 32 px picture: 8 + the offset; a small one's as it is); a firework rocket on a crossbow or war
// pick is their own firework picture instead (firework.json's ammo texture). Offsets per frame 1-3, from TC's
// generated models: longbow/pulling_N (drawback_ammo, the arrow being drawn), crossbow and war_pick/pulling_3 (the
// loaded one) ----
const AMMO_ON={longbow:{flip:true,small:[null,[-3,-4],[-2,-3],[-1,-2]],large:[null,[-2,-2],[0,0],[1,1]]},crossbow:{flip:true,small:[null,null,null,[-1,-1]]},war_pick:{flip:false,small:[null,null,null,[1,-1]]}};const FIREWORK_TEX={};for(const[t,b64]of[['crossbow',''],['war_pick','']]){const im=new Image();im.src='data:image/png;base64,'+b64;FIREWORK_TEX[t]=im;}// what a launcher holds: the loaded ammo, or - the longbow being drawn - the arrow it will shoot (in creative with
// none, an arrow: what TC shows)
function ammoOf(st,frame){const t=ITEMS[st.id].tcTool;if(t!=='longbow')return st.charged&&st.charged[0]||null;if(!frame)return null;const g=typeof game!=='undefined'&&game,f=g&&g.findAmmo&&g.findAmmo(false);return f?f[1]:typeof ITEM_KEY!=='undefined'&&ITEM_KEY.arrow!==undefined?{id:ITEM_KEY.arrow,count:1}:null;}const ammoKey=(st,frame)=>{const a=AMMO_ON[ITEMS[st.id].tcTool]&&ammoOf(st,frame);return a?'|a'+a.id+(a.tc?JSON.stringify(a.tc.m):'')+(a.potion||a.p||''):'';};// an item's flat picture at 16 px: a tool or part of TC's from its own drawing, else the game's icon (tinted ones -
// tipped arrows - as the inventory draws them)
function itemPic(a){const def=ITEMS[a.id];if(!def)return null;if(def.tcTool||def.tcPart)return tcIcon(a);const g=typeof game!=='undefined'&&game,r=g&&g.renderer;if(!r||!r.iconAtlas)return null;const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=16;const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;if(typeof stackTinted==='function'&&stackTinted(a)&&r.stackIcon&&r.stackIcon(a.id,a))c.drawImage(r.stackIcon(a.id,a),0,0,16,16);else{const S=r.iconSize;c.drawImage(r.iconAtlas,...r.iconXY(a.id),S,S,0,0,16,16);}return cv;}function drawAmmo(k,st,out,frame){const t=ITEMS[st.id].tcTool,A=AMMO_ON[t];if(!A||!frame)return;const a=ammoOf(st,frame);if(!a)return;const big=out===32&&!!A.large,off=(big?A.large:A.small)[frame];if(!off)return;const fw=ITEMS[a.id]&&ITEMS[a.id].key==='firework_rocket';k.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;if(fw&&FIREWORK_TEX[t]){if(FIREWORK_TEX[t].complete)k.drawImage(FIREWORK_TEX[t],0,0,out,out);return;}const pic=itemPic(a);if(!pic)return;const u=big?1:out/16,x=(off[0]+(big?8:0))*u,y=(off[1]+(big?8:0))*u;k.save();if(A.flip){k.translate(x+16*u,y);k.scale(-1,1);}else k.translate(x,y);k.drawImage(pic,0,0,pic.width,pic.height,0,0,16*u,16*u);k.restore();}// (frame: the bow's string drawn back - its pulled models' textures, base#1-3, when the tool has them - TC's bows and
// crossbows ToolModel "pulling" overrides; 0: as it rests)

function drawTinted(k,base,rgb,out){const f=TC.sprites[base];if(!f)return;const[si,sx,sy,w,h]=f,im=sheets[si];if(!im.complete||!im.naturalWidth)return;const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=h;const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.drawImage(im,sx,sy,w,h,0,0,w,h);c.globalCompositeOperation='multiply';c.fillStyle='#'+(rgb&0xffffff).toString(16).padStart(6,'0');c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';c.drawImage(im,sx,sy,w,h,0,0,w,h);k.drawImage(cv,0,0,w,h,0,0,out,out);}// (a custom trim - the slime wings', the goggles' - has no texture per material: its grey one in the trim

(function(){'use strict';// 匠魂 Tinkers' Construct (SlimeKnights, MIT licence) - modifiers: the ones a tool's materials and definition give
// (traits) and the ones added at the tinker station (stack.tc.mods = { id: level }, slots they took in stack.tc.used,
// incremental progress in stack.tc.inc). Their definitions are the mod's data (tinkering/modifiers: modules); the
// module kinds that change play are read here - stats, enchantment-like bonuses, durability, conditional damage and
// mining speed (their formulas), area expansion, smelting, magnetism, fire, lifesteal, knockback, tool actions
(function(){const TC=self.TCON,MO=TC.modifiers,DEFS=MO.defs,T=TC.tools;const L=(k,d)=>TC.lang[k]!==undefined?TC.lang[k]:d;const strip=s=>String(s||'').replace(/^[a-z_]+:/,'');const roman=n=>n<=10?['','I','II','III','IV','V','VI','VII','VIII','IX','X'][n]:String(n);// ---- item tags and tool predicates (mantle: tag, set, and, or, inverted) ----
const tagSets=new Map();const inTag=(tag,id)=>{let s=tagSets.get(tag);if(!s){s=new Set(itemIds('#'+tag));tagSets.set(tag,s);}return s.has(id);};const matches=(ing,id)=>Array.isArray(ing)?ing.some(x=>matches(x,id)):typeof ing==='string'&&(ing[0]==='#'?inTag(ing.slice(1),id):ITEM_KEY[ing]===id);function toolPred(p,st,list){if(!p)return true;const t=strip(p.type);if(t==='tag')return inTag(p.tag.replace(/^minecraft:/,''),st.id);if(t==='set')return(p.items||[]).some(k=>ITEM_KEY[strip(k)]===st.id);if(t==='and')return(p.predicates||[]).every(q=>toolPred(q,st,list));if(t==='or')return(p.predicates||[]).some(q=>toolPred(q,st,list));if(t==='inverted')return!toolPred({...p,type:p.inverted_type},st,list);// (level 0: the tool lacks it; else at least that level)
if(t==='has_modifier'){const lv=(list||modList(st)).get(strip(p.modifier&&p.modifier.modifier))||0;return p.level===0?lv===0:lv>=(p.level||1);}return true;}const isTool=st=>!!(st&&ITEMS[st.id]&&ITEMS[st.id].tcTool);// ---- a tool's modifiers: traits (definition, materials, traits' own trait modules) and added ones ----
function modList(st){const out=new Map(),add=(n,lv)=>out.set(n,(out.get(n)||0)+lv);if(!isTool(st))return out;for(const[n,lv]of self.tcTraits(st))add(n,lv);for(const[n,lv]of Object.entries(st.tc&&st.tc.mods||{}))add(n,lv);// (trait modules: a modifier bringing others along - each once, at its fixed level or its level - on the tools its
// tool predicate takes: spilling_rod's spilling on fishing rods only)

function formula(f,vars){var _s$pop;const s=[];for(const t of f){if(typeof t==='number'){s.push(t);continue;}if(t[0]==='$'){var _vars$t$slice;s.push((_vars$t$slice=vars[t.slice(1)])!==null&&_vars$t$slice!==void 0?_vars$t$slice:0);continue;}const b=s.pop(),a=s.pop();switch(t){case'+':s.push(a+b);break;case'-':s.push(a-b);break;case'*':s.push(a*b);break;case'/':s.push(b?a/b:0);break;case'^':s.push(Math.pow(a,b));break;case'!-':s.push(b-a);break;case'!/':s.push(a?b/a:0);break;case'min':s.push(Math.min(a,b));break;case'max':s.push(Math.max(a,b));break;case'>=':s.push(a>=b?1:0);break;case'sqrt':s.push(a);s.push(Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,b)));break;case'abs':s.push(a);s.push(Math.abs(b));break;case'non-negative':s.push(a);s.push(Math.max(0,b));break;case'percent_clamp':s.push(a);s.push(Math.min(1,Math.max(0,b)));break;case'duplicate':s.push(a);s.push(b);s.push(b);break;case'swap':s.push(b);s.push(a);break;default:s.push(a);s.push(b);}}return(_s$pop=s.pop())!==null&&_s$pop!==void 0?_s$pop:0;}// the variables a module names (tool durability lost, a stat's multiplier, the target's health, ...)

function repairAmountOf(tool,mat){const def=tool&&ITEMS[tool.id];if(!def||!def.tcTool||!M[mat])return 0;const t=TOOLS[def.tcTool],mats=tool.tc&&tool.tc.m||[];let amount=0;t.parts.forEach((part,i)=>{const P_=P[part];if(!P_||!REPAIR_STATS.has(P_.stat)||String(mats[i]).split('#')[0]!==mat)return;const st=(M[mat].stats||{})[P_.stat];if(st&&st.durability>amount)amount=st.durability;});return amount;}// CraftingTableRepairKitRecipe: a damaged tool and one repair kit alone in the crafting grid - the kit's material's

self.tcCraftRepair=function(grid){let tool=null,kit=null;for(const st of grid){if(!st)continue;const d=ITEMS[st.id],k=d&&d.key;if(k==='repair_kit'){if(kit)return null;kit=st;}else if(d&&d.tcTool&&d.durability!==undefined){if(tool)return null;tool=st;}else return null;}if(!tool||!kit||!(tool.dmg>0)||!kit.tc||!kit.tc.m)return null;const amount=repairAmountOf(tool,String(kit.tc.m).split('#')[0])*KIT_VALUE.repair_kit/3;if(amount<=0)return null;return{...tool,count:1,tc:{...tool.tc},dmg:Math.max(0,tool.dmg-Math.floor(amount))};};function repair(be,max){const tool=be.slots[0],def=tool&&ITEMS[tool.id];if(!def||!def.tcTool||!(tool.dmg>0))return null;const t=TOOLS[def.tcTool],mats=tool.tc&&tool.tc.m||[];let mat=null;const recs=[];for(let i=1;i<=max;i++){const st=be.slots[i];if(!st){recs.push(null);continue;}const r=kitRecipe(st)||matRecipe(st);if(!r)return null;const b=String(r.mat).split('#')[0];if(mat===null)mat=b;else if(mat!==b)return null;recs.push(r);}if(mat===null)return null;// the most a repairable part of this material repairs

(function(){'use strict';// 匠魂 Tinkers' Construct (SlimeKnights, MIT licence) - the heating structures: the smeltery and the foundry
// (HeatingStructureMultiblock / MultiblockCuboid: walls of the structure's blocks around air, a floor under it, the

(function(){const TC=self.TCON,SM=TC.smeltery;const L=(k,d)=>TC.lang[k]!==undefined?TC.lang[k]:d;const INGOT=90,BUCKET=1000;const HF=self.tcHandlers,MELT=self.tcMelting,FUEL=self.tcFuel,FLD=self.tcFluid;const baseKey=k=>k.split('__')[0];const tags={};const inTag=(t,b)=>{let s=tags[t];if(!s)s=tags[t]=new Set(TC.btags[t]||[]);return!!b&&s.has(baseKey(b.key));};const STRUCT={smeltery:{frame:false,all:'tconstruct:smeltery',floor:'tconstruct:smeltery/floor',tank:'tconstruct:smeltery/tanks',wall:'tconstruct:smeltery/wall',ore:'smeltery'},foundry:{frame:true,all:'tconstruct:foundry',floor:'tconstruct:foundry/floor',tank:'tconstruct:foundry/tanks',wall:'tconstruct:foundry/wall',ore:'foundry'}};const DIR={north:[0,0,-1],south:[0,0,1],west:[-1,0,0],east:[1,0,0]};const stateOf=(g,x,y,z)=>{const b=BLOCKS[g.world.getBlock(x,y,z)];return b&&b.states&&b.states[g.world.getMeta(x,y,z)]||{};};const MSG=(k,d)=>L('multiblock.tconstruct.generic.'+k,d);// a block's state with one property changed (in_structure, active)
function setProp(g,x,y,z,prop,val){const id=g.world.getBlock(x,y,z),b=BLOCKS[id],st=b&&b.states&&b.states[g.world.getMeta(x,y,z)];if(!st||!(prop in st)||st[prop]===val)return;const want={...st,[prop]:val},m=b.states.findIndex(s=>Object.keys(want).every(k=>s[k]===want[k]));if(m>=0)g.world.setBlock(x,y,z,id,m);}// ---- detecting the structure (MultiblockCuboid.detectMultiblock: up to 14 x 14 inside, 64 high) ----
const INNER_LIMIT=14,MAX_HEIGHT=64;function detect(g,cx,cy,cz,kind){const S=STRUCT[kind],W=g.world,tanks=[];const isAir=(x,y,z)=>{const id=W.getBlock(x,y,z);return function forEachShell(s,fn){const[x0,y0,z0]=s.min,[x1,y1,z1]=s.max;for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)for(let z=z0;z<=z1;z++){const inside=x>x0&&x<x1&&z>z0&&z<z1&&y>y0;if(!inside)fn(x,y,z);}}// ---- the structure's tank: several fluids, the bottom one first (SmelteryTank) ----
const total=be=>be.fluids.reduce((a,f)=>a+f.a,0);function fillStruct(be,f,a,sim){const n=Math.min(a,(be.cap||0)-total(be));if(n<=0)return 0;if(!sim){const e=be.fluids.find(x=>x.f===f);if(e)e.a+=n;else be.fluids.push({f,a:n});}return n;}function drainStruct(be,a,sim){const e=be.fluids[0];if(!e)return null;const n=Math.min(a,e.a);if(!sim){e.a-=n;if(e.a<=0)be.fluids.shift();}return{f:e.f,a:n};}const structHandler=be=>({cap:be.cap,get:()=>be.fluids[0]||null,fill:(f,a,sim)=>fillStruct(be,f,a,sim),drain:(a,sim)=>drainStruct(be,a,sim)});// the controllers: their block entities by position, for the drains to find

function structBE(g,x,y,z,kind){const be=HF.beAt(g,x,y,z,'struct');be.sk=kind;be.fluids=be.fluids||[];be.mods=be.mods||[];be.fuel=be.fuel||{fuel:0,quality:0,temp:0,rate:0};be.tick=be.tick||0;be.slots=be.slots||[];return be;}function setStructure(g,be,s){const old=be.st;if(old&&(!s||old.min.join()!==s.min.join()||old.max.join()!==s.max.join()))forEachShell(old,(x,y,z)=>setProp(g,x,y,z,'in_structure','false'));be.st=s||null;const[x,y,z]=be.pos;setProp(g,x,y,z,'in_structure',s?'true':'false');if(!s)return;forEachShell(s,(x,y,z)=>setProp(g,x,y,z,'in_structure','true'));const[dx,dy,dz]=innerSize(s),n=dx*dy*dz;be.cap=be.sk==='foundry'?8*INGOT*(dx+2)*(dy+1)*(dz+2):12*INGOT*n;// items past the new size fall out in front of the controller (MeltingModuleInventory.resize)

function structFuel(g,be,consume){const tanks=be.st?be.st.tanks:[];const order=be.lastTank?[be.lastTank,...tanks.filter(t=>t.join()!==be.lastTank.join())]:tanks;for(const t of order){const h=HF.at(g,...t),temp=FUEL.tryLiquidFuel(be.fuel,h,consume);if(temp>0){if(consume)be.lastTank=t;return temp;}}return 0;}// alloying (AlloyRecipe): each recipe whose inputs are all in the tank, hot enough, once a time if the result fits
function canAlloy(fluids,cap,temp){return SM.alloys.some(r=>alloyOnce(fluids,cap,temp,r,true));}function alloyOnce(fluids,cap,temp,r,sim){if(temp<r.t)return false;const used=new Set(),drains=[];for(const[fs,a,cat]of r.ins){const i=fluids.findIndex((x,k)=>!used.has(k)&&fs.includes(x.f)&&x.a>=a);if(i<0)return false;used.add(i);if(!cat)drains.push([i,a]);}const drainA=drains.reduce((s,[,a])=>s+a,0),have=fluids.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.a,0);if(cap&&have-drainA+r.a>cap)return false;if(sim)return true;for(const[i,a]of drains)fluids[i].a-=a;const out=r.out[0],e=fluids.find(x=>x.f===out);if(e)e.a+=r.a;else fluids.push({f:out,a:r.a});for(let k=fluids.length-1;k>=0;k--)if(fluids[k].a<=0)fluids.splice(k,1);return true;}self.tcAlloy={canAlloy,alloyOnce};// entities inside: living ones take damage and give their fluid (EntityMeltingModule), items go into free slots
function entityMelt(g,be){const s=be.st,[x0,y0,z0]=s.min,[x1,y1,z1]=s.max;let melted=false;for(const e of g.entities){if(e.dead||!e.pos)continue;const[ex,ey,ez]=e.pos;if(ex<x0+1||ex>=x1||ez<z0+1||ez>=z1||ey<y0+1||ey>=y1+1)continue;if(e.stack){// (an item thrown in: into the first empty slot)

function alloyerInputs(g,be){const[x,y,z]=be.pos,out=[];for(const d of N6){const h=HF.at(g,x+d[0],y+d[1],z+d[2]),t=h&&h.get();if(t&&!(BLOCKS[g.world.getBlock(x+d[0],y+d[1],z+d[2])].key||'').includes('faucet'))out.push({h,t});}return out;}function alloyerTick(g,be){const[x,y,z]=be.pos,below=BLOCKS[g.world.getBlock(x,y-1,z)],formed=isHeater(below)||isFuelTank(below);const tryAlloy=(temp,sim)=>{const ins=alloyerInputs(g,be),fluids=ins.map(i=>({f:i.t.f,a:i.t.a}));for(const r of SM.alloys){if(!alloyOnce(fluids.map(f=>({...f})),0,temp,r,true))continue;const own=be.tank;if(own&&own.f!==r.out[0])continue;if((own?own.a:0)+r.a>ALLOYER_CAP)continue;if(sim)return true;// drain the inputs, fill the tank

// the slime leaves (by fortune a sapling, slime balls), slime grass (its dirt), congealed slime (its balls), the cobalt
// ore (raw cobalt), the crystal clusters (crystals) ... - until 11-10 each dropped the first item named in its table,

const lnum=(v,r)=>{if(typeof v==='number')return v;if(!v||typeof v!=='object')return 1;const t=strip(v.type);if(t==='uniform'){const a=lnum(v.min,r),b=lnum(v.max,r);return a+r()*(b-a);}if(t==='binomial'){let n=0;const k=lnum(v.n,r),p=lnum(v.p,r);for(let i=0;i<k;i++)if(r()<p)n++;return n;}return lnum(v.value!==undefined?v.value:1,r);};const function bentry(en,ctx,out){if(en.conditions&&!en.conditions.every(c=>bcond(c,ctx)))return false;const t=strip(en.type);if(t==='alternatives'){for(const ch of en.children||[])if(bentry(ch,ctx,out))return true;return false;}if(t==='group'){for(const ch of en.children||[])bentry(ch,ctx,out);return true;}if(t==='sequence'){for(const ch of en.children||[])if(!bentry(ch,ctx,out))break;return true;}if(t==='item'){let n=1;for(const f of en.functions||[])n=bfunc(f,n,ctx);if(n>0&&ITEM_KEY[en.name]!==undefined)out.push([en.name,n]);return true;}return t==='empty';}function rollBlockLoot(pools,ctx){const out=[];for(const p of pools){if(p.conditions&&!p.conditions.every(c=>bcond(c,ctx)))continue;const rolls=Math.max(0,Math.floor(lnum(p.rolls!==undefined?p.rolls:1,ctx.r)));const es=p.entries||[];for(let i=0;i<rolls;i++){if(es.length===1){bentry(es[0],ctx,out);continue;}const tot=es.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.weight||1),0);let x=ctx.r()*tot;for(const e of es){if((x-=e.weight||1)<0){bentry(e,ctx,out);break;}}}}return out;}self.tcBlockLoot=rollBlockLoot;for(const[k,pools]of Object.entries(TC.blockLoot||{})){const id=BID[k],b=id!==undefined?BLOCKS[id]:null;if(!b)continue;const ore=/_ore$/.test(b.key);b.drops=(meta,r,tool)=>rollBlockLoot(pools,{r:r||Math.random,tool,ore,state:b.states?b.states[meta]:null});}// ---- loot elsewhere (11-10: none of it was there) ----

function rng(seedStr){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<seedStr.length;i++){h^=seedStr.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}let s=h>>>0;const next=()=>{s+=0x6D2B79F5;let t=s;t=Math.imul(t^t>>>15,t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,t|61);return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};return{f:next,int:n=>Math.floor(next()*n),bool:()=>next()<0.5};}const weighted=(list,r)=>{const tot=list.reduce((a,e)=>a+e[1],0);let k=r.int(tot);for(const e of list){k-=e[1];if(k<0)return e[0];}return list[0][0];};// ---- a block state of ours by key and properties ----
